name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_finset_surjective
statement:
lemma exists_finset_surjective {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {f : R →+* A} (hf : f.FiniteType) :
    ∃ s : Finset A, Function.Surjective (eval₂Hom f (fun a : s ↦ (a : A)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hf.out
  refine ⟨s, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  have hb : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range (Subtype.val : s → A)) := by
    rw [Subtype.range_coe, hs]
    trivial
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval] at hb
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hb
  exact ⟨p, (aeval_eq_eval₂Hom _ p).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.Data.nonempty
statement:
theorem Data.nonempty [IrreducibleSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] : Nonempty (Data sY)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx (x : Y) : ∃ V : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ x ∈ V := by
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, -⟩ :=
      Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
    exact ⟨V, hV, hxV⟩
  choose V hV hxV using hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun x ↦ (V x : Set Y))
    (fun x ↦ (V x).isOpen) (fun x _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨x, hxV x⟩)
  have hgen (x : Y) : ∃ s : Finset Γ(V x, ⊤), Function.Surjective
      (eval₂Hom ((V x).ι ≫ sY).baseHom (fun a : s ↦ (a : Γ(V x, ⊤)))) := by
    have : IsAffine (V x) := hV x
    have hft : ((V x).ι ≫ sY).baseHom.FiniteType := by
      have h := (HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)
        (f := (V x).ι ≫ sY)).mp inferInstance
      exact h.comp (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.surjective)
    exact exists_finset_surjective hft
  choose s hs using hgen
  let η := genericPoint Y
  have hη (x : Y) : η ∈ V x :=
    ((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff (V x).isOpen).mpr ⟨x, trivial, hxV x⟩
  have hS : IsOpen (⋂ x : t, (V x : Set Y)) := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun x ↦ (V x).isOpen
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hηU, hUS⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_iInter.2 fun (x : t) ↦ hη x) hS
  have : IsAffine U := hU
  exact ⟨{
    I := t
    V := fun x ↦ V x
    isAffineOpen_V := fun x ↦ hV x
    iSup_V := by
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro y _
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ y))
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hy⟩
    G := fun x ↦ s x
    a := fun x a ↦ a
    surjective := fun x ↦ hs x
    U := U
    U_le := fun x ↦ hUS.trans (Set.iInter_subset (fun x : t ↦ (V x : Set Y)) x)
    dense_U := U.isOpen.dense ⟨η, hηU⟩
    quasiCompact_U := inferInstance }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chow
statement:
theorem exists_chow {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsIntegral Y] [IsProper sY] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (c : Y' ⟶ pullback sY (ProjectiveSpace.toSpec N R))
      (U : Y.Opens), IsClosedImmersion c ∧ IsClosedImmersion (c ≫ pullback.snd _ _) ∧
      (U : Set Y).Nonempty ∧ IsIso ((c ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ∣_ U) ∧ IsIntegral Y'
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace Y := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace sY
  have : QuasiSeparatedSpace Y := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated sY
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := Chow.Data.nonempty (sY := sY)
  exact ⟨d.N, d.Y', d.c, d.U, inferInstance, d.isClosedImmersion_q, d.dense_U.nonempty,
    d.isIso_π_restrict, d.isIntegral_Y'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chow_of_irreducibleSpace
statement:
theorem exists_chow_of_irreducibleSpace {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IrreducibleSpace Y] [IsProper sY] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (c : Y' ⟶ pullback sY (ProjectiveSpace.toSpec N R))
      (U : Y.Opens), IsClosedImmersion c ∧ IsClosedImmersion (c ≫ pullback.snd _ _) ∧
      (U : Set Y).Nonempty ∧ IsIso ((c ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ∣_ U) ∧ IrreducibleSpace Y' ∧
      IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant ((c ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace Y := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace sY
  have : QuasiSeparatedSpace Y := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated sY
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := Chow.Data.nonempty (sY := sY)
  exact ⟨d.N, d.Y', d.c, d.U, inferInstance, d.isClosedImmersion_q, d.dense_U.nonempty,
    d.isIso_π_restrict, d.irreducibleSpace_Y', inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.toSpecOfAlgMap_injective
statement:
theorem toSpecOfAlgMap_injective (X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}) :
    Function.Injective (toSpecOfAlgMap (R := R) X)
proof:
:= by
  intro α α' h
  rw [toSpecOfAlgMap_eq_homEquiv, toSpecOfAlgMap_eq_homEquiv] at h
  have := (ΓSpec.locallyRingedSpaceAdjunction.homEquiv X (op (CommRingCat.of R))).injective h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosedImmersion_morphismRestrict_of_graph
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_morphismRestrict_of_graph (c : X ⟶ pullback sY sP)
    [IsClosedImmersion c] (V : P.Opens) {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion t]
    (ρ : T ⟶ Y) (hρ : ρ ≫ sY = t ≫ V.ι ≫ sP)
    (u : ((c ≫ pullback.snd sY sP) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ⟶ T)
    (hu₁ : u ≫ t = (c ≫ pullback.snd sY sP) ∣_ V)
    (hu₂ : u ≫ ρ = Scheme.Opens.ι _ ≫ c ≫ pullback.fst sY sP) :
    IsClosedImmersion ((c ≫ pullback.snd sY sP) ∣_ V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu₁]
  suffices IsClosedImmersion u from inferInstance
  let O : (pullback sY sP).Opens := pullback.snd sY sP ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let γ : T ⟶ pullback sY sP := pullback.lift ρ (t ≫ V.ι) (by rw [hρ, Category.assoc])
  have hγ : Set.range γ ⊆ (O : Set _) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change pullback.snd sY sP (γ x) ∈ V
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.lift_snd, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (t x).2
  let γ' : T ⟶ O := IsOpenImmersion.lift O.ι γ (by simpa using hγ)
  have hγ' : γ' ≫ O.ι = γ := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have : Mono γ := by
    have : Mono (γ ≫ pullback.snd sY sP) := by rw [pullback.lift_snd]; infer_instance
    exact mono_of_mono γ (pullback.snd sY sP)
  have : Mono γ' := by
    have : Mono (γ' ≫ O.ι) := by rw [hγ']; infer_instance
    exact mono_of_mono γ' O.ι
  have key : u ≫ γ' = (X.isoOfEq (by rfl : c ⁻¹ᵁ O = _)).inv ≫ (c ∣_ O) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono O.ι, Category.assoc, hγ', Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι]
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp only [γ, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst, hu₂, Scheme.isoOfEq_inv_ι_assoc]
    · simp only [γ, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd, reassoc_of% hu₁, morphismRestrict_ι,
        Scheme.isoOfEq_inv_ι_assoc]
  have : IsClosedImmersion (u ≫ γ') := key ▸ inferInstance
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp u γ'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosedImmersion_of_isClosed_range_of_cover
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_isClosed_range_of_cover {X P : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ P)
    (hq : IsClosed (Set.range q)) {α : Type*} (V : α → P.Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x, ∃ a, q x ∈ V a) (h : ∀ a, IsClosedImmersion (q ∣_ V a)) :
    IsClosedImmersion q
proof:
:= by
  let O : P.Opens := ⟨(Set.range q)ᶜ, hq.isOpen_compl⟩
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top (fun o : Option α ↦ o.elim O V) ?_ ?_
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro p _
    by_cases hp : p ∈ Set.range q
    · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hV x
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨some a, ha⟩
    · exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨none, hp⟩
  · rintro (_ | a)
    · have : IsEmpty (q ⁻¹ᵁ O) := ⟨fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ hx ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
      change IsClosedImmersion (q ∣_ O)
      infer_instance
    · exact h a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_comp_ι
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_isPullback (f := g ≫ V.ι) (g := V.ι) (pX := 𝟙 X) (IsPullback.flip ?_)
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback g (𝟙 X) V.ι (g ≫ V.ι) (Category.id_comp _) ?_
  ext x
  exact iff_of_true ⟨g x, rfl⟩ ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.ι_of_fac
statement:
lemma IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.ι_of_fac {W X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens} (g : W ⟶ V)
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant i] (h : g ≫ V.ι = i) :
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant V.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant_iff, eq_bot_iff, ← i.ker_eq_bot, ← h]
  exact Scheme.Hom.le_ker_comp _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant_of_isSeparated
proof:
:= by
  let X' : Over Z := Over.mk (f ≫ s)
  let Y' : Over Z := Over.mk s
  let U' : Over Z := Over.mk (ι ≫ f ≫ s)
  let f' : X' ⟶ Y' := Over.homMk f
  let g' : X' ⟶ Y' := Over.homMk g
  let ι' : U' ⟶ X' := Over.homMk ι
  have : IsSeparated Y'.hom := ‹_›
  have hι : ι' ≫ f' = ι' ≫ g' := by ext1; exact hU
  have hfac : (equalizer.lift ι' hι).left ≫ (equalizer.ι f' g').left = ι := by
    rw [← Over.comp_left, equalizer.lift_ι]
    rfl
  have : IsIso (equalizer.ι f' g').left := by
    have : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
        ((equalizer.lift ι' hι).left ≫ (equalizer.ι f' g').left) := by
      rw [hfac]; exact (inferInstance : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant ι)
    rw [IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff,
      ← ((equalizer.lift ι' hι).left ≫ (equalizer.ι f' g').left).ker_eq_bot]
    exact Scheme.Hom.le_ker_comp _ _
  exact (cancel_epi (equalizer.ι f' g').left).1 congr($(equalizer.condition f' g').left)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isReduced_image

name: AlgebraicGeometry.graphClosureι_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma graphClosureι_ι : graphClosureι sY sP U g hg ≫ (graphClosureFst sY sP U g hg ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι =
    (graphMap sY sP U g hg).toImage
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_graphClosureFst_restrict
statement: lemma isIso_graphClosureFst_restrict : IsIso (graphClosureFst sY sP U g hg ∣_ U)
proof:
:= by
  set Γ := graphMap sY sP U g hg
  set π := graphClosureFst sY sP U g hg
  set ι' := graphClosureι sY sP U g hg
  have hπ : Γ.toImage ≫ π = U.ι := by simp [π, Γ]
  have hq : Γ.toImage ≫ graphClosureSnd sY sP U g hg = g := by simp [Γ]
  have hι' : ι' ≫ (π ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = Γ.toImage := graphClosureι_ι ..
  have h₂ : ι' ≫ π ∣_ U = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono U.ι, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, reassoc_of% hι', hπ,
      Category.id_comp]
  refine ⟨ι', ?_, h₂⟩
  rw [← cancel_mono ((π ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ Γ.imageι), Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hι',
    Γ.toImage_imageι, Category.id_comp]
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, graphMap_fst, Γ]
    exact morphismRestrict_ι π U
  · simp only [Category.assoc, graphMap_snd, Γ]
    refine ext_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant_of_isSeparated sP ?_ ι' ?_
    · simp only [Category.assoc, hg]
      rw [← Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
        pullback.condition]
    · simp only [reassoc_of% h₂, reassoc_of% hι']
      exact hq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι
statement:
lemma germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι (U : X.affineOpens) (y : X) (hy : y ∈ U.1)
    (s : Γ(X, U.1)) (hs : s ∈ I.ideal U) :
    X.presheaf.germ U.1 y hy s ∈ I.subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y
proof:
:= by
  refine I.subschemeι.toLRSHom.germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal y hy s ?_
  rw [← I.ker_subschemeι_app U] at hs
  exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι (U : X.affineOpens) (y : X) (hy : y ∈ U.1) :
    I.subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y =
      (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 y hy).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun r hr ↦ ?_) (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun s hs ↦
    I.germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι U y hy s hs)
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, s, hs0, rfl⟩ :=
    I.subschemeι.toLRSHom.exists_germ_eq_of_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal y r hr
  obtain ⟨h, hhV, hyh⟩ := U.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V) ⟨y, hyV⟩ hy
  let s' : Γ(X, X.basicOpen h) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hhV).op s
  have hs' : s' ∈ I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen h) := by
    rw [← I.ker_subschemeι_app]
    exact I.subschemeι.app_map_eq_zero hhV s hs0
  rw [← I.map_ideal (X.affineBasicOpen_le h)] at hs'
  have key : (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.affineBasicOpen_le h)).op).hom ≤
      ((I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 y hy).hom).comap
        (X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen h) y hyh).hom := by
    refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun a ha ↦ ?_
    have e : X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen h) y hyh
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.affineBasicOpen_le h)).op a) = X.presheaf.germ U.1 y hy a :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
    refine Ideal.mem_comap.2 ?_
    change X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen h) y hyh
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.affineBasicOpen_le h)).op a) ∈
        (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 y hy).hom
    rw [e]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
  have e2 : X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen h) y hyh s' = X.presheaf.germ V y hyV s :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [← e2]
  exact key hs'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι_pow
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι_pow (n : ℕ) (y : X) :
    (I ^ n).subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y =
      I.subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : X.affineOpens, y ∈ (U : X.Opens) :=
    Opens.mem_iSup.1 (by rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial)
  rw [pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι _ U y hU, pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι _ U y hU,
    ← Ideal.map_pow, ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι_vanishingIdeal_le
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι_vanishingIdeal_le {Z Z' : Closeds X} {y : X}
    {V : X.Opens} (hyV : y ∈ V) (hV : (Z : Set X) ∩ V ⊆ Z') :
    (vanishingIdeal Z').subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ≤
      (vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hyU, hUV⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (SetLike.mem_coe.2 hyV) V.isOpen
  rw [pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι _ ⟨U, hU⟩ y hyU,
    pushforwardStalkIdeal_subschemeι _ ⟨U, hU⟩ y hyU]
  refine Ideal.map_mono ?_
  rw [vanishingIdeal_ideal, vanishingIdeal_ideal]
  refine PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_anti_mono fun p hp ↦ hV ⟨hp, hUV ?_⟩
  exact hU.range_fromSpec ▸ Set.mem_range_self p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.locallyFinite_irreducibleComponents

theorem Scheme.locallyFinite_irreducibleComponents [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    LocallyFinite (fun Z : irreducibleComponents X ↦ (Z : Set X))

    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  have : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩

name: PrimeSpectrum.mem_radical_of_basicOpen_subset

    (h : (basicOpen g : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) ⊆ ⋃ i, (basicOpen (f i) : Set _)) :

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_mul

:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [Opens.coe_inf, hD, hD, hD, ← Set.image_inter h.injective, basicOpen_mul]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_prod
statement: lemma localizing_prod (n : ℕ) (g : Fin (n + 1) → A) : D (∏ a, g a) = ⨅ a, D (g a)

:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_isBasis
statement: lemma localizing_isBasis : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
  intro V x hx
  let V' : Opens (PrimeSpectrum A) := ⟨h ⁻¹' V, V.2.preimage h.continuous⟩
  obtain ⟨W, ⟨a, rfl⟩, hxW, hWV⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 isBasis_basic_opens
    (show h.symm x ∈ V' by simpa [V'] using hx)
  refine ⟨D a, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change x ∈ (D a : Set Y)
    rw [hD]
    exact ⟨h.symm x, hxW, by simp⟩
  · rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe, hD]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hWV hy

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_isCompact
statement: lemma localizing_isCompact (a : A) : IsCompact (D a : Set Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hD]
  exact (isCompact_basicOpen a).image h.continuous

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_dvd_of_le
statement: lemma localizing_dvd_of_le {a b : A} (hab : D b ≤ D a) : ∃ n, a ∣ b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizing_le_iff h D hD, basicOpen_le_basicOpen_iff] at hab
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hab
  exact ⟨n, Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hn⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.localizing_mem_radical
statement:
lemma localizing_mem_radical {ι : Type*} (f : ι → A) (g : A) (hfg : ⨆ i, D (f i) = D g) :
    g ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).radical
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_radical_of_basicOpen_subset
  intro x hx
  have : h x ∈ ((⨆ i, D (f i) : Opens Y) : Set Y) := by
    rw [hfg, hD]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [Opens.coe_iSup] at this
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 this
  rw [hD] at hi
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hi
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, h.injective hyx ▸ hy⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.map_map_apply
statement:
lemma map_map_apply (P : (Opens Y)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U V W : Opens Y} (i : U ⟶ V)
    (j : V ⟶ W) (k : U ⟶ W) (x : P.obj (op W)) : P.map i.op (P.map j.op x) = P.map k.op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← P.map_comp]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isCechAcyclic_of_localizing
statement:
lemma isCechAcyclic_of_localizing {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (f : ι → A) (g : A)
    (hfg : ⨆ i, D (f i) = D g) : Presheaf.IsCechAcyclic (fun i ↦ D (f i)) G.obj
proof:
:= by
  let U : ι → Opens Y := fun i ↦ D (f i)
  have hprod {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin (n + 1) → ι) : Presheaf.cechOpen U σ = D (∏ a, f (σ a)) :=
    (localizing_prod h D hD n (fun a ↦ f (σ a))).symm
  let e {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin (n + 1) → ι) :
      LocalizedModule (powers (∏ a, f (σ a))) N ≃+ G.obj.obj (op (Presheaf.cechOpen U σ)) :=
    (ψ _).trans (G.obj.mapIso (eqToIso (hprod σ)).op).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  have he {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin (n + 1) → ι) (y) :
      e σ y = G.obj.map (homOfLE (hprod σ).le).op (ψ _ y) := rfl
  let E (n : ℕ) (x : LocalizedModule.cechObj N f n) : Presheaf.CechCochain U G.obj n :=
    fun σ ↦ e σ (x σ)
  have hE (n : ℕ) (x : LocalizedModule.cechObj N f n) :
      Presheaf.cechD U G.obj n (E n x) = E (n + 1) (LocalizedModule.cechD N f n x) := by
    funext τ
    simp only [E, Presheaf.cechD_apply, LocalizedModule.cechD_apply, map_sum, map_zsmul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    have hle : D (∏ a, f (τ a)) ≤ D (∏ a, f (τ (j.succAbove a))) := by
      rw [← hprod, ← hprod]
      exact Presheaf.cechOpen_le_comp U τ j.succAbove
    rw [he, he, ← hψ _ _ _ hle]
    exact (map_map_apply _ _ _ (homOfLE ((hprod τ).le.trans hle)) _).trans
      (map_map_apply _ _ _ _ _).symm
  have hEinj (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (E n) := fun x y hxy ↦
    funext fun σ ↦ (e σ).injective (congrFun hxy σ)
  have hEsurj (n : ℕ) (c : Presheaf.CechCochain U G.obj n) :
      E n (fun σ ↦ (e σ).symm (c σ)) = c :=
    funext fun σ ↦ (e σ).apply_symm_apply (c σ)
  have hE0 (n : ℕ) : E n 0 = 0 := funext fun σ ↦ map_zero (e σ)
  have hex (n : ℕ) : Function.Exact (LocalizedModule.cechD N f n)
      (LocalizedModule.cechD N f (n + 1)) := by
    refine LocalizedModule.cechD_exact_of_mem_radical N f
      (localizing_mem_radical h D hD f g hfg) (fun i ↦ localizing_dvd_of_le h D hD ?_) n
    rw [← hfg]
    exact le_iSup (fun i ↦ D (f i)) i
  rw [Presheaf.isCechAcyclic_iff]
  intro n c hc
  rw [← hEsurj (n + 1) c, hE, ← hE0] at hc
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ((hex n) _).1 (hEinj _ hc)
  exact ⟨E n y, by rw [hE, hy, hEsurj]⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isCechAcyclic_of_localizing'
statement:
lemma isCechAcyclic_of_localizing' (ι : Type u) (U : ι → Opens Y) [Finite ι]
    (hU : ∀ i, U i ∈ Set.range D) (hsup : ⨆ i, U i ∈ Set.range D) :
    Presheaf.IsCechAcyclic U G.obj
proof:
:= by
  choose f hf using hU
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsup
  obtain rfl : U = fun i ↦ D (f i) := funext fun i ↦ (hf i).symm
  exact isCechAcyclic_of_localizing h D hD N G ψ hψ f g hg.symm

name: TopCat.Sheaf.inf_mem_range
statement:
lemma inf_mem_range {a b : Opens Y} (ha : a ∈ Set.range D) (hb : b ∈ Set.range D) :
    a ⊓ b ∈ Set.range D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hb
  exact ⟨a * b, localizing_mul h D hD a b⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_localizing
statement:
theorem H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_localizing (B : Opens Y) (hB : B ∈ Set.range D) (q : ℕ)
    (x : H ((restrictOpen B).obj G) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  cartan_of_isCompact (Set.range D) (fun _ ha _ hb ↦ inf_mem_range h D hD ha hb)
    (localizing_isBasis h D hD) (by rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact localizing_isCompact h D hD a) G
    (fun ι U _ hU hsup ↦ isCechAcyclic_of_localizing' h D hD N G ψ hψ ι U hU hsup) B hB q x

name: TopCat.Sheaf.H_eq_zero_of_localizing
statement: theorem H_eq_zero_of_localizing (q : ℕ) (x : H G (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let U : PUnit.{u + 1} → Opens Y := fun _ ↦ D 1
  have hU : ∀ i, U i ∈ Set.range D := fun _ ↦ ⟨1, rfl⟩
  exact H_eq_zero_of_isCechAcyclic U (by simp [U, localizing_one h D hD]) G
    (fun n σ q' y ↦ H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_localizing h D hD N G ψ hψ _
      (cechOpen_mem (fun _ ha _ hb ↦ inf_mem_range h D hD ha hb) hU σ) q' y)
    (isCechAcyclic_of_localizing' h D hD N G ψ hψ _ U hU ⟨1, by simp [U]⟩) q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_basicOpenLocalizationEquiv
statement:
lemma map_basicOpenLocalizationEquiv (a b : R) (hd : ∃ n, a ∣ b ^ n)
    (hab : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen b ≤ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)
    (x : LocalizedModule (powers a) ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hab).op (basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M a x) =
      basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M b (LocalizedModule.awayMap _ hd x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen M a
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen M b
  let N := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)
  have key : ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hab).op).hom ∘ₗ
      (IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers a) (sectionsToBasicOpen M a).hom).toLinearMap =
      (IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers b) (sectionsToBasicOpen M b).hom).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LocalizedModule.awayMap N hd := by
    refine IsLocalizedModule.ext (powers a) (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (powers a) N)
      (fun s ↦ ?_) ?_
    · obtain ⟨_, k, rfl⟩ := s
      simp only [map_pow]
      exact (isUnit_algebraMap_end_of_le_basicOpen a hab).pow k
    · have e2 : sectionsToBasicOpen M a ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hab).op =
          sectionsToBasicOpen M b := by
        rw [← Functor.map_comp]
        rfl
      ext m
      have h1 : IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers a) (sectionsToBasicOpen M a).hom
          (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) = (sectionsToBasicOpen M a).hom m :=
        IsLocalizedModule.iso_mk_one _ _ m
      have h2 : IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers b) (sectionsToBasicOpen M b).hom
          (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) = (sectionsToBasicOpen M b).hom m :=
        IsLocalizedModule.iso_mk_one _ _ m
      change ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hab).op).hom
          (IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers a) (sectionsToBasicOpen M a).hom
            (LocalizedModule.mk m 1)) =
        IsLocalizedModule.iso (powers b) (sectionsToBasicOpen M b).hom
          (LocalizedModule.awayMap N hd (LocalizedModule.mk m 1))
      rw [h1, LocalizedModule.awayMap_mk_one, h2, ← e2]
      rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.H_eq_zero_of_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem H_eq_zero_of_isQuasicoherent (q : ℕ)
    (x : H ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).obj M) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  H_eq_zero_of_localizing (Homeomorph.refl _)
    (fun a ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a : (Spec R).Opens)) (fun _ ↦ (Set.image_id _).symm) _ _
    (basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M)
    (fun a b hd hab x ↦ map_basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M a b hd hab x) q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.H_restrictOpen_basicOpen_eq_zero
statement:
theorem H_restrictOpen_basicOpen_eq_zero (a : R) (q : ℕ)
    (x : H ((restrictOpen (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a : (Spec R).Opens)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).obj M)) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_localizing (Homeomorph.refl _)
    (fun a ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a : (Spec R).Opens))
    (fun _ ↦ (Set.image_id _).symm) _ ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).obj M)
    (basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M)
    (fun a b hd hab x ↦ map_basicOpenLocalizationEquiv M a b hd hab x)
    (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a : (Spec R).Opens) ⟨a, rfl⟩ q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.functor_obj_basicOpenInAffine
statement:
lemma functor_obj_basicOpenInAffine (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    U.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj (basicOpenInAffine hU a) =
      hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  change Subtype.val '' (hU.primeSpectrumHomeomorph '' _) = hU.fromSpec '' _

  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen (q : ℕ)
    (x : H ((restrictOpen U).obj ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)) (q + 1)) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine H_eq_zero_of_localizing hU.primeSpectrumHomeomorph (basicOpenInAffine hU)
    (fun _ ↦ rfl) _ _ (basicOpenInAffineEquiv F hU) (fun a b hd hab y ↦ ?_) q x
  have hab' : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen b ≤ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a :=
    (localizing_le_iff hU.primeSpectrumHomeomorph (basicOpenInAffine hU) (fun _ ↦ rfl) b a).1 hab
  have h := map_basicOpenLocalizationEquiv (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) a b hd hab' y
  have hk : U.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj (basicOpenInAffine hU b) ≤
      hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a :=
    (functor_obj_basicOpenInAffine hU b).le.trans (Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ hab')
  calc _ = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hk).op
        (basicOpenLocalizationEquiv (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) a y) := map_map_apply _ _ _ _ _
    _ = F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (functor_obj_basicOpenInAffine hU b)).op
        ((F.restrict hU.fromSpec).presheaf.map (homOfLE hab').op
          (basicOpenLocalizationEquiv (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) a y)) :=
      (map_map_apply _ _ _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := congrArg _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
lemma subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_isAffineOpen (q : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (H ((restrictOpen U).obj ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F))
      (q + 1))
proof:
:=

    (H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen F hU q y).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.restrictOpen_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hcov : W ≤ ⨆ g : {g : Γ(X, U) // X.basicOpen g ≤ W}, X.basicOpen g.1 := by
    intro x hxW
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxW⟩ (hW hxW)
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨g, hgW⟩, hxg⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' X.sheaf _ W (fun g ↦ homOfLE g.2) hcov x 0 fun g ↦ ?_
  have := hU.isLocalization_basicOpen g.1
  have hfg : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (X.basicOpen g.1) (g.2.trans hW) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, X.basicOpen g.1) :=
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (Submonoid.powers g.1) _ hf
  have hx' := congrArg (fun y ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen y (X.basicOpen g.1) g.2) hx
  simp only [ores_mul, ores_res, ores_zero] at hx'
  exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp hfg _ hx').trans (ores_zero _).symm

statement:
lemma mres_existsUnique_gluing (hV : V ≤ iSup W) (hW : ∀ a, W a ≤ V) (sf : ∀ a, Γ(M, W a))
    (hsf : ∀ a b, (sf a |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b)) = (sf b |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b))) :
    ∃! s : Γ(M, V), ∀ a, TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (W a) (hW a) = sf a
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ W V (fun a ↦ homOfLE (hW a)) hV sf
    hsf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv_hom_app
statement:
lemma restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv_hom_app (W : U.toScheme.Opens) (x : Γ(M, U.ι ''ᵁ W)) :
    (restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv U e he).hom.app W x = e _ (U.ι_image_le W) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv_inv_app
statement:
lemma restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv_inv_app (W : U.toScheme.Opens) (y : Γ(N, U.ι ''ᵁ W)) :
    (restrictIsoOfLinearEquiv U e he).inv.app W y = (e _ (U.ι_image_le W)).symm y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext {c d : Cocycle U} (h : ∀ i j, c.g i j = d.g i j) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  cases c; cases d; congr; funext i j; exact h i j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.mul_res
statement:
lemma mul_res (i j k : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k) :
    (c.g i j |ₒ W) * (c.g j k |ₒ W) = c.g i k |ₒ W
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W hW) (c.mul i j k)
  simpa only [ores_mul, ores_res] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.self_res
statement: lemma self_res (i : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U i ⊓ U i) : (c.g i i |ₒ W) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.self, ores_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.mul_res_symm
statement:
lemma mul_res_symm (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U i ⊓ U j) :
    (c.g i j |ₒ W) * (c.g j i |ₒ W) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.mul_res i j i W (by order), c.self_res i W (by order)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.one_g
statement: @[simp] lemma one_g (i j : ι) : (1 : Cocycle U).g i j = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.mul_g
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_g (c d : Cocycle U) (i j : ι) : (c * d).g i j = c.g i j * d.g i j
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.inv_g
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_g (i j : ι) : c⁻¹.g i j = c.g j i |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.pow_g
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pow_g (n : ℕ) (i j : ι) : (c ^ n).g i j = c.g i j ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]; rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, mul_g, ih, pow_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.add_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma TwistAmb.add_apply {V : X.Opens} (s t : TwistAmb F U V) (i : ι) : (s + t) i = s i + t i
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.zero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma TwistAmb.zero_apply {V : X.Opens} (i : ι) : (0 : TwistAmb F U V) i = 0
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.smul_apply
statement:
lemma TwistAmb.smul_apply {V : X.Opens} (r : Γ(X, V)) (s : TwistAmb F U V) (i : ι) :
    (r • s) i = (r |ₒ (V ⊓ U i)) • s i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.res_apply
statement:
lemma TwistAmb.res_apply {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (s : TwistAmb F U V) (i : ι) :
    TwistAmb.res h s i = s i |ₒ (V' ⊓ U i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.res_smul
statement:
lemma TwistAmb.res_smul {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) (s : TwistAmb F U V) :
    TwistAmb.res h (r • s) = (r |ₒ V') • TwistAmb.res h s
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [TwistAmb.res_apply, TwistAmb.smul_apply]
  rw [mres_smul]
  simp only [ores_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.TwistAmb.res_mem
statement:
lemma TwistAmb.res_mem (c : Cocycle U) {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (s : TwistAmb F U V)
    (hs : s ∈ twistSubmodule F c V) : TwistAmb.res h s ∈ twistSubmodule F c V'
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (V' ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)) (by order)) (hs i j)
  simp only [mres_smul, mres_res, ores_res] at this
  simpa only [TwistAmb.res_apply, mres_res] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isSheaf_twistPresheaf
statement: lemma isSheaf_twistPresheaf (c : Cocycle U) : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (twistPresheaf F c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro κ W sf hsf
  have hsf' (a b : κ) (i : ι) :
      ((sf a).1 i |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ U i)) = ((sf b).1 i |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ U i)) :=
    congrArg (fun x : twistSubmodule F c (W a ⊓ W b) ↦ x.1 i) (hsf a b)
  have key (i : ι) : ∃! t : Γ(F, iSup W ⊓ U i), ∀ a,
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (W a ⊓ U i) (by have := le_iSup W a; order) = (sf a).1 i := by
    refine mres_existsUnique_gluing F (fun a ↦ W a ⊓ U i) (by rw [iSup_inf_eq]) _ _ ?_
    intro a b
    have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (W a ⊓ U i ⊓ (W b ⊓ U i))
      (by order)) (hsf' a b i)
    simpa only [mres_res] using this
  choose t ht hu using key
  refine ⟨⟨t, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩, fun a ↦ ?_, fun s hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine mres_eq_of_locally_eq F (fun a ↦ W a ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)) (by rw [iSup_inf_eq])
      (fun a ↦ by have := le_iSup W a; order) _ _ fun a ↦ ?_
    simp only [mres_res, mres_smul, ores_res]
    have hi := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (W a ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))
      (by order)) (ht i a)
    have hj := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (W a ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))
      (by order)) (ht j a)
    simp only [mres_res] at hi hj
    rw [hi, hj]
    exact (sf a).2 i j
  · exact Subtype.ext (funext fun i ↦ ht i a)
  · refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i ↦ hu i _ fun a ↦ ?_)
    exact congrArg (fun x : twistSubmodule F c (W a) ↦ x.1 i) (hs a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_compat
statement:
lemma twistComp_compat (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) (i j : ι) :
    (twistComp s i |ₒ (V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))) =
      (c.g i j |ₒ (V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))) • (twistComp s j |ₒ (V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)))
proof:

  (show twistSubmodule F c V from s).2 i j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_smul
statement:
lemma twistComp_smul (r : Γ(X, V)) (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) (i : ι) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_res
statement:
lemma twistComp_res {W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) (i : ι) :
    twistComp (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s W h) i = twistComp s i |ₒ (W ⊓ U i)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_compat_res
statement:
lemma twistComp_compat_res (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistComp s i) W (by order) =
      (c.g i j |ₒ W) • TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistComp s j) W (by order)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W hW) (twistComp_compat s i j)
  simpa only [mres_res, mres_smul, ores_res] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_twistMap_app

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistSectionsEquiv_res
statement:
lemma twistSectionsEquiv_res {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) :
    twistSectionsEquiv c i (hW.trans hV) (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s W hW) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistSectionsEquiv c i hV s) W hW
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_res, mres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistSectionsEquiv_symm_res
statement:
lemma twistSectionsEquiv_symm_res {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (t : Γ(F, V)) :
    (twistSectionsEquiv c i (hW.trans hV)).symm (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t W hW) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ((twistSectionsEquiv c i hV).symm t) W hW
proof:
:= by
  apply (twistSectionsEquiv c i (hW.trans hV)).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, twistSectionsEquiv_res c i hV hW,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistSectionsEquiv_change

lemma twistSectionsEquiv_change (j : ι) (hj : V ≤ U j) (s : Γ(twist F c, V)) :
    twistSectionsEquiv c i hV s = (c.g i j |ₒ V) • twistSectionsEquiv c j hj s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistSectionsEquiv_apply]
  exact twistComp_compat_res s i j V (by order)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistRestrictIso_hom_app

lemma twistRestrictIso_hom_app (i : ι) (W : (U i).toScheme.Opens)
    (s : Γ(twist F c, (U i).ι ''ᵁ W)) :
    (twistRestrictIso F c i).hom.app W s = twistSectionsEquiv c i ((U i).ι_image_le W) s
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistRestrictIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma twistRestrictIso_naturality {G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) (i : ι) :
    (restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map (twistMap c φ) ≫ (twistRestrictIso G c i).hom =
      (twistRestrictIso F c i).hom ≫ (restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext_apply fun W s ↦ by
    change twistSectionsEquiv c i ((U i).ι_image_le W) ((twistMap c φ).app _ s) =
      φ.app _ (twistSectionsEquiv c i ((U i).ι_image_le W) s)
    rw [twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_twistMap_app, Hom.app_mres]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_toTwistOne_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma twistComp_toTwistOne_app (t : Γ(F, V)) (i : ι) :

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.toTwistOne_bijective
statement:
lemma toTwistOne_bijective (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective ((toTwistOne (U := U) F).app V)
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i, V ⊓ U i := by rw [← inf_iSup_eq, hU, inf_top_eq]
  refine ⟨fun t t' h ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact mres_eq_of_locally_eq F _ hcov (fun _ ↦ inf_le_left) t t' fun i ↦
      congrArg (fun x ↦ twistComp x i) h
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := mres_existsUnique_gluing F (fun i ↦ V ⊓ U i) hcov (fun _ ↦ inf_le_left)
      (twistComp s) fun i j ↦ by
        rw [twistComp_compat_res s i j _ (by order)]
        simp only [Cocycle.one_g, ores_one, one_smul]
    exact ⟨t, twist_ext fun i ↦ ht i⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistOneIso_inv
statement: lemma twistOneIso_inv (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) : (twistOneIso F hU).inv = toTwistOne F
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.toTwistOne_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma toTwistOne_naturality {G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    φ ≫ toTwistOne (U := U) G = toTwistOne F ≫ twistMap 1 φ
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext_apply fun V t ↦ by ext i; simp [Hom.app_mres]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_twistTwistHom_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma twistComp_twistTwistHom_app (s : Γ(twist (twist F c) d, V)) (i : ι) :
    twistComp ((twistTwistHom c d).app V s) i =
      twistSectionsEquiv c i inf_le_right (twistComp s i)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistTwistHom_bijective
statement:
lemma twistTwistHom_bijective (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective ((twistTwistHom (F := F) c d).app V)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s s' h ↦ twist_ext fun i ↦ (twistSectionsEquiv c i inf_le_right).injective ?_,
    fun t ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa using congrArg (fun x ↦ twistComp x i) h
  refine ⟨twistMk (fun i ↦ (twistSectionsEquiv c i inf_le_right).symm (twistComp t i))
    fun i j ↦ ?_, twist_ext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply (twistSectionsEquiv c i (by order : V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j) ≤ U i)).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, twistSectionsEquiv_res c i inf_le_right,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    conv_rhs => rw [twistSectionsEquiv_change c i _ j (by order),
      twistSectionsEquiv_res c j inf_le_right, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [smul_smul, ← ores_mul, mul_comm (d.g i j)]
    exact twistComp_compat t i j
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistTwistHom_naturality

lemma twistTwistHom_naturality {G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_g

lemma comap_g (i j : ι) :
    (c.comap φ).g i j = φ.appLE (U i ⊓ U j) (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j) le_rfl (c.g i j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_g_res

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_mul

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_inv

    simp only [comap_g, inv_g]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_zpow
statement: lemma comap_zpow (m : ℤ) : (c ^ m).comap φ = c.comap φ ^ m
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_pow
statement: lemma comap_pow (m : ℕ) : (c ^ m).comap φ = c.comap φ ^ m
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.isPullback_comap
statement: lemma isPullback_comap : IsPullback φ id (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) c (c.comap φ)
proof:
:=
  fun i j W hW ↦ (comap_g_res φ c i j W hW).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.IsPullback.eq_comap
statement:
lemma IsPullback.eq_comap {d : Cocycle (fun i ↦ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i)}
    (h : IsPullback φ id (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) c d) : d = c.comap φ
proof:
:=
  ext fun i j ↦ by
    have := h i j _ le_rfl
    rw [ores_self] at this
    exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.comap_comap
statement: lemma comap_comap (ψ : Z ⟶ Y) : (c.comap φ).comap ψ = c.comap (ψ ≫ φ)
proof:
:=
  ext fun i j ↦ congr($(Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE ψ φ _ _ _ le_rfl le_rfl) (c.g i j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.app_ores
statement:
lemma app_ores {V W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    φ.app W (r |ₒ W) = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (φ.app V r) (φ ⁻¹ᵁ W) (φ.preimage_mono h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [φ.app_eq_appLE]
  exact appLE_res φ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.smul_congr
proof:
:=
  h ▸ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.app_ores_g_eq_comap_g
statement:
lemma app_ores_g_eq_comap_g (V : X.Opens) (i j : ι) :
    φ.app (V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)) (c.g i j |ₒ (V ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))) =
      ((c.comap φ).g i j |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [φ.app_eq_appLE, Cocycle.comap_g_res]
  exact appLE_res φ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.image_inf_preimage
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.image_inf_preimage (W : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) :
    e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ V) = e ''ᵁ W ⊓ V
proof:
:=
  Opens.ext (Set.image_inter_preimage _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.image_le_of_le_preimage
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.image_le_of_le_preimage {W : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens}
    (h : W ≤ e ⁻¹ᵁ V) : e ''ᵁ W ≤ V
proof:
:=
  (e.image_mono h).trans (e.image_preimage_le V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.appIso_inv_comap_g_res
statement:
lemma appIso_inv_comap_g_res (W : Y.Opens) (i j : ι) (hW : W ≤ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j) :
    (e.appIso W).inv (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ((c.comap e).g i j) W hW) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (c.g i j) (e ''ᵁ W) (e.image_le_of_le_preimage hW)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cocycle.comap_g_res]
  exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv_apply e hW (c.g i j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.appIso_inv_ores
statement:
lemma appIso_inv_ores {W W' : Y.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (r : Γ(Y, W)) :
    (e.appIso W').inv (r |ₒ W') =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ((e.appIso W).inv r) (e ''ᵁ W') (e.image_mono h)
proof:
:=
  congr($(e.appIso_inv_naturality (homOfLE h).op) r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistComp_compat
statement:
lemma restrictTwistComp_compat {W : Y.Opens} (s : Γ(twist F c, e ''ᵁ W)) (i j : ι) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (restrictTwistComp e s i)
        (e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) (e.image_mono (by order)) =
      (e.appIso _).inv ((c.comap e).g i j |ₒ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) •
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (restrictTwistComp e s j)
          (e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) (e.image_mono (by order))
proof:
:= by
  rw [appIso_inv_comap_g_res]
  simp only [restrictTwistComp, mres_res]
  refine twistComp_compat_res s i j _ (le_inf (e.image_mono inf_le_left) ?_)
  exact e.image_le_of_le_preimage (inf_le_right : _ ≤ e ⁻¹ᵁ (U i ⊓ U j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistComp_smul
statement:
lemma restrictTwistComp_smul {W : Y.Opens} (r : Γ(Y, W)) (s : Γ(twist F c, e ''ᵁ W)) (i : ι) :
    restrictTwistComp e ((e.appIso W).inv r • s) i =
      (e.appIso _).inv (r |ₒ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) • restrictTwistComp e s i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTwistComp, twistComp_smul, mres_smul, ores_res]
  rw [appIso_inv_ores e inf_le_left r]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistComp_res
statement:
lemma restrictTwistComp_res {W W' : Y.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (s : Γ(twist F c, e ''ᵁ W))
    (i : ι) :
    restrictTwistComp e (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (e ''ᵁ W') (e.image_mono h)) i =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (restrictTwistComp e s i) (e ''ᵁ (W' ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i))
        (e.image_mono (by order))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTwistComp, twistComp_res, mres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistInvComp_compat
statement:
lemma restrictTwistInvComp_compat {W : Y.Opens} (t : Γ(twist (F.restrict e) (c.comap e), W))
    (i j : ι) :
    (restrictTwistInvComp e t i |ₒ (e ''ᵁ W ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))) =
      (c.g i j |ₒ (e ''ᵁ W ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j))) •
        (restrictTwistInvComp e t j |ₒ (e ''ᵁ W ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (@id Γ(F, e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) (twistComp t i))
        (e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) (e.image_mono (by order)) =
      (e.appIso _).inv ((c.comap e).g i j |ₒ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) •
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (@id Γ(F, e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) (twistComp t j))
          (e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) (e.image_mono (by order)) :=
    twistComp_compat t i j
  rw [appIso_inv_comap_g_res] at h
  have hS : e ''ᵁ W ⊓ (U i ⊓ U j) ≤ e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ (e ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) :=
    (e.image_inf_preimage W (U i ⊓ U j)).ge
  simp only [restrictTwistInvComp, mres_res]
  rw [← mres_res F (e.image_mono (by order)) hS, h, mres_smul, ores_res, mres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistInvComp_smul
statement:
lemma restrictTwistInvComp_smul {W : Y.Opens} (r : Γ(Y, W))
    (t : Γ(twist (F.restrict e) (c.comap e), W)) (i : ι) :
    restrictTwistInvComp e (r • t) i =
      ((e.appIso W).inv r |ₒ (e ''ᵁ W ⊓ U i)) • restrictTwistInvComp e t i
proof:
:= by
  have h : (@id Γ(F, e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) (twistComp (r • t) i)) =
      (e.appIso _).inv (r |ₒ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) •
        (@id Γ(F, e ''ᵁ (W ⊓ e ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) (twistComp t i)) :=
    rfl
  simp only [restrictTwistInvComp]
  rw [h, appIso_inv_ores e inf_le_left, mres_smul, ores_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictTwistInvComp_res
statement:
lemma restrictTwistInvComp_res {W W' : Y.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
    (t : Γ(twist (F.restrict e) (c.comap e), W)) (i : ι) :
    restrictTwistInvComp e (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t W' h) i =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (restrictTwistInvComp e t i) (e ''ᵁ W' ⊓ U i)
        (inf_le_inf_right _ (e.image_mono h))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictTwistInvComp, twistComp_res]
  exact (mres_res F _ _ _).trans (mres_res F _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.yres_mul

statement: lemma preimOpen_inf (V W : X.Opens) : preimOpen f (V ⊓ W) = preimOpen f V ⊓ preimOpen f W

statement:
lemma PbAmb.smul_apply {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (r : Γᵧ(W))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.PbAmb.res_smul
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.PbAmb.res_mem
statement:
lemma PbAmb.res_mem {W W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W) (s : PbAmb f (U := U) W)
    (hs : s ∈ pbTwistSubmodule f c W) : PbAmb.res h s ∈ pbTwistSubmodule f c W'
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x
    (W' ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) (by order)) (hs i j)
  simp only [yres_mul, yres_res] at this
  simpa only [PbAmb.res_apply, yres_res] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isSheaf_pbTwistPresheaf
statement: lemma isSheaf_pbTwistPresheaf : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (pbTwistPresheaf f c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro κ W sf hsf
  have hsf' (a b : κ) (i : ι) :
      ((sf a).1 i |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ preimOpen f (U i))) =
        ((sf b).1 i |ₒ (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ preimOpen f (U i))) :=
    congrArg (fun x : pbTwistSubmodule f c (W a ⊓ W b) ↦ x.1 i) (hsf a b)
  have key (i : ι) : ∃! t : Γᵧ(iSup W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)), ∀ a,
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (W a ⊓ preimOpen f (U i))
        (by have := le_iSup W a; order) = (sf a).1 i := by
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' Y.sheaf (fun a ↦ W a ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) _
      (fun a ↦ homOfLE (by have := le_iSup W a; order)) (by rw [iSup_inf_eq]) _ ?_
    intro a b
    have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x
      (W a ⊓ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ (W b ⊓ preimOpen f (U i))) (by order)) (hsf' a b i)
    simp only [yres_res] at this
    exact this
  choose t ht hu using key
  refine ⟨⟨t, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩, fun a ↦ ?_, fun s hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' Y.sheaf
      (fun a ↦ W a ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) _
      (fun a ↦ homOfLE (by have := le_iSup W a; order)) (by rw [iSup_inf_eq]) _ _ fun a ↦ ?_
    have hi := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x
      (W a ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) (by order)) (ht i a)
    have hj := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x
      (W a ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) (by order)) (ht j a)
    simp only [yres_res] at hi hj
    have key : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen
        (t i |ₒ (iSup W ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))))
        (W a ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) (by have := le_iSup W a; order) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen
        ((pbG f c i j |ₒ (iSup W ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j)))) *
        (t j |ₒ (iSup W ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j)))))
        (W a ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) (by have := le_iSup W a; order) := by
      rw [yres_res, yres_mul, yres_res, yres_res, hi, hj]
      exact (sf a).2 i j
    exact key
  · exact Subtype.ext (funext fun i ↦ ht i a)
  · refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i ↦ hu i _ fun a ↦ ?_)
    exact congrArg (fun x : pbTwistSubmodule f c (W a) ↦ x.1 i) (hs a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbComp_compat
statement:
lemma pbComp_compat (s : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) (i j : ι) :

        (pbComp s j |ₒ (W ⊓ (preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))))

  (show pbTwistSubmodule f c W from s).2 i j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modHomMk_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma modHomMk_app (app : ∀ W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace, P.val.obj (op W) →+ Q.val.obj (op W))
    (map_smul) (naturality) (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (x : P.val.obj (op W)) :
    (modHomMk app map_smul naturality).val.app (op W) x = app W x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  ext W x
  exact h W.unop x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbG_mul_pbG
statement:
lemma pbG_mul_pbG (i j : ι) (O : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hO : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i j) O hO *
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c j i) O (hO.trans (inf_comm _ _).le) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun x : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j) ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbSec f x) O hO)
    (c.mul_res_symm i j (U i ⊓ U j) le_rfl)
  simp only [pbSec_mul, pbSec_one, yres_one, yres_mul, pbSec_res, yres_res] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.unitComp_twistFrame_self
statement:
lemma unitComp_twistFrame_self (i : ι) :
    unitComp (twistFrame c i) i = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (c.g i i |ₒ (U i ⊓ U i)) * ((1 : Γ(X, U i)) |ₒ (U i ⊓ U i)) = 1
  rw [c.self_res i _ le_rfl, ores_one, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.eq_smul_twistFrame
statement:
lemma eq_smul_twistFrame (i : ι) {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U i) (x : Γ(twistUnit c, V)) :
    x = unitSectionsEquiv X V (twistSectionsEquiv c i hV x) •
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistFrame c i) V hV
proof:
:= by
  apply (twistSectionsEquiv c i hV).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, twistSectionsEquiv_res c i le_rfl hV, twistFrame,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change _ = (_ : Γ(X, V)) * ((1 : Γ(X, U i)) |ₒ V)
  rw [ores_one, mul_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.twistFrame_change
statement:
lemma twistFrame_change (i j : ι) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistFrame c i) (U i ⊓ U j) inf_le_left =
      (c.g j i |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j)) • TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistFrame c j) (U i ⊓ U j)
        inf_le_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_smul_twistFrame j inf_le_right (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistFrame c i) (U i ⊓ U j)
    inf_le_left)]
  congr 1
  change (twistComp (twistFrame c i) j |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U j)) |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j) = _
  change (((c.g j i |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j)) * ((1 : Γ(X, U i)) |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j))) |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U j))
    |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j) = _
  rw [ores_one, mul_one, ores_res, ores_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.twistFrameη_change
statement:
lemma twistFrameη_change (i j : ι) (O : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hO : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j)) :
    modRes (twistFrameη f c i) O (hO.trans inf_le_left) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c j i) O (hO.trans (inf_comm _ _).le) •
        modRes (twistFrameη f c j) O (hO.trans inf_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (pfSec (twistUnitη f c) (U i ⊓ U j)) (twistFrame_change c i j)
  rw [pfSec_smul, pfSec_res, pfSec_res, pbSec_res] at h
  have hij : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j) := hO
  calc modRes (twistFrameη f c i) O _
      = modRes (modRes (twistFrameη f c i) (preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j))
          ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_left))
          O hij := (modRes_res _ _ _).symm
    _ = modRes (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbSec f (c.g j i)) (preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j))
          ((Opens.map f.base).monotone (inf_comm _ _).le) •
          modRes (twistFrameη f c j) (preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j))
            ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_right))
          O hij := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x O hij) h
    _ = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbSec f (c.g j i))
          (preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j)) ((Opens.map f.base).monotone (inf_comm _ _).le)) O hij •
          modRes (modRes (twistFrameη f c j) (preimOpen f (U i ⊓ U j))
            ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_right))
          O hij := modRes_smul _ _ _
    _ = _ := congrArg₂ (· • ·) (yres_res _ _ _) (modRes_res _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.smul_smul_cancel
statement:
private lemma smul_smul_cancel {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {a b c' : R}
    (h : a * c' = 1) (x : M) : (a * b) • c' • x = b • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_smul, mul_right_comm, h, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modRes_eq_of_locally_eq
statement:
lemma modRes_eq_of_locally_eq {N : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} {κ : Type u}
    (V : κ → Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (hW : W ≤ iSup V)
    (hV : ∀ a, V a ≤ W) (s t : N.val.obj (op W)) (h : ∀ a, modRes s (V a) (hV a) = modRes t (V a)
        (hV a)) :
    s = t
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (modAbSheaf N) V W (fun a ↦ homOfLE (hV a)) hW s t h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.preimOpen_iSup
statement:
lemma preimOpen_iSup (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) :
    W ≤ ⨆ i, W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : f.base y ∈ (⨆ i, U i : X.Opens) := by rw [hU]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 this
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨i, hy, hi⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistLoc_compat
statement:
lemma pbTwistLoc_compat (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) (i j : ι) (O : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hO : O ≤ W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U j))) :
    modRes (pbTwistLoc f c t i) O (hO.trans inf_le_left) = modRes (pbTwistLoc f c t j) O (hO.trans
        inf_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  have hO' : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j) := by
    refine le_inf (hO.trans ?_) (hO.trans ?_) <;> order
  have hc : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t i) O (hO.trans inf_le_left) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i j) O hO' *
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t j) O (hO.trans inf_le_right) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x O (by
      refine le_inf ((hO.trans inf_le_left).trans inf_le_left) hO')) (pbComp_compat t i j)
    simp only [yres_res, yres_mul] at h
    exact h
  calc modRes (pbTwistLoc f c t i) O (hO.trans inf_le_left)
      = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t i) O (hO.trans inf_le_left) •
          modRes (modRes (twistFrameη f c i) (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) inf_le_right) O (hO.trans
              inf_le_left) :=
        modRes_smul _ _ _
    _ = (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i j) O hO' *
          TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t j) O (hO.trans inf_le_right)) •
          (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c j i) O (hO'.trans (inf_comm _ _).le) •
            modRes (twistFrameη f c j) O (hO'.trans inf_le_right)) := by
        rw [hc, modRes_res, twistFrameη_change i j O hO']
    _ = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t j) O (hO.trans inf_le_right) •
          modRes (twistFrameη f c j) O (hO'.trans inf_le_right) :=
        smul_smul_cancel (pbG_mul_pbG i j O hO') _
    _ = modRes (pbTwistLoc f c t j) O (hO.trans inf_le_right) := by
        rw [pbTwistLoc, modRes_smul, modRes_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_pbTwistGlue
statement:
lemma exists_pbTwistGlue (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) :
    ∃! s : (pbTwistUnit f c).val.obj (op W), ∀ i, modRes s (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) inf_le_left =
        pbTwistLoc f c t i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hu⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' (modAbSheaf (pbTwistUnit f c))
    (fun i ↦ W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) W (fun i ↦ homOfLE inf_le_left) (preimOpen_iSup hU W)
        (pbTwistLoc f c t)
    fun i j ↦ pbTwistLoc_compat t i j _ le_rfl
  exact ⟨s, hs, hu⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modRes_pbTwistGlue
statement:
lemma modRes_pbTwistGlue (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) (i : ι) :
    modRes (pbTwistGlue f c hU t) (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) inf_le_left = pbTwistLoc f c t i
proof:
:=
  (exists_pbTwistGlue hU t).exists.choose_spec i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.eq_pbTwistGlue
statement:
lemma eq_pbTwistGlue (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) (s : (pbTwistUnit f c).val.obj (op W))
    (hs : ∀ i, modRes s (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) inf_le_left = pbTwistLoc f c t i) : s = pbTwistGlue
        f c hU t
proof:
:=
  (exists_pbTwistGlue hU t).unique hs (modRes_pbTwistGlue hU t)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbComp_modRes
statement:
lemma pbComp_modRes {W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W)
    (s : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) (i : ι) :
    pbComp (modRes s W' h) i = pbComp s i |ₒ (W' ⊓ preimOpen f (U i))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistGlue_add
statement:
lemma pbTwistGlue_add (t t' : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) :
    pbTwistGlue f c hU (t + t') = pbTwistGlue f c hU t + pbTwistGlue f c hU t'
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_pbTwistGlue hU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [modRes_add, modRes_pbTwistGlue, modRes_pbTwistGlue, pbTwistLoc, pbTwistLoc, pbTwistLoc,
      pbComp_add, add_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistGlue_zero
statement: lemma pbTwistGlue_zero : pbTwistGlue f c hU (0 : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_pbTwistGlue hU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [modRes_zero, pbTwistLoc, pbComp_zero, zero_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistGlue_smul
statement:
lemma pbTwistGlue_smul (r : Γᵧ(W)) (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) :
    pbTwistGlue f c hU (r • t) = r • pbTwistGlue f c hU t
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_pbTwistGlue hU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [modRes_smul, modRes_pbTwistGlue, pbTwistLoc, pbTwistLoc, pbComp_smul, smul_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistGlue_modRes
statement:
lemma pbTwistGlue_modRes {W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W) (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj
    (op W)) :
    pbTwistGlue f c hU (modRes t W' h) = modRes (pbTwistGlue f c hU t) W' h
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_pbTwistGlue hU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_).symm
  have e := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (W' ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) (inf_le_inf_right _ h))
      (modRes_pbTwistGlue hU t i)
  simp only [modRes_res] at e
  rw [modRes_res, e, pbTwistLoc, pbTwistLoc, modRes_smul, modRes_res, pbComp_modRes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.twistUnitη_comp_pullbackToPbTwist
statement:
lemma twistUnitη_comp_pullbackToPbTwist :
    twistUnitη f c ≫ ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).map (pullbackToPbTwist f c) :
      ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).obj (pbTwistUnit f c) : X.Modules) ⟶
        ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).obj (pbTwist f c) : X.Modules)) =
      toPushforwardPbTwist f c
proof:
:= by
  exact (f.pullbackModulesAdj.homEquiv_unit (twistUnit c) (pbTwist f c) _).symm.trans
    (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pullbackToPbTwist_pfSec
statement:
lemma pullbackToPbTwist_pfSec {V : X.Opens} (x : Γ(twistUnit c, V)) :
    (pullbackToPbTwist f c).val.app (op (preimOpen f V)) (pfSec (twistUnitη f c) V x) =
      pfSec (toPushforwardPbTwist f c) V x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun g ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app g V x) twistUnitη_comp_pullbackToPbTwist

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modHom_modRes
statement:
lemma modHom_modRes {P Q : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} (φ : P ⟶ Q)
    {W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W) (x : P.val.obj (op W)) :
    φ.val.app (op W') (modRes x W' h) = modRes (φ.val.app (op W) x) W' h
proof:
:=
  congr($(φ.val.naturality (homOfLE h).op).hom x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modHom_smul
statement:
lemma modHom_smul {P Q : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} (φ : P ⟶ Q)
    (r : Γᵧ(W)) (x : P.val.obj (op W)) :
    φ.val.app (op W) (r • x) = r • φ.val.app (op W) x
proof:
:=
  (φ.val.app (op W)).hom.map_smul r x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.yres_injective_of_le
statement:
lemma yres_injective_of_le {W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W) (h' : W ≤ W') :
    Function.Injective fun x : Γᵧ(W) ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W' h
proof:
:= by
  intro a b e
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W h') e
  simpa only [yres_res, yres_self] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbComp_twistFrame_self
statement:
lemma pbComp_twistFrame_self (i : ι) :
    pbComp (pfSec (toPushforwardPbTwist f c) (U i) (twistFrame c i)) i = 1
proof:
:= by
  change pbSec f (unitComp (twistFrame c i) i) = 1
  rw [unitComp_twistFrame_self, pbSec_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistToPullback_comp
statement:
lemma pbTwistToPullback_comp :
    pbTwistToPullback f c hU ≫ pullbackToPbTwist f c = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine modHom_ext fun W t ↦ pbTwist_ext fun i ↦ ?_
  change pbComp ((pullbackToPbTwist f c).val.app (op W) (pbTwistGlue f c hU t)) i = pbComp t i
  apply yres_injective_of_le (W' := W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) (by order) (by order)
  change pbComp (modRes ((pullbackToPbTwist f c).val.app (op W) (pbTwistGlue f c hU t)) (W ⊓
      preimOpen f (U i))
    inf_le_left) i = pbComp (modRes t (W ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) inf_le_left) i
  rw [← modHom_modRes, modRes_pbTwistGlue, pbTwistLoc, modHom_smul, pbComp_smul, modHom_modRes,
      twistFrameη,
    pullbackToPbTwist_pfSec, pbComp_modRes, pbComp_twistFrame_self, yres_one, mul_one,
        pbComp_modRes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.twistSectionsEquiv_res_inf
statement:
lemma twistSectionsEquiv_res_inf (i : ι) {V : X.Opens} (x : Γ(twistUnit c, V)) :
    unitSectionsEquiv X (V ⊓ U i) (twistSectionsEquiv c i inf_le_right
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (V ⊓ U i) inf_le_left)) = unitComp x i
proof:
:= by
  change (twistComp x i |ₒ (V ⊓ U i ⊓ U i)) |ₒ (V ⊓ U i) = twistComp x i
  rw [mres_res, mres_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pfSec_twistUnitη_res
statement:
lemma pfSec_twistUnitη_res (i : ι) {V : X.Opens} (x : Γ(twistUnit c, V)) :
    modRes (pfSec (twistUnitη f c) V x) (preimOpen f (V ⊓ U i))
        ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_left) =
      pbSec f (unitComp x i) • modRes (twistFrameη f c i) (preimOpen f (V ⊓ U i))
        ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pfSec_res (twistUnitη f c) (inf_le_left : V ⊓ U i ≤ V), eq_smul_twistFrame i inf_le_right
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x (V ⊓ U i)
    inf_le_left), pfSec_smul, pfSec_res, twistSectionsEquiv_res_inf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.toPushforwardPbTwist_comp
statement:
lemma toPushforwardPbTwist_comp :
    toPushforwardPbTwist f c ≫
      ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).map (pbTwistToPullback f c hU) :
        ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).obj (pbTwist f c) : X.Modules) ⟶
          ((SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingSheafHom).obj (pbTwistUnit f c) : X.Modules)) =
      twistUnitη f c
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Modules.Hom.ext_apply fun V x ↦ ?_
  change pbTwistGlue f c hU (pfSec (toPushforwardPbTwist f c) V x) = pfSec (twistUnitη f c) V x
  refine (eq_pbTwistGlue hU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_).symm
  exact (pfSec_twistUnitη_res i x).trans rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pullbackToPbTwist_comp
statement:
lemma pullbackToPbTwist_comp :
    pullbackToPbTwist f c ≫ pbTwistToPullback f c hU = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine (f.pullbackModulesAdj.homEquiv (twistUnit c) (pbTwistUnit f c)).injective ?_
  refine (f.pullbackModulesAdj.homEquiv_naturality_right _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (· ≫ _) (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)).trans ?_
  exact (toPushforwardPbTwist_comp hU).trans (f.pullbackModulesAdj.homEquiv_id _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbG_mul
statement:
lemma pbG_mul (i j l : ι) (O : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hO : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U j) ⊓ preimOpen f (U l)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i j) O (hO.trans (by order)) *
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c j l) O (hO.trans (by order)) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i l) O (hO.trans (by order))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun x : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U l) ↦
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbSec f x) O hO) (c.mul i j l)
  simp only [pbSec_mul, yres_mul, pbSec_res, yres_res] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbG_self
statement:
lemma pbG_self (i : ι) (O : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hO : O ≤ preimOpen f (U i) ⊓ preimOpen f (U i)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbG f c i i) O hO = 1
proof:
:= by
  change TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbSec f (c.g i i)) O hO = 1
  rw [c.self, pbSec_one, yres_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pbTwistSectionsEquiv_modRes
statement:
lemma pbTwistSectionsEquiv_modRes (i : ι) (hW : W ≤ preimOpen f (U i))
    {W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W) (t : (pbTwist f c).val.obj (op W)) :
    pbTwistSectionsEquiv c i (h.trans hW) (modRes t W' h) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbTwistSectionsEquiv c i hW t) W' h
proof:
:= by
  change pbComp (modRes t W' h) i |ₒ W' = _
  rw [pbComp_modRes]
  change _ = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (pbComp t i |ₒ W) W' h
  rw [yres_res, yres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.cocycleComap_g
statement: lemma cocycleComap_g (c : Cocycle U) (i j : ι) : (cocycleComap f c).g i j = pbSec f (c.g i j)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.cocycleComap_inv
statement: lemma cocycleComap_inv (c : Cocycle U) : cocycleComap f c⁻¹ = (cocycleComap f c)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  ModCocycle.ext fun i j ↦ pbSec_res f _ (c.g j i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.iSup_preimOpen
statement: lemma iSup_preimOpen (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) : ⨆ i, preimOpen f (U i) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 ((preimOpen_iSup hU ⊤).trans (iSup_mono fun _ ↦ inf_le_right))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.subsingleton_sections_of_le_bot
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.subsingleton_sections_of_le_bot {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ ⊥) : Subsingleton Γ(X, W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := le_bot_iff.mp hW
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.appLE_res
statement:
lemma appLE_res {U U' : X.Opens} (hU : U' ≤ U) {W : Y.Opens} (e : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U')
    (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    φ.appLE U' W e (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x U' hU) =
      φ.appLE U W (e.trans (φ.preimage_mono hU)) x
proof:
:=
  congr($(φ.map_appLE e (homOfLE hU).op) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.res_appLE
statement:
lemma res_appLE {U : X.Opens} {W W' : Y.Opens} (e : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hW : W' ≤ W) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (φ.appLE U W e x) W' hW = φ.appLE U W' (hW.trans e) x
proof:
:=
  congr($(φ.appLE_map e (homOfLE hW).op) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.app_res_eq_appLE
statement:
lemma app_res_eq_appLE {U : X.Opens} {W : Y.Opens} (hW : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (φ.app U x) W hW = φ.appLE U W hW x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unit_mres
statement:
lemma unit_mres {Z : Scheme.{u}} {W W' : Z.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
    (x : Γ(SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf, W)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W' h =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (show Γ(Z, W) from x) W' h : Γ(Z, W'))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unit_smul
statement:
lemma unit_smul {Z : Scheme.{u}} {W : Z.Opens} (r : Γ(Z, W))
    (x : Γ(SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf, W)) :
    r • x = (r * (show Γ(Z, W) from x) : Γ(Z, W))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.le_preimage_inf_inf
statement:
lemma le_preimage_inf_inf {W : Y.Opens} {i j : κ'} (hW : W ≤ U' i ⊓ U' j) :
    W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (U (e i) ⊓ U (e j))
proof:
:=
  le_inf (hW.trans (inf_le_left.trans (hU i))) (hW.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hU j)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.IsPullback.one
statement: lemma one : Cocycle.IsPullback φ e hU (1 : Cocycle U) (1 : Cocycle U')
proof:
:= by
  intro i j W hW
  simp only [one_g, ores_one, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.IsPullback.mul
statement:
lemma mul {c c' : Cocycle U} {d d' : Cocycle U'} (h : IsPullback φ e hU c d)
    (h' : IsPullback φ e hU c' d') : IsPullback φ e hU (c * c') (d * d')
proof:
:= by
  intro i j W hW
  simp only [mul_g, ores_mul, map_mul, h i j W hW, h' i j W hW]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.IsPullback.inv
statement:
lemma inv {c : Cocycle U} {d : Cocycle U'} (h : IsPullback φ e hU c d) :
    IsPullback φ e hU c⁻¹ d⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro i j W hW
  simp only [inv_g, ores_res]
  rw [appLE_res, h j i W (by order)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Cocycle.IsPullback.zpow
statement:
lemma zpow {c : Cocycle U} {d : Cocycle U'} (h : IsPullback φ e hU c d) (m : ℤ) :
    IsPullback φ e hU (c ^ m) (d ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using one
  | succ m ih => simpa [zpow_add_one] using ih.mul h
  | pred m ih => simpa [zpow_sub_one] using ih.mul h.inv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.preimage_inf_le
statement: lemma preimage_inf_le (V : X.Opens) (j : κ') : φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ U' j ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (V ⊓ U (e j))
proof:
:=
  le_inf inf_le_left (inf_le_right.trans (hU j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistPullbackComp_compat
statement:
lemma twistPullbackComp_compat (h : Cocycle.IsPullback φ e hU c d) (V : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(twist (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) c, V)) (i j : κ') :
    (twistPullbackComp φ e hU V s i |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (U' i ⊓ U' j))) =
      (d.g i j |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (U' i ⊓ U' j))) •
        (twistPullbackComp φ e hU V s j |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (U' i ⊓ U' j)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistPullbackComp, unit_mres, unit_smul, res_appLE]
  have hW : φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (U' i ⊓ U' j) ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (V ⊓ (U (e i) ⊓ U (e j))) :=
    le_inf inf_le_left (le_preimage_inf_inf φ e hU inf_le_right)
  rw [← appLE_res φ (by order : V ⊓ (U (e i) ⊓ U (e j)) ≤ V ⊓ U (e i)) hW,
    ← appLE_res φ (by order : V ⊓ (U (e i) ⊓ U (e j)) ≤ V ⊓ U (e j)) hW,
    ]
  have hc := twistComp_compat s (e i) (e j)
  simp only [unit_mres, unit_smul] at hc
  rw [hc, map_mul, appLE_res φ (by order : V ⊓ (U (e i) ⊓ U (e j)) ≤ U (e i) ⊓ U (e j)) hW,
    h i j _ inf_le_right]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistPullbackComp_smul
statement:
lemma twistPullbackComp_smul (V : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, V))
    (s : Γ(twist (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) c, V)) (j : κ') :
    twistPullbackComp φ e hU V (r • s) j =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (φ.app V r) (φ ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ U' j) inf_le_left •
        twistPullbackComp φ e hU V s j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistPullbackComp, twistComp_smul, unit_smul, map_mul]
  rw [appLE_res]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistPullbackComp_res
statement:
lemma twistPullbackComp_res {V W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V)
    (s : Γ(twist (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) c, V)) (j : κ') :
    twistPullbackComp φ e hU W (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s W hW) j =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (twistPullbackComp φ e hU V s j) (φ ⁻¹ᵁ W ⊓ U' j)
        (inf_le_inf_right _ (φ.preimage_mono hW))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistPullbackComp, twistComp_res, unit_mres, res_appLE]
  rw [appLE_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistComp_twistUnitToPushforward_app
statement:
lemma twistComp_twistUnitToPushforward_app (h : Cocycle.IsPullback φ e hU c d) (V : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(twist (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) c, V)) (j : κ') :
    twistComp (V := φ ⁻¹ᵁ V) ((twistUnitToPushforward φ e hU c d h).app V s) j =
      twistPullbackComp φ e hU V s j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.algebraMap_basicOpen_eq_res
statement:
lemma algebraMap_basicOpen_eq_res {U : X.Opens} (f : Γ(X, U)) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) r =
      X.toLocallyRingedSpace.res (X.basicOpen_le f) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.hasLocalRelations
statement:
theorem hasLocalRelations [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    X.toLocallyRingedSpace.HasLocalRelations
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro V m f x hx
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨U, hUaff, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨t, htV, hxt⟩ := hUaff.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V) ⟨x, hx⟩ hxU
  haveI hWaff : IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen t) := hUaff.basicOpen t
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨X.basicOpen t, hWaff⟩
  set fW : Fin m → Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) := fun i ↦ X.toLocallyRingedSpace.res htV (f i) with hfW
  
  obtain ⟨k, g, hrelg, hgen⟩ :
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → (Fin m → Γ(X, X.basicOpen t))),
        (∀ l, ∑ i, g l i * fW i = 0) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin m → Γ(X, X.basicOpen t), ∑ i, b i * fW i = 0 →
          b ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) (Set.range g)) := by
    let φ : (Fin m → Γ(X, X.basicOpen t)) →ₗ[Γ(X, X.basicOpen t)] Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) :=
      { toFun := fun b ↦ ∑ i, b i * fW i
        map_add' := fun b c ↦ by simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        map_smul' := fun c b ↦ by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc] }
    obtain ⟨k, g, hgspan⟩ :=
      Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1 (IsNoetherian.noetherian (LinearMap.ker φ))
    refine ⟨k, g, fun l ↦ ?_, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
    · have hg : g l ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) (Set.range g) :=
        Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
      rw [hgspan] at hg
      exact hg
    · rw [hgspan]
      exact hb
  refine ⟨X.basicOpen t, htV, k, g, hxt, hrelg, ?_⟩
  intro W' hW'W a ha y hy
  
  obtain ⟨h, hhW', hyh⟩ := hWaff.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W') ⟨y, hy⟩ (hW'W hy)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(X, X.basicOpen h) := hWaff.isLocalization_basicOpen h
  refine ⟨X.basicOpen h, hhW', hyh, ?_⟩
  have hares : ∑ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.res hhW' (a i) *
      algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) Γ(X, X.basicOpen h) (fW i) = 0 := by
    have hres := congrArg (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.res hhW') ha
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.res_sum, LocallyRingedSpace.res_zero] at hres
    simp only [LocallyRingedSpace.res_mul, LocallyRingedSpace.res_res] at hres
    simpa only [algebraMap_basicOpen_eq_res, hfW, LocallyRingedSpace.res_res] using hres
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_fun_eq_sum_of_sum_mul_eq_zero (Submonoid.powers h)
    fW g hgen (fun i ↦ X.toLocallyRingedSpace.res hhW' (a i)) hares
  exact ⟨c, by simpa only [algebraMap_basicOpen_eq_res, LocallyRingedSpace.res_res] using hc⟩
