name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_appIso_hom_restrict
statement:
lemma fromSpec_appIso_hom_restrict (W : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (hU.fromSpec.appIso W).hom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hU.fromSpec_image_le W)).op r) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map W.leTop.op ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.naturality, Category.assoc, hU.fromSpec_app_of_le U le_rfl]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, homOfLE_refl, op_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.smul_restrict_fromSpec
statement:
lemma smul_restrict_fromSpec (W : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (r : Γ(X, U))
    (x : Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, W)) :
    (r • x : Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, W)) = (show Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ W) from
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen r _ (hU.fromSpec_image_le W) •
        (show Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ W) from x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
  change _ = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hU.fromSpec_image_le W)).op r • _
  rw [← fromSpec_appIso_hom_restrict]
  change ((hU.fromSpec.appIso W).inv ((hU.fromSpec.appIso W).hom _)) •
    (show Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ W) from x) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.id_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul
statement:
theorem exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul (f : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(F, X.basicOpen f)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (t : Γ(F, U)), TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) ^ k • s
proof:
:= by
  have hW := hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen f
  have h := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen
    (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) f
  let s' : Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s _ hW.le
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, k, rfl⟩⟩, ha⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers f)
    (Scheme.Modules.sectionsToBasicOpen (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) f).hom s'
  refine ⟨k, TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (show Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) from a) U
    hU.le_fromSpec_image_top, ?_⟩
  have ha' : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (show Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) from a)
      (hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) (hU.fromSpec.image_mono le_top) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
        (hU.fromSpec_image_le _) ^ k • s' := by
    rw [← ores_pow]
    refine ha.symm.trans ?_
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def]
    exact smul_restrict_fromSpec hU F _ _ _
  refine (mres_res F _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (mres_res F (hU.fromSpec.image_mono le_top) hW.ge _).symm.trans ?_
  rw [ha', mres_smul, ores_pow, ores_res]
  simp only [s', mres_res, mres_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (f : Γ(X, U)) (t : Γ(F, U))
    (ht : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) = 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, f ^ k • t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hW := hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen f
  have h := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen
    (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) f
  let t' : Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) := TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ (hU.fromSpec_image_le ⊤)
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hc⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := Submonoid.powers f)
    (f := (Scheme.Modules.sectionsToBasicOpen (F.restrict hU.fromSpec) f).hom)
    (x₁ := t') (x₂ := 0) (by
      rw [map_zero]
      change TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t' (hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
        (hU.fromSpec.image_mono le_top) = 0
      simp only [t', mres_res]
      rw [← mres_res F (X.basicOpen_le f) hW.le, ht, mres_zero])
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def, smul_zero] at hc
  have hc' := smul_restrict_fromSpec hU F ⊤ (f ^ k) t'
  have h0 : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (f ^ k) _ (hU.fromSpec_image_le ⊤) • t' = 0 :=
    hc'.symm.trans hc
  apply mres_injective_of_le F (hU.fromSpec_image_le ⊤) hU.le_fromSpec_image_top
  simp only
  rw [mres_smul, h0, mres_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.exists_module_finite_basicOpen
statement:
theorem exists_module_finite_basicOpen [F.IsFiniteType] (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ g : Γ(X, U), x ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧
      Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Γ(F, X.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData.{u} F
  have hcov : ⨆ i, σ.X i = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (U := σ.X) _).1 σ.coversTop
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 (hcov.ge (Set.mem_univ x))
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hxg⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le (V := σ.X i) ⟨x, hi⟩ hx
  haveI := hσ.isFiniteType i
  let τ := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.restrict.{u} (homOfLE hg) (σ.generators i)
  haveI : Finite τ.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  exact ⟨g, hxg, Scheme.Modules.module_finite_sections_of_isAffineOpen F (hU.basicOpen g) τ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.epi_of_forall_exists
statement:
theorem epi_of_forall_exists {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (t : Γ(N, W)) (x : X), x ∈ W → ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W), x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ s : Γ(M, V), φ.app V s = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t V hV) : Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  refine (SheafOfModules.isLocallySurjective_toSheaf_map_iff_epi (M := M) (N := N) φ).1 ?_
  change TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective _
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff]
  intro W t x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, s, hs⟩ := h W t x hx
  exact ⟨V, hV, ⟨s, hs⟩, hxV⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.epi_of_surjective_app_affine
statement:
theorem epi_of_surjective_app_affine {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    {ι : Type*} (V : ι → X.Opens) (hcov : ⨆ a, V a = ⊤) (hV : ∀ a, IsAffineOpen (V a))
    (hN : ∀ a (f : Γ(X, V a)) (s : Γ(N, X.basicOpen f)), ∃ (k : ℕ) (t : Γ(N, V a)),
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) ^ k • s)
    (hsurj : ∀ a, Function.Surjective (φ.app (V a))) : Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  refine epi_of_forall_exists φ fun W t x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hcov.ge (Set.mem_univ x))
  obtain ⟨f, hfW, hxf⟩ := (hV a).exists_basicOpen_le (V := W) ⟨x, hx⟩ ha
  refine ⟨X.basicOpen f, hfW, hxf, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, u, hu⟩ := hN a f (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ hfW)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj a u
  have hc : IsUnit (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (X.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen_le f) ^ k) :=
    (X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen f).pow k
  refine ⟨(↑hc.unit⁻¹ : Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)) •
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen y _ (X.basicOpen_le f), ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, Hom.app_mres, hu, smul_smul]
  rw [IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.freeMk_app_freeSection
statement:
lemma freeMk_app_freeSection (M : X.Modules) {I : Type u} (σ : I → Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : I)
    (W : X.Opens) :
    Hom.app (freeMk M σ) W (PresheafOfModules.sections.eval
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf) p) (op W)) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (σ p) W le_top
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun s ↦ PresheafOfModules.sections.eval s (op W))
    (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection (M := M) (fun q ↦
      SheafOfModules.sectionOfTerminal Limits.isTerminalTop M (σ q)) p)
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_sections_of_restrict
statement:
theorem module_finite_sections_of_restrict {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : W.Modules) (U : V.Opens) [Module.Finite Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U)] :
    Module.Finite Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module Γ(V, U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) := inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U))
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(V, U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U))
  exact Module.Finite.of_ringEquiv (f.appIso U).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    fun a n ↦ smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply f M U a n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_sections_of_restrict
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_sections_of_restrict {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : W.Modules) (U : V.Opens)
    [Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U)] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module Γ(V, U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) := inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U))
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U))
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_ringEquiv (f.appIso U).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    fun a n ↦ smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply f M U a n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.notMem_range_of_mem_basicOpen
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.notMem_range_of_mem_basicOpen {V : Y.Opens} (s : Γ(Y, V))
    (hs : i.app V s = 0) {y : Y} (hy : y ∈ Y.basicOpen s) : y ∉ Set.range i.base
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have ht : t ∈ i ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen s := hy
  rw [Scheme.preimage_basicOpen, hs, Scheme.basicOpen_zero] at ht
  exact ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.app_map_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.app_map_eq_zero {V W : Y.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(Y, V)) (hs : i.app V s = 0) :
    i.app W (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (i.naturality (homOfLE h).op) s
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at this
  refine this.trans ?_
  rw [hs, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.mem_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.mem_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal {V : Y.Opens} (b : Γ(Y, V)) :
    b ∈ i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal V ↔ ∀ y ∈ Y.basicOpen b, y ∉ Set.range i.base
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.eq_zero_of_subsingleton_stalk
statement:
lemma Scheme.Modules.eq_zero_of_subsingleton_stalk {V : Y.Opens} (t : Γ(K, V))
    (h : ∀ y ∈ V, Subsingleton ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)) : t = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext (⟨K.val.presheaf, K.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab.{u} Y) V t 0
    fun y hy ↦ ?_
  haveI := h y hy
  exact Subsingleton.elim (α := (Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.radical_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.radical_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen {W : Y.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    [Module.Finite Γ(Y, W) Γ(K, W)]
    (hK : ∀ y ∉ Set.range i.base, Subsingleton ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)) :
    i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W ≤ (Module.annihilator Γ(Y, W) Γ(K, W)).radical
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro b hb
  have hz : ∀ m : Γ(K, W), ∃ k : ℕ, b ^ k • m = 0 := by
    intro m
    refine hW.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero K b m ?_
    exact Scheme.Modules.eq_zero_of_subsingleton_stalk K _ fun y hy ↦ hK y (hb y hy)
  choose k hk using hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := Γ(Y, W)) (M := Γ(K, W))
  refine ⟨∑ m ∈ s, k m, Module.mem_annihilator.2 fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span Γ(Y, W) (s : Set Γ(K, W)) := hs ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s k hx, pow_add, mul_smul, hk x, smul_zero]
  | zero => exact smul_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [smul_comm, hx, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_map_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_map_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal {W : Y.Opens}
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ W) :
    i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ≤
      (i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W).map (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, s, hs0, rfl⟩ := i.toLRSHom.exists_germ_eq_of_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal y r hr
  obtain ⟨h, hhV, hyh⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V) ⟨y, hyV⟩ hy
  let s' : Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen h) := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hhV).op s
  have hs' : i.app _ s' = 0 := i.app_map_eq_zero hhV s hs0
  haveI := hW.isLocalization_basicOpen h
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, k, rfl⟩⟩, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers h) s'
  simp only at ha
  have hres : ∀ c : Γ(Y, W), algebraMap Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen h) c =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le h)).op c := fun c ↦ by
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  have hb : h * a ∈ i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul] at hz
    have hz' : z ∈ Y.basicOpen (algebraMap Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen h) a) := by
      rw [hres, Scheme.basicOpen_res]
      exact ⟨hz.1, hz.2⟩
    rw [← ha, Scheme.basicOpen_mul] at hz'
    exact i.notMem_range_of_mem_basicOpen s' hs' hz'.1
  have hu : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy h) := (Y.mem_basicOpen h y hy).1 hyh
  have hgerm : ∀ c : Γ(Y, W), Y.presheaf.germ _ y hyh (algebraMap _ _ c) =
      Y.presheaf.germ W y hy c := fun c ↦ by
    rw [hres, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  have hs'germ : Y.presheaf.germ _ y hyh s' = Y.presheaf.germ V y hyV s :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have key : Y.presheaf.germ W y hy (h * a) =
      Y.presheaf.germ W y hy h ^ (k + 1) * Y.presheaf.germ V y hyV s := by
    rw [map_mul, ← hgerm a, ← ha, map_mul, hs'germ, hgerm, map_pow, pow_succ]
    ring
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu.pow (k + 1)
  have : Y.presheaf.germ V y hyV s = ↑u⁻¹ * Y.presheaf.germ W y hy (h * a) := by
    rw [key, ← hu, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hb)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.map_annihilator_le
statement:
lemma IsAffineOpen.map_annihilator_le {W : Y.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ W) :
    (Module.annihilator Γ(Y, W) Γ(K, W)).map (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom ≤
      Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro b hb
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Module.mem_annihilator]
  intro m
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, t, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq K.val.presheaf m
  obtain ⟨h, hhV, hyh⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V) ⟨y, hyV⟩ hy
  obtain ⟨k, u, hu⟩ := hW.exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul K h
    (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ hhV)
  let g : ∀ {U : Y.Opens} (_ : y ∈ U), Γ(K, U) → (Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K :=
    fun {U} hU s ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.germ K.val.presheaf U y hU s
  have hunit : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy h ^ k) :=
    ((Y.mem_basicOpen h y hy).1 hyh).pow k
  have e1 : g hy u = Y.presheaf.germ W y hy h ^ k • g hyV t := by
    have r1 : g hy u = g hyh (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen u _ (Y.basicOpen_le h)) :=
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply K.val.presheaf (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le h)) y hyh u).symm
    have r2 : g hyV t = g hyh (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ hhV) :=
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply K.val.presheaf (homOfLE hhV) y hyh t).symm
    have r3 : Y.presheaf.germ W y hy h ^ k = Y.presheaf.germ _ y hyh
        (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen h _ (Y.basicOpen_le h) ^ k) := by
      rw [map_pow]
      exact congrArg (· ^ k)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Y.presheaf (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le h)) y hyh h).symm
    rw [r1, r2, hu, r3]
    exact PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (M := K.val) y _ hyh _ _
  have e2 : Y.presheaf.germ W y hy b • g hy u = 0 := by
    refine (PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (M := K.val) y W hy b u).symm.trans ?_
    change TopCat.Presheaf.germ K.val.presheaf W y hy (b • u) = 0
    rw [Module.mem_annihilator.1 hb u]
    exact map_zero _
  change Y.presheaf.germ W y hy b • g hyV t = 0
  rw [e1, smul_smul, mul_comm, ← smul_smul] at e2
  exact (hunit.smul_left_cancel).1 (e2.trans (smul_zero _).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.exists_pow_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.exists_pow_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen {W : Y.Opens}
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, W)] [Module.Finite Γ(Y, W) Γ(K, W)]
    (hK : ∀ y ∉ Set.range i.base, Subsingleton ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ W, i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ^ n ≤
      Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg
    (i.radical_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen hW hK) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  refine ⟨n, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  calc i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ^ n
      ≤ ((i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W).map (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom) ^ n :=
        Ideal.pow_right_mono (i.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_map_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal hW y hy) n
    _ = ((i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W) ^ n).map (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom :=
        (Ideal.map_pow _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (Module.annihilator Γ(Y, W) Γ(K, W)).map (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom :=
        Ideal.map_mono hn
    _ ≤ _ := hW.map_annihilator_le y hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_pow_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_pow_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (K : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf) [K.IsCoherent]
    (hK : ∀ y ∉ Set.range i.base, Subsingleton ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ y, i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ^ n ≤
      Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y).obj K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K' : Y.Modules := K
  haveI : K'.IsQuasicoherent := Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent K
  haveI : K'.IsFiniteType := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isFiniteType K
  have hloc : ∀ y : Y, ∃ W : Y.Opens, y ∈ W ∧ ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ y' ∈ W,
      i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y' ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y')
        ((Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.stalkFunctor y').obj K) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨U, hyU⟩ : ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, y ∈ (U : Y.Opens) :=
      Opens.mem_iSup.1 (by rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial)
    obtain ⟨g, hyg, hfin⟩ := U.2.exists_module_finite_basicOpen K' y hyU
    have hW := U.2.basicOpen g
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen g) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨_, hW⟩
    exact ⟨_, hyg, i.exists_pow_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator_of_isAffineOpen
      (K := K') hW hK⟩
  choose W hyW n hn using hloc
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun y ↦ (W y : Set Y))
    (fun y ↦ (W y).isOpen) (fun y _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨y, hyW y⟩)
  refine ⟨s.sup n, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hs (Set.mem_univ y))
  exact (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.le_sup hz)).trans (hn z y hyz)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_bot [IsReduced Y] {y : Y} {V : Y.Opens} (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (hV : (V : Set Y) ⊆ Set.range i.base) : i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal y = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨W, hyW, s, hs0, rfl⟩ := i.toLRSHom.exists_germ_eq_of_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal y r hr
  let s' : Γ(Y, V ⊓ W) := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op s
  have hs' : i.app _ s' = 0 := i.app_map_eq_zero inf_le_right s hs0
  have hbot : Y.basicOpen s' = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun z hz ↦ ?_
    exact (i.notMem_range_of_mem_basicOpen s' hs' hz
      (hV (inf_le_left (a := V) (b := W) (Y.basicOpen_le s' hz)))).elim
  rw [basicOpen_eq_bot_iff] at hbot
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot, ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE inf_le_right) y
    ⟨hyV, hyW⟩ s]
  change Y.presheaf.germ _ y _ s' = 0
  rw [hbot, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isCoherent
statement: theorem isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isCoherent [M.IsCoherent] : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent M
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_finset_basicOpen_generatingSections
statement:
theorem exists_finset_basicOpen_generatingSections [M.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Ideal.span (s : Set R) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ g ∈ s, ∃ σ : (M.over (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).GeneratingSections, σ.IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData.{u, u} M
  have hcov : ⨆ i, σ.X i = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (U := σ.X) _).1 σ.coversTop
  have htop : (⨆ g : {g : R // ∃ i, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ σ.X i},
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g.1 : (Spec R).Opens)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, σ.X i := by rw [hcov]; trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    obtain ⟨V, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxV, hV⟩ :=
      Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens hi
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨g, i, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff] at htop
  obtain ⟨s, hsub, hs1⟩ :=
    Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 htop)
  refine ⟨s, (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 hs1, fun g hg ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨g', i, hi⟩, rfl⟩ := hsub hg
  haveI := hσ.isFiniteType i
  exact ⟨SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.restrict.{u} (homOfLE hi) (σ.generators i),
    inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen [M.IsQuasicoherent] (g : R) :
    IsLocalizedModule.Away g (sectionsToBasicOpen M g).hom
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  haveI : IsIso ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ).hom.app (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))) :=
    inferInstance
  rw [show sectionsToBasicOpen M g =
      tilde.toOpen ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) ≫
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ).hom.app (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)) from
    (toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).symm]
  exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv (Submonoid.powers g)
    (tilde.toOpen ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).hom
    (asIso ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ).hom.app
      (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))).toLinearEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen_of_isCoherent
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen_of_isCoherent [M.IsCoherent] (g : R) :
    IsLocalizedModule.Away g (sectionsToBasicOpen M g).hom
proof:
:=
  haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent M
  isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen M g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.surjective_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf
  rw [← ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective]
  let f' : (⟨M, ‹_›⟩ : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) ⟶
    ⟨N, ‹_›⟩ := ObjectProperty.homMk f
  haveI : Epi f' := (ObjectProperty.ι _).epi_of_epi_map (f := f') (by exact ‹Epi f›)
  exact (tildeEquiv (R := R)).inverse.map_epi f'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_free
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_free (I : Type u) :
    (SheafOfModules.free.{u} (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) I).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  (isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ _).mpr
    (inferInstanceAs (IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := R) (SheafOfModules.free.{u} I))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem module_finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj {M : (Spec R).Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (σ : M.GeneratingSections) [Finite σ.I] :
    Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_free (R := R) σ.I
  have hπ : Function.Surjective (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map σ.π).hom :=
    surjective_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map σ.π σ.epi
  have hiso : Function.Surjective (freeΓIso (R := R) σ.I).hom.hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (freeΓIso (R := R) σ.I).hom).2
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (((freeΓIso (R := R) σ.I).hom ≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.map σ.π).hom)
    (by rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]; exact hπ.comp hiso)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_Γ_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem module_finite_Γ_of_isAffine {V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine V] (N : V.Modules)
    [N.IsQuasicoherent] (σ : N.GeneratingSections) [Finite σ.I] :
    Module.Finite Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (restrictFunctor V.isoSpec.inv) := inferInstance
  haveI : Finite (σ.map (restrictFunctor V.isoSpec.inv)
      (restrictUnitIso V.isoSpec.inv).symm).I := inferInstanceAs (Finite σ.I)
  haveI hΓ : Module.Finite Γ(V, ⊤)
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv) : Type u) :=
    module_finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj
      (σ.map (restrictFunctor V.isoSpec.inv) (restrictUnitIso V.isoSpec.inv).symm)
  letI : Module Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(V, ⊤) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv) : Type u))
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) := hΓ
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Spec Γ(V, ⊤), ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) :=
    Module.Finite.of_ringEquiv (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(V, ⊤)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  haveI h := module_finite_sections_of_restrict V.isoSpec.inv N ⊤
  have he : (V.isoSpec.inv ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(V, ⊤)).Opens) : V.Opens) = ⊤ := by simp
  exact he ▸ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_sections_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem module_finite_sections_of_isAffineOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} (N : X.Modules)
    [N.IsQuasicoherent] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (σ : (N.over U).GeneratingSections) [Finite σ.I] :
    Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(N, U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (U : Scheme.{u}) := hU
  haveI := module_finite_Γ_of_isAffine (N.restrict U.ι) (generatingSectionsRestrict N U σ)
  haveI h := module_finite_sections_of_restrict U.ι N ⊤
  exact U.ι_image_top ▸ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_sections_basicOpen
statement:
theorem module_finite_sections_basicOpen (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] (g : R)
    (σ : (N.over (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).GeneratingSections) [Finite σ.I] :
    Module.Finite Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
proof:
:=
  module_finite_sections_of_isAffineOpen N (IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen g) σ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem module_finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj_of_isFiniteType (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    [N.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N : Type u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hσ⟩ := exists_finset_basicOpen_generatingSections N
  haveI : ∀ g : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away (g : R) (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom :=
    fun g ↦ isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)
  letI : ∀ g : s, Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  haveI : ∀ g : s, IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  refine Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan_finite' s hs
    (Rₚ := fun g ↦ Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
    (fun g ↦ (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom) fun g ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ'⟩ := hσ (g : R) g.2
  haveI := hσ'
  exact module_finite_sections_basicOpen N (g : R) σ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_cokernel
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_cokernel {A B : ModuleCat.{u} R} (g : A ⟶ B)
    [Module.Finite R A] [Module.FinitePresentation R B] :
    Module.FinitePresentation R (cokernel g : ModuleCat.{u} R)
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : (LinearMap.range g.hom).FG := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]
    exact (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance).map g.hom
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (B ⧸ LinearMap.range g.hom) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_surjective (LinearMap.range g.hom).mkQ
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) (by rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]; exact hfg)
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (ModuleCat.cokernelIsoRangeQuotient g).symm.toLinearEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_Γ
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_Γ (P : M.Presentation) [P.IsFinite] :
    Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M : Type u)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite P.generators.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  haveI : Finite P.relations.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (cokernel (presentationRelMap M P) : ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
    finitePresentation_cokernel _
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((𝟭 (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (cokernel (presentationRelMap M P)) : Type u) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (Module.FinitePresentation R (cokernel (presentationRelMap M P) : ModuleCat.{u} R))
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := R)).app (cokernel (presentationRelMap M P)) ≪≫
      moduleSpecΓFunctor.mapIso (isoTildeCokernel M P)).toLinearEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_Γ_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_Γ_of_isAffine {V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine V] (N : V.Modules)
    (P : N.Presentation) [P.IsFinite] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (restrictFunctor V.isoSpec.inv) := inferInstance
  haveI hΓ : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, ⊤)
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv) : Type u) :=
    finitePresentation_Γ _ (presentationRestrict V.isoSpec.inv P)
  letI : Module Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(V, ⊤) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv) : Type u))
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(V, ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) := hΓ
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(Spec Γ(V, ⊤), ⊤) Γ(N.restrict V.isoSpec.inv, ⊤) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_ringEquiv
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(V, ⊤)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  haveI h := finitePresentation_sections_of_restrict V.isoSpec.inv N ⊤
  have he : (V.isoSpec.inv ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(V, ⊤)).Opens) : V.Opens) = ⊤ := by simp
  exact he ▸ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} (N : X.Modules)
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (P : (N.over U).Presentation) [P.IsFinite] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(N, U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (U : Scheme.{u}) := hU
  haveI := finitePresentation_Γ_of_isAffine (N.restrict U.ι) (presentationOverRestrict N U P)
  haveI h := finitePresentation_sections_of_restrict U.ι N ⊤
  exact U.ι_image_top ▸ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_sections_basicOpen
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_sections_basicOpen (N : (Spec R).Modules) (g : R)
    (P : (N.over (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).Presentation) [P.IsFinite] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
proof:
:=
  finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen N (IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen g) P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_finset_basicOpen_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_finset_basicOpen_presentation [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Ideal.span (s : Set R) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ g ∈ s, ∃ P : (M.over (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).Presentation, P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData.{u, u} M
  have hcov : ⨆ i, q.X i = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (U := q.X) _).1 q.coversTop
  have htop : (⨆ g : {g : R // ∃ i, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ q.X i},
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g.1 : (Spec R).Opens)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, q.X i := by rw [hcov]; trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    obtain ⟨V, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxV, hV⟩ :=
      Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens hi
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨g, i, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff] at htop
  obtain ⟨s, hsub, hs1⟩ :=
    Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 htop)
  refine ⟨s, (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 hs1, fun g hg ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨g', i, hi⟩, rfl⟩ := hsub hg
  haveI := hq.isFinite_presentation i
  exact ⟨SheafOfModules.Presentation.restrict.{u} (homOfLE hi) (q.presentation i), inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finitePresentation_Γ_of_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_Γ_of_isFinitePresentation (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    [N.IsFinitePresentation] :
    Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N : Type u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hP⟩ := exists_finset_basicOpen_presentation N
  haveI : ∀ g : (s : Set R), IsLocalizedModule.Away (g : R) (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom :=
    fun g ↦ isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)
  letI : ∀ g : (s : Set R), Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  haveI : ∀ g : (s : Set R), IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  refine Module.FinitePresentation.of_localizationSpan' (s : Set R) hs
    (Rₚ := fun g ↦ Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
    (fun g ↦ (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom) fun g ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨P, hP'⟩ := hP (g : R) (Finset.mem_coe.mp g.2)
  haveI := hP'
  exact finitePresentation_sections_basicOpen N (g : R) P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_isFinite_presentation_tilde
statement:
theorem exists_isFinite_presentation_tilde (N : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.FinitePresentation R N] :
    ∃ P : (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde N).Presentation, P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hker⟩ := ‹Module.FinitePresentation R N›
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hker
  haveI : Finite (s : Set N) := s.finite_toSet.to_subtype
  haveI : Finite (t : Set ((s : Set N) →₀ R)) := t.finite_toSet.to_subtype
  exact ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.presentationTilde.{u} N (s : Set N) hs (t : Set _) ht, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_isFinite_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_isFinite_presentation (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N : Type u)] :
    ∃ P : N.Presentation, P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_isFinite_presentation_tilde
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N : ModuleCat.{u} R)
  haveI := hP
  haveI := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
  exact ⟨P.ofIsIso N.fromTildeΓ, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_isFinite_presentation_of_isCoherent
statement:
theorem exists_isFinite_presentation_of_isCoherent (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ P : N.Presentation, P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent N
  haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isFinitePresentation N
  haveI := finitePresentation_Γ_of_isFinitePresentation N
  exact exists_isFinite_presentation N

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.Localizations.comapFun_injective
statement:
lemma Localizations.comapFun_injective {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M N : Type u}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (y : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    Function.Injective (Localizations.comapFun f y)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  induction a using LocalizedModule.induction_on with | h a s => ?_
  induction b using LocalizedModule.induction_on with | h b t => ?_
  rw [Localizations.comapFun_mk, Localizations.comapFun_mk, LocalizedModule.mk_eq] at hab
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hab
  rw [LocalizedModule.mk_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨c.1, c.2⟩, hf ?_⟩
  simp only [Submonoid.smul_def, map_smul] at hc ⊢
  exact hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.injective_map_app
statement:
lemma injective_map_app {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : (Spec R).Opensᵒᵖ) : Function.Injective ((tilde.map f).val.app p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext z
  exact StructureSheaf.Localizations.comapFun_injective f.hom hf z.1
    (congrArg (fun s => s.1 z) h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.mono_map
statement:
lemma mono_map {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Mono (tilde.map f)
proof:
:= by
  let G := SheafOfModules.forget (Spec R).ringCatSheaf ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _
  have : Mono (G.map (tilde.map f)) := by
    rw [NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app]
    intro p
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
    exact injective_map_app f hf p
  exact G.mono_of_mono_map this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.shortExact_map
statement:
lemma shortExact_map {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (tilde.functor R)).ShortExact where
  exact
proof:
:= hS.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel _ hS.epi_g inferInstance
  mono_f := mono_map S.f ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 hS.mono_f)
  epi_g := by haveI := hS.epi_g; exact (tilde.functor R).map_epi S.g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_restrict_sections
statement:
theorem module_finite_restrict_sections {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : W.Modules) (U : V.Opens) [Module.Finite Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U)] :
    Module.Finite Γ(V, U) Γ(M.restrict f, U)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M.restrict f, U) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U))
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M.restrict f, U) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite Γ(W, f ''ᵁ U) Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U))
  refine Module.Finite.of_ringEquiv (f.appIso U).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv fun a n ↦ ?_
  have := smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply f M U ((f.appIso U).hom a) n
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.module_finite_Γ_restrict
statement:
theorem module_finite_Γ_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (j : Spec R ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict j) : Type u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData.{u, u} F
  have hcov : ⨆ i, σ.X i = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (U := σ.X) _).1 σ.coversTop
  have htop : (⨆ g : {g : R // ∃ i, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ σ.X i},
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g.1 : (Spec R).Opens)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : j.base x ∈ ⨆ i, σ.X i := by rw [hcov]; trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    obtain ⟨V, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxV, hV⟩ :=
      Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens
        (show x ∈ j ⁻¹ᵁ σ.X i from hi)
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨g, i, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff] at htop
  obtain ⟨s, hsub, hs1⟩ :=
    Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 htop)
  have hs : Ideal.span (s : Set R) = ⊤ := (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 hs1
  set N := F.restrict j
  have hfin : ∀ g ∈ s, Module.Finite Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨⟨g', i, hi⟩, rfl⟩ := hsub hg
    haveI := hσ.isFiniteType i
    let τ := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.restrict.{u}
      (homOfLE ((j.image_mono hi).trans (j.image_preimage_le _))) (σ.generators i)
    haveI : Finite τ.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
    haveI := module_finite_sections_of_isAffineOpen F
      ((IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen g').image_of_isOpenImmersion j) τ
    exact module_finite_restrict_sections j F _
  haveI : ∀ g : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away (g : R) (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom :=
    fun g ↦ isLocalizedModule_away_sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)
  letI : ∀ g : s, Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  haveI : ∀ g : s, IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))) : Type u) :=
    fun g ↦ inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R))
      Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
  refine Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan_finite' s hs
    (Rₚ := fun g ↦ Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g : R)))
    (fun g ↦ (sectionsToBasicOpen N (g : R)).hom) fun g ↦ ?_
  exact hfin g g.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_isAffine {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] {φ ψ : T ⟶ X.toLocallyRingedSpace}
    (h : Γ.map φ.op = Γ.map ψ.op) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toΓSpec, toΓSpec_naturality, toΓSpec_naturality, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isAffine_of_isClosedImmersion
statement: lemma isAffine_of_isClosedImmersion : IsAffine Z
proof:
:=
  (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine i).1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.closedImmersion_hom_ext
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_hom_ext {ψ₁ ψ₂ : T ⟶ Z.toLocallyRingedSpace}
    (h : ψ₁ ≫ i.toLRSHom = ψ₂ ≫ i.toLRSHom) : ψ₁ = ψ₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isAffine_of_isClosedImmersion i
  refine hom_ext_of_isAffine ?_
  have hs : Function.Surjective i.appTop :=
    (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine i).2
  have h' := congrArg (fun φ ↦ Γ.map (Quiver.Hom.op φ)) h
  simp only [op_comp, Functor.map_comp] at h'
  ext a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hs a
  exact congrArg (fun m ↦ m.hom b) h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.closedImmersionLiftΓ_appTop
statement:
lemma closedImmersionLiftΓ_appTop (φ : T ⟶ X.toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (hφ : ∀ a, i.appTop a = 0 → (Γ.map φ.op) a = 0) (a : Γ.obj (op X.toLocallyRingedSpace)) :
    closedImmersionLiftΓ i φ hφ (Γ.map i.toLRSHom.op a) = Γ.map φ.op a
proof:
:=
  RingHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply _ _ _ _ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.closedImmersionLift_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem closedImmersionLift_comp (φ : T ⟶ X.toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (hφ : ∀ a, i.appTop a = 0 → (Γ.map φ.op) a = 0) :
    closedImmersionLift i φ hφ ≫ i.toLRSHom = φ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine Z := isAffine_of_isClosedImmersion i
  have hi := toΓSpec_naturality i.toLRSHom
  have hρ : Γ.map i.toLRSHom.op ≫ closedImmersionLiftΓ i φ hφ = Γ.map φ.op :=
    CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a ↦ closedImmersionLiftΓ_appTop i φ hφ a)
  rw [← cancel_mono X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toΓSpec, toΓSpec_naturality φ, closedImmersionLift,
    Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hi]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Spec.locallyRingedSpaceMap_comp, hρ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.existsUnique_closedImmersionLift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_closedImmersionLift (φ : T ⟶ X.toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (hφ : ∀ a, i.appTop a = 0 → (Γ.map φ.op) a = 0) :
    ∃! ψ : T ⟶ Z.toLocallyRingedSpace, ψ ≫ i.toLRSHom = φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨closedImmersionLift i φ hφ, closedImmersionLift_comp i φ hφ, fun _ hψ ↦
    closedImmersion_hom_ext i (hψ.trans (closedImmersionLift_comp i φ hφ).symm)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.range_eq_of_isAffine
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : closure (Set.range i) = Set.range i := i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq
  ext x
  rw [← hcl, ← Scheme.Hom.support_ker, SetLike.mem_coe,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem (U := ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩) trivial,
    Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  change x ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom : Set Γ(X, ⊤)) ↔ _
  rw [← hh, Scheme.zeroLocus_span, Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mono_of_injOn_closedPoints
statement:
theorem mono_of_injOn_closedPoints (f : X ⟶ Y) [FormallyUnramified f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (i : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType i]
    (hinj : ∀ x x' : X, IsClosed {x} → IsClosed {x'} → f x = f x' → x = x') : Mono f
proof:
:= by
  have hXJ : JacobsonSpace X := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace (f ≫ i)
  have hYJ : JacobsonSpace Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace i
  have : pullback.fst f f = pullback.snd f f := by
    refine ext_of_apply_eq_of_formallyUnramified f i pullback.condition fun w hw ↦ ?_
    have h₁ : IsClosed {pullback.fst f f w} :=
      (pullback.fst f f).closePoints_subset_preimage_closedPoints hw
    have h₂ : IsClosed {pullback.snd f f w} :=
      (pullback.snd f f).closePoints_subset_preimage_closedPoints hw
    refine hinj _ _ h₁ h₂ ?_
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition]
  refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  have ha : pullback.lift a b hab ≫ pullback.fst f f = a := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hb : pullback.lift a b hab ≫ pullback.snd f f = b := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  rw [← ha, this, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_of_isClosedMap_of_closedPoints_subset
statement:
theorem surjective_of_isClosedMap_of_closedPoints_subset [JacobsonSpace Y] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedMap f) (hsurj : ∀ y : Y, IsClosed {y} → ∃ x, f x = y) : Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range f) := hf.isClosed_range
  have hsub : closedPoints Y ⊆ Set.range f := fun y hy ↦ hsurj y hy
  have : Set.range f = Set.univ := by
    rw [← hcl.closure_eq, ← Set.univ_subset_iff]
    exact (closure_closedPoints (X := Y)).symm.subset.trans (closure_mono hsub)
  exact this.symm.subset (Set.mem_univ y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_of_isFinite_of_etale_of_bijOn_closedPoints
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isFinite_of_etale_of_bijOn_closedPoints (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (i : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType i]
    (hinj : ∀ x x' : X, IsClosed {x} → IsClosed {x'} → f x = f x' → x = x')
    (hsurj : ∀ y : Y, IsClosed {y} → ∃ x, f x = y) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have : JacobsonSpace Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace i
  have : Mono f := mono_of_injOn_closedPoints f i hinj
  have : Surjective f := surjective_of_isClosedMap_of_closedPoints_subset f f.isClosedMap hsurj
  exact Flat.isIso_of_surjective_of_mono f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_fromSpecResidueField_eq_of_formallyUnramified
statement:
theorem ext_of_fromSpecResidueField_eq_of_formallyUnramified {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [JacobsonSpace X] {f g : X ⟶ Y} (s : Y ⟶ Z) [FormallyUnramified s] [LocallyOfFiniteType s]
    (h : f ≫ s = g ≫ s)
    (H : ∀ x ∈ closedPoints X, X.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ f = X.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  let X' : Over Z := Over.mk (f ≫ s)
  let Y' : Over Z := Over.mk s
  let f' : X' ⟶ Y' := Over.homMk f
  let g' : X' ⟶ Y' := Over.homMk g h.symm
  have : FormallyUnramified Y'.hom := ‹_›
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType Y'.hom := ‹_›
  have hsurj : Surjective (equalizer.ι f' g').left := by
    refine ⟨fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    have hr := JacobsonSpace.eq_univ_of_isOpen_of_closedPoints_subset (X := X)
      (equalizer.ι f' g').left.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    · exact Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.1 hr x
    let ι' : Over.mk (X.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ f ≫ s) ⟶ X' :=
      Over.homMk (X.fromSpecResidueField x)
    refine ⟨(equalizer.lift ι' ?_).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint _), ?_⟩
    · ext1
      exact H x hx
    · rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Over.comp_left, equalizer.lift_ι]
      exact Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply x _
  have := (isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective (equalizer.ι f' g').left).2
    ⟨inferInstance, hsurj⟩
  rw [← cancel_epi (equalizer.ι f' g').left]
  exact congr($(equalizer.condition f' g').left)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion.image_basicOpen_ΓIsoTop
statement:
theorem image_basicOpen_ΓIsoTop (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    f ''ᵁ X.basicOpen r = Y.basicOpen ((ΓIsoTop f).hom r)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ΓIsoTop f).hom = ((f.appIso ⊤).symm ≪≫
      Y.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso f.image_top_eq_opensRange.symm).op).hom := rfl
  rw [Scheme.image_basicOpen, h, Iso.trans_hom, CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.basicOpen_res_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion.image_primeSpectrum_basicOpen
statement:
theorem image_primeSpectrum_basicOpen (a : R) :

proof:
:= by
  have h : (specΓIsoTop f).hom = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).symm ≪≫ ΓIsoTop f).hom := rfl
  rw [h, Iso.trans_hom, CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← image_basicOpen_ΓIsoTop, Iso.symm_hom,
    basicOpen_eq_of_affine]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv_restrictOpen
statement:
lemma Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv_restrictOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    U.topIso.inv (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x U le_top) = U.ι.appTop x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.basicOpen_ι_toSpec
statement:
lemma basicOpen_ι_toSpec {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {m : ℕ} (f_deg : f ∈ 𝒜 m)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f).ι ≫ toSpec n R =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (awayConst f))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 f ≫ Proj.awayι 𝒜 f f_deg hm = (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f).ι := by
    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι 𝒜 f f_deg hm, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom 𝒜 f f_deg hm,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← h, Category.assoc, toSpec, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.restrict_toSpec_appTop
statement:
lemma restrict_toSpec_appTop {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {m : ℕ} (f_deg : f ∈ 𝒜 m)
    (hm : 0 < m) (r : R) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ((toSpec n R).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))
      (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f) le_top = Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f (awayConst f r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f).topIso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.injective
  have h1 := congr($(Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top 𝒜 f).hom
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Away 𝒜 f))).inv (awayConst f r)))
  have h2 := congr($(basicOpen_ι_toSpec f_deg hm).appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  have h3 := congr($(Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (awayConst (R := R) f))).hom
    r)
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at h1
  refine (Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv_restrictOpen _ _).trans (h2.trans ?_)
  exact (congrArg _ h3.symm).trans h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayEval_awayXBase
statement:
lemma awayEval_awayXBase (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0)
    (r : R) : awayEval (φ := φ) v (X i) hi (awayXBase R i r) = φ r
proof:
:= by
  have := congr($(awayEval_comp_toAwayX (φ := φ) v i hi) (C r))
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayEval_awayXDiv
statement:
lemma awayEval_awayXDiv (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0) :
    awayEval (φ := φ) v (X i) hi (awayXDiv R i j) = v j / v i
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : v i ≠ 0 := by simpa using hi
  obtain rfl | ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j
  · rw [awayXDiv_self, map_one, div_self hi']
  · have := congr($(awayEval_comp_toAwayX (φ := φ) v i hi) (X m))
    simpa [dehomogenizeVec] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayι_awayPoint_mem_basicOpen_iff
statement:
lemma awayι_awayPoint_mem_basicOpen_iff (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0) (a : Away 𝒜 (X i)) :
    (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (X i) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i) Nat.one_pos).base
        (awayPoint (φ := φ) v (X i) hi) ∈
      ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X i) a) ↔ awayEval (φ := φ) v (X i) hi a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hX := X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) i
  have e1 : Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 (X i) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a =
      (U n R i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X i) a) := by
    rw [Proj.basicOpenToSpec, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen,
      Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen]
    rfl
  set q := awayPoint (φ := φ) v (X i) hi
  have hq : (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos).base q =
      (U n R i).ι.base ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos).inv.base q) := by
    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    rfl
  have hq' : (Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 (X i)).base
      ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos).inv.base q) = q := by
    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  rw [hq, ← Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage, ← e1]
  change (Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 (X i)).base
    ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 (X i) hX Nat.one_pos).inv.base q) ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a ↔ _
  rw [hq']
  change a ∉ q.asIdeal ↔ _
  exact not_congr RingHom.mem_ker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mapGradedHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapGradedHom_apply (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    mapGradedHom n f p = MvPolynomial.map f p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mem_irrelevant_iff_coeff_zero
statement:
lemma mem_irrelevant_iff_coeff_zero {S : Type u} [CommRing S]
    (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) S) :
    a ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) S) ↔ coeff 0 a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply]
  exact (congrArg (· = 0) (decomposition.decompose'_apply a 0)).to_iff.trans (by
    rw [homogeneousComponent_zero, C_eq_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_mapGradedHom
statement:
lemma irrelevant_le_map_mapGradedHom :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) A) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R)).map
        (mapGradedHom n f)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  change b ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.map _ _).toIdeal
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map]
  have h1 : b ∈ Ideal.span (X '' Set.univ) := by
    rw [mem_ideal_span_X_image]
    intro m hm
    by_contra! h
    have : m = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ h i (Set.mem_univ i)
    subst this
    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hm) ((mem_irrelevant_iff_coeff_zero b).mp hb)
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_ h1
  rintro _ ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
  rw [← map_X f]
  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (mapGradedHom n f)
    (show X i ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant _ from ?_)
  rw [mem_irrelevant_iff_coeff_zero, coeff_X]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayMapHom_comp_toAwayX
statement:
lemma awayMapHom_comp_toAwayX (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (awayMapHom n f i).comp (toAwayX R i) = (toAwayX A i).comp (MvPolynomial.map f)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayι_comp_map

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.chart_comp_map
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma chart_comp_map (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chart i ≫ map f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.map f)) ≫ chart i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart, Category.assoc, awayι_comp_map, chart, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  ext p : 2
  apply (awayXEquiv A i).injective
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (awayXEquiv R i).surjective p
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, awayXEquiv_symm_apply,
    awayXEquiv_apply, fromAwayX_toAwayX, toAwayX_fromAwayX]
  exact congr($(awayMapHom_comp_toAwayX f i) p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.map_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_toSpec :
    map f ≫ toSpec n R = toSpec n A ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  refine (affineOpenCover n A).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) ↦ ?_
  change chart j ≫ map f ≫ toSpec n R = chart j ≫ toSpec n A ≫ _
  rw [chart_comp_map_assoc, chart_toSpec, chart_toSpec_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext r : 2
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_chart_map
statement:
lemma isPullback_chart_map (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.map f))) (chart i) (chart i)
      (map f)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (chart_comp_map f i) (by
    rw [opensRange_chart, opensRange_chart, map_preimage_U])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_SpecMap_mvPolynomialMap
statement:
lemma isPullback_SpecMap_mvPolynomialMap :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.map f)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (C : A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) := algebraMvPolynomial
  exact isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map
statement:
theorem isPullback_map :
    IsPullback (map f) (toSpec n A) (toSpec n R) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ (affineOpenCover n R).openCover fun i ↦ ?_
  change IsPullback (pullback.snd (map f) (chart i)) (pullback.fst (map f) (chart i) ≫
    toSpec n A) (chart i ≫ toSpec n R) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
  have hc := (isPullback_chart_map f i).flip
  rw [chart_toSpec]
  refine .of_iso (isPullback_SpecMap_mvPolynomialMap (n := n) f) hc.isoPullback (.refl _)
    (.refl _) (.refl _) ?_ ?_ (by simp) (by simp)
  · simp
  · simp [chart_toSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cocycle_isPullback
statement:
theorem cocycle_isPullback :
    Cocycle.IsPullback (map f) id (fun i ↦ (map_preimage_U f i).ge) (cocycle n R)
      (cocycle n A)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j W hW
  have hWi : W ≤ U n A i := hW.trans inf_le_left
  rw [cocycle_g, cocycle_g, ores_res, appLE_res]
  refine (res_appLE (map f) (map_preimage_U f i).ge hWi (xDiv i j)).symm.trans ?_
  rw [map_appLE_xDiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.UIIsoSpec_inv_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma UIIsoSpec_inv_ι (i : Fin (n + 1)) (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hi : i ∈ I) :
    (UIIsoSpec i I hi).inv ≫ (UI n R I).ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap _ _)) ≫ chart i
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (Finset.mul_prod_erase I (fun j ↦ (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)) hi).symm
  have hg := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) (I.erase i)
  have h₁ : (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 _ (prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule I)
      (card_pos_of_mem hi)).inv ≫ (UI n R I).ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (awayMap 𝒜 hg hx)) ≫
        Proj.awayι 𝒜 (X i) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i) Nat.one_pos := by
    rw [Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι]
    rfl
  rw [UIIsoSpec, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc, h₁, chart, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext p : 2
  apply (awayProdXEquiv R i I hi).injective
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, awayXEquiv_symm_apply, awayProdXEquiv_algebraMap,
    toAwayProdX, toAwayX_fromAwayX]

    awayToLocalization 𝒜 f t (Away.mk 𝒜 hd n a ha) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.fromOfGlobalSections_resLE_basicOpenIsoSpec_hom

      (fromOfGlobalSections_preimage_basicOpen 𝒜 f hf h0d hd).ge ≫
        (basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 t hd h0d).hom =
      X.basicOpenToSpecAway (f t) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (awayToLocalization 𝒜 f t))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.germ_UI_injective
statement:
lemma germ_UI_injective {n : ℕ} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (hI : I.Nonempty) (x : ℙ(n; R)) (hx : x ∈ UI n R I) :
    Function.Injective (ℙ(n; R).presheaf.germ (UI n R I) x hx)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : prodX R I ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ ↦ MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero j
  haveI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (prodX R I)) :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_localization (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hne)
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I) := (toAway_injective hI).isDomain _
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hI
  have hU := isAffineOpen_UI (R := R) hi
  have := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact @IsLocalization.injective _ _ _ _ _ (show _ from _) this
    (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.finite_of_globalCoeff_mem
statement:
lemma finite_of_globalCoeff_mem [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : ℤ)
    (p : Submodule R ((Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℤ) →₀ R)) [Module.Finite R p]
    (h : ∀ s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤), globalCoeff k 0 s ∈ p) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  haveI := isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite R p
  Module.Finite.of_injective ((globalCoeffLinear n R k 0).codRestrict p h)
    fun _ _ hab ↦ globalCoeff_injective k 0 (congrArg Subtype.val hab)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.finite_sections_twistingSheaf
statement:
theorem finite_sections_twistingSheaf [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ n := by omega
  · let S : Set (Fin 1 →₀ ℤ) := {Finsupp.single 0 k}
    haveI : Module.Finite R (Finsupp.supported R R S) :=
      Module.Finite.equiv (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S).symm
    refine finite_of_globalCoeff_mem k (Finsupp.supported R R S) fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [Finsupp.mem_supported]
    intro a ha
    have h := (mem_laurentPart.mp (globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart_singleton k 0 s) a
      (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha)).2
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_one] at h
    refine Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (Finsupp.ext fun j ↦ ?_)
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j, Finsupp.single_eq_same, h]
  obtain hk | ⟨d, rfl⟩ : k < 0 ∨ ∃ d : ℕ, k = d := by
    rcases lt_or_ge k 0 with hk | hk
    · exact Or.inl hk
    · exact Or.inr ⟨k.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hk).symm⟩
  · refine finite_of_globalCoeff_mem k ⊥ fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [globalSections_eq_zero k hn hk s, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · haveI : Module.Finite R (𝒜 d) :=
      Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (homogeneousSubmodule_fg _ _ d)
    refine finite_of_globalCoeff_mem (d : ℤ) (LinearMap.range (polyCoeffLinear n R d))
      fun s ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : globalCoeff (d : ℤ) 0 s ∈ (polyCoeff R d).range := by
      rw [← range_globalCoeff hn d]
      exact ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, hp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.finite_sections_of_iso

lemma finite_sections_of_iso {M N : ℙ(n; R).Modules} (e : M ≅ N) [Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤)] :
    Module.Finite R Γ(N, ⊤)
proof:
:=
