    ⟨sectionsMap e.inv y, by rw [← sectionsMap_comp, e.inv_hom_id, sectionsMap_id]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.finite_sections_sigma
statement:
lemma finite_sections_sigma {I : Type u} [Finite I] (G : I → ℙ(n; R).Modules)
    [∀ i, Module.Finite R Γ(G i, ⊤)] : Module.Finite R Γ(∐ G, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have := HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct G
  suffices Module.Finite R Γ(⨁ G, ⊤) from finite_sections_of_iso (biproduct.isoCoproduct G)
  let L : (∀ i, Γ(G i, ⊤)) →ₗ[R] Γ(⨁ G, ⊤) :=
    ∑ i, (sectionsMap (biproduct.ι G i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  refine Module.Finite.of_surjective L fun x ↦ ⟨fun i ↦ sectionsMap (biproduct.π G i) x, ?_⟩
  have htot : ∑ i, biproduct.π G i ≫ biproduct.ι G i = 𝟙 (⨁ G) :=
    IsBilimit.total (biproduct.isBilimit G)
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset I) (φ : I → (⨁ G ⟶ ⨁ G)),
      sectionsMap (∑ i ∈ s, φ i) x = ∑ i ∈ s, sectionsMap (φ i) x := by
    classical
    intro s φ
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [sectionsMap_zero]
    | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, sectionsMap_add, ih]
  simp only [L, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply]
  simp_rw [← sectionsMap_comp]
  rw [← hsum, htot, sectionsMap_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_module_finite_twist
statement:
theorem exists_module_finite_twist [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m →
      letI
proof:
:= sectionsModule (twist F m); Module.Finite R Γ(twist F m, ⊤) := by
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := exists_epi_twist_free_isCoherent_kernel F
  obtain ⟨I, _, π, _, -, hK⟩ := hm₁ m₁ le_rfl
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ := exists_H_twist_eq_zero (kernel π)
  refine ⟨m₂, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  let S : ShortComplex ℙ(n; R).Modules := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel π))
      inferInstance inferInstance
  have hS' := (hS.map_of_exact (twistFunctor n R m)).map_of_exact
    (Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R))
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (sectionsMap ((twistFunctor n R m).map π)) :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.surjective_of_H_one hS' (hm₂ m hm 0)
  haveI (k : ℤ) := finite_sections_twistingSheaf n R k
  haveI := finite_sections_sigma fun _ : I ↦ twistingSheaf n R (-(m₁ : ℤ) + m)
  let e := twistTwistIso (SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (-(m₁ : ℤ)) m ≪≫
    twistFreeIso I (-(m₁ : ℤ) + m)
  have : Module.Finite R
      Γ((twistFunctor n R m).obj (twist (SheafOfModules.free I) (-(m₁ : ℤ))), ⊤) :=
    finite_sections_of_iso e.symm
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective _ hsurj

name: MvPolynomial.killLast_X_last
statement: @[simp] lemma killLast_X_last : killLast R n (X (Fin.last n)) = 0
proof: := by simp [killLast]

name: MvPolynomial.killLast_X_castSucc
statement: @[simp] lemma killLast_X_castSucc (j : Fin n) : killLast R n (X j.castSucc) = X j
proof:
:= by
  simp [killLast]

name: MvPolynomial.killLast_C
statement: lemma killLast_C (r : R) : killLast R n (C r) = C r
proof: := by simp [killLast]

name: MvPolynomial.killLast_mem_homogeneousSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have := (show p.IsHomogeneous m from hp).aeval
    (Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ ↦ MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) 0 X) (n := 1) (fun i ↦ by
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => simpa using isHomogeneous_zero (Fin n) R 1
      | cast j => simpa using isHomogeneous_X R j)
  rw [one_mul] at this
  exact this

name: MvPolynomial.killLast_surjective
statement: lemma killLast_surjective : Function.Surjective (killLast R n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  refine ⟨rename Fin.castSucc p, ?_⟩
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p j hp => simp [hp]

name: MvPolynomial.exists_eq_rename_killLast_add
statement:
lemma exists_eq_rename_killLast_add (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    ∃ q, p = rename Fin.castSucc (killLast R n p) + X (Fin.last n) * q
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨a + b, by rw [map_add, map_add]; nth_rw 1 [ha, hb]; ring⟩
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      refine ⟨rename Fin.castSucc (killLast R n p) + a * X (Fin.last n), ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, killLast_X_last, mul_zero, map_zero, zero_add]
      nth_rw 1 [ha]
      ring
    | cast j =>
      refine ⟨a * X j.castSucc, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, killLast_X_castSucc, map_mul, rename_X]
      nth_rw 1 [ha]
      ring

name: MvPolynomial.exists_eq_X_last_mul_of_killLast_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_eq_X_last_mul_of_killLast_eq_zero {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R}
    (hp : killLast R n p = 0) : ∃ q, p = X (Fin.last n) * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eq_rename_killLast_add p
  exact ⟨q, by rw [hq, hp, map_zero, zero_add]⟩

name: HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_surjective
statement:
lemma Away.map_surjective (g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hg : Function.Surjective g) {d : ℕ} {s : A}
    (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) : Function.Surjective (Away.map g s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨k, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective ℬ (g.2 hs) x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hg b
  refine ⟨Away.mk 𝒜 hs k _ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a (k • d)).2, ?_⟩
  rw [Away.map_mk]
  congr 1
  rw [GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_hyperplaneGradedHom
statement:
lemma irrelevant_le_map_hyperplaneGradedHom :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) R)).map
        (hyperplaneGradedHom n R)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := killLast_surjective (R := R) (n := n + 1) b
  have ha : a - (DirectSum.decompose (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) R) a 0 :
      MvPolynomial _ R) ∈
        HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) R) := by
    simp
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (hyperplaneGradedHom n R) ha
  rw [map_sub, GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose] at this
  have hb' : ((DirectSum.decompose (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R)
      (hyperplaneGradedHom n R a) 0 : homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 0) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) = 0 := by
    rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply] at hb
    exact hb
  rwa [hb', sub_zero] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneGradedHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hyperplaneGradedHom_apply (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) R) :
    hyperplaneGradedHom n R p = killLast R (n + 1) p
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneGradedHom_surjective
statement: lemma hyperplaneGradedHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (hyperplaneGradedHom n R)
proof:
:=
  killLast_surjective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc
statement:
lemma hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc = U n R j
proof:
:= by
  rw [U, hyperplane, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen, hyperplaneGradedHom_apply, killLast_X_castSucc,
    U]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_preimage_U_last
statement: lemma hyperplane_preimage_U_last : hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [U, hyperplane, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen, hyperplaneGradedHom_apply, killLast_X_last,
    Proj.basicOpen_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_app_surjective
statement:
lemma hyperplane_app_surjective (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective (hyperplane n R |>.app (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE (hyperplaneGradedHom n R)
    (irrelevant_le_map_hyperplaneGradedHom n R) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j.castSucc)
  have h1 : Function.Surjective (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R)
      (hyperplaneGradedHom n R (X j.castSucc))) := by
    exact (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway _ _ ((hyperplaneGradedHom n R).2
      (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j.castSucc))
        Nat.one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective
  have h2 := h1.comp (Away.map_surjective _ hyperplaneGradedHom_surjective
    (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) j.castSucc))
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_ofHom (Away.map _ _), ← RingHom.coe_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    ← h] at h2
  rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  exact Function.Surjective.of_comp h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_appTop_morphismRestrict
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ V W (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V), V = U → W = f ⁻¹ᵁ U →
      Function.Surjective (f.appLE V W e) := by
    rintro V W e rfl rfl
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
    exact h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appTop, morphismRestrict_app']
  exact key _ _ _ (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _) (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv
statement:
lemma hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv (j : Fin (n + 1)) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    hyperplaneAwayMap n R j (awayXDiv R j.castSucc m) =
      Away.mk _ (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) 1 (killLast R (n + 1) (X m))
        (by simpa using killLast_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one m))
proof:
:= by
  apply val_injective
  simp [hyperplaneAwayMap, awayXDiv, Away.mk, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneAwayMap_comp_toAwayX
statement:
lemma hyperplaneAwayMap_comp_toAwayX (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (hyperplaneAwayMap n R j).comp (toAwayX R j.castSucc) =
      (toAwayX R j).comp (killLast R n).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro r
    apply val_injective
    simp [hyperplaneAwayMap, toAwayX, awayXBase, fromZeroRingHom, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk]
  · intro k
    induction k using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      have : j.castSucc.succAbove (Fin.last n) = Fin.last (n + 1) := by
        rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mpr (Fin.le_last j)),
          Fin.succ_last]
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, toAwayX_X, this,
        hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv, killLast_X_last, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
        map_zero]
      apply val_injective
      simp [Localization.mk_zero]
    | cast k =>
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, toAwayX_X, Fin.castSucc_succAbove_castSucc,
        hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv, killLast_X_castSucc, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_comp_map_of_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_comp_map_of_eq {A B σ τ : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [CommRing B] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : 0 < i) {s : A} (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 i) {t : B} (ht : t ∈ ℬ i) (h : f s = t) :
    Proj.awayι ℬ t ht hi ≫ Proj.map f hf =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.map f (P := .powers s)
        (Q := .powers t) (by rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, by simp [h]⟩))) ≫
        Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hi
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf hi s hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayι_comp_hyperplane
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma awayι_comp_hyperplane (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι _ (X j) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) Nat.one_pos ≫ hyperplane n R =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (hyperplaneAwayMap n R j)) ≫
        Proj.awayι _ (X j.castSucc) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j.castSucc) Nat.one_pos
proof:
:=
  Proj.awayι_comp_map_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ (killLast_X_castSucc j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.chart_comp_hyperplane
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma chart_comp_hyperplane (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chart j ≫ hyperplane n R =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (killLast R n).toRingHom) ≫ chart j.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart, Category.assoc, awayι_comp_hyperplane, chart, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  ext p : 2
  apply (awayXEquiv R j).injective
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (awayXEquiv R j.castSucc).surjective p
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, awayXEquiv_symm_apply,
    awayXEquiv_apply, fromAwayX_toAwayX, toAwayX_fromAwayX]
  exact congr($(hyperplaneAwayMap_comp_toAwayX j) p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma hyperplane_toSpec : hyperplane n R ≫ toSpec (n + 1) R = toSpec n R
proof:
:= by
  refine (affineOpenCover n R).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) ↦ ?_
  change chart j ≫ hyperplane n R ≫ toSpec (n + 1) R = chart j ≫ toSpec n R
  rw [chart_comp_hyperplane_assoc, chart_toSpec, chart_toSpec, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  ext r : 2
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneAwayMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := toAwayX_surjective (R := R) j.castSucc z
  have h := congr($(hyperplaneAwayMap_comp_toAwayX (R := R) j) p)
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h
  rw [h, ← awayXEquiv_apply, ← map_zero (awayXEquiv R j)] at hz
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_X_last_mul_of_killLast_eq_zero ((awayXEquiv R j).injective hz)
  have : j.castSucc.succAbove (Fin.last n) = Fin.last (n + 1) := by
    rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mpr (Fin.le_last j)),
      Fin.succ_last]
  exact ⟨toAwayX R j.castSucc q, by rw [map_mul, toAwayX_X, this]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.appLE_awayToSection_of_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.appLE_awayToSection_of_eq {A B σ τ : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [CommRing B] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f) {i : ℕ}
    {s : A} (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 i) {t : B} (h : f s = t) (e) (z : Away 𝒜 s) :
    (Proj.map f hf).appLE (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 s) (Proj.basicOpen ℬ t) e
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 s z) =
      Proj.awayToSection ℬ t (HomogeneousLocalization.map f (P := .powers s)
        (Q := .powers t) (by rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, by simp [h]⟩) z)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact congr($(Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE f hf hs) z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le
statement:
lemma hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    U n R j ≤ hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc
proof:
:=
  (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc j).ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_appLE_awayToSection
statement:
lemma hyperplane_appLE_awayToSection (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (z : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) R) (X j.castSucc)) :
    (hyperplane n R).appLE (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (U n R j) (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le j)
      (Proj.awayToSection _ (X j.castSucc) z) =
      Proj.awayToSection _ (X j) (hyperplaneAwayMap n R j z)
proof:
:=
  Proj.appLE_awayToSection_of_eq _ _ (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j.castSucc)
    (killLast_X_castSucc j) _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_castSucc
statement:
lemma hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_castSucc (j l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (hyperplane n R).appLE (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (U n R j) (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le j)
      (xDiv j.castSucc l.castSucc) = xDiv j l
proof:
:= by
  rw [xDiv, hyperplane_appLE_awayToSection, hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv, xDiv]
  congr 1
  apply val_injective
  simp [val_awayXDiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_last
statement:
lemma hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_last (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (hyperplane n R).appLE (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (U n R j) (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le j)
      (xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [xDiv, hyperplane_appLE_awayToSection, hyperplaneAwayMap_awayXDiv]
  have h0 : ∀ h, Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R)
      (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) 1 (killLast R (n + 1) (X (Fin.last (n + 1)))) h = 0 :=
    fun h ↦ by apply val_injective; simp [Localization.mk_zero]
  rw [h0]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_app_U_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hyperplane_app_U_eq_zero (j : Fin (n + 1)) {y : Γ(ℙ(n + 1; R), U (n + 1) R j.castSucc)}
    (hy : (hyperplane n R).app _ y = 0) : ∃ r, y = xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _) * r
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : (hyperplane n R).appLE (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (U n R j)
      (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le j) y = 0 := by
    change ℙ(n; R).presheaf.map _ ((hyperplane n R).app _ y) = 0
    rw [hy, map_zero]
  let e := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway _ _ (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) j.castSucc)
    Nat.one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e' := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway _ _ (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) j)
    Nat.one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
  change (hyperplane n R).appLE (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (U n R j) _
    (Proj.awayToSection _ _ z) = 0 at hy'
  rw [hyperplane_appLE_awayToSection] at hy'
  have : hyperplaneAwayMap n R j z = 0 := e'.injective (hy'.trans (map_zero e').symm)
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hyperplaneAwayMap_eq_zero this
  exact ⟨Proj.awayToSection _ _ w, map_mul (Proj.awayToSection _ _).hom _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.pushforwardStalkIdeal_hyperplane_le
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_hyperplane_le (l : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (x : ℙ(n + 1; R))
    (hx : x ∈ U (n + 1) R l) :
    (hyperplane n R).toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal x ≤
      Ideal.span {ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.germ (U (n + 1) R l) x hx (xDiv l (Fin.last _))}
proof:
:= by
  induction l using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    rw [xDiv_self, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
    exact le_top
  | cast j =>
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, s, hs, rfl⟩ :=
      (hyperplane n R).toLRSHom.exists_germ_eq_of_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal x r hr
    obtain ⟨f, hfle, hxf⟩ :=
      (isAffineOpen_U (n := n + 1) (R := R) j.castSucc).exists_basicOpen_le
        (V := W ⊓ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) ⟨x, hxW, hx⟩ hx
    have hDW : ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen f ≤ W := hfle.trans inf_le_left
    have hy : (hyperplane n R).app _ (ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.map (homOfLE hDW).op s) = 0 := by
      have hnat := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ s)
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((hyperplane n R).c.naturality (homOfLE hDW).op))
      exact hnat.trans ((CommRingCat.comp_apply _ _ s).trans
        ((congrArg _ hs).trans (map_zero _)))
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hyperplane_app_basicOpen_eq_zero j f hy
    have hg : ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.germ _ x hxf (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen
        (xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _)) _ (ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen_le f)) =
        ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.germ (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) x hx (xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _)) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
    rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf (homOfLE hDW) x hxf s, hr',
      map_mul, hg]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_app_xDiv_last
statement:
lemma hyperplane_app_xDiv_last (l : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    (hyperplane n R).app (U (n + 1) R l) (xDiv l (Fin.last _)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    have : Subsingleton Γ(ℙ(n; R), hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _)) := by
      rw [hyperplane_preimage_U_last]
      exact CommRingCat.subsingleton_of_isTerminal ℙ(n; R).sheaf.isTerminalOfEmpty
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | cast j =>
    have h := hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_last (R := R) j
    have e' : hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc ≤ U n R j :=
      (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc j).le
    have hinj : Function.Injective (ℙ(n; R).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le (R := R) j)).op) := by
      intro a b hab
      have := congrArg (ℙ(n; R).presheaf.map (homOfLE e').op) hab
      rwa [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp,
        Subsingleton.elim (_ ≫ _) (𝟙 _), CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id] at this
    exact hinj (h.trans (map_zero (ℙ(n; R).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le (R := R) j)).op).hom).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.germ_xDiv_last_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal
statement:
lemma germ_xDiv_last_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal (l : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (x : ℙ(n + 1; R))
    (hx : x ∈ U (n + 1) R l) :
    ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.germ (U (n + 1) R l) x hx (xDiv l (Fin.last _)) ∈
      (hyperplane n R).toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  (hyperplane n R).toLRSHom.germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal x hx _ (hyperplane_app_xDiv_last l)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.pushforwardStalkIdeal_hyperplane_eq
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_hyperplane_eq (l : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (x : ℙ(n + 1; R))
    (hx : x ∈ U (n + 1) R l) :
    (hyperplane n R).toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal x =
      Ideal.span {ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.germ (U (n + 1) R l) x hx (xDiv l (Fin.last _))}
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (pushforwardStalkIdeal_hyperplane_le l x hx)
    ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 (germ_xDiv_last_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal l x hx))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_app_basicOpen_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hyperplane_app_basicOpen_eq_zero (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (f : Γ(ℙ(n + 1; R), U (n + 1) R j.castSucc))
    {y : Γ(ℙ(n + 1; R), ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen f)} (hy : (hyperplane n R).app _ y = 0) :
    ∃ r, y = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _)) _
      (ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen_le f) * r
proof:
:= by
  let U₀ : ℙ(n + 1; R).affineOpens := ⟨U (n + 1) R j.castSucc, isAffineOpen_U _⟩
  have hk := (hyperplane n R).ker.map_ideal_basicOpen U₀ f
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply] at hk
  have hle : RingHom.ker ((hyperplane n R).app (U (n + 1) R j.castSucc)).hom ≤
      Ideal.span {xDiv j.castSucc (Fin.last _)} := fun z hz ↦ by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hyperplane_app_U_eq_zero j hz
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hy' : y ∈
      RingHom.ker ((hyperplane n R).app (ℙ(n + 1; R).affineBasicOpen (U := U₀) f).1).hom := hy
  rw [← hk] at hy'
  have := Ideal.map_mono (f := (ℙ(n + 1; R).presheaf.map
    (homOfLE <| ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen_le f).op).hom) hle hy'
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at this
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := this
  exact ⟨r, hr.symm.trans (mul_comm _ _)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cocycle_isPullback_hyperplane
statement:
lemma cocycle_isPullback_hyperplane :
    Cocycle.IsPullback (hyperplane n R) Fin.castSucc hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le
      (cocycle (n + 1) R) (cocycle n R)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j W hW
  rw [cocycle_g, cocycle_g, ores_res, appLE_res, ← res_appLE _ (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le i)
    (hW.trans inf_le_left), hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_castSucc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.twistComp_hyperplaneRestrict_app
statement:
lemma twistComp_hyperplaneRestrict_app (m : ℤ) (V : ℙ(n + 1; R).Opens)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf (n + 1) R m, V)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    twistComp (V := hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ V) ((hyperplaneRestrict n R m).app V s) j =
      (hyperplane n R).appLE (V ⊓ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) (hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ U n R j)
        (preimage_inf_le _ _ hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le V j) (twistComp s j.castSucc)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mulX_comp_hyperplaneRestrict
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma mulX_comp_hyperplaneRestrict (m : ℤ) :
    mulX (SheafOfModules.unit _) m (Fin.last _) ≫ hyperplaneRestrict n R (m + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Hom.ext_apply fun V s ↦ twist_ext (V := hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ V) fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [Hom.comp_app_apply, twistComp_hyperplaneRestrict_app, twistComp_mulX_app, unit_smul,
    map_mul, appLE_res, ← res_appLE _ (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc_le j)
      (inf_le_right), hyperplane_appLE_xDiv_last, ores_zero, zero_mul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.preimage_le_U_of_le
statement:
lemma preimage_le_U_of_le {j : Fin (n + 1)} {W : ℙ(n + 1; R).Opens}
    (hW : W ≤ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc) : hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ U n R j
proof:
:=
  ((hyperplane n R).preimage_mono hW).trans (hyperplane_preimage_U_castSucc j).le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.twistSectionsEquiv_hyperplaneRestrict_app
statement:
lemma twistSectionsEquiv_hyperplaneRestrict_app (m : ℤ) {j : Fin (n + 1)}
    {W : ℙ(n + 1; R).Opens} (hW : W ≤ U (n + 1) R j.castSucc)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf (n + 1) R m, W)) :
    twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ m) j (preimage_le_U_of_le hW)
      ((hyperplaneRestrict n R m).app W s) =
      (hyperplane n R).app W (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle (n + 1) R ^ m) j.castSucc hW s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_hyperplaneRestrict_app,
    unit_mres, unit_mres, res_appLE, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE, appLE_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.twistSectionsEquiv_mulX_app
statement:
lemma twistSectionsEquiv_mulX_app (m : ℤ) (l : Fin (n + 1)) {i : Fin (n + 1)}
    {W : ℙ(n; R).Opens} (hW : W ≤ U n R i) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R m, W)) :
    twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ (m + 1)) i hW ((mulX _ m l).app W s) =
      (xDiv i l |ₒ W) • twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ m) i hW s
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_mulX_app, mres_smul, ores_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneSequence_shortExact
statement: theorem hyperplaneSequence_shortExact (m : ℤ) : (hyperplaneSequence n R m).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have : Mono (hyperplaneSequence n R m).f := mono_mulX_twistingSheaf m (Fin.last _)
  refine shortExact_of_locally_exact _ fun x V hxV ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp ((iSup_U (n + 1) R).ge (Set.mem_univ x))
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    have hW : V ⊓ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _) ≤ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _) := inf_le_right
    refine ⟨V ⊓ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _), inf_le_left, ⟨hxV, hxi⟩, fun b _ ↦ ?_, fun b ↦ ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine ⟨(twistSectionsEquiv _ _ hW).symm (twistSectionsEquiv _ _ hW b), ?_⟩
      apply twistSectionsEquiv_injective _ _ hW
      refine (twistSectionsEquiv_mulX_app m _ hW _).trans ?_
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, xDiv_self, ores_one, one_smul]
    · refine twist_ext (V := hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ (V ⊓ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _))) fun j ↦ ?_
      have := Scheme.subsingleton_sections_of_le_bot (X := ℙ(n; R))
        (W := hyperplane n R ⁻¹ᵁ (V ⊓ U (n + 1) R (Fin.last _)) ⊓ U n R j)
        (inf_le_left.trans (((hyperplane n R).preimage_mono hW).trans
          hyperplane_preimage_U_last.le))
      exact @Subsingleton.elim Γ(ℙ(n; R), _) this _ _
  | cast j =>
    obtain ⟨f, hfV, hxf⟩ := (isAffineOpen_U (n := n + 1) (R := R) j.castSucc).exists_basicOpen_le
      ⟨x, hxV⟩ hxi
    have hW := ℙ(n + 1; R).basicOpen_le f
    refine ⟨_, hfV, hxf, fun b hb ↦ ?_, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
    · have hb' := (twistSectionsEquiv_hyperplaneRestrict_app (m + 1) hW b).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (twistSectionsEquiv _ _ (preimage_le_U_of_le hW)) hb).trans (map_zero _))
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hyperplane_app_basicOpen_eq_zero j f hb'
      refine ⟨(twistSectionsEquiv _ _ hW).symm r, ?_⟩
      apply twistSectionsEquiv_injective _ _ hW
      refine (twistSectionsEquiv_mulX_app m _ hW _).trans ?_
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hr]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (hyperplane n R).app_surjective _ ((isAffineOpen_U _).basicOpen f)
        (twistSectionsEquiv _ _ (preimage_le_U_of_le hW) b)
      refine ⟨(twistSectionsEquiv _ _ hW).symm r, ?_⟩
      apply twistSectionsEquiv_injective _ _ (preimage_le_U_of_le hW)
      refine (twistSectionsEquiv_hyperplaneRestrict_app (m + 1) hW _).trans ?_
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hr]

name: HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_of_surjective
statement:
lemma _root_.HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_of_surjective {A B σ τ : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [CommRing B] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜' : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜'] [GradedRing ℬ] (f : 𝒜' →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜').map f
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hf b
  have ha : a - (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜' a 0 : A) ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜' := by
    simp
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f ha
  rw [map_sub, GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose] at this
  have hb' : ((DirectSum.decompose ℬ (f a) 0 : ℬ 0) : B) = 0 := by
    rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply] at hb
    exact hb
  rwa [hb', sub_zero] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.linearSubstMap_appLE_xDiv
statement:
lemma linearSubstMap_appLE_xDiv (l : Fin (n + 1))
    (e : U n R j ≤ linearSubstMap ψ hψ ⁻¹ᵁ U n R k) :
    (linearSubstMap ψ hψ).appLE (U n R k) (U n R j) e (xDiv k l) =
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (X j) (Away.mk 𝒜 (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) 1 (ψ (X l))
        (by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact hψ l))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Proj.appLE_awayToSection_of_eq (linearSubstGradedHom ψ.toAlgHom hψ) _
    (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k) (t := X j) h e (awayXDiv R k l)).trans ?_
  congr 1
  apply val_injective
  simp only [awayXDiv, Away.mk, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, val_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (by simpa using h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.linearSubstMap_toSpec
statement: lemma linearSubstMap_toSpec : linearSubstMap ψ hψ ≫ toSpec n R = toSpec n R
proof:
:= by
  refine (affineOpenCover n R).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) ↦ ?_
  change chart j ≫ linearSubstMap ψ hψ ≫ toSpec n R = chart j ≫ toSpec n R
  rw [chart_toSpec, chart, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (Proj.awayι _ _ _ _),
    linearSubstMap, Proj.awayι_comp_map_of_eq _ _ Nat.one_pos (hψ' j)
      (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) (by simp), Category.assoc, toSpec,
    ← Category.assoc (Proj.awayι _ _ _ _), Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext r : 2
  change (awayXEquiv R j).symm (HomogeneousLocalization.map (linearSubstGradedHom ψ.toAlgHom hψ)
      (P := .powers (ψ.symm (X j))) (Q := .powers (X j)) (by
        rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, by simp⟩)
    (fromZeroRingHom _ _ (algebraMap R _ r))) = C r
  have h : HomogeneousLocalization.map (linearSubstGradedHom ψ.toAlgHom hψ)
      (P := .powers (ψ.symm (X j))) (Q := .powers (X j)) (by
        rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, by simp⟩)
      (fromZeroRingHom _ _ (algebraMap R _ r)) = awayXBase R j r := by
    apply val_injective
    simp [HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, fromZeroRingHom, awayXBase, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [h, ← toAwayX_C, ← awayXEquiv_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.shearAlgHom_X_self
statement:
lemma shearAlgHom_X_self (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (c : R) :
    shearAlgHom R a b c (X a) = X a + C c * X b
proof:
:= by

lemma shearAlgHom_X_of_ne {a b i : Fin (n + 1)} (c : R) (hi : i ≠ a) :
    shearAlgHom R a b c (X i) = X i
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.shearAlgHom_comp
statement:
lemma shearAlgHom_comp {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (hab : b ≠ a) (c d : R) :
    (shearAlgHom R a b c).comp (shearAlgHom R a b d) = shearAlgHom R a b (c + d)
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
  by_cases hi : i = a
  · subst hi
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, shearAlgHom_X_self, map_add, map_mul, shearAlgHom_X_of_ne c hab]
    rw [show (shearAlgHom R i b c) (C d) = C d from (shearAlgHom R i b c).commutes d]
    ring
  · simp [shearAlgHom_X_of_ne _ hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.shearAlgHom_zero
statement: lemma shearAlgHom_zero (a b : Fin (n + 1)) : shearAlgHom R a b 0 = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
  by_cases hi : i = a
  · subst hi
    simp [shearAlgHom_X_self]
  · simp [shearAlgHom_X_of_ne _ hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isLinearSubst_shearAlgHom
statement:
lemma isLinearSubst_shearAlgHom (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (c : R) :
    IsLinearSubst (shearAlgHom R a b c)
proof:
:= fun i ↦ by
  by_cases hi : i = a
  · subst hi
    rw [shearAlgHom_X_self]
    exact add_mem (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i) (by
      simpa using (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (A := 𝒜) (i := 0) (j := 1)
        ((mem_homogeneousSubmodule 0 _).2 (isHomogeneous_C _ c))
        (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one b)))
  · rw [shearAlgHom_X_of_ne c hi]
    exact X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.evalPoint_injective
statement:
lemma evalPoint_injective (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Injective (evalPoint (n := n) φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro z z' h
  funext m
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hφ (z m)
  have h1 : X m - C r ∈ (show PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) from evalPoint φ z).asIdeal :=
    (mem_evalPoint_asIdeal_iff φ z _).2 (by simp [hr])
  rw [h, mem_evalPoint_asIdeal_iff] at h1
  simp only [eval₂_sub, eval₂_X, eval₂_C] at h1
  rw [← hr]
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 h1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.eval₂_dehomogenize_X

lemma eval₂_dehomogenize_X (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
    eval₂ φ (dehomogenizeVec i v) (dehomogenize R i (X j)) = v j / v i
proof:

  obtain rfl | ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j
  · simp [div_self hi]
  · simp [dehomogenizeVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.chart_base_evalPoint_mem_U_iff
statement:
lemma chart_base_evalPoint_mem_U_iff (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
    (chart (R := R) i).base (evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)) ∈ U n R j ↔ v j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec i v) ∈ chart i ⁻¹ᵁ U n R j ↔ _
  rw [chart_preimage_U]
  change dehomogenize R i (X j) ∉
      (show PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) from
        evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)).asIdeal ↔ _
  rw [mem_evalPoint_asIdeal_iff, eval₂_dehomogenize_X φ i j v hi]
  simp [hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayEval_comp_awayMap
statement:
lemma awayEval_comp_awayMap (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) {f g x : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R}
    {e : ℕ} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 e) (hx : x = f * g) (hf : eval₂ φ v f ≠ 0)
    (hx' : eval₂ φ v x ≠ 0) :
    (awayEval v x hx').comp (awayMap 𝒜 hg hx) = awayEval v f hf
proof:
:= by
  have key : (Localization.awayLift (eval₂Hom φ v) x (by simpa using hx'.isUnit)).comp
      (Localization.awayLift (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away x)) f
        (isUnit_of_dvd_unit (map_dvd _ ⟨_, hx⟩) (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit x))) =
      Localization.awayLift (eval₂Hom φ v) f (by simpa using hf.isUnit) := by
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f) ?_
    ext b
    · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
    · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  ext a
  simp only [awayEval, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, val_awayMap]
  exact congrArg (fun F : Localization.Away f →+* K ↦ F a.val) key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayEval_comp_toAwayX
statement:
lemma awayEval_comp_toAwayX (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0) :
    (awayEval v (X i) hi).comp (toAwayX R i) = eval₂Hom φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : v i ≠ 0 := by simpa using hi
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r ↦ ?_) (fun m ↦ ?_)
  · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, toAwayX_C, awayEval, awayXBase,
      HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_C]
    change Localization.awayLift _ _ _ (Localization.mk _ 1) = _
    rw [Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
    simp [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, toAwayX_X, awayEval,
      HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, val_awayXDiv, coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_X]
    rw [Localization.awayLift_mk (v := (v i)⁻¹) (hv := by simp [hi'])]
    simp [dehomogenizeVec, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.eval₂Hom_comp_fromAwayX
statement:
lemma eval₂Hom_comp_fromAwayX (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0) :
    (eval₂Hom φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)).comp (fromAwayX R i) = awayEval v (X i) hi
proof:
:= by
  rw [← awayEval_comp_toAwayX v i hi]
  ext a
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.chart_base_evalPoint
statement:
lemma chart_base_evalPoint (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : eval₂ φ v (X i) ≠ 0) :
    (chart (R := R) i).base (evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)) =
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (X i) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i) Nat.one_pos).base
        (awayPoint v (X i) hi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  refine PrimeSpectrum.ext ?_
  change Ideal.comap _ (RingHom.ker _) = RingHom.ker _
  rw [RingHom.comap_ker, ← eval₂Hom_comp_fromAwayX v i hi]
  congr 2
  ext a
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayι_base_awayPoint_eq_mul
statement:
lemma awayι_base_awayPoint_eq_mul (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) {f g x : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R}
    {e : ℕ} (hf' : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 e) (hx : x = f * g) (hf : eval₂ φ v f ≠ 0)
    (hx' : eval₂ φ v x ≠ 0) :
    (Proj.awayι 𝒜 f hf' Nat.one_pos).base (awayPoint v f hf) =
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜 x (hx ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded hf' hg)
        (Nat.one_pos.trans_le (Nat.le_add_right 1 e))).base (awayPoint v x hx')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι 𝒜 (f_deg := hf') (hm := Nat.one_pos) (g_deg := hg)
    (hx := hx), Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  refine PrimeSpectrum.ext ?_
  change RingHom.ker _ = Ideal.comap _ (RingHom.ker _)
  rw [RingHom.comap_ker]
  congr 1
  exact (awayEval_comp_awayMap v hg hx hf hx').symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.chart_base_evalPoint_eq
statement:
lemma chart_base_evalPoint_eq (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin (n + 1) → K) (hi : v i ≠ 0)
    (hj : v j ≠ 0) :
    (chart (R := R) i).base (evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec i v)) =
      (chart (R := R) j).base (evalPoint φ (dehomogenizeVec j v))
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : eval₂ φ v (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hi
  have hj' : eval₂ φ v (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hj
  have hij : eval₂ φ v (X i * X j : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) ≠ 0 := by simp [hi, hj]
  rw [chart_base_evalPoint v i hi', chart_base_evalPoint v j hj',
    awayι_base_awayPoint_eq_mul v (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i)
      (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) rfl hi' hij,
    awayι_base_awayPoint_eq_mul v (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j)
      (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i) (mul_comm _ _) hj' hij]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.iterate_smulAb_app
statement:
lemma iterate_smulAb_app (φ : Γ(X, ⊤)) (V : X.Opens) (k : ℕ) (s : Γ(F, V)) :
    ((smulAb F φ).app (op V))^[k] s = (φ |ₒ V) ^ k • s
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.bijective_smulAb_app
statement:
lemma bijective_smulAb_app (φ : Γ(X, ⊤)) {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ X.basicOpen φ) :
    Function.Bijective ((smulAb F φ).app (op V))
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (φ |ₒ V) := by
    have h : IsUnit ((φ |ₒ X.basicOpen φ) |ₒ V) :=
      (X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen φ).map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
    rwa [ores_res] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨fun s t hst ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ⟨(show Γ(F, V) from (↑u⁻¹ : Γ(X, V)) • (show Γ(F, V) from s)),
    ?_⟩⟩
  · change (φ |ₒ V) • (show Γ(F, V) from s) = (φ |ₒ V) • (show Γ(F, V) from t) at hst
    have h := congrArg ((↑u⁻¹ : Γ(X, V)) • ·) hst
    simp only at h
    rwa [← hu, smul_smul, smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul, one_smul] at h
  · change (φ |ₒ V) • (↑u⁻¹ : Γ(X, V)) • (show Γ(F, V) from s) = s
    rw [← hu, smul_smul, Units.mul_inv, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.cechOpen_inf_basicOpen
statement:
lemma cechOpen_inf_basicOpen {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin (n + 1) → ι) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen (fun i ↦ U i ⊓ X.basicOpen φ) σ =
      X.basicOpen (φ |ₒ TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen U σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_restrictOpen]
  exact (iInf_inf (f := fun a ↦ U (σ a))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exactAt_cechComplex_inf_basicOpen
statement:
theorem exactAt_cechComplex_inf_basicOpen
    (hA : ∀ (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin (m + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen U σ)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplex U
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).obj).ExactAt (n + 1)) :
    (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplex (fun i ↦ U i ⊓ X.basicOpen φ)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).obj).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hUU' : ∀ i, U i ⊓ X.basicOpen φ ≤ U i := fun i ↦ inf_le_left
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.exactAt_cechComplex_of_localization hUU' (smulAb F φ) n
    (fun σ s ↦ ?_) (fun σ t ht ↦ ?_)
    (fun m σ ↦ bijective_smulAb_app F φ ((iInf_le _ 0).trans inf_le_right)) h
  · have he := cechOpen_inf_basicOpen U φ σ
    obtain ⟨k, t, ht⟩ := (hA _ σ).exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul F
      (φ |ₒ TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen U σ)
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := F.presheaf) s _ he.ge)
    refine ⟨k, t, ?_⟩
    have ht' := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := F.presheaf) x _ he.le) ht
    simp only [mres_res, mres_smul, ores_pow, ores_res, mres_self] at ht'
    rw [iterate_smulAb_app]
    exact ht'
  · have he := cechOpen_inf_basicOpen U φ σ
    change TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := F.presheaf) t _
      (TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen_mono hUU' σ) = 0 at ht
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hA _ σ).exists_pow_smul_eq_zero F
      (φ |ₒ TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen U σ) t (by
        have ht' := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := F.presheaf) x _ he.ge)
          ht
        simp only [mres_res, mres_zero] at ht'
        exact ht')
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [iterate_smulAb_app]
    exact hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPushforwardAcyclic_of_basicOpen
statement:
lemma isPushforwardAcyclic_of_basicOpen {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) (G : TopCat.AbSheaf X)
    (h : ∀ s : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ s ∈ U ∧ ∀ (g : Γ(S, U)) (q : ℕ)
      (c : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (p ⁻¹ᵁ S.basicOpen g)).obj G) (q + 1)),
        c = 0) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.IsPushforwardAcyclic p.base G
proof:
:= by
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.isPushforwardAcyclic_of_forall_exists G fun V s hs ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hsU, h0⟩ := h s
  obtain ⟨g, hgV, hsg⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨s, hs⟩ hsU
  exact ⟨S.basicOpen g, hgV, hsg, h0 g⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_map_sigma_eq_zero
statement:
lemma H_map_sigma_eq_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} {Y : TopCat.{u}} (T : X.Modules ⥤ TopCat.AbSheaf Y)
    [T.Additive] {I : Type u} [Finite I] (G : I → X.Modules) (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (G i)) q), x = 0)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (∐ G)) q) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have := HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct G
  let e := T.mapIso (biproduct.isoCoproduct G)
  suffices hy : ∀ y : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (⨁ G)) q, y = 0 by
    have hx : x = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom q (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv q x) := by
      rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e.inv_hom_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
    rw [hx, hy (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv q x)]
    exact map_zero _
  intro y
  have htot : ∑ i, biproduct.π G i ≫ biproduct.ι G i = 𝟙 (⨁ G) :=
    IsBilimit.total (biproduct.isBilimit G)
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset I) (φ : I → (⨁ G ⟶ ⨁ G)),
      TopCat.Sheaf.H.map (T.map (∑ i ∈ s, φ i)) q y =
        ∑ i ∈ s, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map (T.map (φ i)) q y := by
    classical
    intro s φ
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_zero_apply]
    | insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, T.map_add,
        TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_add_apply, ih]
  rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply y, ← T.map_id, ← htot, hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [T.map_comp, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, h i (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map _ q y), map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_basicOpen_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero
statement:
theorem H_basicOpen_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k) (φ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ⊤))
    (q : ℕ) (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)).obj
      (twistingSheafAb n R k)) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_isCechAcyclic _ (iSup_stdCover_inf_basicOpen φ) _
    (fun _ σ q y ↦ H_restrictOpen_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen (twistingSheaf n R k)
      (isAffineOpen_cechOpen_stdCover_inf_basicOpen φ σ) q y)
    (fun p ↦ exactAt_cechComplex_inf_basicOpen (twistingSheaf n R k) (stdCover n R) φ
      (fun _ σ ↦ isAffineOpen_cechOpen_stdCover σ) p (isCechAcyclic_twistingSheafAb k hk p)) q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_basicOpen_eq_zero_of_le_of_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem H_basicOpen_eq_zero_of_le_of_isQuasicoherent (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (φ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ⊤)) (q : ℕ) (hq : n + 1 ≤ q)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj F)) q) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_iSup_eq _
    (fun i ↦ stdCover n R i ⊓ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ) (iSup_stdCover_inf_basicOpen φ)
    (fun I hI q hq ↦ ?_) q (by simpa using hq)).elim x 0
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hq.ne'
  have he : ⨅ i ∈ I, (stdCover n R i ⊓ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ) =
      ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (φ |ₒ ⨅ i ∈ I, stdCover n R i) := by
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_restrictOpen]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hI
    refine le_antisymm (le_inf (iInf₂_mono fun _ _ ↦ inf_le_left)
      ((iInf₂_le j hj).trans inf_le_right)) (le_iInf₂ fun i hi ↦ inf_le_inf_right _ ?_)
    exact iInf₂_le i hi
  rw [he]
  exact subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_isAffineOpen F
    ((isAffineOpen_iInf_stdCover I hI).basicOpen _) q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_basicOpen_twist_free_eq_zero
statement:
lemma H_basicOpen_twist_free_eq_zero {I : Type u} [Finite I] (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k)
    (φ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ⊤)) (q : ℕ)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj
        (twist (SheafOfModules.free I) k))) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T := Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R) ⋙ TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)
  let e := T.mapIso (twistFreeIso (n := n) (R := R) I k)
  have hx : x = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv (q + 1) (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom (q + 1) x) := by
    rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e.hom_inv_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
  have h0 : TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom (q + 1) x = 0 :=
    H_map_sigma_eq_zero T _ (q + 1)
      (fun _ y ↦ H_basicOpen_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero k hk φ q y) _
  rw [hx, h0]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero_aux [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) [F.IsCoherent], ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m →
      ∀ (φ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ⊤)) (q : ℕ), n + 1 ≤ q + 1 + k →
        ∀ x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj (twist F m))) (q + 1), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro F _
    haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent F
    exact ⟨0, fun m _ φ q hq x ↦ H_basicOpen_eq_zero_of_le_of_isQuasicoherent (twist F m) φ
      (q + 1) (by omega) x⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro F _
    obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := exists_epi_twist_free_isCoherent_kernel F
    obtain ⟨I, _, π, _, -, hK⟩ := hm₁ m₁ le_rfl
    obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ := ih (kernel π)
    refine ⟨max m₂ ((m₁ : ℤ) - n), fun m hm φ q hq x ↦ ?_⟩
    let S : ShortComplex ℙ(n; R).Modules := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
    have hS : S.ShortExact :=
      ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel π))
        inferInstance inferInstance
    have hS' := ((hS.map_of_exact (twistFunctor n R m)).map_of_exact
      (Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R))).map_of_exact
        (TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ))
    have hδ : TopCat.Sheaf.H.δ hS' (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x = 0 :=
      hm₂ m (le_of_max_le_left hm) φ (q + 1) (by omega) _
    obtain ⟨y, hyx⟩ := (TopCat.Sheaf.H.exact₃ hS' (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x).1 hδ
    have e := twistTwistIso (SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (-(m₁ : ℤ)) m
    let T := Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R) ⋙
      TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)
    let e' := T.mapIso e
    have hy : ∀ z : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (twist (twist (SheafOfModules.free I) (-(m₁ : ℤ))) m))
        (q + 1), z = 0 := by
      intro z
      have hz : z = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.inv (q + 1) (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.hom (q + 1) z) := by
        rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e'.hom_inv_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
      have h0 : TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.hom (q + 1) z = 0 :=
        H_basicOpen_twist_free_eq_zero (-(m₁ : ℤ) + m) (by omega) φ q _
      rw [hz, h0]
      exact map_zero _
    rw [← hyx, hy y]
    exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] : ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (φ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ⊤)) (q : ℕ)
      (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen φ)).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj (twist F m))) (q + 1)), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero_aux n F
  exact ⟨m₀, fun m hm φ q ↦ h m hm φ q (by omega)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_isPushforwardAcyclic_twist
statement:
theorem exists_isPushforwardAcyclic_twist [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] : ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → TopCat.Sheaf.IsPushforwardAcyclic
      (toSpec n R).base ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj (twist F m))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ isPushforwardAcyclic_of_basicOpen _ _ fun _ ↦
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _, trivial, fun g q ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  have := h m hm ((toSpec n R).appTop g) q
  rwa [← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.appLE_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma appLE_eq_of_eq {X Z : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Z} (h : f = g) {U : Z.Opens} {W : X.Opens}
    (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e' : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) : f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W e'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.affineChart_image_top
statement:
lemma affineChart_image_top :
    affineChart n y hV ''ᵁ ⊤ = pullback.fst y (toSpec n K) ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, opensRange_affineChart]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.appIso_inv_globalRingHom
statement:
lemma appIso_inv_globalRingHom (a : Γ(Y, V)) :
    ((affineChart n y hV).appIso ⊤).inv (globalRingHom n Γ(Y, V) a) =
      (pullback.fst y (toSpec n K)).appLE V _ (affineChart_image_top y hV).le a
proof:
:= by
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((affineChart n y hV).appIso ⊤).hom).1
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, appLE_eq_of_eq (affineChart_fst y hV) _
      (by rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hV.fromSpec_preimage_self]; exact le_top),
    Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hV.fromSpec_app_self_apply,
    globalRingHom_apply]
  erw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply ((Spec Γ(Y, V)).presheaf.map _), Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsAddEquiv₁_apply
statement:
lemma sectionsAddEquiv₁_apply
    (x : Γ(twist (((pushforward ι).obj G).restrict (affineChart n y hV)) m, ⊤)) :
    sectionsAddEquiv₁ y hV ι G m x = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen
      (F := (Scheme.Modules.twist ((pushforward ι).obj G)
        ((cocycle n K ^ m).comap (pullback.snd y (toSpec n K)))).presheaf)
      ((restrictTwistIso y hV ι G m).inv.app ⊤ x) _ (affineChart_image_top y hV).ge
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsAddEquiv₁_smul
statement:
lemma sectionsAddEquiv₁_smul (b : Γ(ℙ(n; Γ(Y, V)), ⊤))
    (x : Γ(twist (((pushforward ι).obj G).restrict (affineChart n y hV)) m, ⊤)) :
    sectionsAddEquiv₁ y hV ι G m (b • x) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (((affineChart n y hV).appIso ⊤).inv b) _
        (affineChart_image_top y hV).ge • sectionsAddEquiv₁ y hV ι G m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionsAddEquiv₁_apply, sectionsAddEquiv₁_apply, Hom.app_smul]
  exact mres_smul _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsAddEquiv₂_apply
statement:
lemma sectionsAddEquiv₂_apply
    (x : Γ(Scheme.Modules.twist ((pushforward ι).obj G)
        ((cocycle n K ^ m).comap (pullback.snd y (toSpec n K))),
          pullback.fst y (toSpec n K) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    sectionsAddEquiv₂ y ι G m x = (twistComapCompIso ι _ _ G).hom.app
      (ι ⁻¹ᵁ (pullback.fst y (toSpec n K) ⁻¹ᵁ V))
      ((pushforwardTwistComapIso ι _ G).inv.app _ x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsAddEquiv₂_smul
statement:
lemma sectionsAddEquiv₂_smul (a : Γ(Y, V))
    (x : Γ(Scheme.Modules.twist ((pushforward ι).obj G)
        ((cocycle n K ^ m).comap (pullback.snd y (toSpec n K))),
          pullback.fst y (toSpec n K) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    sectionsAddEquiv₂ y ι G m ((pullback.fst y (toSpec n K)).app V a • x) =
      a • sectionsAddEquiv₂ y ι G m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionsAddEquiv₂_apply, sectionsAddEquiv₂_apply, Hom.app_smul]
  exact Hom.app_smul _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.restrictOpen_appIso_inv_globalRingHom
statement:
lemma restrictOpen_appIso_inv_globalRingHom (a : Γ(Y, V)) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (((affineChart n y hV).appIso ⊤).inv
      (globalRingHom n Γ(Y, V) a)) _ (affineChart_image_top y hV).ge =
      (pullback.fst y (toSpec n K)).app V a
proof:
:= by
  rw [appIso_inv_globalRingHom, ← Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  exact congr($(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map _ _ (homOfLE (affineChart_image_top y hV).ge).op) a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_module_finite_pushforward_twistAlong
statement:
theorem exists_module_finite_pushforward_twistAlong [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (G : Y'.Modules)
    [G.IsCoherent] : ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m →
      Module.Finite Γ(Y, V) Γ((pushforward π).obj (twistAlong j G m), V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback y (toSpec n K)) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst y (toSpec n K))
  haveI := isCoherent_pushforward (pullback.lift π j w) G
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, V) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨V, hV⟩
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian ℙ(n; Γ(Y, V)) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (toSpec n _)
  haveI := isCoherent_restrict (affineChart n y hV) ((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G)
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_module_finite_twist
    (((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G).restrict (affineChart n y hV))
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  letI := sectionsModule
    (twist (((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G).restrict (affineChart n y hV)) m)
  haveI := h m hm
  have := Module.Finite.equiv (sectionsLinearEquiv y hV (pullback.lift π j w) G m)
  rwa [pullback.lift_fst, pullback.lift_snd] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isCoherent_restrict
statement:
theorem isCoherent_restrict [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    (F.restrict e).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI : SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (R := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf) F := ‹_›
  have h := LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_pullbackModules_of_isCoherentStructureSheaf
    (Scheme.isCoherentStructureSheaf (X := Y)) e.toLRSHom F
  haveI : SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
    (e.toLRSHom.pullbackModules.obj F) := h
  exact SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.of_iso.{u}
    (((restrictFunctorIsoPullbackModules e).app F).symm : (_ : Y.Modules) ≅ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isCoherent_pushforward
statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward {Z : Scheme.{u}} (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsCoherent] :
    ((pushforward ι).obj G).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI : SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (R := Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf) G := ‹_›
  exact isCoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion ι G

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.eq_zero_of_addEquiv
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_addEquiv {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] (e : A ≃+ B)
    (h : ∀ b : B, b = 0) (a : A) : a = 0
proof:
:=
  e.injective (by rw [h (e a), map_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_twistAlong_eq_zero_of_affineChart
statement:
lemma H_twistAlong_eq_zero_of_affineChart {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (G : Y'.Modules)
    (m : ℤ) (g : Γ(Y, V)) (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (ℙ(n; Γ(Y, V)).basicOpen
      ((toSpec n _).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv g)))).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; Γ(Y, V)).ringCatSheaf).obj
          (twist (((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G).restrict
            (affineChart n y hV)) m))) (q + 1), x = 0)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (π ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen g)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y'.ringCatSheaf).obj (twistAlong j G m))) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let ι := pullback.lift π j w
  let e := affineChart n y hV
  let F := (pushforward ι).obj G
  let W := pullback.fst y (toSpec n K) ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen g
  let d := (cocycle n K ^ m).comap (pullback.snd y (toSpec n K))
  have hπ : π ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen g = ι ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback.lift_fst]
  have hW : W ≤ e.opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_affineChart]
    exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ (Y.basicOpen_le g)
  let e₁ : twistAlong j G m ≅ Scheme.Modules.twist G (d.comap ι) :=
    twistComapIsoOfEq (pullback.lift_snd π j w).symm _ G ≪≫ (twistComapCompIso ι _ _ G).symm
  let e₃ : (Scheme.Modules.twist F d).restrict e ≅
      Scheme.Modules.twist (F.restrict e) (cocycle n Γ(Y, V) ^ m) :=
    restrictTwistComapIso e d F ≪≫ twistComapCompIso e _ _ _ ≪≫
      twistComapIsoOfEq (affineChart_snd y hV) _ _ ≪≫
      twistIsoOfIsPullback (map (structureRingHom y hV)) (fun i ↦ (map_preimage_U _ i).symm)
        (cocycle n K ^ m) (cocycle n Γ(Y, V) ^ m) ((cocycle_isPullback _).zpow m) _
  revert x
  rw [hπ]
  intro x
  refine eq_zero_of_addEquiv
    (((((TopCat.Sheaf.H.restrictOpenAddEquivOfIso _ ((toAbFunctor Y').mapIso e₁) (q + 1)).trans
      (hRestrictOpenPushforwardAddEquiv ι _ W (q + 1))).trans
      (TopCat.Sheaf.H.restrictOpenAddEquivOfIso _
        ((toAbFunctor _).mapIso (pushforwardTwistComapIso ι d G)) (q + 1))).trans
      (hRestrictOpenRestrictAddEquiv e _ W hW (q + 1))).trans
      (TopCat.Sheaf.H.restrictOpenAddEquivOfIso _ ((toAbFunctor _).mapIso e₃) (q + 1))) ?_ x
  have he : e ⁻¹ᵁ W = _ := affineChart_preimage_basicOpen y hV g
  rw [he]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_isPushforwardAcyclic_twistAlong
statement:
theorem exists_isPushforwardAcyclic_twistAlong [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (G : Y'.Modules) [G.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → TopCat.Sheaf.IsPushforwardAcyclic π.base
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y'.ringCatSheaf).obj (twistAlong j G m))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback y (toSpec n K)) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst y (toSpec n K))
  haveI := isCoherent_pushforward (pullback.lift π j w) G
  have key : ∀ V : Y.affineOpens, ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (g : Γ(Y, V)) (q : ℕ)
      (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (π ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen g)).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y'.ringCatSheaf).obj (twistAlong j G m))) (q + 1)), x = 0 := by
    intro V
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, V) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian ℙ(n; Γ(Y, V)) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (toSpec n _)
    haveI := isCoherent_restrict (affineChart n y V.2)
      ((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G)
    obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_H_basicOpen_twist_eq_zero
      (((pushforward (pullback.lift π j w)).obj G).restrict (affineChart n y V.2))
    exact ⟨m₀, fun m hm g q x ↦
      H_twistAlong_eq_zero_of_affineChart y π j w V.2 G m g q (h m hm _ q) x⟩
  choose m₁ hm₁ using key
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (_root_.isCompact_univ (X := Y)).elim_finite_subcover
    (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Set Y))
    (fun V ↦ V.1.isOpen) fun x _ ↦ by
      have hx : x ∈ (⨆ V : Y.affineOpens, (V : Y.Opens)) := by
        rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨V, hV⟩
  refine ⟨∑ V ∈ t, |m₁ V|, fun m hm ↦ isPushforwardAcyclic_of_basicOpen π _ fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVt, hsV⟩ : ∃ V ∈ t, s ∈ (V : Set Y) := by
    simpa using ht (Set.mem_univ s)
  exact ⟨V, V.2, hsV, fun g q x ↦ hm₁ V m ((le_abs_self _).trans
    ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun V _ ↦ abs_nonneg (m₁ V)) hVt).trans hm)) g q x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.iSup_affineCoverPreimage
statement: lemma iSup_affineCoverPreimage : ⨆ i, affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV i = π ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⨆ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)), U n Γ(Y, V) i.down = ⊤ :=
    le_antisymm le_top ((iSup_U n _).ge.trans (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup_of_le ⟨i⟩ le_rfl))
  simp only [affineCoverPreimage, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup, ← Scheme.Hom.image_iSup, h,
    Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, opensRange_affineChart, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    pullback.lift_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage
statement:
lemma isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage (i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
    IsAffineOpen (affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV i)
proof:
:=
  ((isAffineOpen_U i.down).image_of_isOpenImmersion _).preimage _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage_inf
statement:
lemma isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage_inf (i k : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
    IsAffineOpen (affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV i ⊓ affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : affineChart n y hV ''ᵁ (U n Γ(Y, V) i.down ⊓ U n Γ(Y, V) k.down) =
      affineChart n y hV ''ᵁ U n Γ(Y, V) i.down ⊓ affineChart n y hV ''ᵁ U n Γ(Y, V) k.down := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq (affineChart n y hV) (U n Γ(Y, V) k.down)]
    exact Scheme.Hom.image_inf_preimage _ _ _
  simp only [affineCoverPreimage, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, ← h]
  exact ((isAffineOpen_U_inf _ _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _).preimage _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_twistAlong
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_twistAlong (G : Y'.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (m : ℤ) :
    ((pushforward π).obj (twistAlong j G m)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_cover π _ fun _ hV ↦ ⟨_, inferInstance,
    affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV, iSup_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV,
    isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV,
    isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage_inf y π j w hV⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul_pushforward_twistAlong
statement:
theorem exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul_pushforward_twistAlong (G : Y'.Modules)
    [G.IsQuasicoherent] (m : ℤ) (g : Γ(Y, V))
    (s : Γ((pushforward π).obj (twistAlong j G m), Y.basicOpen g)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (t : Γ((pushforward π).obj (twistAlong j G m), V)),
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (Y.basicOpen g) (Y.basicOpen_le g) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen g (Y.basicOpen g) (Y.basicOpen_le g) ^ k • s
proof:
:=
  exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul_pushforward π _ _ (iSup_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV)
    (isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV)
    (isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage_inf y π j w hV) g s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_pushforward_twistAlong
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_pushforward_twistAlong (G : Y'.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (m : ℤ) (g : Γ(Y, V)) (t : Γ((pushforward π).obj (twistAlong j G m), V))
    (ht : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (Y.basicOpen g) (Y.basicOpen_le g) = 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, g ^ k • t = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_pushforward π _ _ (iSup_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV)
    (isAffineOpen_affineCoverPreimage y π j w hV) g t ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_sigma_eq_zero
statement:
lemma H_sigma_eq_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [Finite I] (G : I → X.Modules) (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj (G i)) q), x = 0)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj (∐ G)) q) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have := HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct G
  let T := Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor X
  let e := T.mapIso (biproduct.isoCoproduct G)
  suffices hy : ∀ y : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (⨁ G)) q, y = 0 by
    have hx : x = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom q (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv q x) := by
      rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e.inv_hom_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
    rw [hx, hy (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv q x)]
    exact map_zero _
  intro y
  have htot : ∑ i, biproduct.π G i ≫ biproduct.ι G i = 𝟙 (⨁ G) :=
    IsBilimit.total (biproduct.isBilimit G)
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset I) (φ : I → (⨁ G ⟶ ⨁ G)),
      TopCat.Sheaf.H.map (T.map (∑ i ∈ s, φ i)) q y =
        ∑ i ∈ s, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map (T.map (φ i)) q y := by
    classical
    intro s φ
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_zero_apply]
    | insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, T.map_add,
        TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_add_apply, ih]
  rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply y, ← T.map_id, ← htot, hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [T.map_comp, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, h i (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map _ q y), map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_succ_twist_free_eq_zero
statement:
lemma H_succ_twist_free_eq_zero {I : Type u} [Finite I] (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k) (q : ℕ)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (twist (SheafOfModules.free I) k)) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T := Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R)
  let e := T.mapIso (twistFreeIso (n := n) (R := R) I k)
  have hx : x = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.inv (q + 1) (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom (q + 1) x) := by
    rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e.hom_inv_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
  have h0 : TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e.hom (q + 1) x = 0 :=
    H_sigma_eq_zero _ (q + 1) (fun _ y ↦ H_succ_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero k hk q y) _
  rw [hx, h0]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_H_twist_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem exists_H_twist_eq_zero_aux [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) [F.IsCoherent], ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ q : ℕ,
      n + 1 ≤ q + 1 + k → ∀ x : TopCat.Sheaf.H
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj (twist F m)) (q + 1), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro F _
    haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent F
    exact ⟨0, fun m _ q hq x ↦ H_eq_zero_of_le_of_isQuasicoherent (twist F m) (q + 1)
      (by omega) x⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro F _
    obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := exists_epi_twist_free_isCoherent_kernel F
    obtain ⟨I, _, π, _, -, hK⟩ := hm₁ m₁ le_rfl
    obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ := ih (kernel π)
    refine ⟨max m₂ ((m₁ : ℤ) - n), fun m hm q hq x ↦ ?_⟩
    let S : ShortComplex ℙ(n; R).Modules := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
    have hS : S.ShortExact :=
      ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel π))
        inferInstance inferInstance
    have hS' := (hS.map_of_exact (twistFunctor n R m)).map_of_exact
      (Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R))
    have hδ : TopCat.Sheaf.H.δ hS' (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x = 0 :=
      hm₂ m (le_of_max_le_left hm) (q + 1) (by omega) _
    obtain ⟨y, hyx⟩ := (TopCat.Sheaf.H.exact₃ hS' (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x).1 hδ
    have e := twistTwistIso (SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (-(m₁ : ℤ)) m
    let T := Scheme.Modules.toAbFunctor ℙ(n; R)
    let e' := T.mapIso e
    have hy : ∀ z : TopCat.Sheaf.H (T.obj (twist (twist (SheafOfModules.free I) (-(m₁ : ℤ))) m))
        (q + 1), z = 0 := by
      intro z
      have hz : z = TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.inv (q + 1) (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.hom (q + 1) z) := by
        rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e'.hom_inv_id, TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply]
      have h0 : TopCat.Sheaf.H.map e'.hom (q + 1) z = 0 :=
        H_succ_twist_free_eq_zero (-(m₁ : ℤ) + m) (by omega) q _
      rw [hz, h0]
      exact map_zero _
    rw [← hyx, hy y]
    exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_H_twist_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_H_twist_eq_zero [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ x : TopCat.Sheaf.H
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ℙ(n; R).ringCatSheaf).obj (twist F m)) (q + 1), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_H_twist_eq_zero_aux n F
  exact ⟨m₀, fun m hm q ↦ h m hm q (by omega)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_locallyRingedSpaceH_twist_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_locallyRingedSpaceH_twist_eq_zero [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] : ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ q : ℕ,
      ∀ x : LocallyRingedSpace.H (Y := ℙ(n; R).toLocallyRingedSpace) (twist F m) (q + 1),
        x = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_H_twist_eq_zero F

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.basicOpen_xDiv
statement:
lemma basicOpen_xDiv (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv i j) = U n R i ⊓ U n R j
proof:
:= by
  have hi := X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) i
  have hj := X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) j
  have key : (U n R i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv i j) = (U n R i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U n R j := by
    have e1 : Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 (X i) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (awayXDiv R i j) =
        (U n R i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv i j) := by
      rw [Proj.basicOpenToSpec, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen,
        Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen]
      rfl
    have e2 : Proj.basicOpenToSpec 𝒜 (X i) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (awayXDiv R i j) =
        (U n R i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U n R j := by
      have := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen 𝒜 hi Nat.one_pos hj Nat.one_pos
      have h3 : Away.isLocalizationElem hi hj = awayXDiv R i j := by
        simp [Away.isLocalizationElem, awayXDiv]
      rw [h3] at this
      rw [← this, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι 𝒜 (X i) hi Nat.one_pos,
        ← Category.assoc, ← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom 𝒜 (X i) hi Nat.one_pos, Iso.hom_inv_id,
        Category.id_comp]
      rfl
    rw [← e1, e2]
  have := congrArg ((U n R i).ι ''ᵁ ·) key
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] at this
  rw [← this, inf_eq_right.mpr (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _)]

    (SetLike.mul_mem_graded (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one j) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k))

@[simp]
lemma twistComp_twistGlobalMk {m : ℤ} (s : ∀ j, Γ(F, U n R j)) (hs) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :

statement:
lemma cocycle_natCast_g (m : ℕ) (j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
