name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_twist_section_eq
statement:
theorem exists_twist_section_eq (i : Fin (n + 1)) (t : Γ(F, U n R i)) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
      ∃ σ : Γ(twist F m, ⊤), twistComp σ i = t |ₒ (⊤ ⊓ U n R i)
proof:
:= by
  have hD (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i) ≤ U n R i := by
    rw [basicOpen_xDiv]; exact inf_le_right
  choose a u hu using fun j ↦ IsAffineOpen.exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul (isAffineOpen_U j) F
    (xDiv j i) (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ (hD j))
  set A := Finset.univ.sup a
  set u' : ∀ j, Γ(F, U n R j) := fun j ↦ xDiv (R := R) j i ^ (A - a j) • u j
  have hu' (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (u' j) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i))
        (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (xDiv j i) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i))
        (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) ^ A • TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t _ (hD j) := by
    simp only [u']
    rw [mres_smul, ores_pow, hu, smul_smul, ← pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup (f := a) (Finset.mem_univ j))]
  clear_value u'
  have hd (j k : Fin (n + 1)) : ∃ b : ℕ, (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ^ b •
      ((u' j |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) -
        (xDiv j k |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ^ A • (u' k |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k))) = 0 := by
    apply IsAffineOpen.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (isAffineOpen_U_inf j k) F
    have hW : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) =
        (U n R j ⊓ U n R k) ⊓ (U n R j ⊓ U n R i) := by
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_restrictOpen, basicOpen_xDiv]
    have h1 : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ≤
        ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i) := by
      rw [hW, basicOpen_xDiv]; exact inf_le_right
    have h2 : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ≤
        ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv k i) := by
      rw [hW, basicOpen_xDiv]
      exact le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right)
    have h3 : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ≤ U n R j ⊓ U n R k :=
      ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _
    rw [mres_sub, mres_smul, ores_pow, mres_res, mres_res, ores_res,
      ← mres_res F (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) h1 (u' j), hu' j,
      ← mres_res F (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) h2 (u' k), hu' k,
      mres_smul, mres_smul, ores_pow, ores_pow, ores_res, ores_res, mres_res, mres_res, smul_smul,
      ← mul_pow, xDiv_mul_xDiv j k i _ h3, sub_self]
  choose b hb using hd
  set B := Finset.univ.sup fun p : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦ b p.1 p.2
  have hone (W : ℙ(n; R).Opens) (h : W ≤ U n R i) :
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (xDiv (R := R) i i) W h = 1 := by
    rw [xDiv_self, ores_one]
  refine ⟨A + B, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
  refine ⟨twistGlobalMk F (m := ((A + B + c : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (fun j ↦ xDiv (R := R) j i ^ (B + c) • u' j) fun j k ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hbB : b j k ≤ B + c :=
      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦ b p.1 p.2)
        (Finset.mem_univ (j, k))).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    have hb' := hb j k
    have h0 : (xDiv j i |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ^ (B + c) •
        ((u' j |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) -
          (xDiv j k |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k)) ^ A • (u' k |ₒ (U n R j ⊓ U n R k))) = 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hbB, pow_add, mul_smul, hb', smul_zero]
    rw [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [cocycle_natCast_g, mres_smul, mres_smul, ores_pow, ores_pow, h0, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← xDiv_mul_xDiv j k i _ le_rfl, mul_pow, add_assoc A B c, pow_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  · simp only [twistComp_twistGlobalMk]
    have hle : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (xDiv (R := R) i i) = ⊤ ⊓ U n R i := by
      rw [basicOpen_xDiv, inf_idem, top_inf_eq]
    refine mres_injective_of_le (V := ⊤ ⊓ U n R i) F hle.le hle.ge ?_
    simp only [mres_smul, mres_res, ores_pow, hone, one_pow, one_smul]
    rw [hu' i, hone, one_pow, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.twist_exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul
statement:
theorem twist_exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul (m : ℤ) {V : ℙ(n; R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hVi : V ≤ U n R i) (f : Γ(ℙ(n; R), V))
    (s : Γ(twist F m, ℙ(n; R).basicOpen f)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (t : Γ(twist F m, V)),
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen t (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen f) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le f) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen f (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen f) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le f) ^ k • s
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen f ≤ U n R i := (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le f).trans hVi
  obtain ⟨k, u, hu⟩ := hV.exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul F f
    (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ m) i hf s)
  refine ⟨k, (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ m) i hVi).symm u, ?_⟩
  rw [← twistSectionsEquiv_symm_res _ _ hVi (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le f), hu, LinearEquiv.map_smul,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isCompact_univ
statement: lemma isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set ℙ(n; R))
proof:
:= by
  have := isCompact_iUnion (fun i ↦ (isAffineOpen_U (n := n) (R := R) i).isCompact)
  rwa [← Opens.coe_iSup, iSup_U, Opens.coe_top] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_epi_freeMk_twist
statement:
theorem exists_epi_freeMk_twist [F.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (σ : I → Γ(twist F m, ⊤)),
      Epi (freeMk (twist F m) σ)
proof:
:= by
  choose i hi using fun x : ℙ(n; R) ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mp ((iSup_U n R).ge (Set.mem_univ x))
  choose g hg hfin using fun x ↦
    (isAffineOpen_U (i x)).exists_module_finite_basicOpen F x (hi x)
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun x ↦ (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x) : Set ℙ(n; R)))
    (fun x ↦ (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x)).isOpen) (fun x _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hg x⟩)
  choose T hT using fun x ↦ (hfin x).fg_top
  let I : Type u := Σ x : S, T x
  choose k t' ht' using fun p : I ↦
    (isAffineOpen_U (i p.1)).exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul F (g p.1) p.2.1
  choose m₀ hm₀ using fun p : I ↦ exists_twist_section_eq F (i p.1) (t' p)
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  choose σ hσ using fun p : I ↦ hm₀ p m ((Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ p)).trans hm)
  refine ⟨I, inferInstance, σ, ?_⟩
  refine epi_of_surjective_app_affine _ (fun x : S ↦ ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x)) ?_
    (fun x ↦ (isAffineOpen_U _).basicOpen _)
    (fun x ↦ twist_exists_restrictOpen_eq_pow_smul F m ((isAffineOpen_U _).basicOpen _) (i x)
      (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _)) fun x ↦ ?_
  · refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS (Set.mem_univ y))
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hy⟩
  have hDU : ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x) ≤ U n R (i x) := ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _
  let e := twistSectionsEquiv (F := F) (cocycle n R ^ (m : ℤ)) (i x) hDU
  let L : Γ((SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules), ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x)) →ₗ[
      Γ(ℙ(n; R), ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x))] Γ(F, ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x)) :=
    { toFun z := e (Hom.app (freeMk (twist F m) σ) _ z)
      map_add' z z' := by simp only [map_add]
      map_smul' r z := by
        simp only [Hom.app_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  have hL : LinearMap.range L = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hT x, Submodule.span_le]
    intro t ht
    let p : I := ⟨x, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
    have hc : IsUnit (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (g x) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x))
        (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) ^ k p) :=
      (ℙ(n; R).toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen (g x)).pow _
    refine ⟨(↑hc.unit⁻¹ : Γ(ℙ(n; R), ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x))) •
      PresheafOfModules.sections.eval (SheafOfModules.freeSection p)
        (Opposite.op (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x))), ?_⟩
    have hp : L (PresheafOfModules.sections.eval (SheafOfModules.freeSection p)
        (Opposite.op (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x)))) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (g x) (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen (g x))
          (ℙ(n; R).basicOpen_le _) ^ k p • t := by
      change e _ = _
      rw [freeMk_app_freeSection, twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_res, hσ p, mres_res,
        mres_res]
      exact ht' p
    refine (L.map_smul _ _).trans ?_
    rw [hp, smul_smul, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_smul]
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : e y ∈ LinearMap.range L := hL ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  exact ⟨z, e.injective hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_generatingSections_twist
statement:
theorem exists_generatingSections_twist [F.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m →
      ∃ σ : SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.{u} (twist F m), σ.IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_epi_freeMk_twist F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI, σ, hσ⟩ := h m hm
  exact ⟨⟨I, fun q ↦ SheafOfModules.sectionOfTerminal Limits.isTerminalTop _ (σ q), hσ⟩, ⟨hI⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_epi_twist_free
statement:
theorem exists_epi_twist_free [F.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I)
      (π : twist (SheafOfModules.free I) (-(m : ℤ)) ⟶ F), Epi π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_epi_freeMk_twist F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI, σ, hσ⟩ := h m hm
  let e : twist (twist F m) (-(m : ℤ)) ≅ F := twistTwistIso F m (-(m : ℤ)) ≪≫
    (twistFunctorCongr (congrArg (cocycle n R ^ ·) (add_neg_cancel (m : ℤ)))).app F ≪≫
    twistZeroIso F
  refine ⟨I, hI, (twistFunctor n R (-(m : ℤ))).map (freeMk (twist F m) σ) ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩
  haveI : Epi ((twistFunctor n R (-(m : ℤ))).map (freeMk (twist F m) σ)) :=
    @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ (twistFunctor n R (-(m : ℤ))) _ _ _ (freeMk (twist F m) σ) hσ
  exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ this _ inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isCoherent_twist
statement: theorem isCoherent_twist [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ) : (twist F m).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI (i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
      SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.{u, u, u} ((twist F m).over (U n R i.down)) :=
    haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.over F (U n R i.down)
    SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.of_iso.{u} (twistOverIso F m i.down).symm
  refine SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.of_coversTop (twist F m) (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦
    U n R i.down) ((Opens.coversTop_iff _ _).2 ?_)
  rw [IsOpenCover, ← iSup_U n R]
  exact le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup (U n R) i.down)
    (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦ U n R i.down) ⟨i⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_epi_twist_free_isCoherent_kernel
statement:
theorem exists_epi_twist_free_isCoherent_kernel [IsNoetherianRing R] [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I)
      (π : twist (SheafOfModules.free I) (-(m : ℤ)) ⟶ F),
        Epi π ∧ (twist (SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (-(m : ℤ))).IsCoherent ∧
          (Limits.kernel π).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.isQuasicoherent F
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian ℙ(n; R) := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (toSpec n R)
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_epi_twist_free F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI, π, hπ⟩ := h m hm
  haveI := Scheme.isCoherent_free (X := ℙ(n; R)) I
  haveI := isCoherent_twist (SheafOfModules.free I : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (-(m : ℤ))
  exact ⟨I, hI, π, hπ, inferInstance, SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.kernel π⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xDiv_self
statement: lemma xDiv_self (i : Fin (n + 1)) : xDiv (R := R) i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [xDiv, awayXDiv_self, map_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xDiv_res
statement:
lemma xDiv_res (i j : Fin (n + 1)) {m : ℕ} {g x : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 m)
    (hx : x = X i * g) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (xDiv i j) (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 x)
      (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨g, hx⟩) =
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 x (awayMap 𝒜 hg hx (awayXDiv R i j))
proof:
:= by
  have := congr($(Proj.awayMap_awayToSection 𝒜 hg hx) (awayXDiv R i j))
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xDiv_mul_xDiv
statement:
lemma xDiv_mul_xDiv (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) (W : ℙ(n; R).Opens) (hW : W ≤ U n R i ⊓ U n R j) :
    (xDiv i j |ₒ W) * (xDiv j l |ₒ W) = (xDiv i l |ₒ W)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (xDiv i j |ₒ (U n R i ⊓ U n R j)) * (xDiv j l |ₒ (U n R i ⊓ U n R j)) =
      (xDiv i l |ₒ (U n R i ⊓ U n R j)) by
    have := congrArg (fun x ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen x W hW) this
    simpa only [ores_mul, ores_res] using this
  have hT : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (X i * X j) = U n R i ⊓ U n R j := Proj.basicOpen_mul _ _ _
  refine ores_injective_of_le hT.le hT.ge ?_
  have h1 := X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) j
  have h2 := X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) i
  simp only [ores_mul, ores_res]
  rw [xDiv_res i j h1 rfl, xDiv_res j l h2 (mul_comm _ _), xDiv_res i l h1 rfl, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply val_injective
  simp only [awayXDiv, awayMap_mk, val_mul, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  exact ⟨1, by simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]; ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cocycle_g

      (cocycle n R).g i j * (xDiv j l |ₒ (U n R i ⊓ U n R j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.twistComp_mulX_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma twistComp_mulX_app (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (m : ℤ) (l : Fin (n + 1)) (V : ℙ(n; R).Opens)
    (s : Γ(twist F m, V)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    twistComp ((mulX F m l).app V s) i = (xDiv i l |ₒ (V ⊓ U n R i)) • twistComp s i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mulX_app_injective
statement:
lemma mulX_app_injective (F : ℙ(n; R).Modules) (m : ℤ) (l : Fin (n + 1)) (V : ℙ(n; R).Opens)
    (hF : ∀ i (x y : Γ(F, V ⊓ U n R i)),
      (xDiv i l |ₒ (V ⊓ U n R i)) • x = (xDiv i l |ₒ (V ⊓ U n R i)) • y → x = y) :
    Function.Injective ((mulX F m l).app V)
proof:
:= fun s t h ↦
  twist_ext fun i ↦ hF i _ _ (by
    rw [← twistComp_mulX_app, ← twistComp_mulX_app, h])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xDiv_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma xDiv_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    xDiv (R := R) i l ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(ℙ(n; R), U n R i)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 (X i) (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one i)
    Nat.one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have h : awayXDiv R i l ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Away 𝒜 (X i)) := by
    obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i l
    · rw [awayXDiv_self]
      exact one_mem _
    · rw [← toAwayX_X, ← awayXEquiv_apply, ← MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors (awayXEquiv R i)]
      exact Submonoid.mem_map_of_mem _ (isRegular_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors.mp isRegular_X)
  have := Submonoid.mem_map_of_mem e h
  rw [MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mulX_twistingSheaf_app_injective
statement:
lemma mulX_twistingSheaf_app_injective (m : ℤ) (l : Fin (n + 1)) (V : ℙ(n; R).Opens) :
    Function.Injective ((mulX (SheafOfModules.unit _) m l).app V)
proof:
:=
  mulX_app_injective _ m l V fun i _ _ hxy ↦
    (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors ((isAffineOpen_U i).restrictOpen_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (xDiv_mem_nonZeroDivisors i l) (inf_le_right : V ⊓ U n R i ≤ U n R i))).mp hxy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.bijective_app_of_iso
statement:
lemma bijective_app_of_iso {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (e.hom.app V)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2 ⟨e.inv.app V, fun s ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Hom.comp_app, e.hom_inv_id, Hom.id_app]
    rfl
  · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Hom.comp_app, e.inv_hom_id, Hom.id_app]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.twistMulSection_app_bijective
statement:
lemma twistMulSection_app_bijective {l : ι} (hl : h l = 1) {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U l) :
    Function.Bijective ((twistMulSection F c d h hh).app V)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ s, twistSectionsEquiv (c * d) l hV ((twistMulSection F c d h hh).app V s) =
      twistSectionsEquiv c l hV s := fun s ↦ by
    rw [twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistSectionsEquiv_apply, twistComp_twistMulSection_app, hl,
      ores_one, one_smul]
  have e : ⇑((twistMulSection F c d h hh).app V) =
      (twistSectionsEquiv (c * d) l hV).symm ∘ twistSectionsEquiv c l hV := by
    funext s
    apply (twistSectionsEquiv (c * d) l hV).injective
    rw [Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, key]
  rw [e]
  exact (LinearEquiv.bijective _).comp (LinearEquiv.bijective _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.mulSection_app_bijective
statement:
lemma mulSection_app_bijective (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) {l : ι} (hl : h l = 1) {V : X.Opens}
    (hV : V ≤ U l) : Function.Bijective ((mulSection F d h hh).app V)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ⇑((mulSection F d h hh).app V) = ⇑(((twistFunctorCongr (one_mul d)).app F).hom.app V) ∘
      ⇑((twistMulSection F 1 d h hh).app V) ∘ ⇑((toTwistOne F).app V) := rfl
  rw [e]
  exact (bijective_app_of_iso _ V).comp
    ((twistMulSection_app_bijective F 1 d h hh hl hV).comp (toTwistOne_bijective hU V))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.comap_mulSection_compat
statement:
lemma comap_mulSection_compat (i j : ι) :
    (φ.app (U i) (h i) |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) =
      (d.comap φ).g i j * (φ.app (U j) (h j) |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j))
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : φ.app (U i ⊓ U j) (h i |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j)) =
      (φ.app (U i) (h i) |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) := app_ores φ inf_le_left (h i)
  have e₂ : φ.app (U i ⊓ U j) (h j |ₒ (U i ⊓ U j)) =
      (φ.app (U j) (h j) |ₒ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U i ⊓ φ ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) := app_ores φ inf_le_right (h j)
  have e₃ : φ.app (U i ⊓ U j) (d.g i j) = (d.comap φ).g i j := by
    rw [Cocycle.comap_g, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
    rfl
  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃, hh i j, map_mul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.iSup_preimage_U
statement: lemma iSup_preimage_U : ⨆ i, j ⁻¹ᵁ U n K i = ⊤

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xDiv_pow_compat

      (cocycle n K ^ (m : ℤ)).g i i' * ((xDiv i' l ^ m) |ₒ (U n K i ⊓ U n K i'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ores_pow, ores_pow, zpow_natCast, Cocycle.pow_g, ← mul_pow, ← xDiv_compat]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mulXPowAlong_app_bijective
statement:
lemma mulXPowAlong_app_bijective (G : Y'.Modules) (m : ℕ) (l : Fin (n + 1)) {V : Y'.Opens}
    (hV : V ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ U n K l) : Function.Bijective ((mulXPowAlong j G m l).app V)
proof:
:=
  mulSection_app_bijective G _ _ _ (iSup_preimage_U j)
    (by simp only [xDiv_self, one_pow, map_one]) hV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.iSup_stdCover
statement: lemma iSup_stdCover : ⨆ i, stdCover n R i = ⊤
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm le_top <| (iSup_U n R).ge.trans <| iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup (stdCover n R) ⟨i⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cechOpen_stdCover
statement:
lemma cechOpen_stdCover {p : ℕ} (σ : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen (stdCover n R) σ = UI n R (im fun a ↦ (σ a).down)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UI_eq_iInf]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_iInf₂ fun j hj ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hj
    exact iInf_le _ a
  · exact le_iInf fun a ↦ iInf₂_le _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ a))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.resEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma resEquiv_apply (M : ℙ(n; R).Modules) {V W : ℙ(n; R).Opens} (h : V = W) (s : Γ(M, V)) :
    resEquiv M h s = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s W h.ge
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cechSectionsEquiv_res
statement:
lemma cechSectionsEquiv_res (k : ℤ) {m p : ℕ} (τ : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
    (θ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (p + 1))
    (s : (twistingSheafAb n R k).obj.obj (op (TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen (stdCover n R) (τ ∘ θ)))) :
    (cechSectionsEquiv k τ ((twistingSheafAb n R k).obj.map
      (homOfLE (TopCat.Presheaf.cechOpen_le_comp _ τ θ)).op s)).1 =
      awayRestr R (im_comp_subset (fun a ↦ (τ a).down) θ) (cechSectionsEquiv k (τ ∘ θ) s).1
proof:
:= by
  have hIJ : (im fun a ↦ (τ (θ a)).down) ⊆ im fun a ↦ (τ a).down :=
    im_comp_subset (fun a ↦ (τ a).down) θ
  change (sectionsUIEquiv (im fun a ↦ (τ a).down) k (im_nonempty _) (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (twistingSheaf n R k).presheaf) s _ _) _ _)).1 =
      awayRestr R hIJ (sectionsUIEquiv (im fun a ↦ (τ (θ a)).down) k (im_nonempty _)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (twistingSheaf n R k).presheaf) s _ _)).1
  rw [mres_res, ← sectionsUIEquiv_res k hIJ (im_nonempty _), mres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cechCochainEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma cechCochainEquiv_apply (k : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : TopCat.Presheaf.CechCochain (stdCover n R) (twistingSheafAb n R k).obj p)
    (i : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    cechCochainEquiv k p c i = cechSectionsEquiv k (fun a ↦ ULift.up (i a)) (c _)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cechCochainEquiv_cechD
statement:
lemma cechCochainEquiv_cechD (k : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : TopCat.Presheaf.CechCochain (stdCover n R) (twistingSheafAb n R k).obj p) :
    cechCochainEquiv k (p + 1) (TopCat.Presheaf.cechD _ _ p c) =
      degCechD (Fin (n + 1)) R k p (cechCochainEquiv k p c)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [cechCochainEquiv_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.cechD_apply]
  simp only [map_sum, map_zsmul, AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum, AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, degCechD,
    AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  congr 1
  exact cechSectionsEquiv_res k (fun a ↦ ULift.up (i a)) l.succAbove _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exactAt_cechComplex_twistingSheafAb
statement:
theorem exactAt_cechComplex_twistingSheafAb (k : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 ≠ n ∨ -(n : ℤ) ≤ k) :
    (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplex (stdCover n R) (twistingSheafAb n R k).obj).ExactAt (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.exactAt_cechComplex_succ_iff]
  intro c hc
  have hp' : p + 2 ≠ Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) ∨ -(Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℤ) < k := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hx : degCechD (Fin (n + 1)) R k (p + 1) (cechCochainEquiv k (p + 1) c) = 0 := by
    rw [← cechCochainEquiv_cechD, hc, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (degCech_exact (R := R) k p hp' _).1 hx
  refine ⟨(cechCochainEquiv k p).symm y, (cechCochainEquiv k (p + 1)).injective ?_⟩
  rw [cechCochainEquiv_cechD, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.isCechAcyclic_twistingSheafAb
statement:
theorem isCechAcyclic_twistingSheafAb (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsCechAcyclic (stdCover n R) (twistingSheafAb n R k).obj
proof:
:=
  fun p ↦ exactAt_cechComplex_twistingSheafAb k p (Or.inr hk)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero
statement:
theorem H_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k)
    (hacyc : ∀ I : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), I.Nonempty → ∀ (q : ℕ)
      (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (UI n R I)).obj (twistingSheafAb n R k))
        (q + 1)), x = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H (twistingSheafAb n R k) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ V : ℙ(n; R).Opens, (∃ I : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), I.Nonempty ∧ V = UI n R I) →
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen V).obj (twistingSheafAb n R k))
        (q + 1)), x = 0 := by
    rintro V ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩
    exact hacyc I hI
  exact TopCat.Sheaf.H_eq_zero_of_isCechAcyclic (stdCover n R) (iSup_stdCover n R) _
    (fun _ σ ↦ key _ ⟨_, im_nonempty _, cechOpen_stdCover σ⟩)
    (isCechAcyclic_twistingSheafAb k hk) q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_zero_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero
statement:
lemma H_zero_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k < 0)
    (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H (twistingSheafAb n R k) 0) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  (TopCat.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ _).injective <| by
    rw [map_zero]
    exact globalSections_eq_zero k hn hk _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.H_twistingSheafAb_complex_eq_zero
statement:
theorem H_twistingSheafAb_complex_eq_zero (k : ℤ) (hk : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k)
    (hacyc : ∀ I : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), I.Nonempty → ∀ (q : ℕ)
      (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen (UI n (ULift.{u} ℂ) I)).obj
        (twistingSheafAb n (ULift.{u} ℂ) k)) (q + 1)), x = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (x : TopCat.Sheaf.H (twistingSheafAb n (ULift.{u} ℂ) k) (q + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  H_twistingSheafAb_eq_zero k hk hacyc q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.cocycle_zpow_g_res
statement:
lemma cocycle_zpow_g_res (k : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : ℙ(n; R).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ U n R i ⊓ U n R j) :
    ((cocycle n R ^ k).g i j |ₒ W) =
      ((xDivUnit i j W hW ^ k : Γ(ℙ(n; R), W)ˣ) : Γ(ℙ(n; R), W))
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [zpow_zero, Cocycle.one_g, ores_one, Units.val_one]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [zpow_add_one, Cocycle.mul_g, ores_mul, ih, zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul]
    simp only [cocycle_g, ores_res]
    rfl
  | pred k ih =>
    rw [zpow_sub_one, Cocycle.mul_g, ores_mul, ih, zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul, Cocycle.inv_g,
      cocycle_g, ores_res, ores_res]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIRingEquiv_symm_apply

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.toAway_xDiv
statement:
lemma toAway_xDiv (hI : I.Nonempty) {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    toAway I hI (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (xDiv i j) (UI n R I) (UI_le_U hi)) *
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (Localization.Away (prodX R I)) (X i) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (Localization.Away (prodX R I)) (X j)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (Finset.mul_prod_erase I (fun j ↦ (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)) hi).symm
  have hg := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) (I.erase i)
  have := xDiv_res i j hg hx
  rw [this, toAway_awayToSection, awayXDiv, awayMap_mk, Away.val_mk,
    ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap,
    Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_one, mul_one]
  rw [hx]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.units_map_toAway_xDivUnit
statement:
lemma units_map_toAway_xDivUnit (hI : I.Nonempty) {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I) (hj : j ∈ I)
    (h : UI n R I ≤ U n R i ⊓ U n R j) :
    Units.map (toAway I hI).toMonoidHom (xDivUnit i j (UI n R I) h) =
      xUnit R hj * (xUnit R hi)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq]
  ext
  exact toAway_xDiv hI hi j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.card_erase_add_one
statement: lemma card_erase_add_one : (I.erase i).card + 1 = I.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_erase_add_one hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.prodX_eq
statement: lemma prodX_eq : prodX R I = X i * prodX R (I.erase i)
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mul_prod_erase I (fun j ↦ (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)) hi).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.val_powX
statement:
@[simp]
lemma val_powX (m : ℕ) : (powX R I m : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) = prodX R I ^ m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mk_eq_mk_of
proof:
:= by
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  exact ⟨1, by simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]; exact h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.algebraMap_mul_mk
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mul_mk (q a : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (b : Submonoid.powers (prodX R I)) :
    algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (prodX R I)) q * Localization.mk a b =
      Localization.mk (q * a) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.val_xUnit_pow
statement:
lemma val_xUnit_pow (t : ℕ) :
    ((xUnit R hi ^ (t : ℤ) : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) _ (X i ^ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, val_xUnit, map_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree
statement:
lemma mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree {d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} :
    p ∈ 𝒜 d ↔ ∀ e, p.coeff e ≠ 0 → (e.degree : ℤ) = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule]
  exact isHomogeneous_iff_forall_degree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.xUnit_zpow_mul_mk_mem
statement:
lemma xUnit_zpow_mul_mk_mem (k : ℤ) (m : ℕ) {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R}
    (hp : p ∈ 𝒜 (m • I.card)) :
    ((xUnit R hi ^ k : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) *
      Localization.mk p (powX R I m) ∈ awayDegree R I k
proof:
:= by
  have hc := card_erase_add_one hi
  obtain ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg k
  · rw [val_xUnit_pow, algebraMap_mul_mk, mem_awayDegree_iff]
    refine ⟨m, _, fun e he ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
    have hXt : X i ^ t ∈ 𝒜 t := by
      simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded t (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) i)
    have hq : X i ^ t * p ∈ 𝒜 (t + m • I.card) := SetLike.mul_mem_graded hXt hp
    rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree.mp hq e he]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  · have hg := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) (I.erase i)
    have hq : prodX R (I.erase i) ^ t * p ∈ 𝒜 (t • (I.erase i).card + m • I.card) :=
      SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded t hg) hp
    have key : ((xUnit R hi ^ (-(t : ℤ)) : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) :
        Localization.Away (prodX R I)) * Localization.mk p (powX R I m) =
        Localization.mk (prodX R (I.erase i) ^ t * p) (powX R I (m + t)) := by
      rw [zpow_neg, Units.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, val_xUnit_pow, algebraMap_mul_mk]
      apply mk_eq_mk_of
      simp only [val_powX]
      rw [prodX_eq hi]
      ring
    rw [key, mem_awayDegree_iff]
    refine ⟨m + t, _, fun e he ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree.mp hq e he]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    rw [← hc]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_xUnit_zpow_mul_val_eq
statement:
lemma exists_xUnit_zpow_mul_val_eq (k : ℤ) {y : Localization.Away (prodX R I)}
    (hy : y ∈ awayDegree R I k) :
    ∃ a : Away 𝒜 (prodX R I), ((xUnit R hi ^ k : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) :
      Localization.Away (prodX R I)) * a.val = y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := card_erase_add_one hi
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp, rfl⟩ := (mem_awayDegree_iff y).mp hy
  by_cases h0 : p = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [h0, Localization.mk_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := MvPolynomial.ne_zero_iff.mp h0
  have hd := hp e₀ he₀
  have hX := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) I
  obtain ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg k
  · have hg := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) (I.erase i)
    have hpd : p ∈ 𝒜 (t + m * I.card) := mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree.mpr fun e he ↦ by
      rw [hp e he]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hq : p * prodX R (I.erase i) ^ t ∈ 𝒜 ((m + t) • I.card) := by
      have := SetLike.mul_mem_graded hpd (SetLike.pow_mem_graded t hg)
      convert this using 2
      rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← hc]
      ring
    refine ⟨Away.mk 𝒜 hX (m + t) _ hq, ?_⟩
    rw [Away.val_mk, val_xUnit_pow, algebraMap_mul_mk]
    apply mk_eq_mk_of
    have hx := prodX_eq (R := R) hi
    simp only [prodX] at hx ⊢
    rw [hx]
    ring
  · have hpd : p ∈ 𝒜 (m * I.card - t) := mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff_degree.mpr fun e he ↦ by
      rw [hp e he]
      have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ e₀.degree := Int.natCast_nonneg _
      omega
    have hq : X i ^ t * p ∈ 𝒜 (m • I.card) := by
      have hXt : X i ^ t ∈ 𝒜 t := by
        simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded t (X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one (R := R) i)
      have := SetLike.mul_mem_graded hXt hpd
      convert this using 2
      have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ e₀.degree := Int.natCast_nonneg _
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      omega
    refine ⟨Away.mk 𝒜 hX m _ hq, ?_⟩
    rw [Away.val_mk, zpow_neg, Units.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, val_xUnit_pow, algebraMap_mul_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIAux_eq
statement:
lemma sectionsUIAux_eq (hI : I.Nonempty) {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I) (hj : j ∈ I)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    sectionsUIAux k hI hi s = sectionsUIAux k hI hj s
proof:
:= by
  have h : UI n R I ≤ U n R i ⊓ U n R j := le_inf (UI_le_U hi) (UI_le_U hj)
  unfold sectionsUIAux
  rw [twistSectionsEquiv_change (cocycle n R ^ k) i (UI_le_U hi) j (UI_le_U hj) s,
    cocycle_zpow_g_res k i j _ h]
  change _ * toAway I hI (_ * _) = _
  rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  have e : toAway I hI ((xDivUnit i j (UI n R I) h ^ k : Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I)ˣ) :
      Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I)) =
      ((Units.map (toAway I hI).toMonoidHom (xDivUnit i j (UI n R I) h) ^ k :
        (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) := by
    rw [← map_zpow]
    rfl
  rw [e, units_map_toAway_xDivUnit hI hi hj h, ← Units.val_mul, mul_zpow, inv_zpow,
    mul_left_comm, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_eq
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_eq (hI : I.Nonempty) {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    sectionsUI I k hI s = ((xUnit R hi ^ k : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) :
      Localization.Away (prodX R I)) *
        toAway I hI (unitSectionsEquiv _ _
          (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ k) i (UI_le_U hi) s))
proof:
:=
  sectionsUIAux_eq k hI (I.min'_mem hI) hi s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_injective
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_injective (hI : I.Nonempty) :
    Function.Injective (sectionsUI (R := R) I k hI)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  rw [sectionsUI_eq k hI (I.min'_mem hI), sectionsUI_eq k hI (I.min'_mem hI)] at h
  exact (twistSectionsEquiv _ _ _).injective ((unitSectionsEquiv _ _).injective
    (toAway_injective hI ((Units.mul_right_inj _).mp h)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_smul
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_smul (hI : I.Nonempty) (r : Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I))
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    sectionsUI I k hI (r • s) = toAway I hI r * sectionsUI I k hI s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionsUI_eq k hI (I.min'_mem hI), sectionsUI_eq k hI (I.min'_mem hI),
    LinearEquiv.map_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_left_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.UI_antitone
statement: lemma UI_antitone : UI n R J ≤ UI n R I
proof:
:= by
  rw [UI_eq_iInf, UI_eq_iInf]
  exact iInf₂_mono' fun j hj ↦ ⟨j, hIJ hj, le_rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.toAway_res
statement:
lemma toAway_res (hI : I.Nonempty) (r : Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I)) :
    toAway J (hI.mono hIJ) (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen r (UI n R J) (UI_antitone hIJ)) =
      awayRestr R hIJ (toAway I hI r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (sectionsUIRingEquiv I hI).symm.surjective r
  have hx : prodX R J = prodX R I * prodX R (J \ I) :=
    by rw [mul_comm]; exact (Finset.prod_sdiff hIJ).symm
  have hg := prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) (J \ I)
  have := congr($(Proj.awayMap_awayToSection 𝒜 hg hx) a)
  rw [sectionsUIRingEquiv_symm_apply, toAway_awayToSection]
  refine ((congrArg (toAway J (hI.mono hIJ)) this.symm).trans ?_)
  erw [toAway_awayToSection]
  exact val_awayMap 𝒜 hg hx a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.awayRestr_algebraMap
statement:
lemma awayRestr_algebraMap (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    awayRestr R hIJ (algebraMap _ _ p) = algebraMap _ _ p
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ (isUnit_algebraMap_prod_X hIJ) p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.units_map_awayRestr_xUnit
statement:
lemma units_map_awayRestr_xUnit {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I) :
    Units.map (awayRestr R hIJ).toMonoidHom (xUnit R hi) = xUnit R (hIJ hi)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact awayRestr_algebraMap hIJ (X i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_res
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_res (hI : I.Nonempty) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    sectionsUI J k (hI.mono hIJ) (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (UI n R J) (UI_antitone hIJ)) =
      awayRestr R hIJ (sectionsUI I k hI s)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := I.min'_mem hI
  rw [sectionsUI_eq k (hI.mono hIJ) (hIJ hi), sectionsUI_eq k hI hi, map_mul,
    twistSectionsEquiv_res _ _ (UI_le_U hi) (UI_antitone hIJ), unitSectionsEquiv_res,
    toAway_res hIJ hI]
  congr 1
  rw [← units_map_awayRestr_xUnit hIJ hi, ← map_zpow]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_mem
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_mem (hI : I.Nonempty) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    sectionsUI I k hI s ∈ awayDegree R I k
proof:
:= by
  have hi := I.min'_mem hI
  rw [sectionsUI_eq k hI hi]
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp, hr⟩ := Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 (prod_X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule (R := R) I)
    (sectionsUIRingEquiv I hI (unitSectionsEquiv _ _
      (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ k) _ (UI_le_U hi) s)))
  have : toAway I hI (unitSectionsEquiv _ _
      (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ k) _ (UI_le_U hi) s)) =
      Localization.mk p (powX R I m) := by
    rw [toAway, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, ← hr]
    rfl
  rw [this]
  exact xUnit_zpow_mul_mk_mem hi k m hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUI_surjective
statement:
lemma sectionsUI_surjective (hI : I.Nonempty) {y : Localization.Away (prodX R I)}
    (hy : y ∈ awayDegree R I k) : ∃ s, sectionsUI I k hI s = y
proof:
:= by
  have hi := I.min'_mem hI
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_xUnit_zpow_mul_val_eq hi k hy
  refine ⟨(twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ k) _ (UI_le_U hi)).symm
    ((unitSectionsEquiv _ _).symm ((sectionsUIRingEquiv I hI).symm a)), ?_⟩
  rw [sectionsUI_eq k hI hi, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← ha]
  congr 1
  simp [toAway]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma sectionsUIEquiv_apply (hI : I.Nonempty) {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ∈ I)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    (sectionsUIEquiv I k hI s : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) =
      ((xUnit R hi ^ k : (Localization.Away (prodX R I))ˣ) : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) *
        toAway I hI (unitSectionsEquiv _ _
          (twistSectionsEquiv (cocycle n R ^ k) i (UI_le_U hi) s))
proof:
:=
  sectionsUI_eq k hI hi s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIEquiv_smul
statement:
lemma sectionsUIEquiv_smul (hI : I.Nonempty) (r : Γ(ℙ(n; R), UI n R I))
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    (sectionsUIEquiv I k hI (r • s) : Localization.Away (prodX R I)) =
      toAway I hI r * sectionsUIEquiv I k hI s
proof:
:=
  sectionsUI_smul k hI r s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIEquiv_res
statement:
lemma sectionsUIEquiv_res {J : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (hIJ : I ⊆ J) (hI : I.Nonempty)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, UI n R I)) :
    (sectionsUIEquiv J k (hI.mono hIJ)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (UI n R J) (UI_antitone hIJ)) :
          Localization.Away (prodX R J)) =
      awayRestr R hIJ (sectionsUIEquiv I k hI s)
proof:
:=
  sectionsUI_res k hIJ hI s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.UI_pair
statement: lemma UI_pair (i j : Fin (n + 1)) : UI n R {i, j} = UI n R {i} ⊓ UI n R {j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [UI_eq_iInf, UI_singleton, UI_singleton, Finset.iInf_insert, Finset.iInf_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.iSup_UI_singleton
statement: lemma iSup_UI_singleton : ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), UI n R {i} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [UI_singleton]
  exact iSup_U n R

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_eq_of_mem (i : Fin (n + 1)) (J : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)) :
    globalCoeff k i s = awayCoeff R J (sectionsUIEquiv J k ⟨i, hi⟩
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (UI n R J) le_top))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ({i} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) ⊆ J := Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi
  change awayCoeff R {i} _ = _
  rw [← awayCoeff_awayRestr h, ← sectionsUIEquiv_res k h, mres_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_eq
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_eq (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)) :
    globalCoeff k i s = globalCoeff k j s
proof:
:= by
  rw [globalCoeff_eq_of_mem k i {i, j} (by simp), globalCoeff_eq_of_mem k j {i, j} (by simp)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart_singleton
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart_singleton (i : Fin (n + 1)) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)) :
    globalCoeff k i s ∈ laurentPart R {i} k
proof:
:=
  (awayCoeff_mem_laurentPart_iff _).mpr (Subtype.property _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart (hn : 1 ≤ n) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)) :
    globalCoeff k 0 s ∈ laurentPart R ∅ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_laurentPart]
  intro a ha
  have h₀ := mem_laurentPart.mp (globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart_singleton k 0 s) a ha
  rw [globalCoeff_eq k 0 (Fin.last n)] at ha
  have h₁ := mem_laurentPart.mp (globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart_singleton k (Fin.last n) s) a ha
  refine ⟨fun j hj ↦ ?_, h₀.2⟩
  have e₀ := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (h₀.1 hj)
  have e₁ := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (h₁.1 hj)
  have := congrArg Fin.val (e₀.symm.trans e₁)
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_last] at this
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_injective
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_injective (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (globalCoeff (R := R) k i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro s hs
  have h (j : Fin (n + 1)) : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (UI n R {j}) le_top = 0 := by
    rw [globalCoeff_eq k i j] at hs
    apply (sectionsUIEquiv {j} k (Finset.singleton_nonempty j)).injective
    rw [map_zero]
    exact Subtype.ext (awayCoeff_injective _ (hs.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  refine mres_eq_of_locally_eq _ (fun j ↦ UI n R {j}) iSup_UI_singleton.ge (fun _ ↦ le_top) s 0
    fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [h j, mres_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalSections_eq_zero
statement:
lemma globalSections_eq_zero (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hk : k < 0) (s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R k, ⊤)) :
    s = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine globalCoeff_injective k 0 ?_
  rw [map_zero]
  ext a
  by_contra ha
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_laurentPart.mp (globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart k hn s) a ha
  have : 0 ≤ a.degree := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ not_lt.mp fun hj ↦ ?_
    simpa using h₁ (mem_negSupp.mpr hj)
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.polyCoeff_apply
statement:
lemma polyCoeff_apply (d : ℕ) (p : 𝒜 d) :
    polyCoeff R d p = (toLaurent (Fin (n + 1)) R p).coeff
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.polyCoeff_injective
statement: lemma polyCoeff_injective (d : ℕ) : Function.Injective (polyCoeff (n := n) R d)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext (toLaurent_injective ((AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffAddEquiv).injective h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_globalSection
statement:
lemma exists_globalSection (d : ℕ) (p : 𝒜 d) :
    ∃ s : Γ(twistingSheaf n R d, ⊤), ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (sectionsUIEquiv {i} d (Finset.singleton_nonempty i)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen s (UI n R {i}) le_top) : Localization.Away (prodX R {i})) =
        algebraMap _ _ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R).IsHomogeneous d := p.2
  let t (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Γ(twistingSheaf n R d, UI n R {i}) :=
    (sectionsUIEquiv {i} d (Finset.singleton_nonempty i)).symm
      ⟨_, algebraMap_mem_awayDegree {i} hp⟩
  have ht (i : Fin (n + 1)) : (sectionsUIEquiv {i} d (Finset.singleton_nonempty i) (t i) :
      Localization.Away (prodX R {i})) = algebraMap _ _ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) := by
    simp [t]
  have key (i j : Fin (n + 1)) : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (t i) (UI n R {i, j})
      (UI_antitone (by simp)) = TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (t j) (UI n R {i, j})
      (UI_antitone (by simp)) := by
    apply (sectionsUIEquiv {i, j} d ⟨i, by simp⟩).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [sectionsUIEquiv_res d (by simp : ({i} : Finset _) ⊆ {i, j}) (Finset.singleton_nonempty i),
      sectionsUIEquiv_res d (by simp : ({j} : Finset _) ⊆ {i, j}) (Finset.singleton_nonempty j),
      ht, ht,
      awayRestr_algebraMap, awayRestr_algebraMap]
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := mres_existsUnique_gluing (twistingSheaf n R d) (fun i ↦ UI n R {i})
    iSup_UI_singleton.ge (fun _ ↦ le_top) t fun i j ↦ by
      apply mres_injective_of_le _ (UI_pair (R := R) i j).le (UI_pair (R := R) i j).ge
      simp only [mres_res]
      exact key i j
  exact ⟨s, fun i ↦ by rw [hs i, ht]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.range_globalCoeff
statement:
lemma range_globalCoeff (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℕ) :
    (globalCoeff (R := R) (n := n) d 0).range = (polyCoeff R d).range
proof:
:= by
  ext F
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpF⟩ := exists_toLaurent_coeff_eq _ (globalCoeff_mem_laurentPart d hn s)
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpF⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_globalSection d p
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    change awayCoeff R {0} _ = _
    rw [hs 0, awayCoeff_apply, awayToLaurent_algebraMap]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.globalCoeff_globalSectionsEquiv_symm
statement:
lemma globalCoeff_globalSectionsEquiv_symm (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℕ) (p : 𝒜 d) :
    globalCoeff d 0 ((globalSectionsEquiv (R := R) hn d).symm p) = polyCoeff R d p
proof:
:= by
  unfold globalSectionsEquiv
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_trans_apply, AddEquiv.symm_trans_apply, AddEquiv.symm_symm]
  set x := (AddEquiv.addSubgroupCongr (range_globalCoeff (R := R) hn d)).symm
    (AddMonoidHom.ofInjective (polyCoeff_injective (n := n) (R := R) d) p)
  have := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((AddMonoidHom.ofInjective (globalCoeff_injective (R := R) (n := n) d 0)).apply_symm_apply x)
  rw [AddMonoidHom.ofInjective_apply] at this
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.sectionsUIEquiv_globalSectionsEquiv_symm
statement:
lemma sectionsUIEquiv_globalSectionsEquiv_symm (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℕ) (p : 𝒜 d)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (sectionsUIEquiv {i} d (Finset.singleton_nonempty i)
      (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ((globalSectionsEquiv (R := R) hn d).symm p) (UI n R {i})
        le_top) : Localization.Away (prodX R {i})) =
      algebraMap _ _ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)
proof:
:= by
  apply awayCoeff_injective {i}
  change globalCoeff d i _ = _
  rw [globalCoeff_eq d i 0, globalCoeff_globalSectionsEquiv_symm, polyCoeff_apply,
    awayCoeff_apply, awayToLaurent_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.iInf_stdCover
statement:
lemma iInf_stdCover (I : Finset (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :
    ⨅ i ∈ I, stdCover n R i = UI n R (I.image ULift.down)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [UI_eq_iInf]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_iInf₂ fun j hj ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hj
    exact iInf₂_le i hi
  · exact le_iInf₂ fun i hi ↦ iInf₂_le i.down (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)

    IsAffineOpen (⨅ i ∈ I, stdCover n R i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hI
  rw [iInf_stdCover]
  exact isAffineOpen_UI (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus_of_ringKrullDim_le_one
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus_of_ringKrullDim_le_one {X : Scheme.{u}} {K : Type u} [Field K]
    [CharZero K] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] {x : X} {V : X.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hx : x ∈ V) [IsDomain Γ(X, V)] [IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(X, V)]
    (h : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≤ 1) : x ∈ f.smoothLocus
proof:
:= by
  have hVU : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := by simp
  have := f.finitePresentation_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hV hVU
  algebraize [(f.appLE ⊤ V hVU).hom]
  let q := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal
  haveI : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization _ q.primeCompl q.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  letI := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hx⟩ : V)
  haveI := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q) ≤ 1 := by
    rwa [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      (IsLocalization.algEquiv q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv]
  let e : Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤) ≃+* K := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  haveI : CharZero Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom (f := e.symm.toRingHom) e.symm.injective
  have hsm : Algebra.IsSmoothAt Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤) q :=
    Algebra.isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_isField
      (e.toMulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField K)) q hdim
  exact (formallySmooth_stalkMap_iff ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top _) V hV hVU hx).mpr hsm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.germ_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem germ_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    haveI : IsLocalRing ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk p)
proof:
:=
      inferInstanceAs (IsLocalRing
        ((Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.stalk p))
    ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial).hom (algebraMap R _ a) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk p) ↔ a ∈ p.asIdeal := by
  have e : ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial).hom (algebraMap R _ a) =
      algebraMap R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk p) a :=
    StructureSheaf.algebraMap_germ_apply (R := R) ⊤ p trivial a
  rw [e]
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ p.asIdeal a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.germ_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iff'
statement:
theorem germ_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iff' (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ((Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial).hom
        (algebraMap R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) a) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        ((Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.stalk p) ↔
      a ∈ p.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  germ_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iff R a p

name: SimplexCochain.restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_apply {m n : ℕ} (θ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : Cochain ι M m)
    (i : Fin (n + 1) → ι) : restrict θ x i = x fun a ↦ i (θ a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.d_apply
statement:
lemma d_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) (i : Fin (p + 2) → ι) :
    d p x i = ∑ k : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ)) • x fun a ↦ i (k.succAbove a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.d_eq_objD
statement:
lemma d_eq_objD (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    d p x = (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
      (cosimplicial (ι := ι) (M := M)) p).hom x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [d_apply, AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD, CosimplicialObject.δ,
    ModuleCat.hom_sum, ModuleCat.hom_zsmul, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  erw [Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.d_d
statement:
@[simp]
lemma d_d (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) : d (p + 1) (d p x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun φ : (cosimplicial (ι := ι) (M := M)).obj ⦋p⦌ ⟶
      (cosimplicial (ι := ι) (M := M)).obj ⦋p + 2⦌ ↦ φ.hom x)
    (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.d_squared (cosimplicial (ι := ι) (M := M)) p)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  rw [d_eq_objD, d_eq_objD]
  exact h

name: SimplexCochain.h_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma h_apply (j : ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) :
    h j p x i = x (Fin.cons j i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.aug_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma aug_apply (v : M) (i : Fin 1 → ι) : aug v i = v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.d_aug
statement:
@[simp]
lemma d_aug (v : M) : d 0 (aug (ι := ι) v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [d_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: SimplexCochain.d_h_add_h_d
statement:
lemma d_h_add_h_d (j : ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) :
    d p (h j p x) + h j (p + 1) (d (p + 1) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, d_apply, h_apply]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ (n := p + 2)]
  have e0 : (fun a ↦ (Fin.cons j i : Fin (p + 3) → ι) ((0 : Fin (p + 3)).succAbove a)) = i := by
    ext a; simp
  have e1 (k : Fin (p + 2)) : (fun a ↦ (Fin.cons j i : Fin (p + 3) → ι) (k.succ.succAbove a)) =
      (Fin.cons j (fun a ↦ i (k.succAbove a)) : Fin (p + 2) → ι) := by
    ext a
    cases a using Fin.cases <;> simp
  simp only [e0, e1, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul]
  abel

name: SimplexCochain.aug_add_h_d
statement:
lemma aug_add_h_d (j : ι) (x : Cochain ι M 0) :
    aug (x fun _ ↦ j) + h j 0 (d 0 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, aug_apply, h_apply, d_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero]
  have e0 : (fun a ↦ (Fin.cons j i : Fin 2 → ι) ((0 : Fin 2).succAbove a)) = i := by
    ext a; simp
  have e1 : (fun a ↦ (Fin.cons j i : Fin 2 → ι) ((0 : Fin 1).succ.succAbove a)) = fun _ ↦ j := by
    ext a; simp [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero a]
  simp only [e0, e1, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Fin.val_succ, zero_add, pow_one, neg_smul,
    add_zero]
  abel

name: SimplexCochain.map_apply

name: SimplexCochain.h_map

name: SimplexCochain.im_nonempty

name: SimplexCochain.im_comp_subset
statement:
lemma im_comp_subset {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1) → ι) (θ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    im (fun a ↦ i (θ a)) ⊆ im i
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht ⊢
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SimplexCochain.im_cons

lemma im_cons {p : ℕ} (j : ι) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) :
    im (Fin.cons j i : Fin (p + 2) → ι) = insert j (im i)

name: SimplexCochain.card_im_le

name: SimplexCochain.res_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_apply (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) :
    res T p x i = if im i ⊆ T then x i else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.res_res
statement:
lemma res_res {T T' : Finset ι} (hT : T' ⊆ T) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    res T' p (res T p x) = res T' p x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : im i ⊆ T'
  · simp [hi, hi.trans hT]
  · simp [hi]

name: SimplexCochain.res_univ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_univ [Fintype ι] (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) : res Finset.univ p x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: SimplexCochain.res_d_res
statement:
lemma res_d_res (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    res T (p + 1) (d p (res T p x)) = res T (p + 1) (d p x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : im i ⊆ T
  · simp only [res_apply, hi, if_true, d_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [if_pos ((im_comp_subset i _).trans hi)]
  · simp [hi]

name: SimplexCochain.h_res
statement:
lemma h_res {T : Finset ι} {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ T) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) :
    h j p (res T (p + 1) x) = res T p (h j p x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [im_cons, Finset.insert_subset_iff, hj]

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.res_eq
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.res_eq {N T : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : SuppBetween N T x) :
    res T p x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : im i ⊆ T
  · simp [hi]
  · simp only [res_apply, hi, if_false]
    by_contra h
    exact hi (hx i (Ne.symm h)).2

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.res_eq_zero
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.res_eq_zero {N T T' : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p}
    (hx : SuppBetween N T x) (hN : ¬ N ⊆ T') : res T' p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : im i ⊆ T'
  · simp only [res_apply, hi, if_true, Pi.zero_apply]
    by_contra h
    exact hN ((hx i h).1.trans hi)
  · simp [hi]

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.map_res
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.map_res {N T T' : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p}
    (hx : SuppBetween N T x) : SuppBetween N T' (res T' p x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [res_apply] at hi
  split_ifs at hi with h
  · exact ⟨(hx i hi).1, h⟩
  · exact absurd rfl hi

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.map_D
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.map_D {N T : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : SuppBetween N T x) :
    SuppBetween N T (res T (p + 1) (d p x))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [res_apply] at hi
  split_ifs at hi with hT
  · refine ⟨?_, hT⟩
    rw [d_apply] at hi
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hi
    have hk' : x (fun a ↦ i (k.succAbove a)) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hk (by rw [h, smul_zero])
    exact (hx _ hk').1.trans (im_comp_subset i _)
  · exact absurd rfl hi

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.mono
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.mono {N N' T : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : SuppBetween N T x)
    (hN : N' ⊆ N) : SuppBetween N' T x
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ ⟨hN.trans (hx i hi).1, (hx i hi).2⟩

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.mono_right
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.mono_right {N T T' : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p}
    (hx : SuppBetween N T x) (hT : T ⊆ T') : SuppBetween N T' x
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ ⟨(hx i hi).1, (hx i hi).2.trans hT⟩

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.zero
statement: lemma SuppBetween.zero (N T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) : SuppBetween N T (0 : Cochain ι M p)
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ absurd rfl h

name: SimplexCochain.SuppBetween.sub
statement:
lemma SuppBetween.sub {N T : Finset ι} {p : ℕ} {x y : Cochain ι M p} (hx : SuppBetween N T x)
    (hy : SuppBetween N T y) : SuppBetween N T (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  by_cases h : x i = 0
  · refine hy i fun h' ↦ hi ?_
    simp [h, h']
  · exact hx i h

name: SimplexCochain.suppEq_empty
statement: lemma suppEq_empty {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : SuppEq ∅ x) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_contra h
  exact (im_nonempty i).ne_empty (Finset.subset_empty.mp (hx i h).2)

name: SimplexCochain.D_apply
statement: lemma D_apply (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) : D T p x = res T (p + 1) (d p x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.D_univ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma D_univ [Fintype ι] (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) : D Finset.univ p x = d p x
proof:
:= by
  simp [D_apply]

name: SimplexCochain.D_D
statement:
@[simp]
lemma D_D (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) : D T (p + 1) (D T p x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [D_apply, res_d_res]

name: SimplexCochain.res_D
statement:
lemma res_D {T T' : Finset ι} (hT : T' ⊆ T) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    res T' (p + 1) (D T p x) = D T' p (res T' p x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D_apply, res_res hT, D_apply, res_d_res]

name: SimplexCochain.D_h_add_h_D
statement:
lemma D_h_add_h_D {T : Finset ι} {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ T) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1))
    (hx : res T (p + 1) x = x) : D T p (h j p x) + h j (p + 1) (D T (p + 1) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [D_apply, D_apply, h_res hj, ← map_add, d_h_add_h_d, hx]

name: SimplexCochain.D_corr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma D_corr (T : Finset ι) (g : (p : ℕ) → Cochain ι M (p + 1) →+ Cochain ι M p) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Cochain ι M p) : D T p (corr T g p x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero => simp [corr]
  | succ p => simp [corr]

name: SimplexCochain.G_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma G_nil (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) : G [] p x = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.G_cons
statement:
lemma G_cons (j : ι) (l : List ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) :
    G (j :: l) p x = h j p x - corr (j :: l).toFinset (G l) p (res l.toFinset p (h j p x)) -
      G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset p (h j p x)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.corr_succ
statement:
lemma corr_succ (T : Finset ι) (g : (p : ℕ) → Cochain ι M (p + 1) →+ Cochain ι M p) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) : corr T g (p + 1) x = D T p (g p x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SimplexCochain.D_G_add_G_D
statement:
theorem D_G_add_G_D (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1))
    (hx : SuppEq l.toFinset x) :
    D l.toFinset p (G l p x) + G l (p + 1) (D l.toFinset (p + 1) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [suppEq_empty hx]
  | cons j l =>
    have hj : j ∉ l := (List.nodup_cons.mp hl).1
    have hjT : j ∈ (j :: l).toFinset := by simp
    have hTT : l.toFinset ⊆ (j :: l).toFinset := by intro t; simp; tauto
    have hx₀ : res l.toFinset (p + 1) x = 0 :=
      hx.res_eq_zero fun h ↦ hj (List.mem_toFinset.mp (h hjT))
    have hxu := D_h_add_h_D hjT p x hx.res_eq
    have h₁ : D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1)
        (h j (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x)) = D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x := by
      have := D_h_add_h_D hjT (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x)
        (by rw [D_apply, res_res le_rfl])
      rwa [D_D, map_zero, add_zero] at this
    have h₂ : res l.toFinset (p + 2) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x) = 0 := by
      rw [res_D hTT, hx₀, map_zero]
    have key : G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset p (h j p x))) +
        G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (h j (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x))) = 0 := by
      rw [← map_add, ← map_add, hxu, hx₀, map_zero]
    rw [G_cons, G_cons, corr_succ, map_sub, map_sub, D_corr, sub_zero, h₁, h₂, map_zero,
      sub_zero]
    calc _ = D (j :: l).toFinset p (h j p x) + h j (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x) -
          D (j :: l).toFinset p
            (G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset p (h j p x))) +
              G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (h j (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset (p + 1) x)))) := by
          rw [map_add]; abel
      _ = x := by rw [key, map_zero, sub_zero, hxu]

name: SimplexCochain.suppEq_G
statement:
theorem suppEq_G (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) (p : ℕ) (hp : l.length ≤ p + 1)
    (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (hx : SuppEq l.toFinset x) : SuppEq l.toFinset (G l p x)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p x with
  | nil => exact SuppBetween.zero _ _ _
  | cons j l ih =>
    obtain ⟨hj, hl'⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hl
    have hT : (j :: l).toFinset = insert j l.toFinset := List.toFinset_cons
    have hTT : l.toFinset ⊆ (j :: l).toFinset := by rw [hT]; exact Finset.subset_insert _ _
    have hu : SuppBetween l.toFinset (j :: l).toFinset (h j p x) := by
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hx _ hi
      rw [im_cons] at h₁ h₂
      refine ⟨fun t ht ↦ ?_, (Finset.subset_insert _ _).trans h₂⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (h₁ (hTT ht)) with rfl | h
      · exact absurd (List.mem_toFinset.mp ht) hj
      · exact h
    have hw : SuppEq l.toFinset (res l.toFinset p (h j p x)) := hu.map_res
    have h₃ : SuppEq l.toFinset
        (G l p (res l.toFinset (p + 1) (D (j :: l).toFinset p (h j p x)))) :=
      ih hl' p (by rw [List.length_cons] at hp; omega) _ hu.map_D.map_res
    have h₂ : SuppBetween l.toFinset (j :: l).toFinset
        (corr (j :: l).toFinset (G l) p (res l.toFinset p (h j p x))) := by
      cases p with
      | zero => exact SuppBetween.zero _ _ _
      | succ p =>
        rw [corr_succ]
        exact ((ih hl' p (by rw [List.length_cons] at hp; omega) _ hw).mono_right hTT).map_D
    have hG : SuppBetween l.toFinset (j :: l).toFinset (G (j :: l) p x) := by
      rw [G_cons]
      exact (hu.sub h₂).sub (h₃.mono_right hTT)
    have hG₀ : res l.toFinset p (G (j :: l) p x) = 0 := by
      rw [G_cons, map_sub, map_sub, h₃.res_eq]
      cases p with
      | zero =>
        have hl0 : l = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by rw [List.length_cons] at hp; omega)
        subst hl0
        have := suppEq_empty hw
        simp only [List.toFinset_nil] at this ⊢
        simp [this, corr]
      | succ p =>
        rw [corr_succ, res_D hTT, (ih hl' p (by rw [List.length_cons] at hp; omega) _ hw).res_eq,
          res_D hTT]
        rw [sub_sub, D_G_add_G_D l hl' p _ hw, sub_self]
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hG i hi
    refine ⟨?_, h₂⟩
    have hji : j ∈ im i := by
      by_contra hji
      refine hi ?_
      have h₄ : im i ⊆ l.toFinset := by
        intro t ht
        have := h₂ ht
        rw [hT, Finset.mem_insert] at this
        rcases this with rfl | h
        · exact absurd ht hji
        · exact h
      simpa [h₄] using congrFun hG₀ i
    rw [hT]
    exact Finset.insert_subset hji h₁

name: SimplexCochain.res_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_map (φ : M →+ M') (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    res T p (map φ p x) = map φ p (res T p x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : im i ⊆ T <;> simp [hi]

name: SimplexCochain.D_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma D_map (φ : M →+ M') (T : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    D T p (map φ p x) = map φ (p + 1) (D T p x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [D_apply]

name: SimplexCochain.G_map
statement:
lemma G_map (φ : M →+ M') (l : List ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) :
    G l p (map φ (p + 1) x) = map φ p (G l p x)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j l ih =>
    rw [G_cons, G_cons]
    cases p with
    | zero => simp [ih, corr]
    | succ p => simp [ih, corr_succ]

name: SimplexCochain.homotopyN_map
statement:
lemma homotopyN_map {M' : Type w} [AddCommGroup M'] (φ : M →+ M') (N : Finset ι) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) : homotopyN N p (map φ (p + 1) x) = map φ p (homotopyN N p x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold homotopyN
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact G_map φ _ p x

name: SimplexCochain.d_homotopyN_add
statement:
lemma d_homotopyN_add (N : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1))
    (hx : SuppBetween N Finset.univ x) :
    d p (homotopyN N p x) + homotopyN N (p + 1) (d (p + 1) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold homotopyN
  split_ifs with hN
  · exact d_h_add_h_d _ p x
  · push Not at hN
    obtain rfl : N = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_forall hN
    have := D_G_add_G_D (M := M) Finset.univ.toList (Finset.nodup_toList _) p x
      (by rwa [Finset.toList_toFinset])
    simpa only [Finset.toList_toFinset, D_univ] using this

name: SimplexCochain.suppBetween_homotopyN
statement:
lemma suppBetween_homotopyN (N : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1))
    (hx : SuppBetween N Finset.univ x) (hp : Fintype.card ι ≤ p + 1 ∨ (N = Finset.univ → x = 0)) :
    SuppBetween N Finset.univ (homotopyN N p x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold homotopyN
  split_ifs with hN
  · intro i hi
    refine ⟨fun t ht ↦ ?_, Finset.subset_univ _⟩
    have := (hx _ hi).1 ht
    rw [im_cons, Finset.mem_insert] at this
    rcases this with rfl | h
    · exact absurd ht hN.choose_spec
    · exact h
  · push Not at hN
    obtain rfl : N = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_forall hN
    rcases hp with hp | hp
    · have := suppEq_G (M := M) Finset.univ.toList (Finset.nodup_toList _) p
        (by rwa [Finset.length_toList]) x (by rwa [Finset.toList_toFinset])
      rwa [Finset.toList_toFinset] at this
    · rw [hp rfl, map_zero]
      exact SuppBetween.zero _ _ _

name: SimplexCochain.homotopyN_eq_sum
statement:
lemma homotopyN_eq_sum (N : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) :
    homotopyN N p x i =
      ∑ i' : Fin (p + 2) → ι, homotopyN N p (Pi.single i' (1 : ℤ)) i • x i'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x = ∑ i' : Fin (p + 2) → ι,
      map (zmultiplesHom M (x i')) (p + 1) (Pi.single i' (1 : ℤ)) := by
    ext i''
    simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  simp only [map_sum, homotopyN_map, Finset.sum_apply, map_apply, zmultiplesHom_apply]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.IsAdmissible.suppBetween
statement:
lemma IsAdmissible.suppBetween {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : π.IsAdmissible x)
    (N : Finset ι) : SuppBetween N Finset.univ (map (π.proj N) p x)
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ ⟨by_contra fun h ↦ hi (hx i N h), Finset.subset_univ _⟩

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.sum_map_proj
statement: lemma sum_map_proj {p : ℕ} (x : Cochain ι M p) : ∑ N, map (π.proj N) p x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Finset.sum_apply, π.sum_proj]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.map_proj_map_proj
statement:
lemma map_proj_map_proj (N N' : Finset ι) {p : ℕ} (x : Cochain ι M p) :
    map (π.proj N) p (map (π.proj N') p x) = if N = N' then map (π.proj N) p x else 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [π.proj_proj, h]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.isAdmissible_d
statement:
lemma isAdmissible_d {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : π.IsAdmissible x) :
    π.IsAdmissible (d p x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i N hN
  rw [d_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_zsmul, hx _ N fun h ↦ hN (h.trans (im_comp_subset i _)), smul_zero]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.proj_univ_eq_zero
statement:
lemma proj_univ_eq_zero {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M p} (hx : π.IsAdmissible x)
    (hp : p + 1 < Fintype.card ι) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) : π.proj Finset.univ (x i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hx i _ fun h ↦ ?_
  have := Finset.card_le_card h
  rw [Finset.card_univ] at this
  exact absurd ((this.trans (card_im_le i)).trans_lt hp) (lt_irrefl _)

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.homotopy_apply
statement:
lemma homotopy_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) :
    π.homotopy p x = ∑ N, homotopyN N p (map (π.proj N) (p + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [homotopy]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.proj_homotopy
statement:
lemma proj_homotopy (N : Finset ι) (p : ℕ) (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (i : Fin (p + 1) → ι) :
    π.proj N (π.homotopy p x i) = homotopyN N p (map (π.proj N) (p + 1) x) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_apply (π.proj N) p, homotopy_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [← homotopyN_map, map_proj_map_proj]
  simp [Finset.sum_apply, apply_ite, ite_apply]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.d_homotopy_add
statement:
theorem d_homotopy_add {p : ℕ} (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (hx : π.IsAdmissible x) :
    d p (π.homotopy p x) + π.homotopy (p + 1) (d (p + 1) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy_apply, homotopy_apply, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  conv_rhs => rw [← π.sum_map_proj x]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← d_map, d_homotopyN_add N p _ (hx.suppBetween π N)]

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.isAdmissible_homotopy
statement:
theorem isAdmissible_homotopy {p : ℕ} {x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)} (hx : π.IsAdmissible x)
    (hp : Fintype.card ι ≤ p + 1 ∨ ∀ i, π.proj Finset.univ (x i) = 0) :
    π.IsAdmissible (π.homotopy p x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i N hN
  rw [proj_homotopy]
  have hs := suppBetween_homotopyN N p _ (hx.suppBetween π N) (by
    refine hp.imp id fun hp hN ↦ ?_
    subst hN
    ext i
    exact hp i)
  by_contra h
  exact hN (hs i h).1

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.homotopy_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine sum_mem fun N _ ↦ ?_
  have : map (π.proj N) (p + 1) x =
      map S.subtype (p + 1) (fun i ↦ ⟨π.proj N (x i), hS N _ (hx i)⟩) := rfl
  rw [this, homotopyN_map]
  exact SetLike.coe_mem _

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.exists_eq_d
statement:
theorem exists_eq_d (S : AddSubgroup M) (hS : ∀ N, ∀ m ∈ S, π.proj N m ∈ S) {p : ℕ}
    (x : Cochain ι M (p + 1)) (hx : π.IsAdmissible x) (hxS : ∀ i, x i ∈ S)
    (hdx : d (p + 1) x = 0)
    (hp : Fintype.card ι ≤ p + 1 ∨ ∀ i, π.proj Finset.univ (x i) = 0) :
    ∃ y : Cochain ι M p, π.IsAdmissible y ∧ (∀ i, y i ∈ S) ∧ d p y = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨π.homotopy p x, π.isAdmissible_homotopy hx hp, π.homotopy_mem S hS hxS, ?_⟩
  simpa [hdx] using π.d_homotopy_add x hx

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.isAdmissible_aug
statement: lemma isAdmissible_aug {v : M} (hv : π.proj ∅ v = v) : π.IsAdmissible (aug (ι := ι) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro i N hN
  have hN' : N ≠ ∅ := by rintro rfl; exact hN (Finset.empty_subset _)
  rw [aug_apply, ← hv, π.proj_proj, if_neg hN']

name: SimplexCochain.Grading.exists_eq_aug
statement:
theorem exists_eq_aug [Nonempty ι] (x : Cochain ι M 0) (hx : π.IsAdmissible x)
    (hdx : d 0 x = 0) (huniv : ∀ i, π.proj Finset.univ (x i) = 0) :
    ∃ v, π.proj ∅ v = v ∧ x = aug v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
  refine ⟨π.proj ∅ (x fun _ ↦ j₀), by rw [π.proj_proj, if_pos rfl], ?_⟩
  have key (N : Finset ι) : map (π.proj N) 0 x =
      if N = ∅ then aug (π.proj ∅ (x fun _ ↦ j₀)) else 0 := by
    have hd : d 0 (map (π.proj N) 0 x) = 0 := by rw [d_map, hdx, map_zero]
    split_ifs with hN
    · subst hN
      rw [← aug_add_h_d j₀ (map (π.proj ∅) 0 x), hd, map_zero, add_zero, map_apply]
    · by_cases hj : ∃ j, j ∉ N
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hj
        rw [← aug_add_h_d j (map (π.proj N) 0 x), hd, map_zero, add_zero, map_apply]
        rw [hx _ N, map_zero]
        intro h
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hN
        have := h ht
        simp only [im, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at this
        obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := this
        exact hj ht
      · push Not at hj
        obtain rfl : N = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_forall hj
        ext i
        exact huniv i
  conv_lhs => rw [← π.sum_map_proj x]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N _ ↦ key N, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  simp

name: ImplicitFunctionData.injOn_rightFun_levelSet
statement:
theorem injOn_rightFun_levelSet :
    Set.InjOn φ.rightFun
      (φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source ∩ {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt})
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxs, hxl⟩ y ⟨hys, hyl⟩ hxy
  refine φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.injOn hxs hys ?_
  rw [φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply, φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply, hxl, hyl, hxy]

name: ImplicitFunctionData.isOpen_image_rightFun_levelSet
statement:
theorem isOpen_image_rightFun_levelSet {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hsub : s ⊆ φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source) :
    IsOpen (φ.rightFun '' (s ∩ {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt}))
proof:
:= by
  have himg : φ.rightFun '' (s ∩ {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt}) =
      (fun y ↦ (φ.leftFun φ.pt, y)) ⁻¹' (φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph '' s) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hzs, hzl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, hzs, by rw [φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply, hzl]⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hzs, hz⟩
      rw [φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply] at hz
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hzs, (congrArg Prod.fst hz : _)⟩, congrArg Prod.snd hz⟩
  rw [himg]
  exact (φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hs hsub).preimage (by fun_prop)

name: isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] {g : T → (ι → 𝕜)} (hg : Topology.IsEmbedding g)
    (he : ∀ i, i ≠ j → i ∈ Set.range e) (hj : j ∉ Set.range e)
    (hrange : Set.range g = {z | f z = c})
    (hf : ∀ z, f z = c → HasStrictFDerivAt f (f' z) z)
    (hne : ∀ z, f z = c → f' z (Pi.single j 1) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph fun x ↦ g x ∘ e
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  haveI : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  rw [isLocalHomeomorph_iff_isOpenEmbedding_restrict]
  intro x
  have hmem : ∀ y : T, f (g y) = c := fun y ↦ by
    have hy : g y ∈ {z | f z = c} := hrange ▸ Set.mem_range_self y
    exact hy
  set φ := ImplicitFunctionData.ofCoordProj he hj (hf _ (hmem x)) (hne _ (hmem x)) with hφ
  have hlevel : {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt} = {z | f z = c} := by
    ext z; simp [hφ, hmem x]
  set U : Set T := g ⁻¹' φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source with hU
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.open_source.preimage hg.continuous
  have hxU : x ∈ U := φ.pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hsub : ∀ y ∈ U, g y ∈ φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source ∩
      {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt} := fun y hy ↦ ⟨hy, by rw [hlevel]; exact hmem y⟩
  refine ⟨U, hUopen.mem_nhds hxU, ?_⟩
  refine IsOpenEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap
    ((continuous_pi fun k ↦ (continuous_apply (e k)).comp hg.continuous).comp
      continuous_subtype_val) ?_ ?_
  · intro y y' hyy'
    exact Subtype.ext (hg.injective
      (φ.injOn_rightFun_levelSet (hsub y y.2) (hsub y' y'.2) hyy'))
  · intro W hW
    obtain ⟨W', hW'open, rfl⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.1 hW
    have himg : U.restrict (fun t ↦ g t ∘ e) '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' W') =
        (fun t ↦ g t ∘ e) '' (U ∩ W') := by
      rw [Set.restrict_eq, Set.image_comp, Subtype.image_preimage_coe]
    rw [himg]
    obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀open, hW₀⟩ := hg.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 (hUopen.inter hW'open)
    have hgV : g '' (U ∩ W') = W₀ ∩ Set.range g := by
      rw [← hW₀, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range]
    have hgVsub : g '' (U ∩ W') ⊆ φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact (hsub y hy.1).1
    have hset : (W₀ ∩ φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source) ∩
        {z | φ.leftFun z = φ.leftFun φ.pt} = g '' (U ∩ W') := by
      rw [hgV, hlevel, hrange]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hzW, _⟩, hzl⟩; exact ⟨hzW, hzl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hzW, hzl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hzW, hgVsub (by rw [hgV, hrange]; exact ⟨hzW, hzl⟩)⟩, hzl⟩
    have himg2 : (fun t ↦ g t ∘ e) '' (U ∩ W') = φ.rightFun '' (g '' (U ∩ W')) := by
      rw [← Set.image_comp]; rfl
    rw [himg2, ← hset]
    exact φ.isOpen_image_rightFun_levelSet
      (hW₀open.inter φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.open_source) Set.inter_subset_right

name: isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding_inter
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding_inter
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] {g : T → (ι → 𝕜)} {Ω : Set (ι → 𝕜)}
    (hg : Topology.IsEmbedding g) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (he : ∀ i, i ≠ j → i ∈ Set.range e) (hj : j ∉ Set.range e)
    (hrange : Set.range g = {z | f z = c} ∩ Ω)
    (hf : ∀ z ∈ Ω, f z = c → HasStrictFDerivAt f (f' z) z)
    (hne : ∀ z ∈ Ω, f z = c → f' z (Pi.single j 1) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph fun x ↦ g x ∘ e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : c + 1 ≠ c := by simp
  set F : (ι → 𝕜) → 𝕜 := fun z ↦ if z ∈ Ω then f z else c + 1 with hF
  have hFlevel : {z | F z = c} = {z | f z = c} ∩ Ω := by
    ext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Ω <;> simp [hF, hz, hc]
  have hFeq : ∀ z ∈ Ω, F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f := fun z hz ↦
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hz) fun y hy ↦ by simp [hF, hy]
  refine isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding (f := F) (f' := f') (c := c) hg he hj
    (by rw [hrange, hFlevel]) (fun z hz ↦ ?_) fun z hz ↦ ?_
  · obtain ⟨hzl, hzΩ⟩ : z ∈ {z | f z = c} ∩ Ω := hFlevel ▸ (show z ∈ {z | F z = c} from hz)
    exact (hf z hzΩ hzl).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hFeq z hzΩ).symm
  · obtain ⟨hzl, hzΩ⟩ : z ∈ {z | f z = c} ∩ Ω := hFlevel ▸ (show z ∈ {z | F z = c} from hz)
    exact hne z hzΩ hzl

name: isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_levelSet
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_levelSet
    (he : ∀ i, i ≠ j → i ∈ Set.range e) (hj : j ∉ Set.range e)
    (hf : ∀ z, f z = c → HasStrictFDerivAt f (f' z) z)
    (hne : ∀ z, f z = c → f' z (Pi.single j 1) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph fun z : ↥{z : ι → 𝕜 | f z = c} ↦ (z : ι → 𝕜) ∘ e
proof:
:=
  isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal he hj
    Subtype.range_coe hf hne

name: isClosedMap_npow
statement:
theorem isClosedMap_npow (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    IsClosedMap fun x : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0} ↦ (⟨x ^ n, pow_ne_zero n x.2⟩ : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  intro C hC
  rw [isClosed_induced_iff] at hC
  obtain ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩ := hC
  rw [isClosed_induced_iff]
  refine ⟨(fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x ^ n) '' D, isClosedMap_pow 𝕜 n D hD, ?_⟩
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hdD, hdw⟩
    have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact w.2 (by simpa [hn] using hdw.symm)
    exact ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, hdD, Subtype.ext hdw⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hcD, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c.1, hcD, rfl⟩

name: finite_fiber_npow
statement:
theorem finite_fiber_npow (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (w : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0}) :
    Finite ((fun x : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0} ↦ (⟨x ^ n, pow_ne_zero n x.2⟩ : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0})) ⁻¹'
      {w})
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (X ^ n - C (w : 𝕜)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hc := congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · n) h
    simp [coeff_X_pow, coeff_C, hn] at hc
  haveI := (finite_setOf_isRoot hp).to_subtype
  have hmem : ∀ p : ((fun x : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0} ↦
      (⟨x ^ n, pow_ne_zero n x.2⟩ : {x : 𝕜 // x ≠ 0})) ⁻¹' {w}),
      (p.1 : 𝕜) ∈ {x : 𝕜 | (X ^ n - C (w : 𝕜)).IsRoot x} := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp'⟩
    have hpw : (p : 𝕜) ^ n = (w : 𝕜) := congrArg Subtype.val hp'
    simpa [Set.mem_setOf_eq, IsRoot.def, sub_eq_zero] using hpw
  refine Finite.of_injective (fun p ↦ (⟨(p.1 : 𝕜), hmem p⟩ : {x : 𝕜 | _})) ?_
  intro a b hab
  simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at hab
  exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hab)
