name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.ι_glueMorphismsOfGlueData
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ι_glueMorphismsOfGlueData (D : LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.{u})
    (α : ∀ j, ℂ →+* (D.U j).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (hα : GlueDataCLinear D α)
    (hlm : ∀ j, HasLocalModels (D.U j) (α j)) {Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}}
    (f : ∀ j, D.U j ⟶ Y.toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (hf : ∀ i j, D.f i j ≫ f i = D.t i j ≫ D.f j i ≫ f j)
    (hlin : ∀ j, IsCLinearHom (f j) (α j) Y.algebraMap) (j : D.J) :
    D.toGlueData.ι j ≫ (glueMorphismsOfGlueData D α hα hlm f hf hlin).toLRSHom = f j
proof:
:=
  D.openCover.ι_glueMorphisms f (D.pullback_condition_of_comm f hf) j

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.pullback_compat_of_restrictLE
statement:
theorem pullback_compat_of_restrictLE {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (φ : ∀ i, X.restrict (U i) ⟶ Y)
    (hφ : ∀ i j, X.restrictLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i) ≫ φ i =
      X.restrictLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j) ≫ φ j) (i j : ι) :
    Limits.pullback.fst (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding)
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict (U j).isOpenEmbedding) ≫ (φ i).toLRSHom =
      Limits.pullback.snd (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding)
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict (U j).isOpenEmbedding) ≫ (φ j).toLRSHom
proof:
:=
  (cancel_epi (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictInfIsoPullback (U i) (U j)).hom).mp
    ((LocallyRingedSpace.restrictInfIsoPullback_hom_fst_assoc _ _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom (hφ i j)).trans
        (LocallyRingedSpace.restrictInfIsoPullback_hom_snd_assoc _ _ _ _).symm))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.ofRestrict_comp_glueMorphismsOfOpens
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofRestrict_comp_glueMorphismsOfOpens (φ : ∀ i, X.restrict (U i) ⟶ Y)
    (hφ : ∀ i j, X.restrictLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i) ≫ φ i =
      X.restrictLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j) ≫ φ j) (i : ι) :
    X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ glueMorphismsOfOpens U hU φ hφ = φ i
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
    (ι_glueMorphisms (LocallyRingedSpace.openCoverOfOpens U hU) _ _ _ i)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_of_opens
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_opens {φ ψ : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ i, X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ φ = X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
    ((LocallyRingedSpace.openCoverOfOpens U hU).hom_ext _ _
      (fun i ↦ congrArg AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom (h i)))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.existsUnique_glueMorphismsOfOpens
statement:
theorem existsUnique_glueMorphismsOfOpens (φ : ∀ i, X.restrict (U i) ⟶ Y)
    (hφ : ∀ i j, X.restrictLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i) ≫ φ i =
      X.restrictLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j) ≫ φ j) :
    ∃! ψ : X ⟶ Y, ∀ i, X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ ψ = φ i
proof:
:=
  ⟨glueMorphismsOfOpens U hU φ hφ, ofRestrict_comp_glueMorphismsOfOpens U hU φ hφ,
    fun _ hψ ↦ hom_ext_of_opens U hU
      (fun i ↦ (hψ i).trans (ofRestrict_comp_glueMorphismsOfOpens U hU φ hφ i).symm)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.hasHartogsExtension_of_local
statement:
theorem hasHartogsExtension_of_local {O : Z.Opens}
    (h : ∀ Ω : Z.Opens, ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ (B : Z.Opens) (_ : B ≤ Ω), x ∈ B ∧
      Function.Bijective (Z.res (inf_le_left : B ⊓ O ≤ B))) :
    HasHartogsExtension Z O
proof:
:= by
  
  have hinj : ∀ Ω : Z.Opens, Function.Injective (Z.res (inf_le_left : Ω ⊓ O ≤ Ω)) := by
    intro Ω s t hst
    refine res_eq_of_locally fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨B, hBΩ, hxB, hB⟩ := h Ω x hx
    refine ⟨B, hBΩ, hxB, hB.1 ?_⟩
    have hle : B ⊓ O ≤ Ω ⊓ O := inf_le_inf_right O hBΩ
    rw [res_res, res_res, ← res_res _ hle inf_le_left, ← res_res _ hle inf_le_left t, hst]
  intro Ω
  refine ⟨hinj Ω, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have hloc : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ (B : Z.Opens) (hBΩ : B ≤ Ω), x ∈ B ∧ ∃ u : Z.presheaf.obj (op B),
      Z.res (inf_le_left : B ⊓ O ≤ B) u = Z.res (inf_le_inf_right O hBΩ) s := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨B, hBΩ, hxB, hB⟩ := h Ω x hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hB.2 (Z.res (inf_le_inf_right O hBΩ) s)
    exact ⟨B, hBΩ, hxB, u, hu⟩
  choose B hBΩ hxB u hu using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_sectRes_eq_of_locally (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringSheaf) B hBΩ hxB u
    fun x hx x' hx' ↦ by
      refine hinj (B x hx ⊓ B x' hx') ?_
      refine (res_res _ _ _ _).trans (Eq.trans ?_ (res_res _ _ _ _).symm)
      have h₁ : B x hx ⊓ B x' hx' ⊓ O ≤ B x hx ⊓ O := inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left
      have h₂ : B x hx ⊓ B x' hx' ⊓ O ≤ B x' hx' ⊓ O := inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right
      refine (res_res _ h₁ inf_le_left _).symm.trans ?_
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (res_res _ h₂ inf_le_left _)
      rw [hu, hu, res_res, res_res]
  refine ⟨t, res_eq_of_locally fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  refine ⟨B y hy.1 ⊓ O, inf_le_inf_right O (hBΩ y hy.1), ⟨hxB y hy.1, hy.2⟩, ?_⟩
  refine (res_res _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  have h₁ : B y hy.1 ⊓ O ≤ B y hy.1 := inf_le_left
  refine (res_res _ h₁ (hBΩ y hy.1) t).symm.trans ?_
  change Z.res h₁ (sectRes (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringSheaf) (hBΩ y hy.1) t) = _
  rw [ht, hu]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.HasHartogsExtension.mono
statement:
theorem HasHartogsExtension.mono {O O' : Z.Opens} (h : HasHartogsExtension Z O) (hO : O ≤ O') :
    HasHartogsExtension Z O'
proof:
:= by
  intro Ω
  have hle : Ω ⊓ O ≤ Ω ⊓ O' := inf_le_inf_left Ω hO
  refine ⟨fun s t hst ↦ (h Ω).1 ?_, fun s' ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← res_res _ hle inf_le_left, ← res_res _ hle inf_le_left t, hst]
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (h Ω).2 (Z.res hle s')
    refine ⟨t, (h (Ω ⊓ O')).1 ?_⟩
    have h₁ : Ω ⊓ O' ⊓ O ≤ Ω ⊓ O := inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_left
    rw [res_res, ← res_res _ h₁ inf_le_left, ht, res_res]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.bijective_res_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem bijective_res_of_disjoint {O W B B' : Z.Opens} (hB : B ≤ W) (hB' : B' ≤ W)
    (hW : W ≤ B ⊔ B') (hdisj : B ⊓ B' = ⊥)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (Z.res (inf_le_left : W ⊓ O ≤ W))) :
    Function.Bijective (Z.res (inf_le_left : B ⊓ O ≤ B))
proof:
:= by
  let N := SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringSheaf
  let P : Bool → Z.Opens := fun i ↦ if i then B else B'
  have hP : ∀ i, P i ≤ W := fun i ↦ by cases i <;> simp [P, hB, hB']
  have hPW : W ≤ ⨆ i, P i := hW.trans (sup_le (le_iSup P true) (le_iSup P false))
  have hPdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i ⊓ P j = ⊥ := by
    intro i j hij
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp_all [P, inf_comm]
  let PO : Bool → Z.Opens := fun i ↦ P i ⊓ O
  have hPO : ∀ i, PO i ≤ W ⊓ O := fun i ↦ inf_le_inf_right O (hP i)
  have hPOW : W ⊓ O ≤ ⨆ i, PO i := fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 (hPW hx.1)
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨i, hi, hx.2⟩
  have hPOdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → PO i ⊓ PO j = ⊥ := fun i j hij ↦
    eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ (hPdisj i j hij).le ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2.1⟩
  constructor
  · suffices hker : ∀ s, Z.res (inf_le_left : B ⊓ O ≤ B) s = 0 → s = 0 from fun s s' h ↦
      sub_eq_zero.1 (hker _ ((map_sub _ _ _).trans (sub_eq_zero.2 h)))
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := exists_extend_zero N P hP hPW hPdisj true s
    have ht0 : Z.res (inf_le_left : W ⊓ O ≤ W) t = 0 := by
      refine sectRes_ext N PO hPO hPOW _ 0 fun i ↦ ?_
      change Z.res _ (Z.res _ t) = Z.res _ 0
      rw [res_zero, res_res]
      cases i
      · rw [← res_res _ (inf_le_left : PO false ≤ P false) (hP false)]
        change Z.res _ (sectRes N (hP false) t) = 0
        rw [ht' false Bool.false_ne_true]
        exact map_zero _
      · rw [← res_res _ (inf_le_left : PO true ≤ P true) (hP true)]
        change Z.res _ (sectRes N (hP true) t) = 0
        rw [ht]
        exact hs
    rw [← ht, (hres.1 (ht0.trans (res_zero _ _).symm) : t = 0)]
    exact res_zero _ _
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := exists_extend_zero N PO hPO hPOW hPOdisj true s
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hres.2 t
    refine ⟨Z.res hB w, (res_res _ _ _ _).trans ?_⟩
    refine (res_res _ (hPO true) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ O ≤ W) w).symm.trans ?_
    rw [hw]
    exact ht

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.hasHartogsExtension_of_isFinite
statement:
theorem hasHartogsExtension_of_isFinite {X' S : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (q : X' ⟶ S) [IsFinite q]
    [T2Space X'] (O : S.Opens)
    (h : ∀ V : S.Opens, Function.Bijective (X'.res (inf_le_left :
      (Opens.map q.toLRSHom.base).obj V ⊓ (Opens.map q.toLRSHom.base).obj O ≤
        (Opens.map q.toLRSHom.base).obj V))) :
    HasHartogsExtension X' ((Opens.map q.toLRSHom.base).obj O)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine hasHartogsExtension_of_local fun Ω x hx ↦ ?_
  haveI : Finite (q.toLRSHom.base ⁻¹' {q.toLRSHom.base x}) := IsFinite.finite_fiber _
  obtain ⟨V, P, -, -, hxP, hPU, hPV, hdisj, hcov⟩ := Hom.exists_fibre_cover q.toLRSHom
    IsFinite.isClosedMap (y := q.toLRSHom.base x) (Set.toFinite _) (W := ⊤) trivial
    (fun x' ↦ if x'.1 = x then Ω else ⊤) fun x' ↦ by
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [h]
        exact hx
      · trivial
  let x₀ : q.toLRSHom.base ⁻¹' {q.toLRSHom.base x} := ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hBΩ : P x₀ ≤ Ω := (hPU x₀).trans (by simp [x₀])
  refine ⟨P x₀, hBΩ, hxP x₀, ?_⟩
  refine bijective_res_of_disjoint (hPV x₀) (B' := ⨆ x' : {x' // x' ≠ x₀}, P x'.1)
    (iSup_le fun x' ↦ hPV x'.1) (fun z hz ↦ ?_) ?_ (h V)
  · obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 (hcov hz)
    by_cases hx'₀ : x' = x₀
    · subst hx'₀
      exact Or.inl hx'
    · exact Or.inr (Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨x', hx'₀⟩, hx'⟩)
  · refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun z hz ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hz.2
    exact ((hdisj x₀ x'.1 (Ne.symm x'.2)).le ⟨hz.1, hx'⟩)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.mem_nonvanishingOpens_iff
statement:
lemma mem_nonvanishingOpens_iff (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (g h : Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (z : Z) :
    z ∈ nonvanishingOpens Z g h ↔
      ¬ (Z.eval (U := ⊤) z trivial g = 0 ∧ Z.eval (U := ⊤) z trivial h = 0)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.eval_res
statement:
lemma eval_res {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ V) (s : X.presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    X.eval y hy (X.res h s) = X.eval y (h hy) s
proof:
:=
  eval_map_homOfLE h hy s

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_smul_mgerm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_mgerm_eq_zero [M.IsCoherent] {T : Set X} {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V)
    (hVW : ∀ y ∈ V, y ∉ T → y ∈ W) (s : M.val.obj (op V)) (hs : modRes s W hWV = 0)
    {U : X.Opens} (g : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) (hgT : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0)
    {z : X} (hzU : z ∈ U) (hzV : z ∈ V) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g ^ N • mgerm M V z hzV s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁V, k, a, hzW₁, hrel, hgen⟩ :=
    hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent M V 1 (fun _ ↦ s) z hzV
  
  have hoff : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W₁), y ∉ T → ∃ l, X.eval y hy (a l 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hyT
    have hyW : y ∈ W := hVW y (hW₁V hy) hyT
    obtain ⟨W₂, hW₂, hyW₂, c, hc⟩ := hgen (W₁ ⊓ W) inf_le_left (fun _ ↦ 1) (by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one, one_smul]
      rw [← sectRes_sectRes M (inf_le_right : W₁ ⊓ W ≤ W) hWV]
      change sectRes M _ (modRes s W hWV) = 0
      rw [hs]
      exact sectRes_zero M _) y ⟨hy, hyW⟩
    by_contra! H
    have := congrArg (X.eval y hyW₂) (hc 0)
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ ↦ ?_] at this
    · exact one_ne_zero ((map_one _).symm.trans ((eval_res _ _ _).symm.trans this))
    · rw [eval_res, H l, mul_zero]
  
  have hzWn : z ∈ W₁ ⊓ U := ⟨hzW₁, hzU⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := X.isNullstellensatzAt z (W₁ ⊓ U) hzWn
    (fun l ↦ X.res inf_le_left (a l 0)) (X.res inf_le_right g)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun y hy hall ↦ by
      rw [eval_res]
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
      · exact hgT y _ hyT
      · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hoff y hy.1 hyT
        exact absurd ((eval_res _ _ _).symm.trans (hall l)) hl)
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  have hg : X.presheaf.germ (W₁ ⊓ U) z hzWn (X.res inf_le_right g) =
      X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [hg] at hN
  
  have hker : Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ X.presheaf.germ (W₁ ⊓ U) z hzWn
      (X.res inf_le_left (a l 0))) ≤
        (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (X.presheaf.stalk z) _ (mgerm M V z hzV s)).ker := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    have h1 : X.presheaf.germ (W₁ ⊓ U) z hzWn (X.res inf_le_left (a l 0)) =
        X.presheaf.germ W₁ z hzW₁ (a l 0) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
    change X.presheaf.germ (W₁ ⊓ U) z hzWn (X.res inf_le_left (a l 0)) • mgerm M V z hzV s = 0
    rw [h1, ← mgerm_modRes hW₁V z hzW₁ s, ← mgerm_smul]
    have := hrel l
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one] at this
    exact (congrArg _ this).trans (mgerm_zero _ _ _)
  have := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hker hN)
  rwa [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at this

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.eq_zero_of_isSMulRegular
proof:
:= by
  have hgerm : ∀ z (hz : z ∈ V), mgerm M V z hz s = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨U, hzU, g, hgT, hreg⟩ := hT z hzT
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_pow_smul_mgerm_eq_zero M hWV hVW s hs g hgT hzU hz
      exact (hreg.pow N).right_eq_zero_of_smul hN
    · rw [← mgerm_modRes hWV z (hVW z hz hzT) s, hs]
      exact mgerm_zero _ _ _
  choose O hOV hzO hO using fun z : V ↦
    exists_modRes_eq_zero_of_mgerm_eq_zero (N := M) z.1 z.2 s (hgerm z.1 z.2)
  exact modRes_eq_of_cover M O (fun z hz ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hzO ⟨z, hz⟩⟩) hOV s 0
    fun a ↦ (hO a).trans (modRes_zero _).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular [M.IsCoherent] {T : Set X}
    (hT : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hzU : z ∈ U) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op U)),
      (∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0) ∧
      IsSMulRegular ((X.stalkFunctor z).obj M) (X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g))
    {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (hVW : ∀ y ∈ V, y ∉ T → y ∈ W) :
    Function.Injective fun s : M.val.obj (op V) ↦ modRes s W hWV
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_isSMulRegular hT hWV hVW ?_
  exact (map_sub (M.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom s t).trans (sub_eq_zero.mpr hst)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.modRes_eq_of_modRes_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← modRes_res hA hBA, h, modRes_res]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.bijective_restrict_of_forall_exists_extend
statement:
theorem bijective_restrict_of_forall_exists_extend [M.IsCoherent] {T : Set X} (O : X.Opens)
    (hO : (O : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    (hT : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hzU : z ∈ U) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op U)),
      (∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0) ∧
      IsSMulRegular ((X.stalkFunctor z).obj M) (X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g))
    (hext : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ V : X.Opens, z ∈ V → ∃ W : X.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ z ∈ W ∧
      ∀ s : M.val.obj (op (W ⊓ O)), ∃ t : M.val.obj (op W), modRes t (W ⊓ O) inf_le_left = s)
    (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective fun t : M.val.obj (op V) ↦ modRes t (V ⊓ O) inf_le_left
proof:
:= by
  have hVO : ∀ {V : X.Opens}, ∀ y ∈ V, y ∉ T → y ∈ V ⊓ O := fun y hy hyT ↦
    ⟨hy, by rw [hO]; exact hyT⟩
  refine ⟨injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular hT inf_le_left fun y hy hyT ↦ hVO y hy hyT,
    fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have hloc : ∀ z : V, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), z.1 ∈ W ∧ ∃ t : M.val.obj (op W),
      modRes t (W ⊓ O) inf_le_left = modRes s (W ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O hWV) := by
    intro z
    by_cases hzT : z.1 ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨W, hWV, hzW, hW⟩ := hext z.1 hzT V z.2
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hW (modRes s (W ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O hWV))
      exact ⟨W, hWV, hzW, t, ht⟩
    · exact ⟨V ⊓ O, inf_le_left, hVO z.1 z.2 hzT, s, rfl⟩
  choose W hWV hzW t ht using hloc
  
  have hglue : ∀ a b, modRes (t a) (W a ⊓ W b) inf_le_left =
      modRes (t b) (W a ⊓ W b) inf_le_right := by
    intro a b
    refine injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular hT (V := W a ⊓ W b) (W := W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O)
      inf_le_left (fun y hy hyT ↦ hVO y hy hyT) ?_
    simp only [modRes_res]
    exact (modRes_eq_of_modRes_eq (ht a) (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_left)).trans
      (modRes_eq_of_modRes_eq (ht b) (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_right)).symm
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := modRes_existsUnique_gluing M W
    (fun z hz ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hzW ⟨z, hz⟩⟩) hWV t hglue
  refine ⟨u, modRes_eq_of_cover M (fun z ↦ W z ⊓ O)
    (fun y (hy : y ∈ V ⊓ O) ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy.1⟩, hzW ⟨y, hy.1⟩, hy.2⟩)
    (fun z ↦ inf_le_inf_right O (hWV z)) _ s fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [modRes_res]
  rw [← modRes_res (hWV z) inf_le_left, hu z, ht z]

name: RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.exists_eq_smul_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.exists_eq_smul_of_smul_eq
    (H : IsWeaklyRegular M [g, h]) {m m' : M} (e : h • m = g • m') : ∃ m'', m = g • m''
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff, isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff] at H
  obtain ⟨-, H, -⟩ := H
  have hmem : ∀ x : M, Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := g • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) x = 0 ↔
      ∃ m'', x = g • m'' := fun x ↦ by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    simp [eq_comm]
  refine (hmem m).1 (H.right_eq_zero_of_smul ?_)
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, e]
  exact (hmem _).2 ⟨m', rfl⟩

name: RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.exists_eq_pow_smul_of_pow_smul_eq
statement:
theorem RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.exists_eq_pow_smul_of_pow_smul_eq
    (H : IsWeaklyRegular M [g, h]) (a b : ℕ) {m m' : M} (e : h ^ b • m = g ^ a • m') :
    ∃ m'', m = g ^ a • m''
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IsSMulRegular M g := ((isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff M g [h]).1 H).1
  
  have h1 : ∀ (b : ℕ) (m m' : M), h ^ b • m = g • m' → ∃ m'', m = g • m'' := by
    intro b
    induction b with
    | zero => exact fun m m' e ↦ ⟨m', by simpa using e⟩
    | succ b ih =>
      intro m m' e
      obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := ih (h • m) m' (by rw [← mul_smul, ← pow_succ]; exact e)
      exact H.exists_eq_smul_of_smul_eq hm₁
  induction a generalizing m m' with
  | zero => exact ⟨m, by simp⟩
  | succ a ih =>
    obtain ⟨m₁, rfl⟩ := h1 b m (g ^ a • m') (by rw [e, pow_succ', mul_smul])
    have e' : h ^ b • m₁ = g ^ a • m' := by
      refine hg ?_
      change g • h ^ b • m₁ = g • g ^ a • m'
      rw [smul_comm, e, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    obtain ⟨m'', rfl⟩ := ih e'
    exact ⟨m'', by rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.SeparatingFunctionals.τ_zero
statement: lemma τ_zero (j : Fin D.m) {V : Opens Y} (hV : V ≤ U) : D.τ j V hV 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.τ_smul j V hV 0 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.SeparatingFunctionals.τ_neg
statement:
lemma τ_neg (j : Fin D.m) {V : Opens Y} (hV : V ≤ U) (a : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    D.τ j V hV (-a) = -D.τ j V hV a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.τ_smul j V hV (-1) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.SeparatingFunctionals.τ_sub
statement:
lemma τ_sub (j : Fin D.m) {V : Opens Y} (hV : V ≤ U) (a b : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    D.τ j V hV (a - b) = D.τ j V hV a - D.τ j V hV b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, D.τ_add, D.τ_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.SeparatingFunctionals.τ_sum
statement:
lemma τ_sum (j : Fin D.m) {V : Opens Y} (hV : V ≤ U) {k : ℕ} (a : Fin k → M.val.obj (op V)) :
    D.τ j V hV (∑ i, a i) = ∑ i, D.τ j V hV (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : ∀ s : Finset (Fin k), D.τ j V hV (∑ i ∈ s, a i) = ∑ i ∈ s, D.τ j V hV (a i) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa using D.τ_zero j hV
    | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, D.τ_add, ih]
  exact this Finset.univ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.SeparatingFunctionals.ext
statement:
lemma ext {V : Opens Y} (hV : V ≤ U) {a b : M.val.obj (op V)}
    (h : ∀ j, D.τ j V hV a = D.τ j V hV b) : a = b
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_zero.1 (D.eq_zero_of_τ V hV _ fun j ↦ by rw [D.τ_sub, h j, sub_self])

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.bijective_restrict_of_forall_exists_extend'
statement:
theorem bijective_restrict_of_forall_exists_extend' [M.IsCoherent] {T : Set X} (O : X.Opens)
    (hO : (O : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    (hT : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hzU : z ∈ U) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op U)),
      (∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0) ∧
      IsSMulRegular ((X.stalkFunctor z).obj M) (X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g))
    (hext : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op (V ⊓ O))) (z : X), z ∈ V → z ∈ T →
      ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), z ∈ W ∧ ∃ t : M.val.obj (op W),
        modRes t (W ⊓ O) inf_le_left = modRes s (W ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O hWV))
    (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective fun t : M.val.obj (op V) ↦ modRes t (V ⊓ O) inf_le_left
proof:
:= by
  have hVO : ∀ {V : X.Opens}, ∀ y ∈ V, y ∉ T → y ∈ V ⊓ O := fun y hy hyT ↦
    ⟨hy, by rw [hO]; exact hyT⟩
  refine ⟨injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular hT inf_le_left fun y hy hyT ↦ hVO y hy hyT,
    fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have hloc : ∀ z : V, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), z.1 ∈ W ∧ ∃ t : M.val.obj (op W),
      modRes t (W ⊓ O) inf_le_left = modRes s (W ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O hWV) := by
    intro z
    by_cases hzT : z.1 ∈ T
    · exact hext V s z.1 z.2 hzT
    · exact ⟨V ⊓ O, inf_le_left, hVO z.1 z.2 hzT, s, rfl⟩
  choose W hWV hzW t ht using hloc
  
  have hglue : ∀ a b, modRes (t a) (W a ⊓ W b) inf_le_left =
      modRes (t b) (W a ⊓ W b) inf_le_right := by
    intro a b
    refine injective_restrict_of_isSMulRegular hT (V := W a ⊓ W b) (W := W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O)
      inf_le_left (fun y hy hyT ↦ hVO y hy hyT) ?_
    simp only [modRes_res]
    have ha : modRes (t a) (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_left |>.trans inf_le_left) =
        modRes s (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O (inf_le_left.trans (hWV a))) := by
      rw [← modRes_res inf_le_left (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_left), ht a, modRes_res]
    have hb : modRes (t b) (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O)
        (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_right |>.trans inf_le_left) =
        modRes s (W a ⊓ W b ⊓ O) (inf_le_inf_right O (inf_le_right.trans (hWV b))) := by
      rw [← modRes_res inf_le_left (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_right), ht b, modRes_res]
    exact ha.trans hb.symm
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := modRes_existsUnique_gluing M W
    (fun z hz ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hzW ⟨z, hz⟩⟩) hWV t hglue
  refine ⟨u, modRes_eq_of_cover M (fun z ↦ W z ⊓ O)
    (fun y (hy : y ∈ V ⊓ O) ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy.1⟩, hzW ⟨y, hy.1⟩, hy.2⟩)
    (fun z ↦ inf_le_inf_right O (hWV z)) _ s fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [modRes_res]
  rw [← modRes_res (hWV z) inf_le_left, hu z, ht z]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.conductorMem_zero
statement: lemma conductorMem_zero (hz : z ∈ V) : ConductorMem D hV f z 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨V, le_rfl, hz, 0, 0, map_zero _, fun j ↦ by rw [zero_mul, D.τ_zero]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.conductor_eq_res
statement:
lemma conductor_eq_res {W : Opens Y} (hWV : W ≤ V) {r : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)}
    {t : M.val.obj (op W)} (e : ∀ j, r * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) t)
    {W' : Opens Y} (h : W' ≤ W) :
    ∀ j, Y.res h r * Y.res (h.trans hWV) (f j) = D.τ j W' ((h.trans hWV).trans hV)
      (sectRes M h t)
proof:
:= fun j ↦ by
  rw [D.τ_res _ _ (hWV.trans hV), ← e j, res_mul, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.conductor_eq_add
statement:
lemma conductor_eq_add {W : Opens Y} (hWV : W ≤ V) {r r' : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)}
    {t t' : M.val.obj (op W)} (e : ∀ j, r * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) t)
    (e' : ∀ j, r' * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) t') :
    ∀ j, (r + r') * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) (t + t')
proof:
:= fun j ↦ by
  rw [D.τ_add, ← e j, ← e' j, add_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.conductor_eq_mul
statement:
lemma conductor_eq_mul {W : Opens Y} (hWV : W ≤ V) (c : Y.presheaf.obj (op W))
    {r : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)} {t : M.val.obj (op W)}
    (e : ∀ j, r * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) t) :
    ∀ j, (c * r) * Y.res hWV (f j) = D.τ j W (hWV.trans hV) (c • t)
proof:
:= fun j ↦ by
  rw [D.τ_smul, ← e j, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ConductorMem.add
statement:
lemma ConductorMem.add {a b : Y.presheaf.stalk z} (ha : ConductorMem D hV f z a)
    (hb : ConductorMem D hV f z b) : ConductorMem D hV f z (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hz₁, r₁, t₁, rfl, e₁⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨W₂, h₂, hz₂, r₂, t₂, rfl, e₂⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨W₁ ⊓ W₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩, _, _, ?_,
    conductor_eq_add (hV := hV) _ (conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₁ e₁ inf_le_left)
      (conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₂ e₂ inf_le_right)⟩
  rw [map_add, germ_res, germ_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ConductorMem.mul
statement:
lemma ConductorMem.mul (c : Y.presheaf.stalk z) {a : Y.presheaf.stalk z}
    (ha : ConductorMem D hV f z a) : ConductorMem D hV f z (c * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hz₁, r₁, t₁, rfl, e₁⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨W₂, hz₂, c', rfl⟩ := Y.presheaf.exists_germ_eq c
  refine ⟨W₁ ⊓ W₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩, _, _, ?_,
    conductor_eq_mul (hV := hV) _ (Y.res inf_le_right c')
      (conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₁ e₁ inf_le_left)⟩
  rw [map_mul, germ_res, germ_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.mem_conductor_iff
statement:
lemma mem_conductor_iff (hz : z ∈ V) (a : Y.presheaf.stalk z) :
    a ∈ conductor D hV f z hz ↔ ConductorMem D hV f z a
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_pow_mem_conductor
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_conductor [M.IsCoherent]
    (hTup : HasLocalTupleRelations (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringSheaf)) {z : Y} (hz : z ∈ V)
    (a : Y.presheaf.stalk z)
    (hNS : ∀ (W : Opens Y) (hzW : z ∈ W) {K : ℕ} (φ : Fin K → Y.presheaf.obj (op W)),
      (∀ y (hy : y ∈ W), y ∉ T → Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ Y.presheaf.germ W y hy (φ l)) = ⊤) →
      ∃ N : ℕ, a ^ N ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ Y.presheaf.germ W z hzW (φ l))) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, a ^ N ∈ conductor D hV f z hz
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨W₀, k, e₀, hzW₀, hgen₀⟩ := isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_of_isFiniteType M z
  set W₁ : Opens Y := W₀ ⊓ V
  have hW₁V : W₁ ≤ V := inf_le_right
  have hW₁₀ : W₁ ≤ W₀ := inf_le_left
  
  let v : Fin (k + 1) → Fin D.m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W₁) :=
    Fin.cons (fun j ↦ Y.res hW₁V (f j)) fun l j ↦ D.τ j W₁ (hW₁V.trans hV) (sectRes M hW₁₀ (e₀ l))
  obtain ⟨W₂, hW₂, K, ρ, hzW₂, hrel, hgen⟩ := hTup W₁ (k + 1) D.m v z ⟨hzW₀, hz⟩
  have hrel' : ∀ l j, ∑ i, ρ l i * Y.res hW₂ (v i j) = 0 := hrel
  
  have hoff : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W₂), y ∉ T →
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ Y.presheaf.germ W₂ y hy (ρ l 0)) = ⊤ := by
    intro y hy hyT
    have hyO : y ∈ O := by
      have : y ∈ (O : Set Y) := by rw [hO]; exact hyT
      exact this
    have hle : W₂ ⊓ O ≤ W₀ := inf_le_left.trans (hW₂.trans hW₁₀)
    obtain ⟨W₃, hW₃, hyW₃, c, hc⟩ := hgen₀ (W₂ ⊓ O) hle
      (sectRes M (inf_le_inf_right O (hW₂.trans hW₁V)) s) y ⟨hy, hyO⟩
    have hW₃₂ : W₃ ≤ W₂ := hW₃.trans inf_le_left
    let a : Fin (k + 1) → Y.presheaf.obj (op W₃) := Fin.cons 1 fun l ↦ -c l
    have hW₃V : W₃ ≤ V ⊓ O := hW₃.trans (inf_le_inf_right O (hW₂.trans hW₁V))
    have hW₃U : W₃ ≤ U := (hW₃V.trans inf_le_left).trans hV
    have ha : ∀ j, ∑ i, a i * Y.res (hW₃₂.trans hW₂) (v i j) = 0 := by
      intro j
      have E1 : D.τ j W₃ hW₃U (sectRes M hW₃V s) = Y.res (hW₃V.trans inf_le_left) (f j) :=
        (D.τ_res j (V ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans hV) W₃ hW₃U hW₃V s).trans
          ((congrArg (Y.res hW₃V) (hf j).symm).trans (res_res _ _ _ _))
      have E2 : sectRes M hW₃V s =
          ∑ l, c l • sectRes M (hW₃₂.trans (hW₂.trans hW₁₀)) (e₀ l) := by
        rw [← hc, sectRes_sectRes]
      have E3 : ∀ l, Y.res (hW₃₂.trans hW₂) (D.τ j W₁ (hW₁V.trans hV) (sectRes M hW₁₀ (e₀ l))) =
          D.τ j W₃ hW₃U (sectRes M (hW₃₂.trans (hW₂.trans hW₁₀)) (e₀ l)) := fun l ↦
        (D.τ_res j W₁ (hW₁V.trans hV) W₃ hW₃U (hW₃₂.trans hW₂) (sectRes M hW₁₀ (e₀ l))).symm.trans
          (congrArg (D.τ j W₃ hW₃U) (sectRes_sectRes M _ _ _))
      rw [E2] at E1
      simp only [D.τ_sum, D.τ_smul] at E1
      refine (Fin.sum_univ_succ _).trans ?_
      simp only [a, v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, res_res, one_mul, neg_mul,
        Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      simp only [E3, E1, add_neg_cancel]
    obtain ⟨W₄, hW₄, hyW₄, d, hd⟩ := hgen W₃ hW₃₂ a ha y hyW₃
    have h0 := congrArg (Y.presheaf.germ W₄ y hyW₄) (hd 0)
    simp only [a, Fin.cons_zero, map_one, map_sum, map_mul, germ_res] at h0
    rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, h0]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hNS W₂ hzW₂ (fun l ↦ ρ l 0) hoff
  refine ⟨N, Ideal.span_le.2 ?_ hN⟩
  rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
  have hW₂V : W₂ ≤ V := hW₂.trans hW₁V
  have hW₂U : W₂ ≤ U := hW₂V.trans hV
  refine ⟨W₂, hW₂V, hzW₂, ρ l 0,
    -∑ i, ρ l i.succ • sectRes M (hW₂.trans hW₁₀) (e₀ i), rfl, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have E3 : ∀ i, Y.res hW₂ (D.τ j W₁ (hW₁V.trans hV) (sectRes M hW₁₀ (e₀ i))) =
      D.τ j W₂ hW₂U (sectRes M (hW₂.trans hW₁₀) (e₀ i)) := fun i ↦
    (D.τ_res j W₁ (hW₁V.trans hV) W₂ hW₂U hW₂ (sectRes M hW₁₀ (e₀ i))).symm.trans
      (congrArg (D.τ j W₂ hW₂U) (sectRes_sectRes M _ _ _))
  have hr := hrel' l j
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hr
  simp only [v, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, res_res, E3] at hr
  simp only [D.τ_neg, D.τ_sum, D.τ_smul]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_opens_le_forall
statement:
lemma exists_opens_le_forall {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {x : Y} {W : Opens Y} (hx : x ∈ W)
    (W' : ι → Opens Y) (hW' : ∀ i, x ∈ W' i) :
    ∃ W'' : Opens Y, x ∈ W'' ∧ W'' ≤ W ∧ ∀ i, W'' ≤ W' i
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  refine ⟨W ⊓ Finset.univ.inf W', ⟨hx, ?_⟩, inf_le_left,
    fun i ↦ inf_le_right.trans (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))⟩
  rw [Opens.coe_finset_inf]
  simpa using hW'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.mgerm_sectRes
statement:
lemma mgerm_sectRes {W W' : Opens Y} (h : W ≤ W') {x : Y} (hx : x ∈ W)
    (t : M.val.obj (op W')) : mgerm M W x hx (sectRes M h t) = mgerm M W' x (h hx) t
proof:
:=
  mgerm_modRes h x hx t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_extend_of_mem_conductor
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hz₁, r₁, t₁, hr₁, e₁⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨W₂, h₂, hz₂, r₂, t₂, hr₂, e₂⟩ := hb
  set W₃ := W₁ ⊓ W₂
  have hW₃V : W₃ ≤ V := inf_le_left.trans h₁
  have hW₃U : W₃ ≤ U := hW₃V.trans hV
  have hz₃ : z ∈ W₃ := ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
  
  have key : (Y.res (inf_le_right : W₃ ≤ W₂) r₂ : Y.presheaf.obj (op W₃)) •
      (sectRes M (inf_le_left : W₃ ≤ W₁) t₁ : M.val.obj (op W₃)) =
      (Y.res (inf_le_left : W₃ ≤ W₁) r₁ : Y.presheaf.obj (op W₃)) •
      (sectRes M (inf_le_right : W₃ ≤ W₂) t₂ : M.val.obj (op W₃)) := by
    refine D.ext hW₃U fun j ↦ ?_
    refine (conductor_eq_mul (hV := hV) hW₃V (Y.res inf_le_right r₂)
      (conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₁ e₁ inf_le_left) j).symm.trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (conductor_eq_mul (hV := hV) hW₃V (Y.res inf_le_left r₁)
      (conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₂ e₂ inf_le_right) j)
    exact congrArg (· * _) (mul_comm _ _)
  have hgerm := congrArg (mgerm M W₃ z hz₃) key
  simp only [mgerm_smul, germ_res, hr₁, hr₂, mgerm_sectRes] at hgerm
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hreg.exists_eq_pow_smul_of_pow_smul_eq a b hgerm
  obtain ⟨W₄, hz₄, t₄, rfl⟩ := exists_mgerm_eq z μ
  have hμ' : mgerm M W₁ z hz₁ t₁ = mgerm M (W₁ ⊓ W₄) z ⟨hz₁, hz₄⟩
      ((Y.res (inf_le_left : W₁ ⊓ W₄ ≤ W₁) r₁ : Y.presheaf.obj (op (W₁ ⊓ W₄))) •
        (sectRes M (inf_le_right : W₁ ⊓ W₄ ≤ W₄) t₄ : M.val.obj (op (W₁ ⊓ W₄)))) := by
    simp only [mgerm_smul, germ_res, hr₁, mgerm_sectRes]
    exact hμ
  obtain ⟨W₅, h₅₁, h₅₂, hz₅, e₅⟩ := exists_modRes_eq_of_mgerm_eq z hz₁ _ _ _ hμ'
  have hW₅V : W₅ ≤ V := h₅₁.trans h₁
  have hW₅U : W₅ ≤ U := hW₅V.trans hV
  have hW₅₄ : W₅ ≤ W₄ := h₅₂.trans inf_le_right
  have E5 : sectRes M h₅₁ t₁ = Y.res h₅₁ r₁ • sectRes M hW₅₄ t₄ := by
    refine e₅.trans ?_
    change sectRes M h₅₂ _ = _
    rw [sectRes_smul, sectRes_sectRes, res_res]
  
  have hj : ∀ j, Y.presheaf.germ W₅ z hz₅
      (Y.res hW₅V (f j) - D.τ j W₅ hW₅U (sectRes M hW₅₄ t₄)) = 0 := by
    intro j
    refine (hg.pow a) ?_
    have e := conductor_eq_res (hV := hV) h₁ e₁ h₅₁ j
    rw [E5, D.τ_smul] at e
    change g ^ a * _ = g ^ a * 0
    rw [mul_zero, ← hr₁, ← germ_res h₅₁ z hz₅, ← map_mul, mul_sub, e, sub_self, map_zero]
  
  have hloc : ∀ j, ∃ W : Opens Y, ∃ hW : W ≤ W₅, z ∈ W ∧
      Y.res hW (Y.res hW₅V (f j)) = D.τ j W (hW.trans hW₅U) (sectRes M (hW.trans hW₅₄) t₄) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨W, hzW, iU, iV, e⟩ :=
      Y.presheaf.germ_eq z hz₅ hz₅ _ 0 ((hj j).trans (map_zero _).symm)
    refine ⟨W, leOfHom iU, hzW, ?_⟩
    have e' : Y.res (leOfHom iU) (Y.res hW₅V (f j)) =
        Y.res (leOfHom iU) (D.τ j W₅ hW₅U (sectRes M hW₅₄ t₄)) :=
      sub_eq_zero.1 ((map_sub _ _ _).symm.trans (e.trans (map_zero _)))
    exact e'.trans ((D.τ_res j W₅ hW₅U W _ (leOfHom iU) _).symm.trans
      (congrArg _ (sectRes_sectRes M _ _ _)))
  choose W hW hzW hWf using hloc
  obtain ⟨W₆, hz₆, h₆₅, h₆⟩ := exists_opens_le_forall hz₅ W hzW
  have hW₆V : W₆ ≤ V := h₆₅.trans hW₅V
  refine ⟨W₆, hW₆V, hz₆, sectRes M (h₆₅.trans hW₅₄) t₄, ?_⟩
  have hU' : W₆ ⊓ O ≤ U := (inf_le_left.trans hW₆V).trans hV
  refine D.ext hU' fun j ↦ ?_
  have hle : W₆ ⊓ O ≤ W j := inf_le_left.trans (h₆ j)
  calc D.τ j _ hU' (sectRes M inf_le_left (sectRes M (h₆₅.trans hW₅₄) t₄))
      = D.τ j _ hU' (sectRes M hle (sectRes M ((hW j).trans hW₅₄) t₄)) :=
        congrArg _ (by rw [sectRes_sectRes, sectRes_sectRes])
    _ = Y.res hle (D.τ j (W j) (((hW j).trans hW₅V).trans hV) (sectRes M ((hW j).trans hW₅₄) t₄)) :=
        D.τ_res _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    _ = Y.res hle (Y.res (hW j) (Y.res hW₅V (f j))) := congrArg _ (hWf j).symm
    _ = Y.res (inf_le_inf_right O hW₆V) (Y.res inf_le_left (f j)) := by simp only [res_res]
    _ = Y.res (inf_le_inf_right O hW₆V) (D.τ j (V ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans hV) s) :=
        congrArg _ (hf j)
    _ = D.τ j _ hU' (sectRes M (inf_le_inf_right O hW₆V) s) := (D.τ_res _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_germ_mem_span
statement:
lemma exists_pow_germ_mem_span {T : Set X} {U : X.Opens} (g : X.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hg : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0) {z : X} (hzU : z ∈ U)
    (W : X.Opens) (hzW : z ∈ W) {K : ℕ} (φ : Fin K → X.presheaf.obj (op W))
    (hφ : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W), y ∉ T →
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ X.presheaf.germ W y hy (φ l)) = ⊤) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g ^ N ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun l ↦ X.presheaf.germ W z hzW (φ l))
proof:
:= by
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, ∀ hy : y ∈ W ⊓ U,
      (∀ l, X.eval y hy (X.res inf_le_left (φ l)) = 0) →
        X.eval y hy (X.res inf_le_right g) = 0 := by
    refine Eventually.of_forall fun y hy hall ↦ ?_
    rw [eval_res]
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
    · exact hg y hy.2 hyT
    · refine absurd (hφ y hy.1 hyT) fun htop ↦
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk y)).ne_top ?_
      rw [eq_top_iff, ← htop, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
      exact (eval_eq_zero_iff X).1 ((eval_res _ _ _).symm.trans (hall l))
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := X.isNullstellensatzAt z (W ⊓ U) ⟨hzW, hzU⟩
    (fun l ↦ X.res inf_le_left (φ l)) (X.res inf_le_right g) hev
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  have h1 : X.presheaf.germ (W ⊓ U) z ⟨hzW, hzU⟩ (X.res inf_le_right g) =
      X.presheaf.germ U z hzU g := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have h2 : (fun l ↦ X.presheaf.germ (W ⊓ U) z ⟨hzW, hzU⟩ (X.res inf_le_left (φ l))) =
      fun l ↦ X.presheaf.germ W z hzW (φ l) :=
    funext fun l ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [h1, h2] at hN
  exact hN

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.bijective_restrict_of_separatingFunctionals
statement:
theorem bijective_restrict_of_separatingFunctionals [M.IsCoherent] {U : X.Opens}
    (D : SeparatingFunctionals M U) {T : Set X} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (O : X.Opens)
    (hO : (O : Set X) = Tᶜ) (g h : X.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hg : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy g = 0)
    (hh : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ T → X.eval y hy h = 0)
    (hg𝒪 : ∀ z (hz : z ∈ T), IsSMulRegular (X.presheaf.stalk z) (X.presheaf.germ U z (hTU hz) g))
    (hreg : ∀ z (hz : z ∈ T), IsWeaklyRegular ((X.stalkFunctor z).obj M)
      [X.presheaf.germ U z (hTU hz) g, X.presheaf.germ U z (hTU hz) h])
    (h𝒪 : ∀ V : X.Opens, V ≤ U → Function.Surjective (X.res (inf_le_left : V ⊓ O ≤ V)))
    (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective fun t : M.val.obj (op V) ↦ modRes t (V ⊓ O) inf_le_left
proof:
:= by
  refine bijective_restrict_of_forall_exists_extend' O hO
    (fun z hz ↦ ⟨U, hTU hz, g, hg, ((isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff _ _ _).1 (hreg z hz)).1⟩)
    (fun V s z hzV hzT ↦ ?_) V
  
  set V' := V ⊓ U
  have hV' : V' ≤ U := inf_le_right
  have hzV' : z ∈ V' := ⟨hzV, hTU hzT⟩
  let s' : M.val.obj (op (V' ⊓ O)) := sectRes M (inf_le_inf_right O inf_le_left) s
  choose f hf using fun j ↦ h𝒪 V' hV' (D.τ j (V' ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans hV') s')
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_pow_mem_conductor D O hO hV' s' f hf (hasLocalTupleRelations_unit X)
    hzV' _ fun W hzW {_} φ hφ ↦ exists_pow_germ_mem_span g hg (hTU hzT) W hzW φ hφ
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_pow_mem_conductor D O hO hV' s' f hf (hasLocalTupleRelations_unit X)
    hzV' _ fun W hzW {_} φ hφ ↦ exists_pow_germ_mem_span h hh (hTU hzT) W hzW φ hφ
  obtain ⟨W, hWV', hzW, t, ht⟩ :=
    exists_extend_of_mem_conductor D O hV' s' f hf hzV' (hg𝒪 z hzT) (hreg z hzT) ha hb
  refine ⟨W, hWV'.trans inf_le_left, hzW, t, ht.trans ?_⟩
  exact sectRes_sectRes M _ _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_cylinderSection'
statement:
theorem evalHom_cylinderSection' {z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ cylinder.{u} V) :
    OkaRing.evalHom hz (cylinderSection.{u} V P) =
      Polynomial.eval₂ (OkaRing.evalHom (mem_cylinder.1 hz)) (z (ULift.up (Fin.last n))) P
proof:
:= by
  have key : (OkaRing.evalHom hz).comp (cylinderSection.{u} V).toRingHom =
      Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (OkaRing.evalHom (mem_cylinder.1 hz))
        (z (ULift.up (Fin.last n))) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
        cylinderSection_C, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
      rfl
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
        cylinderSection_X, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
      rfl
  have := congrArg (fun Φ ↦ Φ P) key
  simpa using this

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_monic
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_monic
    (i : W ⟶ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder.{u} V))
    (hi : IsClosedEmbedding (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _))
    (hP : P.Monic)
    (hrange : Set.range (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _) =
      {z | OkaRing.evalHom z.2 (cylinderSection.{u} V P) = 0}) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.projRestrict.{u} V)
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_range_eq i hi (monic_okaFamily.{u} V P hP)
    (natDegree_okaFamily.{u} V P hP) (continuous_coeff_okaFamily.{u} V P) ?_
  rw [hrange]
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [evalHom_cylinderSection.{u} V P z.2]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHom_stalkMap_okaMapPre
statement:
lemma isLocalHom_stalkMap_okaMapPre (u : κ → OkaRing (⊤ : Opens (ι → ℂ))) (z : ι → ℂ) :
    IsLocalHom (((okaMapPre u).stalkMap z).hom)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hw, s, rfl⟩ := (okaCommPresheaf.{u} κ).exists_germ_eq a
  have hz : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapBase u)).obj W := hw
  have hmap : ((okaMapPre u).stalkMap z).hom
        ((okaCommPresheaf.{u} κ).germ W ((okaMapPre u).base z) hw s) =
      (okaCommPresheaf.{u} ι).germ ((Opens.map (okaMapBase u)).obj W) z hz
        (okaMapC u W s) :=
    PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (okaMapPre u) W z hw s
  rw [hmap] at ha
  by_contra hcon
  have h1 : OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := okaMapFun u z) hw s = 0 :=
    (germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff hw s).1 ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hcon)
  refine (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1
    ((germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff hz (okaMapC u W s)).2 ?_) ha
  exact (evalHom_okaMapC u W s hz).trans h1

name: ComplexAnalytic.base_nodeToLineHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem base_nodeToLineHom (j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (p : AnalyticSpace.node.{u})
    (l : ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) :
    ((nodeToLineHom.{u} j).base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ) l = p.1.1 j
proof:
:=
  ((coord j).toGlobalFun_apply trivial).trans (evalHom_coord j)

name: ComplexAnalytic.surjective_base_nodeToLineHom
statement:
theorem surjective_base_nodeToLineHom (j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
    Function.Surjective fun p : AnalyticSpace.node.{u} ↦
      ((nodeToLineHom.{u} j).base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ) (ULift.up 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro c
  have hne : (ULift.up 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ≠ ULift.up 1 := fun hcon ↦ by
    simpa using congrArg ULift.down hcon
  set x : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun l ↦ if l = j then c else 0 with hx
  have hx0 : x (ULift.up 0) * x (ULift.up 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hx]
    dsimp only
    rcases eq_or_ne (ULift.up 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) j with h | h
    · rw [if_neg (fun hcon : (ULift.up 1 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) = j ↦ hne (h.trans hcon.symm)),
        mul_zero]
    · rw [if_neg h, zero_mul]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, (mem_zeroLocus_nodeSection_iff _).2 hx0⟩,
    (base_nodeToLineHom j _ (ULift.up 0)).trans (if_pos rfl)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.not_injective_base_nodeToLineHom
statement:
theorem not_injective_base_nodeToLineHom (j : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) :
    ¬ Function.Injective fun p : AnalyticSpace.node.{u} ↦
      ((nodeToLineHom.{u} j).base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ) (ULift.up 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set k : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) := if j = ULift.up 0 then ULift.up 1 else ULift.up 0 with hk
  have hjk : j ≠ k := by
    rw [hk]
    split
    · next h => rw [h]; exact fun hcon ↦ by simpa using congrArg ULift.down hcon
    · next h => exact fun hcon ↦ h hcon
  have hmem : ∀ c : ℂ, (fun l ↦ if l = k then c else 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℂ) (ULift.up 0) *
      (fun l ↦ if l = k then c else 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℂ) (ULift.up 1) = 0 := by
    intro c
    dsimp only
    rcases eq_or_ne (ULift.up 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) k with h | h
    · rw [if_neg (fun hcon : (ULift.up 1 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) = k ↦ by
        simpa using congrArg ULift.down (h.trans hcon.symm)), mul_zero]
    · rw [if_neg h, zero_mul]
  intro hinj
  have h := hinj (a₁ := ⟨⟨fun l ↦ if l = k then 1 else 0, trivial⟩,
      (mem_zeroLocus_nodeSection_iff _).2 (hmem 1)⟩)
    (a₂ := ⟨⟨fun l ↦ if l = k then 2 else 0, trivial⟩,
      (mem_zeroLocus_nodeSection_iff _).2 (hmem 2)⟩) ?_
  · have h2 := congrArg (fun p : AnalyticSpace.node.{u} ↦ p.1.1 k) h
    dsimp only at h2
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  · dsimp only
    rw [base_nodeToLineHom, base_nodeToLineHom]
    dsimp only
    rw [if_neg hjk, if_neg hjk]

name: ComplexAnalytic.nodeToLine_ne
statement: theorem nodeToLine_ne : nodeToLine.{u} (ULift.up 0) ≠ nodeToLine.{u} (ULift.up 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : (ULift.up 0 : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ≠ ULift.up 1 := fun hcon ↦ by
    simpa using congrArg ULift.down hcon
  set x : ULift.{u} (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun l ↦ if l = ULift.up 0 then 1 else 0 with hx
  have hx0 : x (ULift.up 0) * x (ULift.up 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hx]
    dsimp only
    rw [if_neg hne.symm, mul_zero]
  set p : AnalyticSpace.node.{u} :=
    ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, (mem_zeroLocus_nodeSection_iff _).2 hx0⟩ with hp
  intro hcon
  have h := congrArg (fun φ : AnalyticSpace.node.{u} ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} 1 ↦
    (φ.toLRSHom.base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ) (ULift.up 0)) hcon
  rw [show ((nodeToLine.{u} (ULift.up 0)).toLRSHom.base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ)
      (ULift.up 0) = x (ULift.up 0) from base_nodeToLineHom _ p _,
    show ((nodeToLine.{u} (ULift.up 1)).toLRSHom.base p : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) → ℂ)
      (ULift.up 0) = x (ULift.up 1) from base_nodeToLineHom _ p _, hx] at h
  dsimp only at h
  rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg hne.symm] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.coordPullback_restrictLE_comp
statement:
theorem coordPullback_restrictLE_comp (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) {V W : Z.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (ψ : Z.restrict W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m) (j : ULift.{u} (Fin m))
    (hψ : AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψ j = Z.resΓ W g) :
    AnalyticSpace.coordPullback (Z.restrictLE h ≫ ψ) j = Z.resΓ V g
proof:
:=
  (AnalyticSpace.coordPullback_comp (Z.restrictLE h) ψ j).trans
    ((congrArg (fun a ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map
        (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictLE h).op).hom a) hψ).trans (Z.resΓ_restrictLE h g))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.coordPullback_ofRestrict_comp
statement:
theorem coordPullback_ofRestrict_comp (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ} (U : Z.Opens)
    (φ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m) (j : ULift.{u} (Fin m)) :
    AnalyticSpace.coordPullback (Z.ofRestrict U ≫ φ) j =
      Z.resΓ U (AnalyticSpace.coordPullback φ j)
proof:
:=
  AnalyticSpace.coordPullback_comp (Z.ofRestrict U) φ j

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.restrictLE_comp_eq
statement:
theorem restrictLE_comp_eq (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    {V W : Z.Opens} (ψV : Z.restrict V ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m)
    (ψW : Z.restrict W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m)
    (hV : ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψV j = Z.resΓ V (g j))
    (hW : ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψW j = Z.resΓ W (g j)) :
    Z.restrictLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W ≤ V) ≫ ψV =
      Z.restrictLE (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W ≤ W) ≫ ψW
proof:
:=
  AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_complexAffineSpace _ _ fun j ↦
    (Z.coordPullback_restrictLE_comp (g j) inf_le_left ψV j (hV j)).trans
      (Z.coordPullback_restrictLE_comp (g j) inf_le_right ψW j (hW j)).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_of_local
statement:
theorem exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_of_local (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hloc : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (U : Z.Opens) (_ : z ∈ U)
      (ψ : Z.restrict U ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m),
      ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψ j = Z.resΓ U (g j)) :
    ∃ φ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m,
      ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback φ j = g j
proof:
:= by
  choose U hzU ψ hψ using hloc
  have hcover : ∀ x : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace, ∃ i, x ∈ U i := fun x ↦ ⟨x, hzU x⟩
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ₀, -⟩ := LocallyRingedSpace.existsUnique_glueMorphisms_of_opens U hcover
    (fun i ↦ (ψ i).toLRSHom) fun i j ↦ congrArg
      (fun χ : Z.restrict (U i ⊓ U j) ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m ↦ χ.toLRSHom)
      (Z.restrictLE_comp_eq g (ψ i) (ψ j) (hψ i) (hψ j))
  
  have key : ∀ (i : Z) (a : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)),
      (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map
          (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).op).hom
            ((LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map φ₀.op).hom a) =
        (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (ψ i).toLRSHom.op).hom a := fun i a ↦
    (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply _ φ₀ a).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun n : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ⟶
          (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m).toLocallyRingedSpace ↦
        (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map n.op).hom a) (hφ₀ i))
  have hclin : IsCLinearHom φ₀ Z.algebraMap
      (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m).algebraMap := fun c ↦
    LocallyRingedSpace.section_ext_of_cover Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U hcover _ _ fun i ↦
      (key i _).trans (((ψ i).isCLinear c).trans
        (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict Z.toLocallyRingedSpace Z.algebraMap (U i) c).symm)
  exact ⟨⟨φ₀, hclin⟩, fun j ↦
    LocallyRingedSpace.section_ext_of_cover Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U hcover _ _ fun i ↦
      (key i _).trans (hψ i j)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_hom_complexLine_of_local
statement:
theorem exists_hom_complexLine_of_local (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (g : Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hloc : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (U : Z.Opens) (_ : z ∈ U)
      (ψ : Z.restrict U ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} 1),
      AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψ (ULift.up 0) = Z.resΓ U g) :
    ∃ φ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} 1,
      AnalyticSpace.coordPullback φ (ULift.up 0) = g
proof:
:=
  let ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Z.exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_of_local (m := 1) (fun _ ↦ g) fun z ↦
    let ⟨U, hzU, ψ, hψ⟩ := hloc z
    ⟨U, hzU, ψ, fun j ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim j (ULift.up 0)]; exact hψ⟩
  ⟨φ, hφ (ULift.up 0)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_local_hom_of_chartLift
statement:
theorem exists_local_hom_of_chartLift (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    {W : Z.Opens} {n : ℕ} {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n)}
    (c : Z.restrict W ⟶ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin m) →
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ j, (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map c.toLRSHom.op).hom (s j) = Z.resΓ W (g j)) :
    ∃ ψ : Z.restrict W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m,
      ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback ψ j = Z.resΓ W (g j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := AnalyticSpace.exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_restrict s
  exact ⟨c ≫ φ, fun j ↦ ((AnalyticSpace.coordPullback_comp c φ j).trans
    (congrArg (fun a ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map c.toLRSHom.op).hom a) (hφ j))).trans (hs j)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_chartLift
statement:
theorem exists_chartLift (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (z : Z) :
    ∃ (W : Z.Opens) (_ : z ∈ W) (n : ℕ)
      (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n))
      (c : Z.restrict W ⟶ (ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V)
      (s : ULift.{u} (Fin m) →
        ((ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V).presheaf.obj
          (op ⊤)),
      ∀ j, (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map c.toLRSHom.op).hom (s j) = Z.resΓ W (g j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₀, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := Z.local_model z
  have hsurj : ∀ x : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding,
      Function.Surjective
        (((i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap x).hom) :=
      fun x c ↦ by
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hcut.surjective_stalkMap x c
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (((_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap
        (i.base x))).surjective b
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    exact ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ a
  obtain ⟨A, hA, u, B', hB'top, hB'A, hxB', heq⟩ :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.exists_localLift_family
      (i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding) hsurj (B₀ := ⊤)
      (fun j : Fin m ↦ Z.resΓ U₀.1 (g (ULift.up j)))
      (⟨z, U₀.2⟩ : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) trivial
  have hW : U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B' ≤
      U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj
        ((Opens.map (i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict
          V.isOpenEmbedding).base).obj A) :=
    (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.map (homOfLE hB'A)).le
  have hr1 := LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict Z.toLocallyRingedSpace
    (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B')
  have hr2 := LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict_comp Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1
    ((Opens.map (i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).base).obj A)
  have hrange : Set.range ((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B').isOpenEmbedding).base) ⊆
      Set.range (((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict
        ((Opens.map (i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict
          V.isOpenEmbedding).base).obj A).isOpenEmbedding ≫
        Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).base) :=
    (hr1.subset.trans hW).trans hr2.symm.subset
  refine ⟨U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B',
    ⟨⟨z, U₀.2⟩, hxB', rfl⟩, n, A,
    ⟨LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift _ _ hrange ≫
      
      
      ComplexAnalytic.restrictHom
        (i ≫ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding) A, ?_⟩,
    fun j ↦ (_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).toRestrictΓ A (u j.down), ?_⟩
  · exact IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ hrange)
      (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict Z.toLocallyRingedSpace Z.algebraMap _)
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) _ _).comp
        (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict Z.toLocallyRingedSpace Z.algebraMap U₀.1))
      |>.comp (isCLinearHom_restrictHom (hlin.comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict_constants n V)) A)
  · intro j
    refine Eq.trans (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply _ _ _) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg
      (fun b ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map
        (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift _ _ hrange).op).hom b)
      (Γ_map_restrictHom_toRestrictΓ _ A (u j.down))) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_over_ambient Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1 _ _ hW _
      (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ hrange) _) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRestrictΓ
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B'))
      (LocallyRingedSpace.restrict_map_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1 hB'A hW _).symm) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRestrictΓ
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B')) (heq j.down)) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRestrictΓ
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B'))
      (LocallyRingedSpace.restrict_map_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1 hB'top
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.map (homOfLE hB'top)).le _)) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRestrictΓ
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B'))
      (congrArg (fun b ↦ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.map (homOfLE hB'top)).le).op).hom b)
        (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_ofRestrict_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1 (g j)))) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRestrictΓ
        (U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj B'))
      (LocallyRingedSpace.map_map_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace _ le_top le_top (g j))) ?_
    exact (LocallyRingedSpace.map_map_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace _ le_top le_top (g j)).trans
      (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_ofRestrict_apply Z.toLocallyRingedSpace _ (g j)).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_general
statement:
theorem exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_general (Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {m : ℕ}
    (g : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    ∃ φ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} m,
      ∀ j, AnalyticSpace.coordPullback φ j = g j
proof:
:=
  exists_hom_complexAffineSpace_of_local Z g fun z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨W, hzW, n, V, c, s, hs⟩ := exists_chartLift Z g z
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_local_hom_of_chartLift Z g c s hs
    exact ⟨W, hzW, ψ, hψ⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_okaMapOpenC
statement:
lemma evalHom_okaMapOpenC (s : OkaRing W) {z : complexSpace.{u} ι}
    (hz : z ∈ V.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj ((Opens.map (okaMapOpenBase u)).obj W)) :
    OkaRing.evalHom hz (okaMapOpenC u W s) =
      OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := okaMapOpenFun u z) (mem_okaMapOpen_source u W ⟨z, hz⟩) s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHom_stalkMap_okaMapOpenPre
statement:
lemma isLocalHom_stalkMap_okaMapOpenPre
    (z : ((complexSpace.{u} ι).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding)) :
    IsLocalHom (((okaMapOpenPre u).stalkMap z).hom)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hw, s, rfl⟩ := (okaCommPresheaf.{u} κ).exists_germ_eq a
  have hz : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapOpenBase u)).obj W := hw
  have hmap : ((okaMapOpenPre u).stalkMap z).hom
        ((okaCommPresheaf.{u} κ).germ W ((okaMapOpenPre u).base z) hw s) =
      ((complexSpace.{u} ι).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.germ
        ((Opens.map (okaMapOpenBase u)).obj W) z hz (okaMapOpenC u W s) :=
    PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (okaMapOpenPre u) W z hw s
  rw [hmap] at ha
  have hiso := (complexSpace.{u} ι).restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ_apply V.isOpenEmbedding
    ((Opens.map (okaMapOpenBase u)).obj W) z hz (okaMapOpenC u W s)
  have ha' := hiso ▸ ha.map ((complexSpace.{u} ι).restrictStalkIso V.isOpenEmbedding z).hom.hom
  by_contra hcon
  have h1 : OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := (okaMapOpenPre u).base z) hw s = 0 :=
    (germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff hw s).1 ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hcon)
  refine (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1
    ((germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff ?_ (okaMapOpenC u W s)).2 ?_) ha'
  · exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  · exact (evalHom_okaMapOpenC u W s _).trans h1

name: OkaRing.germ_ofMvPolynomial_X
statement:
lemma germ_ofMvPolynomial_X (hy : y ∈ U) (i : ι) :
    OkaRing.germ hy (OkaRing.ofMvPolynomial U (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing ι) (y i) + LocalOkaRing.coord i
proof:
:= by
  refine OkaRing.germ_eq_of_represents hy ?_
  have hcoe : ((algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing ι) (y i) + LocalOkaRing.coord i :
        LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) =
      algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) (y i) + MvPowerSeries.X i := by
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, LocalOkaRing.coe_coord]
    rfl
  rw [hcoe]
  refine ((MvPowerSeries.represents_algebraMap (ι := ι) (y i)).add
    (MvPowerSeries.represents_X i)).congr ?_
  have hnhds : ∀ᶠ z : ι → ℂ in nhds (0 : ι → ℂ), z + y ∈ U := by
    have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ι → ℂ ↦ z + y) (nhds 0) (nhds y) := by
      simpa using (continuous_add_const y).tendsto (0 : ι → ℂ)
    exact htend (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hy)
  filter_upwards [hnhds] with z hz
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Function.const_apply,
    OkaRing.toGlobalFun_ofMvPolynomial (U := U) hz (MvPolynomial.X i), MvPolynomial.eval_X,
    Pi.add_apply, add_comm]

  refine congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i ↦ ?_))

    (hconst : ∀ c : ℂ, θ (((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ ⊤ y trivial).hom
          (algebraMap ℂ (OkaRing ⊤) c)) =
        θ' (((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ ⊤ y trivial).hom (algebraMap ℂ (OkaRing ⊤) c)))
    (hcoord : ∀ i : ι, θ (((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ ⊤ y trivial).hom
          (OkaRing.ofMvPolynomial ⊤ (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
        θ' (((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ ⊤ y trivial).hom
          (OkaRing.ofMvPolynomial ⊤ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) :
    θ = θ'
proof:
:=
  (isCoefficientField_germ_algebraMap (U := ⊤) (y := y) trivial).ringHom_ext
    (maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_span_stalkCoord y) hconst fun i ↦ by
      rw [stalkCoord, map_sub, map_sub, hconst, hcoord]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.base_eq_of_Γ_map_eq
statement:
theorem base_eq_of_Γ_map_eq (φ ψ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n)
    (h : ∀ j : ULift.{u} (Fin n), (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map φ.toLRSHom.op).hom (coord j) =
      (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map ψ.toLRSHom.op).hom (coord j))
    (z : Z) : φ.toLRSHom.base z = ψ.toLRSHom.base z
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  have hφ := eval_c_app φ.toLRSHom φ.isCLinear (U := ⊤) z trivial (coord j)
  have hψ := eval_c_app ψ.toLRSHom ψ.isCLinear (U := ⊤) z trivial (coord j)
  rw [eval_coord] at hφ hψ
  rw [← hφ, ← hψ]
  exact congrArg _ (h j)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem hom_ext_complexAffineSpace (φ ψ : Z ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n)
    (h : ∀ j : ULift.{u} (Fin n), (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map φ.toLRSHom.op).hom (coord j) =
      (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map ψ.toLRSHom.op).hom (coord j)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine AnalyticSpace.forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective ?_
  have hbase : φ.toLRSHom.base = ψ.toLRSHom.base :=
    ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ (base_eq_of_Γ_map_eq φ ψ h)
  refine LocallyRingedSpace.hom_stalk_ext _ _ hbase fun z ↦ ?_
  have hins : Inseparable (φ.toLRSHom.base z) (ψ.toLRSHom.base z) := by
    rw [base_eq_of_Γ_map_eq φ ψ h z]
  haveI hloc : IsLocalHom (φ.toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom := φ.toLRSHom.prop z
  haveI hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing (Z.presheaf.stalk z) := instIsNoetherianRingStalk Z z
  have key : (φ.toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom = (ψ.toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom.comp
      (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).presheaf.stalkCongr hins).hom).hom := by
    refine @okaStalk_ringHom_ext (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) _ (φ.toLRSHom.base z) _ _ _ hnoeth _ _ hloc
      (fun c ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · refine Eq.trans ((φ.isCLinear.stalkAlgMap z c).trans (ψ.isCLinear.stalkAlgMap z c).symm)
        (congrArg (ψ.toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom_germ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).presheaf
            hins ⊤ trivial trivial
            ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).algebraMap c)).symm)
    · refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (ψ.toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom_germ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).presheaf
          hins ⊤ trivial trivial (coord j)).symm)
      exact (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply φ.toLRSHom ⊤ z trivial _).trans
        ((congrArg (Z.presheaf.germ ((Opens.map φ.toLRSHom.base).obj ⊤) z trivial) (h j)).trans
          (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply ψ.toLRSHom ⊤ z trivial _).symm)
  exact ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun a ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun key a

@[simp]
lemma val_app_sectionsHom {I : Type u} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (f : I → Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (V : Opens ↑Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (b : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I).val.obj (op V)) :
    (Y.sectionsHom f).val.app (op V) b =
      ∑ i : I, SheafOfModules.freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf) (I := I) (op V) b i •
        (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringSheaf).val.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := V))).op
          ((f i : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) : (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringSheaf).val.obj (op ⊤))
proof:
:= by

  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.not_epi_sectionsHom_of_germ_mem
statement:
theorem not_epi_sectionsHom_of_germ_mem {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (f : I → Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (y : Y)
    (hf : ∀ i, Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial (f i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ¬ Epi (Y.sectionsHom f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype I
  intro hepi
  
  have hloc : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringSheaf).map (Y.sectionsHom f)).hom :=
    SheafOfModules.isLocallySurjective_toSheaf_map_of_epi (Y.sectionsHom f)
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff] at hloc
  obtain ⟨V, hVtop, ⟨s, hs⟩, hyV⟩ :=
    hloc ⊤ (show ToType (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringSheaf).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringSheaf)).obj.obj (op ⊤)) from (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
      y trivial
  rw [show ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringSheaf).map (Y.sectionsHom f)).hom.app (op V) s =
    (Y.sectionsHom f).val.app (op V) s from rfl, Y.val_app_sectionsHom f V s] at hs
  
  
  have hs' : ∑ i : I,
      (show ToType (Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) from
        SheafOfModules.freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf) (I := I) (op V) s i) *
        Y.res (le_top (a := V)) (f i) =
      Y.res (le_top (a := V)) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) := hs
  rw [show Y.res (le_top (a := V)) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) = 1 from map_one _] at hs'
  have hgerm : ∀ i : I, Y.presheaf.germ V y hyV (Y.res (le_top (a := V)) (f i)) =
      Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial (f i) :=
    fun i ↦ Y.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE le_top) y hyV (f i)
  have hg := congrArg (fun z ↦ Y.presheaf.germ V y hyV z) hs'
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_one, hgerm] at hg
  refine (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).ne_top ?_
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, ← hg]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hf i)

statement:

    (f : I → Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (y : Y)
    (hf : ∀ i, Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial (f i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ¬ IsZero (cokernel (Y.sectionsHom f))
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  Y.not_epi_sectionsHom_of_germ_mem f y hf (Preadditive.epi_of_isZero_cokernel _ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isZero_cokernel_sectionsHom_one
statement:
theorem isZero_cokernel_sectionsHom_one :
    IsZero (cokernel (Y.sectionsHom
      (fun _ : PUnit.{u + 1} ↦ (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (Y.sectionsHom (fun _ : PUnit.{u + 1} ↦ (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) := by
    rw [← SheafOfModules.isLocallySurjective_toSheaf_map_iff_epi]
    apply CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_surjective
    rintro ⟨V⟩ t
    refine ⟨SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm (R := Y.ringSheaf) (I := PUnit.{u + 1}) (op V)
      (fun _ ↦ t), ?_⟩
    change (Y.sectionsHom (fun _ : PUnit.{u + 1} ↦ (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))).val.app (op V)
      (SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm (R := Y.ringSheaf) (I := PUnit.{u + 1}) (op V) fun _ ↦ t) = t
    rw [Y.val_app_sectionsHom, SheafOfModules.freeEval_freeEvalSymm]
    
    exact (Finset.sum_const _).trans <|
      (one_nsmul _).trans <|
        (congrArg (fun z ↦ (show ToType (Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) from t) * z)
          (show Y.res (le_top (a := V)) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) = 1 from map_one _)).trans
          (mul_one _)
  exact Limits.isZero_cokernel_of_epi _

name: ComplexAnalytic.isCLinearHom_sheetHom
statement:

    IsCLinearHom (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetHom Y p V hV)
      (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetToBase Y p V) β)
      (Y.resAlgMap β (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetImage Y p V hV))
proof:
:=
  IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.liftRestrict_fac _ _ _)
    (isCLinearHom_comapAlgMap _ β) (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict Y β _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.isCLinearHom_sheetIso_inv
statement:
theorem isCLinearHom_sheetIso_inv :
    IsCLinearHom (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetIso Y p V hV).inv
      (Y.resAlgMap β (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetImage Y p V hV))
      (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetToBase Y p V) β)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsCLinearHom.of_comp (q := LocallyRingedSpace.sheetToBase Y p V)
    (p := Y.ofRestrict (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetImage Y p V hV).isOpenEmbedding) ?_
    (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict Y β _) (isCLinearHom_comapAlgMap _ β)
  have h : (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetIso Y p V hV).inv ≫ LocallyRingedSpace.sheetHom Y p V hV =
      𝟙 _ := by
    have hid := (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetIso Y p V hV).inv_hom_id
    rwa [LocallyRingedSpace.sheetIso_hom] at hid
  have hfac : LocallyRingedSpace.sheetHom Y p V hV ≫
      Y.ofRestrict (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetImage Y p V hV).isOpenEmbedding =
      LocallyRingedSpace.sheetToBase Y p V :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.liftRestrict_fac _ _ _
  rw [← hfac, ← Category.assoc, h, Category.id_comp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.comapAlgMap_sheetHom
statement:

        (Y.resAlgMap β (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetImage Y p V hV)) =
      (Y.inverseImage p).resAlgMap
        (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (Y.inverseImageHom p) β) V
proof:
:=
  (comapAlgMap_sheetToBase Y p V β) ▸
    (isCLinearHom_comapAlgMap (LocallyRingedSpace.sheetHom Y p V hV) _).eq
      (isCLinearHom_sheetHom Y p V hV β)

name: ComplexAnalytic.HasLocalModels.of_iSup_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, U i := hU ▸ trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨W, n, k, V, c, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := h i ⟨x, hxi⟩
  set W' : Opens X := (U i).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W.1 with hW'
  have hxW' : x ∈ W' := ⟨⟨x, hxi⟩, W.2, rfl⟩
  have hrange : Set.range (X.ofRestrict W'.isOpenEmbedding).base =
      Set.range (((X.restrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict W.1.isOpenEmbedding ≫
        X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).base) :=
    (X.range_ofRestrict W').trans (X.range_ofRestrict_comp (U i) W.1).symm
  set e := LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange with he'
  have he : IsCLinearHom e.hom (X.resAlgMap α W')
      ((X.restrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap (X.resAlgMap α (U i)) W.1) :=
    IsCLinearHom.of_comp
      (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ hrange)
      (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict X α W')
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ W.1).comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict X α (U i)))
  exact ⟨⟨W', hxW'⟩, n, k, V, e.hom ≫ c, f, hcut.comp_iso e, he.comp hlin⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_of_isOpenCover_source
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_of_isOpenCover_source (hV : IsOpenCover V)
    (h : ∀ i, IsLocalIso (X.ofRestrict (V i) ≫ f)) : IsLocalIso f where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:= by
    rw [isLocalHomeomorph_iff_isLocalHomeomorphOn_univ]
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hV.exists_mem x
    have hcomp : IsLocalHomeomorphOn
        ((f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) ∘ ((X.ofRestrict (V i)).toLRSHom.base : X.restrict (V i) → X))
        Set.univ := (h i).isLocalHomeomorph.isLocalHomeomorphOn
    have hincl : IsLocalHomeomorphOn
        ((X.ofRestrict (V i)).toLRSHom.base : X.restrict (V i) → X) Set.univ :=
      ((V i).isOpenEmbedding.isLocalHomeomorph).isLocalHomeomorphOn
    have hres := hcomp.of_comp_right hincl
    rw [Set.image_univ, AnalyticSpace.range_base_ofRestrict] at hres
    exact hres x hi
  isIso_stalkMap x := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hV.exists_mem x
    have hcomp : IsIso ((X.ofRestrict (V i) ≫ f).toLRSHom.stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩) :=
      (h i).isIso_stalkMap _
    have he : (X.ofRestrict (V i) ≫ f).toLRSHom = (X.ofRestrict (V i)).toLRSHom ≫ f.toLRSHom := rfl
    rw [he, LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp] at hcomp
    have hiso : IsIso ((X.ofRestrict (V i)).toLRSHom.stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩) := inferInstance
    exact @CategoryTheory.IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ _ _ _ _ _
      ((X.ofRestrict (V i)).toLRSHom.stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩) hiso hcomp

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_iff_isOpenCover_source

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFinite_of_isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isFinite_of_isOpenCover (hU : IsOpenCover U)
    (h : ∀ i, IsFinite (restrictHom f (U i))) : IsFinite f where
  isClosedMap
proof:
:= by
    rw [hU.isClosedMap_iff_restrictPreimage]
    intro i
    have hcl := (h i).isClosedMap
    rwa [base_restrictHom_eq_restrictPreimage] at hcl
  finite_fiber y := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hU.exists_mem y
    have hfin := (h i).finite_fiber ⟨y, hi⟩
    rw [base_restrictHom_eq_restrictPreimage] at hfin
    have himg : (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) ⁻¹' {y} =
        Subtype.val ''
          (((U i : Set Y).restrictPreimage (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y)) ⁻¹' {⟨y, hi⟩}) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hx' : (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) x = y := hx
        refine ⟨⟨x, ?_⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
        · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hx']
          exact hi
        · exact Subtype.ext hx'
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hz
    rw [himg]
    exact ((Set.finite_coe_iff.mp hfin).image _).to_subtype

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFinite_iff_restrictHom
statement:
theorem isFinite_iff_restrictHom (hU : IsOpenCover U) :
    IsFinite f ↔ ∀ i, IsFinite (restrictHom f (U i))
proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_of_isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_of_isOpenCover (hU : IsOpenCover U)
    (h : ∀ i, IsLocalIso (restrictHom f (U i))) : IsLocalIso f where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:= by
    refine hU.isLocalHomeomorph_of_restrictPreimage f.toLRSHom.base.hom.continuous fun i ↦ ?_
    have hlh := (h i).isLocalHomeomorph
    rwa [base_restrictHom_eq_restrictPreimage] at hlh
  isIso_stalkMap x := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hU.exists_mem ((f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) x)
    have hx : x ∈ ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i) : Set X) := hi
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ : ∃ x' : X.restrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)),
        ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
          ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)).isOpenEmbedding).base x') = x :=
      ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hiso : IsIso ((ComplexAnalytic.restrictHom f.toLRSHom (U i)).stalkMap x') :=
      (h i).isIso_stalkMap x'
    rw [ComplexAnalytic.stalkMap_restrictHom_eq'] at hiso
    haveI := hiso
    haveI hBC : IsIso (f.toLRSHom.stalkMap
          ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
            ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)).isOpenEmbedding).base x') ≫
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
          ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)).isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap x') :=
      IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left
        (ComplexAnalytic.restrictStalkEquiv f.toLRSHom (U i) x').hom _
    haveI hB : IsIso (f.toLRSHom.stalkMap
        ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
          ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)).isOpenEmbedding).base x')) :=
      IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _
        ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
          ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (U i)).isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap x')
    exact hx' ▸ hB

        M).HasFreeResolutionLE n

    (fun z ↦ hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_stalk_of_isIso

      (hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_stalk_complexAffineSpace n _)) M y

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_of_comp
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_of_comp {X Y Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsLocalIso (f ≫ g)] [IsLocalIso g] : IsLocalIso f where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:=
    IsLocalHomeomorph.of_comp (IsLocalIso.isLocalHomeomorph (f := f ≫ g))
      (IsLocalIso.isLocalHomeomorph (f := g)) f.toLRSHom.base.hom.continuous
  isIso_stalkMap x := by
    haveI : IsIso (g.toLRSHom.stalkMap (f.toLRSHom.base x) ≫ f.toLRSHom.stalkMap x) := by
      rw [← LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
      exact IsLocalIso.isIso_stalkMap (f := f ≫ g) x
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (g.toLRSHom.stalkMap (f.toLRSHom.base x))
      (f.toLRSHom.stalkMap x)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_of_isIso {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] : IsLocalIso f where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:=
    (LocallyRingedSpace.homeoOfIso
      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.{u}.mapIso (asIso f))).isLocalHomeomorph
  isIso_stalkMap x := by
    haveI : IsIso (AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom f) :=
      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.{u}.mapIso (asIso f)).isIso_hom
    infer_instance

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFiniteEtale_of_comp
statement:
theorem isFiniteEtale_of_comp {X Y Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [T2Space Y] [IsFiniteEtale (f ≫ g)] [IsLocalIso g] : IsFiniteEtale f where
  isFinite
proof:
:= isFinite_of_comp_of_t2Space f g

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_of_isLocalIso_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isLocalIso_of_bijective {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [hf : IsLocalIso f] (hb : Function.Bijective (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y)) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have hoe : IsOpenEmbedding (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) :=
    hf.isLocalHomeomorph.isOpenEmbedding_of_injective hb.injective
  haveI : LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f.toLRSHom :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso f.toLRSHom hoe
  haveI : Epi f.toLRSHom.base := (TopCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 hb.surjective
  haveI : IsIso (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map f) :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.to_iso f.toLRSHom
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso f forgetToLocallyRingedSpace

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isEmpty {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hY : IsEmpty (Y : Type u)) :
    IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsEmpty (X : Type u) := Function.isEmpty (β := (Y : Type u)) f.toLRSHom.base
  haveI : IsLocalIso f :=
    { isLocalHomeomorph := fun x ↦ (hX.false x).elim
      isIso_stalkMap := fun x ↦ (hX.false x).elim }
  exact isIso_of_isLocalIso_of_bijective f
    ⟨fun a ↦ (hX.false a).elim, fun y ↦ (hY.false y).elim⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_of_isFiniteEtale_of_injective
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isFiniteEtale_of_injective {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsFiniteEtale f] [PreconnectedSpace (Y : Type u)] [Nonempty (X : Type u)]
    (hi : Function.Injective (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y)) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  refine isIso_of_isLocalIso_of_bijective f ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  rcases surjective_base_or_isEmpty_of_isFiniteEtale f with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h (not_isEmpty_of_nonempty _)

name: mem_zeroLocus_restrict_complexSpace_iff
statement:

    (f : κ → ((complexSpace.{u} ι).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (y : (complexSpace.{u} ι).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding) :
    y ∈ ((complexSpace.{u} ι).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).zeroLocus f ↔
      ∀ i, OkaRing.evalHom

          ⟨y, trivial, rfl⟩) (f i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_zeroLocus_restrict_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [← germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
  exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).symm
