name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sectRes_sum_smul
statement:
lemma sectRes_sum_smul {U V : Opens Y} (h : U ≤ V) {q : ℕ} (a : Fin q → Y.presheaf.obj (op V))
    (s : Fin q → M.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectRes M h (∑ i, a i • s i) = ∑ i, Y.res h (a i) • sectRes M h (s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectRes_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ sectRes_smul M h _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.HasLocalModuleRelations.hasLocalTupleRelations
statement:
theorem HasLocalModuleRelations.hasLocalTupleRelations (hM : HasLocalModuleRelations M) :
    HasLocalTupleRelations M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro V q m
  induction m generalizing V q with
  | zero =>
    intro v x hx
    refine ⟨V, le_rfl, q, fun l i ↦ if l = i then 1 else 0, hx, fun l j ↦ j.elim0,
      fun W' hW' a _ y hy ↦ ⟨W', le_rfl, hy, a, fun i ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb ↦ by rw [if_neg hb, res_zero, mul_zero])
      (by simp), if_pos rfl, res_self]
    exact (mul_one _).symm.trans (congrArg _ (map_one _).symm)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro v x hx
    obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, k₁, r, hx₁, hr, hrgen⟩ := hM V q (fun i ↦ v i 0) x hx
    let w : Fin k₁ → Fin m → M.val.obj (op W₁) := fun σ j ↦
      ∑ i, r σ i • sectRes M h₁ (v i j.succ)
    obtain ⟨W, h, k, ρ, hxW, hρ, hρgen⟩ := ih W₁ k₁ w x hx₁
    refine ⟨W, h.trans h₁, k, fun l i ↦ ∑ σ, ρ l σ * Y.res h (r σ i), hxW, fun l j ↦ ?_,
      fun W' hW' a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
    · have e : ∑ i, (∑ σ, ρ l σ * Y.res h (r σ i)) • sectRes M (h.trans h₁) (v i j) =
          ∑ σ, ρ l σ • sectRes M h (∑ i, r σ i • sectRes M h₁ (v i j)) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_smul, sectRes_sum_smul, sectRes_sectRes, Finset.smul_sum,
          mul_smul]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [e]
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => simp only [hr, sectRes_zero, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      | succ j => exact hρ l j
    · 
      have ha0 : ∑ i, a i • sectRes M (hW'.trans (h.trans h₁)) (v i 0) = 0 := ha 0
      obtain ⟨W₂, h₂, hy₂, c₁, hc₁⟩ := hrgen W' (hW'.trans h) a ha0 y hy
      
      have hc₁rel : ∀ j, ∑ σ, c₁ σ • sectRes M (h₂.trans (hW'.trans h)) (w σ j) = 0 := by
        intro j
        have e : ∑ σ, c₁ σ • sectRes M (h₂.trans (hW'.trans h)) (w σ j) =
            sectRes M h₂ (∑ i, a i • sectRes M (hW'.trans (h.trans h₁)) (v i j.succ)) := by
          simp only [w, sectRes_sum_smul, sectRes_sectRes, Finset.smul_sum, hc₁,
            Finset.sum_smul, mul_smul]
          exact Finset.sum_comm
        rw [e, ha j.succ, sectRes_zero]
      obtain ⟨W₃, h₃, hy₃, c₂, hc₂⟩ := hρgen W₂ (h₂.trans hW') c₁ hc₁rel y hy₂
      refine ⟨W₃, h₃.trans h₂, hy₃, c₂, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [← res_res _ h₃ h₂, hc₁, res_sum]
      simp only [res_mul, res_res, hc₂, Finset.sum_mul, res_sum, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      exact Finset.sum_comm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_localRelations_of_tuple
statement:
theorem exists_localRelations_of_tuple (hM : HasLocalTupleRelations M)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) {V : Opens Y} {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k → N.val.obj (op V))
    {x : Y} {W₀ : Opens Y} (hW₀ : W₀ ≤ V) (hx : x ∈ W₀) {L m : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (k + L) → Fin m → M.val.obj (op W₀))
    (hsound : ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (h : W' ≤ W₀) (b : Fin (k + L) → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
      (∀ j, ∑ i, b i • sectRes M h (v i j) = 0) →
        ∑ i, b (Fin.castAdd L i) • sectRes N (h.trans hW₀) (t i) = 0)
    (hcompl : ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (h : W' ≤ W₀) (a : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
      ∑ i, a i • sectRes N (h.trans hW₀) (t i) = 0 → ∀ y ∈ W',
        ∃ (W'' : Opens Y) (h'' : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧ ∃ c : Fin L → Y.presheaf.obj (op W''),
          ∀ j, ∑ i, Fin.append (fun i ↦ Y.res h'' (a i)) c i • sectRes M (h''.trans h) (v i j)
            = 0) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y) (hWV : W ≤ V) (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → (Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W))),
      x ∈ W ∧ (∀ l, ∑ i, g l i • sectRes N hWV (t i) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (hW' : W' ≤ W) (a : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
        (∑ i, a i • sectRes N (hW'.trans hWV) (t i) = 0) → ∀ y ∈ W',
          ∃ (W'' : Opens Y) (hW'' : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧
            ∃ c : Fin n → Y.presheaf.obj (op W''),
              ∀ i, Y.res hW'' (a i) = ∑ l, c l * Y.res (hW''.trans hW') (g l i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, n, G, hxW, hG, hGgen⟩ := hM W₀ (k + L) m v x hx
  refine ⟨W, hW.trans hW₀, n, fun l i ↦ G l (Fin.castAdd L i), hxW,
    fun l ↦ hsound W hW (G l) (hG l), fun W' hW' a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W'', h'', hy'', c, hc⟩ := hcompl W' (hW'.trans hW) a ha y hy
  obtain ⟨W₃, h₃, hy₃, d, hd⟩ := hGgen W'' (h''.trans hW') _ hc y hy''
  refine ⟨W₃, h₃.trans h'', hy₃, d, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have := hd (Fin.castAdd L i)
  rw [Fin.append_left, res_res] at this
  rw [this]

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_subset
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_subset
    (i : W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1))
    (hi : IsClosedEmbedding (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _))
    {q : (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ) → Polynomial ℂ}
    (hm : ∀ w, (q w).Monic) (hd : ∀ w, (q w).natDegree = d)
    (hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun w ↦ (q w).coeff j)
    (hrange : Set.range (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _) ⊆
      {z | (q (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).1).eval (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).2 = 0}) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n)
proof:
:= by
  refine AnalyticSpace.isFinite_comp_of_isClosedEmbedding i _ hi (fun t ht hsub ↦ ?_) (fun s ↦ ?_)
  · have himg : ⇑(AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom.base '' t
        = Prod.fst '' (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n '' t) := by
      rw [base_proj_eq]
      exact Set.image_comp _ _ _
    rw [himg]
    refine Polynomial.isClosed_fst_image_of_monic hm hd hc
      ((uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n).isClosedMap t ht) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hrange (hsub hz)
  · refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.preimage (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n).injective.injOn
      (Polynomial.finite_inter_fst_preimage_of_monic hm s fun y hy ↦ hy)) ?_
    intro z hz
    have hfib := hz.2
    rw [base_proj_eq] at hfib
    exact ⟨hrange hz.1, hfib⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_eq
    (i : W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1))

    {q : (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ) → Polynomial ℂ}
    (hm : ∀ w, (q w).Monic) (hd : ∀ w, (q w).natDegree = d)
    (hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun w ↦ (q w).coeff j)
    (hrange : Set.range (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _) =
      {z | (q (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).1).eval (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).2 = 0}) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n)
proof:
:=
  isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_subset.{u} i hi hm hd hc hrange.subset

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_proj_of_isCutOutBy
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_proj_of_isCutOutBy
    (i : W ⟶ AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1))
    {F : OkaRing (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ))}
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i.toLRSHom ![F])
    {q : (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ) → Polynomial ℂ}
    (hm : ∀ w, (q w).Monic) (hd : ∀ w, (q w).natDegree = d)
    (hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun w ↦ (q w).coeff j)
    (hF : ∀ z, OkaRing.evalHom (U := ⊤) (x := z) trivial F =
      (q (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).1).eval (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).2) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n)
proof:
:=
  isFinite_comp_proj_of_range_eq i hcut.isClosedEmbedding hm hd hc
    ((range_base_eq_of_isCutOutBy i hcut).trans (by simp only [hF]))

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.map_mem
statement: lemma map_mem (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) {f : T} (hf : f ∈ K) (i : ι) : κ i f ∈ I i
proof:
:=
  (h.forall_mem_iff f).2 hf i

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.exists_single
statement:
lemma exists_single (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) (i : ι) (q : Q i) :
    ∃ f : T, κ i f - q ∈ I i ∧ ∀ j ≠ i, κ j f ∈ I j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem (Pi.single i q)
  refine ⟨f, by simpa using hf i, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj] using hf j

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.exists_mem_of_mem_map
statement:
lemma exists_mem_of_mem_map (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) (𝔞 : Ideal T) (i : ι)
    {x : Q i} (hx : x ∈ 𝔞.map (κ i)) :
    ∃ g ∈ 𝔞, κ i g - x ∈ I i ∧ ∀ j ≠ i, κ j g ∈ I j
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨e, he, he'⟩ := h.exists_single i 1
    refine ⟨e * a, 𝔞.mul_mem_left e ha, ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_mul, ← sub_one_mul]
      exact (I i).mul_mem_right _ he
    · rw [map_mul]
      exact (I j).mul_mem_right _ (he' j hj)
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 𝔞.zero_mem, by simp, fun j _ ↦ by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgi, hgj⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨g', hg', hgi', hgj'⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨g + g', 𝔞.add_mem hg hg', ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
      exact (I i).add_mem hgi hgi'
    · rw [map_add]
      exact (I j).add_mem (hgj j hj) (hgj' j hj)
  | smul y x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgi, hgj⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ := h.exists_single i y
    refine ⟨w * g, 𝔞.mul_mem_left w hg, ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    · have e : κ i (w * g) - y • x = κ i w * (κ i g - x) + (κ i w - y) * x := by
        rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
        ring
      rw [e]
      exact (I i).add_mem ((I i).mul_mem_left _ hgi) ((I i).mul_mem_right _ hw)
    · rw [map_mul]
      exact (I j).mul_mem_left _ (hgj j hj)

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.sup
statement:
theorem sup [Finite ι] (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) (𝔞 : Ideal T) :
    IsPiQuotient κ (fun i ↦ I i ⊔ 𝔞.map (κ i)) (K ⊔ 𝔞) where
  exists_sub_mem q
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem q
    exact ⟨f, fun i ↦ Ideal.mem_sup_left (hf i)⟩
  forall_mem_iff f := by
    classical
    have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    constructor
    · intro hf
      have hx : ∀ i, ∃ g ∈ 𝔞, κ i f - κ i g ∈ I i ∧ ∀ j ≠ i, κ j g ∈ I j := fun i ↦ by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (hf i)
        obtain ⟨g, hg, hgi, hgj⟩ := h.exists_mem_of_mem_map 𝔞 i hz
        refine ⟨g, hg, ?_, hgj⟩
        have e : κ i f - κ i g = y - (κ i g - z) := by
          rw [← hyz]
          ring
        rw [e]
        exact (I i).sub_mem hy hgi
      choose g hg hgi hgj using hx
      have hK : f - ∑ i, g i ∈ K := by
        rw [← h.forall_mem_iff]
        intro j
        rw [map_sub, map_sum, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j),
          sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
        exact (I j).sub_mem (hgi j) (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦
          hgj i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi).symm)
      have := Submodule.add_mem_sup hK (Ideal.sum_mem 𝔞 (t := Finset.univ) fun i _ ↦ hg i)
      rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
    · intro hf i
      obtain ⟨k, hk, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hf
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (h.map_mem hk i) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.comp
statement:
theorem comp {δ : Type*} {R : ι → δ → Type*} [∀ i d, CommRing (R i d)]
    (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) {ψ : ∀ i d, Q i →+* R i d} {J : ∀ i d, Ideal (R i d)}
    (hψ : ∀ i, IsPiQuotient (ψ i) (J i) (I i)) :
    IsPiQuotient (fun p : ι × δ ↦ (ψ p.1 p.2).comp (κ p.1)) (fun p ↦ J p.1 p.2) K where
  exists_sub_mem r
proof:
:= by
    choose q hq using fun i ↦ (hψ i).exists_sub_mem (fun d ↦ r (i, d))
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem q
    refine ⟨f, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
    have := (J p.1 p.2).add_mem ((hψ p.1).map_mem (hf p.1) p.2) (hq p.1 p.2)
    rwa [map_sub, sub_add_sub_cancel] at this
  forall_mem_iff f := by
    rw [← h.forall_mem_iff]
    exact ⟨fun hf i ↦ ((hψ i).forall_mem_iff _).1 fun d ↦ hf (i, d),
      fun hf p ↦ ((hψ p.1).forall_mem_iff _).2 (hf p.1) p.2⟩

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.polynomial
statement:
theorem polynomial [Finite ι] (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) {P : T[X]} (hP : P.Monic) :
    IsPiQuotient (fun i ↦ mapRingHom (κ i)) (fun i ↦ span {P.map (κ i)} ⊔ (I i).map C)
      (span {P} ⊔ K.map C) where
  exists_sub_mem q
proof:
:= by
    classical
    have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    choose α hα using fun j : ℕ ↦ h.exists_sub_mem (fun i ↦ (q i).coeff j)
    let N := Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (q i).natDegree
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), C (α j) * X ^ j, fun i ↦ Ideal.mem_sup_right ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff]
    intro k
    simp only [coe_mapRingHom, coeff_sub, coeff_map, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
      map_sum]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ N
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hj), map_zero])
        (fun hk' ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)) hk'), if_pos rfl]
      exact hα k i
    · have hq : (q i).coeff k = 0 := coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ (q i).natDegree) (Finset.mem_univ i))
          (not_le.1 hk))
      rw [hq, sub_zero, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j hj ↦ ?_]
      · exact zero_mem _
      rw [if_neg, map_zero]
      rintro rfl
      exact hk (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.1 hj))
  forall_mem_iff f := by
    constructor
    · intro hf
      rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial T with hT | hT
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (by simp [Subsingleton.elim f 0])
      have hr : f %ₘ P ∈ K.map C := by
        rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff]
        intro k
        rw [← h.forall_mem_iff]
        intro i
        by_cases hI : I i = ⊤
        · rw [hI]
          trivial
        haveI : Nontrivial (Q i ⧸ I i) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2 hI
        haveI : Nontrivial (Q i) := by
          by_contra h'
          rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at h'
          exact hI (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
        obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (hf i)
        obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hy
        let π := Ideal.Quotient.mk (I i)
        have hz0 : z.map π = 0 := by
          ext l
          rw [coeff_map, coeff_zero, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_C_iff.1 hz l
        have hrf : (f %ₘ P).map (κ i) = (v - (f /ₘ P).map (κ i)) * P.map (κ i) + z := by
          have e1 := congrArg (Polynomial.map (κ i)) (modByMonic_add_div f P)
          simp only [coe_mapRingHom] at hyz
          rw [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, ← hyz] at e1
          linear_combination e1
        have hkey : ((f %ₘ P).map (κ i)).map π =
            (v - (f /ₘ P).map (κ i)).map π * (P.map (κ i)).map π := by
          rw [hrf, Polynomial.map_add, hz0, add_zero, Polynomial.map_mul]
        have hPm : ((P.map (κ i)).map π).Monic := (hP.map _).map _
        have hdeg : (((f %ₘ P).map (κ i)).map π).degree < ((P.map (κ i)).map π).degree := by
          rw [(hP.map (κ i)).degree_map π, hP.degree_map]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_map_le.trans degree_map_le) (degree_modByMonic_lt f hP)
        have h0 : ((f %ₘ P).map (κ i)).map π = 0 := by
          rw [← (modByMonic_eq_self_iff hPm).2 hdeg, modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hPm, hkey]
          exact dvd_mul_left _ _
        have := congrArg (fun p ↦ p.coeff k) h0
        simp only [coeff_map, coeff_zero, π, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at this
        exact this
      rw [← modByMonic_add_div f P]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_right hr)
        (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self P)))
    · intro hf i
      obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hf
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hy
      rw [map_add, map_mul]
      refine Submodule.add_mem_sup (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)) ?_
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff] at hz ⊢
      intro l
      rw [coe_mapRingHom, coeff_map]
      exact h.map_mem (hz l) i

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.reindex
statement:
theorem reindex {ι' : Type*} (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) (e : ι' ≃ ι) :
    IsPiQuotient (fun i' ↦ κ (e i')) (fun i' ↦ I (e i')) K where
  exists_sub_mem q
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem (Equiv.piCongrLeft Q e q)
    refine ⟨f, fun i' ↦ ?_⟩
    have := hf (e i')
    rwa [Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply] at this
  forall_mem_iff f := by
    rw [← h.forall_mem_iff]
    refine ⟨fun hf i ↦ ?_, fun hf i' ↦ hf (e i')⟩
    have := hf (e.symm i)
    rwa [e.apply_symm_apply] at this

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.comp_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem comp_ringEquiv {T' : Type*} [CommRing T'] (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) (e : T' ≃+* T) :
    IsPiQuotient (fun i ↦ (κ i).comp e.toRingHom) I (K.comap e.toRingHom) where
  exists_sub_mem q
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem q
    exact ⟨e.symm f, fun i ↦ by simpa using hf i⟩
  forall_mem_iff f := h.forall_mem_iff (e f)

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : κ = κ' := funext hκ
  obtain rfl : I = I' := funext hI
  exact hK ▸ h

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.restrict
statement:
theorem restrict {Q₀ : Type*} [CommRing Q₀] {κ : ι → T →+* Q₀} {I : ι → Ideal Q₀}
    (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K) {F : Type*} (j : F → ι) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (htop : ∀ i ∉ Set.range j, I i = ⊤) :
    IsPiQuotient (fun y ↦ κ (j y)) (fun y ↦ I (j y)) K where
  exists_sub_mem q
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem (Function.extend j q 0)
    exact ⟨f, fun y ↦ by simpa [hj.extend_apply] using hf (j y)⟩
  forall_mem_iff f := by
    rw [← h.forall_mem_iff]
    refine ⟨fun hf i ↦ ?_, fun hf y ↦ hf (j y)⟩
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range j
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hi
      exact hf y
    · rw [htop i hi]
      trivial

name: Ideal.IsPiQuotient.surjective_and_ker_eq
statement:
theorem surjective_and_ker_eq {O : ι → Type*} [∀ i, CommRing (O i)] (h : IsPiQuotient κ I K)
    (σ : ∀ i, Q i →+* O i) (hσ : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (σ i))
    (hker : ∀ i, RingHom.ker (σ i) = I i) :
    Function.Surjective (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ (σ i).comp (κ i)) ∧
      RingHom.ker (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ (σ i).comp (κ i)) = K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun o ↦ ?_, Ideal.ext fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  · choose q hq using fun i ↦ hσ i (o i)
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.exists_sub_mem q
    refine ⟨f, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have := hf i
    rw [← hker i, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hq i, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  · rw [← h.forall_mem_iff, RingHom.mem_ker]
    simp only [funext_iff, RingHom.pi_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, Pi.zero_apply, ← hker,
      RingHom.mem_ker]

name: Polynomial.Monic.taylor
statement:
lemma Polynomial.Monic.taylor {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (r : R) :
    (taylor r p).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_taylor]
  exact hp

name: LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_renameEmb
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_renameEmb {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e : ι ↪ κ) (P : LocalOkaRing ι) :
    LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (renameEmb e P) = LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff P
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Filter.TendstoCofinite (e : ι → κ) := Filter.tendstoCofinite_of_finite _
  rw [constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_apply, coe_renameEmb,
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_rename]

name: LocalOkaRing.renameEmb_coord
statement:
lemma renameEmb_coord {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e : ι ↪ κ) (i : ι) :
    renameEmb e (coord i) = coord (e i)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Filter.TendstoCofinite (e : ι → κ) := Filter.tendstoCofinite_of_finite _
  ext1
  rw [coe_renameEmb, coe_coord, coe_coord, MvPowerSeries.rename_X]

name: LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_fromPolynomial_eq_eval
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_fromPolynomial_eq_eval (f : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (fromPolynomial f) =
      (f.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).eval 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff.comp (fromPolynomial (n := n)).toRingHom =
      (evalRingHom 0).comp (mapRingHom LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        RingHom.coe_coe, fromPolynomial_C, coe_mapRingHom, map_C, coe_evalRingHom, eval_C]
      rw [incl_eq_renameEmb, constantCoeff_renameEmb]
    · simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        RingHom.coe_coe, fromPolynomial_X, coe_mapRingHom, map_X, coe_evalRingHom, eval_X]
      rw [lastVar_eq_coord, constantCoeff_coord]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h f

name: LocalOkaRing.taylor_neg_taylor
statement:
lemma taylor_neg_taylor {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℂ R] (c : ℂ) (f : R[X]) :
    taylor (algebraMap ℂ R (-c)) (taylor (algebraMap ℂ R c) f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylor_taylor, ← map_add, neg_add_cancel, map_zero, taylor_zero]

name: LocalOkaRing.taylor_taylor_neg
statement:
lemma taylor_taylor_neg {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℂ R] (c : ℂ) (f : R[X]) :
    taylor (algebraMap ℂ R c) (taylor (algebraMap ℂ R (-c)) f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylor_taylor, ← map_add, add_neg_cancel, map_zero, taylor_zero]

name: LocalOkaRing.shiftPoly_apply
statement:
lemma shiftPoly_apply (c : ℂ) (f : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    shiftPoly c f = fromPolynomial (taylor (algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) c) f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LocalOkaRing.shiftPoly_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma shiftPoly_C (c : ℂ) (a : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) : shiftPoly c (C a) = incl a
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftPoly_apply, taylor_C, fromPolynomial_C]

name: LocalOkaRing.shiftPoly_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma shiftPoly_X (c : ℂ) :
    shiftPoly (n := n) c X = coord (Fin.last n) + algebraMap ℂ _ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftPoly_apply, taylor_X, map_add, fromPolynomial_X, fromPolynomial_C, AlgHom.commutes,
    lastVar_eq_coord]

name: LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_shiftPoly
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_shiftPoly (c : ℂ) (f : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (shiftPoly c f) = (f.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).eval c
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftPoly_apply, constantCoeff_fromPolynomial_eq_eval, map_taylor, constantCoeff_algebraMap,
    taylor_eval, zero_add]

name: IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial.monic'
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.monic_of_injective Subtype.val_injective hg.monic

name: IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial.map_constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k g.natDegree with hk | rfl | hk
  · rw [if_neg hk.ne]
    have := hg.apply_zero k (by
      rw [degree_map_eq_of_injective Subtype.val_injective, degree_eq_natDegree hg.monic'.ne_zero]
      exact_mod_cast hk)
    rw [coeff_map] at this
    rw [constantCoeff_apply]
    exact this
  · rw [if_pos rfl, hg.monic'.coeff_natDegree, map_one]
  · rw [if_neg hk.ne', coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hk, map_zero]

name: LocalOkaRing.span_shiftPoly_eq
statement: lemma span_shiftPoly_eq : Ideal.span {shiftPoly c P} = Ideal.span {fromPolynomial g}
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftPoly_apply, hPgu, map_mul]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu _

name: LocalOkaRing.shiftPoly_mem_span_iff
statement:
lemma shiftPoly_mem_span_iff (f : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    shiftPoly c f ∈ Ideal.span {shiftPoly c P} ↔
      taylor (algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (-c)) g ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_shiftPoly_eq hPgu hu, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', shiftPoly_apply]
  have hgm := hg.monic'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    have h0 := (fromPolynomial_eq_divByMonic hg (taylor _ f) (a := a) (b := 0)
      (by rw [degree_zero]; exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 (degree_ne_bot.2 hgm.ne_zero))
      (by rw [map_zero, add_zero, ha])).2
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hgm).1 h0.symm
    refine ⟨taylor (algebraMap ℂ _ (-c)) w, ?_⟩
    rw [← taylor_mul, ← hw, taylor_neg_taylor]
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fromPolynomial (taylor (algebraMap ℂ _ c) v), ?_⟩
    rw [taylor_mul, taylor_taylor_neg, map_mul, mul_comm]

name: LocalOkaRing.exists_shiftPoly_sub_mem
statement:
lemma exists_shiftPoly_sub_mem (h : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ f, shiftPoly c f - h ∈ Ideal.span {shiftPoly c P}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, -, hab⟩ := localweierstrass_division g hg h
  refine ⟨taylor (algebraMap ℂ _ (-c)) b, ?_⟩
  rw [span_shiftPoly_eq hPgu hu, shiftPoly_apply, taylor_taylor_neg, hab,
    show fromPolynomial b - (a * fromPolynomial g + fromPolynomial b) =
      -a * fromPolynomial g by ring]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: LocalOkaRing.rootMultiplicity_map_constantCoeff
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_map_constantCoeff :
    rootMultiplicity c (P.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff) = g.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : taylor c (P.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff) =
      X ^ g.natDegree * u.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← constantCoeff_algebraMap (ι := Fin n) c]
    rw [← map_taylor, hPgu, Polynomial.map_mul, hg.map_constantCoeff]
  have hu0 : (u.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).eval 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← constantCoeff_fromPolynomial_eq_eval]
    exact isUnit_iff.1 hu
  have hne : (u.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hu0 (by rw [h, eval_zero])
  rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_rootMultiplicity, ← taylor_apply, h1,
    rootMultiplicity_mul (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ X_ne_zero) hne),
    rootMultiplicity_eq_zero (p := u.map _) hu0, add_zero]
  simpa using rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow (0 : ℂ) g.natDegree

name: LocalOkaRing.isUnit_shiftPoly_taylor
statement:
lemma isUnit_shiftPoly_taylor {g : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]} {c c' : ℂ}
    (hg : IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial (g.map (localOkaSubring (Fin n)).toSubring.subtype))
    (hc : c' ≠ c) :
    IsUnit (shiftPoly c' (taylor (algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (-c)) g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff, constantCoeff_shiftPoly, map_taylor, constantCoeff_algebraMap,
    hg.map_constantCoeff, taylor_eval, eval_pow, eval_X]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (by rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact sub_ne_zero.2 hc)

name: LocalOkaRing.isPiQuotient_shiftPoly
statement:
theorem isPiQuotient_shiftPoly {P : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]} (hP : P.Monic) (D : Finset ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ c, (P.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).IsRoot c → c ∈ D) :
    Ideal.IsPiQuotient (fun c : D ↦ shiftPoly (n := n) (c : ℂ))
      (fun c ↦ Ideal.span {shiftPoly (c : ℂ) P}) (Ideal.span {P})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose g u hg hgu hu using fun c : ℂ ↦
    exists_weierstrass_factor (hP.taylor (algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) c))
  have hker (c : ℂ) := shiftPoly_mem_span_iff (hg c) (hgu c) (hu c)
  set G : ℂ → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X] := fun c ↦ taylor (algebraMap ℂ _ (-c)) (g c) with hG
  have hGm : ∀ c, (G c).Monic := fun c ↦ (hg c).monic'.taylor _
  have hcop : ∀ c c', c ≠ c' → IsCoprime (G c) (G c') := by
    intro c c' hcc'
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (isUnit_shiftPoly_taylor (hg c') hcc').exists_left_inv
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_shiftPoly_sub_mem (hg c) (hgu c) (hu c) v
    have hmem : shiftPoly c (b * G c' - 1) ∈ Ideal.span {shiftPoly c P} := by
      have e : shiftPoly c (b * G c' - 1) =
          (shiftPoly c b - v) * shiftPoly c (G c') + (v * shiftPoly c (G c') - 1) := by
        rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one]
        ring
      rw [e, hv, sub_self, add_zero]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hker c _).1 hmem
    rw [show taylor (algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (-c)) (g c) = G c from rfl] at ha
    exact ⟨-a, b, by linear_combination ha⟩
  have hdvd : ∀ c, G c ∣ P := fun c ↦ by
    refine ⟨taylor (algebraMap ℂ _ (-c)) (u c), ?_⟩
    rw [hG, ← taylor_mul, ← hgu c, taylor_neg_taylor]
  have hprod : ∏ c ∈ D, G c = P := by
    refine (eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun c _ ↦ hGm c) hP
      (Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (fun c _ c' _ h ↦ hcop c c' h) fun c _ ↦ hdvd c) ?_).symm
    rw [natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ fun c _ ↦ hGm c]
    have e : ∀ c, (G c).natDegree = Multiset.count c (P.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).roots :=
      fun c ↦ by
        rw [hG, natDegree_taylor, count_roots,
          rootMultiplicity_map_constantCoeff (hg c) (hgu c) (hu c)]
    simp only [e]
    rw [Multiset.sum_count_eq_card, IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hP.natDegree_map]
    intro a ha
    exact hD a ((mem_roots (hP.map _).ne_zero).1 ha)
  refine ⟨fun q ↦ ?_, fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  · choose f hf using fun c : D ↦ exists_shiftPoly_sub_mem (hg c) (hgu c) (hu c) (q c)
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.exists_forall_sub_mem_ideal (I := fun c : D ↦ Ideal.span {G c})
      (fun c c' h ↦ (Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff _ _).2
        (hcop c c' (Subtype.coe_injective.ne h))) f
    refine ⟨r, fun c ↦ ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hker c (r - f c)).2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 (hr c))
    rw [map_sub] at h1
    have := Ideal.add_mem _ h1 (hf c)
    rwa [sub_add_sub_cancel] at this
  · rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [← hprod]
      exact Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (fun c _ c' _ h' ↦ hcop c c' h')
        fun c hc ↦ (hker c f).1 (h ⟨c, hc⟩)
    · intro h c
      rw [← hprod] at h
      exact (hker c f).2 ((Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem G c.2).trans h)

name: LocalOkaRing.incl_inclAdd
statement:
lemma incl_inclAdd (m : ℕ) (a : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) :
    incl (inclAdd n m a) = inclAdd n (m + 1) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [inclAdd, inclAdd, incl_eq_renameEmb, renameEmb_trans]
  exact renameEmb_congr (fun i ↦ Fin.castSucc_castAdd i) a

name: LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_inclAdd
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_inclAdd (m : ℕ) (a : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) :
    LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (inclAdd n m a) = LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff a
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_renameEmb _ a

name: LocalOkaRing.germMap_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma germMap_C {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → ℂ) (a : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) :
    germMap n m c (MvPolynomial.C a) = inclAdd n m a
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C _ _ _

name: LocalOkaRing.germMap_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma germMap_X {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → ℂ) (k : Fin m) :
    germMap n m c (MvPolynomial.X k) = coord (Fin.natAdd n k) + algebraMap ℂ _ (c k)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _

name: LocalOkaRing.germMap_comp_C
statement:
lemma germMap_comp_C {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → ℂ) :
    (germMap n m c).comp MvPolynomial.C = (inclAdd n m).toRingHom
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun a ↦ germMap_C c a

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_rootsFinset
statement:
lemma mem_rootsFinset {p : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {c : ℂ} :
    c ∈ rootsFinset p ↔ (p.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff).IsRoot c
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootsFinset, Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots (hp.map _).ne_zero]

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lastVarEquiv_C (r : R) :
    lastVarEquiv m R (MvPolynomial.C r) = C (MvPolynomial.C r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lastVarEquiv]

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_X_last
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lastVarEquiv_X_last : lastVarEquiv m R (MvPolynomial.X (Fin.last m)) = X
proof:
:= by
  simp [lastVarEquiv, finSuccEquiv'_at]

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_X_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lastVarEquiv_X_castSucc (j : Fin m) :
    lastVarEquiv m R (MvPolynomial.X j.castSucc) = C (MvPolynomial.X j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lastVarEquiv, finSuccEquiv'_below (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j)]

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_eval₂
statement:
lemma lastVarEquiv_eval₂ (p : R[X]) (x : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) R) :
    lastVarEquiv m R (p.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C x) =
      p.eval₂ (C.comp MvPolynomial.C) (lastVarEquiv m R x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hom_eval₂]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext fun r ↦ lastVarEquiv_C r

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_polyVar_last
statement:
lemma lastVarEquiv_polyVar_last (P : Fin (m + 1) → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    lastVarEquiv m _ (polyVar P (Fin.last m)) = (P (Fin.last m)).map MvPolynomial.C
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyVar, lastVarEquiv_eval₂, lastVarEquiv_X_last,
    ← eval₂_C_X (p := (P (Fin.last m)).map _), eval₂_map]

name: LocalOkaRing.lastVarEquiv_polyVar_castSucc
statement:
lemma lastVarEquiv_polyVar_castSucc (P : Fin (m + 1) → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X])
    (j : Fin m) :
    lastVarEquiv m _ (polyVar P j.castSucc) = C (polyVar (fun k ↦ P k.castSucc) j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyVar, polyVar, lastVarEquiv_eval₂, lastVarEquiv_X_castSucc, hom_eval₂]

name: LocalOkaRing.germMap_succ
statement:
lemma germMap_succ {m : ℕ} (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) :
    ((shiftPoly (n := n + m) (c (Fin.last m))).comp
      (mapRingHom (germMap n m fun k ↦ c k.castSucc))).comp (lastVarEquiv m _).toRingHom =
      germMap n (m + 1) c
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun k ↦ ?_)
  · simp [incl_inclAdd]
  · induction k using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      simp [Fin.natAdd_last]
      rfl
    | cast j =>
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, lastVarEquiv_X_castSucc, coe_mapRingHom, map_C, germMap_X,
        shiftPoly_C, map_add, AlgHom.commutes, incl_eq_renameEmb, renameEmb_coord]
      rw [Fin.natAdd_castSucc]
      rfl

name: LocalOkaRing.isPiQuotient_germMap_zero
statement:
lemma isPiQuotient_germMap_zero (P : Fin 0 → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) :
    Ideal.IsPiQuotient (fun c : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)) ↦ germMap n 0 fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ))
      (fun c ↦ Ideal.span (Set.range fun k ↦ germMap n 0 (fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ)) (polyVar P k)))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (polyVar P)))
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (n + 0) ↪ Fin n := ⟨Fin.cast (Nat.add_zero n), Fin.cast_injective _⟩
  have h1 : ∀ a, inclAdd n 0 (renameEmb e a) = a := fun a ↦ by
    rw [inclAdd, renameEmb_trans]
    exact (renameEmb_congr (e := e.trans (Fin.castAddEmb 0))
      (e' := Function.Embedding.refl _) (fun i ↦ Fin.ext rfl) a).trans (renameEmb_refl a)
  have h2 : ∀ a, renameEmb e (inclAdd n 0 a) = a := fun a ↦ by
    rw [inclAdd, renameEmb_trans]
    exact (renameEmb_congr (e := (Fin.castAddEmb 0).trans e)
      (e' := Function.Embedding.refl _) (fun i ↦ Fin.ext rfl) a).trans (renameEmb_refl a)
  simp only [Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]
  refine ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨MvPolynomial.C (renameEmb e (q default)), fun c ↦ ?_⟩, fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Subsingleton.elim c default, germMap_C, h1, sub_self]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · rw [MvPolynomial.eq_C_of_isEmpty f]
    simp only [germMap_C, Ideal.mem_bot, MvPolynomial.C_eq_zero]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [← h2 (MvPolynomial.coeff 0 f), h default, map_zero],
      fun h _ ↦ by rw [h, map_zero]⟩

name: LocalOkaRing.isPiQuotient_germMap
statement:
theorem isPiQuotient_germMap (m : ℕ) (P : Fin m → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X])
    (hP : ∀ k, (P k).Monic) :
    Ideal.IsPiQuotient (fun c : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)) ↦ germMap n m fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ))
      (fun c ↦ Ideal.span (Set.range fun k ↦ germMap n m (fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ)) (polyVar P k)))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (polyVar P)))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact isPiQuotient_germMap_zero P
  | succ m ih =>
    classical
    set P' : Fin m → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X] := fun k ↦ P k.castSucc with hP'
    have h' := ih P' fun k ↦ hP k.castSucc
    set Pl : (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)))[X] :=
      (P (Fin.last m)).map MvPolynomial.C with hPl
    have hPlm : Pl.Monic := (hP _).map _
    have hmap : ∀ c' : Fin m → ℂ, Pl.map (germMap n m c') = (P (Fin.last m)).map (inclAdd n m) :=
      fun c' ↦ by rw [hPl, Polynomial.map_map, germMap_comp_C]; rfl
    have hcc : ∀ p : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X],
        (p.map (inclAdd n m)).map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff = p.map LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff :=
      fun p ↦ by
        ext k
        simp only [coeff_map]
        exact constantCoeff_inclAdd m _
    have hW : ∀ i : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P' k)), Ideal.IsPiQuotient
        (fun d : rootsFinset (P (Fin.last m)) ↦ shiftPoly (n := n + m) (d : ℂ))
        (fun d ↦ Ideal.span {shiftPoly (d : ℂ) (Pl.map (germMap n m fun k ↦ (i k : ℂ)))} ⊔
          ((Ideal.span (Set.range fun k ↦ germMap n m (fun k ↦ (i k : ℂ)) (polyVar P' k))).map
            C).map (shiftPoly (d : ℂ)))
        (Ideal.span {Pl.map (germMap n m fun k ↦ (i k : ℂ))} ⊔
          (Ideal.span (Set.range fun k ↦ germMap n m (fun k ↦ (i k : ℂ)) (polyVar P' k))).map
            C) := fun i ↦ by
      refine (isPiQuotient_shiftPoly ?_ _ fun d hd ↦ ?_).sup _
      · rw [hmap]
        exact (hP _).map _
      · rw [mem_rootsFinset (hP _)]
        rwa [hmap, hcc] at hd
    have hc := ((h'.polynomial hPlm).comp hW).comp_ringEquiv (lastVarEquiv m _)
    let ε : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)) ≃
        (∀ k, rootsFinset (P' k)) × rootsFinset (P (Fin.last m)) :=
      (Fin.snocEquiv fun k ↦ rootsFinset (P k)).symm.trans (Equiv.prodComm _ _)
    have hκ : ∀ c : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)),
        ((shiftPoly ((ε c).2 : ℂ)).comp (mapRingHom (germMap n m fun k ↦ ((ε c).1 k : ℂ)))).comp
          (lastVarEquiv m _).toRingHom = germMap n (m + 1) fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ) :=
      fun c ↦ germMap_succ fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ)
    have hlast : ∀ c : (∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)),
        germMap n (m + 1) (fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ)) (polyVar P (Fin.last m)) =
          shiftPoly ((ε c).2 : ℂ) (Pl.map (germMap n m fun k ↦ ((ε c).1 k : ℂ))) := fun c ↦ by
      rw [← hκ c]
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, lastVarEquiv_polyVar_last, coe_mapRingHom]
      rfl
    have hcs : ∀ (c : ∀ k, rootsFinset (P k)) (j : Fin m),
        germMap n (m + 1) (fun k ↦ (c k : ℂ)) (polyVar P j.castSucc) =
          shiftPoly ((ε c).2 : ℂ) (C (germMap n m (fun k ↦ ((ε c).1 k : ℂ)) (polyVar P' j))) :=
      fun c j ↦ by
        rw [← hκ c]
        simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
          RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, lastVarEquiv_polyVar_castSucc, coe_mapRingHom, map_C]
        rfl
    refine (hc.reindex ε).congr hκ (fun c ↦ ?_) ?_
    · refine le_antisymm (sup_le ?_ ?_) (Ideal.span_le.2 ?_)
      · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨Fin.last m, hlast c⟩
      · rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j.castSucc, hcs c j⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
        dsimp only
        induction k using Fin.lastCases with
        | last => exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (by rw [hlast]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
        | cast j =>
          refine Ideal.mem_sup_right ?_
          rw [hcs]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩))
    · have hJ : Ideal.span {Pl} ⊔ (Ideal.span (Set.range (polyVar P'))).map C =
          (Ideal.span (Set.range (polyVar P))).map (lastVarEquiv m _).toRingHom := by
        refine le_antisymm (sup_le ?_ ?_) ?_
        · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, hPl,
            ← lastVarEquiv_polyVar_last P]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨Fin.last m, rfl⟩)
        · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.span_le]
          rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
          rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, hP', ← lastVarEquiv_polyVar_castSucc P j]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j.castSucc, rfl⟩)
        · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.span_le]
          rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
          rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap]
          change lastVarEquiv m _ (polyVar P k) ∈ _
          induction k using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
            rw [lastVarEquiv_polyVar_last]
            exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
          | cast j =>
            rw [lastVarEquiv_polyVar_castSucc]
            exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩))
      rw [hJ]
      exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ (lastVarEquiv m _).bijective

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.injective_base_of_baseChangeFst_eq
statement:
theorem injective_base_of_baseChangeFst_eq {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B)
    [IsFiniteEtale i] (h : baseChangeFst i i = baseChangeSnd i i) :
    Function.Injective i.toLRSHom.base
proof:
:= by
  intro a₁ a₂ hEq
  set z : baseChange i i := ⟨(a₁, a₂), hEq⟩ with hz
  have h1 : (baseChangeFst i i).toLRSHom.base z = a₁ := by rw [base_baseChangeFst]; rfl
  have h2 : (baseChangeSnd i i).toLRSHom.base z = a₂ := by rw [base_baseChangeSnd]; rfl
  rw [← h1, ← h2, h]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.injective_base_of_mono
statement:
theorem injective_base_of_mono {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B)
    [IsFiniteEtale i] [Mono i] :
    Function.Injective i.toLRSHom.base
proof:
:=
  injective_base_of_baseChangeFst_eq i ((cancel_mono i).1 (baseChange_square i i))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.FiniteEtaleOver.injective_base_left_of_mono
statement:
theorem FiniteEtaleOver.injective_base_left_of_mono [Mono i] :
    Function.Injective (i.left.toLRSHom.base : A.left → B.left)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsFiniteEtale i.left := FiniteEtaleOver.isFiniteEtale_left i
  have h : FiniteEtaleOver.selfProdFst i = FiniteEtaleOver.selfProdSnd i :=
    (cancel_mono i).1 (MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext (baseChange_square i.left i.left))
  exact injective_base_of_baseChangeFst_eq i.left
    (congrArg (fun m : FiniteEtaleOver.selfProd i ⟶ A => m.left) h)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.FiniteEtaleOver.inducesIsoOnDirectSummand_of_mono
statement:
theorem FiniteEtaleOver.inducesIsoOnDirectSummand_of_mono [Mono i] :
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtaleOver.{u} X) (u : Z ⟶ B),
      Nonempty (Limits.IsColimit (Limits.BinaryCofan.mk i u))
proof:
:=
  FiniteEtaleOver.inducesIsoOnDirectSummand_of_injective i
    (FiniteEtaleOver.injective_base_left_of_mono i)

name: OkaRing.germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq
statement:
theorem germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq {V V' V'' : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (h : V'' ≤ V) (h' : V'' ≤ V')
    {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ V'') (g : σ → OkaRing V) (g' : σ → OkaRing V')
    (heq : ∀ i (x : ι → ℂ) (hx : x ∈ V''), evalHom (h hx) (g i) = evalHom (h' hx) (g' i)) :
    germVec (h hy) g = germVec (h' hy) g'
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  rw [germVec_apply, germVec_apply, ← germ_restrict h hy, ← germ_restrict h' hy]
  congr 1
  exact OkaRing.ext (funext fun x ↦ heq i x.1 x.2)

name: OkaRing.germVec_restrict_mulVec_mem_span
statement:
theorem germVec_restrict_mulVec_mem_span {W V : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (h : V ≤ W) {τ : Type*}
    [Fintype τ] (A : Matrix σ τ (OkaRing W)) (c : τ → OkaRing V) {z : ι → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ V) :
    germVec hz ((A.map (restrict h)) *ᵥ c) ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
      (range fun j ↦ germVec (h hz) fun i ↦ A i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ∀ j, germVec (h hz) (fun i ↦ A i j) =
      germVec hz fun i ↦ (A.map (restrict h)) i j := fun j ↦ by
    ext i : 1
    simp
  simp_rw [hA]
  exact germVec_mulVec_mem_span _ c hz

name: OkaRing.exists_forall_mem_span_of_germVec_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_forall_mem_span_of_germVec_mem_span [Finite σ] {W : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {τ : Type*}
    [Finite τ] (A : Matrix σ τ (OkaRing W)) (f : σ → OkaRing W) {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ W)
    (hf : germVec hy f ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
      (range fun j ↦ germVec hy fun i ↦ A i j)) :
    ∃ (V₀ : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (h : V₀ ≤ W), y ∈ V₀ ∧ ∀ (z : ι → ℂ) (hz : z ∈ V₀),
      germVec (h hz) f ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
        (range fun j ↦ germVec (h hz) fun i ↦ A i j)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite τ
  obtain ⟨V₀, h, hyV₀, c, hc⟩ := exists_restrict_eq_mulVec A f hy hf
  refine ⟨V₀, h, hyV₀, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  have hf' : germVec (h hz) f = germVec hz ((A.map (restrict h)) *ᵥ c) := by
    ext i : 1
    rw [germVec_apply, ← germ_restrict h hz, germVec_apply, hc i]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply]
    exact congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ mul_comm _ _)
  rw [hf']
  exact germVec_restrict_mulVec_mem_span h A c hz

name: OkaRing.exists_forall_ge_eq_of_monotone
statement:
theorem exists_forall_ge_eq_of_monotone [Finite σ] {W : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {x₀ : ι → ℂ}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (N : ℕ → (ι → ℂ) → Submodule (LocalOkaRing ι) (σ → LocalOkaRing ι))
    (hN : Monotone N)
    {τ : ℕ → Type*} [∀ k, Finite (τ k)] (A : ∀ k, Matrix σ (τ k) (OkaRing W))
    (hA : ∀ k (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W),
      N k y = Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι) (range fun j ↦ germVec hy fun i ↦ A k i j)) :
    ∃ V : Opens (ι → ℂ), x₀ ∈ V ∧ V ≤ W ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ V, N k y = N k₀ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 W.isOpen x₀ hx₀
  set r := ε / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hε
  have hKW : closedBall x₀ r ⊆ W := (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hεW
  
  let D : ℕ → Submodule ℂ (σ → OkaRing W) := fun k ↦
    ⨅ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W) (_ : y ∈ closedBall x₀ r),
      ((N k y).restrictScalars ℂ).comap (germVec hy)
  
  let E : Submodule ℂ (σ → OkaRing W) := ⨅ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W),
    ((⨆ k, N k y).restrictScalars ℂ).comap (germVec hy)
  have mem_D : ∀ k f, f ∈ D k ↔ ∀ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W), y ∈ closedBall x₀ r →
      germVec hy f ∈ N k y := fun k f ↦ by
    simp only [D, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
  have mem_E : ∀ f, f ∈ E ↔ ∀ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W), germVec hy f ∈ ⨆ k, N k y := fun f ↦ by
    simp only [E, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
  have hEc : IsClosed (E : Set (σ → OkaRing W)) := by
    have : (E : Set (σ → OkaRing W)) =
        ⋂ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W), {f | germVec hy f ∈ ⨆ k, N k y} := by
      ext f
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_E, mem_iInter, mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun y ↦ isClosed_iInter fun hy ↦ isClosed_setOf_germVec_mem hy _
  have hDc : ∀ k, IsClosed (D k : Set (σ → OkaRing W)) := fun k ↦ by
    have : (D k : Set (σ → OkaRing W)) = ⋂ (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ W) (_ : y ∈ closedBall x₀ r),
        {f | germVec hy f ∈ N k y} := by
      ext f
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_D, mem_iInter, mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun y ↦ isClosed_iInter fun hy ↦ isClosed_iInter fun _ ↦
      isClosed_setOf_germVec_mem hy _
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := hEc.completeSpace_coe
  haveI : (uniformity E).IsCountablyGenerated :=
    inferInstanceAs (uniformity (E : Set (σ → OkaRing W))).IsCountablyGenerated
  let C : ℕ → Submodule ℂ E := fun k ↦ (D k).comap E.subtype
  have hCc : ∀ k, IsClosed (C k : Set E) := fun k ↦ (hDc k).preimage continuous_subtype_val
  
  have hcov : ⋃ k, (C k : Set E) = univ := by
    refine eq_univ_of_forall fun f ↦ mem_iUnion.2 ?_
    have hloc : ∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ r, ∃ k, ∃ O : Set (ι → ℂ), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧
        ∀ (z : ι → ℂ) (hz : z ∈ W), z ∈ O → germVec hz f.1 ∈ N k z := by
      intro y hyK
      have hy := hKW hyK
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _
        (show Monotone fun k ↦ N k y from fun _ _ h ↦ hN h y).directed_le).1
        ((mem_E f.1).1 f.2 y hy)
      rw [hA k y hy] at hk
      obtain ⟨V₀, h, hyV₀, hV₀⟩ := exists_forall_mem_span_of_germVec_mem_span (A k) f.1 hy hk
      refine ⟨k, V₀, V₀.isOpen, hyV₀, fun z hz hzO ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [hA k z hz]
      exact hV₀ z hzO
    choose! k O hO hyO hkO using hloc
    obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r).elim_nhds_subcover O
      fun y hy ↦ (hO y hy).mem_nhds (hyO y hy)
    refine ⟨t.sup k, (mem_D _ _).2 fun z hz hzK ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hyt, hzy⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcover hzK)
    exact hN (Finset.le_sup (f := k) hyt) z (hkO y (htK y hyt) z hz hzy)
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := nonempty_interior_of_iUnion_of_closed hCc hcov
  have htop : C k₀ = ⊤ := (C k₀).eq_top_of_nonempty_interior' hk₀
  refine ⟨⟨ball x₀ r, isOpen_ball⟩, mem_ball_self hr, fun y hy ↦ hKW (ball_subset_closedBall hy),
    k₀, fun k hk y hyV ↦ le_antisymm ?_ (hN hk y)⟩
  have hyK : y ∈ closedBall x₀ r := ball_subset_closedBall hyV
  have hy : y ∈ W := hKW hyK
  rw [hA k y hy, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hcol : (fun i ↦ A k i j) ∈ E := (mem_E _).2 fun z hz ↦ by
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem k ?_
    rw [hA k z hz]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have : (⟨_, hcol⟩ : E) ∈ C k₀ := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  exact (mem_D _ _).1 this y hy hyK

name: ComplexAnalytic.locallyInRange_app
statement:
lemma locallyInRange_app (φ : F ⟶ M) {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (t : F.val.obj (op W)) :
    LocallyInRange φ (φ.val.app (op W) t)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hy ↦ ⟨W, le_rfl, hy, t, (modRes_self _).symm⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.app_modRes
statement:
lemma app_modRes (φ : F ⟶ M) {W W' : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W' ≤ W)
    (t : F.val.obj (op W)) :
    φ.val.app (op W') (modRes t W' h) = modRes (φ.val.app (op W) t) W' h
proof:
:=
  PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply φ.val (homOfLE h).op t

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_freeOka
statement:
lemma evalHom_freeOka {x : ι → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ imageOpens f W)
    (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)) (i : b) :
    OkaRing.evalHom hx (freeOka f s i) = secEval f hx (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W) s i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_freeOka_modRes
statement:
lemma evalHom_freeOka_modRes (h : W' ≤ W) {x : ι → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ imageOpens f W')
    (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)) (i : b) :
    OkaRing.evalHom hx (freeOka f (modRes s W' h) i) =
      OkaRing.evalHom (mem_imageOpens_of_le h hx) (freeOka f s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalHom_freeOka, evalHom_freeOka, modRes, SheafOfModules.freeEval_naturality]
  exact secEval_map h hx _

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_freeOka_sum_smul
statement:
lemma evalHom_freeOka_sum_smul {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {x : ι → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ imageOpens f W)
    (c : κ → Y.presheaf.obj (op W))
    (s : κ → (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)) (i : b) :
    OkaRing.evalHom hx (freeOka f (∑ j, c j • s j) i) =
      ∑ j, secEval f hx (c j) * OkaRing.evalHom hx (freeOka f (s j) i)
proof:
:= by
  let ev : Y.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W) →+* ℂ := secEval f hx
  rw [evalHom_freeOka]
  change ev _ = ∑ j, ev (c j) * ev _
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have h := (SheafOfModules.freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf) (I := b) (op W)).map_smul (c j) (s j)
  exact (congrArg (fun v ↦ ev (v i)) h).trans (map_mul ev (c j) _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.free_ext
proof:
:=
  SheafOfModules.freeEval_injective (op W) (funext fun i ↦ sec_ext fun x hx ↦ h i x hx)

name: ComplexAnalytic.mem_of_mem_imageOpens
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_imageOpens {y : Y} (h : f.base y ∈ imageOpens f W) : y ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h
  rwa [← (isOpenEmbedding_base (f := f)).injective hzy]

name: ComplexAnalytic.germVec_freeOka_mem_span
statement:
theorem germVec_freeOka_mem_span [Fintype I] (hg : GeneratesLocally g)
    {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace}
    {s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)} (hs : LocallyInRange φ s)
    {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ imageOpens f W) (hyO : y ∈ O) :
    OkaRing.germVec hy (freeOka f s) ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
      (range fun j ↦ OkaRing.germVec hyO fun i ↦ genMatrix f φ g hO i j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'W, hyy⟩ := id hy
  have hy'W₀ : y' ∈ W₀ := mem_of_mem_imageOpens (f := f) (hyy ▸ hO hyO)
  obtain ⟨W₁, h₁, hy'₁, t, ht⟩ := hs y' hy'W
  obtain ⟨W₃, h₃, hy'₃, c, hc⟩ :=
    hg (W₁ ⊓ W₀) inf_le_right (modRes t _ inf_le_left) y' ⟨hy'₁, hy'W₀⟩
  have h₃₁ : W₃ ≤ W := h₃.trans (inf_le_left.trans h₁)
  have e : modRes s W₃ h₃₁ =
      ∑ j, c j • modRes (φ.val.app _ (g j)) W₃ (h₃.trans inf_le_right) := by
    rw [← modRes_res h₁ (h₃.trans inf_le_left), ← ht, ← app_modRes, ← modRes_res inf_le_left h₃,
      hc, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, app_modRes]
  let V : Opens (ι → ℂ) := imageOpens f W₃ ⊓ O
  have hV₃ : V ≤ imageOpens f W₃ := inf_le_left
  have hVO : V ≤ O := inf_le_right
  have hyV : y ∈ V := ⟨⟨y', hy'₃, hyy⟩, hyO⟩
  let c' : I → OkaRing V := fun j ↦ OkaRing.restrict hV₃ (secOka f (c j))
  have heq : OkaRing.germVec hy (freeOka f s) =
      OkaRing.germVec hyV ((genMatrix f φ g hO).map (OkaRing.restrict hVO) *ᵥ c') := by
    refine OkaRing.germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq (V'' := V)
      (fun x hx ↦ mem_imageOpens_of_le h₃₁ (hV₃ hx)) le_rfl hyV _ _ fun i x hx ↦ ?_
    have := evalHom_freeOka_modRes h₃₁ (hV₃ hx) s i
    rw [e, evalHom_freeOka_sum_smul] at this
    rw [← this]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, map_sum, map_mul,
      OkaRing.evalHom_restrict, genMatrix, c']
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_comm, evalHom_freeOka_modRes]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact OkaRing.germVec_restrict_mulVec_mem_span hVO _ c' hyV

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_app_eq_modRes_of_germVec_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_app_eq_modRes_of_germVec_mem_span [Finite b] [Finite I]
    {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace}
    (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)) {y' : Y} (hy' : y' ∈ W)
    (hyO : f.base y' ∈ O) (hy : f.base y' ∈ imageOpens f W)
    (hmem : OkaRing.germVec hy (freeOka f s) ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
      (range fun j ↦ OkaRing.germVec hyO fun i ↦ genMatrix f φ g hO i j)) :
    ∃ (W₃ : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (h : W₃ ≤ W), y' ∈ W₃ ∧
      ∃ t : F.val.obj (op W₃), φ.val.app (op W₃) t = modRes s W₃ h
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hy'W₀ : y' ∈ W₀ := mem_of_mem_imageOpens (f := f) (hO hyO)
  let V : Opens (ι → ℂ) := imageOpens f W ⊓ O
  have hVW : V ≤ imageOpens f W := inf_le_left
  have hVO : V ≤ O := inf_le_right
  have hyV : f.base y' ∈ V := ⟨hy, hyO⟩
  let A' := (genMatrix f φ g hO).map (OkaRing.restrict hVO)
  let f' : b → OkaRing V := fun i ↦ OkaRing.restrict hVW (freeOka f s i)
  have hmem' : OkaRing.germVec hyV f' ∈ Submodule.span (LocalOkaRing ι)
      (range fun j ↦ OkaRing.germVec hyV fun i ↦ A' i j) := by
    have h1 : OkaRing.germVec hyV f' = OkaRing.germVec hy (freeOka f s) :=
      OkaRing.germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq le_rfl hVW hyV _ _ fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
    have h2 : ∀ j, OkaRing.germVec hyV (fun i ↦ A' i j) =
        OkaRing.germVec hyO fun i ↦ genMatrix f φ g hO i j := fun j ↦
      OkaRing.germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq le_rfl hVO hyV _ _ fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
    simp_rw [h1, h2]
    exact hmem
  obtain ⟨V₀, h₀, hy₀, c, hc⟩ := OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_mulVec A' f' hyV hmem'
  let W₃ : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace := W ⊓ W₀ ⊓ (Opens.map f.base).obj V₀
  have hW₃W : W₃ ≤ W := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hW₃W₀ : W₃ ≤ W₀ := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have himg : ∀ x ∈ imageOpens f W₃, x ∈ V₀ := by
    rintro x ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hz.2
  choose c'' hc'' using fun j ↦ exists_secEval_eq (f := f) (W := W₃)
    (OkaRing.toGlobalFun _ (c j)) ((c j).differentiableOn_toGlobalFun.mono himg)
  refine ⟨W₃, hW₃W, ⟨⟨hy', hy'W₀⟩, hy₀⟩, ∑ j, c'' j • modRes (g j) W₃ hW₃W₀,
    free_ext (f := f) fun i x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have e : φ.val.app (op W₃) (∑ j, c'' j • modRes (g j) W₃ hW₃W₀) =
      ∑ j, c'' j • modRes (φ.val.app _ (g j)) W₃ hW₃W₀ := by
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, app_modRes]
  have hxV₀ := himg x hx
  have := congrArg (OkaRing.evalHom hxV₀) (hc i)
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.evalHom_restrict, f', A', Matrix.map_apply,
    genMatrix] at this
  rw [e, evalHom_freeOka_sum_smul, evalHom_freeOka_modRes, this]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [hc'' j x hx, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hxV₀, evalHom_freeOka_modRes]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.ball_subset_closedBox
statement:
lemma ball_subset_closedBox (p : ι → ℂ) (δ : ℝ) :
    ball p δ ⊆ Complex.closedBox (p - fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) (p + fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_ball] at hx
  rw [dist_pi_lt_iff (dist_nonneg.trans_lt hx)] at hx
  intro j _
  have h := hx j
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at h
  have hre := (abs_le.1 ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans h.le))
  have him := (abs_le.1 ((Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans h.le))
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at hre him
  refine Complex.mem_reProdIm.2 ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> linarith

name: ComplexAnalytic.closedBox_subset_closedBall
statement:
lemma closedBox_subset_closedBall (p : ι → ℂ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    Complex.closedBox (p - fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) (p + fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) ⊆ closedBall p (2 * δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_pi_le_iff (by linarith)]
  intro j
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := Complex.mem_reProdIm.1 (hx j (mem_univ j))
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_im,
    Complex.add_im] at h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  refine (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans ?_
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  rw [two_mul]
  exact add_le_add (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩) (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

name: ComplexAnalytic.LocallyInRange.of_le
proof:
:= by
  induction hkk' with
  | refl => exact hs
  | step _ ih => exact hφ _ W s ih

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_locallyInRange_stationary
statement:
theorem exists_locallyInRange_stationary [Finite b] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (f : Y ⟶ complexSpace ι) [LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f] (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations)
    {F : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} [∀ k, (F k).IsCoherent]
    (hpd : ∀ k, ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj (F k)) d)
    (φ : ∀ k, F k ⟶ SheafOfModules.free b)
    (hφ : ∀ k (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
      (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)),
      LocallyInRange (φ k) s → LocallyInRange (φ (k + 1)) s) (y₀ : Y) :
    ∃ V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace, y₀ ∈ V ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      ∀ (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace), W ≤ V →
        ∀ s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W),
          LocallyInRange (φ k) s → LocallyInRange (φ k₀) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set p : ι → ℂ := f.base y₀
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεr⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (isOpenEmbedding_base (f := f)).isOpen_range p (mem_range_self y₀)
  set δ := ε / 4
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have h2δ : 2 * δ < ε := by rw [show δ = ε / 4 from rfl]; linarith
  have hK : Complex.closedBox (p - fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) (p + fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) ⊆ range f.base :=
    (closedBox_subset_closedBall p hδ.le).trans
      ((closedBall_subset_ball h2δ).trans hεr)
  have hpO : p ∈ ball p δ := mem_ball_self hδ
  have hne : (Complex.closedBox (p - fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩) (p + fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨p, ball_subset_closedBox p δ hpO⟩
  choose d hd using hpd
  choose W hKW I hI g hg _ using fun k ↦ exists_sections_closedBox f hY (F k) (hd k) hK hne
  let O : Opens (ι → ℂ) := ⟨ball p δ, isOpen_ball⟩
  have hO : ∀ k, O ≤ imageOpens f (W k) := fun k ↦ (ball_subset_closedBox p δ).trans (hKW k)
  let A : ∀ k, Matrix b (I k) (OkaRing O) := fun k ↦ genMatrix f (φ k) (g k) (hO k)
  let N : ℕ → (ι → ℂ) → Submodule (LocalOkaRing ι) (b → LocalOkaRing ι) := fun k y ↦
    if hy : y ∈ O then Submodule.span _ (range fun j ↦ OkaRing.germVec hy fun i ↦ A k i j) else ⊥
  have hNA : ∀ k (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ∈ O),
      N k y = Submodule.span _ (range fun j ↦ OkaRing.germVec hy fun i ↦ A k i j) :=
    fun k y hy ↦ dif_pos hy
  have hN : Monotone N := by
    intro k k' hkk' y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ O
    · rw [hNA k y hy, hNA k' y hy, Submodule.span_le]
      refine range_subset_iff.2 fun j ↦ ?_
      have h1 : OkaRing.germVec hy (fun i ↦ A k i j) =
          OkaRing.germVec (hO k hy) (freeOka f ((φ k).val.app _ (g k j))) :=
        OkaRing.germVec_eq_of_evalHom_eq le_rfl (hO k) hy _ _ fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
      rw [h1]
      exact germVec_freeOka_mem_span f (φ k') (hO k') (hg k')
        (LocallyInRange.of_le hφ hkk' (locallyInRange_app _ _)) (hO k hy) hy
    · simp only [N, dif_neg hy, le_refl]
  obtain ⟨V, hpV, hVO, k₀, hk₀⟩ := OkaRing.exists_forall_ge_eq_of_monotone hpO N hN A hNA
  refine ⟨(Opens.map f.base).obj V, hpV, k₀, fun k hk W' hW' s hs y' hy' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hyV : f.base y' ∈ V := hW' hy'
  have hyO : f.base y' ∈ O := hVO hyV
  have hy : f.base y' ∈ imageOpens f W' := ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
  have hmem := germVec_freeOka_mem_span f (φ k) (hO k) (hg k) hs hy hyO
  rw [← hNA k _ hyO, hk₀ k hk _ hyV, hNA k₀ _ hyO] at hmem
  exact exists_app_eq_modRes_of_germVec_mem_span f (φ k₀) (hO k₀) s hy' hyO hy hmem

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_locallyInRange_stationary_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem exists_locallyInRange_stationary_complexAffineSpace
    {F : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf}
    [∀ k, (F k).IsCoherent] (φ : ∀ k, F k ⟶ SheafOfModules.free b)
    (hφ : ∀ k (W : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace)
      (s : (SheafOfModules.free
        (R := ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) b).val.obj (op W)),
      LocallyInRange (φ k) s → LocallyInRange (φ (k + 1)) s)
    (y₀ : (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding) :
    ∃ V : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace,
      y₀ ∈ V ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      ∀ (W : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace),
        W ≤ V → ∀ s : (SheafOfModules.free
          (R := ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) b).val.obj
            (op W),
          LocallyInRange (φ k) s → LocallyInRange (φ k₀) s
proof:
:=
  exists_locallyInRange_stationary ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding)
    ((hasLocalRelations_complexSpace _).restrict U)
    (fun k ↦ ⟨n, hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace U (F k)⟩) φ hφ y₀

name: ComplexAnalytic.isNoetherianRing_stalk_restrict
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_stalk_restrict {X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} {U : TopCat.{u}}
    {f : U ⟶ X.toTopCat} (h : IsOpenEmbedding f) (x : U)
    (hX : IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk (f x))) :
    IsNoetherianRing ((X.restrict h).presheaf.stalk x)

name: ComplexAnalytic.IsLocalModel.isNoetherianRing_stalk
statement:
theorem IsLocalModel.isNoetherianRing_stalk {M : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (hM : IsLocalModel M)

proof:

  have hY : IsNoetherianRing
      (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.stalk (i.base x)) :=
    isNoetherianRing_stalk_restrict _ _ inferInstance
  exact isNoetherianRing_of_surjective _ _ (i.stalkMap x).hom (hcut.surjective_stalkMap x)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.liftOpen_fac
statement:

lemma liftOpen_fac : liftOpen φ U h ≫ X.ofRestrict U = φ

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.base_liftOpen

lemma base_liftOpen (z : Z) : ((liftOpen φ U h).toLRSHom.base z).1 = φ.toLRSHom.base z

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.mem_nonvanishing_iff
statement:
lemma mem_nonvanishing_iff {z : X} :
    z ∈ X.nonvanishing a ↔ X.eval (U := ⊤) z trivial a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, eval_apply, evalStalk_eq_zero_iff, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
    not_not]
  exact RingedSpace.mem_top_basicOpen X.toRingedSpace a z

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.nonvanishing_mul
statement: lemma nonvanishing_mul : X.nonvanishing (a * b) = X.nonvanishing a ⊓ X.nonvanishing b
proof:
:=
  RingedSpace.basicOpen_mul X.toRingedSpace a b

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.nonvanishing_pullbackΓ
statement:
theorem nonvanishing_pullbackΓ {Z W : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (φ : Z ⟶ W)
    (a : W.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    Z.nonvanishing (φ.pullbackΓ a) = (Opens.map φ.toLRSHom.base).obj (W.nonvanishing a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Opens.ext (Set.ext fun z ↦ ?_)
  change z ∈ Z.nonvanishing (φ.pullbackΓ a) ↔ φ.toLRSHom.base z ∈ W.nonvanishing a
  rw [mem_nonvanishing_iff, mem_nonvanishing_iff,
    ← eval_c_app φ.toLRSHom φ.isCLinear (U := ⊤) z trivial a]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isUnit_resΓ_of_le_nonvanishing
statement:
theorem isUnit_resΓ_of_le_nonvanishing {U : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ X.nonvanishing a) :
    IsUnit (X.resΓ U a)
proof:
:= by
  have e : X.resΓ U a =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
        U.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom a :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_ofRestrict_apply X.toLocallyRingedSpace U a
  rw [e]
  exact RingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_le_basicOpen X.toRingedSpace a le_top
    (le_trans (le_of_eq (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isOpenEmbedding_obj_top U)) h)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isUnit_resΓ_nonvanishing
statement: theorem isUnit_resΓ_nonvanishing : IsUnit (X.resΓ (X.nonvanishing a) a)
