name: Ideal.map_mem_radical_span
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f hk
  rwa [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp, map_pow] at this

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.eval_map_homOfLE
statement:
lemma eval_map_homOfLE {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ V)
    (s : X.presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    X.eval y hy (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = X.eval y (h hy) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_apply, eval_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.eventually_eval_eq_of_germ_eq
statement:
lemma eventually_eval_eq_of_germ_eq {V W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hxV : x ∈ V) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    {s : X.presheaf.obj (op V)} {t : X.presheaf.obj (op W)}
    (h : X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s = X.presheaf.germ W x hxW t) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ (hyV : y ∈ V) (hyW : y ∈ W), X.eval y hyV s = X.eval y hyW t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, hxO, iV, iW, hO⟩ := X.presheaf.germ_eq x hxV hxW s t h
  filter_upwards [O.isOpen.mem_nhds hxO] with y hyO hyV hyW
  rw [← eval_map_homOfLE (leOfHom iV) hyO, ← eval_map_homOfLE (leOfHom iW) hyO]
  exact congrArg (X.eval y hyO) hO

name: ComplexAnalytic.eval_complexAffineSpace_of_mem
statement:
theorem eval_complexAffineSpace_of_mem {W : Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n)}
    (y : 𝔸) (hy : y ∈ W)
    (s : (𝔸).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    (𝔸).eval (U := W) y hy s =
      OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := y) hy s
proof:
:= by
  set c := OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := y) hy s with hc
  set t : (𝔸).presheaf.obj (op W) :=
    (𝔸).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op ((𝔸).algebraMap c)
  have h1 : (𝔸).stalkAlgMap y c = (𝔸).presheaf.germ W y hy t :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (𝔸).presheaf (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)) y hy _).symm
  have h2 : (𝔸).presheaf.germ W y hy s - (𝔸).stalkAlgMap y c = (𝔸).presheaf.germ W y hy (s - t) :=
    (congrArg ((𝔸).presheaf.germ W y hy s - ·) h1).trans (map_sub _ _ _).symm
  have h3 : OkaRing.evalHom (U := W) (x := y) hy (s - t) = 0 := by
    change c - c = 0
    exact sub_self c
  exact ((𝔸).evalStalk_eq_iff _ _).2 (h2 ▸
    (germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (ι := ULift.{u} (Fin n)) (y := y) (U := W) hy _).2 h3)

name: ComplexAnalytic.isNullstellensatzAt_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem isNullstellensatzAt_complexAffineSpace (w : AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n) :
    (𝔸).IsNullstellensatzAt w
proof:
:= by
  intro W hwW s φ g h
  have h' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (w : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ),
      (∀ j, OkaRing.toGlobalFun W (φ j : OkaRing W) y = 0) →
        OkaRing.toGlobalFun W (g : OkaRing W) y = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [h, W.isOpen.mem_nhds hwW] with y hy hyW hφ
    have := hy hyW fun j ↦ by
      rw [eval_complexAffineSpace_of_mem y hyW, OkaRing.evalHom_apply,
        ← OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply]
      exact hφ j
    rwa [eval_complexAffineSpace_of_mem y hyW, OkaRing.evalHom_apply,
      ← OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply] at this
  have hmem := Ideal.map_mem_radical_span
    (okaStalkEquiv (ι := ULift.{u} (Fin n)) w).symm.toRingHom
    (OkaRing.germ_mem_radical_span_of_eventually hwW (fun j ↦ (φ j : OkaRing W)) g h')
  have hgerm : ∀ t : OkaRing W, (okaStalkEquiv (ι := ULift.{u} (Fin n)) w).symm
      (OkaRing.germ hwW t) = (𝔸).presheaf.germ W w hwW t :=
    fun t ↦ by
      rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      exact (okaStalkEquiv_germ hwW t).symm
  have e1 : (okaStalkEquiv (ι := ULift.{u} (Fin n)) w).symm.toRingHom (OkaRing.germ hwW g) =
      (𝔸).presheaf.germ W w hwW g := hgerm g
  have e2 : ((okaStalkEquiv (ι := ULift.{u} (Fin n)) w).symm.toRingHom ∘
      fun j ↦ OkaRing.germ hwW (φ j : OkaRing W)) = fun j ↦ (𝔸).presheaf.germ W w hwW (φ j) :=
    funext fun j ↦ hgerm _
  rw [e1, e2] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.IsNullstellensatzAt.of_hom
statement:
theorem of_hom {Z Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (i : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ Y.toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (hlin : IsCLinearHom i Z.algebraMap Y.algebraMap) (hi : Topology.IsInducing i.base) {z : Z}
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (i.stalkMap z).hom) {O : Y.Opens} (hzO : i.base z ∈ O)
    {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op O))
    (hf : ∀ l, (i.stalkMap z).hom (Y.presheaf.germ O (i.base z) hzO (f l)) = 0)
    (hrange : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (i.base z), ∀ hw : w ∈ O, (∀ l, Y.eval w hw (f l) = 0) →
      w ∈ Set.range i.base)
    (hY : Y.IsNullstellensatzAt (i.base z)) : Z.IsNullstellensatzAt z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro W hzW s φ g hyp
  
  have hlift : ∀ a : Z.presheaf.stalk z, ∃ (V : Y.Opens) (hV : i.base z ∈ V)
      (b : Y.presheaf.obj (op V)), (i.stalkMap z).hom (Y.presheaf.germ V (i.base z) hV b) = a := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hsurj a
    obtain ⟨V, hV, b, rfl⟩ := Y.presheaf.exists_germ_eq c
    exact ⟨V, hV, b, rfl⟩
  choose V hV Φ hΦ using fun j ↦ hlift (Z.presheaf.germ W z hzW (φ j))
  obtain ⟨VG, hVG, G, hG⟩ := hlift (Z.presheaf.germ W z hzW g)
  
  have hev : ∀ {V' : Y.Opens} (hV' : i.base z ∈ V') (b : Y.presheaf.obj (op V'))
      (a : Z.presheaf.obj (op W)),
      (i.stalkMap z).hom (Y.presheaf.germ V' (i.base z) hV' b) = Z.presheaf.germ W z hzW a →
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, ∀ (hyW : y ∈ W) (hyV : i.base y ∈ V'),
        Z.eval y hyW a = Y.eval (i.base y) hyV b := by
    intro V' hV' b a hab
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply] at hab
    filter_upwards [eventually_eval_eq_of_germ_eq _ hzW hab] with y hy hyW hyV
    rw [← hy hyV hyW]
    exact eval_c_app i hlin y hyV b
  
  set O' : Y.Opens := O ⊓ VG ⊓ Finset.univ.inf V with hO'
  have hO'O : O' ≤ O := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hO'G : O' ≤ VG := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hO'V : ∀ j, O' ≤ V j := fun j ↦ inf_le_right.trans (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ j))
  have hzO' : i.base z ∈ O' :=
    ⟨⟨hzO, hVG⟩, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun j _ ↦ hV j⟩
  set F : Fin (s + k) → Y.presheaf.obj (op O') :=
    Fin.append (fun j ↦ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hO'V j)).op (Φ j))
      (fun l ↦ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hO'O).op (f l)) with hF
  set G' : Y.presheaf.obj (op O') := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hO'G).op G with hG'
  
  have hZ : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, (∀ j, ∀ (hyW : y ∈ W) (hyV : i.base y ∈ V j),
        Z.eval y hyW (φ j) = Y.eval (i.base y) hyV (Φ j)) ∧
      (∀ (hyW : y ∈ W) (hyV : i.base y ∈ VG), Z.eval y hyW g = Y.eval (i.base y) hyV G) ∧
      y ∈ W ∧ (∀ hy : y ∈ W, (∀ j, Z.eval y hy (φ j) = 0) → Z.eval y hy g = 0) :=
    (eventually_all.mpr fun j ↦ hev (hV j) (Φ j) (φ j) (hΦ j)).and
      ((hev hVG G g hG).and (Filter.Eventually.and (W.isOpen.mem_nhds hzW) hyp))
  rw [hi.nhds_eq_comap z, Filter.eventually_comap] at hZ
  have hYhyp : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (i.base z), ∀ hw : w ∈ O',
      (∀ m, Y.eval w hw (F m) = 0) → Y.eval w hw G' = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hZ, hrange] with w hw hwr hwO' hFw
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hwr (hO'O hwO') fun l ↦ by
      have := hFw (Fin.natAdd s l)
      rwa [hF, Fin.append_right, eval_map_homOfLE] at this
    obtain ⟨hφΦ, hgG, hyW, hyp'⟩ := hw y rfl
    rw [hG', eval_map_homOfLE, ← hgG hyW (hO'G hwO')]
    refine hyp' hyW fun j ↦ ?_
    rw [hφΦ j hyW (hO'V j hwO')]
    have := hFw (Fin.castAdd k j)
    rwa [hF, Fin.append_left, eval_map_homOfLE] at this
  
  have hmem := Ideal.map_mem_radical_span (i.stalkMap z).hom (hY O' hzO' F G' hYhyp)
  have hGz : (i.stalkMap z).hom (Y.presheaf.germ O' (i.base z) hzO' G') =
      Z.presheaf.germ W z hzW g := by
    rw [hG', TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    exact hG
  rw [hGz] at hmem
  refine Ideal.radical_mono ?_ hmem
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) m
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, hF, Fin.append_left, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hΦ j]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, hF, Fin.append_right, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hf l]
    exact zero_mem _

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.IsNullstellensatzAt.of_restrict
statement:
theorem of_restrict {X : AnalyticSpace.{u}} {U : X.Opens} {x : X.restrict U}
    (h : (X.restrict U).IsNullstellensatzAt x) : X.IsNullstellensatzAt x.1
proof:
:= by
  intro W hxW s φ g hyp
  set i := (X.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom with hi
  have hlin : IsCLinearHom i (X.restrict U).algebraMap X.algebraMap := (X.ofRestrict U).isCLinear
  have hx : i.base x ∈ W := hxW
  have ht : Tendsto i.base (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (i.base x)) := i.base.hom.continuous.tendsto x
  have hyp' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ hy : i.base y ∈ W,
      (∀ j, (X.restrict U).eval y hy (i.c.app (op W) (φ j)) = 0) →
        (X.restrict U).eval y hy (i.c.app (op W) g) = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ht.eventually hyp] with y hy hyW hφ
    rw [eval_c_app i hlin y hyW]
    exact hy hyW fun j ↦ by rw [← eval_c_app i hlin y hyW]; exact hφ j
  have hmem := h ((Opens.map i.base).obj W) hx (fun j ↦ i.c.app (op W) (φ j))
    (i.c.app (op W) g) hyp'
  set e := (asIso (i.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  have hmem' := Ideal.map_mem_radical_span e.symm.toRingHom hmem
  have hgerm : ∀ a : X.presheaf.obj (op W), e.symm.toRingHom
      ((X.restrict U).presheaf.germ ((Opens.map i.base).obj W) x hx (i.c.app (op W) a)) =
        X.presheaf.germ W (i.base x) hx a := fun a ↦ by
    rw [← LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply]
    exact e.symm_apply_apply _
  have e2 : (e.symm.toRingHom ∘ fun j ↦ (X.restrict U).presheaf.germ ((Opens.map i.base).obj W)
      x hx (i.c.app (op W) (φ j))) = fun j ↦ X.presheaf.germ W (i.base x) hx (φ j) :=
    funext fun j ↦ hgerm (φ j)
  rw [hgerm, e2] at hmem'
  exact hmem'

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isNullstellensatzAt
statement: theorem isNullstellensatzAt (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (x : X) : X.IsNullstellensatzAt x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := X.local_model x
  refine IsNullstellensatzAt.of_restrict (U := U.1) (x := ⟨x, U.2⟩) ?_
  have hY : ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V).IsNullstellensatzAt
      (i.base ⟨x, U.2⟩) := by
    refine IsNullstellensatzAt.of_hom
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V).toLRSHom
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V).isCLinear
      V.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).surjective
      (O := ⊤) trivial Fin.elim0 (fun l ↦ l.elim0) ?_ (isNullstellensatzAt_complexAffineSpace _)
    filter_upwards [V.isOpen.mem_nhds (i.base ⟨x, U.2⟩).2] with w hw _ _
    exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  refine IsNullstellensatzAt.of_hom (Z := X.restrict U.1)
    (Y := (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V) i hlin
    hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing (hcut.surjective_stalkMap _) (O := ⊤) trivial f
    (fun l ↦ ?_) ?_ hY
  · have hker : ((_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.Γgerm
        (i.base ⟨x, U.2⟩) (f l) ∈ RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap ⟨x, U.2⟩).hom := by
      rw [hcut.ker_stalkMap]
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
    exact hker
  · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w _ hw ↦ ?_
    refine (Set.ext_iff.mp hcut.range_base w).mpr fun j ↦ ?_
    exact (eval_eq_zero_iff _).1 (hw j)

name: ComplexAnalytic.mem_cylinder
statement:
theorem mem_cylinder {V : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)} {z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ} :
    z ∈ cylinder V ↔ (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z).1 ∈ V
proof:
:= by
  change (AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom.base z ∈ V ↔ _
  rw [base_proj_eq]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.cylinderHomeo_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cylinderHomeo_apply (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ))
    (z : ↥(cylinder V)) :
    cylinderHomeo V z =
      (⟨(uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z.1).1, mem_cylinder.1 z.2⟩, (uliftSnocHomeo.{u} n z.1).2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.base_projRestrict_eq
statement:
theorem base_projRestrict_eq (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)) :
    ⇑(AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.base = Prod.fst ∘ cylinderHomeo V
proof:
:=
  funext fun z ↦ Subtype.ext
    ((base_restrictHom (AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom V z).trans
      (uliftSnocHomeo_fst _).symm)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Γgerm_resΓ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem Γgerm_resΓ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
    {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)}
    (z : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    (G : OkaRing (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ))) :
    ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm z
        ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict
          (cylinder V)).presheaf.stalk z) ↔
      OkaRing.evalHom (U := ⊤)
        (x := ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
          (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base z) trivial G = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgerm : ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict
      (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm z
        ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G) =
      ((((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap z).hom
        ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).presheaf.Γgerm
          (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
            (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base z) G)) :=
    (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict (cylinder V)).toLRSHom ⊤ z
      trivial G).symm
  rw [hgerm, mem_maximalIdeal_stalkMap_iff]
  exact germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (U := ⊤) trivial G

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_base_eq_of_isCutOutBy_resΓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcut.range_base]
  refine Set.ext fun z ↦ ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (Γgerm_resΓ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff z G).1 (h 0)
  · intro h j
    fin_cases j
    exact (Γgerm_resΓ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff z G).2 h

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_range_eq
    {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)}
    (i : W ⟶ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    (hi : IsClosedEmbedding (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _))
    {q : ↥V → Polynomial ℂ}
    (hm : ∀ w, (q w).Monic) (hd : ∀ w, (q w).natDegree = d)
    (hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun w ↦ (q w).coeff j)
    (hrange : Set.range (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _) =
      {z | (q (cylinderHomeo V z).1).eval (cylinderHomeo V z).2 = 0}) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V)
proof:
:= by
  refine AnalyticSpace.isFinite_comp_of_isClosedEmbedding i _ hi (fun t ht hsub ↦ ?_) (fun s ↦ ?_)
  · have himg : ⇑(AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.base '' t
        = Prod.fst '' (cylinderHomeo V '' t) := by
      rw [base_projRestrict_eq]
      exact Set.image_comp _ _ _
    rw [himg]
    refine Polynomial.isClosed_fst_image_of_monic hm hd hc
      ((cylinderHomeo V).isClosedMap t ht) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hmem := hsub hz
    rw [hrange] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · have hset : Set.range (i.toLRSHom.base : W → _) ∩
        ⇑(AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.base ⁻¹' {s}
        = cylinderHomeo V ⁻¹'
          ({y : ↥V × ℂ | (q y.1).eval y.2 = 0} ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' {s}) := by
      ext z
      simp only [hrange, base_projRestrict_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
        Function.comp_apply, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [hset]
    exact Set.Finite.preimage (cylinderHomeo V).injective.injOn
      (Polynomial.finite_inter_fst_preimage_of_monic hm s fun y hy ↦ hy)

name: ComplexAnalytic.isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_isCutOutBy
statement:
theorem isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_isCutOutBy
    {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)}
    (i : W ⟶ (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    {G : OkaRing (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ))}
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i.toLRSHom
      ![(AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G])
    {q : ↥V → Polynomial ℂ}
    (hm : ∀ w, (q w).Monic) (hd : ∀ w, (q w).natDegree = d)
    (hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun w ↦ (q w).coeff j)
    (hG : ∀ z : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V),
      OkaRing.evalHom (U := ⊤)
        (x := ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
          (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base z) trivial G =
        (q (cylinderHomeo V z).1).eval (cylinderHomeo V z).2) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsFinite (i ≫ AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V)
proof:
:=
  isFinite_comp_projRestrict_of_range_eq i hcut.isClosedEmbedding hm hd hc
    ((range_base_eq_of_isCutOutBy_resΓ i hcut).trans (by simp only [hG]; rfl))

name: ComplexAnalytic.cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_ofRestrict
statement:
theorem cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_ofRestrict
    (y : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    (v : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).presheaf.stalk
      (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base y)) :
    cylinderStalkEquiv V y ((((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom v) =
      LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1))
        (okaStalkEquiv (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
          (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base y) v)
proof:
:= by
  change LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1)) (okaStalkEquiv _
    ((inv (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap y)).hom
      ((((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom v))) = _
  rw [inv_hom_apply]

name: ComplexAnalytic.cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_projRestrict
statement:
theorem cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_projRestrict
    (y : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    (t : ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V).presheaf.stalk
      ((AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.base y)) :
    cylinderStalkEquiv V y (((AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom t) =
      LocalOkaRing.incl (baseStalkEquiv V y t)
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : ((AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom t =
      (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom
        (((AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom.stalkMap _).hom
          ((restrictStalkEquiv (AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom V y).hom.hom t)) :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (stalkMap_restrictHom_eq' (AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom V y) t
  rw [hfac, cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_ofRestrict]
  exact AnalyticSpace.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_uliftProj_apply _

name: ComplexAnalytic.cylinderStalkEquiv_Γgerm_resΓ
statement:
theorem cylinderStalkEquiv_Γgerm_resΓ
    (y : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V))
    (G : OkaRing (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ))) :
    cylinderStalkEquiv V y
        (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm y
          ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G)) =
      LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1))
        (OkaRing.germ (U := ⊤) (y := ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
          (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base y) trivial G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm y
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G) =
      ((((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
        (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom
        ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).presheaf.Γgerm
          (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
            (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base y) G)) from
    (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply
      ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict (cylinder V)).toLRSHom ⊤ y
      trivial G).symm, cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_ofRestrict]
  exact congrArg (LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1))) (okaStalkEquiv_germ _ G)

name: ComplexAnalytic.bijective_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![F]) (x : X)
    (hf : PowerSeries.order (MvPowerSeries.partialEval (Fin.last n)
      ((cylinderStalkEquiv V (i.base x)
        (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict
          (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm (i.base x) F) :
            LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)) = 1) :
    Function.Bijective ((i ≫ (AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom).stalkMap x).hom
proof:
:=
  bijective_stalkMap_comp_of_incl i _ x (baseStalkEquiv V (i.base x))
    (cylinderStalkEquiv V (i.base x))
    (fun t ↦ cylinderStalkEquiv_stalkMap_projRestrict V (i.base x) t)
    (hcut.surjective_stalkMap x) (fun s ↦ hcut.mem_ker_stalkMap_iff x _ rfl s) hf

name: ComplexAnalytic.isIso_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![F]) (x : X)

      ((cylinderStalkEquiv V (i.base x)
        (((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).restrict
          (cylinder V)).presheaf.Γgerm (i.base x) F) :
            LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)) = 1) :
    IsIso ((i ≫ (AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom).stalkMap x)

name: ComplexAnalytic.evalHom_eq_zero_of_isCutOutBy_resΓ
statement:
theorem evalHom_eq_zero_of_isCutOutBy_resΓ
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![(AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G])
    (x : X) :

proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.bijective_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict_of_coeff
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_comp_projRestrict_of_coeff
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![(AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).resΓ (cylinder V) G])
    (x : X)
    (hlin : MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) 1)
      ((OkaRing.germ (U := ⊤)
        (y := ((AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} (n + 1)).ofRestrict
          (cylinder V)).toLRSHom.base (i.base x)) trivial G :
            LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :
          MvPowerSeries (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective ((i ≫ (AnalyticSpace.projRestrict V).toLRSHom).stalkMap x).hom
proof:
:= by

  rw [cylinderStalkEquiv_Γgerm_resΓ, MvPowerSeries.order_partialEval_eq_one_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_apply, LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff_uliftEquiv,
      OkaRing.constantCoeff_germ]
    exact evalHom_eq_zero_of_isCutOutBy_resΓ V hcut x
  · rw [show (Finsupp.single (Fin.last n) 1 : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) =
        Finsupp.embDomain (Equiv.ulift (α := Fin (n + 1))).toEmbedding
          (Finsupp.single (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) 1) by
      rw [Finsupp.embDomain_single]; rfl,
    LocalOkaRing.coeff_uliftEquiv]
    exact hlin

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_local_model_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_local_model_restrict (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (x : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding) :
    ∃ (W : OpenNhds x) (n k : ℕ) (V : Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n))
      (c : (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).restrict W.1.isOpenEmbedding ⟶
        (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding)
      (f : Fin k → ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)),
      IsCutOutBy c f ∧
        IsCLinearHom c
          ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
            (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.resAlgMap X.algebraMap U) W.1)
          (constantsAlgMap n V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₀, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := X.local_model x.1
  set ιU := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding with hιU
  set ι₀ := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding with hι₀
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htpre⟩ := hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1
    ((Opens.map ι₀.base).obj U).2
  set V' : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding) := ⟨t, ht⟩ with hV'
  set W₀ : Opens (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    (Opens.map i.base).obj V' with hW₀
  have hW₀eq : W₀ = (Opens.map ι₀.base).obj U := Opens.ext htpre
  set W : Opens (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    (Opens.map ιU.base).obj U₀.1 with hW
  have hxW : x ∈ W := U₀.2
  
  have hrange : Set.range (((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict
        W.isOpenEmbedding ≫ ιU).base) =
      Set.range (((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict
        W₀.isOpenEmbedding ≫ ι₀).base) := by
    refine Eq.trans (range_ofRestrict_comp X.toLocallyRingedSpace U W) ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (range_ofRestrict_comp X.toLocallyRingedSpace U₀.1 W₀).symm
    rw [hW₀eq]
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨y.1, hy⟩, y.2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨y.1, hy⟩, y.2, rfl⟩
  
  set V'' : Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) := V.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V' with hV''
  have hrange₂ : Set.range ((((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict
        V'.isOpenEmbedding ≫ (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).base) =
      Set.range (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V''.isOpenEmbedding).base) := by
    refine Eq.trans (range_ofRestrict_comp (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) V V') ?_
    exact (LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) V'').symm
  set e₁ := LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange with he₁def
  set e₂ := LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange₂ with he₂def
  have he₁ : IsCLinearHom e₁.hom
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.resAlgMap X.algebraMap U) W)
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.resAlgMap X.algebraMap U₀.1) W₀) :=
    IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ hrange)
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ W).comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict X.toLocallyRingedSpace _ U))
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ W₀).comp
        (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict X.toLocallyRingedSpace _ U₀.1))
  have he₂ : IsCLinearHom e₂.hom
      (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
        (constantsAlgMap n V) V') (constantsAlgMap n V'') :=
    IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ hrange₂)
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ V').comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict_constants n V))
      (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict_constants n V'')
  exact ⟨⟨W, hxW⟩, n, k, V'', (e₁.hom ≫ restrictHom i V') ≫ e₂.hom,
    fun j ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map e₂.inv.op).hom (restrictSections V' f j),
    ((hcut.restrictOpen V').comp_iso e₁).iso_comp e₂,
    (he₁.comp (isCLinearHom_restrictHom hlin V')).comp he₂⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.restrictLE_fac
statement:
lemma restrictLE_fac (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    X.restrictLE h ≫ X.ofRestrict W = X.ofRestrict V
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective (LocallyRingedSpace.restrictLE_fac _ h)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.restrictHom_fac
statement:
lemma restrictHom_fac {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (V : B.Opens) :
    restrictHom f V ≫ B.ofRestrict V = A.ofRestrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V) ≫ f
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective (ComplexAnalytic.restrictHom_fac f.toLRSHom V)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.restrictHom_comp
statement:
lemma restrictHom_comp {A B C : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) (V : C.Opens) :
    restrictHom (f ≫ h) V =
      restrictHom f ((Opens.map h.toLRSHom.base).obj V) ≫ restrictHom h V
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
    (ComplexAnalytic.restrictHom_comp f.toLRSHom h.toLRSHom V)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFinite_restrictHom_of_subset_range

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isLocalIso_restrictHom
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_restrictHom {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) [IsLocalIso f] (V : B.Opens) :
    IsLocalIso (restrictHom f V) where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:= by
    have hsq : ((B.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom.base : B.restrict V → B) ∘
        ((restrictHom f V).toLRSHom.base : _ → B.restrict V) =
        (f.toLRSHom.base : A → B) ∘
          ((A.ofRestrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V)).toLRSHom.base : _ → A) :=
      funext fun x ↦ ComplexAnalytic.base_restrictHom f.toLRSHom V x
    refine IsLocalHomeomorph.of_comp (g := ((B.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom.base : B.restrict V → B))
      ?_ V.isOpenEmbedding.isLocalHomeomorph
      (restrictHom f V).toLRSHom.base.hom.continuous
    rw [hsq]
    exact (IsLocalIso.isLocalHomeomorph (f := f)).comp
      ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V).isOpenEmbedding.isLocalHomeomorph
  isIso_stalkMap x :=
    (ComplexAnalytic.stalkMap_restrictHom_eq' f.toLRSHom V x).symm ▸
      (inferInstance : IsIso ((ComplexAnalytic.restrictStalkEquiv f.toLRSHom V x).hom ≫
        f.toLRSHom.stalkMap ((A.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
            ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V).isOpenEmbedding).base x) ≫
          (A.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
            ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V).isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap x))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.resΓ_restrictLE
statement:
lemma resΓ_restrictLE (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (g : X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictLE h).op).hom (X.resΓ W g) =
      X.resΓ V g
proof:
:=
  (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictLE h)
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict W.isOpenEmbedding) g).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun m : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict V.isOpenEmbedding ⟶
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map m.op).hom g)
      (LocallyRingedSpace.restrictLE_fac X.toLocallyRingedSpace h))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.liftRestrict_fac

lemma liftRestrict_fac {Z X : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (φ : Z ⟶ X) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : Set.range (φ.toLRSHom.base : Z → X) ⊆ (V : Set X)) :
    liftRestrict φ V h ≫ X.ofRestrict V = φ

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.liftTop_ofRestrict
statement:
theorem liftTop_ofRestrict (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = Set.univ) :
    liftTop X U hU ≫ X.ofRestrict U = 𝟙 X
proof:
:=
  liftRestrict_fac (𝟙 X) U (by rw [hU]; exact Set.subset_univ _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_ofRestrict_of_eq_univ
statement:
theorem isIso_ofRestrict_of_eq_univ (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set X) = Set.univ) : IsIso (X.ofRestrict U)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨liftTop X U hU, ?_, liftTop_ofRestrict X U hU⟩
  rw [← cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict U), Category.assoc, liftTop_ofRestrict, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_liftTop
statement:
theorem isIso_liftTop (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = Set.univ) :
    IsIso (liftTop X U hU)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨X.ofRestrict U, liftTop_ofRestrict X U hU, ?_⟩
  rw [← cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict U), Category.assoc, liftTop_ofRestrict, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.liftTop_comp_restrictHom_top
statement:
theorem liftTop_comp_restrictHom_top {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (⊤ : B.Opens) : Set A) = Set.univ) :
    liftTop A _ h ≫ restrictHom f ⊤ ≫ B.ofRestrict ⊤ = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictHom_fac f ⊤, ← Category.assoc, liftTop_ofRestrict, Category.id_comp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFinite_of_restrictHom_top
statement:
theorem isFinite_of_restrictHom_top {A B : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hfin : IsFinite (restrictHom f (⊤ : B.Opens))) : IsFinite f
proof:
:= by
  set U : A.Opens := (Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj (⊤ : B.Opens) with hUdef
  have h : (U : Set A) = Set.univ := rfl
  have hB : ((⊤ : B.Opens) : Set B) = Set.univ := rfl
  haveI : IsIso (B.ofRestrict (⊤ : B.Opens)) := isIso_ofRestrict_of_eq_univ B ⊤ hB
  haveI : IsIso (liftTop A U h) := isIso_liftTop A U h
  haveI : IsFinite (restrictHom f (⊤ : B.Opens)) := hfin
  haveI : IsFinite (B.ofRestrict (⊤ : B.Opens)) := isFinite_of_isIso _
  haveI : IsFinite (liftTop A U h) := isFinite_of_isIso _
  have hp : IsFinite (liftTop A U h ≫ restrictHom f ⊤ ≫ B.ofRestrict ⊤) := inferInstance
  rwa [liftTop_comp_restrictHom_top] at hp

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isClosedEmbedding_ofRestrict_of_isClosed
statement:

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFiniteEtale_ofRestrict_of_isClosed

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isFiniteEtale_ofRestrict_comp
statement:
theorem isFiniteEtale_ofRestrict_comp {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (U : X.Opens)

name: ComplexAnalytic.restrict_eq_ofCutOut
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_ofCutOut (hcut : IsCutOutBy i f)
    (hlin : IsCLinearHom i (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.resAlgMap X.algebraMap U)
      (constantsAlgMap n V)) :
    X.restrict U = AnalyticSpace.ofCutOut hcut
proof:

  AnalyticSpace.ext' rfl (heq_of_eq (RingHom.ext fun c ↦ (hlin c).symm))

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_restrict_eq_ofCutOut
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq_ofCutOut (X : AnalyticSpace.{u}) (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ U) (n k : ℕ) (V : Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n))
      (i : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding ⟶
        (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding)
      (f : Fin k → ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
      (hcut : IsCutOutBy i f), X.restrict U = AnalyticSpace.ofCutOut hcut
proof:

  obtain ⟨U, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := X.local_model x
  exact ⟨U.1, U.2, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, restrict_eq_ofCutOut hcut hlin⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.okaMapFun_coordEmb
statement:
theorem okaMapFun_coordEmb (e : κ ↪ ι) (z : ι → ℂ) :
    okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z = z ∘ e
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [okaMapFun_apply, coordEmb, evalHom_coord]

name: ComplexAnalytic.germ_okaMapC_coordEmb
statement:
theorem germ_okaMapC_coordEmb [Fintype κ] {e : κ ↪ ι} {z : ι → ℂ} {W : Opens (κ → ℂ)}
    (hz : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapBase (coordEmb e))).obj W) (s : OkaRing W) :
    OkaRing.germ hz (okaMapC (coordEmb e) W s)
      = LocalOkaRing.renameEmb e
          (OkaRing.germ (show okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z ∈ W from hz) s)
proof:
:= by
  refine OkaRing.germ_eq_of_represents _ ?_
  refine (LocalOkaRing.renameEmb_represents e
    (OkaRing.germ_represents (show okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z ∈ W from hz) s)).congr ?_
  have hset : IsOpen {w : ι → ℂ |
      w + z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapBase (coordEmb e))).obj W} :=
    ((Opens.map (okaMapBase (coordEmb e))).obj W).isOpen.preimage (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [hset.mem_nhds (by simpa using hz)] with w hw
  have hkey : w ∘ e + okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z = okaMapFun (coordEmb e) (w + z) := by
    rw [okaMapFun_coordEmb, okaMapFun_coordEmb]
    rfl
  have hw' : okaMapFun (coordEmb e) (w + z) ∈ W := hw
  rw [hkey, s.toGlobalFun_apply hw', OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hw]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_coordEmb
statement:
theorem okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_coordEmb [Fintype κ] {e : κ ↪ ι} {z : ι → ℂ}
    {W : Opens (κ → ℂ)} (hw : okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z ∈ W) (s : OkaRing W) :
    okaStalkEquiv z ((okaMapHom (coordEmb e)).stalkMap z
        ((okaCommPresheaf κ).germ W _ hw s))
      = LocalOkaRing.renameEmb e (okaStalkEquiv (okaMapFun (coordEmb e) z)
          ((okaCommPresheaf κ).germ W _ hw s))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapBase (coordEmb e))).obj W := hw
  have hmap : ((okaMapPre (coordEmb e)).stalkMap z).hom
        ((okaCommPresheaf κ).germ W ((okaMapPre (coordEmb e)).base z) hw s) =
      (okaCommPresheaf ι).germ ((Opens.map (okaMapBase (coordEmb e))).obj W) z hz
        (okaMapC (coordEmb e) W s) :=
    PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (okaMapPre (coordEmb e)) W z hw s
  rw [show (okaMapHom (coordEmb e)).stalkMap z
      ((okaCommPresheaf κ).germ W _ hw s) = _ from hmap,
    okaStalkEquiv_germ, okaStalkEquiv_germ, germ_okaMapC_coordEmb]

name: ComplexAnalytic.germ_okaMapC_projCoords

name: ComplexAnalytic.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_projCoords
statement:
theorem okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_projCoords {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ}
    {W : Opens (Fin n → ℂ)} (hw : okaMapFun (projCoords n) z ∈ W) (s : OkaRing W) :
    okaStalkEquiv z ((okaMapHom (projCoords n)).stalkMap z
        ((okaCommPresheaf (Fin n)).germ W _ hw s))
      = LocalOkaRing.incl (okaStalkEquiv (okaMapFun (projCoords n) z)
          ((okaCommPresheaf (Fin n)).germ W _ hw s))

name: ComplexAnalytic.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_projCoords_apply
statement:

    okaStalkEquiv z ((okaMapHom (projCoords n)).stalkMap z t) =
      LocalOkaRing.incl (okaStalkEquiv (okaMapFun (projCoords n) z) t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hw, s, rfl⟩ := (okaCommPresheaf (Fin n)).exists_germ_eq t

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_uliftProj
statement:
theorem AnalyticSpace.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_uliftProj
    {z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ} {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)}
    (hw : okaMapFun (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)) z ∈ W) (s : OkaRing W) :
    LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1))
        (okaStalkEquiv z ((AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom.stalkMap z
          ((okaCommPresheaf (ULift.{u} (Fin n))).germ W _ hw s)))
      = LocalOkaRing.incl (LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin n)
          (okaStalkEquiv (okaMapFun (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)) z)
            ((okaCommPresheaf (ULift.{u} (Fin n))).germ W _ hw s)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_okaMapHom_coordEmb (e := uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n) hw s
  exact (congrArg (fun x ↦ LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1)) x) h).trans
    (LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv_renameEmb_incl (fun _ ↦ rfl) _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_uliftProj_apply
statement:

    {z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ}

      (okaMapFun (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)) z)) :
    LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin (n + 1)) (okaStalkEquiv z
        ((okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).stalkMap z t)) =
      LocalOkaRing.incl (LocalOkaRing.uliftEquiv (Fin n)
        (okaStalkEquiv (okaMapFun (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)) z) t))
proof:

  obtain ⟨W, hw, s, rfl⟩ := (okaCommPresheaf (ULift.{u} (Fin n))).exists_germ_eq t
  exact AnalyticSpace.okaStalkEquiv_stalkMap_uliftProj hw s

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t_fst_fst
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t_fst_fst (i j : I) : t U f g i j ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    pullback.snd _ _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t, Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc, pullbackAssoc_hom_snd_fst,
    pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd, pullbackAssoc_inv_fst_fst,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t_fst_snd
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t_fst_snd (i j : I) :
    t U f g i j ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t, Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc, pullbackAssoc_hom_snd_snd,
    pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id, pullbackAssoc_inv_snd, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t_snd
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t_snd (i j : I) : t U f g i j ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t, Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd, pullbackAssoc_hom_fst,
    pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst, pullbackAssoc_inv_fst_snd,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t_id
statement: theorem t_id (i : I) : t U f g i i = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> rw [Category.id_comp]
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · rw [← cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict (U i))]
      simp only [pullback.condition, Category.assoc, t_fst_fst]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, t_fst_snd]
  · rw [← cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict (U i))]; simp only [pullback.condition, t_snd, Category.assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'_fst_fst_fst
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t'_fst_fst_fst (i j k : I) :
    t' U f g i j k ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t', Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc,
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_inv_snd_fst_assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc, t_fst_fst,
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_fst_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'_fst_fst_snd
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t'_fst_fst_snd (i j k : I) :
    t' U f g i j k ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t', Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc,
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_inv_snd_fst_assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc, t_fst_snd,
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_fst_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'_fst_snd
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t'_fst_snd (i j k : I) :

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'_snd_fst_fst
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem t'_snd_fst_fst (i j k : I) :

    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_fst_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.cocycle_fst_fst_fst
statement:
theorem cocycle_fst_fst_fst (i j k : I) :

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.cocycle_snd_snd

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.cocycle
statement: theorem cocycle (i j k : I) : t' U f g i j k ≫ t' U f g j k i ≫ t' U f g k i j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> rw [Category.id_comp]
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · apply pullback.hom_ext
      · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_fst_fst_fst U f g i j k]
      · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_fst_fst_snd U f g i j k]
    · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_fst_snd U f g i j k]
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · apply pullback.hom_ext
      · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_snd_fst_fst U f g i j k]
      · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_snd_fst_snd U f g i j k]
    · simp_rw [Category.assoc, cocycle_snd_snd U f g i j k]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'Map_cocycle
statement:
theorem t'Map_cocycle (i j k : I) :
    t'Map U f g i j k ≫ t'Map U f g j k i ≫ t'Map U f g k i j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t'Map, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    ← forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_comp_assoc, cocycle]
  rw [forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'Map_snd
statement:
theorem t'Map_snd (i j k : I) :
    t'Map U f g i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      (isoPullbackFV U f g i j k).inv ≫
        forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (t' U f g i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [t'Map, Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp, isoPullbackFV,
    IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_snd]

name: ComplexAnalytic.isCoherent_pullbackModules_of_isCoherent
statement:
theorem isCoherent_pullbackModules_of_isCoherent {Z : AnalyticSpace.{u}}
    {Y : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (f : Z.toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ Y)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) [M.IsCoherent] :
    (f.pullbackModules.obj M).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_of_isCoherent_restrictModules _ _ fun z ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨U, hU, I, K, _, _, ψ, g, H, ⟨hc⟩⟩ :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.exists_restrictModules_isColimit_cokernelCofork Y M (f.base z)
  refine ⟨(Opens.map f.base).obj U, hU, ?_⟩
  have : ((restrictHom f U).pullbackModules.obj ((Y.restrictModules U).obj M)).IsCoherent :=
    isCoherent_pullbackModules_of_isColimit (Z := Z.restrict ((Opens.map f.base).obj U))
      (restrictHom f U) ψ g H hc
  exact @SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.of_iso.{u} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (restrictModulesPullbackModulesIso f U M).symm this

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'_fac
statement:
theorem t'_fac (i j k : I) :
    t' U f g i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ t U f g i j
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  on_goal 1 => apply pullback.hom_ext
  all_goals
    simp only [t'_snd_fst_fst, t'_snd_fst_snd, t'_snd_snd, t_fst_fst, t_fst_snd, t_snd,
      Category.assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.t'Map_fac
statement:
theorem t'Map_fac (i j k : I) :
    t'Map U f g i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (t U f g i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [t'Map_snd, t'_fac]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, isoPullbackFV, IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_fst_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.glueDataCLinear_gluing

proof:
:=
  glueDataCLinear_of_isCLinearHom _ _ (fun p ↦ (v U f g p.1 p.2).algebraMap)
    (fun i j ↦ (fV U f g i j).isCLinear) (fun i j ↦ (Pullback.t U f g i j).isCLinear)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.fV_comp_toBase

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.fV_comp_snd

proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.toBase_comp
statement:

    toBase U f g j ≫ f = pullback.snd (X.ofRestrict (U j) ≫ f) g ≫ g
proof:
:= by

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.ι_p1
statement:
theorem ι_p1 (j : I) :
    (gluing U f g).toGlueData.ι j ≫ (p1 U f g).toLRSHom =
      forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (toBase U f g j)
proof:
:=
  ι_glueMorphismsOfGlueData (gluing U f g) _ (glueDataCLinear_gluing U f g) _
    (fun j ↦ forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (toBase U f g j)) _ _ j

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.ι_p2
statement:
theorem ι_p2 (j : I) :
    (gluing U f g).toGlueData.ι j ≫ (p2 U f g).toLRSHom =
      forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (pullback.snd (X.ofRestrict (U j) ≫ f) g)
proof:
:=
  ι_glueMorphismsOfGlueData (gluing U f g) _ (glueDataCLinear_gluing U f g) _
    (fun j ↦ forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (pullback.snd (X.ofRestrict (U j) ≫ f) g)) _ _ j

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.p_comm
statement: theorem p_comm : p1 U f g ≫ f = p2 U f g ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  apply forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
  refine (gluing U f g).hom_ext _ _ fun j ↦ ?_
  change (gluing U f g).toGlueData.ι j ≫ (p1 U f g).toLRSHom ≫ _ =
    (gluing U f g).toGlueData.ι j ≫ (p2 U f g).toLRSHom ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ι_p1, ι_p2]
  have h := congrArg forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (toBase_comp U f g j)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at h
  exact h

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.liftMember_fst

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.liftMember_snd
statement:

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.overlapLift_fV
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem overlapLift_fV (i j : I) :
    overlapLift U f g s i j ≫ fV U f g i j =
      s.pt.restrictLE (inf_le_left : conePreimage U f g s i ⊓ conePreimage U f g s j ≤ _) ≫
        liftMember U f g s i
proof:

  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.overlapLift_snd
statement:
theorem overlapLift_snd (i j : I) :
    overlapLift U f g s i j ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      s.pt.restrictLE (inf_le_right : conePreimage U f g s i ⊓ conePreimage U f g s j ≤ _) ≫

proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.overlapLift_t_fV
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem overlapLift_t_fV (i j : I) :
    overlapLift U f g s i j ≫ t U f g i j ≫ fV U f g j i =
      s.pt.restrictLE (inf_le_right : conePreimage U f g s i ⊓ conePreimage U f g s j ≤ _) ≫
        liftMember U f g s j
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, t_fst_fst, overlapLift_snd, Category.assoc,
      liftMember_fst]
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, t_fst_snd, overlapLift_fV_assoc, Category.assoc,
      liftMember_snd, liftMember_snd, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, restrictLE_fac,
      restrictLE_fac]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.conePreimage_covers
statement: theorem conePreimage_covers : ∀ p : s.pt, ∃ i, p ∈ conePreimage U f g s i
proof:
:=
  fun p ↦ (hU ((s.fst : s.pt ⟶ X).toLRSHom.base p)).imp fun _ h ↦ h

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.restrictLE_comp_liftMember_comp_ι
statement:
theorem restrictLE_comp_liftMember_comp_ι (i j : I) :
    s.pt.restrictLE (inf_le_left : conePreimage U f g s i ⊓ conePreimage U f g s j ≤ _) ≫
        (liftMember U f g s i ≫ ι U f g i) =
      s.pt.restrictLE (inf_le_right : conePreimage U f g s i ⊓ conePreimage U f g s j ≤ _) ≫
        (liftMember U f g s j ≫ ι U f g j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← overlapLift_fV_assoc, fV_comp_ι, overlapLift_t_fV_assoc]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.ofRestrict_comp_gluedLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofRestrict_comp_gluedLift (i : I) :
    s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ gluedLift U f g s hU =
      liftMember U f g s i ≫ ι U f g i
proof:
:=
  ofRestrict_comp_glueMorphismsOfOpens _ _ _ _ i

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.gluedLift_p1
statement: theorem gluedLift_p1 : gluedLift U f g s hU ≫ p1 U f g = s.fst
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_of_opens (conePreimage U f g s) (conePreimage_covers U f g s hU) fun i ↦ ?_
  have h : liftMember U f g s i ≫ pullback.fst (X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ f) g ≫
      X.ofRestrict (U i) = s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ s.fst := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, liftMember_fst, restrictHom_fac]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ofRestrict_comp_gluedLift, Category.assoc, ι_comp_p1]
  exact h

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.gluedLift_p2
statement: theorem gluedLift_p2 : gluedLift U f g s hU ≫ p2 U f g = s.snd
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_of_opens (conePreimage U f g s) (conePreimage_covers U f g s hU) fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [← Category.assoc, ofRestrict_comp_gluedLift, Category.assoc, ι_comp_p2, liftMember_snd]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.range_base_ι
statement:
theorem range_base_ι (i : I) :
    Set.range ((ι U f g i).toLRSHom.base) =
      ((p1 U f g).toLRSHom.base : glued U f g → X) ⁻¹' (U i : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have hc : (((ι U f g i ≫ p1 U f g)).toLRSHom.base : _ → X) q =
        ((p1 U f g).toLRSHom.base : glued U f g → X)
          (((ι U f g i).toLRSHom.base : _ → glued U f g) q) := rfl
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, ← hc, ι_comp_p1]
    exact (((pullback.fst (X.ofRestrict (U i) ≫ f) g).toLRSHom.base :
      _ → X.restrict (U i)) q).2
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨j, q, hq⟩ := LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.ι_jointly_surjective (gluing U f g) p
    rw [← toLRSHom_ι U f g j] at hq
    have hq' : ((ι U f g j).toLRSHom.base : _ → glued U f g) q = p := hq
    have hmem : ((toBase U f g j).toLRSHom.base : _ → X) q ∈ (U i : Set X) := by
      have hc : (((ι U f g j ≫ p1 U f g)).toLRSHom.base : _ → X) q =
          ((p1 U f g).toLRSHom.base : glued U f g → X)
            (((ι U f g j).toLRSHom.base : _ → glued U f g) q) := rfl
      rw [← ι_comp_p1 U f g j, hc, hq']
      exact hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : q ∈ Set.range ((fV U f g j i).toLRSHom.base) := by
      rw [range_base_pullbackFst_ofRestrict (toBase U f g j) (U i)]
      exact hmem
    refine ⟨(fV U f g i j).toLRSHom.base ((t U f g j i).toLRSHom.base r), ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun (ψ : v U f g j i ⟶ glued U f g) ↦ (ψ.toLRSHom.base : _ → _) r)
      (fV_comp_ι U f g j i)
    rw [← hq', ← hr]
    exact h.symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.isOpenImmersion_toLRSHom_ι
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_toLRSHom_ι (i : I) :
    LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion (ι U f g i).toLRSHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLRSHom_ι]
  exact LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.ι_isOpenImmersion (gluing U f g) i

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.liftι_fac
statement:
theorem liftι_fac {T : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (i : I) (h : T ⟶ glued U f g)
    (hr : Set.range (h.toLRSHom.base : T → glued U f g) ⊆
      Set.range ((ι U f g i).toLRSHom.base)) :
    liftι U f g i h hr ≫ ι U f g i = h
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isOpenImmersion_toLRSHom_ι U f g i
  exact forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
    (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (ι U f g i).toLRSHom h.toLRSHom hr)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι
statement:
theorem range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι (m : s.pt ⟶ glued U f g)
    (h₁ : m ≫ p1 U f g = s.fst) (i : I) :
    Set.range (((s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i)) ≫ m).toLRSHom.base) ⊆
      Set.range ((ι U f g i).toLRSHom.base)
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_base_ι]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hc : (((s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i)) ≫ m).toLRSHom.base : _ → glued U f g) w =
      (m.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → glued U f g)
        (((s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i)).toLRSHom.base : _ → s.pt) w) := rfl
  have hc' : ((m ≫ p1 U f g).toLRSHom.base : s.pt → X)
        (((s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i)).toLRSHom.base : _ → s.pt) w) =
      ((p1 U f g).toLRSHom.base : glued U f g → X)
        ((m.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → glued U f g)
          (((s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i)).toLRSHom.base : _ → s.pt) w)) := rfl
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, hc, ← hc', h₁]
  exact w.2

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.liftι_eq_liftMember
statement:
theorem liftι_eq_liftMember (m : s.pt ⟶ glued U f g)
    (h₁ : m ≫ p1 U f g = s.fst) (h₂ : m ≫ p2 U f g = s.snd) (i : I) :
    liftι U f g i (s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ m)
        (range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι U f g s m h₁ i) =
      liftMember U f g s i
proof:
:= by
  have hfac := liftι_fac U f g i (s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ m)
    (range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι U f g s m h₁ i)
  have htoBase : liftι U f g i (s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ m)
        (range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι U f g s m h₁ i) ≫ toBase U f g i =
      s.pt.ofRestrict (conePreimage U f g s i) ≫ s.fst := by
    rw [← ι_comp_p1 U f g i, ← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc, h₁]
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [liftMember_fst]
    refine (cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict (U i))).1 ?_
    rw [restrictHom_fac, Category.assoc]
    exact htoBase
  · rw [liftMember_snd, ← ι_comp_p2 U f g i, ← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc, h₂]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Pullback.gluedLift_uniq
statement:
theorem gluedLift_uniq (m : s.pt ⟶ glued U f g)
    (h₁ : m ≫ p1 U f g = s.fst) (h₂ : m ≫ p2 U f g = s.snd) :
    m = gluedLift U f g s hU
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_of_opens (conePreimage U f g s) (conePreimage_covers U f g s hU) fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [ofRestrict_comp_gluedLift, ← liftι_eq_liftMember U f g s m h₁ h₂ i,
    liftι_fac U f g i _ (range_base_ofRestrict_comp_subset_ι U f g s m h₁ i)]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.range_subset_preimage_of_pullbackCone
statement:
theorem range_subset_preimage_of_pullbackCone (s : PullbackCone f (Y.ofRestrict V)) :
    Set.range (s.fst.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → X) ⊆
      (((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V : X.Opens) : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have h : (f.toLRSHom.base : X → Y) ((s.fst.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → X) w) =
      ((s.snd.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → Y.restrict V) w).1 :=
    congrArg (fun (φ : s.pt ⟶ Y) ↦ (φ.toLRSHom.base : s.pt → Y) w) s.condition

    (fun s ↦ liftRestrict s.fst _ (range_subset_preimage_of_pullbackCone f V s))
    (fun s ↦ liftRestrict_fac _ _ _) (fun s ↦ ?_) (fun s m hm _ ↦ ?_))
  · rw [← cancel_mono (Y.ofRestrict V), Category.assoc, restrictHom_fac,
      ← Category.assoc, liftRestrict_fac, s.condition]
  · rw [← cancel_mono (X.ofRestrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V)), liftRestrict_fac, hm]

statement:

      (restrictIsoPullbackOfRestrict f V).inv ≫
        X.ofRestrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isOpenImmersion_map_pullbackFst_ofRestrict

proof:

      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map (X.ofRestrict ((Opens.map f.toLRSHom.base).obj V))) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isOpenImmersion_ofRestrict X.toLocallyRingedSpace _
