name: ComplexAnalytic.not_mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb
statement:
theorem not_mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb :
    ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n) ∉ Set.range (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  exact absurd (ULift.up.inj hk) (Fin.castSucc_lt_last k.down).ne

name: ComplexAnalytic.mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb
statement:
theorem mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb {m : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hm : m ≠ ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) : m ∈ Set.range (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀⟩ := m
  have h : m₀ ≠ Fin.last n := fun h ↦ hm (by rw [h])
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 h
  exact ⟨ULift.up k, ULift.ext _ _ hk⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_base_eq_zeroSet
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change F.toGlobalFun ⊤ _ = 0
    rw [OkaRing.toGlobalFun_eq_evalHom F (show (i.base x : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ) ∈
      (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) from trivial)]
    simpa using hcut.evalHom_eq_zero x 0
  · intro h
    have h' : OkaRing.evalHom (U := ⊤) (x := (z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) trivial F = 0 := by
      rw [← OkaRing.toGlobalFun_eq_evalHom]
      exact h
    change z ∈ Set.range (i.base : X → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ))
    rw [hcut.range_base]
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    exact (germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (U := ⊤) trivial F).2 h'

name: ComplexAnalytic.base_comp_uliftProj
statement:
theorem base_comp_uliftProj :
    ((i ≫ okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).base : X → _) =
      fun x ↦ (i.base x : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ) ∘ (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n)
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ ↦ okaMapFun_coordEmb _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHomeomorph_base_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![F])
    (hlin : ∀ x : X, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) 1)
      ((OkaRing.germ (show i.base x ∈ (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) from trivial) F :
        LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :
          MvPowerSeries (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph ((i ≫ okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).base : X → _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [base_comp_uliftProj]
  refine isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding (f := F.toGlobalFun ⊤)
    (f' := fun z ↦ fderiv ℂ (F.toGlobalFun ⊤) z) hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding
    (fun m hm ↦ mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb hm) not_mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb
    (range_base_eq_zeroSet hcut) (fun z _ ↦ (F.analyticAt_toGlobalFun trivial).hasStrictFDerivAt)
    fun z hz ↦ ?_
  have hmem : z ∈ Set.range (i.base : X → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) := by
    rw [range_base_eq_zeroSet hcut]; exact hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hmem
  rw [← OkaRing.coeff_single_one_germ]
  exact hlin x

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHomeomorph_base_comp_uliftProj_of_pderiv
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base_comp_uliftProj_of_pderiv
    {P : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ}
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![OkaRing.ofMvPolynomial ⊤ P])
    (hlin : ∀ x : X, MvPolynomial.eval (i.base x)
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) P) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph ((i ≫ okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).base : X → _)
proof:
:= by
  refine isLocalHomeomorph_base_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff hcut fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [← LocalOkaRing.ofMvPolynomial_eq, LocalOkaRing.coeff_single_one_ofMvPolynomial]
  exact hlin x

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_base_ofRestrict_eq_zeroSet_inter
statement:
theorem range_base_ofRestrict_eq_zeroSet_inter (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![F]) (U : Opens X) :
    ∃ Ω : Set (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ), IsOpen Ω ∧
      Set.range ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i).base :
        X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) =
        {z : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ | F.toGlobalFun ⊤ z = 0} ∩ Ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ, hUΩ⟩ := hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 U.isOpen
  refine ⟨Ω, hΩ, ?_⟩
  have hr : Set.range ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i).base :
      X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) =
      (i.base : X → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) '' (U : Set X) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x.1, x.2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hr, ← hUΩ, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_base_eq_zeroSet hcut]
  exact Set.inter_comm _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![F])
    (U : Opens X)
    (hlin : ∀ x : X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding,
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) 1)
      ((OkaRing.germ (show (X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i).base x ∈
          (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) from trivial) F :
        LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :
          MvPowerSeries (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i ≫
      okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).base :
        X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding → _)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ, hrange⟩ := range_base_ofRestrict_eq_zeroSet_inter hcut U
  rw [← Category.assoc, base_comp_uliftProj]
  refine isLocalHomeomorph_coordProj_comp_of_isEmbedding_inter
    (hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding.comp Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal) hΩ
    (f := F.toGlobalFun ⊤) (f' := fun z ↦ fderiv ℂ (F.toGlobalFun ⊤) z)
    (fun m hm ↦ mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb hm) not_mem_range_uliftCastSuccEmb hrange
    (fun z _ _ ↦ (F.analyticAt_toGlobalFun trivial).hasStrictFDerivAt) fun z hzΩ hz ↦ ?_
  have hmem : z ∈ Set.range ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i).base :
      X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding → (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) := by
    rw [hrange]; exact ⟨hz, hzΩ⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hmem
  rw [← OkaRing.coeff_single_one_germ]
  exact hlin x

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_pderiv
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_pderiv
    {P : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ}
    (hcut : IsCutOutBy i ![OkaRing.ofMvPolynomial ⊤ P]) (U : Opens X)
    (hlin : ∀ x : X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding,
      MvPolynomial.eval ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i).base x)
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) P) ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph ((X.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ i ≫
      okaMapHom (coordEmb (uliftCastSuccEmb.{u} n))).base :
        X.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding → _)
proof:
:= by
  refine isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff hcut U fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [← LocalOkaRing.ofMvPolynomial_eq, LocalOkaRing.coeff_single_one_ofMvPolynomial]
  exact hlin x

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalIso_comp_proj_of_coeff
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_comp_proj_of_coeff (hcut : IsCutOutBy i'.toLRSHom ![F])

      ((OkaRing.germ (show i'.toLRSHom.base x ∈
          (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) from trivial) F :

proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalIso_comp_proj_of_pderiv
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_comp_proj_of_pderiv {P : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ}

name: ComplexAnalytic.isLocalIso_ofRestrict_comp_proj_of_coeff
statement:
theorem isLocalIso_ofRestrict_comp_proj_of_coeff (hcut : IsCutOutBy i'.toLRSHom ![F])
    (U : W.Opens)
    (hlin : ∀ x : W.restrict U, MvPowerSeries.coeff
      (Finsupp.single (ULift.up.{u} (Fin.last n)) 1)
      ((OkaRing.germ (show i'.toLRSHom.base x.1 ∈
          (⊤ : Opens (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → ℂ)) from trivial) F :
        LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :
          MvPowerSeries (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) ℂ) ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticSpace.IsLocalIso (W.ofRestrict U ≫ i' ≫ AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n) where
  isLocalHomeomorph
proof:
:= isLocalHomeomorph_base_ofRestrict_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff hcut _ hlin
  isIso_stalkMap x := by

        (W.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom ≫ (i' ≫ AnalyticSpace.proj.{u} n).toLRSHom := rfl
    rw [h, LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso' (isIso_stalkMap_comp_uliftProj_of_coeff hcut x.1 (hlin x))
      (AnalyticSpace.isIso_stalkMap_ofRestrict W U x)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fiber
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fiber (x : X)
    [Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x)]
    (A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X) [PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected A] :
    Subsingleton ((SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x).obj A)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isPretransitive_fundamentalGroup.{u} x A
  refine ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x) a b
  rw [← hg, Subsingleton.elim g 1, one_smul]

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id (x : X)
    [Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x)]
    (A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X) [PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected A] :
    Nonempty (A ≅ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty ((SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x).obj A) :=
    PreGaloisCategory.nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected _ A
  haveI := SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fiber.{u} x A
  set f : A ⟶ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X :=
    (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalId.{u} X).from A with hf
  have hiso : IsIso ((SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x).map f) :=
    ⟨(SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalFintypeFiber.{u} x A).from _,
      (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalFintypeFiber.{u} x A).hom_ext _ _,
      (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalFintypeFiberId.{u} x).hom_ext _ _⟩
  haveI : IsIso f := isIso_of_reflects_iso f (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x)
  exact ⟨asIso f⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.exists_iso_coprod_id
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.exists_iso_coprod_id (x : X)
    [Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x)]
    (A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty (A ≅ ∐ fun _ : ι ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, f, e, hf⟩ := SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.exists_isConnected_decomposition.{u} A
  refine ⟨ι, hι, ⟨e.symm ≪≫ Sigma.mapIso fun i ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  haveI := hf i
  exact (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id.{u} x (f i)).some

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.not_isInitial_id
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.not_isInitial_id (x : X) :
    IsInitial (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X) → False
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  PreGaloisCategory.not_initial_of_inhabited
    (F := SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x)
    ((SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalFintypeFiberId.{u} x).from
      (FintypeCat.of PUnit) PUnit.unit) h

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id_of_iso_coprod_id
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id_of_iso_coprod_id (x : X)
    (A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X) [PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected A]
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (e : A ≅ ∐ fun _ : ι ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X) :
    Nonempty (A ≅ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Nonempty ι := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    exact PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected.notInitial (X := A)
      (IsInitial.ofIso (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isInitialCoprodId.{u} X) e.symm)
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hne
  set f : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X ⟶ A :=
    Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X) i ≫ e.inv with hf
  haveI : Mono f := mono_comp _ _
  haveI : IsIso f := PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected.noTrivialComponent _ f
    (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.not_isInitial_id.{u} x)
  exact ⟨(asIso f).symm⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_coprod
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_coprod (x : X)
    (h : ∀ A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X, ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty (A ≅ ∐ fun _ : ι ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)) :
    Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x)
proof:
:= by
  refine SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_iso_id.{u} x fun A hA ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, e⟩ := h A
  exact SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id_of_iso_coprod_id.{u} x A e.some

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_coprod_iff
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_coprod_iff (x : X) :
    Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x) ↔
      ∀ A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X, ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
        Nonempty (A ≅ ∐ fun _ : ι ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ A ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.exists_iso_coprod_id.{u} x A,
    SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_coprod.{u} x⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_iso_id
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_iso_id (x : X)
    (h : ∀ A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X, PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected A →
      Nonempty (A ≅ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)) :
    Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Subsingleton (PreGaloisCategory.AutGalois
      (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x)) := by
    refine ⟨fun f g ↦ PreGaloisCategory.AutGalois.ext _ fun A ↦ ?_⟩
    have hterm : IsTerminal A.obj :=
      (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.isTerminalId.{u} X).ofIso (h A.obj inferInstance).some.symm
    exact Aut.ext (hterm.hom_ext _ _)
  exact (PreGaloisCategory.autMulEquivAutGalois
    (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fintypeFiberFunctor.{u} x)).toEquiv.subsingleton

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_iff
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_iff (x : X) :
    Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x) ↔
      ∀ A : SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.{u} X, PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected A →
        Nonempty (A ≅ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.id.{u} X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ A _ ↦ SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nonempty_iso_id.{u} x A,
    SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_iso_id.{u} x⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_congr
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_congr (x y : X) :
    Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} x) ↔
      Subsingleton (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} y)

:=
  (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_iff.{u} x).trans
    (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_iff.{u} y).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_congr
statement:
theorem SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_congr (x y : X) :

      Nontrivial (SeparatedFiniteEtaleOver.fundamentalGroup.{u} y)
proof:
:= by

name: ComplexAnalytic.injective_stalkMap_okaMapHom
statement:
theorem injective_stalkMap_okaMapHom (hcont : ContinuousAt σ (okaMapFun u z))
    (hσz : σ (okaMapFun u z) = z)
    (hright : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), okaMapFun u (σ w) = w) :
    Function.Injective ((okaMapHom u).stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨W, hW, s, rfl⟩ := (complexSpace.{u} κ).presheaf.exists_germ_eq a
  rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (okaMapHom u) W z hW s] at ha
  have hzP : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapHom u).base).obj W := hW
  obtain ⟨V, hVz, iV, i0, hres⟩ := (complexSpace.{u} ι).presheaf.germ_eq z hzP hzP
    ((okaMapHom u).c.app (op W) s) 0 (ha.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have hzero : ∀ y : V, s.toFun _ ⟨okaMapFun u y.1, (leOfHom iV) y.2⟩ = 0 := fun y ↦
    congrArg (fun t : OkaRing V ↦ t.toFun _ y) hres
  have hWmem : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), w ∈ W := W.isOpen.mem_nhds hW
  have hVmem : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), σ w ∈ V :=
    hcont (by rw [hσz]; exact V.isOpen.mem_nhds hVz)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), σ w ∈ V ∧ okaMapFun u (σ w) = w ∧ w ∈ W :=
    hVmem.and (hright.and hWmem)
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htopen, ht0⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hev
  set W' : Opens (κ → ℂ) := ⟨t, htopen⟩ with hW'def
  have hWle : W' ≤ W := fun w hw ↦ (hts hw).2.2
  have hres' : OkaRing.restrict hWle s = 0 := by
    refine OkaRing.ext (funext fun w ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨hσV, hFσ, _⟩ := hts w.2
    change s.toFun _ ⟨w.1, hWle w.2⟩ = 0
    rw [← hzero ⟨σ w.1, hσV⟩]
    exact congrArg (fun q : W ↦ s.toFun _ q) (Subtype.ext hFσ.symm)
  have hzW' : (okaMapHom u).base z ∈ W' := ht0
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (complexSpace.{u} κ).presheaf (homOfLE hWle)
    ((okaMapHom u).base z) hzW' s]
  change (complexSpace.{u} κ).presheaf.germ W' _ hzW' (OkaRing.restrict hWle s) = 0
  rw [hres']
  exact map_zero _

name: ComplexAnalytic.surjective_stalkMap_okaMapHom
statement:
theorem surjective_stalkMap_okaMapHom (hσ : AnalyticAt ℂ σ (okaMapFun u z))
    (hσz : σ (okaMapFun u z) = z) (hleft : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, σ (okaMapFun u y) = y) :
    Function.Surjective ((okaMapHom u).stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨V, hVz, t, rfl⟩ := (complexSpace.{u} ι).presheaf.exists_germ_eq b
  have hev : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), AnalyticAt ℂ σ w ∧ σ w ∈ V :=
    hσ.eventually_analyticAt.and (hσ.continuousAt (by rw [hσz]; exact V.isOpen.mem_nhds hVz))
  obtain ⟨W0, hsub, hopen, hmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hev
  set W : Opens (κ → ℂ) := ⟨W0, hopen⟩ with hWdef
  have hAn : ∀ w ∈ W, AnalyticAt ℂ σ w := fun w hw ↦ (hsub hw).1
  have hIn : ∀ w ∈ W, σ w ∈ V := fun w hw ↦ (hsub hw).2
  have hmemW : (okaMapHom u).base z ∈ W := hmem
  refine ⟨(complexSpace.{u} κ).presheaf.germ W _ hmemW
    (OkaRing.mk (fun w : W ↦ t.toFun _ ⟨σ w.1, hIn w.1 w.2⟩)
      (t.2.comp_analyticOn σ hAn hIn)), ?_⟩
  rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (okaMapHom u) W z hmemW _]
  obtain ⟨O0, hOsub, hOopen, hO0⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hleft
  set O : Opens (ι → ℂ) := ⟨O0, hOopen⟩ with hOdef
  have hzP : z ∈ (Opens.map (okaMapHom u).base).obj W := hmemW
  set V0 : Opens (ι → ℂ) := V ⊓ (Opens.map (okaMapHom u).base).obj W ⊓ O with hV0def
  have hzV0 : z ∈ V0 := ⟨⟨hVz, hzP⟩, hO0⟩
  have hle1 : V0 ≤ (Opens.map (okaMapHom u).base).obj W := fun y hy ↦ hy.1.2
  have hle2 : V0 ≤ V := fun y hy ↦ hy.1.1
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (complexSpace.{u} ι).presheaf (homOfLE hle1) z hzV0 _,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (complexSpace.{u} ι).presheaf (homOfLE hle2) z hzV0 t]
  congr 1
  refine OkaRing.ext (funext fun y ↦ ?_)
  exact congrArg (fun q : V ↦ t.toFun _ q) (Subtype.ext (hOsub y.2.2))

name: ComplexAnalytic.isIso_stalkMap_okaMapHom
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_okaMapHom (hσ : AnalyticAt ℂ σ (okaMapFun u z))
    (hleft : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, σ (okaMapFun u y) = y)
    (hright : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (okaMapFun u z), okaMapFun u (σ w) = w) :
    IsIso ((okaMapHom u).stalkMap z)
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2
    ⟨injective_stalkMap_okaMapHom hσ.continuousAt hleft.self_of_nhds hright,
      surjective_stalkMap_okaMapHom hσ hleft.self_of_nhds hleft⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.isIso_stalkMap_okaMap
proof:
:=
  isIso_stalkMap_okaMapHom hτ hleft hright

name: Ideal.span_range_pow_le_of_forall_pow_mem
statement:
theorem span_range_pow_le_of_forall_pow_mem {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {A : Ideal R} {k : ℕ} :
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R), (∀ i, f i ^ k ∈ A) →
      Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ (r * k + 1) ≤ A
  | 0, f, _ => by
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty, zero_mul, zero_add, pow_one]
    exact bot_le
  | r + 1, f, hf => by
    rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail f, Fin.range_cons, Ideal.span_insert,
      show (r + 1) * k + 1 = k + (r * k + 1) by ring]
    refine Ideal.sup_pow_add_le_pow_sup_pow.trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hf 0
    · exact span_range_pow_le_of_forall_pow_mem (Fin.tail f) fun i ↦ hf i.succ

end Ideal

namespace TopCat.Presheaf

name: TopCat.Presheaf.eventually_Γgerm_mem_span
statement:
theorem eventually_Γgerm_mem_span {X : TopCat.{u}} (F : X.Presheaf CommRingCat.{u}) {x : X}
    {m : ℕ} (s : F.obj (op ⊤)) (ψ : Fin m → F.obj (op ⊤))
    (h : F.Γgerm x s ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ F.Γgerm x (ψ j))) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, F.Γgerm y s ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ F.Γgerm y (ψ j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp h
  choose O hxO c' hc' using fun j ↦ F.exists_germ_eq (c j)
  set O' : Opens X := Finset.univ.inf O
  have hxO' : x ∈ O' := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun j _ ↦ hxO j
  have hle : ∀ j, O' ≤ O j := fun j ↦ Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ j)
  set t : F.obj (op O') := F.map (homOfLE le_top).op s -
    ∑ j, F.map (homOfLE (hle j)).op (c' j) * F.map (homOfLE le_top).op (ψ j) with ht
  have hgerm : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ O'), F.germ O' y hy t =
      F.Γgerm y s - ∑ j, F.germ (O j) y (hle j hy) (c' j) * F.Γgerm y (ψ j) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [ht, map_sub, map_sum, germ_res_apply]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, germ_res_apply, germ_res_apply]
    rfl
  have ht0 : F.germ O' x hxO' t = F.germ O' x hxO' 0 := by
    rw [hgerm, map_zero, sub_eq_zero, ← hc]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by rw [hc' j, smul_eq_mul]
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, i1, i2, hW⟩ := F.germ_eq x hxO' hxO' t 0 ht0
  filter_upwards [W.isOpen.mem_nhds hxW] with y hyW
  have hyO' : y ∈ O' := leOfHom i1 hyW
  have key : F.germ O' y hyO' t = 0 := by
    rw [← germ_res_apply F i1 y hyW, hW, germ_res_apply, map_zero]
  rw [hgerm, sub_eq_zero] at key
  rw [key]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.basisStalkFree_repr_stalkFunctor_map
statement:
lemma basisStalkFree_repr_stalkFunctor_map [Finite J] (y : Y) (j : J) (i : I) :
    (basisStalkFree I y).repr ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ (basisStalkFree J y j)) i =
      Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (freeHomMatrix φ i j)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hgen : φ.val.app (op ⊤) (generatorSection (𝟙 _) j) = generatorSection φ j := by
    rw [← generatorSection_comp, Category.id_comp]
  set b := generatorSection φ j with hb
  have hsum : b = ∑ i', SheafOfModules.freeEval (op ⊤) b i' •
      generatorSection (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I)) i' :=
    SheafOfModules.val_app_eq_sum (op ⊤) (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I)) b
  rw [basisStalkFree_apply, stalkFunctor_map_germTop, hgen, hsum]
  have hgerm : germTop (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I) y
      (∑ i', SheafOfModules.freeEval (op ⊤) b i' •
        generatorSection (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I)) i') =
      ∑ i', Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op ⊤) b i') • basisStalkFree I y i' := by
    rw [germTop]
    erw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ ↦ ?_
    rw [basisStalkFree_apply]
    exact germMod_smul (M := SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I) (W := ⊤) trivial _ _
  rw [hgerm, Module.Basis.repr_sum_self]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Γgerm_det_submatrix
statement:
lemma Γgerm_det_submatrix [Fintype I] [Finite J] (y : Y) (σ : I → J) :
    Y.presheaf.Γgerm y ((freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id σ).det =
      ((Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (basisStalkFree I y).repr
        ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ (basisStalkFree J y j)) i).submatrix _root_.id σ).det
proof:
:= by
  have hM : ((freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id σ).map (Y.presheaf.Γgerm y).hom =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (basisStalkFree I y).repr
        ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ (basisStalkFree J y j)) i).submatrix _root_.id σ := by
    ext i k
    exact (basisStalkFree_repr_stalkFunctor_map φ y (σ k) i).symm
  rw [← hM]
  exact RingHom.map_det _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Γgerm_det_mem_annihilator
statement:
theorem Γgerm_det_mem_annihilator [Fintype I] [Finite J] [Epi p] {y : Y}
    (hex : Function.Exact ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map p)) (σ : I → J) :
    Y.presheaf.Γgerm y ((freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id σ).det ∈
      Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Γgerm_det_submatrix φ y σ) ▸ Module.det_submatrix_mem_annihilator (basisStalkFree I y)
    (fun j ↦ (Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ (basisStalkFree J y j)) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map p).hom
    (surjective_stalk_of_epi p y) ?_ σ
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_isUnit_Γgerm_det
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_Γgerm_det [Fintype I] [Finite J] {y : Y}
    (hex : Function.Exact ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map p))
    [Subsingleton ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj N)] :
    ∃ σ : I → J, IsUnit (Y.presheaf.Γgerm y ((freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id σ).det)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite J
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Module.exists_isUnit_det_submatrix (basisStalkFree I y)
    (fun j ↦ (Y.stalkFunctor y).map φ (basisStalkFree J y j)) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).map p).hom
    (by
      rw [LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hex]
      rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
      rw [← (basisStalkFree J y).sum_repr w, map_sum]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩))
  exact ⟨σ, (Γgerm_det_submatrix φ y σ) ▸ hσ⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_presentation {N : SheafOfModules.{u} Z.ringSheaf}
    {I J : Type u} [Finite I] [Finite J]
    (φ : SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringSheaf) J ⟶ SheafOfModules.free I)
    (p : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶ N) [Epi p]
    (hex : ∀ y : Z, Function.Exact ((Z.stalkFunctor y).map φ) ((Z.stalkFunctor y).map p))
    {r : ℕ} (g : Fin r → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hN : ∀ y : Z, (∃ i, Z.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (g i) ≠ 0) →
      Subsingleton ((Z.stalkFunctor y).obj N))
    (x : Z) :
    ∃ U : Z.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, Z.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i) ^ k ∈
      Module.annihilator (Z.presheaf.stalk y) ((Z.stalkFunctor y).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite I
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite J
  set e := Fintype.equivFin (I → J)
  set ψ : Fin (Fintype.card (I → J)) → Z.presheaf.obj (op ⊤) := fun m ↦
    ((LocallyRingedSpace.freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id (e.symm m)).det with hψ
  have hψann : ∀ y m, Z.presheaf.Γgerm y (ψ m) ∈
      Module.annihilator (Z.presheaf.stalk y) ((Z.stalkFunctor y).obj N) := fun y m ↦
    LocallyRingedSpace.Γgerm_det_mem_annihilator φ p (hex y) _
  have hvan : ∀ i, ∀ y : Z, (∀ m, Z.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (ψ m) = 0) →
      Z.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (g i) = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    by_contra hne
    haveI := hN y ⟨i, hne⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := LocallyRingedSpace.exists_isUnit_Γgerm_det φ p (hex y)
    have h1 := hy (e σ)
    rw [eval_apply] at h1
    refine (evalStalk_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (Z := Z)).2 ?_ h1
    have h2 : ψ (e σ) = ((LocallyRingedSpace.freeHomMatrix φ).submatrix _root_.id σ).det := by
      simp [hψ]
    rw [h2]
    exact hσ
  have hk : ∀ i, ∃ k, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Z.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i) ^ k ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun m ↦ Z.presheaf.Γgerm y (ψ m)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Z.isNullstellensatzAt x ⊤ trivial ψ (g i)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun y _ h ↦ hvan i y h)
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have := TopCat.Presheaf.eventually_Γgerm_mem_span Z.presheaf (g i ^ k) ψ
      (by rw [map_pow]; exact hk)
    filter_upwards [this] with y hy
    rwa [map_pow] at hy
  choose k hk using hk
  have hall : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ i, Z.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i) ^ (∑ i, k i) ∈
      Module.annihilator (Z.presheaf.stalk y) ((Z.stalkFunctor y).obj N) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_all.mpr hk] with y hy i
    refine Ideal.pow_mem_of_pow_mem (I := Module.annihilator _ _) ?_
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i))
    refine (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (hy i)
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact hψann y m
  obtain ⟨U, hUt, hUo, hxU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hall
  exact ⟨⟨U, hUo⟩, hxU, ∑ i, k i, fun y hy ↦ hUt hy⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.Γgerm_resΓ
statement:
lemma Γgerm_resΓ (y : X.restrict U) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (X.restrict U).presheaf.Γgerm y (X.resΓ U g) =
      ((X.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom (X.presheaf.Γgerm y.1 g)
proof:
:=
  (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (X.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom ⊤ y trivial g).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.eval_resΓ
statement:
lemma eval_resΓ (y : X.restrict U) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (X.restrict U).eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (X.resΓ U g) = X.eval (U := ⊤) y.1 trivial g
proof:
:=
  eval_c_app (X.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom (X.ofRestrict U).isCLinear (U := ⊤) y trivial g

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.stalkMap_mem_annihilator_iff
statement:
lemma stalkMap_mem_annihilator_iff (y : X.restrict U) (a : X.presheaf.stalk y.1) :
    ((X.ofRestrict U).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom a ∈ Module.annihilator _
        (((X.restrict U).stalkFunctor y).obj ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules U).obj N)) ↔
      a ∈ Module.annihilator _ ((X.stalkFunctor y.1).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  set σ := (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding).stalkPullbackModulesSemilinearEquiv
    y N
  simp only [Module.mem_annihilator]
  constructor
  · intro h m
    exact σ.injective ((σ.map_smulₛₗ a m).trans ((h (σ m)).trans (map_zero σ).symm))
  · intro h m
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := σ.surjective m
    exact (σ.map_smulₛₗ a m).symm.trans ((congrArg σ (h m)).trans (map_zero σ))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.subsingleton_stalk_restrict
statement:
lemma subsingleton_stalk_restrict (y : X.restrict U)
    [Subsingleton ((X.stalkFunctor y.1).obj N)] :
    Subsingleton (((X.restrict U).stalkFunctor y).obj
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules U).obj N))
proof:
:=
  haveI : Subsingleton ((X.stalkFunctor
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding).base y)).obj N) := ‹_›
  LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.subsingleton_stalk_pullbackModules
    (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) y N

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_restrict {r : ℕ} (g : Fin r → X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (h : ∃ W : (X.restrict U).Opens, (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrict U) ∈ W ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i,
      (X.restrict U).presheaf.Γgerm y (X.resΓ U (g i)) ^ k ∈
        Module.annihilator ((X.restrict U).presheaf.stalk y)
          (((X.restrict U).stalkFunctor y).obj
            ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules U).obj N))) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i, X.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i) ^ k ∈
      Module.annihilator (X.presheaf.stalk y) ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, k, hk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨LocallyRingedSpace.imOpen U W, LocallyRingedSpace.mem_imOpen U W hx hxW, k, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, hyW, rfl⟩ i
  have := hk y hyW i
  rw [Γgerm_resΓ, ← map_pow] at this
  exact (stalkMap_mem_annihilator_iff U N y _).1 this

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_presentation_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_presentation_restrict {M : SheafOfModules.{u} Z.ringSheaf} [M.IsCoherent]
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] (π : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶ M) [Epi π] (z : Z) :
    ∃ (V : Z.Opens) (_ : z ∈ V) (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J)
      (φ : SheafOfModules.free (R := (Z.restrict V).ringSheaf) J ⟶ SheafOfModules.free I)
      (p : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).obj M),
      Epi p ∧ ∀ y : Z.restrict V,
        Function.Exact (((Z.restrict V).stalkFunctor y).map φ)
          (((Z.restrict V).stalkFunctor y).map p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringSheaf).IsCoherent := Z.isCoherentStructureSheaf
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringSheaf) I).IsCoherent :=
    SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.free I
  haveI : (kernel π).IsCoherent := SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.kernel π
  obtain ⟨V, hzV, J, _, π', _⟩ :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.exists_epi_free_restrictModules (kernel π) z
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V) :=
    (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).preservesFiniteLimits_pullbackModules
      (LocallyRingedSpace.flat_stalkMap_of_isIso _)
  haveI : (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesAdj.isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : PreservesColimits (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V) :=
    (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict
      V.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesAdj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI := Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint
    (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V)
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η, η =
      (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesFreeIso I :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS := (LocallyRingedSpace.shortExact_kernel π).map_of_exact
    (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V)
  refine ⟨V, hzV, J, inferInstance,
    π' ≫ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map (kernel.ι π) ≫ η.hom,
    η.inv ≫ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map π, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · haveI : Epi ((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map π) :=
      (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map_epi π
    exact epi_comp _ _
  · have hex := LocallyRingedSpace.exact_stalk _ hS.exact y
    have hsurj := LocallyRingedSpace.surjective_stalk_of_epi π' y
    set S := (Z.restrict V).stalkFunctor y
    have hHH' : ∀ v, S.map η.hom (S.map η.inv v) = v := fun v ↦
      (S.mapIso η).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply v
    have hH'H : ∀ v, S.map η.inv (S.map η.hom v) = v := fun v ↦
      (S.mapIso η).toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply v
    have hφ : ∀ w, S.map (π' ≫ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map (kernel.ι π) ≫
        η.hom) w = S.map η.hom (S.map ((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map
          (kernel.ι π)) (S.map π' w)) := fun w ↦ by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    have hp : ∀ v, S.map (η.inv ≫ (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map π) v =
        S.map ((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map π) (S.map η.inv v) := fun v ↦ by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    intro v
    refine ⟨fun hv ↦ ?_, fun hv ↦ ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hex _).1 ((hp v).symm.trans hv)
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hsurj u
      exact ⟨w, (hφ w).trans ((congrArg (S.map η.hom) hu).trans (hHH' v))⟩
    · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
      exact (hp _).trans ((congrArg (S.map ((Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).map π))
        ((congrArg (S.map η.inv) (hφ w)).trans (hH'H _))).trans ((hex _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩))

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_mem_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_annihilator (N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf) [N.IsCoherent] {r : ℕ}
    (g : Fin r → X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hN : ∀ y : X, (∃ i, X.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (g i) ≠ 0) →
      Subsingleton ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N))
    (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, X.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i) ^ k ∈
      Module.annihilator (X.presheaf.stalk y) ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, hxU₁, I, _, π, hπ⟩ := LocallyRingedSpace.exists_epi_free_restrictModules N x
  refine exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_restrict U₁ N g hxU₁ ?_
  have hcoh : ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules U₁).obj N).IsCoherent :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_restrictModules N U₁
  obtain ⟨U₂, hxU₂, J, _, φ, p, hp, hex⟩ := @exists_presentation_restrict (X.restrict U₁)
    ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules U₁).obj N) hcoh I _ π hπ ⟨x, hxU₁⟩
  refine exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_restrict U₂ _ (fun i ↦ X.resΓ U₁ (g i)) hxU₂ ?_
  refine @exists_pow_mem_annihilator_of_presentation _ _ I J _ _ φ p hp hex _ _ ?_ _
  rintro y ⟨i, hi⟩
  rw [eval_resΓ, eval_resΓ] at hi
  haveI := hN y.1.1 ⟨i, hi⟩
  haveI := subsingleton_stalk_restrict U₁ N y.1
  exact subsingleton_stalk_restrict U₂ _ y

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_le_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_pow_le_annihilator (N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf) [N.IsCoherent] {r : ℕ}
    (g : Fin r → X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hN : ∀ y : X, (∃ i, X.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial (g i) ≠ 0) →
      Subsingleton ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N))
    (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U,
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ X.presheaf.Γgerm y (g i)) ^ k ≤
        Module.annihilator (X.presheaf.stalk y) ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, k, hk⟩ := exists_pow_mem_annihilator X N g hN x
  exact ⟨U, hxU, r * k + 1, fun y hy ↦
    Ideal.span_range_pow_le_of_forall_pow_mem _ fun i ↦ hk y hy i⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf) [N.IsCoherent]
    (g : X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hN : ∀ y : X, X.eval (U := ⊤) y trivial g ≠ 0 → Subsingleton ((X.stalkFunctor y).obj N))
    (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ m : (X.stalkFunctor y).obj N,
      X.presheaf.Γgerm y g ^ k • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, k, hk⟩ := exists_pow_mem_annihilator X N (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ g)
    (fun y ⟨_, hy⟩ ↦ hN y hy) x
  exact ⟨U, hxU, k, fun y hy m ↦ Module.mem_annihilator.mp (hk y hy 0) m⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_nhds_pow_map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_nhds_pow_map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) [M.IsCoherent]
    (hM : ∀ y : Y, p.base y ∉ Set.range i.base → Subsingleton ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M))
    (y₀ : Y) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, y₀ ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U,
      Ideal.map (p.stalkMap y).hom (i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal (p.base y)) ^ k ≤
        Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : X.affineOpens, p.base y₀ ∈ (W : X.Opens) :=
    Opens.mem_iSup.1 (by rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial)
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian W
  obtain ⟨r, h, hh⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W.1))
  let V : Y.Opens := (Opens.map p.base).obj W.1
  have hy₀ : y₀ ∈ V := hW
  let g : (Y.restrict V).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ X.toLocallyRingedSpace :=
    (Y.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom ≫ p
  have hle : (⊤ : (Y.restrict V).Opens) ≤ (Opens.map g.base).obj W.1 := fun y _ ↦ y.2
  let gs : Fin r → (Y.restrict V).presheaf.obj (op ⊤) := fun j ↦
    (Y.restrict V).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (g.c.app (op W.1) (h j))
  have hgerm : ∀ (y : Y.restrict V) j, (Y.restrict V).presheaf.Γgerm y (gs j) =
      g.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ W.1 (g.base y) y.2 (h j)) := by
    intro y j
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply]
    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  let N := (Y.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules V).obj M
  haveI hN : N.IsCoherent := LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_restrictModules M V
  obtain ⟨U', hU', k, hk⟩ := @exists_pow_le_annihilator (Y.restrict V) N hN r gs
    (fun y ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ by
      have hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ W.1 (g.base y) y.2 (h j)) := by
        haveI : IsLocalHom (g.stalkMap y).hom := g.prop y
        rw [← isUnit_map_iff (g.stalkMap y).hom, ← hgerm,
          ← evalStalk_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (Z := Y.restrict V)]
        exact hj
      have hb : g.base y ∈ X.basicOpen (h j) := (X.mem_basicOpen (h j) _ y.2).2 hu
      have hmem : h j ∈ i.basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W.1 := hh ▸ Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
      haveI := hM y.1 ((i.mem_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal _).1 hmem _ hb)
      exact subsingleton_stalk_restrict V M y) ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩
  refine ⟨LocallyRingedSpace.imOpen V U', LocallyRingedSpace.mem_imOpen V U' hy₀ hU', k, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, hyU', rfl⟩
  have hspan' : Ideal.map (g.stalkMap y).hom (i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal (p.base y.1)) ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ (Y.restrict V).presheaf.Γgerm y (gs j)) := by
    refine (Ideal.map_mono (i.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_map_basicOpenAvoidingIdeal W.2 _ y.2)).trans
      ?_
    rw [← hh, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp]
    refine le_of_eq (congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun j ↦ ?_)))
    exact (hgerm y j).symm
  have hφ : ∀ a, (Y.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom.stalkMap y (p.stalkMap y.1 a) = g.stalkMap y a := by
    intro a
    change _ = ((Y.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom ≫ p).stalkMap y a
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    rfl
  have hspan : Ideal.map ((Y.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom
      (Ideal.map (p.stalkMap y.1).hom (i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal (p.base y.1))) ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ (Y.restrict V).presheaf.Γgerm y (gs j)) := by
    refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun a ha ↦ ?_)
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap]
    erw [hφ]
    exact hspan' (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
  intro a ha
  refine (stalkMap_mem_annihilator_iff V M y a).1 (hk y hyU' ?_)
  have hpow : Ideal.map ((Y.ofRestrict V).toLRSHom.stalkMap y).hom
      (Ideal.map (p.stalkMap y.1).hom (i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal (p.base y.1)) ^ k) ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ (Y.restrict V).presheaf.Γgerm y (gs j)) ^ k := by
    rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hspan k
  exact hpow (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.exists_pow_map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_pow_map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [CompactSpace Y] (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) [M.IsCoherent]
    (hM : ∀ y : Y, p.base y ∉ Set.range i.base → Subsingleton ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ y : Y,
      Ideal.map (p.stalkMap y).hom (i.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal (p.base y)) ^ n ≤
        Module.annihilator (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose U hyU k hk using exists_nhds_pow_map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le_annihilator p i M hM
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun y ↦ (U y : Set Y))
    (fun y ↦ (U y).isOpen) (fun y _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨y, hyU y⟩)
  refine ⟨s.sup k, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hs (Set.mem_univ y))
  exact (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.le_sup hz)).trans (hk z y hyz)

name: ComplexAnalytic.hasLocalModels_zeroLocusSubspace
statement:
theorem hasLocalModels_zeroLocusSubspace (X : AnalyticSpace.{u})
    (s : Fin p → X.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    HasLocalModels (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s)
      (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspaceι s)
        X.algebraMap)
proof:
:= by
  set ι := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspaceι s with hιdef
  have hZ : IsCutOutBy ι s := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.isCutOutBy_zeroLocusSubspaceι s
  intro z
  obtain ⟨U₀, n, k, V, i, f, hcut, hlin⟩ := X.local_model (ι.base z)
  
  have hsurj : ∀ x : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding,
      Function.Surjective
        (((i ≫ (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap x).hom) :=
      fun x c ↦ by
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hcut.surjective_stalkMap x c
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap (i.base x))).surjective b
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    exact ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ a
  obtain ⟨A, hA, t, B, hBtop, hBA, hzB, heq⟩ :=
    LocallyRingedSpace.exists_localLift_family
      (i ≫ (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding) hsurj (B₀ := ⊤)
      (restrictSections U₀.1 s)
      (⟨ι.base z, U₀.2⟩ : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) trivial
  
  
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hOpre⟩ := hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 B.2
  set A' : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    (Opens.map ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).base).obj A with hA'
  set V' : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    ⟨O, hO⟩ ⊓ A' with hV'
  set B₁ : Opens (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    (Opens.map i.base).obj V' with hB₁def
  have hB₁ : B₁ = B := by
    refine Opens.ext (Set.ext fun w ↦ ?_)
    have h1 : (i.base w ∈ O) ↔ w ∈ B := Set.ext_iff.1 hOpre w
    exact ⟨fun hw ↦ h1.1 hw.1, fun hw ↦ ⟨h1.2 hw, hBA hw⟩⟩
  have hV'A' : V' ≤ A' := inf_le_right
  
  set u : Fin p → ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op V') :=
    fun r ↦ ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).res hV'A'
      (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).c.app (op A) (t r)) with hu
  have hkey : ∀ r, i.c.app (op V') (u r) =
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).res (le_top : B₁ ≤ ⊤)
        (restrictSections U₀.1 s r) := by
    intro r
    have h1 := congrArg
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).res (le_of_eq hB₁)) (heq r)
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.res_res, LocallyRingedSpace.res_res] at h1
    rw [← h1, hu]
    exact LocallyRingedSpace.c_app_res i hV'A' _
  set t' : Fin p → (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).restrict
      V'.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op ⊤) :=
    fun r ↦ ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).toRestrictΓ V' (u r) with ht'
  
  have hfam : restrictSections B₁ (restrictSections U₀.1 s)
      = fun r ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (restrictHom i V').op).hom (t' r) := by
    funext r
    
    
    have hrs : restrictSections B₁ (restrictSections U₀.1 s) r
        = (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict
            U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict B₁.isOpenEmbedding).op).hom
          (restrictSections U₀.1 s r) := rfl
    rw [ht', Γ_map_restrictHom_toRestrictΓ, hkey r, hrs,
      LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_ofRestrict_apply]
    exact (LocallyRingedSpace.map_map_apply _ _ _ _ _).symm
  have hinner : IsCutOutBy (restrictHom (restrictHom ι U₀.1) B₁)
      (fun r ↦ (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (restrictHom i V').op).hom (t' r)) :=
    hfam ▸ ((hZ.restrictOpen U₀.1).restrictOpen B₁)
  have hcomp := (hcut.restrictOpen V').comp_append hinner
  
  set UZ : Opens (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s) :=
    (Opens.map ι.base).obj U₀.1 with hUZ
  set Bstar : Opens ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).restrict UZ.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    (Opens.map (restrictHom ι U₀.1).base).obj B₁ with hBstar
  set WZ : Opens (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s) :=
    UZ.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj Bstar with hWZ
  set V'' : Opens (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) :=
    V.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V' with hV''
  have hrange : Set.range
        (((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).ofRestrict WZ.isOpenEmbedding).base) =
      Set.range (((((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).restrict
        UZ.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict Bstar.isOpenEmbedding ≫
        (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).ofRestrict UZ.isOpenEmbedding).base)) :=
    (LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict _ WZ).trans
      (LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict_comp _ UZ Bstar).symm
  have hrange₂ : Set.range ((((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).ofRestrict
        V'.isOpenEmbedding ≫ (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V.isOpenEmbedding).base) =
      Set.range (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict V''.isOpenEmbedding).base) :=
    (LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict_comp (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) V V').trans
      (LocallyRingedSpace.range_ofRestrict (complexAffineSpace.{u} n) V'').symm
  set e₁ := LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange with he₁
  set e₂ := LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange₂ with he₂
  have hfinal := (hcomp.iso_comp e₂).comp_iso e₁
  have hbase : (restrictHom ι U₀.1).base (⟨z, U₀.2⟩ :
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).restrict UZ.isOpenEmbedding)
      = (⟨ι.base z, U₀.2⟩ : X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict U₀.1.isOpenEmbedding) :=
    Subtype.ext (base_restrictHom ι U₀.1 _)
  have hzWZ : z ∈ WZ := by
    refine ⟨⟨z, U₀.2⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (restrictHom ι U₀.1).base (⟨z, U₀.2⟩ :
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).restrict UZ.isOpenEmbedding) ∈ B₁
    rw [hbase, hB₁]
    exact hzB
  have he₁lin : IsCLinearHom e₁.hom
      ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).resAlgMap
        (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap ι X.algebraMap) WZ)
      (((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).restrict UZ.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
        ((X.toLocallyRingedSpace.zeroLocusSubspace s).resAlgMap
          (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap ι X.algebraMap) UZ) Bstar) :=
    IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ hrange)
      (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ WZ)
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ Bstar).comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ UZ))
  have he₂lin : IsCLinearHom e₂.hom
      (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).resAlgMap
        (constantsAlgMap n V) V') (constantsAlgMap n V'') :=
    IsCLinearHom.of_comp (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ hrange₂)
      ((isCLinearHom_ofRestrict _ _ V').comp (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict_constants n V))
      (isCLinearHom_ofRestrict_constants n V'')
  exact ⟨⟨WZ, hzWZ⟩, n, k + p, V'', _, _, hfinal,
    he₁lin.comp (((isCLinearHom_restrictHom
      (isCLinearHom_restrictHom (isCLinearHom_comapAlgMap ι X.algebraMap) U₀.1) B₁).comp
      (isCLinearHom_restrictHom hlin V')).comp he₂lin)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.IsCutOutBy.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le
statement:
theorem IsCutOutBy.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le (hcut : IsCutOutBy i f) (y : Y) :
    i.pushforwardStalkIdeal y ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f j))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range i.base
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [i.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_ker hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing x, hcut.ker_stalkMap x]
  · have hy' : ¬ ∀ j, Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f j) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := fun h ↦
      hy (by rw [hcut.range_base]; exact h)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := not_forall.1 hy'
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, not_not] at hj
    have hmem : Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f j) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f j)) := Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hmem hj]
    exact le_top

    (hcut.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le y hr) m

statement:
theorem IsCutOutBy.isIso_pullbackModulesAdj_unit_app_iff (hcut : IsCutOutBy i f)
    (A : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) :
    IsIso (i.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app A) ↔
      ∀ j, LocallyRingedSpace.modulesSMul A (f j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ j ↦ ?_, hcut.isIso_pullbackModulesAdj_unit_app A⟩
  have h := LocallyRingedSpace.modulesSMul_naturality (i.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app A) (f j)
  have h0 := hcut.modulesSMul_pushforward_eq_zero (i.pullbackModules.obj A) j
  erw [h0, comp_zero] at h
  exact (cancel_mono (i.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app A)).1 (h.symm.trans zero_comp.symm)

        (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (coverOverlap.{u} obj poly j i).g).algebraMap =

name: ComplexAnalytic.comapAlgMap_coverIncl_eq
statement:
theorem comapAlgMap_coverIncl_eq (i j : J) :
    LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (coverIncl.{u} obj poly i j)
        (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj i).g).algebraMap =
      LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap
        ((coverTransition.{u} obj poly glue i j).hom ≫ coverIncl.{u} obj poly j i)
        (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj j).g).algebraMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_hom_injective (coverOverlapIso.{u} obj poly i j) ?_
  dsimp only
  rw [← LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_comp, ← LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_comp,
    comapAlgMap_coverOverlapIso]
  have ht : (coverOverlapIso.{u} obj poly i j).hom ≫
      (coverTransition.{u} obj poly glue i j).hom ≫ coverIncl.{u} obj poly j i =
        (coverGlueIso.{u} obj poly glue i j).hom ≫
          ((coverOverlapIso.{u} obj poly j i).hom ≫ coverIncl.{u} obj poly j i) := by
    simp [coverTransition]
  rw [ht, LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_comp, comapAlgMap_coverOverlapIso,
    comapAlgMap_coverGlueIso]

name: ComplexAnalytic.glueDataCLinear_coverGlueData
statement:
theorem glueDataCLinear_coverGlueData :
    GlueDataCLinear.{u} (coverGlueData.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)
      fun j ↦ (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj j).g).algebraMap
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    refine congrArg (fun m ↦ LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap m
      (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj i).g).algebraMap) ?_
    change (CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
        (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).f i i =
      (CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
        (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).t i i ≫
        (CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
          (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).f i i
    rw [CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'_f_self, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'_t_self]
    simp
  · change LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap ((CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
        (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).f i j) _ =
      LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap ((CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
        (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).t i j ≫
        (CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'
          (coverGlueData'.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)).f j i) _
    rw [CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'_f_of_ne _ h,
      CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData'_t_comp_f_of_ne _ h]
    dsimp only [coverGlueData']
    exact (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_comp _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap (eqToHom (dif_neg h)))
        (comapAlgMap_coverIncl_eq.{u} obj poly glue i j)).trans
          (LocallyRingedSpace.comapAlgMap_comp _ _ _).symm)

name: ComplexAnalytic.coverGlueMorphisms_eq_glueMorphismsOfGlueData
statement:
theorem coverGlueMorphisms_eq_glueMorphismsOfGlueData {Y : AnalyticSpace.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj i).g ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ i j : J, i ≠ j → coverIncl.{u} obj poly i j ≫ (f i).toLRSHom =
      (coverTransition.{u} obj poly glue i j).hom ≫
        coverIncl.{u} obj poly j i ≫ (f j).toLRSHom) :
    coverGlueMorphisms.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle f h =
      AnalyticSpace.glueMorphismsOfGlueData
        (coverGlueData.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)
        (fun i ↦ (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj i).g).algebraMap)
        (glueDataCLinear_coverGlueData.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle)
        (fun i ↦ (AnalyticSpace.analytification.{u} (obj i).g).local_model)
        (fun i ↦ (f i).toLRSHom)
        (comm_coverGlueData.{u} obj poly glue hrange hsymm hcocycle (fun i ↦ (f i).toLRSHom) h)
        (fun i ↦ (f i).isCLinear)
