    ((LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.opensFunctor f).monotone le_sup_right)

name: ComplexAnalytic.card_eq_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
lemma card_eq_of_mul_eq_one {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix J I ℂ) (B : Matrix I J ℂ) (h₁ : A * B = 1) (h₂ : B * A = 1) :
    Fintype.card I = Fintype.card J
proof:
:= by
  let e : (I → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (J → ℂ) := LinearEquiv.ofLinear (Matrix.toLin' A) (Matrix.toLin' B)
    (by rw [← Matrix.toLin'_mul, h₁, Matrix.toLin'_one]) (by rw [← Matrix.toLin'_mul, h₂,
      Matrix.toLin'_one])
  simpa using e.finrank_eq

name: ComplexAnalytic.isSecComb_self
statement:
lemma isSecComb_self {V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (u : κ → M.val.obj (op V)) (k : κ) : IsSecComb u le_rfl (u k)
proof:
:=
  by classical exact ⟨Pi.single k 1, by simp [Pi.single_apply, modRes_self]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.nearFreeResolution_union_zero
statement:
theorem nearFreeResolution_union_zero {K₁ K₂ : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hK₁ : IsCompact K₁)
    (hK₂ : IsCompact K₂)
    (hsplit : ∀ (κ : Type u) [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ], Complex.MatrixSplit κ K₁ K₂)
    {a' b' : ι → ℂ} (hS₁ : Complex.closedBox a' b' ⊆ K₁) (hS₂ : Complex.closedBox a' b' ⊆ K₂)
    (hS : K₁ ∩ K₂ ⊆ Complex.closedBox a' b') (hne : (Complex.closedBox a' b').Nonempty)
    (h₁ : NearFreeResolution f M 0 K₁) (h₂ : NearFreeResolution f M 0 K₂) :
    NearFreeResolution f M 0 (K₁ ∪ K₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  obtain ⟨W₁, hKW₁, hW₁⟩ := h₁ (hne.mono hS₁)
  obtain ⟨W₂, hKW₂, hW₂⟩ := h₂ (hne.mono hS₂)
  obtain ⟨Ω₀, hΩ₀, hSΩ₀, -⟩ := exists_le_image_openBox f (W := W₁ ⊓ W₂)
    fun x hx ↦ image_inf_subset ⟨hKW₁ (hS₁ hx), hKW₂ (hS₂ hx)⟩
  have h₀₁ : Ω₀ ≤ W₁ := hΩ₀.trans inf_le_left
  have h₀₂ : Ω₀ ≤ W₂ := hΩ₀.trans inf_le_right
  obtain ⟨I, _, _, s, hs, hsc⟩ := exists_basis_of_hasFreeResolutionLE_zero hW₁
  obtain ⟨J, _, _, t, ht, htc⟩ := exists_basis_of_hasFreeResolutionLE_zero hW₂
  choose A hA using fun j ↦ hsc Ω₀ h₀₁ (modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂)
  choose B hB using fun i ↦ htc Ω₀ h₀₂ (modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁)
  set A' : Matrix J I (Y.presheaf.obj (op Ω₀)) := Matrix.of A
  set B' : Matrix I J (Y.presheaf.obj (op Ω₀)) := Matrix.of B
  have eA : (fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂) = matAct A' fun i ↦ modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁ := funext hA
  have eB : (fun i ↦ modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁) = matAct B' fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂ := funext hB
  have hBA : B' * A' = 1 := by
    have h0 : matAct (B' * A' - 1) (fun i ↦ modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁) = 0 := by
      rw [matAct_sub, matAct_mul, ← eA, ← eB, matAct_one, sub_self]
    ext i i'
    have := congrFun (hs Ω₀ h₀₁ _ (congrFun h0 i)) i'
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this
  have hAB : A' * B' = 1 := by
    have h0 : matAct (A' * B' - 1) (fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂) = 0 := by
      rw [matAct_sub, matAct_mul, ← eB, ← eA, matAct_one, sub_self]
    ext j j'
    have := congrFun (ht Ω₀ h₀₂ _ (congrFun h0 j)) j'
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  have hx₀ := hSΩ₀ hx
  have hcard : Fintype.card J = Fintype.card I :=
    (card_eq_of_mul_eq_one (B'.map (secEval f hx₀)) (A'.map (secEval f hx₀))
      (by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hBA, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _)])
      (by rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hAB, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _)]))
  let e : J ≃ I := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard
  obtain ⟨Ω₁, Ω₂, hΩ₁, hΩ₂, hKΩ₁, hKΩ₂, w, ⟨H₁, H₁', hH₁, hw₁⟩, ⟨H₂, H₂', hH₂, hw₂⟩⟩ :=
    exists_glued_sections hK₁ hK₂ (hsplit I) hKW₁ hKW₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ (hS.trans hSΩ₀) s (t ∘ e.symm)
      (B'.submatrix _root_.id e.symm) (A'.submatrix e.symm _root_.id)
      (by rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hBA, Matrix.submatrix_id_id]) (by
        rw [eB]
        funext i
        simp only [matAct, Matrix.submatrix_apply, _root_.id, Function.comp_apply]
        exact (e.symm.sum_comp fun j ↦ B' i j • modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂).symm)
  have hgen : GeneratesLocally w := by
    refine GeneratesLocally.sup ?_ ?_
    · exact ((generatesLocally_of_forall_isSecComb hsc).res hΩ₁).of_matAct
        (mul_eq_one_comm.1 hH₁) hw₁
    · refine ((generatesLocally_of_forall_isSecComb htc).of_comb fun j ↦ ?_).res hΩ₂
        |>.of_matAct (mul_eq_one_comm.1 hH₂) hw₂
      have := isSecComb_self (M := M) (t ∘ e.symm) (e j)
      simpa using this
  have hlin : LinIndepSections w :=
    LinIndepSections.sup ((hs.res hΩ₁).of_matAct hH₁ hw₁)
      (((ht.comp_equiv e.symm).res hΩ₂).of_matAct hH₂ hw₂)
  haveI := isIso_freeHomOfSections hgen hlin
  exact ⟨Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂, (union_subset_union hKΩ₁ hKΩ₂).trans image_sup,
    .free 0 I (restrictModulesObjIso Y _ M ≪≫ (asIso (freeHomOfSections w)).symm)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.fromBlocks_mul_fromBlocks_eq_one
statement:
lemma fromBlocks_mul_fromBlocks_eq_one {I J R : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    [DecidableEq J] [CommRing R] (A : Matrix J I R) (B : Matrix I J R) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks 1 B (-A) (1 - A * B) * Matrix.fromBlocks (1 - B * A) (-B) A 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, ← Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  congr 1 <;> simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg] <;> abel

name: ComplexAnalytic.nearFreeResolution_union_succ
statement:
theorem nearFreeResolution_union_succ {d : ℕ} (IH : BoxResolution ι d)
    (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations) [M.IsCoherent]
    (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) (d + 1))
    {K₁ K₂ : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hK₁ : IsCompact K₁) (hK₂ : IsCompact K₂)
    (hsplit : ∀ (κ : Type u) [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ], Complex.MatrixSplit κ K₁ K₂)
    {a' b' : ι → ℂ} (hS₁ : Complex.closedBox a' b' ⊆ K₁) (hS₂ : Complex.closedBox a' b' ⊆ K₂)
    (hS : K₁ ∩ K₂ ⊆ Complex.closedBox a' b') (hne : (Complex.closedBox a' b').Nonempty)
    {a₀ b₀ : ι → ℂ} (hK : K₁ ∪ K₂ = Complex.closedBox a₀ b₀)
    (h₁ : NearFreeResolution f M (d + 1) K₁) (h₂ : NearFreeResolution f M (d + 1) K₂) :
    NearFreeResolution f M (d + 1) (K₁ ∪ K₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro _
  obtain ⟨W₁, hKW₁, hW₁⟩ := h₁ (hne.mono hS₁)
  obtain ⟨W₂, hKW₂, hW₂⟩ := h₂ (hne.mono hS₂)
  obtain ⟨Ω₀, hΩ₀, hSΩ₀, a₁, b₁, hbox⟩ := exists_le_image_openBox f (W := W₁ ⊓ W₂)
    fun x hx ↦ image_inf_subset ⟨hKW₁ (hS₁ hx), hKW₂ (hS₂ hx)⟩
  have h₀₁ : Ω₀ ≤ W₁ := hΩ₀.trans inf_le_left
  have h₀₂ : Ω₀ ≤ W₂ := hΩ₀.trans inf_le_right
  obtain ⟨I, _, s, hs, hsc⟩ := exists_sections_of_hasFreeResolutionLE f hW₁
  obtain ⟨J, _, t, ht, htc⟩ := exists_sections_of_hasFreeResolutionLE f hW₂
  choose A hA using fun j ↦ hsc Ω₀ h₀₁ ⟨a₁, b₁, hbox⟩ (modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂)
  choose B hB using fun i ↦ htc Ω₀ h₀₂ ⟨a₁, b₁, hbox⟩ (modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁)
  set A' : Matrix J I (Y.presheaf.obj (op Ω₀)) := Matrix.of A
  set B' : Matrix I J (Y.presheaf.obj (op Ω₀)) := Matrix.of B
  have eA : (fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂) = matAct A' fun i ↦ modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁ := funext hA
  have eB : (fun i ↦ modRes (s i) Ω₀ h₀₁) = matAct B' fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂ := funext hB
  let u₁ : I ⊕ J → M.val.obj (op W₁) := Sum.elim s 0
  let u₂ : I ⊕ J → M.val.obj (op W₂) := Sum.elim 0 t
  have ht0 : matAct (1 - A' * B') (fun j ↦ modRes (t j) Ω₀ h₀₂) = 0 := by
    rw [matAct_sub, matAct_mul, ← eB, ← eA, matAct_one, sub_self]
  have hu : (fun k ↦ modRes (u₁ k) Ω₀ h₀₁) =
      matAct (Matrix.fromBlocks 1 B' (-A') (1 - A' * B')) fun l ↦ modRes (u₂ l) Ω₀ h₀₂ := by
    funext k
    rcases k with i | j
    · simp only [u₁, u₂, matAct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
        Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Pi.zero_apply, modRes_zero,
        smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
      exact congrFun eB i
    · simp only [u₁, u₂, matAct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
        Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Pi.zero_apply, modRes_zero,
        smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
      exact (congrFun ht0 j).symm
  obtain ⟨Ω₁, Ω₂, hΩ₁, hΩ₂, hKΩ₁, hKΩ₂, w, ⟨H₁, H₁', hH₁, hw₁⟩, ⟨H₂, H₂', hH₂, hw₂⟩⟩ :=
    exists_glued_sections hK₁ hK₂ (hsplit (I ⊕ J)) hKW₁ hKW₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ (hS.trans hSΩ₀) u₁ u₂ _ _
      (fromBlocks_mul_fromBlocks_eq_one A' B') hu
  have hgen : GeneratesLocally w := by
    refine GeneratesLocally.sup ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hs.res hΩ₁).of_comb fun i ↦
        isSecComb_self (fun k ↦ modRes (u₁ k) Ω₁ hΩ₁) (Sum.inl i)).of_matAct
          (mul_eq_one_comm.1 hH₁) hw₁
    · exact ((ht.res hΩ₂).of_comb fun j ↦
        isSecComb_self (fun k ↦ modRes (u₂ k) Ω₂ hΩ₂) (Sum.inr j)).of_matAct
          (mul_eq_one_comm.1 hH₂) hw₂
  let π := freeHomOfSections w ≫ (restrictModulesObjIso Y (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂) M).inv
  haveI : Epi π := @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ (epi_freeHomOfSections hgen) _ inferInstance
  let Y' := Y.restrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂).isOpenEmbedding
  let M' := (Y.restrictModules (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂)).obj M
  have hY' : Y'.HasLocalRelations := hY.restrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂)
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.unit Y'.ringSheaf).IsCoherent :=
    isCoherentStructureSheaf_of_hasLocalRelations hY'
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y'.ringSheaf) (I ⊕ J)).IsCoherent :=
    SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.free _
  have hM' := isCoherent_restrictModules M (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂)
  haveI : (kernel π).IsCoherent :=
    @SheafOfModules.IsCoherent.kernel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ π inferInstance hM'
  have hS' := shortExact_kernel π
  have hpdK : ∀ y', HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y'.stalkFunctor y').obj (kernel π)) d :=
    fun y' ↦ hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_of_shortExact _ _ _ hS' y' d
      (@Hom.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_pullbackModules _ _
        (Y.ofRestrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂).isOpenEmbedding) y' _ M (d + 1) (hpd _))
  have hrange : Complex.closedBox a₀ b₀ ⊆
      range (Y.ofRestrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂).isOpenEmbedding ≫ f).base := by
    rw [← hK]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := image_sup (union_subset_union hKΩ₁ hKΩ₂ hx)
    exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W', hKW', hW'⟩ := IH (Y.ofRestrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂).isOpenEmbedding ≫ f) hY' (kernel π) hpdK
    a₀ b₀ hrange (hK ▸ (hne.mono (hS₁.trans subset_union_left)))
  have hW'' : ((Y'.restrictModules W').obj (kernel π)).HasFreeResolutionLE d := hW'
  haveI hfl : PreservesFiniteLimits (Y'.restrictModules W') :=
    (Y'.ofRestrict W'.isOpenEmbedding).preservesFiniteLimits_pullbackModules
      (flat_stalkMap_of_isIso _)
  haveI : (Y'.restrictModules W').IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (Y'.ofRestrict W'.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesAdj.isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : PreservesColimits (Y'.restrictModules W') :=
    (Y'.ofRestrict W'.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesAdj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI := Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint (Y'.restrictModules W')
  have hres : ((Y'.restrictModules W').obj M').HasFreeResolutionLE (d + 1) :=
    @SheafOfModules.HasFreeResolutionLE.of_shortExact_map _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (Y'.restrictModules W') inferInstance hfl inferInstance
      (fun I _ ↦ (Y'.ofRestrict W'.isOpenEmbedding).pullbackModulesFreeIso I)
      _ _ _ inferInstance _ _ _ hS' _ hW''
  refine ⟨imOpen (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂) W', ?_,
    hasFreeResolutionLE_restrictModules_of_restrict (Ω₁ ⊔ Ω₂) W' hres⟩
  rw [hK]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hKW' hx
  exact ⟨z.1, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.boxResolution
statement: theorem boxResolution (d : ℕ) : BoxResolution ι d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro Y f _ hY M _ hpd a b hK
    refine Complex.closedBox_induction (NearFreeResolution f M 0) (fun _ _ h hK ↦ hK.mono h)
      (fun h ↦ absurd h Set.not_nonempty_empty) ?_ ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
    · intro i a' b' hord x₀ x₁ hx₀ hx₁ hQ₁ hQ₂
      exact nearFreeResolution_union_zero (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (fun κ _ _ ↦ Complex.matrixSplit_re i (hord i).1 (hord i).2 hx₀ hx₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_left i hx₀) (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_right i hx₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_update_inter_subset i x₀ x₁) (Complex.closedBox_nonempty hord) hQ₁ hQ₂
    · intro i a' b' hord y₀ y₁ hy₀ hy₁ hQ₁ hQ₂
      exact nearFreeResolution_union_zero (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (fun κ _ _ ↦ Complex.matrixSplit_im i (hord i).1 (hord i).2 hy₀ hy₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_left_im i hy₀)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_right_im i hy₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_update_inter_subset_im i y₀ y₁) (Complex.closedBox_nonempty hord) hQ₁
        hQ₂
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hK hx
      obtain ⟨U, hyU, hU⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_of_stalk 0 hY M y (hpd y)
      exact ⟨imageOpens f U, (imageOpens f U).isOpen.mem_nhds ⟨y, hyU, rfl⟩,
        fun K hKU _ ↦ ⟨U, hKU, hU⟩⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    intro Y f _ hY M _ hpd a b hK
    refine Complex.closedBox_induction (NearFreeResolution f M (d + 1))
      (fun _ _ h hK ↦ hK.mono h) (fun h ↦ absurd h Set.not_nonempty_empty) ?_ ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
    · intro i a' b' hord x₀ x₁ hx₀ hx₁ hQ₁ hQ₂
      exact nearFreeResolution_union_succ ih hY hpd (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (fun κ _ _ ↦ Complex.matrixSplit_re i (hord i).1 (hord i).2 hx₀ hx₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_left i hx₀) (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_right i hx₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_update_inter_subset i x₀ x₁) (Complex.closedBox_nonempty hord)
        (Complex.closedBox_union_re i (hord i).1 hx₀ hx₁) hQ₁ hQ₂
    · intro i a' b' hord y₀ y₁ hy₀ hy₁ hQ₁ hQ₂
      exact nearFreeResolution_union_succ ih hY hpd (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (Complex.isCompact_closedBox _ _)
        (fun κ _ _ ↦ Complex.matrixSplit_im i (hord i).1 (hord i).2 hy₀ hy₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_left_im i hy₀)
        (Complex.closedBox_subset_update_right_im i hy₁)
        (Complex.closedBox_update_inter_subset_im i y₀ y₁) (Complex.closedBox_nonempty hord)
        (Complex.closedBox_union_im i (hord i).2 hy₀ hy₁) hQ₁ hQ₂
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hK hx
      obtain ⟨U, hyU, hU⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_of_stalk (d + 1) hY M y (hpd y)
      exact ⟨imageOpens f U, (imageOpens f U).isOpen.mem_nhds ⟨y, hyU, rfl⟩,
        fun K hKU _ ↦ ⟨U, hKU, hU⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_epi_free_of_hasFreeResolutionLE
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | free _ I e => exact ⟨I, inferInstance, e.inv, inferInstance⟩
  | ext I i p w hS _ => exact ⟨I, inferInstance, p, hS.epi_g⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox
statement:
theorem exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {d : ℕ} (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) d)
    {a b : ι → ℂ} (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ range f.base)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace, Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W ∧
      ((Y.restrictModules W).obj M).HasFreeResolutionLE d
proof:
:=
  boxResolution d f hY M hpd a b hK hne

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_epi_free_closedBox
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_closedBox (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {d : ℕ} (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) d)
    {a b : ι → ℂ} (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ range f.base)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (_ : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W) (I : Type u)
      (_ : Finite I) (p : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶ (Y.restrictModules W).obj M), Epi p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hKW, hW⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox f hY M hpd hK hne
  exact ⟨W, hKW, exists_epi_free_of_hasFreeResolutionLE hW⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_sections_closedBox
statement:
theorem exists_sections_closedBox (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {d : ℕ} (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) d)
    {a b : ι → ℂ} (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ range f.base)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (_ : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W) (I : Type u)
      (_ : Fintype I) (s : I → M.val.obj (op W)), GeneratesLocally s ∧
      ∀ (V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (hV : V ≤ W),
        (∃ a' b' : ι → ℂ, (imageOpens f V : Set (ι → ℂ)) = Complex.openBox a' b') →
        ∀ σ : M.val.obj (op V), IsSecComb s hV σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hKW, hW⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox f hY M hpd hK hne
  exact ⟨W, hKW, exists_sections_of_hasFreeResolutionLE f hW⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace
statement:
lemma hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] (y : (complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      ((((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).stalkFunctor y).obj M) n
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finite_stalk_of_isFiniteType M y
  exact hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_stalk_of_isIso
    ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) y
    (hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_stalk_complexAffineSpace n _)
    (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).stalkFunctor y |>.obj M)

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {a b : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ}
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ Complex.closedBox a b, x ∈ U)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ W : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace,
      Complex.closedBox a b ⊆
        imageOpens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) W ∧
      ((((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).restrictModules W).obj
        M).HasFreeResolutionLE n
proof:
:=
  exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding)
    ((hasLocalRelations_complexSpace _).restrict U) M
    (hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace U M)
    (fun x hx ↦ ⟨⟨x, hK x hx⟩, rfl⟩) hne

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_epi_free_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {a b : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ}
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ Complex.closedBox a b, x ∈ U)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (W : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace)
      (_ : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆
        imageOpens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) W) (I : Type u)
      (_ : Finite I) (p : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶
        (((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).restrictModules W).obj M),
      Epi p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hKW, hW⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox_complexAffineSpace U M hK hne
  exact ⟨W, hKW, exists_epi_free_of_hasFreeResolutionLE hW⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_image_eq_openBox
statement:
lemma exists_image_eq_openBox {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} {a b : ι → ℂ}
    (h : Complex.openBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W) :
    ∃ V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace, V ≤ W ∧
      (imageOpens f V : Set (ι → ℂ)) = Complex.openBox a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨W ⊓ (Opens.map f.base).obj ⟨_, isOpen_openBox a b⟩, inf_le_left, ?_⟩
  ext x
  refine ⟨?_, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hy.2
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := h hx
    exact ⟨y, ⟨hy, hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_presentation_closedBox
statement:
theorem exists_presentation_closedBox (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) [M.IsCoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) d) {a b : ι → ℂ}
    (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ range f.base) (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (_ : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W)
      (I I' : Type u) (_ : Fintype I) (_ : Fintype I') (g : I → M.val.obj (op W))
      (A : I' → I → Y.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W)), (∀ j, ∑ i, A j i • g i = 0) ∧
      ∀ (V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (hV : V ≤ W),
        (∃ a' b' : ι → ℂ, (imageOpens f V : Set (ι → ℂ)) = Complex.openBox a' b') →
        (∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen V).obj M.toAb) q)) ∧
        (∀ s : M.val.obj (op V), ∃ c : I → Y.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op V),
          s = ∑ i, c i • M.val.map (homOfLE hV).op (g i)) ∧
        (∀ c : I → Y.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op V),
          ∑ i, c i • M.val.map (homOfLE hV).op (g i) = 0 →
          ∃ e : I' → Y.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op V),
            ∀ i, c i = ∑ j, e j * Y.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hV).op (A j i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hKW, hW⟩ := exists_hasFreeResolutionLE_closedBox f hY M hpd hK hne
  obtain ⟨I, I', _, _, g, A, hA, H⟩ := exists_generators_acyclic W M hW
  exact ⟨W, hKW, I, I', inferInstance, inferInstance, g, A, hA, fun V hV ⟨a', b', hab⟩ ↦
    H V hV (subsingleton_H_structureSheafAb_of_openBox f hab)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_subsingleton_H_closedBox
statement:
theorem exists_subsingleton_H_closedBox (hY : Y.HasLocalRelations)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) [M.IsCoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (hpd : ∀ y, HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Y.stalkFunctor y).obj M) d) {a b : ι → ℂ}
    (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ range f.base) (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace, Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ imageOpens f W ∧
      (∃ a' b' : ι → ℂ, Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ Complex.openBox a' b' ∧
        Complex.openBox a' b' ⊆ imageOpens f W) ∧
      ∀ (V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace), V ≤ W →
        (∃ a' b' : ι → ℂ, (imageOpens f V : Set (ι → ℂ)) = Complex.openBox a' b') →
        ∀ q, 0 < q →
          Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen V).obj M.toAb) q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hKW, I, I', _, _, g, A, -, H⟩ := exists_presentation_closedBox f hY M hpd hK hne
  exact ⟨W, hKW, exists_openBox_between (imageOpens f W).isOpen hKW,
    fun V hV hbox ↦ (H V hV hbox).1⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_subsingleton_H_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
statement:
theorem exists_subsingleton_H_closedBox_complexAffineSpace
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
    [M.IsCoherent] {a b : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ} (hK : ∀ x ∈ Complex.closedBox a b, x ∈ U)
    (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ W : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace,
      Complex.closedBox a b ⊆
        imageOpens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) W ∧
      (∃ a' b' : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ, Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ Complex.openBox a' b' ∧
        Complex.openBox a' b' ⊆
          imageOpens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) W) ∧
      ∀ (V : Opens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace),
        V ≤ W → (∃ a' b' : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ,
          (imageOpens ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding) V :
            Set (ULift.{u} (Fin n) → ℂ)) = Complex.openBox a' b') →
        ∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen V).obj M.toAb) q)
proof:
:=
  exists_subsingleton_H_closedBox ((complexAffineSpace.{u} n).ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding)
    ((hasLocalRelations_complexSpace _).restrict U) M
    (hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace U M)
    (fun x hx ↦ ⟨⟨x, hK x hx⟩, rfl⟩) hne

name: Complex.mapsTo_horizontal_rectBoundary
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [uIcc_of_le hre] at hx
  refine ⟨⟨by simpa using hx, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hy with rfl | rfl <;> simp [him]
  · have := h.2
    simp only [mem_preimage, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, I_im, mul_one, I_re,
      mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, mem_Ioo] at this
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl <;> simp at this

name: Complex.mapsTo_vertical_rectBoundary
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [uIcc_of_le him] at hy
  refine ⟨⟨?_, by simpa using hy⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> simp [hre]
  · have := h.1
    simp only [mem_preimage, add_re, ofReal_re, mul_re, I_re, mul_zero, ofReal_im, I_im,
      mul_one, sub_self, add_zero, mem_Ioo] at this
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> simp at this

name: Complex.rectBoundaryIntegral_sub
statement:
lemma rectBoundaryIntegral_sub (hre : a.re ≤ b.re) (him : a.im ≤ b.im) {f g : ℂ → E}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (rectBoundary a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (rectBoundary a b)) :
    rectBoundaryIntegral (fun ζ ↦ f ζ - g ζ) a b =
      rectBoundaryIntegral f a b - rectBoundaryIntegral g a b
proof:
:= by
  have hH : ∀ {y : ℝ}, (y = a.im ∨ y = b.im) → ∀ {h : ℂ → E},
      ContinuousOn h (rectBoundary a b) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ ↦ h (x + y * I)) volume a.re b.re := fun hy _ hh ↦
    (hh.comp (by fun_prop) (mapsTo_horizontal_rectBoundary hre him hy)).intervalIntegrable
  have hV : ∀ {x : ℝ}, (x = a.re ∨ x = b.re) → ∀ {h : ℂ → E},
      ContinuousOn h (rectBoundary a b) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ ↦ h (x + y * I)) volume a.im b.im := fun hx _ hh ↦
    (hh.comp (by fun_prop) (mapsTo_vertical_rectBoundary hre him hx)).intervalIntegrable
  simp only [rectBoundaryIntegral]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hH (Or.inl rfl) hf) (hH (Or.inl rfl) hg),
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hH (Or.inr rfl) hf) (hH (Or.inr rfl) hg),
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hV (Or.inr rfl) hf) (hV (Or.inr rfl) hg),
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hV (Or.inl rfl) hf) (hV (Or.inl rfl) hg)]
  simp only [smul_sub]
  abel

name: Complex.rectBoundaryIntegral_congr
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectBoundaryIntegral]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx ↦
      h (mapsTo_horizontal_rectBoundary hre him (Or.inl rfl) hx),
    intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx ↦
      h (mapsTo_horizontal_rectBoundary hre him (Or.inr rfl) hx),
    intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun y hy ↦
      h (mapsTo_vertical_rectBoundary hre him (Or.inr rfl) hy),
    intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun y hy ↦
      h (mapsTo_vertical_rectBoundary hre him (Or.inl rfl) hy)]

name: Complex.rectBoundaryIntegral_smul_const
statement:
lemma rectBoundaryIntegral_smul_const [CompleteSpace E] (g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : E) :
    rectBoundaryIntegral (fun ζ ↦ g ζ • c) a b = rectBoundaryIntegral g a b • c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectBoundaryIntegral, intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const, sub_smul, add_smul,
    smul_assoc]

name: Complex.integral_div_affine_eq_log
proof:
:= by
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ log (u * t + v))
    (f' := fun t : ℝ ↦ u / (u * t + v)) (fun t ht ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ u * (t : ℂ) + v) u t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp.const_mul u).add_const v
    exact hd.clog_real (h t ht)
  · exact (continuousOn_const.div (by fun_prop)
      fun t ht ↦ slitPlane_ne_zero (h t ht)).intervalIntegrable

name: Complex.log_neg_of_im_pos
statement: lemma log_neg_of_im_pos {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) : log (-w) = log w - (π : ℂ) * I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [log_re, log_im, arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos hw]

name: Complex.log_neg_of_im_neg
statement: lemma log_neg_of_im_neg {w : ℂ} (hw : w.im < 0) : log (-w) = log w + (π : ℂ) * I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [log_re, log_im, arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg hw]

name: Complex.rectBoundaryIntegral_sub_inv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3, hz4⟩ := hz
  set p₁ : ℂ := a.re + a.im * I - z
  set p₂ : ℂ := b.re + a.im * I - z
  set p₃ : ℂ := b.re + b.im * I - z
  set p₄ : ℂ := a.re + b.im * I - z
  have hbot : (∫ x : ℝ in a.re..b.re, ((x : ℂ) + a.im * I - z)⁻¹) = log p₂ - log p₁ := by
    have h := integral_div_affine_eq_log 1 (a.im * I - z) (t₀ := a.re) (t₁ := b.re)
      fun t _ ↦ mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr (by simp; linarith))
    convert h using 1
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ ↦ by simp only [one_mul, one_div]; ring_nf
    · simp only [p₁, p₂, one_mul]; ring_nf
  have htop : (∫ x : ℝ in a.re..b.re, ((x : ℂ) + b.im * I - z)⁻¹) = log p₃ - log p₄ := by
    have h := integral_div_affine_eq_log 1 (b.im * I - z) (t₀ := a.re) (t₁ := b.re)
      fun t _ ↦ mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr (by simp; linarith))
    convert h using 1
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ ↦ by simp only [one_mul, one_div]; ring_nf
    · simp only [p₃, p₄, one_mul]; ring_nf
  have hright : I • (∫ y : ℝ in a.im..b.im, ((b.re : ℂ) + y * I - z)⁻¹) =
      log p₃ - log p₂ := by
    have h := integral_div_affine_eq_log I (b.re - z) (t₀ := a.im) (t₁ := b.im)
      fun t _ ↦ mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by simp; linarith))
    rw [smul_eq_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    convert h using 1
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun y _ ↦ by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring_nf
    · simp only [p₂, p₃]; ring_nf
  have hleft : I • (∫ y : ℝ in a.im..b.im, ((a.re : ℂ) + y * I - z)⁻¹) =
      log (-p₄) - log (-p₁) := by
    have h := integral_div_affine_eq_log (-I) (z - a.re) (t₀ := a.im) (t₁ := b.im)
      fun t _ ↦ mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by simp; linarith))
    rw [smul_eq_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    convert h using 1
    · refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun y _ ↦ ?_
      rw [show -I * (y : ℂ) + (z - a.re) = -((a.re : ℂ) + y * I - z) by ring, neg_div_neg_eq,
        div_eq_mul_inv]
    · simp only [p₁, p₄]; ring_nf
  have h₄ : log (-p₄) = log p₄ - (π : ℂ) * I := log_neg_of_im_pos (by simp [p₄]; linarith)
  have h₁ : log (-p₁) = log p₁ + (π : ℂ) * I := log_neg_of_im_neg (by simp [p₁]; linarith)
  simp only [rectBoundaryIntegral]
  rw [hbot, htop, hright, hleft, h₄, h₁]
  ring

name: Complex.rectBoundaryIntegral_sub_inv_smul
statement:
theorem rectBoundaryIntegral_sub_inv_smul [CompleteSpace E] {a b z : ℂ} {f : ℂ → E}
    (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a.re b.re ×ℂ Icc a.im b.im))
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Ioo a.re b.re ×ℂ Ioo a.im b.im))
    (hz : z ∈ Ioo a.re b.re ×ℂ Ioo a.im b.im) :
    rectBoundaryIntegral (fun ζ ↦ (ζ - z)⁻¹ • f ζ) a b = (2 * π * I) • f z
proof:
:= by
  have hre : a.re ≤ b.re := (hz.1.1.trans hz.1.2).le
  have him : a.im ≤ b.im := (hz.2.1.trans hz.2.2).le
  have hopen : IsOpen (Ioo a.re b.re ×ℂ Ioo a.im b.im) := isOpen_Ioo.reProdIm isOpen_Ioo
  have hsub : Ioo a.re b.re ×ℂ Ioo a.im b.im ⊆ Icc a.re b.re ×ℂ Icc a.im b.im :=
    fun w hw ↦ ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw.2⟩
  have hzb : ∀ ζ ∈ rectBoundary a b, ζ ≠ z := fun ζ hζ h ↦ hζ.2 (h ▸ hz)
  set F : ℂ → E := dslope f z
  have hcF : ContinuousOn F (Icc a.re b.re ×ℂ Icc a.im b.im) :=
    (continuousOn_dslope (Filter.mem_of_superset (hopen.mem_nhds hz) hsub)).2
      ⟨hc, hd.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hz)⟩
  have hdF : ∀ w ∈ Ioo (min a.re b.re) (max a.re b.re) ×ℂ Ioo (min a.im b.im) (max a.im b.im) \
      {z}, DifferentiableAt ℂ F w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [min_eq_left hre, max_eq_right hre, min_eq_left him, max_eq_right him] at hw
    exact (differentiableAt_dslope_of_ne hw.2).2 (hd.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hw.1))
  have hG : rectBoundaryIntegral F a b = 0 := by
    refine integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiable_on_off_countable F a b {z}
      (countable_singleton z) ?_ hdF
    rwa [uIcc_of_le hre, uIcc_of_le him]
  have hinv : ContinuousOn (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ (ζ - z)⁻¹) (rectBoundary a b) :=
    (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ fun ζ hζ ↦ sub_ne_zero.2 (hzb ζ hζ)
  have hbd : rectBoundary a b ⊆ Icc a.re b.re ×ℂ Icc a.im b.im := sdiff_subset
  have hFeq : EqOn F (fun ζ ↦ (ζ - z)⁻¹ • f ζ - (ζ - z)⁻¹ • f z) (rectBoundary a b) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    simp only [F, dslope_of_ne f (hzb ζ hζ), slope_def_module, smul_sub]
  rw [rectBoundaryIntegral_congr hre him hFeq,
    rectBoundaryIntegral_sub hre him (f := fun ζ ↦ (ζ - z)⁻¹ • f ζ)
      (g := fun ζ ↦ (ζ - z)⁻¹ • f z) (hinv.smul (hc.mono hbd)) (hinv.smul continuousOn_const),
    rectBoundaryIntegral_smul_const, rectBoundaryIntegral_sub_inv hz, sub_eq_zero] at hG
  exact hG

name: CechProjectiveAn.V_eq_polyAnnulus
statement:
lemma V_eq_polyAnnulus (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    V I = polyAnnulus (radii I) (fun _ ↦ ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [V, mem_setOf_eq, mem_polyAnnulus, annulus, radii, enorm_lt_top, and_true]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hj
    · exact norm_pos_iff.2 (h j hj)
    · linarith [norm_nonneg (z j)]
  · have := h j
    rw [if_pos hj] at this
    exact norm_pos_iff.1 this

name: CechProjectiveAn.isRadius_one
statement:
lemma isRadius_one (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsRadius (radii I j) ((fun _ ↦ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) j) ((fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨one_pos, ?_, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
  simp only [radii]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: CechProjectiveAn.isOpen_V
statement: lemma isOpen_V (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) : IsOpen (V I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [V_eq_polyAnnulus]; exact isOpen_polyAnnulus _ _

name: CechProjectiveAn.V_anti
statement: lemma V_anti {I J : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (h : J ⊆ I) : V I ⊆ V J
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz j hj ↦ hz j (h hj)

name: CechProjectiveAn.torus_subset_V
statement: lemma torus_subset_V (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) : torus (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) ⊆ V I
proof:
:= by
  rw [V_eq_polyAnnulus]; exact torus_subset_polyAnnulus (isRadius_one I)

name: CechProjectiveAn.smul_mem_V
statement:
lemma smul_mem_V {I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ V I) : c • z ∈ V I
proof:
:=
  fun j hj ↦ by simpa using And.intro hc (hz j hj)

name: CechProjectiveAn.const_mem_V
statement:
lemma const_mem_V (I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (fun _ ↦ c) ∈ V I
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ hc

name: CechProjectiveAn.prod_zpow_eq
statement:
lemma prod_zpow_eq {G₀ : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero G₀] {c : G₀} (hc : c ≠ 0) (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    ∏ i, c ^ k i = c ^ ∑ i, k i
proof:
:= by
  have (s : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) : ∏ i ∈ s, c ^ k i = c ^ ∑ i ∈ s, k i := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, zpow_add₀ hc, ih]
  exact this _

name: CechProjectiveAn.monomial_smul
statement:
lemma monomial_smul {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    monomial k (c • z) = c ^ (∑ i, k i) * monomial k z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomial, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_zpow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    prod_zpow_eq hc]

name: CechProjectiveAn.monomial_one
statement: lemma monomial_one (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) : monomial k (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [monomial]

name: CechProjectiveAn.monomial_const
statement:
lemma monomial_const {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    monomial k (fun _ ↦ c) = c ^ (∑ i, k i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [monomial, prod_zpow_eq hc]

name: CechProjectiveAn.coe_holRes
statement:
lemma coe_holRes (d : ℤ) {I J : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (h : J ⊆ I) (f : hol d J) :
    (holRes d h f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) = (V I).indicator f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.mem_negSupp
statement: lemma mem_negSupp {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} : j ∈ negSupp k ↔ k j < 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [negSupp]

name: CechProjectiveAn.proj_apply
statement:
lemma proj_apply (N : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (a : Coeff n) (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    proj N a k = if negSupp k = N then a k else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.grading_proj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma grading_proj (N : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (a : Coeff n) :
    (grading n).proj N a = proj N a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_iff
statement:
lemma summableAt_iff (a : Coeff n) (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    SummableAt a w ↔ Summable fun k ↦ ‖a k * monomial k w‖
proof:
:= by
  simp [SummableAt, norm_monomial]

name: CechProjectiveAn.SummableAt.of_le
statement:
lemma SummableAt.of_le {a b : Coeff n} {w w' : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (h : SummableAt b w')
    (hab : ∀ k, a k ≠ 0 → ‖a k‖ ≤ ‖b k‖ ∧ ∀ i, ‖w i‖ ^ k i ≤ ‖w' i‖ ^ k i) :
    SummableAt a w
proof:
:= by
  refine h.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k ↦ mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)) fun k ↦ ?_
  by_cases hk : a k = 0
  · simp only [hk, norm_zero, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  · exact mul_le_mul (hab k hk).1 (Finset.prod_le_prod
      (fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) fun i _ ↦ (hab k hk).2 i)
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (norm_nonneg _)

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_zero
statement: lemma summableAt_zero (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) : SummableAt 0 w
proof:
:= by
  simp [SummableAt, summable_zero]

name: CechProjectiveAn.SummableAt.add
statement:
lemma SummableAt.add {a b : Coeff n} {w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (ha : SummableAt a w)
    (hb : SummableAt b w) : SummableAt (a + b) w
proof:
:= by
  refine (Summable.add ha hb).of_nonneg_of_le (fun k ↦ mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)) fun k ↦ ?_
  rw [← add_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le _ _)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)

name: CechProjectiveAn.SummableAt.smul
statement:
lemma SummableAt.smul {a : Coeff n} {w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (ha : SummableAt a w) (c : ℂ) :
    SummableAt (c • a) w
proof:
:= by
  refine (ha.mul_left ‖c‖).congr fun k ↦ ?_
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_of_proj
statement:
lemma summableAt_of_proj {a : Coeff n} {w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ}
    (h : ∀ N, SummableAt (proj N a) w) : SummableAt a w
proof:
:= by
  refine (summable_sum fun N (_ : N ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ h N).congr fun k ↦ ?_
  simp [proj_apply, apply_ite, ite_mul]

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_of_finite
statement:
lemma summableAt_of_finite {a : Coeff n} (s : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → ℤ))
    (hs : ∀ k ∉ s, a k = 0) (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) : SummableAt a w
proof:
:=
  summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := s) fun k hk ↦ by simp [hs k hk]

name: CechProjectiveAn.proj_mem_coeffSpace
statement:
lemma proj_mem_coeffSpace {d : ℤ} (N : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) {a : Coeff n}
    (ha : a ∈ coeffSpace n d) : proj N a ∈ coeffSpace n d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun k hk ↦ ha.1 k fun h ↦ hk (by simp [proj_apply, h]), fun N' w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  have := (grading n).proj_proj N' N a
  simp only [grading_proj] at this
  rw [this]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact ha.2 N' w hw
  · exact summableAt_zero w

name: CechProjectiveAn.proj_eq_zero_of_negSupp
statement:
lemma proj_eq_zero_of_negSupp {I N : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {a : Coeff n}
    (ha : ∀ k, a k ≠ 0 → negSupp k ⊆ I) (hN : ¬ N ⊆ I) : proj N a = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · by_contra hk
    exact hN (h ▸ ha k hk)
  · rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_of_mem_coef
statement:
lemma summableAt_of_mem_coef {d : ℤ} {I : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {a : Coeff n}
    (ha : a ∈ coef d I) {w : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (hw : w ∈ V I) : SummableAt a w
proof:
:= by
  refine summableAt_of_proj fun N ↦ ?_
  by_cases hN : N ⊆ I
  · exact ha.1.2 N w (V_anti hN hw)
  · rw [proj_eq_zero_of_negSupp ha.2 hN]; exact summableAt_zero w

name: CechProjectiveAn.isAdmissible_iff
statement:
lemma isAdmissible_iff {p : ℕ} (x : Cochain (Fin (n + 1)) (Coeff n) p) :
    (grading n).IsAdmissible x ↔ ∀ i k, x i k ≠ 0 → negSupp k ⊆ im i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i k hk ↦ by_contra fun hN ↦ hk ?_, fun h i N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := congrFun (h i _ hN) k
    simpa [proj_apply] using this
  · ext k
    simp only [grading_proj, proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    split_ifs with hk
    · by_contra hx
      exact hN (hk ▸ h i k hx)
    · rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.differentiableOn_polyAnnulus
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_polyAnnulus (hf : f ∈ hol d I) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (polyAnnulus (radii I) fun _ ↦ ⊤)
proof:
:=
  V_eq_polyAnnulus I ▸ hf.1

name: CechProjectiveAn.hasSum_toCoeff
statement:
lemma hasSum_toCoeff (hf : f ∈ hol d I) {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ V I) :
    HasSum (fun k ↦ toCoeff f k * monomial k z) (f z)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_mcoeff (differentiableOn_polyAnnulus hf) (isRadius_one I) (V_eq_polyAnnulus I ▸ hz)

name: CechProjectiveAn.summableAt_toCoeff
statement:
lemma summableAt_toCoeff (hf : f ∈ hol d I) {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ V I) :
    SummableAt (toCoeff f) z
proof:
:=
  (summableAt_iff _ _).2 (summable_norm_mcoeff_mul (differentiableOn_polyAnnulus hf)
    (isRadius_one I) (V_eq_polyAnnulus I ▸ hz))

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum
statement:
lemma toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum {b : Coeff n} (hb : SummableAt b fun _ ↦ 1)
    (h : ∀ z ∈ torus (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)), HasSum (fun k ↦ b k * monomial k z) (f z)) :
    toCoeff f = b
proof:
:=
  funext (mcoeff_eq_of_hasSum (fun _ ↦ one_pos) (by simpa [SummableAt] using hb) h)

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_indicator
statement:
lemma toCoeff_indicator (J : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) :
    toCoeff ((V J).indicator f) = toCoeff f
proof:
:=
  funext fun k ↦ mcoeff_congr (fun _ ↦ zero_le_one)
    (fun _ hz ↦ indicator_of_mem (torus_subset_V J hz) f) k

name: CechProjectiveAn.sum_eq_of_toCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma sum_eq_of_toCoeff_ne_zero (hf : f ∈ hol d I) {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ}
    (hk : toCoeff f k ≠ 0) : ∑ i, k i = d
proof:
:= by
  set a := toCoeff f
  have h2 : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := two_ne_zero
  have hb : SummableAt a fun _ ↦ 2 := summableAt_toCoeff hf (const_mem_V I h2)
  have e1 : toCoeff (fun z ↦ f ((2 : ℂ) • z)) = fun k ↦ a k * 2 ^ (∑ i, k i) := by
    refine toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum ?_ fun z hz ↦ ?_
    · rw [summableAt_iff] at hb ⊢
      simpa [monomial_one, monomial_const h2] using hb
    · convert hasSum_toCoeff hf (smul_mem_V h2 (torus_subset_V I hz)) using 1
      ext k
      rw [monomial_smul h2]
      ring
  have e2 : toCoeff (fun z ↦ f ((2 : ℂ) • z)) = (2 : ℂ) ^ d • a := by
    refine toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum
      ((summableAt_toCoeff hf (const_mem_V I one_ne_zero)).smul _) fun z hz ↦ ?_
    have hz' := torus_subset_V I hz
    rw [hf.2.1 z hz' 2 h2]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using (hasSum_toCoeff hf hz').mul_left ((2 : ℂ) ^ d)
  have h := congrFun (e1.symm.trans e2) k
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  have h' := congrArg norm (mul_right_cancel₀ hk h)
  simp only [norm_zpow, Complex.norm_ofNat] at h'
  exact zpow_right_injective₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (by norm_num) h'

name: CechProjectiveAn.negSupp_subset_of_toCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma negSupp_subset_of_toCoeff_ne_zero (hf : f ∈ hol d I) {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ}
    (hk : toCoeff f k ≠ 0) : negSupp k ⊆ I
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  by_contra hjI
  exact hk (mcoeff_eq_zero_of_neg (differentiableOn_polyAnnulus hf) (isRadius_one I) (i := j)
    (by simp [radii, hjI]) (mem_negSupp.1 hj))

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_mem
statement: lemma toCoeff_mem (hf : f ∈ hol d I) : toCoeff f ∈ coef d I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneg := fun k (hk : toCoeff f k ≠ 0) ↦ negSupp_subset_of_toCoeff_ne_zero hf hk
  refine ⟨⟨fun k hk ↦ sum_eq_of_toCoeff_ne_zero hf hk, fun N w hw ↦ ?_⟩, hneg⟩
  by_cases hN : N ⊆ I
  · let w' : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ := fun j ↦ if j ∈ I ∧ j ∉ N then ((‖w j‖ + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) else w j
    have hw' : w' ∈ V I := fun j hj ↦ by
      by_cases hjN : j ∈ N
      · simp [w', hjN, hw j hjN]
      · simp only [w', hj, hjN, not_false_eq_true, and_self, if_true, ne_eq,
          Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]
        positivity
    refine (summableAt_toCoeff hf hw').of_le fun k hk ↦ ?_
    by_cases hkN : negSupp k = N
    swap
    · simp [proj_apply, hkN] at hk
    simp only [proj_apply, if_pos hkN]
    refine ⟨le_rfl, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    by_cases hi : i ∈ I ∧ i ∉ N
    · have : 0 ≤ k i := not_lt.1 fun h ↦ hi.2 (hkN ▸ mem_negSupp.2 h)
      simp only [w', hi, not_false_eq_true, and_self, if_true, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      exact zpow_le_zpow_left₀ this (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    · simp only [w', hi, if_false, le_refl]
  · rw [proj_eq_zero_of_negSupp hneg hN]
    exact summableAt_zero w

name: CechProjectiveAn.hasSum_ofCoeff
statement:
lemma hasSum_ofCoeff {a : Coeff n} (ha : a ∈ coef d I) {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ V I) :
    HasSum (fun k ↦ a k * monomial k z) (ofCoeff I a z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofCoeff, indicator_of_mem hz]
  exact (Summable.of_norm ((summableAt_iff _ _).1 (summableAt_of_mem_coef ha hz))).hasSum

name: CechProjectiveAn.ofCoeff_mem
statement: lemma ofCoeff_mem {a : Coeff n} (ha : a ∈ coef d I) : ofCoeff I a ∈ hol d I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun z hz c hc ↦ ?_, fun z hz ↦ indicator_of_notMem hz _⟩
  · have hb0 : ∀ k i, radii I i < 0 → k i < 0 → a k = 0 := fun k i hr hk ↦ by
      by_contra hak
      have := ha.2 k hak (mem_negSupp.2 hk)
      simp [radii, this] at hr
    have := differentiableOn_tsum_monomial hb0
      (fun w hw ↦ summableAt_of_mem_coef ha ((V_eq_polyAnnulus I).symm ▸ hw))
    rw [← V_eq_polyAnnulus] at this
    exact this.congr fun z hz ↦ indicator_of_mem hz _
  · rw [← (hasSum_ofCoeff ha (smul_mem_V hc hz)).tsum_eq, ← (hasSum_ofCoeff ha hz).tsum_eq,
      ← tsum_mul_left]
    congr 1
    ext k
    rw [monomial_smul hc]
    by_cases hk : a k = 0
    · simp [hk]
    · rw [ha.1.1 k hk]; ring

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_ofCoeff
statement: lemma toCoeff_ofCoeff {a : Coeff n} (ha : a ∈ coef d I) : toCoeff (ofCoeff I a) = a
proof:
:=
  toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum (summableAt_of_mem_coef ha (const_mem_V I one_ne_zero))
    fun _ hz ↦ hasSum_ofCoeff ha (torus_subset_V I hz)

name: CechProjectiveAn.ofCoeff_toCoeff
statement: lemma ofCoeff_toCoeff (hf : f ∈ hol d I) : ofCoeff I (toCoeff f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ V I
  · exact (hasSum_ofCoeff (toCoeff_mem hf) hz).unique (hasSum_toCoeff hf hz)
  · rw [ofCoeff, indicator_of_notMem hz, hf.2.2 z hz]

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_add
statement:
lemma toCoeff_add (hf : f ∈ hol d I) (hg : g ∈ hol d I) :
    toCoeff (f + g) = toCoeff f + toCoeff g
proof:
:=
  toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum ((summableAt_toCoeff hf (const_mem_V I one_ne_zero)).add
    (summableAt_toCoeff hg (const_mem_V I one_ne_zero))) fun z hz ↦ by
    have hz' := torus_subset_V I hz
    simpa [add_mul] using (hasSum_toCoeff hf hz').add (hasSum_toCoeff hg hz')

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCoeff_smul
statement: lemma toCoeff_smul (hf : f ∈ hol d I) (c : ℂ) : toCoeff (c • f) = c • toCoeff f
proof:
:=
  toCoeff_eq_of_hasSum ((summableAt_toCoeff hf (const_mem_V I one_ne_zero)).smul c)
    fun z hz ↦ by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using (hasSum_toCoeff hf (torus_subset_V I hz)).mul_left c

name: CechProjectiveAn.coe_holEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_holEquiv (f : hol d I) : (holEquiv d I f : Coeff n) = toCoeff f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.coe_holEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_holEquiv_symm (a : coef d I) :
    ((holEquiv d I).symm a : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) = ofCoeff I a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCochain_mem
statement:
lemma toCochain_mem {p : ℕ} (x : HolCochain d n p) (i : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    toCochain x i ∈ coef d (im i)
proof:
:=
  toCoeff_mem (x i).2

name: CechProjectiveAn.isAdmissible_toCochain
statement:
lemma isAdmissible_toCochain {p : ℕ} (x : HolCochain d n p) :
    (grading n).IsAdmissible (toCochain x)
proof:
:=
  (isAdmissible_iff _).2 fun i k hk ↦ (toCochain_mem x i).2 k hk

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCochain_injective
statement: lemma toCochain_injective {p : ℕ} : Function.Injective (toCochain (d := d) (n := n) (p := p))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ funext fun i ↦ (holEquiv d (im i)).injective (Subtype.ext (congrFun h i))

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCochain_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toCochain_zero {p : ℕ} : toCochain (0 : HolCochain d n p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change toCoeff ((0 : hol d (im i)) : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) = 0
  rw [← coe_holEquiv, map_zero]
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.exists_toCochain_eq
statement:
lemma exists_toCochain_eq {p : ℕ} (y : Cochain (Fin (n + 1)) (Coeff n) p)
    (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ coef d (im i)) : ∃ x : HolCochain d n p, toCochain x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i ↦ (holEquiv d (im i)).symm ⟨y i, hy i⟩, funext fun i ↦ by
    change toCoeff ((holEquiv d (im i)).symm ⟨y i, hy i⟩ : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) = y i
    rw [← coe_holEquiv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCochain_holD
statement:
lemma toCochain_holD {p : ℕ} (x : HolCochain d n p) :
    toCochain (holD d p x) = SimplexCochain.d p (toCochain x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [SimplexCochain.d_apply]
  change toCoeff ((∑ k : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ)) •
    holRes d (im_comp_subset i k.succAbove) (x fun a ↦ i (k.succAbove a)) : hol d (im i)) :
      (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) = _
  rw [← coe_holEquiv, map_sum, Submodule.coe_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_zsmul, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, coe_holEquiv, coe_holRes, toCoeff_indicator]
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_holD
statement:
@[simp]
lemma holD_holD {p : ℕ} (x : HolCochain d n p) : holD d (p + 1) (holD d p x) = 0
proof:
:=
  toCochain_injective (by rw [toCochain_holD, toCochain_holD, d_d, toCochain_zero])

name: CechProjectiveAn.proj_univ_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
lemma proj_univ_eq_zero_of_lt {a : Coeff n} (ha : a ∈ coeffSpace n d)
    (hd : -((n : ℤ) + 1) < d) : proj Finset.univ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  split_ifs with hk
  · by_contra hak
    have hs := ha.1 k hak
    have : ∑ i, k i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ by
      have := mem_negSupp.1 (hk ▸ Finset.mem_univ i)
      omega
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at this
    push_cast at this
    omega
  · rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_exact
statement:
theorem holD_exact (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : n ≤ p ∨ p + 1 < n ∨ -((n : ℤ) + 1) < d) :
    Function.Exact (holD d (n := n) p) (holD d (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hdx : SimplexCochain.d (p + 1) (toCochain x) = 0 := by
      rw [← toCochain_holD, hx, toCochain_zero]
    have hadm := isAdmissible_toCochain x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyS, hdy⟩ := (grading n).exists_eq_d (coeffSpace n d).toAddSubgroup
      (fun N _ hm ↦ proj_mem_coeffSpace N hm) (toCochain x) hadm
      (fun i ↦ (toCochain_mem x i).1) hdx (by
        rcases hp with hp | hp | hp
        · left; simpa using hp
        · right; exact (grading n).proj_univ_eq_zero hadm (by simpa using hp)
        · right; intro i; exact proj_univ_eq_zero_of_lt (toCochain_mem x i).1 hp)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_toCochain_eq y fun i ↦ ⟨hyS i, (isAdmissible_iff y).1 hy i⟩
    exact ⟨w, toCochain_injective (by rw [toCochain_holD, hw, hdy])⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact holD_holD w

name: CechProjectiveAn.expToInt_injective
statement: lemma expToInt_injective : Function.Injective (expToInt (n := n))
proof:
:= fun s t h ↦ by
  ext i
  simpa [expToInt] using congrFun h i

name: CechProjectiveAn.sum_expToInt
statement: lemma sum_expToInt (s : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) : ∑ i, expToInt s i = (s.degree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [expToInt, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]

name: CechProjectiveAn.polyCoeff_apply
statement:
lemma polyCoeff_apply (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) (k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    polyCoeff n P k = if ∀ i, 0 ≤ k i then
      P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun i ↦ (k i).toNat) else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.expToInt_toNat
statement:
lemma expToInt_toNat {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ} (hk : ∀ i, 0 ≤ k i) :
    expToInt (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun i ↦ (k i).toNat) = k
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [expToInt, hk i]

name: CechProjectiveAn.polyCoeff_expToInt
statement:
lemma polyCoeff_expToInt (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) (s : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) :
    polyCoeff n P (expToInt s) = P.coeff s
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyCoeff_apply, if_pos fun i ↦ by simp [expToInt]]
  congr
  ext i
  simp [expToInt]

name: CechProjectiveAn.exists_expToInt_of_polyCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyCoeff_apply] at hk
  split_ifs at hk with h0
  · exact ⟨_, hk, expToInt_toNat h0⟩
  · exact absurd rfl hk

name: CechProjectiveAn.polyCoeff_eq_zero_of_notMem
statement:
lemma polyCoeff_eq_zero_of_notMem (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ}
    (hk : k ∉ P.support.image expToInt) : polyCoeff n P k = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := exists_expToInt_of_polyCoeff_ne_zero h
  exact hk (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.2 hs))

name: CechProjectiveAn.hasSum_polyCoeff
statement:
lemma hasSum_polyCoeff (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun k ↦ polyCoeff n P k * monomial k z) (MvPolynomial.eval z P)
proof:
:= by
  have h : MvPolynomial.eval z P =
      ∑ k ∈ P.support.image expToInt, polyCoeff n P k * monomial k z := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq', Finset.sum_image expToInt_injective.injOn]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [polyCoeff_expToInt]
    simp [monomial, expToInt]
  rw [h]
  exact hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero fun k hk ↦ by rw [polyCoeff_eq_zero_of_notMem P hk, zero_mul]

name: CechProjectiveAn.polyCoeff_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule] at hP
  refine ⟨⟨fun k hk ↦ ?_, fun N w _ ↦ summableAt_of_finite (P.support.image expToInt)
    (fun k hk ↦ ?_) w⟩, fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := exists_expToInt_of_polyCoeff_ne_zero hk
    have : s.degree = e := by rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]; exact hP hs
    rw [sum_expToInt, this]
  · simp [proj_apply, polyCoeff_eq_zero_of_notMem P hk]
  · obtain ⟨s, -, rfl⟩ := exists_expToInt_of_polyCoeff_ne_zero hk
    intro j hj
    have := mem_negSupp.1 hj
    simp only [expToInt] at this
    omega

name: CechProjectiveAn.holAug_apply
statement:
lemma holAug_apply {e : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ e)
    (i : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) {z : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ V (im i)) :
    (holAug n e P i : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) z =
      MvPolynomial.eval z (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_ofCoeff (polyCoeff_mem P.2 _) hz).unique (hasSum_polyCoeff _ z)

name: CechProjectiveAn.toCochain_holAug
statement:
lemma toCochain_holAug {e : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ e) :
    toCochain (holAug n e P) = SimplexCochain.aug (polyCoeff n P)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change toCoeff (ofCoeff (im i) (polyCoeff n P)) = _
  rw [toCoeff_ofCoeff (polyCoeff_mem P.2 _)]
  rfl

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_holAug
statement:
@[simp]
lemma holD_holAug {e : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ e) :
    holD (e : ℤ) 0 (holAug n e P) = 0
proof:
:=
  toCochain_injective (by rw [toCochain_holD, toCochain_holAug, d_aug, toCochain_zero])

name: CechProjectiveAn.holAug_injective
statement: theorem holAug_injective (e : ℕ) : Function.Injective (holAug n e)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  have h' := congrFun (congrArg toCochain h) fun _ ↦ 0
  rw [toCochain_holAug, toCochain_holAug] at h'
  refine Subtype.ext (MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun s ↦ ?_)
  rw [← polyCoeff_expToInt, ← polyCoeff_expToInt]
  exact congrFun h' _

name: CechProjectiveAn.nonneg_of_proj_empty
statement:
lemma nonneg_of_proj_empty {v : Coeff n} (hv : proj ∅ v = v) {k : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ}
    (hk : v k ≠ 0) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 ≤ k i
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun hv k
  rw [proj_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h with h0
  · exact not_lt.1 fun hi ↦ by simpa [h0] using mem_negSupp.2 hi
  · exact absurd h.symm hk

name: CechProjectiveAn.exists_toCochain_eq_aug
statement:
lemma exists_toCochain_eq_aug (x : HolCochain d n 0) (hx : holD d 0 x = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n ∨ -((n : ℤ) + 1) < d) :
    ∃ v ∈ coeffSpace n d, (∀ k, v k ≠ 0 → ∀ i, 0 ≤ k i) ∧ toCochain x = SimplexCochain.aug v
proof:
:= by
  have hdx : SimplexCochain.d 0 (toCochain x) = 0 := by rw [← toCochain_holD, hx, toCochain_zero]
  have hadm := isAdmissible_toCochain x
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hxv⟩ := (grading n).exists_eq_aug (toCochain x) hadm hdx (by
    rcases hn with hn | hn
    · exact (grading n).proj_univ_eq_zero hadm (by simpa using hn)
    · intro i; exact proj_univ_eq_zero_of_lt (toCochain_mem x i).1 hn)
  have hvx : v = toCochain x fun _ ↦ 0 := by rw [hxv]; rfl
  exact ⟨v, hvx ▸ (toCochain_mem x _).1, fun k hk ↦ nonneg_of_proj_empty hv hk, hxv⟩

name: CechProjectiveAn.holAug_exact
statement: theorem holAug_exact (e : ℕ) : Function.Exact (holAug n e) (holD (e : ℤ) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨P, rfl⟩; exact holD_holAug P⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hv0, hxv⟩ := exists_toCochain_eq_aug x hx (Or.inr (by omega))
  have hfin : (Function.support fun s : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ ↦ v (expToInt s)).Finite :=
    (Finsupp.finite_of_degree_le e).subset fun s hs ↦ by
      have := hvS.1 _ hs
      rw [sum_expToInt] at this
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
      omega
  let P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ := AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite _ hfin)
  have hP (s : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) : P.coeff s = v (expToInt s) := rfl
  have hPv : polyCoeff n P = v := by
    funext k
    rw [polyCoeff_apply]
    split_ifs with h0
    · rw [hP, expToInt_toNat h0]
    · by_contra hk
      exact h0 (hv0 k (Ne.symm hk))
  have hPh : P ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ e := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule]
    intro s hs
    rw [hP] at hs
    have := hvS.1 _ hs
    rw [sum_expToInt] at this
    have h : s.degree = e := by exact_mod_cast this
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨⟨P, hPh⟩, toCochain_injective (by rw [toCochain_holAug, hxv]; exact congrArg _ hPv)⟩

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_zero_injective
statement:
theorem holD_zero_injective {d : ℤ} (hd : d < 0) (hn : 0 < n ∨ -((n : ℤ) + 1) < d) :
    Function.Injective (holD d (n := n) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hv0, hxv⟩ := exists_toCochain_eq_aug x hx hn
  have hv : v = 0 := by
    funext k
    by_contra hk
    have h1 := hvS.1 k hk
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, k i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hv0 k hk i
    omega
  exact toCochain_injective (by rw [hxv, hv, map_zero, toCochain_zero])

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_exact_zero
statement: theorem holD_exact_zero (p : ℕ) : Function.Exact (holD 0 (n := n) p) (holD 0 (p + 1))
proof:
:=
  holD_exact 0 p (Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega)))

name: CechProjectiveAn.holD_zero_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem holD_zero_eq_zero_iff (x : HolCochain 0 n 0) :
    holD 0 0 x = 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V (im i), (x i : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) z = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := (holAug_exact (n := n) 0 x).1 hx
    have hP := (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).1 P.2
    refine ⟨(P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).coeff 0, fun i z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [holAug_apply P i hz]
    by_cases h0 : (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) = 0
    · simp [h0]
    · rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 (hP.totalDegree h0), MvPolynomial.eval_C,
        MvPolynomial.coeff_C, if_pos rfl]
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    let P : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ 0 :=
      ⟨MvPolynomial.C c, MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ c⟩
    have hx : x = holAug n 0 P := by
      funext i
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z ↦ ?_)
      by_cases hz : z ∈ V (im i)
      · rw [holAug_apply P i hz, hc i z hz, MvPolynomial.eval_C]
      · rw [(x i).2.2.2 z hz, (holAug n 0 P i).2.2.2 z hz]
    rw [hx]
    exact holD_holAug P

name: ComplexAnalytic.AnalyticSpace.toLRSHom_homOfFac
statement:
@[simp]
lemma AnalyticSpace.toLRSHom_homOfFac {A B C : AnalyticSpace.{u}} (f : A.toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶
    B.toLocallyRingedSpace) (g : B ⟶ C) (h : A ⟶ C) (w : f ≫ g.toLRSHom = h.toLRSHom) :
    (homOfFac f g h w).toLRSHom = f

name: ComplexAnalytic.analytificationπLRS_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma analytificationπLRS_naturality :
    (analytification.map i).toLRSHom ≫ analytificationπLRS X =
      analytificationπLRS Z ≫ i.hom.left.toLRSHom
proof:
:=
  congrArg CommaMorphism.left (analytificationπ_naturality i)

name: ComplexAnalytic.analytification_map_kills
statement:
lemma analytification_map_kills :
    ∀ j, (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.c.app (op ⊤) (analytificationSections h j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  change (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.op).hom
    ((LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map (analytificationπLRS X).op).hom (h j)) = 0
  rw [← LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply, analytificationπLRS_naturality,
    LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply]
  have hj : h j ∈ RingHom.ker i.hom.left.appTop.hom := hh ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have : (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map i.hom.left.toLRSHom.op).hom (h j) = 0 := hj
  rw [this, map_zero]

name: ComplexAnalytic.zeroLocusSubspaceι_comp_kills
statement:
lemma zeroLocusSubspaceι_comp_kills (a : Γ(X.obj.left, ⊤)) (ha : i.hom.left.appTop a = 0) :
    (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map ((zeroLocusSubspaceι (analytification.obj X)
      (analytificationSections h)).toLRSHom ≫ analytificationπLRS X).op) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range h) := hh ▸ ha
  refine (Ideal.span_le (I := RingHom.ker (LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map
    ((zeroLocusSubspaceι (analytification.obj X) (analytificationSections h)).toLRSHom ≫
      analytificationπLRS X).op).hom)).2 ?_ hmem
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_comp_apply]
  exact pullbackΓ_zeroLocusSubspaceι_eq_zero _ _ j

name: ComplexAnalytic.zeroLocusToScheme_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma zeroLocusToScheme_comp :
    zeroLocusToScheme i h hh ≫ i.hom.left.toLRSHom =
      (zeroLocusSubspaceι (analytification.obj X) (analytificationSections h)).toLRSHom ≫
        analytificationπLRS X

  LocallyRingedSpace.closedImmersionLift_comp _ _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.analytificationToZeroLocus_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma analytificationToZeroLocus_ι :
    analytificationToZeroLocus i h hh ≫ zeroLocusSubspaceι _ _ = analytification.map i
proof:
:=
  forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map_injective
    ((isCutOutBy_zeroLocusSubspaceι _ _).lift_comp _ (analytification_map_kills i h hh))

name: ComplexAnalytic.zeroLocusToAnalytification_π
statement:

lemma zeroLocusToAnalytification_π :
    (zeroLocusToAnalytification i h hh).toLRSHom ≫ analytificationπLRS Z =

name: ComplexAnalytic.zeroLocusToAnalytification_map
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma zeroLocusToAnalytification_map :
    zeroLocusToAnalytification i h hh ≫ analytification.map i = zeroLocusSubspaceι _ _
proof:
:= by
  refine (isAnalytification_analytificationπ X).hom_ext ?_
  ext1
  change (zeroLocusToAnalytification i h hh).toLRSHom ≫ (analytification.map i).toLRSHom ≫
    analytificationπLRS X = _
  rw [analytificationπLRS_naturality, zeroLocusToAnalytification_π_assoc,
    zeroLocusToScheme_comp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.analytificationIsoZeroLocus_hom_ι

name: ComplexAnalytic.isCutOutBy_analytification_map
statement:
theorem isCutOutBy_analytification_map :
    IsCutOutBy (analytification.map i).toLRSHom (analytificationSections h)
proof:
:= by
  have := (isCutOutBy_zeroLocusSubspaceι (analytification.obj X)
    (analytificationSections h)).comp_iso
      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.mapIso (analytificationIsoZeroLocus i h hh))
  have e : (analytification.map i).toLRSHom =
      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.mapIso (analytificationIsoZeroLocus i h hh)).hom ≫
        (zeroLocusSubspaceι (analytification.obj X) (analytificationSections h)).toLRSHom :=
    (congrArg AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom (analytificationIsoZeroLocus_hom_ι i h hh)).symm
  rw [e]
  exact this

name: ComplexAnalytic.mem_zeroLocus_analytificationSections_iff
statement:
lemma mem_zeroLocus_analytificationSections_iff (x : analytification.obj X) :
    (∀ j, (analytification.obj X).presheaf.Γgerm x (analytificationSections h j) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _) ↔
      ∀ j, ¬ IsUnit (X.obj.left.presheaf.Γgerm ((analytificationπLRS X).base x) (h j))
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_congr' fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  refine not_congr ?_
  have e : (analytification.obj X).presheaf.Γgerm x (analytificationSections h j) =
      (analytificationπLRS X).stalkMap x
        (X.obj.left.presheaf.Γgerm ((analytificationπLRS X).base x) (h j)) :=
    (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (analytificationπLRS X) ⊤ x trivial (h j)).symm
  rw [e]
  exact isUnit_map_iff _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_analytification_map_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem range_analytification_map_of_isAffine :
    Set.range (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base =
      (analytificationπLRS X).base ⁻¹' Set.range i.hom.left.base
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isCutOutBy_analytification_map i h hh).range_base]
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_zeroLocus_analytificationSections_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  rw [IsClosedImmersion.range_eq_of_isAffine i.hom.left h hh]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.SchemeLFTℂ.restrictι_hom_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma SchemeLFTℂ.restrictι_hom_left : (X.restrictι U).hom.left = U.ι
proof: := rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.analytification_map_restrictι
statement:
theorem analytification_map_restrictι :
    analytification.map (X.restrictι U) =
      (analytificationRestrictIso X U).hom ≫
        (analytification.obj X).ofRestrict (analytificationPreimage X U)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isAnalytification_analytificationπ X).hom_ext ?_
  rw [analytificationπ_naturality]
  ext1
  change (analytificationπ (X.restrict U)).left ≫ U.ι.toLRSHom =
    (analytificationRestrictIso X U).hom.toLRSHom ≫
      ((analytification.obj X).ofRestrict (analytificationPreimage X U)).toLRSHom ≫
        (analytificationπ X).left
  rw [← analytificationRestrictIso_hom_comp]
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg _ (congrArg CommaMorphism.left (restrictπ_comp (analytificationπ X) U))

name: ComplexAnalytic.isOpenEmbedding_analytification_map_restrictι
statement:
theorem isOpenEmbedding_analytification_map_restrictι :
    IsOpenEmbedding (analytification.map (X.restrictι U)).toLRSHom.base
proof:
:= by
  rw [analytification_map_restrictι]
  exact (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isOpenEmbedding _).comp
    (LocallyRingedSpace.homeoOfIso
      (forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.mapIso (analytificationRestrictIso X U))).isOpenEmbedding

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_analytification_map_restrictι
statement:
theorem range_analytification_map_restrictι :
    Set.range (analytification.map (X.restrictι U)).toLRSHom.base =
      (analytificationπLRS X).base ⁻¹' (U : Set X.obj.left)
proof:
:= by
  rw [analytification_map_restrictι]
  have hs := (AnalyticSpace.bijective_base_of_isIso
    (analytificationRestrictIso X U).hom).2.range_eq
  change Set.range (((analytification.obj X).ofRestrict _).toLRSHom.base ∘
    (analytificationRestrictIso X U).hom.toLRSHom.base) = _
  rw [Set.range_comp, hs, Set.image_univ, range_base_ofRestrict]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.restrictHomLFT_hom_left

name: ComplexAnalytic.isNoetherianRing_of_isAffine
statement:
lemma isNoetherianRing_of_isAffine (Y : SchemeLFTℂ.{u}) [IsAffine Y.obj.left] :
    IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y.obj.left, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType Y.obj.hom := Y.property
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (ULift.{u} ℂ) := isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv ℂ ULift.ringEquiv.symm
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.obj.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Y.obj.hom
  exact IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_generators
statement:
lemma exists_generators [IsAffine X.obj.left] :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (h : Fin p → Γ(X.obj.left, ⊤)),
      Ideal.span (Set.range h) = RingHom.ker i.hom.left.appTop.hom
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherianRing_of_isAffine X
  exact Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (RingHom.ker i.hom.left.appTop.hom))

name: ComplexAnalytic.exists_isCutOutBy_restrict
statement:
lemma exists_isCutOutBy_restrict (U : X.obj.left.affineOpens) :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (f : Fin p → (analytification.obj (X.restrict U.1)).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)),
      IsCutOutBy (analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom f ∧
      Set.range (analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom.base =
        (analytificationπLRS (X.restrict U.1)).base ⁻¹'
          Set.range (restrictHomLFT i U.1).hom.left.base
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (X.restrict U.1).obj.left := inferInstanceAs (IsAffine U)
  obtain ⟨p, h, hh⟩ := exists_generators (restrictHomLFT i U.1)
  exact ⟨p, _, isCutOutBy_analytification_map _ h hh,
    range_analytification_map_of_isAffine _ h hh⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.range_analytification_map_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem range_analytification_map_of_isClosedImmersion :
    Set.range (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base =
      (analytificationπLRS X).base ⁻¹' Set.range i.hom.left.base
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (analytificationπ_base_map i z).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem X.obj.left ((analytificationπLRS X).base x)
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom.base := by
    rw [range_analytification_map_restrictι]
    exact hU
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨p, f, -, hrange⟩ := exists_isCutOutBy_restrict i U
  have hy : y ∈ Set.range (analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom.base := by
    rw [hrange]
    have h1 := analytificationπ_base_map (X.restrictι U.1) y
    have hmem : z₀ ∈ i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by
      change i.hom.left.base z₀ ∈ U.1
      rw [hz₀]
      exact hU
    refine ⟨⟨z₀, hmem⟩, Subtype.ext
      ((morphismRestrict_base_coe i.hom.left U.1 ⟨z₀, hmem⟩).trans ?_)⟩
    rw [hz₀, h1]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨(analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom.base w, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.toLRSHom.base w)
    (analytification_map_restrictHomLFT_restrictι i U.1)).symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.isClosedEmbedding_analytification_map
statement:
theorem isClosedEmbedding_analytification_map :
    IsClosedEmbedding (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base
proof:
:= by
  have hemb : IsEmbedding (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base := by
    refine isEmbedding_of_iSup_eq_top_of_preimage_subset_range _
      (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base.hom.continuous
      (fun U : X.obj.left.affineOpens ↦ analytificationPreimage X U.1) ?_
      (fun U ↦ analytification.obj (Z.restrict (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))
      (fun U ↦ (analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom.base)
      (fun U ↦ (analytification.map _).toLRSHom.base.hom.continuous) (fun U ↦ ?_) (fun U ↦ ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem X.obj.left
        ((analytificationπLRS X).base ((analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base z))
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨U, hU⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [range_analytification_map_restrictι]
      change i.hom.left.base ((analytificationπLRS Z).base z) ∈ U.1
      rw [← analytificationπ_base_map]
      exact hz
    · obtain ⟨p, f, hcut, -⟩ := exists_isCutOutBy_restrict i U
      have : (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base ∘
          (analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom.base =
          (analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom.base ∘
            (analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom.base :=
        funext fun w ↦ (congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.toLRSHom.base w)
          (analytification_map_restrictHomLFT_restrictι i U.1)).symm
      rw [this]
      exact (isOpenEmbedding_analytification_map_restrictι X U.1).isEmbedding.comp
        hcut.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding
  refine ⟨hemb, ?_⟩
  rw [range_analytification_map_of_isClosedImmersion]
  exact i.hom.left.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.preimage
    (analytificationπLRS X).base.hom.continuous

name: ComplexAnalytic.surjective_stalkMap_analytification_map
statement:
theorem surjective_stalkMap_analytification_map (z : analytification.obj Z) :
    Function.Surjective ((analytification.map i).toLRSHom.stalkMap z)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {A B : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (f g : A ⟶ B) (a : A), f = g →
      Function.Surjective (g.stalkMap a) → Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap a) := by
    rintro A B f g a rfl h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    exists_affineOpens_mem X.obj.left (i.hom.left.base ((analytificationπLRS Z).base z))
  have hz : z ∈
      Set.range (analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom.base := by
    rw [range_analytification_map_restrictι]
    exact hU
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨p, f, hcut, -⟩ := exists_isCutOutBy_restrict i U
  have hsq := congrArg AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom
    (analytification_map_restrictHomLFT_restrictι i U.1)
  have h1 : Function.Surjective ((analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) ≫
      analytification.map i).toLRSHom.stalkMap w) := by
    refine key _ ((analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom ≫
      (analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom) w hsq.symm ?_
    rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    haveI := isIso_stalkMap_analytification_map_restrictι X U.1
      ((analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom.base w)
    exact (hcut.surjective_stalkMap w).comp (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      ((analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom.stalkMap
        ((analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom.base w))).2
  change Function.Surjective (((analytification.map
    (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom ≫ (analytification.map i).toLRSHom).stalkMap w)
    at h1
  rw [LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp] at h1
  haveI := isIso_stalkMap_analytification_map_restrictι Z (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) w
  exact Function.Surjective.of_comp_left
    (f := (LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.stalkMap (analytification.map
      (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom w).hom) h1
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1

name: ComplexAnalytic.existsUnique_analytification_map_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_analytification_map_eq (x : analytification.obj X) (z₀ : Z.obj.left)
    (hx : (analytificationπLRS X).base x = i.hom.left.base z₀) :
    ∃! z : analytification.obj Z, (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base z = x ∧
      (analytificationπLRS Z).base z = z₀
proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.hasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal_analytification_map
statement:
theorem hasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal_analytification_map :
    (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.HasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem X.obj.left ((analytificationπLRS X).base y)
  haveI : IsAffine (X.restrict U.1).obj.left := inferInstanceAs (IsAffine U)
  obtain ⟨p, h, hh⟩ := exists_generators (restrictHomLFT i U.1)
  have hcut := isCutOutBy_analytification_map (restrictHomLFT i U.1) h hh
  let W₀ : X.obj.left.Opens := U.1.ι ''ᵁ ⊤
  let W : Opens (analytification.obj X) := (Opens.map (analytificationπLRS X).base).obj W₀
  let H : Fin p → (analytification.obj X).presheaf.obj (op W) :=
    fun j ↦ (analytificationπLRS X).c.app (op W₀) (h j)
  refine ⟨W, p, H, ⟨⟨_, hU⟩, trivial, rfl⟩, fun j ↦ ?_, fun y' hy' ↦ ?_⟩
  · have key : ∀ φ ψ : (analytification.obj Z).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶
        X.obj.left.toLocallyRingedSpace, φ = ψ → ψ.c.app (op W₀) (h j) = 0 →
        φ.c.app (op W₀) (h j) = 0 := by
      rintro _ _ rfl h
      exact h
    refine key ((analytification.map i).toLRSHom ≫ analytificationπLRS X)
      (analytificationπLRS Z ≫ i.hom.left.toLRSHom) (analytificationπLRS_naturality i) ?_
    change (analytificationπLRS Z).c.app _ (i.hom.left.toLRSHom.c.app (op W₀) (h j)) = 0
    have h0 : i.hom.left.toLRSHom.c.app (op W₀) (h j) = 0 :=
      app_restrictι_image_top_eq_zero i U.1 (h j) (hh ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    rw [h0]
    exact map_zero _
  
  have hy'' : y' ∈ Set.range (analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom.base := by
    rw [range_analytification_map_restrictι]
    obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ := hy'
    change (analytificationπLRS X).base y' ∈ U.1
    rw [← hu]
    exact u.2
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hy''
  set jU := (analytification.map (X.restrictι U.1)).toLRSHom
  have hsq : (analytification.map (restrictHomLFT i U.1)).toLRSHom ≫ jU =
      (analytification.map (Z.restrictι (i.hom.left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).toLRSHom ≫
        (analytification.map i).toLRSHom :=
    congrArg AnalyticSpace.Hom.toLRSHom (analytification_map_restrictHomLFT_restrictι i U.1)
  have h1 := (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le hsq x'
  have h2 := hcut.pushforwardStalkIdeal_le x'
  have hbij := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (jU.stalkMap x')
  have hV : (analytificationπLRS X).base (jU.base x') ∈ W₀ :=
    ⟨_, trivial, (analytificationπ_base_map (X.restrictι U.1) x').symm⟩
  have hgen : ∀ j, (analytification.obj (X.restrict U.1)).presheaf.Γgerm x'
      (analytificationSections h j) =
      jU.stalkMap x' ((analytification.obj X).presheaf.germ W (jU.base x') hy' (H j)) := by
    intro j
    rw [← stalkMap_restrictι_stalkMap_germ U.1 x' hV (h j)]
    congr 1
    exact LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (analytificationπLRS X) W₀ (jU.base x') hV
      (h j)
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ (analytification.obj (X.restrict U.1)).presheaf.Γgerm
      x' (analytificationSections h j)) = Ideal.map (jU.stalkMap x').hom
      (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦
        (analytification.obj X).presheaf.germ W (jU.base x') hy' (H j))) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext hgen))
  intro r hr
  have h3 := h2 (h1 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hr))
  rw [hspan] at h3
  change r ∈ Ideal.comap (jU.stalkMap x').hom (Ideal.map (jU.stalkMap x').hom _) at h3
  rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij] at h3

name: ComplexAnalytic.isCoherent_pushforward_analytification_map

    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} Z.obj.left.toLocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf) (q : ℕ)

    LocallyRingedSpace.H.map (analytificationPushforwardBaseChange i G) q
        (gagaMap X _ q (closedImmersionCohomologyAddEquiv i G q x)) =

statement:
lemma gagaMap_pushforward_eq_comp :

name: ComplexAnalytic.pushforwardStalkIdeal_analytification_map
statement:
theorem pushforwardStalkIdeal_analytification_map {Z X : SchemeLFTℂ.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left] (x : analytification.obj X) :
    (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal x =
      Ideal.map ((analytificationπLRS X).stalkMap x).hom
        (i.hom.left.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal ((analytificationπLRS X).base x))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_
    (LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.map_pushforwardStalkIdeal_le (f := i.hom.left.toLRSHom)
      (f' := (analytification.map i).toLRSHom) (g := analytificationπLRS X)
      (g' := analytificationπLRS Z)
      (analytificationπLRS_naturality i) x)
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range (analytification.map i).toLRSHom.base
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [(analytification.map i).toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_ker
      (isClosedEmbedding_analytification_map i).isInducing z]
    exact ker_stalkMap_analytification_map_le i z
  · have hx' : (analytificationπLRS X).base x ∉ Set.range i.hom.left.toLRSHom.base := fun h ↦
      hx (by rw [range_analytification_map_of_isClosedImmersion]; exact h)
    rw [i.hom.left.toLRSHom.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_top i.hom.left.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
      _ hx', Ideal.map_top]
    exact le_top
