  refine ⟨n₀, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  have hCT := tubeCompact_subset_tube.{u} (K := Complex.closedBox a b) (B := boxOpens a₁ b₁) hab₁
  choose I hI σ W hW hxW hgenx using fun x : tubeCompact.{u} (Complex.closedBox a b) ↦
    hgen n hn x (hCT x.2)
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ :=
    (isCompact_tubeCompact.{u} (Complex.isCompact_closedBox a b)).elim_finite_subcover
    (fun x ↦ (W x : Set (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1))) (fun x ↦ (W x).isOpen)
    (fun x hx ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxW _⟩)
  let O : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens := ⨆ x ∈ F, W x
  have hCO : tubeCompact.{u} (Complex.closedBox a b) ⊆ O := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hxF, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hF hy)
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨x, Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨hxF, hyx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨a', b', hab', hsub, hBO⟩ := exists_openBox_tube_subset hCO
    (isOpen_openBox a₁ b₁) hab₁
  letI : ∀ x, Fintype (I x) := hI
  have hB₂B₁ : tube.{u} (N := 1) (boxOpens a' b') ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) (boxOpens a₁ b₁) :=
    fun y hy ↦ hsub hy
  refine ⟨a', b', hab', fun y hy ↦ hB₁U (hsub hy), (Σ x : F, I x.1), inferInstance,
    fun p ↦ modRes (σ p.1.1 p.2) _ hB₂B₁, fun W' hW' τ y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxF, hyx⟩ : ∃ x ∈ F, y ∈ W x := by
    have := hBO (hW' hy)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 this
    obtain ⟨hxF, hyx⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    exact ⟨x, hxF, hyx⟩
  obtain ⟨W'', h, hyW'', c, hc⟩ := hgenx x (W' ⊓ W x) inf_le_right
    (modRes τ _ inf_le_left) y ⟨hy, hyx⟩
  refine ⟨W'', h.trans inf_le_left, hyW'', fun p ↦ if hp : p.1.1 = x then
    c (hp ▸ p.2) else 0, ?_⟩
  rw [modRes_res] at hc
  rw [hc, Fintype.sum_sigma, Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x, hxF⟩ : F)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) fun i _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [modRes_res, dite_true]
  · intro x' _ hx'
    have hx'' : x'.1 ≠ x := fun h ↦ hx' (Subtype.ext h)
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [dif_neg hx'', zero_smul]
  · simp

name: Complex.ProjectiveLineBundle.matCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma matCLM_apply (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) : matCLM A v = A *ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  simp [matCLM]

name: Complex.ProjectiveLineBundle.differentiableOn_matCLM
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_matCLM {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
    {g : X → Matrix ι ι ℂ} {s : Set X} (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g s) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p ↦ matCLM (g p)) s
proof:
:= by
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in
  let L : Matrix ι ι ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ι → ℂ) :=
    { toFun := fun A ↦ matCLM A
      map_add' := fun A B ↦ by ext1 v; simp [Matrix.add_mulVec]
      map_smul' := fun c A ↦ by ext1 v; simp [Matrix.smul_mulVec] }
  open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in
  exact (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap L).differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hg

name: Complex.ProjectiveLineBundle.isOpen_annulusSet
statement: lemma isOpen_annulusSet (r₀ r₁ : ℝ) : IsOpen (annulusSet r₀ r₁)
proof:
:=
  (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)

name: Complex.ProjectiveLineBundle.mem_annulusSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_annulusSet_iff {l ρ : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) {w : ℂ} :
    w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l) ↔ w / (l : ℂ) ∈ overlap ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hl' : ‖(l : ℂ)‖ = l := by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hl.le]
  simp only [annulusSet, overlap, mem_setOf_eq, norm_div, hl']
  rw [inv_div, lt_div_iff₀ hl, inv_mul_eq_div, div_lt_iff₀ hl, mul_comm ρ l]

name: Complex.ProjectiveLineBundle.exists_vanishing_scaled
statement:
theorem exists_vanishing_scaled {l ρ : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hρ : 1 < ρ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {g : E × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (U ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l)))
    (hgu : ∀ p ∈ U ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l), IsUnit (g p)) {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKU : K ⊆ U) :
    ∃ U' : Set E, IsOpen U' ∧ K ⊆ U' ∧ U' ⊆ U ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ W ⊆ U', IsOpen W →
      ∀ h : E × ℂ → ι → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ h (W ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) →
      ∃ s₀ t : E × ℂ → ι → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s₀ (W ×ˢ ball 0 (l * ρ)) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ t (W ×ˢ ball 0 (ρ / l)) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l),
          h (z, w) = s₀ (z, w) - w ^ k • g (z, w) *ᵥ t (z, w⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hl0 : (l : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 hl.ne'
  have hscale : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ overlap ρ → (l : ℂ) * w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l) := by
    intro w hw
    rw [mem_annulusSet_iff hl, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hl0]
    exact hw
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : E × ℂ ↦ (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2)) (U ×ˢ overlap ρ)
      (U ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) := fun p hp ↦ ⟨hp.1, hscale _ hp.2⟩
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ (fun p : E × ℂ ↦ (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2)) :=
    differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.const_mul _)
  obtain ⟨U', hU'o, hKU', hU'U, k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_vanishing (V := ι → ℂ) hρ hU
    (g := fun p ↦ matCLM (g (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2)))
    ((differentiableOn_matCLM hg).comp hdiff.differentiableOn hmaps)
    (fun p hp ↦ (hgu _ (hmaps hp)).map matCLM) hK hKU
  refine ⟨U', hU'o, hKU', hU'U, k₀, fun k hk W hWU hW h hh ↦ ?_⟩
  have hmapsW : MapsTo (fun p : E × ℂ ↦ (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2)) (W ×ˢ overlap ρ)
      (W ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) := fun p hp ↦ ⟨hp.1, hscale _ hp.2⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, t, hs₀, ht, hrel⟩ := hk₀ k hk W hWU hW (fun p ↦ h (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2))
    (hh.comp hdiff.differentiableOn hmapsW)
  refine ⟨fun p ↦ s₀ (p.1, (l : ℂ)⁻¹ * p.2), fun p ↦ ((l : ℂ) ^ k)⁻¹ • t (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2),
    ?_, ?_, fun z hz w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hmaps₀ : MapsTo (fun p : E × ℂ ↦ (p.1, (l : ℂ)⁻¹ * p.2)) (W ×ˢ ball 0 (l * ρ))
        (W ×ˢ ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
      have := hp.2
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at this ⊢
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hl.le, inv_mul_eq_div,
        div_lt_iff₀ hl, mul_comm]
      exact this
    exact hs₀.comp (differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.const_mul _)).differentiableOn
      hmaps₀
  · have hmaps₁ : MapsTo (fun p : E × ℂ ↦ (p.1, (l : ℂ) * p.2)) (W ×ˢ ball 0 (ρ / l))
        (W ×ˢ ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
      have := hp.2
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at this ⊢
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hl.le, ← lt_div_iff₀' hl]
      exact this
    have := (ht.comp hdiff.differentiableOn hmaps₁).const_smul ((l : ℂ) ^ k)⁻¹
    exact this
  · have hw' : w / l ∈ overlap ρ := (mem_annulusSet_iff hl).1 hw
    have := hrel z hz (w / l) hw'
    simp only [matCLM_apply] at this
    have e1 : (l : ℂ) * (w / l) = w := mul_div_cancel₀ w hl0
    have e2 : (w / l)⁻¹ = (l : ℂ) * w⁻¹ := by rw [inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    rw [this]
    change _ = s₀ (z, (l : ℂ)⁻¹ * w) - w ^ k • g (z, w) *ᵥ (((l : ℂ) ^ k)⁻¹ • t (z, (l : ℂ) * w⁻¹))
    rw [inv_mul_eq_div, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_smul, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv,
      div_eq_mul_inv]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_rect_subset
statement:
lemma exists_rect_subset {z : ℂ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ c d : ℂ, z ∈ rectOpens c d ∧ (rectOpens c d : Set ℂ) ⊆ Metric.ball z ε
proof:
:= by
  set δ : ℝ := ε / 4
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  refine ⟨z - (δ + δ * Complex.I), z + (δ + δ * Complex.I), ?_, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_rectOpens, Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_Ioo, Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
    constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith
  · simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_rectOpens, Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_Ioo,
      Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im] at hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    refine (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans_lt ?_
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    have h1 : |w.re - z.re| < 2 * δ := abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h2 : |w.im - z.im| < 2 * δ := abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hδε : δ = ε / 4 := rfl
    linarith

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_chartBox_subset
statement:
lemma exists_chartBox_subset (i : Fin 2) {W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens}
    {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : chartPt.{u} i p ∈ W) :
    ∃ (a b : Fin m → ℂ) (c d : ℂ), chartPt.{u} i p ∈ chartBox.{u} i
      (prodOpens (boxOpens a b) (rectOpens c d)) ∧
      chartBox.{u} i (prodOpens (boxOpens a b) (rectOpens c d)) ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  have hS : IsOpen (chartPt.{u} i ⁻¹' (W : Set (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1))) :=
    W.isOpen.preimage (isOpenEmbedding_chartPt i).continuous
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hS p hp
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, habε⟩ := exists_openBox_subset (m := m) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (Metric.mem_ball_self hε) (z := p.1)
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hcdε⟩ := exists_rect_subset (z := p.2) hε
  refine ⟨a, b, c, d, ⟨p, ⟨hab, hcd⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨hq1, hq2⟩, rfl⟩
  refine hball ?_
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
  exact ⟨habε hq1, hcdε hq2⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_isUnit_restrictOpen
statement:
lemma exists_isUnit_restrictOpen {W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens} (a : Γₚ(W))
    {x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1} (hx : x ∈ W)
    (ha : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval x hx a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (V : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (h : V ≤ W), x ∈ V ∧
      IsUnit (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen a V h)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit ((relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.germ W x hx a) :=
    (AnalyticSpace.evalStalk_ne_zero_iff_isUnit _).1 ha
  obtain ⟨V, i, hxV, hV⟩ := RingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ
    (X := (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace) W a x hx hu
  exact ⟨V, i.le, hxV, hV⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_chartPt_of_mem_stdOpen
statement:
lemma exists_chartPt_of_mem_stdOpen {i : Fin 2} {x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1}
    (hx : x ∈ stdOpen.{u} m 1 i) : ∃ p, chartPt.{u} i p = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [stdOpen_eq_chartOpens] at hx
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨(yPart w, zPart w 0), by rw [chartPt, cpt_yPart_zPart]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_generates_of_matrix
statement:
theorem exists_generates_of_matrix {i : Fin 2} {N D : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens}
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (g : I → 𝒢.val.obj (op N))
    (hg : IsAcyclicGenerating 𝒢 g) (hDN : D ≤ N) (hDi : D ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 i)
    (T : Matrix I I Γₚ(D)) {x₀ : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D)
    (hT : ∀ j j', (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval x₀ hx₀ (T j j') = if j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    ∃ (W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hWD : W ≤ D), x₀ ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (W' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W) (σ : 𝒢.val.obj (op W'))
        (x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1), x ∈ W' →
        ∃ (W'' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (h : W'' ≤ W'), x ∈ W'' ∧
          ∃ c : I → Γₚ(W''), modRes σ W'' h =
            ∑ j, c j • modRes (∑ i', T j i' • modRes (g i') D hDN) W''
              (h.trans (hW'.trans hWD))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set φ := (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval x₀ hx₀
  have hTφ : φ.mapMatrix T = 1 := by
    ext j j'
    rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, map_apply, hT, one_apply]
  obtain ⟨W, hWD, hx₀W, hu⟩ := exists_isUnit_restrictOpen T.det hx₀ (by
    rw [RingHom.map_det, hTφ, det_one]
    exact one_ne_zero)
  let res : Γₚ(D) →+* Γₚ(W) := ((relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWD).op).hom
  set TW := res.mapMatrix T
  have hTW : IsUnit TW := by
    have e : TW.det = res T.det := (RingHom.map_det res T).symm
    rw [isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, e]
    exact hu
  set Tinv := TW⁻¹
  have hinv : Tinv * TW = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul TW ((isUnit_iff_isUnit_det TW).1 hTW)
  
  have hgW : ∀ i', modRes (g i') W (hWD.trans hDN) =
      ∑ j, Tinv i' j • modRes (∑ i'', T j i'' • modRes (g i'') D hDN) W hWD := by
    intro i'
    simp only [modRes_sum, modRes_smul, modRes_res, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have e : ∀ i'', ∑ j, (Tinv i' j * TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (T j i'') W hWD) =
        (Tinv * TW) i' i'' := fun i'' ↦ by
      rw [mul_apply]
      rfl
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_smul, e, hinv, one_apply, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  refine ⟨W, hWD, hx₀W, fun W' hW' σ x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_chartPt_of_mem_stdOpen (hDi (hWD (hW' hx)))
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, hpW'', hW''⟩ := exists_chartBox_subset i hx
  set W'' := chartBox.{u} i (prodOpens (boxOpens a b) (rectOpens c d))
  obtain ⟨-, hgen⟩ := hg W'' (hW''.trans (hW'.trans (hWD.trans hDN)))
    (fun q hq ↦ subsingleton_H_chartBox i a b c d hq)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hgen (modRes σ W'' hW'')
  refine ⟨W'', hW'', hpW'', fun j ↦ ∑ i', e i' *
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (Tinv i' j) W'' (hW''.trans hW'), ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  have hg' : ∀ i', modRes (g i') W'' (hW''.trans (hW'.trans (hWD.trans hDN))) =
      ∑ j, TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (Tinv i' j) W'' (hW''.trans hW') •
        modRes (∑ i'', T j i'' • modRes (g i'') D hDN) W'' (hW''.trans (hW'.trans hWD)) := by
    intro i'
    have e' := congrArg (fun y ↦ modRes y W'' (hW''.trans hW')) (hgW i')
    simp only [modRes_sum, modRes_smul, modRes_res, yres_res] at e' ⊢
    exact e'
  simp_rw [hg', Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_generates_twistMod_of_matrix
statement:
theorem exists_generates_twistMod_of_matrix {i : Fin 2}
    {N D V : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens} {I : Type u} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (g : I → 𝒢.val.obj (op N)) (hg : IsAcyclicGenerating 𝒢 g) (hDN : D ≤ N)
    (hDi : D ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 i) (hDV : D ≤ V) (n : ℤ)
    (σ : I → (twistMod 𝒢 n).val.obj (op V)) (T : Matrix I I Γₚ(D))
    (hσ : ∀ j, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 n) i hDi
      (modRes (σ j) D hDV) = ∑ i', T j i' • modRes (g i') D hDN)
    {x₀ : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D)
    (hT : ∀ j j', (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval x₀ hx₀ (T j j') = if j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    ∃ (W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), x₀ ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (W' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W)
        (τ : (twistMod 𝒢 n).val.obj (op W')) (x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1), x ∈ W' →
        ∃ (W'' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (h : W'' ≤ W'), x ∈ W'' ∧
          ∃ c : I → Γₚ(W''), modRes τ W'' h =
            ∑ j, c j • modRes (σ j) W'' (h.trans (hW'.trans hWV))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWD, hx₀W, hW⟩ := exists_generates_of_matrix 𝒢 g hg hDN hDi T hx₀ hT
  refine ⟨W, hWD.trans hDV, hx₀W, fun W' hW' τ x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have hW'i : W' ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 i := hW'.trans (hWD.trans hDi)
  obtain ⟨W'', h, hxW'', c, hc⟩ := hW W' hW'
    (modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 n) i hW'i τ) x hx
  refine ⟨W'', h, hxW'', c, ?_⟩
  apply (modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 n) i (h.trans hW'i)).injective
  rw [modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ i hW'i h τ, hc, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← hσ j, ← modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ i hDi (h.trans (hW'.trans hWD)),
    modRes_res]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.mem_discOverlap_of
statement:
lemma mem_discOverlap_of {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)} {r₀ r₁ : ℝ} (hr₁ : 0 < r₁)
    {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : p.1 ∈ B ∧ p.2 ∈ annulusSet r₀ r₁) :
    chartPt.{u} 0 p ∈ discOverlap.{u} B r₀ r₁
proof:
:=
  ⟨p, (mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁).2 hp, rfl⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.ne_zero_of_mem_annulusSet
statement:
lemma ne_zero_of_mem_annulusSet {r₀ r₁ : ℝ} (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ annulusSet r₀ r₁) :
    z ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  norm_pos_iff.1 ((inv_pos.2 hr₁).trans hz.1)

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.eq_of_f0_eq_discOverlap
proof:
:=
  eq_of_f0_eq fun p hp ↦ by
    rw [mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁] at hp
    exact h p hp.1 hp.2

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_f0_eq_discOverlap
statement:
lemma exists_f0_eq_discOverlap (B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)) {r₀ r₁ : ℝ} (hr₁ : 0 < r₁)
    (F : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F ((B : Set (Fin m → ℂ)) ×ˢ annulusSet r₀ r₁)) :
    ∃ a : Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B r₀ r₁), ∀ p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ, p.1 ∈ B →
      p.2 ∈ annulusSet r₀ r₁ → f0 a p = F p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_f0_eq.{u} (overlapOpens (prodOpens B (ballOpens r₀))
    (prodOpens B (ballOpens r₁))) F (hF.mono fun p hp ↦ (mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁).1 hp)
  exact ⟨a, fun p h1 h2 ↦ ha p ((mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁).2 ⟨h1, h2⟩)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.differentiableOn_f0_discOverlap
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_f0_discOverlap {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)} {r₀ r₁ : ℝ} (hr₁ : 0 < r₁)
    (a : Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B r₀ r₁)) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (f0 a) ((B : Set (Fin m → ℂ)) ×ˢ annulusSet r₀ r₁)
proof:
:=
  (differentiableOn_f0 a).mono fun _ hp ↦ (mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁).2 hp

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.modRes_neg'
statement:
lemma modRes_neg' {V W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    (x : 𝒢.val.obj (op V)) : modRes (-x) W h = -modRes x W h
proof:
:=
  map_neg _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.discOverlap_le_discBox_zero
statement:
lemma discOverlap_le_discBox_zero (B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)) (r₀ r₁ : ℝ) :
    discOverlap.{u} B r₀ r₁ ≤ discBox 0 B r₀
proof:
:=
  (discOverlap_eq B r₀ r₁).le.trans inf_le_left

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.discOverlap_le_discBox_one
statement:
lemma discOverlap_le_discBox_one (B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)) (r₀ r₁ : ℝ) :
    discOverlap.{u} B r₀ r₁ ≤ discBox 1 B r₁
proof:
:=
  (discOverlap_eq B r₀ r₁).le.trans inf_le_right

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.BundleData.exists_section_chart_zero
statement:
theorem exists_section_chart_zero {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)} (hBB₀ : B ≤ B₀) {l ρ : ℝ}
    (hr₀ : 0 < l * ρ) (hr₁ : 0 < ρ / l) (hr : 1 < l * ρ * (ρ / l)) (hr₀S : l * ρ ≤ S)
    (hr₁S : ρ / l ≤ S) {k : ℕ} (hsplit : d.Splits B l ρ k)
    (q : Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))) (ℓ₀ : Γₚ(discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ)))
    (ℓ₁ : Γₚ(discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l)))
    (hℓq : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_zero B _ _) * q = 1)
    (hℓz : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_zero B _ _) *
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec (k : ℤ)) _ (discOverlap_le_stdOpen B _ _) =
      -(TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1)) _ (discOverlap_le_stdOpen B _ _) *
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₁ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_one B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))))
    (j : d.I₀) :
    ∃ (σ : (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op (tube.{u} (N := 1) B)))
      (ψ : d.I₀ ⊕ d.I₁ → Γₚ(discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ))),
      modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 0
        (chartBox_le_stdOpen 0 _) (modRes σ _ (chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 0 B _)) =
        modRes (d.s j) _ ((discBox_le_sqBox 0 hBB₀ hr₀S).trans d.hN₀) -
          ℓ₀ • ∑ a, ψ a • modRes (d.u₀ a) _ ((discBox_le_sqBox 0 hBB₀ hr₀S).trans d.hN₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hO₀ := discOverlap_le_discBox_zero.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hO₁ := discOverlap_le_discBox_one.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hOD : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) = discBox 0 B (l * ρ) ⊓ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) :=
    discOverlap_eq B _ _
  have hD₀st : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 0 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 0 _
  have hD₁st : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 1 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 1 _
  have hD₀T : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 0 B _
  have hD₁T : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 1 B _
  have hOst := discOverlap_le_stdOpen.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hsup : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ⊔ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) = tube.{u} (N := 1) B :=
    chartBox_sup B _ _ (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₀) (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₁)
      (ballOpens_or_inv hr₀ hr)
  let ĥ : d.I₀ ⊕ d.I₁ → Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) :=
    Sum.elim (fun j' ↦ if j' = j then q else 0) 0
  obtain ⟨φ₀, φ₁, hφ₀, hφ₁, hrel⟩ := hsplit (fun p a ↦ f0 (ĥ a) p)
    (differentiableOn_pi.2 fun a ↦ differentiableOn_f0_discOverlap hr₁ (ĥ a))
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, ψ₁, -, -, hΦ⟩ := d.exists_split hBB₀ hr₁ hr₀S hr₁S k ĥ φ₀ φ₁ hφ₀ hφ₁
    fun y hy w hw ↦ hrel y hy w hw
  have hL : ∑ a, ĥ a • modRes (d.u₀ a) (discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))
      ((discOverlap_le_sqOverlap hBB₀ hr₀S hr₁S).trans d.sqOverlap_le_N₀) =
      q • modRes (d.s j) (discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))
        ((discOverlap_le_sqOverlap hBB₀ hr₀S hr₁S).trans d.sqOverlap_le_N₀) := by
    simp only [ĥ, Fintype.sum_sum_type, BundleData.u₀, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, ite_smul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hD₀N : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ d.N₀ := (discBox_le_sqBox 0 hBB₀ hr₀S).trans d.hN₀
  have hD₁N : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ d.N₁ := (discBox_le_sqBox 1 hBB₀ hr₁S).trans d.hN₁
  set Φ₀ := ∑ a, ψ₀ a • modRes (d.u₀ a) _ hD₀N
  set Φ₁ := ∑ b, ψ₁ b • modRes (d.u₁ b) _ hD₁N
  have e := congrArg (fun y ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ hO₀ • y) hΦ
  rw [hL, smul_smul, hℓq, one_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, hℓz, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add] at e
  have hcompat : modRes (modRes (d.s j) _ hD₀N - ℓ₀ • Φ₀) _ hO₀ =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1)) _ hOst • modRes (ℓ₁ • Φ₁) _ hO₁ := by
    rw [modRes_sub, modRes_smul, modRes_smul, modRes_res, e, smul_smul, add_sub_cancel_left]
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ : ∃ T₀, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1))
      0 hD₀st T₀ = modRes (d.s j) _ hD₀N - ℓ₀ • Φ₀ := ⟨_, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ : ∃ T₁, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1))
      1 hD₁st T₁ = ℓ₁ • Φ₁ := ⟨_, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ₀, -⟩ := exists_modRes_eq_of_two (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) hsup.ge hD₀T hD₁T
    T₀ T₁ (by
      apply (modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 0
        (inf_le_left.trans hD₀st)).injective
      rw [modTwistSectionsEquiv_change _ 0 _ 1 (inf_le_right.trans hD₁st) (modRes T₁ _ _),
        modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ 0 hD₀st inf_le_left T₀,
        modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ 1 hD₁st inf_le_right T₁, hT₀, hT₁]
      have e2 := congrArg (fun y ↦ modRes y (discBox 0 B (l * ρ) ⊓ discBox 1 B (ρ / l)) hOD.ge)
        hcompat
      rw [modRes_res, modRes_smul, yres_res, modRes_res] at e2
      exact e2)
  exact ⟨σ, ψ₀, by rw [hσ₀, hT₀]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.BundleData.exists_generates_chart_zero
statement:
theorem exists_generates_chart_zero (hs : IsAcyclicGenerating 𝒢 d.s) {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)}
    (hBB₀ : B ≤ B₀) {l ρ : ℝ} (hr₀ : 0 < l * ρ) (hr₁ : 0 < ρ / l) (hr : 1 < l * ρ * (ρ / l))
    (hr₀S : l * ρ ≤ S) (hr₁S : ρ / l ≤ S) {k : ℕ} (hsplit : d.Splits B l ρ k)
    {y₀ : Fin m → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ B) {c : ℂ} (hc : ‖c‖ < (ρ / l)⁻¹) :
    ∃ (σ : d.I₀ → (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op (tube.{u} (N := 1) B)))
      (W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW : W ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B),
      chartPt.{u} 0 (y₀, c) ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (W' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W)
        (τ : (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op W')) (x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1),
        x ∈ W' → ∃ (W'' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (h : W'' ≤ W'), x ∈ W'' ∧
          ∃ e : d.I₀ → Γₚ(W''), modRes τ W'' h =
            ∑ j, e j • modRes (σ j) W'' (h.trans (hW'.trans hW))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hOD : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) = discBox 0 B (l * ρ) ⊓ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) :=
    discOverlap_eq B _ _
  have hO₀ : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) ≤ discBox 0 B (l * ρ) := hOD.le.trans inf_le_left
  have hO₁ : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) ≤ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) := hOD.le.trans inf_le_right
  have hD₀N : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ d.N₀ := (discBox_le_sqBox 0 hBB₀ hr₀S).trans d.hN₀
  have hD₀st : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 0 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 0 _
  have hD₁st : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 1 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 1 _
  have hOst := discOverlap_le_stdOpen.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hD₀T : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 0 B _
  have hD₁T : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 1 B _
  have hsup : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ⊔ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) = tube.{u} (N := 1) B :=
    chartBox_sup B _ _ (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₀) (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₁) (ballOpens_or_inv hr₀ hr)
  have hann_c : ∀ w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l), w - c ≠ 0 := fun w hw h ↦ by
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    subst h
    exact absurd hw.1 (not_lt.2 hc.le)
  have hinv_ball : ∀ w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l), w⁻¹ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (ρ / l) := by
    intro w hw
    have h0 : 0 < ‖w‖ := (inv_pos.2 hr₁).trans hw.1
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_inv]
    exact (inv_lt_comm₀ h0 hr₁).2 hw.1
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_f0_eq_discOverlap.{u} B hr₁ (fun p ↦ (p.2 - c)⁻¹) (fun p hp ↦
    ((differentiableAt_snd.sub_const c).inv (hann_c _ hp.2)).differentiableWithinAt)
  obtain ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀⟩ := exists_f0_eq.{u} (prodOpens B (ballOpens (l * ρ))) (fun p ↦ p.2 - c)
    (differentiable_snd.sub_const c).differentiableOn
  obtain ⟨ℓ₁, hℓ₁⟩ := exists_f1_eq.{u} (prodOpens B (ballOpens (ρ / l))) (fun p ↦ c * p.2 - 1)
    ((differentiable_snd.const_mul c).sub_const 1).differentiableOn
  have hℓq : (ℓ₀ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) * q = 1 :=
    eq_of_f0_eq_discOverlap hr₁ fun p hp1 hp2 ↦ by
      have hpO := mem_discOverlap_of.{u} hr₁ ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      rw [f0_mul, Pi.mul_apply, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, hℓ₀ p ⟨hp1, ?_⟩, hq p hp1 hp2,
        f0_one hpO]
      · exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hann_c _ hp2)
      · change p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (l * ρ)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact hp2.2
  have hℓz : (ℓ₀ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) *
      (zSec (k : ℤ) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) =
      -((zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) *
        (ℓ₁ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))) :=
    eq_of_f0_eq_discOverlap hr₁ fun p hp1 hp2 ↦ by
      have hpO := mem_discOverlap_of.{u} hr₁ ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      have h2 := ne_zero_of_mem_annulusSet hr₁ hp2
      have hneg : f0 (-((zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) *
          (ℓ₁ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)))) p = -(f0 ((zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1) |ₒ
            discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) * (ℓ₁ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))) p) := by
        rw [neg_eq_zero_sub, f0_sub, f0_zero]
        simp
      have hp₀ : p ∈ prodOpens B (ballOpens (l * ρ)) := ⟨hp1, by
        change p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (l * ρ)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact hp2.2⟩
      have hp₁ : (p.1, p.2⁻¹) ∈ prodOpens B (ballOpens (ρ / l)) := ⟨hp1, hinv_ball _ hp2⟩
      rw [hneg, f0_mul, f0_mul, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.mul_apply, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO,
        f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO,
        f0_twistModCocycle _ (hOst hpO), f0_twistModCocycle _ (hOst hpO), hℓ₀ p hp₀,
        ← f1_inv_eq_f0 ℓ₁ h2, hℓ₁ _ hp₁, zpow_add₀ h2, zpow_one, zpow_natCast]
      field_simp
      ring
  choose σ ψ hσψ using d.exists_section_chart_zero hBB₀ hr₀ hr₁ hr hr₀S hr₁S hsplit q ℓ₀ ℓ₁
    hℓq hℓz
  let T : Matrix d.I₀ d.I₀ Γₚ(discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ)) :=
    fun j j' ↦ (if j = j' then 1 else 0) - ℓ₀ * ψ j (Sum.inl j')
  have hTσ : ∀ j, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 0
      hD₀st (modRes (σ j) _ hD₀T) = ∑ j', T j j' • modRes (d.s j') _ hD₀N := by
    intro j
    rw [hσψ j]
    simp only [T, sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, BundleData.u₀, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply,
      modRes_zero, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  have hx₀ : chartPt.{u} 0 (y₀, c) ∈ discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) := by
    refine ⟨(y₀, c), ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (l * ρ)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    refine hc.trans ?_
    rw [inv_lt_iff_one_lt_mul₀ hr₁]
    exact hr
  have hℓ₀x : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval _ hx₀ ℓ₀ = 0 := by
    rw [← f0_eq_eval, hℓ₀ _ ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩, sub_self]
    change c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (l * ρ)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    refine hc.trans ?_
    rw [inv_lt_iff_one_lt_mul₀ hr₁]
    exact hr
  have hT : ∀ j j', (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval _ hx₀ (T j j') =
      if j = j' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j j'
    simp only [T, map_sub, map_mul, hℓ₀x, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hx₀W, hgen⟩ := exists_generates_twistMod_of_matrix 𝒢 d.s hs hD₀N hD₀st hD₀T
    ((k : ℤ) + 1) σ T hTσ hx₀ hT
  exact ⟨σ, W, hWV, hx₀W, hgen⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.BundleData.exists_section_chart_one
statement:
theorem exists_section_chart_one {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)} (hBB₀ : B ≤ B₀) {l ρ : ℝ}
    (hr₀ : 0 < l * ρ) (hr₁ : 0 < ρ / l) (hr : 1 < l * ρ * (ρ / l)) (hr₀S : l * ρ ≤ S)
    (hr₁S : ρ / l ≤ S) {k : ℕ} (hsplit : d.Splits B l ρ k)
    (r : Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))) (ℓ₀ : Γₚ(discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ)))
    (ℓ₁ : Γₚ(discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l)))
    (hℓr : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_zero B _ _) * r =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1)) _ (discOverlap_le_stdOpen B _ _))
    (hℓz : TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_zero B _ _) *
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec (k : ℤ)) _ (discOverlap_le_stdOpen B _ _) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1)) _ (discOverlap_le_stdOpen B _ _) *
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₁ _ (discOverlap_le_discBox_one B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)))
    (l₁ : d.I₁) :
    ∃ (σ : (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op (tube.{u} (N := 1) B)))
      (ψ : d.I₀ ⊕ d.I₁ → Γₚ(discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l))),
      modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 1
        (chartBox_le_stdOpen 1 _) (modRes σ _ (chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 1 B _)) =
        modRes (d.t l₁) _ ((discBox_le_sqBox 1 hBB₀ hr₁S).trans d.hN₁) +
          ℓ₁ • ∑ b, ψ b • modRes (d.u₁ b) _ ((discBox_le_sqBox 1 hBB₀ hr₁S).trans d.hN₁)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hO₀ := discOverlap_le_discBox_zero.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hO₁ := discOverlap_le_discBox_one.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hOD : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) = discBox 0 B (l * ρ) ⊓ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) :=
    discOverlap_eq B _ _
  have hOS : discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l) ≤ sqOverlap B₀ S :=
    discOverlap_le_sqOverlap hBB₀ hr₀S hr₁S
  have hD₀st : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 0 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 0 _
  have hD₁st : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 1 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 1 _
  have hD₀T : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 0 B _
  have hD₁T : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 1 B _
  have hOst := discOverlap_le_stdOpen.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hsup : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ⊔ discBox 1 B (ρ / l) = tube.{u} (N := 1) B :=
    chartBox_sup B _ _ (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₀) (zero_mem_ballOpens hr₁)
      (ballOpens_or_inv hr₀ hr)
  let ĥ : d.I₀ ⊕ d.I₁ → Γₚ(discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) :=
    Sum.elim (fun j ↦ r * TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (d.A l₁ j) _ hOS) 0
  obtain ⟨φ₀, φ₁, hφ₀, hφ₁, hrel⟩ := hsplit (fun p a ↦ f0 (ĥ a) p)
    (differentiableOn_pi.2 fun a ↦ differentiableOn_f0_discOverlap hr₁ (ĥ a))
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, ψ₁, -, -, hΦ⟩ := d.exists_split hBB₀ hr₁ hr₀S hr₁S k ĥ φ₀ φ₁ hφ₀ hφ₁
    fun y hy w hw ↦ hrel y hy w hw
  have hL : ∑ a, ĥ a • modRes (d.u₀ a) (discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l))
      (hOS.trans d.sqOverlap_le_N₀) =
      r • modRes (d.t l₁) (discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) (hOS.trans d.sqOverlap_le_N₁) := by
    have e := congrArg (fun y ↦ modRes y (discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) hOS) (d.hA l₁)
    simp only [modRes_sum, modRes_smul, modRes_res] at e
    rw [e, Finset.smul_sum]
    simp only [ĥ, Fintype.sum_sum_type, BundleData.u₀, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, mul_smul]
  have hD₀N : discBox.{u} 0 B (l * ρ) ≤ d.N₀ := (discBox_le_sqBox 0 hBB₀ hr₀S).trans d.hN₀
  have hD₁N : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ d.N₁ := (discBox_le_sqBox 1 hBB₀ hr₁S).trans d.hN₁
  set Φ₀ := ∑ a, ψ₀ a • modRes (d.u₀ a) _ hD₀N
  set Φ₁ := ∑ b, ψ₁ b • modRes (d.u₁ b) _ hD₁N
  have e := congrArg (fun y ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen ℓ₀ _ hO₀ • y) hΦ
  rw [hL, smul_smul, hℓr, smul_sub, smul_smul, hℓz, mul_smul] at e
  have hcompat : modRes (ℓ₀ • Φ₀) _ hO₀ =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1)) _ hOst •
        modRes (modRes (d.t l₁) _ hD₁N + ℓ₁ • Φ₁) _ hO₁ := by
    rw [modRes_add, modRes_smul, modRes_res, smul_add, e, modRes_smul, sub_add_cancel]
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ : ∃ T₀, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1))
      0 hD₀st T₀ = ℓ₀ • Φ₀ := ⟨_, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ : ∃ T₁, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1))
      1 hD₁st T₁ = modRes (d.t l₁) _ hD₁N + ℓ₁ • Φ₁ := ⟨_, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ₁⟩ := exists_modRes_eq_of_two (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) hsup.ge hD₀T hD₁T
    T₀ T₁ (by
      apply (modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 0
        (inf_le_left.trans hD₀st)).injective
      rw [modTwistSectionsEquiv_change _ 0 _ 1 (inf_le_right.trans hD₁st) (modRes T₁ _ _),
        modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ 0 hD₀st inf_le_left T₀,
        modTwistSectionsEquiv_res _ 1 hD₁st inf_le_right T₁, hT₀, hT₁]
      have e2 := congrArg (fun y ↦ modRes y (discBox 0 B (l * ρ) ⊓ discBox 1 B (ρ / l)) hOD.ge)
        hcompat
      rw [modRes_res] at e2
      conv_rhs at e2 => rw [modRes_smul, yres_res, modRes_res]
      exact e2)
  exact ⟨σ, ψ₁, by rw [hσ₁, hT₁]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.BundleData.exists_generates_chart_one
statement:
theorem exists_generates_chart_one (ht : IsAcyclicGenerating 𝒢 d.t) {B : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)}
    (hBB₀ : B ≤ B₀) {l ρ : ℝ} (hr₀ : 0 < l * ρ) (hr₁ : 0 < ρ / l) (hr : 1 < l * ρ * (ρ / l))
    (hr₀S : l * ρ ≤ S) (hr₁S : ρ / l ≤ S) {k : ℕ} (hsplit : d.Splits B l ρ k)
    {y₀ : Fin m → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ B) {c : ℂ} (hc : ‖c‖ < (l * ρ)⁻¹) :
    ∃ (σ : d.I₁ → (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op (tube.{u} (N := 1) B)))
      (W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW : W ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B),
      chartPt.{u} 1 (y₀, c) ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (W' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W)
        (τ : (twistMod 𝒢 ((k : ℤ) + 1)).val.obj (op W')) (x : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1),
        x ∈ W' → ∃ (W'' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (h : W'' ≤ W'), x ∈ W'' ∧
          ∃ e : d.I₁ → Γₚ(W''), modRes τ W'' h =
            ∑ j, e j • modRes (σ j) W'' (h.trans (hW'.trans hW))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hD₁N : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ d.N₁ := (discBox_le_sqBox 1 hBB₀ hr₁S).trans d.hN₁
  have hD₁st : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 1 := chartBox_le_stdOpen 1 _
  have hOst := discOverlap_le_stdOpen.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hO₀ := discOverlap_le_discBox_zero.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hO₁ := discOverlap_le_discBox_one.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)
  have hD₁T : discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) B := chartBox_prodOpens_le_tube 1 B _
  have hann_c : ∀ w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l), 1 - c * w ≠ 0 := fun w hw h ↦ by
    have h1 : ‖c * w‖ < 1 := by
      rw [norm_mul]
      calc ‖c‖ * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖c‖ * (l * ρ) := by gcongr; exact hw.2.le
        _ < (l * ρ)⁻¹ * (l * ρ) := by gcongr
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr₀.ne'
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [← h, norm_one] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  have hinv_ball : ∀ w ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l), w⁻¹ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (ρ / l) := by
    intro w hw
    have h0 : 0 < ‖w‖ := (inv_pos.2 hr₁).trans hw.1
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_inv]
    exact (inv_lt_comm₀ h0 hr₁).2 hw.1
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr'⟩ := exists_f0_eq_discOverlap.{u} B hr₁ (fun p ↦ p.2 ^ (k + 1) * (1 - c * p.2)⁻¹)
    (fun p hp ↦ ((differentiableAt_snd.pow _).mul ((differentiableAt_snd.const_mul c).const_sub 1
      |>.inv (hann_c _ hp.2))).differentiableWithinAt)
  obtain ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀⟩ := exists_f0_eq.{u} (prodOpens B (ballOpens (l * ρ))) (fun p ↦ 1 - c * p.2)
    ((differentiable_snd.const_mul c).const_sub 1).differentiableOn
  obtain ⟨ℓ₁, hℓ₁⟩ := exists_f1_eq.{u} (prodOpens B (ballOpens (ρ / l))) (fun p ↦ p.2 - c)
    (differentiable_snd.sub_const c).differentiableOn
  have hp₀ : ∀ p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ, p.1 ∈ B → p.2 ∈ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l) →
      p ∈ prodOpens B (ballOpens (l * ρ)) := fun p hp1 hp2 ↦ ⟨hp1, by
    change p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (l * ρ)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hp2.2⟩
  have hℓr : (ℓ₀ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) * r =
      (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) :=
    eq_of_f0_eq_discOverlap hr₁ fun p hp1 hp2 ↦ by
      have hpO := mem_discOverlap_of.{u} hr₁ ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      rw [f0_mul, Pi.mul_apply, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO,
        hℓ₀ p (hp₀ p hp1 hp2), hr' p hp1 hp2, f0_twistModCocycle _ (hOst hpO), zpow_add₀
        (ne_zero_of_mem_annulusSet hr₁ hp2), zpow_one, zpow_natCast]
      have := hann_c _ hp2
      field_simp
      ring
  have hℓz : (ℓ₀ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) *
      (zSec (k : ℤ) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) =
      (zSec ((k : ℤ) + 1) |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) *
        (ℓ₁ |ₒ discOverlap.{u} B (l * ρ) (ρ / l)) :=
    eq_of_f0_eq_discOverlap hr₁ fun p hp1 hp2 ↦ by
      have hpO := mem_discOverlap_of.{u} hr₁ ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      have h2 := ne_zero_of_mem_annulusSet hr₁ hp2
      have hp₁ : (p.1, p.2⁻¹) ∈ prodOpens B (ballOpens (ρ / l)) := ⟨hp1, hinv_ball _ hp2⟩
      rw [f0_mul, f0_mul, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.mul_apply, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO,
        f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO, f0_restrictOpen _ _ hpO,
        f0_twistModCocycle _ (hOst hpO), f0_twistModCocycle _ (hOst hpO), hℓ₀ p (hp₀ p hp1 hp2),
        ← f1_inv_eq_f0 ℓ₁ h2, hℓ₁ _ hp₁, zpow_add₀ h2, zpow_one, zpow_natCast]
      field_simp
  choose σ ψ hσψ using d.exists_section_chart_one hBB₀ hr₀ hr₁ hr hr₀S hr₁S hsplit r ℓ₀ ℓ₁
    hℓr hℓz
  let T : Matrix d.I₁ d.I₁ Γₚ(discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l)) :=
    fun j j' ↦ (if j = j' then 1 else 0) + ℓ₁ * ψ j (Sum.inr j')
  have hTσ : ∀ j, modTwistSectionsEquiv (N := 𝒢) (twistModCocycle.{u} m 1 ((k : ℤ) + 1)) 1
      hD₁st (modRes (σ j) _ hD₁T) = ∑ j', T j j' • modRes (d.t j') _ hD₁N := by
    intro j
    rw [hσψ j]
    simp only [T, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, BundleData.u₁, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply,
      modRes_zero, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  have hcball : c ∈ ballOpens (ρ / l) := by
    change c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (ρ / l)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    refine hc.trans ?_
    rw [inv_lt_iff_one_lt_mul₀ hr₀, mul_comm]
    exact hr
  have hx₀ : chartPt.{u} 1 (y₀, c) ∈ discBox.{u} 1 B (ρ / l) := ⟨(y₀, c), ⟨hy₀, hcball⟩, rfl⟩
  have hℓ₁x : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval _ hx₀ ℓ₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← f1_eq_eval, hℓ₁ _ ⟨hy₀, hcball⟩, sub_self]
  have hT : ∀ j j', (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval _ hx₀ (T j j') =
      if j = j' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j j'
    simp only [T, map_add, map_mul, hℓ₁x, zero_mul, add_zero]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hx₀W, hgen⟩ := exists_generates_twistMod_of_matrix 𝒢 d.t ht hD₁N hD₁st hD₁T
    ((k : ℤ) + 1) σ T hTσ hx₀ hT
  exact ⟨σ, W, hWV, hx₀W, hgen⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.generatesLocally_of
statement:
lemma generatesLocally_of
    {M : SheafOfModules.{u} (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).toLocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf}
    {V W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens} {I : Type u} [Fintype I]
    {σ : I → M.val.obj (op V)} {hW : W ≤ V}
    (h : ∀ (W' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W) (τ : M.val.obj (op W'))
      (y : relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1), y ∈ W' → ∃ (W'' : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens)
        (h : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧ ∃ e : I → Γₚ(W''),
          modRes τ W'' h = ∑ i, e i • modRes (σ i) W'' (h.trans (hW'.trans hW))) :
    GeneratesLocally fun i ↦ modRes (σ i) W hW
proof:
:= fun W' hW' τ y hy ↦ by
  obtain ⟨W'', h', hy'', e, he⟩ := h W' hW' τ y hy
  exact ⟨W'', h', hy'', e, by rw [he]; simp only [modRes_res]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_chartPt_norm_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tube] at hx
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_chartPt x
  · rw [baseY_chartPt] at hx
    by_cases hp : ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1
    · exact ⟨p, hx, hp, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · push Not at hp
      have h0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (zero_lt_one.trans hp)
      refine ⟨(p.1, p.2⁻¹), hx, ?_, Or.inr (chartPt_zero_eq_chartPt_one h0).symm⟩
      rw [norm_inv]
      exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hp.le
  · rw [baseY_chartPt] at hx
    by_cases hp : ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1
    · exact ⟨p, hx, hp, Or.inr rfl⟩
    · push Not at hp
      have h0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (zero_lt_one.trans hp)
      refine ⟨(p.1, p.2⁻¹), hx, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_inv]
        exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hp.le
      · rw [chartPt_zero_eq_chartPt_one (inv_ne_zero h0), inv_inv]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_generates_twistMod
statement:
theorem exists_generates_twistMod {U : Opens (Fin m → ℂ)}
    (h𝒢 : (((relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictModules
      (tube.{u} (N := 1) U)).obj 𝒢).IsCoherent)
    {a b : Fin m → ℂ} (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ U) (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ a' b' : Fin m → ℂ, Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ Complex.openBox a' b' ∧
      Complex.openBox a' b' ⊆ U ∧ ∃ n₀ : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n₀ ≤ n →
        ∀ x ∈ tube.{u} (N := 1) (boxOpens a' b'), ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
          (σ : I → (twistMod 𝒢 n).val.obj (op (tube.{u} (N := 1) (boxOpens a' b'))))
          (W : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).Opens)
          (hW : W ≤ tube.{u} (N := 1) (boxOpens a' b')), x ∈ W ∧
          GeneratesLocally fun i ↦ modRes (σ i) W hW
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, b₀, hab₀, hB₀U, d, hs, ht⟩ := exists_bundleData 𝒢 h𝒢 hK hne (S := 3) (by norm_num)
  have hann : ∀ {l ρ : ℝ}, 0 < ρ / l → l * ρ ≤ 3 → ρ / l ≤ 3 →
      (boxOpens a₀ b₀ : Set (Fin m → ℂ)) ×ˢ annulusSet (l * ρ) (ρ / l) ⊆
        overlapOpens (prodOpens (boxOpens a₀ b₀) (squareOpens 3))
          (prodOpens (boxOpens a₀ b₀) (squareOpens 3)) := fun hr₁ h₀ h₁ p hp ↦
    overlapOpens_mono (prodOpens_mono le_rfl (ballOpens_le_squareOpens h₀))
      (prodOpens_mono le_rfl (ballOpens_le_squareOpens h₁))
      ((mem_overlapOpens_ballOpens hr₁).2 hp)
  
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀o, hKU₀, hU₀U, k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_vanishing_scaled (l := 2) (ρ := 3 / 2)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (isOpen_openBox a₀ b₀)
    (d.differentiableOn_G.mono (hann (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)))
    (fun p hp ↦ d.isUnit_G (hann (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hp))
    (Complex.isCompact_closedBox a b) hab₀
  obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁o, hKU₁, hU₁U, k₁, hk₁⟩ := exists_vanishing_scaled (l := 1 / 2) (ρ := 3 / 2)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (isOpen_openBox a₀ b₀)
    (d.differentiableOn_G.mono (hann (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)))
    (fun p hp ↦ d.isUnit_G (hann (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hp))
    (Complex.isCompact_closedBox a b) hab₀
  obtain ⟨a', b', hab', hsub'⟩ := exists_openBox_between (hU₀o.inter hU₁o)
    (fun x hx ↦ ⟨hKU₀ hx, hKU₁ hx⟩)
  refine ⟨a', b', hab', fun x hx ↦ hB₀U (hU₀U (hsub' hx).1), (max k₀ k₁ : ℕ) + 1,
    fun n hn x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = (k : ℤ) + 1 := ⟨(n - 1).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hk₀' : k₀ ≤ k := by omega
  have hk₁' : k₁ ≤ k := by omega
  have hBB₀ : boxOpens a' b' ≤ boxOpens a₀ b₀ := fun y hy ↦ hU₀U (hsub' hy).1
  have hsplit₀ : d.Splits (boxOpens a' b') 2 (3 / 2) k :=
    hk₀ k hk₀' _ (fun y hy ↦ (hsub' hy).1) (boxOpens a' b').isOpen
  have hsplit₁ : d.Splits (boxOpens a' b') (1 / 2) (3 / 2) k :=
    hk₁ k hk₁' _ (fun y hy ↦ (hsub' hy).2) (boxOpens a' b').isOpen
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp | hp⟩ := exists_chartPt_norm_le_one hx
  · obtain ⟨σ, W, hW, hxW, hgen⟩ := d.exists_generates_chart_zero hs hBB₀ (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hsplit₀ hp1
      (c := p.2) (hp2.trans_lt (by norm_num))
    exact ⟨d.I₀, inferInstance, σ, W, hW, hp ▸ hxW, generatesLocally_of hgen⟩
  · obtain ⟨σ, W, hW, hxW, hgen⟩ := d.exists_generates_chart_one ht hBB₀ (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hsplit₁ hp1
      (c := p.2) (hp2.trans_lt (by norm_num))
    exact ⟨d.I₁, inferInstance, σ, W, hW, hp ▸ hxW, generatesLocally_of hgen⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.iSup_stdOpen
statement: lemma iSup_stdOpen : ⨆ i, stdOpen.{u} m N i = ⊤

  iSup_preimOpen (iSup_U N _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.stdOpen_eq_chartOpens
statement: lemma stdOpen_eq_chartOpens (i : Fin (N + 1)) : stdOpen.{u} m N i = chartOpens i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change π m N x ∈ U N (RelBase.{u} m) i ↔ x ∈ Set.range (chartLRS.{u} i).base
  rw [range_chart]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.twistModCocycle_add
statement:
lemma twistModCocycle_add (a b : ℤ) :
    twistModCocycle.{u} m N (a + b) = twistModCocycle m N a * twistModCocycle m N b
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistModCocycle, zpow_add, cocycleComap_mul]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.twistModCocycle_zero
statement: lemma twistModCocycle_zero : twistModCocycle.{u} m N 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistModCocycle, zpow_zero, cocycleComap_one]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.twistModCocycle_g
statement:
lemma twistModCocycle_g (n : ℤ) (i j : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (twistModCocycle.{u} m N n).g i j = pbG πL.{u} (cocycle N (RelBase.{u} m) ^ n) i j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveSpaceAn.isCoherent_twistMod

  isCoherent_modTwist M _ iSup_stdOpen

:=
  (TopCat.Sheaf.H.addEquivOfIso (restrictOpenTwistModIso M n W i hW) q).toEquiv

statement:
lemma chartBox_le_stdOpen (i : Fin 2) (S : Opens ((Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ)) :
    chartBox.{u} i S ≤ stdOpen.{u} m 1 i

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.ne_zero_vec₀
statement: lemma ne_zero_vec₀ (z : ℂ) : (![1, z] : Fin 2 → ℂ) ≠ 0

:=
  Function.ne_iff.2 ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.ne_zero_vec₁

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_zero
statement:
lemma mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_zero {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : chartPt.{u} 0 p ∈ W) :
    ((![1, p.2] : Fin 2 → ℂ), p.1) ∈ vecCone.{u} W
proof:
:=
  ⟨ne_zero_vec₀ p.2, by rw [← chartPt_zero_eq]; exact hp⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_one
statement:
lemma mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_one {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : chartPt.{u} 1 p ∈ W) :
    ((![p.2, 1] : Fin 2 → ℂ), p.1) ∈ vecCone.{u} W
proof:
:=
  ⟨ne_zero_vec₁ p.2, by rw [← chartPt_one_eq]; exact hp⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_add
statement:
lemma f0_add (a b : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    f0 (a + b) = f0 a + f0 b
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  simp [f0, secFun_add]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_mul
statement:
lemma f0_mul (a b : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    f0 (a * b) = f0 a * f0 b
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  simp [f0, secFun_mul]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_sub
statement:
lemma f0_sub (a b : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    f0 (a - b) = f0 a - f0 b
proof:
:= by
  have h := f0_add (a - b) b
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_one
statement:
lemma f0_one {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : chartPt.{u} 0 p ∈ W) :
    f0 (1 : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [f0, secFun_of_mem _ (ne_zero_vec₀ p.2) (by rw [← chartPt_zero_eq]; exact hp), map_one]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_zero
statement: lemma f0_zero : f0 (0 : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  simp [f0, secFun_zero]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_sum
statement:
lemma f0_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    f0 (∑ i ∈ s, a i) = ∑ i ∈ s, f0 (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [f0_zero]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, f0_add, ih]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_restrictOpen
statement:
lemma f0_restrictOpen (h : W' ≤ W) (a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W))

    f0 (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen a W' h) p = f0 a p
proof:
:= by

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f1_restrictOpen
statement:
lemma f1_restrictOpen (h : W' ≤ W) (a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W))

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f1_inv_eq_f0
statement:
lemma f1_inv_eq_f0 (a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W))
    {p : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ} (hp : p.2 ≠ 0) : f1 a (p.1, p.2⁻¹) = f0 a p
proof:
:= by
  rw [f1, f0, ← secFun_smul a _ p.1 hp]

  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> simp [hp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_twistModCocycle
proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.f0_eq_eval
statement:
lemma f0_eq_eval (a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W))

proof:

statement:
lemma f1_eq_eval (a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op W))

    f1 a p = (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval (chartPt.{u} 1 p) hp a
proof:

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.eq_of_f0_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_secFun fun q hq ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, hpS, hp⟩ := hq.2
  have h0 : q.1 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have := (mem_range_chart_pointOfVec_iff q.1 hq.1 q.2 0).1 (hp ▸ ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩)
    exact this
  have hq' : pointOfVec.{u} q.1 hq.1 q.2 = chartPt.{u} 0 (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0) :=
    pointOfVec_eq_chartPt_zero q.1 hq.1 q.2 h0
  have hpq : p = (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0) := chartPt_injective 0 (hp.trans hq')
  have hvec : (q.1 0)⁻¹ • q.1 = ![1, q.1 1 / q.1 0] := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [h0, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have e (c : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op (chartBox.{u} 0 S))) :
      secFun c q = f0 c (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0) := by
    rw [f0, ← hvec, secFun_smul c q.1 q.2 (inv_ne_zero h0)]
  rw [e, e, ← hpq]
  exact h p hpS

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.eq_of_f1_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_secFun fun q hq ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, hpS, hp⟩ := hq.2
  have h1 : q.1 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have := (mem_range_chart_pointOfVec_iff q.1 hq.1 q.2 1).1 (hp ▸ ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩)
    exact this
  have hq' : pointOfVec.{u} q.1 hq.1 q.2 = chartPt.{u} 1 (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1) :=
    pointOfVec_eq_chartPt_one q.1 hq.1 q.2 h1
  have hpq : p = (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1) := chartPt_injective 1 (hp.trans hq')
  have hvec : (q.1 1)⁻¹ • q.1 = ![q.1 0 / q.1 1, 1] := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [h1, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have e (c : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op (chartBox.{u} 1 S))) :
      secFun c q = f1 c (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1) := by
    rw [f1, ← hvec, secFun_smul c q.1 q.2 (inv_ne_zero h1)]
  rw [e, e, ← hpq]
  exact h p hpS

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_f0_eq
statement:
lemma exists_f0_eq (S : Opens ((Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ)) (F : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F S) :
    ∃ a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op (chartBox.{u} 0 S)),
      ∀ p ∈ S, f0 a p = F p
proof:
:= by
  have hW : ∀ y ∈ chartBox.{u} 0 S, y ∈ Set.range (chartLRS.{u} (m := m) (N := 1) 0).base := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩
  have hcone : ∀ q ∈ vecCone.{u} (chartBox.{u} 0 S), q.1 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0) ∈ S := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, hpS, hp⟩ := hq.2
    have h0 : q.1 0 ≠ 0 :=
      (mem_range_chart_pointOfVec_iff q.1 hq.1 q.2 0).1 (hp ▸ ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩)
    have hpq : p = (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0) :=
      chartPt_injective 0 (hp.trans (pointOfVec_eq_chartPt_zero q.1 hq.1 q.2 h0))
    exact ⟨h0, hpq ▸ hpS⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_secFun_eq (N := 1) 0 hW
    (fun q ↦ F (q.2, q.1 1 / q.1 0)) (by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨h0, hS⟩ := hcone q hq
      refine (DifferentiableAt.comp q ?_ ?_).differentiableWithinAt
      · exact (hF _ hS).differentiableAt (S.isOpen.mem_nhds hS)
      · have hc : ∀ k : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun q : (Fin 2 → ℂ) × (Fin m → ℂ) ↦ q.1 k) q :=
          fun k ↦ DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun v : Fin 2 → ℂ ↦ v k) q
            (differentiableAt_apply k q.1) differentiableAt_fst
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun q : (Fin 2 → ℂ) × (Fin m → ℂ) ↦ q.1 1 / q.1 0) q := by
          simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          exact (hc 1).mul ((hc 0).inv h0)
        exact differentiableAt_snd.prodMk hd)
    (by
      intro q hq c hc
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc])
  refine ⟨a, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [f0, ha _ (mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_zero ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)]
  simp

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.exists_f1_eq
statement:
lemma exists_f1_eq (S : Opens ((Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ)) (F : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F S) :
    ∃ a : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj (op (chartBox.{u} 1 S)),
      ∀ p ∈ S, f1 a p = F p
proof:
:= by
  have hW : ∀ y ∈ chartBox.{u} 1 S, y ∈ Set.range (chartLRS.{u} (m := m) (N := 1) 1).base := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩
  have hcone : ∀ q ∈ vecCone.{u} (chartBox.{u} 1 S), q.1 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1) ∈ S := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, hpS, hp⟩ := hq.2
    have h1 : q.1 1 ≠ 0 :=
      (mem_range_chart_pointOfVec_iff q.1 hq.1 q.2 1).1 (hp ▸ ⟨cpt p, rfl⟩)
    have hpq : p = (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1) :=
      chartPt_injective 1 (hp.trans (pointOfVec_eq_chartPt_one q.1 hq.1 q.2 h1))
    exact ⟨h1, hpq ▸ hpS⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_secFun_eq (N := 1) 1 hW
    (fun q ↦ F (q.2, q.1 0 / q.1 1)) (by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨h1, hS⟩ := hcone q hq
      refine (DifferentiableAt.comp q ?_ ?_).differentiableWithinAt
      · exact (hF _ hS).differentiableAt (S.isOpen.mem_nhds hS)
      · have hc : ∀ k : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun q : (Fin 2 → ℂ) × (Fin m → ℂ) ↦ q.1 k) q :=
          fun k ↦ DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun v : Fin 2 → ℂ ↦ v k) q
            (differentiableAt_apply k q.1) differentiableAt_fst
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun q : (Fin 2 → ℂ) × (Fin m → ℂ) ↦ q.1 0 / q.1 1) q := by
          simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          exact (hc 0).mul ((hc 1).inv h1)
        exact differentiableAt_snd.prodMk hd)
    (by
      intro q hq c hc
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc])
  refine ⟨a, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [f1, ha _ (mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_one ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)]
  simp

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.differentiableOn_f0
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hmem := mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_zero (W := chartBox.{u} 0 S) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hd := (differentiableOn_secFun a _ hmem).differentiableAt (isOpen_vecCone.mem_nhds hmem)
  refine (DifferentiableAt.comp p hd ?_).differentiableWithinAt
  refine DifferentiableAt.prodMk ?_ differentiableAt_fst
  refine differentiableAt_pi.2 fun k ↦ ?_
  fin_cases k
  · exact differentiableAt_const _
  · exact differentiableAt_snd

name: ComplexAnalytic.relProjectiveLine.differentiableOn_f1
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hmem := mem_vecCone_of_chartPt_one (W := chartBox.{u} 1 S) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hd := (differentiableOn_secFun a _ hmem).differentiableAt (isOpen_vecCone.mem_nhds hmem)
  refine (DifferentiableAt.comp p hd ?_).differentiableWithinAt
  refine DifferentiableAt.prodMk ?_ differentiableAt_fst
  refine differentiableAt_pi.2 fun k ↦ ?_
  fin_cases k
  · exact differentiableAt_snd
  · exact differentiableAt_const _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_modRes_eq_of_two
statement:
lemma exists_modRes_eq_of_two {W A B : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (hW : W ≤ A ⊔ B) (hA : A ≤ W)
    (hB : B ≤ W) (a : F.val.obj (op A)) (b : F.val.obj (op B))
    (hab : modRes a (A ⊓ B) inf_le_left = modRes b (A ⊓ B) inf_le_right) :
    ∃ s : F.val.obj (op W), modRes s A hA = a ∧ modRes s B hB = b
proof:
:= by
  let O : Bool → Opens X.toPresheafedSpace := fun i ↦ bif i then A else B
  let sf : ∀ i, F.val.obj (op (O i)) := fun i ↦ Bool.casesOn (motive := fun i ↦
    F.val.obj (op (O i))) i b a
  have hWO : W ≤ iSup O := by
    refine hW.trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · exact le_iSup O true
    · exact le_iSup O false
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := modRes_existsUnique_gluing F O hWO (fun i ↦ by cases i <;> assumption) sf
    (fun i j ↦ by
      cases i <;> cases j
      · rfl
      · change modRes b (B ⊓ A) _ = modRes a (B ⊓ A) _
        have := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (B ⊓ A) (by rw [inf_comm])) hab
        simp only [modRes_res] at this
        exact this.symm
      · change modRes a (A ⊓ B) _ = modRes b (A ⊓ B) _
        exact hab
      · rfl)
  exact ⟨s, hs true, hs false⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.eq_of_modRes_eq_two
statement:
lemma eq_of_modRes_eq_two {W A B : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (hW : W ≤ A ⊔ B) (hA : A ≤ W)
    (hB : B ≤ W) (s t : F.val.obj (op W)) (h₁ : modRes s A hA = modRes t A hA)
    (h₂ : modRes s B hB = modRes t B hB) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  let O : Bool → Opens X.toPresheafedSpace := fun i ↦ bif i then A else B
  have hWO : W ≤ iSup O := by
    refine hW.trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · exact le_iSup O true
    · exact le_iSup O false
  exact modRes_eq_of_cover F O hWO (fun i ↦ by cases i <;> assumption) s t
    (fun i ↦ by cases i <;> assumption)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modRes_sub
statement:
lemma modRes_sub {V W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W ≤ V) (x y : F.val.obj (op V)) :
    modRes (x - y) W h = modRes x W h - modRes y W h
proof:
:=
  map_sub _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_sub_eq_of_refine
statement:
lemma exists_sub_eq_of_refine {V₀ V₁ D₀ D₁ : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (hD₀ : D₀ ≤ V₀)
    (hD₁ : D₁ ≤ V₁) (hcov : V₀ ⊔ V₁ ≤ D₀ ⊔ D₁) (σ : F.val.obj (op (V₀ ⊓ V₁)))
    (Φ₀ : F.val.obj (op D₀)) (Φ₁ : F.val.obj (op D₁))
    (h : modRes σ (D₀ ⊓ D₁) (inf_le_inf hD₀ hD₁) =
      modRes Φ₀ (D₀ ⊓ D₁) inf_le_left - modRes Φ₁ (D₀ ⊓ D₁) inf_le_right) :
    ∃ (σ₀ : F.val.obj (op V₀)) (σ₁ : F.val.obj (op V₁)),
      modRes σ₀ (V₀ ⊓ V₁) inf_le_left - modRes σ₁ (V₀ ⊓ V₁) inf_le_right = σ
proof:
:= by
  have hV₀ : V₀ ≤ D₀ ⊔ (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₁) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Opens.mem_sup.1 (hcov (Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inl hx))) with h0 | h1
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inl h0)
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inr ⟨⟨hx, hD₁ h1⟩, h1⟩)
  have hV₁ : V₁ ≤ D₁ ⊔ (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₀) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Opens.mem_sup.1 (hcov (Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inr hx))) with h0 | h1
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inr ⟨⟨hD₀ h0, hx⟩, h0⟩)
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inl h1)
  have hV₀₁ : V₀ ⊓ V₁ ≤ (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₀) ⊔ (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₁) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Opens.mem_sup.1 (hcov (Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inl hx.1))) with h0 | h1
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inl ⟨hx, h0⟩)
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.2 (Or.inr ⟨hx, h1⟩)
  
  have hres : ∀ (O : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace) (hO : O ≤ D₀ ⊓ D₁),
      modRes σ O (hO.trans (inf_le_inf hD₀ hD₁)) =
        modRes Φ₀ O (hO.trans inf_le_left) - modRes Φ₁ O (hO.trans inf_le_right) := by
    intro O hO
    have e := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x O hO) h
    simp only [modRes_res, modRes_sub] at e
    exact e
  obtain ⟨σ₀, hσ₀D, hσ₀V⟩ := exists_modRes_eq_of_two F hV₀ hD₀ (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
    Φ₀ (modRes σ _ inf_le_left + modRes Φ₁ _ inf_le_right) (by
      rw [modRes_add, modRes_res, modRes_res,
        hres _ (le_inf inf_le_left (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right)), sub_add_cancel])
  obtain ⟨σ₁, hσ₁D, hσ₁V⟩ := exists_modRes_eq_of_two F hV₁ hD₁ (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)
    Φ₁ (modRes Φ₀ _ inf_le_right - modRes σ _ inf_le_left) (by
      rw [modRes_sub, modRes_res, modRes_res,
        hres _ (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_left), sub_sub_cancel])
  refine ⟨σ₀, σ₁, eq_of_modRes_eq_two F hV₀₁ inf_le_left inf_le_left _ _ ?_ ?_⟩
  · have e₀ := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₀) inf_le_right) hσ₀D
    have e₁ := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₀) le_rfl) hσ₁V
    simp only [modRes_res, modRes_self] at e₀ e₁
    rw [modRes_sub, modRes_res, modRes_res, e₀, e₁, sub_sub_cancel]
  · have e₀ := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₁) le_rfl) hσ₀V
    have e₁ := congrArg (fun x ↦ modRes x (V₀ ⊓ V₁ ⊓ D₁) inf_le_right) hσ₁D
    simp only [modRes_res, modRes_self] at e₀ e₁
    rw [modRes_sub, modRes_res, modRes_res, e₀, e₁, add_sub_cancel_right]
