      have := h hx.1
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Pi.zero_apply]
      exact sub_eq_zero.2 this) j
  exact fun x hx ↦ sub_eq_zero.1 (this hx)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.mem_goodBase
statement: lemma mem_goodBase {b : Cm.{u} m} : baseCoord b ∈ goodBase R ↔ b ∈ F.G ∧ b ∉ R.zeroSet
proof:
:= by
  change ofBase (baseCoord b) ∈ F.G \ R.zeroSet ↔ _
  rw [ofBase_baseCoord]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.ofBase_mem_of_mem_goodBase
statement: lemma ofBase_mem_of_mem_goodBase {y : Fin m → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ goodBase R) : ofBase.{u} y ∈ F.G

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isCoherentAt_of_mem_goodBase
proof:
:=
  hcoh x ((mem_goodBase R).1 hx).2

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.capTheoremAInput
statement: theorem capTheoremAInput (m : ℕ) : CapTheoremAInput.{u} m
proof:
:= by
  intro N N₀ h₀ W _ F R D hcoh y hy
  have hyG : baseOf y.1 ∈ F.G := ((F.mem_N y.1).1 y.2).1
  exact D.capTheoremA_of_isCoherent h₀ (fun _ hy ↦ ofBase_mem_of_mem_goodBase R hy)
    (D.isCoherent_restrictModules_capModule h₀ (fun _ hy ↦ ofBase_mem_of_mem_goodBase R hy)
      (isCoherentAt_of_mem_goodBase R hcoh)) ((mem_goodBase R).2 ⟨hyG, hy⟩)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.capFinitenessInput
statement: theorem capFinitenessInput (m : ℕ) : CapFinitenessInput.{u} m
proof:
:= by
  intro N N₀ h₀ W _ F R D hcoh n b hbG hbZ
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := D.exists_capLocallyFinite_of_isCoherent h₀
    (fun _ hy ↦ ofBase_mem_of_mem_goodBase R hy) (isCoherentAt_of_mem_goodBase R hcoh)
    ((mem_goodBase R).2 ⟨hbG, hbZ⟩)
  have hdown : ∀ k, D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ (n + k) b → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact id
    | succ k ih => exact fun h ↦ ih (D.capLocallyFinite_of_succ h₀ h)
  exact hdown N₁ (hN₁ _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _))

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.capExtension
statement: theorem capExtension (m : ℕ) : CapExtension.{u} m
proof:
:=
  capExtension_of_input (capTheoremAInput m) (capFinitenessInput m)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isCoherent_boundedModule_of_hasThinComplement
proof:
:=
  isCoherent_boundedModule_of_capExtension h₀ W (fun m _ _ ↦ capExtension m) hD

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.capExtension_of_input
statement:
theorem capExtension_of_input {m : ℕ} (hA : CapTheoremAInput.{u} m)
    (hfin : CapFinitenessInput.{u} m) : CapExtension.{u} m
proof:
:= by
  intro N N₀ h₀ W _ F R hcoh x
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := AnnulusDecomposition.nonempty (W := W) F.convex_G F.isOpen_G F.one_lt_ρ
    F.annulusRegion_subset
  have hxG : baseOf x.1 ∈ F.G := ((F.mem_N x.1).1 x.2).1
  exact D.isCoherentAt_of_capGenerators h₀ R (hA N N₀ h₀ W F R D hcoh)
    (D.capGenerators_of_capLocallyFinite h₀ (fun n _ hb ↦
      AnnulusDecomposition.capLocallyFinite_of_forall_not_mem (hfin N N₀ h₀ W F R D hcoh n) hb) hxG)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isCoherent_boundedModule_of_input
statement:
theorem isCoherent_boundedModule_of_input
    (hA : ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → CapTheoremAInput.{u} m) (hfin : ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → CapFinitenessInput.{u} m)
    {n : ℕ} {N N₀ : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).Opens} (h₀ : N₀ ≤ N)
    (W : FiniteEtaleOver (space N₀)) [T2Space W.left] (hD : HasThinComplement N N₀) :
    (boundedModule h₀ W).IsCoherent
proof:
:=
  isCoherent_boundedModule_of_capExtension h₀ W
    (fun m _ hm ↦ capExtension_of_input (hA m hm) (hfin m hm)) hD

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCoherent_evalSubmodule
statement:
theorem isCoherent_evalSubmodule (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) :
    (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_free (space F.baseOpens) (D.EvIdx M)
  exact isCoherent_of_hasLocalModuleRelations _
    (D.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_evalSubmodule h₀ hwρ hloc)
    ((D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).hasLocalModuleRelations
      (hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent _))

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_generatesLocally_evalSubmodule
statement:
theorem exists_generatesLocally_evalSubmodule (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hcoh : (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.IsCoherent) {a b : Cm.{u} m}
    (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ F.G) (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ W' : (space F.baseOpens).Opens, (∀ z ∈ Complex.closedBox a b, z ∈ img W') ∧
      ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
        (g : I → (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op W')),
        ∀ (V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens) (hV : V ≤ W')
          (σ : (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op V))
          (y : space F.baseOpens), y ∈ V →
          ∃ (W₃ : (space F.baseOpens).Opens) (h : W₃ ≤ V), y ∈ W₃ ∧
            ∃ c : I → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op W₃),
              modRes σ W₃ h = ∑ i, c i • modRes (g i) W₃ (h.trans hV)
proof:
:= by
  let S' : SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} m).restrict F.baseOpens.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf :=
    (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules
  obtain ⟨W', hKW', I, hI, g, hg, -⟩ := @ComplexAnalytic.exists_sections_closedBox _ _ _
    ((_root_.complexAffineSpace.{u} m).ofRestrict F.baseOpens.isOpenEmbedding) _
    ((hasLocalRelations_complexSpace _).restrict F.baseOpens) S' hcoh _
    (fun y ↦ @ComplexAnalytic.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_stalk_restrict_complexAffineSpace _
      F.baseOpens S' hcoh y)
    _ _ (fun x hx ↦ ⟨⟨x, hK hx⟩, rfl⟩) hne
  refine ⟨W', fun z hz ↦ ?_, I, hI, g, fun V hV σ y hy ↦ hg V hV σ y hy⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hKW' hz
  exact mem_img_iff.2 ⟨y.2, hy⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_isCapGenAt_openBox
statement:
theorem exists_isCapGenAt_openBox (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) (hw : Function.Injective w)
    (hM : (∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n < M)
    (hcoh : (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.IsCoherent) {a b : Cm.{u} m}
    (hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ F.G) (hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (L : ℕ) (σ : Fin L → boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N (Complex.openBox a b)
      (isOpen_openBox a b)) × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)),
      (∀ l, σ l ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N (Complex.openBox a b) (isOpen_openBox a b))
        (Complex.openBox a b ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Complex.openBox a b, D.IsCapGenAt h₀ n σ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set O := Complex.openBox a b
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_openBox a b
  have hOK : O ⊆ Complex.closedBox a b := fun x hx j _ ↦
    ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hx j trivial).1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hx j trivial).2⟩
  have hOG : O ⊆ F.G := hOK.trans hK
  set S := (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules
  obtain ⟨W', hKW', I, hI, g, hg⟩ :=
    D.exists_generatesLocally_evalSubmodule h₀ hwρ hcoh hK hne
  have hOW' : ∀ z ∈ O, z ∈ img W' := fun z hz ↦ hKW' z (hOK hz)
  
  have hglue : ∀ i, ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N O hO) (O ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ), ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ x,
      D.evalVec w t.1.1 z x = holFun (V := W') (SheafOfModules.freeEval _ (g i).1 x) z := by
    intro i
    have hτ : D.IsCapEval h₀ n w (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') (g i).1) := (g i).2
    refine D.exists_capPole_of_locally h₀ hOG hM hw hwρ fun z hz ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hBW, hzB, t, ht, htv⟩ := hτ z (hOW' z hz)
    have hBO : IsOpen (B ∩ O) := hB.inter hO
    have hle : tubeN N (B ∩ O) hBO ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono inter_subset_left
    refine ⟨B ∩ O, hBO, inter_subset_right, ⟨hzB, hz⟩, D.capRestrict h₀ hle t,
      D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono inter_subset_left subset_rfl) ht,
      fun z' hz' x ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ (inter_subset_right.trans hOG) inter_subset_left _ hz']
    exact htv z' hz'.1 x
  choose t ht htv using hglue
  set e := Fintype.equivFin I
  refine ⟨Fintype.card I, fun l ↦ t (e.symm l), fun l ↦ ht _, fun z hz V hV hVO hzV t' ht' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hVG : V ⊆ F.G := hVO.trans hOG
  have hle : F.baseOpen V hV ≤ W' := fun y hy ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 (hOW' y.1 (hVO hy))).2
  obtain ⟨W₃, h₃, hzW₃, c, hc⟩ := hg (F.baseOpen V hV) hle (D.evalSec h₀ hwρ hVG ht') ⟨z, hVG hzV⟩
    hzV
  have hW₃V : ∀ z' ∈ img W₃, z' ∈ V := fun z' hz' ↦
    (F.mem_img_baseOpen hVG).1 (img_mono h₃ hz')
  refine ⟨img W₃, hW₃V, (img W₃).isOpen, mem_img_iff.2 ⟨_, hzW₃⟩,
    fun l ↦ holFun (c (e.symm l)), fun l ↦ (differentiableOn_holFun _), ?_⟩
  refine D.evalFun_eq_sum_of_evalVec h₀ (img W₃).isOpen hVG hW₃V hVO ht' (fun l ↦ ht _) hM hw hwρ
    (fun l ↦ differentiableOn_holFun _) fun z' hz' x ↦ ?_
  have := congrArg (fun s : S.val.obj (op W₃) ↦
    holFun (V := W₃) (SheafOfModules.freeEval _ s.1 x) z') hc
  rw [D.holFun_freeEval_modRes h₀ hwρ h₃ _ x hz', D.holFun_freeEval_sum_smul h₀ hwρ _ _ x hz',
    D.holFun_evalSec h₀ hwρ hVG ht' x (hW₃V z' hz')] at this
  rw [this, ← e.sum_comp]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [D.holFun_freeEval_modRes h₀ hwρ _ _ x hz', Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    htv _ z' (hVO (hW₃V z' hz')) x]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.convex_openBox
statement: lemma convex_openBox (a b : Cm.{u} m) : Convex ℝ (Complex.openBox a b)
proof:
:=
  convex_pi fun _ _ ↦ ((convex_Ioo _ _).linear_preimage Complex.reLm).inter
    ((convex_Ioo _ _).linear_preimage Complex.imLm)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.capGenerators_of_capLocallyFinite
statement:
theorem capGenerators_of_capLocallyFinite
    (hloc : ∀ n, ∀ b ∈ F.G, D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) {z₀ : Cm.{u} m} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ F.G) :
    D.CapGenerators h₀ z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεG⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 F.isOpen_G z₀ hz₀
  set δ : ℝ := ε / 4
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  set a : Cm.{u} m := z₀ - fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩
  set b : Cm.{u} m := z₀ + fun _ ↦ ⟨δ, δ⟩
  have hK : Complex.closedBox a b ⊆ F.G := fun x hx ↦ hεG (by
    have := closedBox_subset_closedBall z₀ hδ.le hx
    rw [mem_closedBall] at this
    rw [mem_ball]
    have : δ = ε / 4 := rfl
    linarith)
  have hz₀O : z₀ ∈ Complex.openBox a b := fun j _ ↦ by
    refine Complex.mem_reProdIm.2 ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [a, b] <;> linarith
  have hne : (Complex.closedBox a b).Nonempty :=
    ⟨z₀, fun j _ ↦ ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hz₀O j trivial).1,
      Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hz₀O j trivial).2⟩⟩
  refine ⟨Complex.openBox a b, isOpen_openBox a b, fun x hx ↦ hK fun j _ ↦
    ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hx j trivial).1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hx j trivial).2⟩,
    convex_openBox a b, hz₀O, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwρ⟩ := exists_nodes F.one_lt_ρ ((∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n + 1)
  exact D.exists_isCapGenAt_openBox h₀ hwρ hw (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    (D.isCoherent_evalSubmodule h₀ hwρ (hloc n)) hK hne

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.WeierstrassForm.img_subset_G
statement: lemma img_subset_G (V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens) : (img V : Set (Cn.{u} m)) ⊆ F.G
proof:
:=
  fun x hx ↦ img_le V x hx

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.IsCapEval.congr
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩ := hv b hb
  exact ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t, ht, fun b' hb' x ↦ by rw [htv b' hb' x, h x b' (hBV hb')]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCapEval_zero
statement:
lemma isCapEval_zero (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens} :
    D.IsCapEval h₀ n w (0 : D.EvIdx M → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V))
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  refine ⟨img V, (img V).isOpen, subset_rfl, hb, 0, zero_mem _, fun b' hb' x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Pi.zero_apply, holFun_zero hb']
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hval⟩ := D.exists_evalVec_eq_tube h₀ hwρ (F.img_subset_G V) hb' x
    (hV := (img V).isOpen)
  rw [hval]
  exact evalFun_of_mem _ hy |>.trans (map_zero _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCapEval_add
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩ := hv b hb
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'V, hbB', t', ht', ht'v⟩ := hv' b hb
  have hBB : IsOpen (B ∩ B') := hB.inter hB'
  have h1 : tubeN N (B ∩ B') hBB ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono inter_subset_left
  have h2 : tubeN N (B ∩ B') hBB ≤ tubeN N B' hB' := tubeN_mono inter_subset_right
  have hG : B ∩ B' ⊆ F.G := inter_subset_left.trans (hBV.trans (F.img_subset_G V))
  refine ⟨B ∩ B', hBB, inter_subset_left.trans hBV, ⟨hbB, hbB'⟩,
    D.capRestrict h₀ h1 t + D.capRestrict h₀ h2 t',
    add_mem (D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ h1 (prod_mono inter_subset_left subset_rfl) ht)
      (D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ h2 (prod_mono inter_subset_right subset_rfl) ht'),
    fun b' hb' x ↦ ?_⟩
  have hbV : (splitEquiv m).symm (b', w x.1) ∈ img (tubeN N (B ∩ B') hBB) := by
    rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hb', mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ x.1).2⟩
  change D.evalVec w ((D.capRestrict h₀ h1 t).1.1 + (D.capRestrict h₀ h2 t').1.1) b' x = _
  rw [D.evalVec_add hwρ (hG hb') x hbV, D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hG inter_subset_left _ hb',
    D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hG inter_subset_right _ hb', htv b' hb'.1 x, ht'v b' hb'.2 x,
    Pi.add_apply, holFun_add _ _ (hBV hb'.1)]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCapEval_smul
statement:
lemma isCapEval_smul (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens}
    (r : (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V))
    {v : D.EvIdx M → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V)} (hv : D.IsCapEval h₀ n w v) :
    D.IsCapEval h₀ n w (fun x ↦ r * v x)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩ := hv b hb
  have hG : B ⊆ F.G := hBV.trans (F.img_subset_G V)
  obtain ⟨t', ht', ht'v, -⟩ := D.exists_capPole_sum h₀ hG (s := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ t)
    (fun _ ↦ ht) (e := fun _ ↦ holFun r) fun _ ↦ (differentiableOn_holFun r).mono hBV
  refine ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t', ht', fun b' hb' x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [D.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun h₀ hG hwρ ht'v hb' x, Fin.sum_univ_one, htv b' hb' x,
    holFun_mul _ _ (hBV hb')]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCapEval_map
statement:
lemma isCapEval_map (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {V V' : (space F.baseOpens).Opens}
    (h : V' ≤ V)
    {v : D.EvIdx M → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V)} (hv : D.IsCapEval h₀ n w v) :
    D.IsCapEval h₀ n w (fun x ↦ (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (v x))
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBV, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩ := hv b (img_mono h hb)
  have hBB : IsOpen (B ∩ img V') := hB.inter (img V').isOpen
  have h1 : tubeN N (B ∩ img V') hBB ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono inter_subset_left
  have hG : B ∩ img V' ⊆ F.G := inter_subset_right.trans (F.img_subset_G V')
  refine ⟨B ∩ img V', hBB, inter_subset_right, ⟨hbB, hb⟩, D.capRestrict h₀ h1 t,
    D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ h1 (prod_mono inter_subset_left subset_rfl) ht,
    fun b' hb' x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hG inter_subset_left _ hb', htv b' hb'.1 x,
    holFun_map h _ hb'.2]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_freeEval_map
statement:
lemma holFun_freeEval_map {V V' : (space F.baseOpens).Opens} (f : op V ⟶ op V')
    (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := (space F.baseOpens).ringSheaf) (D.EvIdx M)).val.obj (op V))
    [DecidableEq (D.EvIdx M)] (x : D.EvIdx M) {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ img V') :
    holFun (V := V') (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V')
      ((SheafOfModules.free (D.EvIdx M)).val.map f s) x) b =
      holFun (V := V) (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V) s x) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeEval_naturality]
  exact holFun_map (leOfHom f.unop) _ hb

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sectRes
statement:
lemma val_sectRes {V V' : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (h : V' ≤ V)
    (s : N.toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op V)) :
    (sectRes N.toSheafOfModules h s).1 = sectRes M h s.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sum_smul
statement:
lemma val_sum_smul {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (c : κ → Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) (s : κ → N.toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op V)) :
    (∑ k, c k • s k).1 = ∑ k, c k • (s k).1
proof:
:= by
  change ((∑ k, c k • s k : N.obj (op V)) : M.val.obj (op V)) = _
  rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.SheafOfModules.Submodule.hasLocalModuleRelations
statement:
theorem hasLocalModuleRelations (hM : HasLocalModuleRelations M) :
    HasLocalModuleRelations N.toSheafOfModules
proof:
:= by
  intro V q f x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, k, g, hxW, hg, hgen⟩ := hM V q (fun i ↦ (f i).1) x hx
  refine ⟨W, hWV, k, g, hxW, fun l ↦ Subtype.ext ?_, fun W' hW' a ha ↦ hgen W' hW' a ?_⟩
  · rw [val_sum_smul]
    exact hg l
  · have := congrArg Subtype.val ha
    rw [val_sum_smul] at this
    exact this

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.WeierstrassForm.mem_img_baseOpen
statement:
lemma mem_img_baseOpen {B : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hB : IsOpen B} (hBG : B ⊆ F.G) {b : Cm.{u} m} :
    b ∈ img (F.baseOpen B hB) ↔ b ∈ B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 h).2, fun h ↦ mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hBG h, h⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyb, hval⟩ := D.exists_evalVec_eq_tube h₀ hwρ hVG (hV'V hb) x
  rw [hval, h y hy (hyb ▸ hb), hyb]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hle : tubeN N V hV ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono hVB
  have hbV : (splitEquiv m).symm (b, w x.1) ∈ img (tubeN N V hV) := by
    rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hVG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hV'V hb, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ x.1).2⟩
  rw [← D.evalVec_map hle hwρ (hVG (hV'V hb)) x hbV, hval, evalFun_map W _ _ hy]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.differentiableOn_evalVec_baseOpen
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_evalVec_baseOpen (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {B : Set (Cm.{u} m)}
    {hB : IsOpen B} (hBG : B ⊆ F.G) (a : W.left.presheaf.obj (op (preim h₀ W (tubeN N B hB))))
    (x : D.EvIdx M) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun b ↦ D.evalVec w a b x) (img (F.baseOpen B hB))
proof:
:=
  (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ a x).mono fun b hb ↦ by
    have hbB := (F.mem_img_baseOpen hBG).1 hb
    refine ⟨hBG hbB, ?_⟩
    rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hBG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hbB, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ x.1).2⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_evalSec
proof:
:= by
  change holFun (V := F.baseOpen B hB) (SheafOfModules.freeEval (R := (space F.baseOpens).ringSheaf)
    (op (F.baseOpen B hB)) (SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm (op (F.baseOpen B hB)) _) x) b = _
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeEval_freeEvalSymm]
  exact holFun_ofDifferentiableOn _ ((F.mem_img_baseOpen hBG).2 hb)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_sum
statement:
lemma holFun_sum {V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens} {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (r : κ → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V)) {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ img V) :
    holFun (∑ k, r k) b = ∑ k, holFun (r k) b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [holFun_eq_eval _ hb, map_sum]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_freeEval_modRes
statement:
lemma holFun_freeEval_modRes (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {V V' : (space F.baseOpens).Opens}
    (h : V' ≤ V) (s : (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op V))
    (x : D.EvIdx M) {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ img V') :
    holFun (V := V') (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V') (modRes s V' h).1 x) b =
      holFun (V := V) (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V) s.1 x) b
proof:
:=
  D.holFun_freeEval_map (homOfLE h).op s.1 x hb

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_freeEval_sum_smul
statement:
lemma holFun_freeEval_sum_smul (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {V : (space F.baseOpens).Opens}
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (c : κ → (space F.baseOpens).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (s : κ → (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op V)) (x : D.EvIdx M)
    {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ img V) :
    holFun (V := V) (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V) (∑ k, c k • s k).1 x) b =
      ∑ k, holFun (c k) b * holFun (V := V) (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V) (s k).1 x) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sum_smul, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  erw [holFun_sum _ hb]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  exact (congrArg (fun v ↦ holFun (V := V) (v x) b)
    ((SheafOfModules.freeEval (op V)).map_smul (c k) (s k).1)).trans (holFun_mul _ _ hb)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_evalSubmodule
statement:
theorem isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_evalSubmodule (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) :
    IsLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule (D.evalSubmodule h₀ n hwρ).toSheafOfModules
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBG, hbB, K, s, hs, hgen⟩ := hloc x.1 x.2
  refine ⟨F.baseOpen B hB, K, fun k ↦ D.evalSec h₀ hwρ hBG (hs k), hbB,
    fun W' hW' τ y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have hyW' : y.1 ∈ img W' := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨y.2, hy⟩
  have hτ : D.IsCapEval h₀ n w (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') τ.1) := τ.2
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'W', hyB', t', ht', ht'v⟩ := hτ y.1 hyW'
  have hB'B : B' ⊆ B := fun b hb ↦ (F.mem_img_baseOpen hBG).1 (img_mono hW' (hB'W' hb))
  have hB'G : B' ⊆ F.G := hB'B.trans hBG
  obtain ⟨V', hV'B', hV', hyV', e, he, hrel⟩ := hgen y.1 (hB'B hyB') B' hB' hB'B hyB' t' ht'
  set W'' : (space F.baseOpens).Opens := W' ⊓ F.baseOpen V' hV'
  have hW''V' : ∀ b ∈ img W'', b ∈ V' := fun b hb ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 hb).2.2
  refine ⟨W'', inf_le_left, ⟨hy, hyV'⟩,
    fun k ↦ OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn (e k) ((he k).mono hW''V'), ?_⟩
  refine Subtype.ext (SheafOfModules.freeEval_injective _ (funext fun x ↦ ?_))
  refine eq_of_holFun_eq fun b hb ↦ ?_
  have hbV' := hW''V' b hb
  erw [SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sectRes, SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sum_smul, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, Finset.sum_apply]
  erw [holFun_sum _ hb]
  erw [D.holFun_freeEval_map _ _ x hb]
  refine (ht'v b (hV'B' hbV') x).symm.trans ?_
  rw [D.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun' h₀ hB'G hV'B' hB'B hwρ hrel hbV' x]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  erw [holFun_mul _ _ hb]
  erw [SheafOfModules.Submodule.val_sectRes, D.holFun_freeEval_map _ _ x hb]
  rw [D.holFun_evalSec h₀ hwρ hBG (hs k) x (hB'B (hV'B' hbV')),
    holFun_ofDifferentiableOn _ hb]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isOpen_splitEquiv_preimage
statement:
lemma isOpen_splitEquiv_preimage {Ω : Set (Cm.{u} m × ℂ)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) :
    IsOpen (splitEquiv m ⁻¹' Ω)
proof:
:=
  hΩ.preimage (splitEquiv m).continuous

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.eqOn_of_eqOn_off_zeroSet
statement:
lemma eqOn_of_eqOn_off_zeroSet {Ω : Set (Cm.{u} m × ℂ)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hΩG : ∀ z ∈ Ω, z.1 ∈ G) {f g : Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f Ω)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g Ω) (h : ∀ z ∈ Ω, z.1 ∉ R.zeroSet → f z = g z) : EqOn f g Ω
proof:
:= by
  set S := splitEquiv m ⁻¹' Ω
  have hSG : ∀ x ∈ S, baseOf x ∈ G := fun x hx ↦ hΩG _ hx
  have hc : ∀ {φ : Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn φ Ω → ContinuousOn (φ ∘ splitEquiv m) S :=
    fun hφ ↦ hφ.comp (splitEquiv m).continuous.continuousOn fun _ hx ↦ hx
  have := (R.pullBase hSG).eqOn_of_eqOn_diff (isOpen_splitEquiv_preimage hΩ) subset_rfl
    (hc hf) (hc hg) fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [RegularPairFamily.zeroSet_pullBase] at hx
      exact h _ hx.1 hx.2
  intro z hz
  have h' := this (show (splitEquiv m).symm z ∈ S by simpa [S] using hz)
  simpa using h'

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_extension_off_zeroSet
statement:
lemma exists_extension_off_zeroSet {Ω : Set (Cm.{u} m × ℂ)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hΩG : ∀ z ∈ Ω, z.1 ∈ G) {f : Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f {z | z ∈ Ω ∧ z.1 ∉ R.zeroSet}) :
    ∃ f' : Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f' Ω ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Ω, z.1 ∉ R.zeroSet → f' z = f z
proof:
:= by
  set S := splitEquiv m ⁻¹' Ω
  have hSG : ∀ x ∈ S, baseOf x ∈ G := fun x hx ↦ hΩG _ hx
  obtain ⟨F', hF', hF'f⟩ := (R.pullBase hSG).exists_differentiableOn_eqOn
    (isOpen_splitEquiv_preimage hΩ) subset_rfl (f := f ∘ splitEquiv m)
    (hf.comp Cap.differentiable_splitEquiv.differentiableOn fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [RegularPairFamily.zeroSet_pullBase] at hx
      exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩)
  refine ⟨F' ∘ (splitEquiv m).symm, hF'.comp Cap.differentiable_splitEquiv_symm.differentiableOn
    fun z hz ↦ by simpa [S] using hz, fun z hz hzZ ↦ ?_⟩
  have := hF'f (x := (splitEquiv m).symm z) ⟨by simpa [S] using hz, by
    rw [RegularPairFamily.zeroSet_pullBase]
    simpa [baseOf] using hzZ⟩
  simpa using this

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isOpen_pieceSet_inter
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : 0 < F.ρ := F.pos_ρ
  have hpo := D.isOpen_pieceSet F.isOpen_G (preim h₀ W V) i
  have hne : ∀ y ∈ D.pieceSet (preim h₀ W V) i, y.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h
    have := hy.1.2.1
    rw [h, norm_zero, zero_pow (D.deg i).ne_zero] at this
    exact (inv_pos.2 hρ0).not_gt this
  have hinvc : ContinuousOn invCoord (D.pieceSet (preim h₀ W V) i) :=
    fun y hy ↦ (continuousAt_fst.prodMk (continuousAt_snd.inv₀ (hne y hy))).continuousWithinAt
  exact hinvc.isOpen_inter_preimage hpo
    ((hU.prod isOpen_ball).preimage (Kummer.continuous_powMap _))

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.continuousOn_invCoord_pieceSet
statement:
lemma continuousOn_invCoord_pieceSet {V : (space N).Opens} (i : D.ι) :
    ContinuousOn invCoord (D.pieceSet (preim h₀ W V) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : 0 < F.ρ := F.pos_ρ
  intro y hy
  have hne : y.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := hy.1.2.1
    rw [h, norm_zero, zero_pow (D.deg i).ne_zero] at this
    exact (inv_pos.2 hρ0).not_gt this
  exact (continuousAt_fst.prodMk (continuousAt_snd.inv₀ hne)).continuousWithinAt

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_capPole_extend
statement:
theorem exists_capPole_extend {n : ℕ} {U : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hU : IsOpen U} (hUG : U ⊆ F.G)
    (R : RegularPairFamily F.G) (hU' : IsOpen (U \ R.zeroSet))
    {t : boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU') × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)}
    (ht : t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU') ((U \ R.zeroSet) ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) :
    ∃ t' ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N U hU) (U ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
      (∀ y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU'), evalFun t'.1.1 y = evalFun t.1.1 y) ∧
      ∀ i z, z.1 ∈ U \ R.zeroSet → ‖z.2 ^ (D.deg i : ℕ)‖ < F.ρ → t'.2 i z = t.2 i z
proof:
:= by
  have hD := F.hasThinComplement
  have hle : tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU' ≤ tubeN N U hU := tubeN_mono sdiff_subset
  have hPG : ∀ x ∈ (img (tubeN N U hU) : Set (Cn.{u} (m + 1))), baseOf x ∈ F.G :=
    fun x hx ↦ hUG (mem_img_iff.1 hx).2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (bijective_boundedModule_map (R.pullBase hPG) h₀ W le_rfl hle
    (fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [RegularPairFamily.zeroSet_pullBase] at hx
      obtain ⟨hxN, hxU⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx.1
      exact mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hxN, hxU, hx.2⟩) hD).2 (mkSec h₀ W t.1.1 t.1.2)
  have hav : ∀ y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU'),
      evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) y = evalFun t.1.1 y := by
    intro y hy
    have := congrArg (fun c ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W c) y) ha
    simp only [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hy, secVal_mkSec] at this
    exact this
  
  have hinf : ∀ i, ∃ f' : Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f' (Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' (U ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' (U ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ), z.1 ∉ R.zeroSet → f' z = t.2 i z := by
    intro i
    exact exists_extension_off_zeroSet R (((hU.prod isOpen_ball)).preimage
      (Kummer.continuous_powMap _)) (fun z hz ↦ hUG hz.1)
      ((ht.1 i).mono fun z hz ↦ ⟨⟨hz.1.1, hz.2⟩, hz.1.2⟩)
  choose f' hf' hf'eq using hinf
  refine ⟨(⟨secVal h₀ W a, secVal_mem h₀ W a⟩, f'), ⟨hf', fun i z hz hz' ↦ ?_⟩, hav,
    fun i z hz hzρ ↦ hf'eq i z ⟨hz.1, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hzρ⟩ hz.2⟩
  have hΩ := D.isOpen_pieceSet_inter h₀ hU (V := tubeN N U hU) i
  refine eqOn_of_eqOn_off_zeroSet R hΩ (fun y hy ↦ hUG hy.2.1)
    ((D.differentiableOn_kummerVal F.isOpen_G (secVal h₀ W a) i).continuousOn.mono
      inter_subset_left)
    ((continuous_snd.pow _).continuousOn.mul ((hf' i).continuousOn.comp
      ((D.continuousOn_invCoord_pieceSet h₀ i).mono inter_subset_left) fun y hy ↦ hy.2))
    (fun y hy hyZ ↦ ?_) ⟨hz, hz'⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨hyb, hyO⟩, hy'⟩ := hy
  have hyO' : D.toFun ⟨i, ⟨y, hyb⟩⟩ ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (U \ R.zeroSet) hU') := by
    obtain ⟨hN, -⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hyO)
    refine (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hN, ?_⟩)
    change baseOf (pt W (D.toFun ⟨i, ⟨y, hyb⟩⟩)) ∈ U \ R.zeroSet
    rw [D.pt_toFun]
    simpa [baseOf] using (⟨hy'.1, hyZ⟩ : y.1 ∈ U \ R.zeroSet)
  have hrel := ht.2 i y ⟨hyb, hyO'⟩ ⟨⟨hy'.1, hyZ⟩, hy'.2⟩
  change D.kummerVal (secVal h₀ W a) i y = y.2 ^ (n * D.deg i) * f' i (invCoord y)
  rw [D.kummerVal_of_mem _ _ hyb, hav _ hyO', ← D.kummerVal_of_mem _ _ hyb, hrel,
    hf'eq i (invCoord y) hy' hyZ]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_evalVec_eq_tube
statement:
lemma exists_evalVec_eq_tube {M : ℕ} {w : Fin M → ℂ} (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    {V : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hV : IsOpen V} (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ V)
    (x : Fin M × (Σ i, Fin (D.deg i))) :
    ∃ y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N V hV), baseOf (pt W y) = b ∧
      ∀ a : W.left.presheaf.obj (op (preim h₀ W (tubeN N V hV))),
        D.evalVec w a b x = evalFun a y
proof:
:= by
  have hbV : (splitEquiv m).symm (b, w x.1) ∈ img (tubeN N V hV) := by
    rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hVG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hb, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ x.1).2⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hpt, h⟩ := D.exists_evalVec_eq (h₀ := h₀) hwρ (hVG hb) x hbV
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_, fun a ↦ by rw [h, evalFun_of_mem _ hy]⟩
  rw [hpt]
  simp [baseOf]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_capPole_sum
statement:
theorem exists_capPole_sum {n : ℕ} {V : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hV : IsOpen V} (hVG : V ⊆ F.G)
    {K : ℕ} {s : Fin K → boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N V hV) × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)}
    (hs : ∀ k, s k ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V hV) (V ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ))
    {e : Fin K → Cm.{u} m → ℂ} (he : ∀ k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (e k) V) :
    ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V hV) (V ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
      (∀ y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N V hV),
        evalFun t.1.1 y = ∑ k, e k (baseOf (pt W y)) * evalFun (s k).1.1 y) ∧
      ∀ i x, t.2 i x = ∑ k, e k x.1 * (s k).2 i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose c hc hce hc2 using fun k ↦ D.exists_const_mem_capSubring (h₀ := h₀)
    (V := tubeN N V hV) (U := V) (F.mem_img_tubeN hVG) (he k)
  refine ⟨∑ k, c k * s k, AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦
    D.mul_mem_capPole_of_mem_capSubring (hc k) (hs k), fun y hy ↦ ?_, fun i x ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hsum : (∑ k, c k * s k).1.1 = ∑ k, (c k).1.1 * (s k).1.1 := by
      simp only [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.fst_mul, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
        MulMemClass.coe_mul]
    rw [hsum, evalFun_of_mem _ hy, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hy, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hy, hce k y hy]
  · simp only [Prod.snd_sum, Prod.snd_mul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hc2]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.capPole_ext
statement:
theorem capPole_ext {n : ℕ} {V : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hV : IsOpen V} (hVG : V ⊆ F.G)
    {t t' : boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N V hV) × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)}
    (ht : t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V hV) (V ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ))
    (ht' : t' ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V hV) (V ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : (∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n < M) {w : Fin M → ℂ} (hw : Function.Injective w)
    (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) (h : ∀ b ∈ V, D.evalVec w t.1.1 b = D.evalVec w t'.1.1 b) :
    t.1 = t'.1 ∧ ∀ i, EqOn (t.2 i) (t'.2 i) (Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' (V ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := D.eq_zero_of_forall_evalVec_eq_zero F.hasThinComplement
    F.annulusRegion_subset F.one_lt_ρ hVG (F.mem_img_tubeN hVG) hM hw hwρ (sub_mem ht ht')
    fun b hb ↦ funext fun x ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, hyO, -, hy⟩ := D.exists_evalVec_eq_tube h₀ hwρ hVG hb x
      have := congrFun (h b hb) x
      rw [hy, hy] at this
      rw [hy]
      change evalFun (t.1.1 - t'.1.1) y = 0
      rw [evalFun_of_mem _ hyO, map_sub, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hyO, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hyO, this,
        sub_self]
  refine ⟨sub_eq_zero.1 h1, fun i z hz ↦ sub_eq_zero.1 (h2 i hz)⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.evalVec_capRestrict
statement:
lemma evalVec_capRestrict {M : ℕ} {w : Fin M → ℂ} (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    {V V' : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hV : IsOpen V} {hV' : IsOpen V'} (hV'G : V' ⊆ F.G) (h : V' ⊆ V)
    (t : boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N V hV) × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)) {b : Cm.{u} m}
    (hb : b ∈ V') :
    D.evalVec w (D.capRestrict h₀ (tubeN_mono (hV := hV) (hV' := hV') h) t).1.1 b =
      D.evalVec w t.1.1 b
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  refine D.evalVec_map (tubeN_mono h) hwρ (hV'G hb) x ?_ t.1.1
  rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hV'G, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
  exact ⟨hb, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ x.1).2⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_capPole_of_locally
statement:
theorem exists_capPole_of_locally {n : ℕ} {U : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hU : IsOpen U} (hUG : U ⊆ F.G)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : (∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n < M) {w : Fin M → ℂ} (hw : Function.Injective w)
    (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ) {v : Fin M × (Σ i, Fin (D.deg i)) → Cm.{u} m → ℂ}
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ U, ∃ (B : Set (Cm.{u} m)) (hB : IsOpen B), B ⊆ U ∧ b ∈ B ∧
      ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N B hB) (B ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
        ∀ b' ∈ B, ∀ x, D.evalVec w t.1.1 b' x = v x b') :
    ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N U hU) (U ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
      ∀ b ∈ U, ∀ x, D.evalVec w t.1.1 b x = v x b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose B hB hBU hbB t ht htv using fun p : U ↦ hloc p.1 p.2
  have hBG : ∀ p, B p ⊆ F.G := fun p ↦ (hBU p).trans hUG
  
  have hagree : ∀ p q : U, (∀ y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (B p ∩ B q) ((hB p).inter (hB q))),
      evalFun (t p).1.1 y = evalFun (t q).1.1 y) ∧ ∀ i, EqOn ((t p).2 i) ((t q).2 i)
        (Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' ((B p ∩ B q) ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) := by
    intro p q
    have hpq : B p ∩ B q ⊆ F.G := inter_subset_left.trans (hBG p)
    have hp := D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ (tubeN_mono (hV := hB p)
      (hV' := (hB p).inter (hB q)) inter_subset_left)
      (prod_mono (inter_subset_left : B p ∩ B q ⊆ B p) subset_rfl) (ht p)
    have hq := D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ (tubeN_mono (hV := hB q)
      (hV' := (hB p).inter (hB q)) inter_subset_right)
      (prod_mono (inter_subset_right : B p ∩ B q ⊆ B q) subset_rfl) (ht q)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := D.capPole_ext h₀ hpq hp hq hM hw hwρ fun b hb ↦ by
      rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hpq inter_subset_left _ hb,
        D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hpq inter_subset_right _ hb]
      funext x
      rw [htv p b hb.1, htv q b hb.2]
    refine ⟨fun y hy ↦ ?_, fun i z hz ↦ h2 i hz⟩
    have := congrArg (fun a : boundedSubring h₀ W _ ↦ evalFun a.1 y) h1
    simp only [capRestrict] at this
    rwa [evalFun_map W _ _ hy, evalFun_map W _ _ hy] at this
  
  set O : U → (space N).Opens := fun p ↦ tubeN N (B p) (hB p)
  have hOU : ∀ p, O p ≤ tubeN N U hU := fun p ↦ tubeN_mono (hBU p)
  have hcov : tubeN N U hU ≤ iSup O := fun y hy ↦
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨baseOf y.1, hy⟩, hbB ⟨baseOf y.1, hy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, -⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modRes_existsUnique_gluing
    (boundedModule h₀ W) O hcov hOU (fun p ↦ mkSec h₀ W (t p).1.1 (t p).1.2) fun p q ↦ by
      refine secVal_ext h₀ W fun y hy ↦ ?_
      have hy' : y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (B p ∩ B q) ((hB p).inter (hB q))) := by
        rw [mem_preim_iff] at hy ⊢
        obtain ⟨hyN, hyV⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hy
        exact mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hyN, hyV.1, hyV.2⟩
      change evalFun (secVal h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) _ _)) y =
        evalFun (secVal h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) _ _)) y
      rw [secVal_map, secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hy, evalFun_map W _ _ hy, secVal_mkSec,
        secVal_mkSec]
      exact (hagree p q).1 y hy'
  have ha₀val : ∀ p : U, ∀ y ∈ preim h₀ W (O p), evalFun (secVal h₀ W a₀) y =
      evalFun (t p).1.1 y := by
    intro p y hy
    have := congrArg (fun a ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) y) (ha₀ p)
    rw [show modRes a₀ (O p) (hOU p) = sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (hOU p) a₀ from rfl,
      secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hy, secVal_mkSec] at this
    exact this
  
  set f : D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ := fun i z ↦
    if hz : z.1 ∈ U then (t ⟨z.1, hz⟩).2 i z else 0
  have hf : ∀ i (p : U) z, z.1 ∈ B p → ‖z.2 ^ (D.deg i : ℕ)‖ < F.ρ → f i z = (t p).2 i z := by
    intro i p z hzp hzρ
    have hzU : z.1 ∈ U := hBU p hzp
    simp only [f, dif_pos hzU]
    exact (hagree ⟨z.1, hzU⟩ p).2 i ⟨⟨hbB ⟨z.1, hzU⟩, hzp⟩, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hzρ⟩
  refine ⟨(⟨secVal h₀ W a₀, secVal_mem h₀ W a₀⟩, f), ⟨fun i z hz ↦ ?_, fun i z hz hz' ↦ ?_⟩,
    fun b hb x ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hzU : z.1 ∈ U := hz.1
    set p : U := ⟨z.1, hzU⟩
    have hopen : IsOpen (Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' (B p ×ˢ ball (0 : ℂ) F.ρ)) :=
      ((hB p).prod isOpen_ball).preimage (Kummer.continuous_powMap _)
    have hzB : z ∈ Kummer.powMap (D.deg i) ⁻¹' (B p ×ˢ ball (0 : ℂ) F.ρ) := ⟨hbB p, hz.2⟩
    refine (((ht p).1 i).differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hzB)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      ?_ |>.differentiableWithinAt
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hzB] with z' hz'
    exact hf i p z' hz'.1 (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz'.2)
  · 
    have hzU : z.1 ∈ U := hz'.1
    set p : U := ⟨z.1, hzU⟩
    obtain ⟨hzb, hzO⟩ := hz
    have hzOp : D.toFun ⟨i, ⟨z, hzb⟩⟩ ∈ preim h₀ W (O p) := by
      obtain ⟨hN, -⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hzO)
      refine (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hN, ?_⟩)
      change baseOf (pt W (D.toFun ⟨i, ⟨z, hzb⟩⟩)) ∈ B p
      rw [D.pt_toFun]
      simpa [baseOf] using hbB p
    have hzpiece : z ∈ D.pieceSet (preim h₀ W (O p)) i := ⟨hzb, hzOp⟩
    have hrel := (ht p).2 i z hzpiece ⟨hbB p, hz'.2⟩
    change D.kummerVal (secVal h₀ W a₀) i z = z.2 ^ (n * D.deg i) * f i (invCoord z)
    rw [D.kummerVal_of_mem _ _ hzb, ha₀val p _ hzOp, ← D.kummerVal_of_mem _ _ hzb, hrel,
      hf i p (invCoord z) (hbB p) (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz'.2)]
  · 
    set p : U := ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hres : D.capRestrict h₀ (hOU p) (⟨secVal h₀ W a₀, secVal_mem h₀ W a₀⟩, f) =
        (⟨(t p).1.1, (t p).1.2⟩, f) := by
      refine Prod.ext (Subtype.ext ?_) rfl
      have := congrArg (secVal h₀ W) (ha₀ p)
      exact this
    have := D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ (hBG p) (hBU p) (hV := hU) (hV' := hB p)
      (⟨secVal h₀ W a₀, secVal_mem h₀ W a₀⟩, f) (hbB p)
    rw [hres] at this
    change D.evalVec w (secVal h₀ W a₀) b x = v x b
    rw [← this]
    exact htv p b (hbB p) x

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.evalFun_sum_smul
statement:
lemma evalFun_sum_smul {V : (space N).Opens} {L : ℕ} (c : Fin L → (space N).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (a : Fin L → (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) {w : W.left} (hw : w ∈ preim h₀ W V) :
    evalFun (secVal h₀ W (∑ l, c l • a l)) w =
      ∑ l, holFun (c l) (pt W w) * evalFun (secVal h₀ W (a l)) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [secVal_sum, evalFun_of_mem _ hw, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [secVal_smul, map_mul, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hw, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hw,
    evalFun_pullback h₀ W _ hw]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.holFun_trace_mulSec
statement:
lemma holFun_trace_mulSec {V : (space N).Opens} (a b : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V))
    {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x ∈ img V) (hxN : x ∈ N₀) :
    holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W a b)) x = ∑ w ∈ fiberFinset W x,
      evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) w * evalFun (secVal h₀ W b) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [holFun_trace _ _ _ _ hx hxN, traceFun]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
  have hw' : w ∈ preim h₀ W V := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 ((mem_fiberFinset W).1 hw ▸ hx)
  rw [secVal_mulSec, evalFun_mul W _ _ hw']

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.eq_zero_of_trace_eq_zero_of_generatesNear
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_trace_eq_zero_of_generatesNear {U : (space N).Opens}
    (hU : IsPreconnected (img U : Set (Cn.{u} n))) {k : ℕ}
    (t : Fin k → (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op U)) {y₀ : space N} (hy₀ : y₀.1 ∈ N₀)
    (hgen : GeneratesNear h₀ W t y₀) {V : (space N).Opens} (hV : V ≤ U)
    (a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V))
    (ha : ∀ j, trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W a (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV (t j))) = 0) :
    a = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V', hV'U, hy₀V', hspan⟩ := hgen
  set F₀ := fiberFinset W y₀.1
  have hy₀U : y₀.1 ∈ img U := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨y₀.2, hV'U hy₀V'⟩
  
  set A : Matrix F₀ (Fin k) ℂ := Matrix.of fun w i ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W (t i)) w.1
  have hind : ∀ w : F₀, ∃ c : Fin k → ℂ, ∀ w' : F₀,
      (if w' = w then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = ∑ i, A w' i * c i := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨B, hBo, hwB, hBN, hind⟩ := exists_indicator W w.1
    have hptw : pt W w.1 = y₀.1 := (mem_fiberFinset W).1 w.2
    let VB : (space N).Opens := ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' B, hBo.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
    let V₁ : (space N).Opens := V' ⊓ VB
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hind (preim h₀ W V₁) fun w' hw' ↦ by
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw')
      exact h.2
    have hbmem : b ∈ boundedSubring h₀ W V₁ := by
      rw [boundedSubring_eq_top h₀ W fun z (hz : z ∈ V₁) ↦ hBN _ hz.2]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨V'', hV''V₁, hy₀V'', f, hf⟩ := hspan V₁ inf_le_left (mkSec h₀ W b hbmem) y₀
      ⟨hy₀V', show y₀.1 ∈ B from hptw ▸ hwB⟩
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ holFun (f i) y₀.1, fun w' ↦ ?_⟩
    have hptw' : pt W w'.1 = y₀.1 := (mem_fiberFinset W).1 w'.2
    have hw'V'' : w'.1 ∈ preim h₀ W V'' :=
      (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (hptw' ▸ mem_img_iff.2 ⟨y₀.2, hy₀V''⟩)
    have h1 := congrArg (fun c ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W c) w'.1) hf
    rw [evalFun_sum_smul h₀ W _ _ hw'V'', secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hw'V'', secVal_mkSec,
      hb w'.1 (preim_mono h₀ W hV''V₁ hw'V'') (hptw'.trans hptw.symm)] at h1
    rw [show (if w' = w then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if w'.1 = w.1 then 1 else 0 from
      if_congr Subtype.ext_iff rfl rfl, h1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hw'V'', hptw', mul_comm]
    rfl
  choose c hc using hind
  have hAC : A * Matrix.of (fun i w ↦ c w i) = 1 := by
    ext w' w
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hc w w']
    rfl
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Matrix.exists_isUnit_det_submatrix_of_mul_eq_one hAC
  
  set δ : Cn.{u} n → ℂ := fun y ↦ (Matrix.of fun p q : F₀ ↦
    holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (t (σ p)) (t (σ q)))) y).det
  have hδd : DifferentiableOn ℂ δ (img U) :=
    ComplexAnalytic.Cap.differentiableOn_det fun p q ↦ differentiableOn_holFun _
  have hδ₀ : δ y₀.1 ≠ 0 := by
    have hG : (Matrix.of fun p q : F₀ ↦
        holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (t (σ p)) (t (σ q)))) y₀.1) =
          (A.submatrix id σ)ᵀ * A.submatrix id σ := by
      ext p q
      rw [Matrix.of_apply, holFun_trace_mulSec h₀ W hD _ _ hy₀U hy₀, Matrix.mul_apply,
        ← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      rfl
    change (Matrix.of fun p q : F₀ ↦
      holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (t (σ p)) (t (σ q)))) y₀.1).det ≠ 0
    rw [hG, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact mul_ne_zero (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.1 hσ) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.1 hσ)
  have hint : interior ((img U : Set (Cn.{u} n)) ∩ δ ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ := by
    refine eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun y hy ↦ hδ₀ ?_
    have hyU := (interior_subset hy).1
    have h0 : δ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := Filter.mem_of_superset (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hy)
      fun z hz ↦ (interior_subset hz).2
    have hA : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ δ (img U) := fun z hz ↦
      analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_of_finiteDimensional (img U).isOpen hδd hz
    have hEq := hA.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hU hyU h0
    exact hEq hy₀U
  
  have hvan : ∀ w (hw : w ∈ preim h₀ W V), δ (pt W w) ≠ 0 → evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hδw
    set y := pt W w
    have hyV : y ∈ img V := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw
    have hyN : y ∈ N₀ := pt_mem W w
    set Fy := fiberFinset W y
    have hcard : Fintype.card Fy = Fintype.card F₀ := by
      rw [Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_coe]
      exact card_fiberFinset_eq W hD (img U).isOpen hU (img_le U) (img_mono hV hyV) hyN hy₀U hy₀
    set e : Fy ≃ F₀ := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard
    set T : Matrix F₀ F₀ ℂ := Matrix.of fun p q ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W (t (σ q))) (e.symm p).1
    have hG : (Matrix.of fun p q : F₀ ↦
        holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (t (σ p)) (t (σ q)))) y) = Tᵀ * T := by
      ext p q
      rw [Matrix.of_apply, holFun_trace_mulSec h₀ W hD _ _ (img_mono hV hyV) hyN,
        Matrix.mul_apply, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      exact (Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ fun w ↦ by simp [T]).trans rfl
    have hT : T.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hδw
      change (Matrix.of fun p q : F₀ ↦
        holFun (trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (t (σ p)) (t (σ q)))) y).det = 0
      rw [hG, Matrix.det_mul, h0, mul_zero]
    have hα : (fun p : F₀ ↦ evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) (e.symm p).1) ᵥ* T = 0 := by
      funext q
      have := ha (σ q)
      have h2 := holFun_trace_mulSec h₀ W hD a (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV (t (σ q))) hyV hyN
      rw [this, holFun_zero hyV] at h2
      rw [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply, h2, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort Fy]
      refine Fintype.sum_equiv e.symm _ _ fun p ↦ ?_
      have hw' : (e.symm p).1 ∈ preim h₀ W V :=
        (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 ((mem_fiberFinset W).1 (e.symm p).2 ▸ hyV)
      simp only [T, Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hw']
    have := congrFun (Matrix.eq_zero_of_vecMul_eq_zero hT hα) (e ⟨w, (mem_fiberFinset W).2 rfl⟩)
    simpa using this
  
  refine secVal_injective h₀ W (eq_of_forall_eval_eq (isLocallyOpenInAffine_left W)
    fun w hw ↦ ?_)
  rw [secVal_zero, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨O, hwO, -, hsheet⟩ := exists_sheet W w
  obtain ⟨F, hFd, hF⟩ := hsheet (O' := O ⊓ preim h₀ W V) inf_le_left
    (W.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (secVal h₀ W a))
  set G : Set (Cn.{u} n) := pt W '' ((O ⊓ preim h₀ W V : W.left.Opens) : Set W.left)
  have hFc : ContinuousOn F G := by
    rintro _ ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩
    exact (hFd w' hw').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have h0 := EqOn.of_eqOn_diff_of_interior_eq_empty (isOpen_image_pt W _) hint hFc
    (continuousOn_const (c := 0)) (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ⟨w, ⟨hwO, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  · have := hF w ⟨hwO, hw⟩
    rw [eval_presheaf_map] at this
    exact this.trans h0
  · obtain ⟨⟨w', hw', rfl⟩, hxZ⟩ := hx
    have hδw' : δ (pt W w') ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hxZ
      ⟨(image_pt_subset h₀ W O |>.trans (img_mono hV)) ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩, h⟩
    rw [← hF w' hw', eval_presheaf_map, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hw'.2]
    exact hvan w' hw'.2 hδw'

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.exists_cumFamily_eq
proof:
:= by
  set p := (Fintype.equivFin (Σ i : Fin (j + 1), Fin (k i))).symm c
  refine ⟨Fintype.equivFin (Σ i : Fin (j' + 1), Fin (k i))
    ⟨Fin.castLE (by omega) p.1, p.2⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold cumFamily
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.exists_cumFamily_eq_last
statement:
lemma exists_cumFamily_eq_last {M : Type*} {k : ℕ → ℕ} (σ : ∀ j, Fin (k j) → M) (j : ℕ)
    (l : Fin (k j)) : ∃ c, cumFamily σ j c = σ j l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Fintype.equivFin (Σ i : Fin (j + 1), Fin (k i)) ⟨Fin.last j, l⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold cumFamily
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.exists_generatesNear_of_chain
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set t := σ j₀
  set r : ℕ → ℕ := fun j ↦ Fintype.card (Σ i : Fin (j + 1), Fin (k i))
  
  set col : ∀ j, Fin (r j) → Fin (k j₀) → OkaRing (img U) :=
    fun j c ↦ tauVec h₀ W hD t le_rfl (cumFamily σ j c)
  set A : ∀ j, Matrix (Fin (k j₀)) (Fin (r j)) (OkaRing (img U)) :=
    fun j ↦ Matrix.of fun a c ↦ col j c a
  set Nj : ℕ → Cn.{u} n → Submodule (LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
      (Fin (k j₀) → LocalOkaRing (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) :=
    fun j y ↦ if hy : y ∈ img U then germSpan (col j) hy else ⊥
  have hNA : ∀ j y (hy : y ∈ img U), Nj j y = Submodule.span _
      (range fun c ↦ germVec hy fun a ↦ A j a c) := fun j y hy ↦ by
    simp only [Nj, dif_pos hy, germSpan, A, Matrix.of_apply]
  have hmono : Monotone Nj := by
    intro j j' hjj' y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ img U
    · simp only [Nj, dif_pos hy, germSpan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := exists_cumFamily_eq σ hjj' c
      refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨c', ?_⟩
      simp only [col, hc']
    · simp only [Nj, dif_neg hy, le_refl]
  have hxU : x.1 ∈ img U := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, j₁, hj₁⟩ := OkaRing.exists_forall_ge_eq_of_monotone hxU Nj hmono A hNA
  
  set U' : (space N).Opens := ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (V : Set (Cn.{u} n)),
    V.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hU'U : U' ≤ U := fun y hy ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 (hVU hy)).2
  refine ⟨U', hU'U, hxV, r j₁, fun c ↦ sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hU'U (cumFamily σ j₁ c),
    fun y hy hyZ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j₂, hj₂⟩ := hgen y (hU'U hy) hyZ
  obtain ⟨Vy, hVyU, hyVy, hspan⟩ := hj₂ (max j₁ j₂) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨Vy ⊓ U', inf_le_right, ⟨hyVy, hy⟩, fun V'' hV'' b z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, hzW₁', f, hf⟩ := hspan V'' (hV''.trans inf_le_left) b z hz
  have hW₁U : W₁ ≤ U := hW₁.trans (hV''.trans (inf_le_left.trans hVyU))
  have hzW₁ : z.1 ∈ img W₁ := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨z.2, hzW₁'⟩
  have hzV : z.1 ∈ V := (hV''.trans inf_le_right) hz
  
  have hmem : germVec hzW₁ (tauVec h₀ W hD t hW₁U (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hW₁ b)) ∈
      Nj j₁ z.1 := by
    rw [← hj₁ (max j₁ j₂) (le_max_left _ _) z.1 hzV, hf, tauVec_sum_smul, germVec_sum]
    simp only [Nj, dif_pos (img_mono hW₁U hzW₁)]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ ↦ ?_
    rw [germVec_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_cumFamily_eq_last σ (max j₁ j₂) l
    rw [tauVec_res h₀ W hD t le_rfl, germVec_resVec, ← hc]
    exact germVec_mem_germSpan _ _ c
  simp only [Nj, dif_pos (img_mono hW₁U hzW₁)] at hmem
  rw [← germSpan_resVec (img_mono hW₁U) (col j₁) hzW₁] at hmem
  obtain ⟨O₂, hO₂, hzO₂, e, he⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hzW₁ hmem
  set W₂ : (space N).Opens := W₁ ⊓ ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (O₂ : Set (Cn.{u} n)),
    O₂.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hW₂O₂ : img W₂ ≤ O₂ := fun p hp ↦ by
    obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hp
    exact h.2
  refine ⟨W₂, inf_le_left.trans hW₁, ⟨hzW₁', hzO₂⟩, fun c ↦ ofOka (restrict hW₂O₂ (e c)), ?_⟩
  
  have hW₂W₁ : W₂ ≤ W₁ := inf_le_left
  have hW₂U : W₂ ≤ U := hW₂W₁.trans hW₁U
  refine sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_trace_eq_zero_of_generatesNear h₀ W hD hU t hy₀ hsep hW₂U _
    fun a ↦ ?_)
  have key : tauVec h₀ W hD t hW₂U (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (hW₂W₁.trans hW₁) b) =
      tauVec h₀ W hD t hW₂U (∑ c, ofOka (restrict hW₂O₂ (e c)) • sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W)
        ((hW₂W₁.trans hW₁).trans (hV''.trans inf_le_right))
          (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hU'U (cumFamily σ j₁ c))) := by
    rw [← sectRes_sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hW₂W₁ hW₁,
      tauVec_res h₀ W hD t hW₁U hW₂W₁, tauVec_sum_smul]
    funext i
    have := congrArg (fun w ↦ restrict hW₂O₂ (w i)) he
    simp only [resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_sum, map_mul,
      restrict_restrict] at this
    simp only [sectRes_sectRes, tauVec_res h₀ W hD t le_rfl, resVec, Finset.sum_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, this]
    rfl
  have := congrFun key a
  simp only [tauVec] at this
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, mulSec_add, trace_add, this, ← trace_add, ← mulSec_add, add_neg_cancel,
    mulSec_zero_left, trace_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModuleAt_of
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, k, s, hzW, hgen⟩ := hM
  set W₀ : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace := W ⊓ C.img ⊤
  have hW₀e : C.img (C.pre W₀) = W₀ := C.img_pre inf_le_right
  have hW₀W : C.img (C.pre W₀) ≤ W := hW₀e.le.trans inf_le_left
  refine ⟨C.pre W₀, k, fun l ↦ C.φ (C.pre W₀) (sectRes M hW₀W (s l)),
    ⟨hzW, (C.mem_img z ⊤).2 trivial⟩, fun O₁ hO₁ t y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have h₁ : C.img O₁ ≤ W := (C.img_mono hO₁).trans hW₀W
  obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c, hc⟩ := hgen (C.img O₁) h₁ (C.φInv O₁ t) (C.g y)
    ((C.mem_img y O₁).2 hy)
  have hW''r : W'' ≤ C.img ⊤ := hW''.trans (C.img_mono le_top)
  have hW''e : C.img (C.pre W'') = W'' := C.img_pre hW''r
  have hpre : C.pre W'' ≤ O₁ := C.pre_le_of_le_img hW''
  refine ⟨C.pre W'', hpre, hyW'', fun l ↦ C.ψ (C.pre W'') (Y.res hW''e.le (c l)), ?_⟩
  have e₁ : sectRes K hpre t = C.φ (C.pre W'') (sectRes M (C.img_mono hpre) (C.φInv O₁ t)) := by
    rw [C.φ_res hpre, φ_φInv]
  rw [e₁]
  have e₂ : sectRes M (C.img_mono hpre) (C.φInv O₁ t) =
      sectRes M hW''e.le (sectRes M hW'' (C.φInv O₁ t)) := by
    rw [sectRes_sectRes]
  rw [e₂, hc, sectRes_sum, C.φ_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [sectRes_smul, C.φ_smul, sectRes_sectRes]
  beta_reduce
  congr 1
  exact C.φ_sectRes_sectRes _ (hpre.trans hO₁) hW₀W _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.hasLocalModuleRelationsAt_of
statement:
theorem hasLocalModuleRelationsAt_of {z : Z} (hM : HasLocalModuleRelationsAt M (C.g z)) :
    HasLocalModuleRelationsAt K z
proof:
:= by
  intro V m f hzV
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, k, g, hzW, hrel, hcompl⟩ :=
    hM (C.img V) m (fun i ↦ C.φInv V (f i)) ((C.mem_img z V).2 hzV)
  have hWr : W ≤ C.img ⊤ := hWV.trans (C.img_mono le_top)
  have hWe : C.img (C.pre W) = W := C.img_pre hWr
  have hpreV : C.pre W ≤ V := C.pre_le_of_le_img hWV
  refine ⟨C.pre W, hpreV, k, fun l i ↦ C.ψ (C.pre W) (Y.res hWe.le (g l i)), hzW,
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W' hW' a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun s ↦ C.φ (C.pre W) (sectRes M hWe.le s)) (hrel l)
    simp only [sectRes_sum, sectRes_smul, C.φ_sum, sectRes_zero, map_zero] at this
    rw [← this]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [C.φ_smul, sectRes_sectRes, C.φ_res hpreV, φ_φInv]
  · 
    have hW'e : C.img W' ≤ W := (C.img_mono hW').trans hWe.le
    let a' : Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op (C.img W')) := fun i ↦ C.ψInv W' (a i)
    have ha' : ∑ i, a' i • sectRes M (hW'e.trans hWV) (C.φInv V (f i)) = 0 := by
      refine C.φ_injective W' ?_
      rw [C.φ_sum, map_zero, ← ha]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [C.φ_smul, ψ_ψInv, C.φ_res (hW'.trans hpreV), φ_φInv]
    obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c, hc⟩ := hcompl (C.img W') hW'e a' ha' (C.g y)
      ((C.mem_img y W').2 hy)
    have hW''r : W'' ≤ C.img ⊤ := hW''.trans (C.img_mono le_top)
    have hW''e : C.img (C.pre W'') = W'' := C.img_pre hW''r
    have hpre : C.pre W'' ≤ W' := C.pre_le_of_le_img hW''
    refine ⟨C.pre W'', hpre, hyW'', fun l ↦ C.ψ (C.pre W'') (Y.res hW''e.le (c l)),
      fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun r ↦ C.ψ (C.pre W'') (Y.res hW''e.le r)) (hc i)
    simp only [res_sum, map_sum] at this
    have e₁ : Z.res hpre (a i) = C.ψ (C.pre W'') (Y.res (C.img_mono hpre) (a' i)) := by
      rw [C.ψ_res hpre, ψ_ψInv]
    rw [e₁, ← Y.res_res hW''e.le hW'', this]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    rw [res_mul, map_mul, Y.res_res, C.ψ_res_res _ (hpre.trans hW') hWe.le]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.evalFun_secVal_sectRes_capSec
statement:
lemma evalFun_secVal_sectRes_capSec {V V' : (space N).Opens} (h : V' ≤ V)
    (t : boundedSubring h₀ W V × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)) {y : W.left}
    (hy : y ∈ preim h₀ W V') :
    evalFun (secVal h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) h (D.capSec h₀ t))) y =
      evalFun t.1.1 y
proof:
:= by
  rw [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hy, secVal_mkSec]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.generatesNear_of_combination
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V₁, hV₁B, hyV₁, hgen⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨V₁ ⊓ tubeN N V' hV', fun z hz ↦ hV'O hz.2, ⟨hyV₁, hyV'⟩,
    fun V₃ h₃ a z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W₄, h₄, hzW₄, f, hf⟩ := hgen V₃ (h₃.trans inf_le_left) a z hz
  have hW₄V' : ∀ x ∈ img W₄, baseOf x ∈ V' := fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨hxN, hx4⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
    exact (h₃ (h₄ hx4)).2
  have hd : ∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun x ↦ ∑ k, holFun (f k) x * e k l (baseOf x)) (img W₄) := fun l ↦
    DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun k _ ↦ (differentiableOn_holFun (f k)).mul
      ((he k l).comp differentiable_baseOf.differentiableOn fun x hx ↦ hW₄V' x hx)
  refine ⟨W₄, h₄, hzW₄, fun l ↦ OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn _ (hd l), ?_⟩
  refine secVal_ext h₀ W fun w hw ↦ ?_
  have hwimg : pt W w ∈ img W₄ := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw
  have hwB : w ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N B hB) :=
    preim_mono h₀ W (h₄.trans ((h₃.trans inf_le_left).trans hV₁B)) hw
  rw [hf, evalFun_sum_smul h₀ W _ _ hw, evalFun_sum_smul h₀ W _ _ hw]
  simp_rw [evalFun_secVal_sectRes_capSec h₀ D _ _ hw, holFun_ofDifferentiableOn _ hwimg,
    hse _ w hwB (hW₄V' _ hwimg), Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ by ring

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_mem_sdiff_zeroSet
statement:
lemma exists_mem_sdiff_zeroSet (R : RegularPairFamily F.G) {O : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hOG : O ⊆ F.G) {z₀ : Cm.{u} m} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ O) : ∃ b ∈ O, b ∉ R.zeroSet
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have := R.eqOn_of_eqOn_diff hO hOG (F₁ := fun _ ↦ (0 : ℂ)) (F₂ := fun _ ↦ 1)
    continuousOn_const continuousOn_const (fun b hb ↦ absurd (h b hb.1) hb.2) hz₀
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isCoherentAt_of_capGenerators
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hOG, hOc, hxO, hσ⟩ := hx
  choose L σ hσmem hσgen using hσ
  
  have hgen : ∀ y ∈ tubeN N O hO, y.1 ∉ baseOf ⁻¹' R.zeroSet → ∃ j₁, ∀ j, j₁ ≤ j →
      GeneratesNear h₀ W (fun l ↦ D.capSec h₀ (σ j l)) y := by
    intro y hyU hyZ
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hBG, hyB, n₀, hs⟩ := hRT y hyZ
    refine ⟨n₀, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨K, s, hsmem, hsgen⟩ := hs j hj
    have hBO : IsOpen (B ∩ O) := hB.inter hO
    have hle : tubeN N (B ∩ O) hBO ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono inter_subset_left
    choose V' hV'sub hV'o hbV' e he hrel using fun k ↦
      hσgen j (baseOf y.1) hyU (B ∩ O) hBO inter_subset_right ⟨hyB, hyU⟩
        (D.capRestrict h₀ hle (s k))
        (D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono inter_subset_left subset_rfl) (hsmem k))
    set V'' : Set (Cm.{u} m) := (⋂ k, V' k) ∩ (B ∩ O)
    have hV''o : IsOpen V'' := (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hV'o).inter hBO
    refine D.generatesNear_of_combination h₀ hV''o (inter_subset_right.trans inter_subset_right)
      ⟨mem_iInter.2 hbV', hyB, hyU⟩ hsgen (σ j) (e := e)
      (fun k l ↦ (he k l).mono fun b hb ↦ mem_iInter.1 hb.1 k) fun k w hw hwV ↦ ?_
    have hw' : w ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N (B ∩ O) hBO) := by
      obtain ⟨hwN, -⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw)
      exact (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hwN, hwV.2⟩)
    have := hrel k w hw' (mem_iInter.1 hwV.1 k)
    simp only [capRestrict] at this
    rwa [evalFun_map W _ _ hw'] at this
  
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁O, hb₁Z⟩ := exists_mem_sdiff_zeroSet R hO hOG hxO
  have hann : mkPt b₁ 1 ∈ annulusRegion F.G F.ρ := by
    change splitEquiv m (mkPt b₁ 1) ∈ F.G ×ˢ overlap F.ρ
    rw [mkPt, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hOG hb₁O, mem_overlap_of_norm_eq_one F.one_lt_ρ norm_one⟩
  have hy₀N : mkPt b₁ 1 ∈ N :=
    (F.mem_N _).2 ⟨by rw [baseOf_mkPt]; exact hOG hb₁O, by
      rw [fibOf_mkPt, norm_one]; exact F.one_lt_ρ⟩
  set y₀ : space N := ⟨mkPt b₁ 1, hy₀N⟩
  have hy₀U : y₀ ∈ tubeN N O hO := by
    change baseOf (mkPt b₁ 1) ∈ O
    rw [baseOf_mkPt]
    exact hb₁O
  have hy₀Z : y₀.1 ∉ baseOf ⁻¹' R.zeroSet := by
    change baseOf (mkPt b₁ 1) ∉ R.zeroSet
    rw [baseOf_mkPt]
    exact hb₁Z
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hgen y₀ hy₀U hy₀Z
  
  obtain ⟨U', hU'U, hxU', r, s, hs⟩ := exists_generatesNear_of_chain h₀ W F.hasThinComplement
    (F.isPreconnected_img_tubeN hOG hOc) (fun j l ↦ D.capSec h₀ (σ j l))
    (F.annulusRegion_subset _ hann) (hj₀ j₀ le_rfl) hgen hxO
  have hU'G : ∀ z ∈ (img U' : Set (Cn.{u} (m + 1))), baseOf z ∈ F.G := fun z hz ↦ by
    obtain ⟨hzN, hzU'⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hz
    exact hOG (hU'U hzU')
  refine isCoherentAt_of_generates h₀ W F.hasThinComplement s (R.pullBase hU'G)
    (fun y hy hyZ ↦ hs y hy ?_) hxU'
  rwa [RegularPairFamily.zeroSet_pullBase] at hyZ

name: Submodule.coordProj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coordProj_apply (v : E) (i : Fin r) : E.coordProj I₀ v i = (v : X → ℂ) (I₀ i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submodule.bijective_coordProj_of_det
statement:
theorem bijective_coordProj_of_det [Finite X] (hdim : finrank ℂ E ≤ r) (vs : Fin r → X → ℂ)
    (hvs : ∀ j, vs j ∈ E) (hdet : (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ vs j (I₀ i)).det ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (E.coordProj I₀)
proof:
:= by
  set A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ vs j (I₀ i)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (E.coordProj I₀) := by
    intro c
    set a := A⁻¹ *ᵥ c
    refine ⟨⟨∑ j, a j • vs j, sum_mem fun j _ ↦ smul_mem _ _ (hvs j)⟩, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have : (A *ᵥ a) i = c i := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hdet),
        Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [← this]
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, A, mul_comm]
  have hr : finrank ℂ E = r := le_antisymm hdim (by
    simpa using LinearMap.finrank_range_le (E.coordProj I₀) |>.trans_eq' (by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 hsurj, finrank_top, finrank_fin_fun]))
  refine ⟨(LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank (by simp [hr])).2 hsurj,
    hsurj⟩

name: Submodule.exists_bijective_coordProj
statement:
theorem exists_bijective_coordProj [Finite X] (E : Submodule ℂ (X → ℂ)) :
    ∃ I₀ : Fin (finrank ℂ E) → X, Function.Bijective (E.coordProj I₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite X
  set r := finrank ℂ E
  set bs := Module.finBasis ℂ E
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective E.subtype (ker_subtype E)
  set A : Matrix (Fin r) X ℂ := Matrix.of fun i x ↦ (bs i : X → ℂ) x
  set C : Matrix X (Fin r) ℂ := Matrix.of fun x j ↦ bs.repr (g (Pi.single x 1)) j
  have hAC : A * C = 1 := by
    ext i j
    have hsum : (bs i : X → ℂ) = ∑ x, (bs i : X → ℂ) x • Pi.single x 1 := by
      ext y
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    have := congrArg (fun v ↦ bs.repr (g v) j) hsum
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul] at this
    have hgi : g (bs i : X → ℂ) = bs i := LinearMap.congr_fun hg (bs i)
    rw [hgi, Basis.repr_self] at this
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    simp only [A, C, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [← this, Finsupp.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Matrix.exists_isUnit_det_submatrix_of_mul_eq_one hAC
  refine ⟨σ, bijective_coordProj_of_det le_rfl (fun j ↦ (bs j : X → ℂ)) (fun j ↦ (bs j).2) ?_⟩
  have : (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (bs j : X → ℂ) (σ i)) = (A.submatrix id σ).transpose := by
    ext i j
    rfl
  rw [this, Matrix.det_transpose]
  exact hσ.ne_zero

name: Submodule.graphVec_mem
statement: lemma graphVec_mem (e : Fin r) : graphVec hbij e ∈ E

name: Submodule.graphVec_apply
statement:
lemma graphVec_apply (e i : Fin r) :
    graphVec hbij e (I₀ i) = (Pi.single e (1 : ℂ) : Fin r → ℂ) i
proof:

name: Submodule.eq_of_coord_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_coord_eq {v v' : X → ℂ} (hv : v ∈ E) (hv' : v' ∈ E) (h : ∀ i, v (I₀ i) = v' (I₀ i)) :
    v = v'
proof:
:= by
  have := hbij.1 (a₁ := ⟨v, hv⟩) (a₂ := ⟨v', hv'⟩) (funext h)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Submodule.eq_sum_graphVec
statement: theorem eq_sum_graphVec {v : X → ℂ} (hv : v ∈ E) : v = ∑ e, v (I₀ e) • graphVec hbij e
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_coord_eq hbij hv (sum_mem fun e _ ↦ smul_mem _ _ (graphVec_mem hbij e))
    fun i ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, graphVec_apply]
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: Submodule.exists_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_det_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Finite K] (vs : K → X → ℂ)
    (hE : E ≤ span ℂ (range vs)) :
    ∃ J : Fin r → K, (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ vs (J j) (I₀ i)).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite K
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ c : K → ℂ, ∑ k, c k • vs k = graphVec hbij j := fun j ↦
    (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℂ).1 (hE (graphVec_mem hbij j))
  choose c hc using hc
  set A : Matrix (Fin r) K ℂ := Matrix.of fun i k ↦ vs k (I₀ i)
  have hAC : A * Matrix.of (fun k j ↦ c j k) = 1 := by
    ext i j
    have := congrFun (hc j) (I₀ i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, graphVec_apply] at this
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    simp only [A, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [← Pi.single_apply, ← this]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ mul_comm _ _
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Matrix.exists_isUnit_det_submatrix_of_mul_eq_one hAC
  exact ⟨σ, hσ.ne_zero⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.evalVec_mem_fibImage
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨B, hB, hBG, hb, t, ht, rfl⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.fibImage_le_span
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro v ⟨B', hB', hB'G, hbB', t, ht, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen (B' ∩ B) := hB'.inter hB
  have hle : tubeN N (B' ∩ B) hVo ≤ tubeN N B' hB' := tubeN_mono inter_subset_left
  have hVG : B' ∩ B ⊆ F.G := inter_subset_left.trans hB'G
  obtain ⟨V', hV'V, hV', hbV', e, -, hrel⟩ := hgen (B' ∩ B) hVo inter_subset_right ⟨hbB', hbB⟩
    (D.capRestrict h₀ hle t)
    (D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono inter_subset_left subset_rfl) ht)
  have hv : D.evalVec w t.1.1 b = ∑ k, e k b • D.evalVec w (s k).1.1 b := by
    funext x
    rw [← D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hVG (hV' := hVo) inter_subset_left t ⟨hbB', hbB⟩,
      D.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun' h₀ hVG hV'V inter_subset_right hwρ hrel hbV' x]
    simp [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hv]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)

name: RegularPairFamily.exists_differentiableOn_of_represents
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hA : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w ↦ g (w + z)) 0 :=
    (G.2.analyticAt).congr (G.2.represents_eval.eventuallyEq hG)
  have hA' : AnalyticAt ℂ g z := by
    have hs : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ι → ℂ ↦ w - z) z :=
      (analyticAt_id).sub analyticAt_const
    have := hA.comp_of_eq hs (sub_self z)
    exact this.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun w ↦ by simp)
  obtain ⟨O, hOs, hO, hzO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 hA'.eventually_analyticAt
  exact ⟨O, hO, hzO, fun w hw ↦ (hOs hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt⟩

name: RegularPairFamily.exists_isOpen_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_isOpen_ne_zero {g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} {z : ι → ℂ} (hc : ContinuousAt g z)
    (hg : g z ≠ 0) : ∃ O : Set (ι → ℂ), IsOpen O ∧ z ∈ O ∧ ∀ y ∈ O, g y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, hOs, hO, hzO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 (hc.eventually_ne hg)
  exact ⟨O, hO, hzO, fun y hy ↦ hOs hy⟩

name: RegularPairFamily.exists_local_equations
statement:
theorem exists_local_equations (hU : IsOpen U) {z : ι → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    ∃ O : Opens (ι → ℂ), (O : Set (ι → ℂ)) ⊆ U ∧ z ∈ O ∧ ∃ (S : ℕ) (f : Fin S → OkaRing O),
      ∀ y (hy : y ∈ O), y ∈ P.zeroSet ↔ ∀ s, OkaRing.evalHom hy (f s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin P.k, ∃ O : Set (ι → ℂ), IsOpen O ∧ z ∈ O ∧
      ((z ∈ P.zeroSetOf i → DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.g i) O ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.h i) O) ∧
        (z ∉ P.zeroSetOf i → ∀ y ∈ O, y ∉ P.zeroSetOf i)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : z ∈ P.zeroSetOf i
    · obtain ⟨G, H, hG, hH, -⟩ := P.isWeaklyRegular i z hz hi.1 hi.2
      obtain ⟨O₁, hO₁, hz₁, hd₁⟩ := exists_differentiableOn_of_represents hG
      obtain ⟨O₂, hO₂, hz₂, hd₂⟩ := exists_differentiableOn_of_represents hH
      exact ⟨O₁ ∩ O₂, hO₁.inter hO₂, ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩, fun _ ↦ ⟨hd₁.mono inter_subset_left,
        hd₂.mono inter_subset_right⟩, fun h ↦ absurd hi h⟩
    · have hne : P.g i z ≠ 0 ∨ P.h i z ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h
        push Not at h
        exact hi ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
      rcases hne with hg | hh
      · obtain ⟨O, hO, hzO, hO'⟩ :=
          exists_isOpen_ne_zero ((P.continuousOn_g i).continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)) hg
        exact ⟨O, hO, hzO, fun h ↦ absurd h hi, fun _ y hy hy' ↦ hO' y hy hy'.1⟩
      · obtain ⟨O, hO, hzO, hO'⟩ :=
          exists_isOpen_ne_zero ((P.continuousOn_h i).continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)) hh
        exact ⟨O, hO, hzO, fun h ↦ absurd h hi, fun _ y hy hy' ↦ hO' y hy hy'.2⟩
  choose O hO hzO hOi using hloc
  set O₀ : Opens (ι → ℂ) := ⟨U ∩ ⋂ i, O i, hU.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hO)⟩
  have hO₀U : (O₀ : Set (ι → ℂ)) ⊆ U := fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hO₀i : ∀ i, (O₀ : Set (ι → ℂ)) ⊆ O i := fun i _ h ↦ mem_iInter.1 h.2 i
  
  set I : Finset (Fin P.k) := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ z ∈ P.zeroSetOf i
  
  set F : (I → Bool) → (ι → ℂ) → ℂ := fun σ y ↦
    ∏ i : I, if σ i then P.g i y else P.h i y
  have hF : ∀ σ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F σ) O₀ := fun σ ↦ by
    have : DifferentiableOn ℂ (∏ i : I, fun y ↦ if σ i then P.g i y else P.h i y) O₀ := by
      refine Finset.prod_induction _ (p := fun g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ ↦ DifferentiableOn ℂ g O₀)
        (fun a b (ha : DifferentiableOn ℂ a O₀) (hb : DifferentiableOn ℂ b O₀) ↦ ha.mul hb)
        (differentiableOn_const (c := (1 : ℂ))) fun i _ ↦ ?_
      have hi : z ∈ P.zeroSetOf i := (Finset.mem_filter.1 i.2).2
      obtain ⟨hgd, hhd⟩ := (hOi i).1 hi
      split_ifs
      · exact hgd.mono (hO₀i i)
      · exact hhd.mono (hO₀i i)
    convert this using 1
    funext y
    simp [F, Finset.prod_apply]
  set e := Fintype.equivFin (I → Bool)
  refine ⟨O₀, hO₀U, ⟨hz, mem_iInter.2 hzO⟩, Fintype.card (I → Bool),
    fun s ↦ OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn (F (e.symm s)) (hF _), fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [OkaRing.evalHom_apply, OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn_toFun]
  constructor
  · rintro hyZ s
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hyZ
    have hiI : z ∈ P.zeroSetOf i := by
      by_contra h
      exact (hOi i).2 h y (hO₀i i hy) hi
    refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hiI⟩⟩)
      (Finset.mem_univ _) ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact hi.1
    · exact hi.2
  · intro h
    by_contra hyZ
    have hne : ∀ i : I, P.g i y ≠ 0 ∨ P.h i y ≠ 0 := fun i ↦ by
      by_contra h'
      push Not at h'
      exact hyZ (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, h'.1, h'.2⟩)
    set σ : I → Bool := fun i ↦ decide (P.g i y ≠ 0)
    have := h (e σ)
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
    refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (fun i _ ↦ ?_) this
    by_cases hg : P.g i y ≠ 0
    · simp [σ, hg]
    · have hh := (hne i).resolve_left hg
      simp [σ, hg, hh]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.res_eq_restrict
statement:
lemma res_eq_restrict {V V' : (space N).Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (r : (space N).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (space N).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r = OkaRing.restrict (img_mono h) r
proof:
:= by
  refine OkaRing.ext (funext fun x ↦ ?_)
  have hx : (x : Cn.{u} n) ∈ img V' := x.2
  have h1 := holFun_map h r hx
  rw [holFun, holFun, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hx,
    OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ (img_mono h hx)] at h1
  exact h1

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.tauVec_add
statement:
lemma tauVec_add (a b : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) :
    tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (a + b) = tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a + tauVec h₀ W hD s hV b
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  exact (congrArg (trace h₀ W hD) (mulSec_add h₀ W _ _ _)).trans (trace_add h₀ W hD _ _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.tauVec_smul
statement:
lemma tauVec_smul (c : (space N).presheaf.obj (op V)) (a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) :
    tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (c • a) = toOka c • tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  exact (congrArg (trace h₀ W hD) (mulSec_smul h₀ W _ _ _)).trans (trace_smul h₀ W hD _ _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.tauVec_sum_smul
statement:
lemma tauVec_sum_smul {L : ℕ} (c : Fin L → (space N).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (a : Fin L → (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) :
    tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (∑ l, c l • a l) = ∑ l, toOka (c l) • tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (a l)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : ∀ t : Finset (Fin L), tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (∑ l ∈ t, c l • a l) =
      ∑ l ∈ t, toOka (c l) • tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (a l) := fun t ↦ by
    induction t using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      funext j
      exact (congrArg (trace h₀ W hD) (mulSec_zero_left h₀ W _)).trans (trace_zero h₀ W hD)
    | insert l t hl ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hl, Finset.sum_insert hl, tauVec_add, tauVec_smul, ih]
  exact this Finset.univ

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.tauVec_res
statement:
lemma tauVec_res {V' : (space N).Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) :
    tauVec h₀ W hD s (h.trans hV) (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) h a) =
      resVec (img_mono h) (tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [tauVec, resVec]
  rw [← sectRes_sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) h hV, ← mulSec_map, trace_map, res_eq_restrict]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.tauVec_sectRes
statement:
lemma tauVec_sectRes (i : Fin r) :
    tauVec h₀ W hD s hV (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV (s i)) =
      resVec (img_mono hV) (tauCol h₀ W hD s i)
proof:
:= by
  have := tauVec_res h₀ W hD s (le_refl U) hV (s i)
  exact this

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.eq_zero_of_trace_mulSec_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_trace_mulSec_eq_zero' (a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V))
    (ha : ∀ j, trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W a (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV (s j))) = 0) :
    a = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hpt : ∀ w (hw : w ∈ preim h₀ W V), pt W w ∉ P.zeroSet →
      evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hwZ
    set x := pt W w
    have hxV : x ∈ img V := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw
    obtain ⟨hxN, hyV⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hxV
    obtain ⟨V', hV'U, hyV', hspan⟩ := hgen ⟨x, hxN⟩ (hV hyV) hwZ
    obtain ⟨B, hBo, hxB, hBN, hind⟩ := exists_indicator W w
    let VB : (space N).Opens := ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' B, hBo.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
    let V₁ : (space N).Opens := V ⊓ V' ⊓ VB
    have hV₁V' : V₁ ≤ V' := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hind (preim h₀ W V₁) fun w' hw' ↦ by
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hw')
      exact h.2
    have hbmem : b ∈ boundedSubring h₀ W V₁ := by
      rw [boundedSubring_eq_top h₀ W fun z (hz : z ∈ V₁) ↦ hBN _ hz.2]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨V'', hV''V₁, hxV'', f, hf⟩ := hspan V₁ hV₁V' (mkSec h₀ W b hbmem) ⟨x, hxN⟩
      ⟨⟨hyV, hyV'⟩, hxB⟩
    have hV''V : V'' ≤ V := hV''V₁.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
    have hxV''i : x ∈ img V'' := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hxN, hxV''⟩
    set b'' := sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV''V₁ (mkSec h₀ W b hbmem)
    have key : trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV''V a) b'') = 0 := by
      rw [hf, mulSec_sum_smul, trace_sum_smul]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [← sectRes_sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV''V hV, ← mulSec_map, trace_map, ha i,
        map_zero, mul_zero]
    have hw'' : w ∈ preim h₀ W V'' := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 hxV''i
    have hvb : ∀ w' ∈ preim h₀ W V'', pt W w' = x →
        evalFun (secVal h₀ W b'') w' = if w' = w then 1 else 0 := fun w' hw' hw'x ↦ by
      rw [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hw', secVal_mkSec]
      exact hb w' (preim_mono h₀ W hV''V₁ hw') hw'x
    have hva : ∀ w' ∈ preim h₀ W V'',
        evalFun (secVal h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV''V a)) w' =
          evalFun (secVal h₀ W a) w' := fun w' hw' ↦ by
      rw [secVal_map, evalFun_map W _ _ hw']
    have := holFun_trace h₀ W hD (mulSec h₀ W (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) hV''V a) b'')
      hxV''i (pt_mem W w)
    rw [key, holFun_zero hxV''i, traceFun, Finset.sum_eq_single w] at this
    · rw [secVal_mulSec, evalFun_mul W _ _ hw'', hva w hw'', hvb w hw'' rfl, if_pos rfl,
        mul_one] at this
      exact this.symm
    · intro w' hw' hw'w
      have hw'x : pt W w' = x := (mem_fiberFinset W).1 hw'
      have hw'V : w' ∈ preim h₀ W V'' := (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (hw'x ▸ hxV''i)
      rw [secVal_mulSec, evalFun_mul W _ _ hw'V, hvb w' hw'V hw'x, if_neg hw'w, mul_zero]
    · exact fun h ↦ (h ((mem_fiberFinset W).2 rfl)).elim
  
  refine secVal_injective h₀ W (eq_of_forall_eval_eq (isLocallyOpenInAffine_left W)
    fun w hw ↦ ?_)
  rw [secVal_zero, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨O, hwO, -, hsheet⟩ := exists_sheet W w
  obtain ⟨F, hFd, hF⟩ := hsheet (O' := O ⊓ preim h₀ W V) inf_le_left
    (W.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (secVal h₀ W a))
  set G : Set (Cn.{u} n) := pt W '' ((O ⊓ preim h₀ W V : W.left.Opens) : Set W.left)
  have hGU : G ⊆ img U := (image_pt_subset h₀ W O).trans (img_mono hV)
  have hFc : ContinuousOn F G := by
    rintro _ ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩
    exact (hFd w' hw').continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have h0 := P.eqOn_of_eqOn_diff (isOpen_image_pt W _) hGU hFc (continuousOn_const (c := 0))
    (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ⟨w, ⟨hwO, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  · have := hF w ⟨hwO, hw⟩
    rw [eval_presheaf_map] at this
    exact this.trans h0
  · obtain ⟨⟨w', hw', rfl⟩, hxZ⟩ := hx
    rw [← hF w' hw', eval_presheaf_map, ← evalFun_of_mem _ hw'.2]
    exact hpt w' hw'.2 hxZ

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.eq_of_tauVec_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_tauVec_eq {a b : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)}
    (h : tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a = tauVec h₀ W hD s hV b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_trace_mulSec_eq_zero' h₀ W hD s hV P hgen _ fun j ↦ ?_)
  have := congrFun h j
  simp only [tauVec] at this
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, mulSec_add, trace_add, this, ← trace_add, ← mulSec_add, add_neg_cancel,
    mulSec_zero_left, trace_zero]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isGapGood_tauVec
statement:
lemma isGapGood_tauVec (a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V)) :
    IsGapGood (tauCol h₀ W hD s) P.zeroSet (img_mono hV) (tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy hyZ
  obtain ⟨hyN, hyV⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hy
  obtain ⟨V', hV'U, hyV', hspan⟩ := hgen ⟨y, hyN⟩ (hV hyV) hyZ
  obtain ⟨V₂, hV₂, hyV₂, f, hf⟩ := hspan (V ⊓ V') inf_le_right
    (sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) inf_le_left a) ⟨y, hyN⟩ ⟨hyV, hyV'⟩
  have hy'' : y ∈ img V₂ := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hyN, hyV₂⟩
  have key := congrArg (tauVec h₀ W hD s (hV₂.trans (inf_le_left.trans hV))) hf
  rw [sectRes_sectRes, tauVec_res h₀ W hD s hV (hV₂.trans inf_le_left) a,
    tauVec_sum_smul] at key
  have hgerm := congrArg (germVec hy'') key
  rw [germVec_resVec] at hgerm
  rw [hgerm, ← germSpan_resVec (img_mono (hV₂.trans (inf_le_right.trans hV'U)))
    (tauCol h₀ W hD s) hy'']
  simp only [tauVec_sectRes] at *
  exact germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan _ _ hy''

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isGapGood_resVec_iff
statement:
lemma isGapGood_resVec_iff {O : Opens (Cn.{u} n)} (hO : O ≤ img U) {V' : Opens (Cn.{u} n)}
    (hV' : V' ≤ O) (v : Fin r → OkaRing V') :
    IsGapGood (fun i ↦ resVec hO (tauCol h₀ W hD s i)) P.zeroSet hV' v ↔
      IsGapGood (tauCol h₀ W hD s) P.zeroSet (hV'.trans hO) v
proof:
:= by
  refine forall₂_congr fun y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [germSpan_resVec]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.exists_tauVec_eq
statement:
theorem exists_tauVec_eq (v : Fin r → OkaRing (img V))
    (hv : IsGapGood (tauCol h₀ W hD s) P.zeroSet (img_mono hV) v) :
    ∃ a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V), tauVec h₀ W hD s hV a = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D : (space N).Opens := V ⊓ diffZeroSet N P
  have hDV : D ≤ V := inf_le_left
  
  have hloc : ∀ p : D, ∃ (O : (space N).Opens) (hOD : O ≤ D), p.1 ∈ O ∧
      ∃ a : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op O),
        tauVec h₀ W hD s (hOD.trans (hDV.trans hV)) a = resVec (img_mono (hOD.trans hDV)) v := by
    intro p
    have hpV : p.1.1 ∈ img V := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨p.1.2, hDV p.2⟩
    have hpZ : p.1.1 ∉ P.zeroSet := p.2.2.2
    have hmem := hv p.1.1 hpV hpZ
    rw [← germSpan_resVec (img_mono hV) (tauCol h₀ W hD s) hpV] at hmem
    obtain ⟨O', hO'V, hpO', c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ v hpV hmem
    let O : (space N).Opens := D ⊓ ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (O' : Set (Cn.{u} n)),
      O'.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
    have hOO' : img O ≤ O' := fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
      exact h.2
    refine ⟨O, inf_le_left, ⟨p.2, hpO'⟩, ∑ j, ofOka (restrict hOO' (c j)) •
      sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (show O ≤ U from inf_le_left.trans (hDV.trans hV)) (s j), ?_⟩
    rw [tauVec_sum_smul]
    funext i
    have := congrArg (fun w ↦ restrict hOO' (w i)) hc
    simp only [resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_sum, map_mul,
      restrict_restrict] at this
    simp only [tauVec_sectRes, resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, this]
  choose O hOD hpO a ha using hloc
  
  have hcompat : ∀ p q : D, sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (inf_le_left : O p ⊓ O q ≤ O p) (a p) =
