      sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (inf_le_right : O p ⊓ O q ≤ O q) (a q) := by
    intro p q
    have hpq : O p ⊓ O q ≤ U := inf_le_left.trans ((hOD p).trans (hDV.trans hV))
    refine eq_of_tauVec_eq h₀ W hD s hpq P hgen ?_
    rw [tauVec_res h₀ W hD s ((hOD p).trans (hDV.trans hV)) inf_le_left,
      tauVec_res h₀ W hD s ((hOD q).trans (hDV.trans hV)) inf_le_right, ha p, ha q]
    rfl
  have hcov : D ≤ iSup O := fun p hp ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpO ⟨p, hp⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, -⟩ := modRes_existsUnique_gluing (boundedModule h₀ W) O hcov hOD a
    fun p q ↦ hcompat p q
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (bijective_boundedModule_map P h₀ W hV hDV (img_diff_subset P hV) hD).2 a₀
  refine ⟨b, funext fun j ↦ (bijective_map_of_regularPairFamily P hV hDV
    (img_diff_subset P hV)).1 (eq_of_holFun_eq fun x hx ↦ ?_)⟩
  obtain ⟨hxN, hxD⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
  set p : D := ⟨⟨x, hxN⟩, hxD⟩
  have hxO : x ∈ img (O p) := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hxN, hpO p⟩
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun w : Fin r → OkaRing (img (O p)) ↦ (w j).toGlobalFun _ x) (ha p)
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun c ↦ tauVec h₀ W hD s ((hOD p).trans (hDV.trans hV)) c) (ha₀ p)
  rw [← h₂, show modRes a₀ (O p) (hOD p) = sectRes (boundedModule h₀ W) (hOD p) a₀ from rfl,
    tauVec_res h₀ W hD s (hDV.trans hV) (hOD p), ← hb, tauVec_res h₀ W hD s hV hDV] at h₁
  simp only [resVec, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hxO] at h₁
  rw [res_eq_restrict, res_eq_restrict, holFun, holFun, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hx,
    OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hx]
  exact h₁

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isCoherentAt_of_generates
statement: theorem isCoherentAt_of_generates {x : space N} (hx : x ∈ U) : IsCoherentAt h₀ W x
proof:
:= by
  have hxU : x.1 ∈ img U := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨O, hOU, hxO, S, f, hZ⟩ := P.exists_local_equations (img U).isOpen hxU
  have hOU' : O ≤ img U := hOU
  obtain ⟨V, hVO, hxV, L, B, hBgood, hBgen⟩ :=
    exists_gap_generators (A := fun i ↦ resVec hOU' (tauCol h₀ W hD s i)) hZ hxO
  
  set V' : (space N).Opens := ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (V : Set (Cn.{u} n)),
    V.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hV'U : V' ≤ U := fun y hy ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 (hOU' (hVO hy))).2
  have hImg : img V' ≤ V := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hy
    exact h
  have hxV' : x ∈ V' := hxV
  
  have hlift : ∀ l, ∃ b : (boundedModule h₀ W).val.obj (op V'),
      tauVec h₀ W hD s hV'U b = resVec hImg (B l) := fun l ↦
    exists_tauVec_eq h₀ W hD s hV'U P hgen _ (by
      have := ((isGapGood_resVec_iff h₀ W hD s P hOU' hVO (B l)).1 (hBgood l)).resVec hImg
      exact this)
  choose b hb using hlift
  refine ⟨⟨V', L, b, hxV', fun W' hW' t y hy ↦ ?_⟩,
    hasLocalModuleRelationsAt_of_le U hx fun V₁ hV₁ m g hxV₁ ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hyW' : y.1 ∈ img W' := mem_img_iff.2 ⟨y.2, hy⟩
    have hgood := isGapGood_tauVec h₀ W hD s (hW'.trans hV'U) P hgen t
    have hmem := hBgen (img W') ((img_mono hW').trans hImg) (tauVec h₀ W hD s (hW'.trans hV'U) t)
      ((isGapGood_resVec_iff h₀ W hD s P hOU' _ _).2 hgood) y.1 hyW'
    rw [← germSpan_resVec ((img_mono hW').trans hImg) B hyW'] at hmem
    obtain ⟨O'', hO''W, hyO'', c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hyW' hmem
    set W'' : (space N).Opens := W' ⊓ ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (O'' : Set (Cn.{u} n)),
      O''.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
    have hW''O : img W'' ≤ O'' := fun z hz ↦ by
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hz
      exact h.2
    refine ⟨W'', inf_le_left, ⟨hy, hyO''⟩, fun l ↦ ofOka (restrict hW''O (c l)), ?_⟩
    refine eq_of_tauVec_eq h₀ W hD s (inf_le_left.trans (hW'.trans hV'U)) P hgen ?_
    rw [tauVec_res h₀ W hD s (hW'.trans hV'U) inf_le_left, tauVec_sum_smul]
    funext i
    have := congrArg (fun w ↦ restrict hW''O (w i)) hc
    simp only [resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_sum, map_mul,
      restrict_restrict] at this
    simp only [tauVec_res h₀ W hD s hV'U, hb, resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, restrict_restrict, this]
  · 
    obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, p, g', hxW₁, hg', hgen'⟩ := ReflexiveHullData.exists_tuple_relations
      (space N).hasLocalTupleRelations_unit (fun i j ↦ tauVec h₀ W hD s hV₁ (g i) j) hxV₁
    refine ⟨W₁, hW₁, p, g', hxW₁, fun l ↦ ?_, fun W' hW' a ha ↦ hgen' W' hW' a fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    · refine eq_of_tauVec_eq h₀ W hD s (hW₁.trans hV₁) P hgen ?_
      rw [tauVec_sum_smul]
      funext j
      have := hg' l j
      simp only [tauVec_res h₀ W hD s hV₁ hW₁, resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      have h0 := (tauVec_sum_smul h₀ W hD s (hW₁.trans hV₁) (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ 0) Fin.elim0)
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty] at h0
      rw [h0]
      simp only [LocallyRingedSpace.res] at this
      exact this
    · have := congrArg (fun c ↦ tauVec h₀ W hD s (hW'.trans (hW₁.trans hV₁)) c j) ha
      simp only [tauVec_sum_smul, tauVec_res h₀ W hD s hV₁ (hW'.trans hW₁), resVec,
        Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
      have h0 := (tauVec_sum_smul h₀ W hD s (hW'.trans (hW₁.trans hV₁)) (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ 0)
        Fin.elim0)
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty] at h0
      rw [h0] at this
      simp only [LocallyRingedSpace.res]
      exact this

name: OkaRing.finInf_le
statement:
lemma finInf_le {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] (U : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (W : κ → Opens (ι → ℂ)) :
    finInf U W ≤ U
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: OkaRing.finInf_le'
statement:
lemma finInf_le' {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] (U : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (W : κ → Opens (ι → ℂ)) (k : κ) :
    finInf U W ≤ W k
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ mem_iInter.1 h.2 k

name: OkaRing.mem_finInf
statement:
lemma mem_finInf {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {W : κ → Opens (ι → ℂ)}
    {y : ι → ℂ} (hU : y ∈ U) (hW : ∀ k, y ∈ W k) : y ∈ finInf U W
proof:
:=
  ⟨hU, mem_iInter.2 hW⟩

name: OkaRing.germVec_resVec
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  simp [resVec]

name: OkaRing.germSpan_resVec
statement:
lemma germSpan_resVec {U V : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (h : V ≤ U) {p : ℕ} (A : Fin p → Fin q → OkaRing U)
    {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ V) : germSpan (fun j ↦ resVec h (A j)) hy = germSpan A (h hy)
proof:
:= by
  simp [germSpan]

name: OkaRing.germVec_smul
statement:
lemma germVec_smul {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (c : OkaRing U) (v : Fin q → OkaRing U) {y : ι → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ U) : germVec hy (c • v) = germ hy c • germVec hy v
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  simp

name: OkaRing.germVec_add
statement:
lemma germVec_add {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (v w : Fin q → OkaRing U) {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    germVec hy (v + w) = germVec hy v + germVec hy w
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: OkaRing.germVec_sum
statement:
lemma germVec_sum {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {L : ℕ} (v : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing U) {y : ι → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ U) : germVec hy (∑ l, v l) = ∑ l, germVec hy (v l)
proof:
:=
  map_sum _ _ _

name: OkaRing.germVec_mem_germSpan
statement:
lemma germVec_mem_germSpan {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {p : ℕ} (A : Fin p → Fin q → OkaRing U)
    {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ U) (j : Fin p) : germVec hy (A j) ∈ germSpan A hy
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: OkaRing.germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan
statement:
lemma germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {p : ℕ} (A : Fin p → Fin q → OkaRing U)
    (c : Fin p → OkaRing U) {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    germVec hy (∑ j, c j • A j) ∈ germSpan A hy
proof:
:= by
  rw [germVec_sum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ by
    rw [germVec_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (germVec_mem_germSpan A hy j)

name: OkaRing.exists_germVec_eq
statement:
lemma exists_germVec_eq (g : Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι) {y : ι → ℂ} (U : Opens (ι → ℂ))
    (hyU : y ∈ U) : ∃ (W : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (_ : W ≤ U) (hy : y ∈ W) (v : Fin q → OkaRing W),
      germVec hy v = g
proof:
:= by
  choose W hyW f hf using fun i ↦ LocalOkaRing.exists_okaRing_germ (g i) y
  refine ⟨finInf U W, finInf_le U W, mem_finInf hyU hyW,
    fun i ↦ restrict (finInf_le' U W i) (f i), ?_⟩
  ext i : 1
  simp [hf]

name: OkaRing.exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan {V : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {L : ℕ} (B : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V)
    (v : Fin q → OkaRing V) {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ V) (h : germVec hy v ∈ germSpan B hy) :
    ∃ (W : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧ ∃ c : Fin L → OkaRing W,
      resVec hWV v = ∑ l, c l • resVec hWV (B l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hyW, c, hc⟩ := exists_restrict_eq_mulVec (Matrix.of fun i l ↦ B l i) v hy h
  refine ⟨W, hWV, hyW, c, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [resVec, hc i, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply]

name: OkaRing.mem_germSpan_of_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hc
  have := Submodule.smul_mem _ (↑u⁻¹ : LocalOkaRing ι) h
  rwa [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] at this

name: OkaRing.IsGapGood.resVec
statement:
lemma IsGapGood.resVec {W W' : Opens (ι → ℂ)} {hWU : W ≤ U} {v : Fin q → OkaRing W}
    (hv : IsGapGood A Z hWU v) (h : W' ≤ W) : IsGapGood A Z (h.trans hWU) (resVec h v)
proof:
:=
  fun y hy hyZ ↦ by
    rw [germVec_resVec]
    exact hv y (h hy) hyZ

name: OkaRing.isGapGood_resVec_col
statement:
lemma isGapGood_resVec_col {W : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hWU : W ≤ U) (j : Fin p) :
    IsGapGood A Z hWU (resVec hWU (A j))
proof:
:=
  fun y hy _ ↦ by
    rw [germVec_resVec]
    exact germVec_mem_germSpan A _ j

name: OkaRing.mem_gapSubmodule_of_smul_mem
statement:
lemma mem_gapSubmodule_of_smul_mem
    (hZ : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ Z ↔ ∀ s, evalHom hy (f s) = 0) {x₀ : ι → ℂ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U)
    {g : Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι} (hg : ∀ s, germ hx₀ (f s) • g ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀) :
    g ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀U, hx₀W₀, v, rfl⟩ := exists_germVec_eq g U hx₀
  choose W hWU hxW v' hv' hgood using hg
  
  have hloc : ∀ s, ∃ (W' : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (h' : W' ≤ W s ⊓ W₀), x₀ ∈ W' ∧
      resVec (h'.trans inf_le_left) (v' s) =
        restrict (h'.trans (inf_le_right.trans hW₀U)) (f s) • resVec (h'.trans inf_le_right) v := by
    intro s
    have heq : ∀ i, germ (show x₀ ∈ W s ⊓ W₀ from ⟨hxW s, hx₀W₀⟩)
        (restrict inf_le_left (v' s i) - restrict (inf_le_right.trans hW₀U) (f s) *
          restrict inf_le_right (v i)) = 0 := fun i ↦ by
      have := congrFun (hv' s) i
      simp only [germVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, germ_restrict, germ_restrict, germ_restrict, this, sub_self]
    choose W' hW' hxW' hz using fun i ↦ exists_restrict_eq_zero _ (heq i)
    refine ⟨finInf (W s ⊓ W₀) W', finInf_le _ _, mem_finInf ⟨hxW s, hx₀W₀⟩ hxW',
      funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (restrict (finInf_le' (W s ⊓ W₀) W' i)) (hz i)
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, restrict_restrict, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at this
    simpa [resVec] using this
  choose W' hW' hxW' hW'eq using hloc
  refine ⟨finInf W₀ W', finInf_le _ _ |>.trans hW₀U, mem_finInf hx₀W₀ hxW',
    resVec (finInf_le _ _) v, by rw [germVec_resVec], fun y hy hyZ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, evalHom (hW₀U (finInf_le _ _ hy)) (f s) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hyZ ((hZ y _).2 h)
  have hyW' : y ∈ W' s := finInf_le' W₀ W' s hy
  have h₁ := hgood s y ((hW' s hyW').1) hyZ
  have h₂ : germVec ((hW' s hyW').1) (v' s) =
      germ (hW₀U (finInf_le _ _ hy)) (f s) • germVec (finInf_le _ _ hy) v := by
    rw [← germVec_resVec (hW' s |>.trans inf_le_left) (v' s) hyW', hW'eq s, germVec_smul,
      germ_restrict, germVec_resVec]
  rw [h₂] at h₁
  rw [germVec_resVec]
  refine mem_germSpan_of_isUnit A _ ?_ h₁
  rw [LocalOkaRing.isUnit_iff, constantCoeff_germ]
  exact hs

name: OkaRing.exists_isSMulRegular
statement:
lemma exists_isSMulRegular (hZ : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ Z ↔ ∀ s, evalHom hy (f s) = 0)
    {x₀ : ι → ℂ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U) :
    ∃ φ ∈ Ideal.span (range fun s ↦ germ hx₀ (f s)), ∀ g : Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι,
      φ • g ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀ → g ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set M := (Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι) ⧸ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀
  set J : Ideal (LocalOkaRing ι) := Ideal.span (range fun s ↦ germ hx₀ (f s))
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  
  have hJ : (J : Set (LocalOkaRing ι)) ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ associatedPrimes (LocalOkaRing ι) M, P := by
    intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hg'⟩ := hcon φ hφ
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_zero_divisors]
    refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk g, fun h ↦ hg' ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 h), ?_⟩
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hg
  have hfin := associatedPrimes.finite (LocalOkaRing ι) M
  rw [← hfin.coe_toFinset] at hJ
  have hJ' : (J : Set (LocalOkaRing ι)) ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ (↑hfin.toFinset : Set (Ideal (LocalOkaRing ι))),
      id P := by simpa using hJ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hJP⟩ := (Ideal.subset_union_prime (s := hfin.toFinset) (f := id) ⊥ ⊥
    (fun P hP _ _ ↦ by
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hP
      exact hP.1)).1 hJ'
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff, isAssociatedPrime_iff] at hP
  obtain ⟨hPprime, x, rfl⟩ := hP
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  have hg : g ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀ := mem_gapSubmodule_of_smul_mem hZ hx₀ fun s ↦ by
    have hs : germ hx₀ (f s) ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have := hJP hs
    rw [id, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  refine hPprime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _ |>.2 ?_)
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, one_smul, Submodule.mem_bot,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact hg

name: OkaRing.sum_mul_single
statement:
lemma sum_mul_single {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (c : Fin q → R) (φ : R) (j : Fin q) :
    ∑ i, c i * Pi.single (M := fun _ ↦ R) i φ j = c j * φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i _ hij ↦ by rw [Pi.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hij),
    mul_zero]) (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same]

name: OkaRing.sum_relFamily
statement:
lemma sum_relFamily {V W : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (h : W ≤ V) {L : ℕ} (φ : OkaRing V)
    (B : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V) (a : Fin (q + L) → OkaRing W) (j : Fin q) :
    ∑ i, a i * restrict h (relFamily φ B i j) =
      a (Fin.castAdd L j) * restrict h φ + ∑ l, a (Fin.natAdd q l) * restrict h (B l j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  congr 1
  · simp only [relFamily, Fin.append_left]
    rw [← sum_mul_single (fun i ↦ a (Fin.castAdd L i)) (restrict h φ) j]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Pi.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · simp [relFamily]

name: OkaRing.exists_gap_generators
statement:
theorem exists_gap_generators (hZ : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), y ∈ Z ↔ ∀ s, evalHom hy (f s) = 0)
    {x₀ : ι → ℂ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (hVU : V ≤ U), x₀ ∈ V ∧ ∃ (L : ℕ) (B : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V),
      (∀ l, IsGapGood A Z hVU (B l)) ∧
      ∀ (W : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (hWV : W ≤ V) (v : Fin q → OkaRing W),
        IsGapGood A Z (hWV.trans hVU) v → ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W), germVec hy v ∈ germSpan B (hWV hy)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨L, g, hg⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (gapSubmodule A Z hx₀))
  have hgmem : ∀ l, g l ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀ := fun l ↦ hg ▸ Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
  choose W₁ hW₁U hxW₁ v₁ hv₁ hgood₁ using hgmem
  set V₁ := finInf U W₁
  have hV₁U : V₁ ≤ U := finInf_le U W₁
  have hxV₁ : x₀ ∈ V₁ := mem_finInf hx₀ hxW₁
  set B₁ : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V₁ := fun l ↦ resVec (finInf_le' U W₁ l) (v₁ l)
  have hB₁good : ∀ l, IsGapGood A Z hV₁U (B₁ l) := fun l ↦ (hgood₁ l).resVec _
  have hB₁x : germSpan B₁ hxV₁ = gapSubmodule A Z hx₀ := by
    rw [← hg, germSpan]
    congr 1
    ext t
    simp only [mem_range]
    refine exists_congr fun l ↦ ?_
    rw [germVec_resVec, hv₁]
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφJ, hφreg⟩ := exists_isSMulRegular (A := A) hZ hx₀
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.1 hφJ
  choose W₂ hxW₂ ã hã using fun s ↦ LocalOkaRing.exists_okaRing_germ (a s) x₀
  set V₂ := finInf V₁ W₂
  have hV₂V₁ : V₂ ≤ V₁ := finInf_le V₁ W₂
  have hxV₂ : x₀ ∈ V₂ := mem_finInf hxV₁ hxW₂
  set φ' : OkaRing V₂ :=
    ∑ s, restrict (finInf_le' V₁ W₂ s) (ã s) * restrict (hV₂V₁.trans hV₁U) (f s)
  have hφ'x : germ hxV₂ φ' = φ := by
    rw [← ha, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, germ_restrict, germ_restrict, hã]
  have hφ'Z : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V₂), y ∈ Z → evalHom hy φ' = 0 := by
    intro y hy hyZ
    have h := (hZ y (hV₁U (hV₂V₁ hy))).1 hyZ
    simp only [φ', map_sum, map_mul, evalHom_restrict, h, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  
  set B₂ : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V₂ := fun l ↦ resVec hV₂V₁ (B₁ l)
  obtain ⟨V₃, hV₃, K, gR, hxV₃, hrel, hgen⟩ := oka' V₂ (relFamily φ' B₂) x₀ hxV₂
  
  have hc : ∀ k, ∃ (W : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (hW : W ≤ V₃), x₀ ∈ W ∧ ∃ e : Fin L → OkaRing W,
      resVec hW (fun i ↦ gR k (Fin.castAdd L i)) =
        ∑ l, e l • resVec (hW.trans (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁)) (B₁ l) := by
    intro k
    have hrelk : restrict hV₃ φ' • (fun i ↦ gR k (Fin.castAdd L i)) =
        -∑ l, gR k (Fin.natAdd q l) • resVec (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁) (B₁ l) := by
      funext j
      have := hrel k j
      rw [sum_relFamily] at this
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.neg_apply, Finset.sum_apply, resVec]
      simp only [B₂, resVec, restrict_restrict] at this
      linear_combination this
    have hmem : φ • germVec hxV₃ (fun i ↦ gR k (Fin.castAdd L i)) ∈ gapSubmodule A Z hx₀ := by
      rw [← hB₁x, ← hφ'x, ← germ_restrict hV₃ hxV₃, ← germVec_smul, hrelk, map_neg]
      refine Submodule.neg_mem _ ?_
      have := germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan (fun l ↦ resVec (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁) (B₁ l))
        (fun l ↦ gR k (Fin.natAdd q l)) hxV₃
      rwa [germSpan_resVec] at this
    have hmem' := hφreg _ hmem
    rw [← hB₁x, ← germSpan_resVec (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁) B₁ hxV₃] at hmem'
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, e, he⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hxV₃ hmem'
    refine ⟨W, hW, hxW, e, ?_⟩
    rw [he]
    rfl
  choose W₄ hW₄ hxW₄ e he using hc
  
  have hA : ∀ j, ∃ (W : Opens (ι → ℂ)) (hW : W ≤ V₁), x₀ ∈ W ∧ ∃ E : Fin L → OkaRing W,
      resVec (hW.trans hV₁U) (A j) = ∑ l, E l • resVec hW (B₁ l) := by
    intro j
    have hmem : germVec (hV₁U hxV₁) (A j) ∈ germSpan B₁ hxV₁ := by
      rw [hB₁x]
      exact ⟨U, le_rfl, hx₀, A j, rfl, fun y hy _ ↦ germVec_mem_germSpan A hy j⟩
    rw [← germVec_resVec hV₁U (A j) hxV₁] at hmem
    exact exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hxV₁ hmem
  choose W₅ hW₅ hxW₅ E hE using hA
  set V : Opens (ι → ℂ) := finInf (finInf V₃ W₄) W₅
  have hVV₃ : V ≤ V₃ := (finInf_le _ _).trans (finInf_le _ _)
  have hVV₁ : V ≤ V₁ := hVV₃.trans (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁)
  have hxV : x₀ ∈ V := mem_finInf (mem_finInf hxV₃ hxW₄) hxW₅
  have hVW₄ : ∀ k, V ≤ W₄ k := fun k ↦ (finInf_le _ _).trans (finInf_le' _ _ k)
  set B : Fin L → Fin q → OkaRing V := fun l ↦ resVec hVV₁ (B₁ l)
  have hBspan : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V), germSpan B hy = germSpan B₁ (hVV₁ hy) :=
    fun y hy ↦ germSpan_resVec hVV₁ B₁ hy
  
  have hAB : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V), germSpan A (hV₁U (hVV₁ hy)) ≤ germSpan B hy := by
    intro y hy
    rw [germSpan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hyW₅ : y ∈ W₅ j := finInf_le' _ _ j hy
    have h₁ := congrArg (germVec hyW₅) (hE j)
    rw [germVec_resVec] at h₁
    change germVec (hV₁U (hVV₁ hy)) (A j) ∈ germSpan B hy
    rw [h₁, hBspan]
    have := germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan (fun l ↦ resVec (hW₅ j) (B₁ l)) (E j) hyW₅
    rwa [germSpan_resVec] at this
  
  have hreg : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V) (u : Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι),
      germ (hV₃ (hVV₃ hy)) φ' • u ∈ germSpan B hy →
        u ∈ germSpan B hy := by
    intro y hy u hu
    obtain ⟨W₆, hW₆, hyW₆, ũ, rfl⟩ := exists_germVec_eq u V hy
    have hu' : germVec hyW₆ (restrict (hW₆.trans (hVV₃.trans hV₃)) φ' • ũ) ∈
        germSpan (fun l ↦ resVec hW₆ (B l)) hyW₆ := by
      rw [germVec_smul, germ_restrict, germSpan_resVec]
      exact hu
    obtain ⟨W₇, hW₇, hyW₇, c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hyW₆ hu'
    have hW₇V₃ : W₇ ≤ V₃ := hW₇.trans (hW₆.trans hVV₃)
    obtain ⟨W₈, hW₈, hyW₈, γ, hγ⟩ := hgen W₇ hW₇V₃
      (Fin.append (resVec hW₇ ũ) (fun l ↦ -c l)) (fun j ↦ by
        rw [sum_relFamily]
        have := congrFun hc j
        simp only [resVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
          restrict_restrict, B] at this
        simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, resVec, restrict_restrict, B₂, neg_mul,
          Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        linear_combination this) y hyW₇
    have hũ : resVec (hW₈.trans hW₇) ũ = ∑ k, γ k • resVec (hW₈.trans hW₇V₃)
        (fun i ↦ gR k (Fin.castAdd L i)) := by
      funext i
      have := hγ (Fin.castAdd L i)
      simp only [Fin.append_left, resVec, restrict_restrict] at this
      simp only [resVec, this, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← germVec_resVec (hW₈.trans hW₇) ũ hyW₈, hũ, germVec_sum, hBspan]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [germVec_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have hyW₄ : y ∈ W₄ k := hVW₄ k hy
    rw [germVec_resVec, ← germVec_resVec (hW₄ k) _ hyW₄, he k]
    have := germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan
      (fun l ↦ resVec ((hW₄ k).trans (hV₃.trans hV₂V₁)) (B₁ l)) (e k) hyW₄
    rwa [germSpan_resVec] at this
  refine ⟨V, hVV₁.trans hV₁U, hxV, L, B, fun l ↦ (hB₁good l).resVec hVV₁,
    fun W hWV v hv y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  
  set F' : Fin (1 + L) → Fin q → OkaRing W := Fin.append (fun _ ↦ v) (fun l ↦ resVec hWV (B l))
  obtain ⟨V₉, hV₉, K', gC, hyV₉, hrelC, hgenC⟩ := oka' W F' y hy
  have hV₉V : V₉ ≤ V := hV₉.trans hWV
  have hrelC' : ∀ k, gC k (Fin.castAdd L 0) • resVec hV₉ v =
      -∑ l, gC k (Fin.natAdd 1 l) • resVec hV₉V (B l) := by
    intro k
    funext j
    have := hrelC k j
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add] at this
    simp only [F', Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,
      Finset.sum_singleton] at this
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.neg_apply, Finset.sum_apply, resVec,
      restrict_restrict] at this ⊢
    linear_combination this
  have hrad := germ_mem_radical_span_of_eventually hyV₉ (fun k ↦ gC k (Fin.castAdd L 0))
    (restrict (hV₉V.trans (hVV₃.trans hV₃)) φ') (by
      filter_upwards [V₉.isOpen.mem_nhds hyV₉] with y' hy' hzero
      by_cases hy'Z : y' ∈ Z
      · rw [toGlobalFun_apply _ hy']
        exact hφ'Z y' _ hy'Z
      · exfalso
        have hy'W : y' ∈ W := hV₉ hy'
        have hmem := hAB y' (hWV hy'W) (hv y' hy'W hy'Z)
        rw [← germSpan_resVec hWV B hy'W] at hmem
        obtain ⟨W₁₀, hW₁₀, hy'W₁₀, d, hd⟩ := exists_eq_sum_of_mem_germSpan _ _ hy'W hmem
        obtain ⟨W₁₁, hW₁₁, hy'W₁₁, δ, hδ⟩ := hgenC (W₁₀ ⊓ V₉) inf_le_right
          (Fin.append (fun _ ↦ 1) (fun l ↦ -restrict inf_le_left (d l))) (fun j ↦ by
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
            have := congrFun hd j
            simp only [F', Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Finset.univ_unique,
              Fin.default_eq_zero, Finset.sum_singleton, resVec, Finset.sum_apply,
              Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, restrict_restrict, one_mul, neg_mul,
              Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at this ⊢
            have := congrArg (restrict (inf_le_left : W₁₀ ⊓ V₉ ≤ W₁₀)) this
            simp only [map_sum, map_mul, restrict_restrict] at this
            rw [this]
            ring) y' ⟨hy'W₁₀, hy'⟩
        have h1 := congrArg (evalHom hy'W₁₁) (hδ (Fin.castAdd L 0))
        simp only [Fin.append_left, map_one, map_sum, map_mul, evalHom_restrict] at h1
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ by
          rw [show evalHom _ (gC k (Fin.castAdd L 0)) = 0 from by
            have := hzero k
            rwa [toGlobalFun_apply _ hy'] at this, mul_zero]] at h1
        exact one_ne_zero h1)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hrad
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.1 hN
  have hpow : (germ (hV₃ (hVV₃ (hWV hy))) φ') ^ N • germVec hy v ∈
      germSpan B (hWV hy) := by
    rw [germ_restrict] at hβ
    rw [← hβ, Finset.sum_smul, ← germSpan_resVec hWV B hy]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    rw [← germVec_resVec hV₉ v hyV₉, ← germVec_smul, hrelC', map_neg,
      ← germSpan_resVec hV₉ (fun l ↦ resVec hWV (B l)) hyV₉]
    refine Submodule.neg_mem _ ?_
    have := germVec_sum_smul_mem_germSpan (fun l ↦ resVec hV₉V (B l))
      (fun l ↦ gC k (Fin.natAdd 1 l)) hyV₉
    exact this
  have hpowreg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Fin q → LocalOkaRing ι),
      (germ (hV₃ (hVV₃ (hWV hy))) φ') ^ n • u ∈ germSpan B (hWV hy) →
        u ∈ germSpan B (hWV hy) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro u hu; simpa using hu
    | succ n ih =>
      intro u hu
      refine ih u (hreg y (hWV hy) _ ?_)
      rwa [smul_smul, ← pow_succ']
  exact hpowreg N _ hpow

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.subset_closure_inter_of_subset_closure
statement:
lemma subset_closure_inter_of_subset_closure {S O : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hO : IsOpen O) (hOV : O ⊆ V)
    (hS : V ⊆ closure S) : O ⊆ closure (O ∩ S)
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦ by
  rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzS⟩ :=
    mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 (hS (hOV hy)) (t ∩ O) (inter_mem ht (hO.mem_nhds hy))
  exact ⟨z, hz.1, hz.2, hzS⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.subset_closure_ne_zero
statement:
lemma subset_closure_ne_zero {O : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hO : IsOpen O) {g h : Cm.{u} m → ℂ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g O) (hg0 : interior (O ∩ g ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅)
    (hh0 : interior (O ∩ h ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅) :
    O ⊆ closure (O ∩ {y | g y ≠ 0} ∩ {y | h y ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  refine (subset_closure_diff_zero hO
    (interior_inter_preimage_zero_mul_eq_empty hg hg0 hh0)).trans
    (closure_mono fun y hy ↦ ?_)
  have hy2 : g y * h y ≠ 0 := hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨hy.1, left_ne_zero_of_mul hy2⟩, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy2⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.kerCond_evalVec
statement:
theorem kerCond_evalVec {N' : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hN'V : N' ⊆ V) {c : Cm.{u} m → ℂ}
    {Ψ : D.EvIdx M → Fin r → Cm.{u} m → ℂ} (hc : DifferentiableOn ℂ c N')
    (hΨ : ∀ x e, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Ψ x e) N') (hc0 : interior (N' ∩ c ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅)
    (hΦ : ∀ y ∈ N', y ∈ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V → c y ≠ 0 →
      ∀ x e, D.graphFun h₀ n w I₀ x e y = Ψ x e y / c y)
    (hdense : V ⊆ closure (D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V)) (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    {V' : Set (Cm.{u} m)} {hV' : IsOpen V'} (hV'N' : V' ⊆ N') (hV'G : V' ⊆ F.G)
    {t : boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N V' hV') × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)}
    (ht : t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V' hV') (V' ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) :
    ∀ y ∈ V', ∀ x, c y * D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x =
      ∑ e, Ψ x e y * D.evalVec w t.1.1 y (I₀ e)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy x
  have hev : ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦ D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x) V' := fun x ↦
    (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ t.1.1 x).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hV'G hy, by
      rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hV'G, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩
  set O := V' ∩ {y | c y ≠ 0}
  have hO : IsOpen O := (hc.mono hV'N').continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hV' isOpen_ne
  have hV'O : V' ⊆ closure O := by
    refine (subset_closure_diff_zero hV' (subset_empty_iff.1 (hc0 ▸ interior_mono
      fun y hy ↦ ⟨hV'N' hy.1, hy.2⟩))).trans (closure_mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hy.1, hy.2⟩)
  have hOd : O ⊆ closure (O ∩ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V) :=
    subset_closure_inter_of_subset_closure hO (fun y hy ↦ hN'V (hV'N' hy.1)) hdense
  refine Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (s := O ∩ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V) (t := V') ?_
    ((hc.mono hV'N').continuousOn.mul (hev x).continuousOn)
    (continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun e _ ↦ ((hΨ x e).mono hV'N').continuousOn.mul
      (hev _).continuousOn) (fun y hy ↦ hy.1.1)
    (hV'O.trans (closure_minimal hOd isClosed_closure)) hy
  intro y ⟨⟨hyV', hcy⟩, hyg⟩
  have hmem := evalVec_mem_fibImage hV'G hyV' ht (w := w)
  have hsum := Submodule.eq_sum_graphVec hyg.2.1 hmem
  have hx := congrFun hsum x
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hx
  change c y * D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x = ∑ e, Ψ x e y * D.evalVec w t.1.1 y (I₀ e)
  rw [hx, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ ↦ ?_
  have hΦe := hΦ y (hV'N' hyV') hyg hcy x e
  rw [graphFun, dif_pos hyg.2.1] at hΦe
  have hcy' : c y ≠ 0 := hcy
  rw [hΦe]
  field_simp

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_local_capPole_of_kerCond
statement:
theorem exists_local_capPole_of_kerCond {V' : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hV' : IsOpen V') (hV'N' : V' ⊆ N')
    {v : D.EvIdx M → Cm.{u} m → ℂ} (hv : ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (v x) V')
    (hker : ∀ y ∈ V', ∀ x, c y * v x y = ∑ e, Ψ x e y * v (I₀ e) y) {b : Cm.{u} m}
    (hb : b ∈ V' \ R.zeroSet) :
    ∃ (B : Set (Cm.{u} m)) (hB : IsOpen B), B ⊆ V' \ R.zeroSet ∧ b ∈ B ∧
      ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N B hB) (B ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
        ∀ b' ∈ B, ∀ x, D.evalVec w t.1.1 b' x = v x b'
proof:
:= by
  have hdense := D.subset_closure_goodSet R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀
  have hbV : b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet := ⟨hN'V (hV'N' hb.1), hb.2⟩
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, hbB₀, hB₀S, -, K, s₀, hs₀, -, J, hint₀, hJ₀⟩ :=
    D.exists_chart R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hr hbV
      (D.forall_frequently_isGood R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀ b hbV)
  have hB₀G : B₀ ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hVG (hB₀S hy).1
  have hV'S : IsOpen (V' \ R.zeroSet) :=
    R.isOpen_diff_zeroSet hV' fun y hy ↦ hVG (hN'V (hV'N' hy))
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hB₀.inter hV'S) b ⟨hbB₀, hb⟩
  set B := ball b ε
  have hBB₀ : B ⊆ B₀ := fun y hy ↦ (hεB hy).1
  have hBV' : B ⊆ V' \ R.zeroSet := fun y hy ↦ (hεB hy).2
  have hBG : B ⊆ F.G := hBB₀.trans hB₀G
  have hle : tubeN N B isOpen_ball ≤ tubeN N B₀ hB₀ := tubeN_mono hBB₀
  set s := fun k ↦ D.capRestrict h₀ hle (s₀ k)
  have hs : ∀ k, s k ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N B isOpen_ball) (B ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ) := fun k ↦
    D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono hBB₀ subset_rfl) (hs₀ k)
  set Λ : Cm.{u} m → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ := D.evalMat h₀ w I₀ (fun k ↦ (s₀ k).1.1) J
  set δ : Cm.{u} m → ℂ := fun y ↦ (Λ y).det
  have hδ : DifferentiableOn ℂ δ B := (D.differentiableOn_det_evalMat hwρ hB₀G _ J).mono hBB₀
  have hδ0 : interior (B ∩ δ ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ :=
    subset_empty_iff.1 (hint₀ ▸ interior_mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hBB₀ hy.1, hy.2⟩)
  have hΛ : ∀ i j, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦ Λ y i j) B := fun i j ↦
    (D.differentiableOn_evalMat hwρ hB₀G _ J i j).mono hBB₀
  set a : Fin r → Cm.{u} m → ℂ := fun j y ↦ ∑ i, (Λ y).adjugate j i * v (I₀ i) y
  have ha : ∀ j, DifferentiableOn ℂ (a j) B := fun j ↦ DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun i _ ↦
    (differentiableOn_adjugate hΛ j i).mul ((hv _).mono fun y hy ↦ (hBV' hy).1)
  have hevs : ∀ k x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦ D.evalVec w (s₀ k).1.1 y x) B := fun k x ↦
    (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ (s₀ k).1.1 x).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hBG hy, by
      rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hB₀G, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨hBB₀ hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩
  
  have hkey : ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ x, δ y * v x y = ∑ j, a j y * D.evalVec w (s₀ (J j)).1.1 y x := by
    intro y hy x
    set O := B ∩ {y | δ y ≠ 0} ∩ {y | c y ≠ 0}
    have hc0B : interior (B ∩ c ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ := subset_empty_iff.1 (hc0 ▸ interior_mono
      fun y hy ↦ ⟨hV'N' (hBV' hy.1).1, hy.2⟩)
    have hO : IsOpen O :=
      (hc.mono fun y hy ↦ hV'N' (hBV' hy.1).1).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage
        (hδ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_ball isOpen_ne) isOpen_ne
    have hBO : B ⊆ closure O := subset_closure_ne_zero isOpen_ball hδ.continuousOn hδ0 hc0B
    have hOd : O ⊆ closure (O ∩ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V) :=
      subset_closure_inter_of_subset_closure hO
        (fun y hy ↦ hN'V (hV'N' (hBV' hy.1.1).1)) hdense
    refine Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (s := O ∩ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V) (t := B) ?_
      (hδ.continuousOn.mul ((hv x).mono fun y hy ↦ (hBV' hy).1).continuousOn)
      (continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun j _ ↦ (ha j).continuousOn.mul (hevs _ x).continuousOn)
      (fun y hy ↦ hy.1.1.1) (hBO.trans (closure_minimal hOd isClosed_closure)) hy
    intro y ⟨⟨⟨hyB, hδy⟩, hcy⟩, hyg⟩
    have hδy' : δ y ≠ 0 := hδy
    have hcy' : c y ≠ 0 := hcy
    have hcol : ∀ j, D.evalVec w (s₀ (J j)).1.1 y x = ∑ e, Λ y e j * (Ψ x e y / c y) := by
      intro j
      have hsum := Submodule.eq_sum_graphVec hyg.2.1
        (evalVec_mem_fibImage hB₀G (hBB₀ hyB) (hs₀ (J j)) (w := w))
      have := congrFun hsum x
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
      rw [this]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ ↦ ?_
      have hΦe := hΦ y (hV'N' (hBV' hyB).1) hyg hcy' x e
      rw [graphFun, dif_pos hyg.2.1] at hΦe
      rw [hΦe]
      rfl
    have hΛa : ∀ e, ∑ j, Λ y e j * a j y = δ y * v (I₀ e) y := by
      intro e
      have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_adjugate (Λ y)) e)
      simp only [a, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
      rw [show δ y * v (I₀ e) y = ∑ i, (Λ y * (Λ y).adjugate) e i * v (I₀ i) y by
        simp [Matrix.mul_adjugate, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, δ]]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    change δ y * v x y = ∑ j, a j y * D.evalVec w (s₀ (J j)).1.1 y x
    simp_rw [hcol, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have : ∀ e, ∑ j, a j y * (Λ y e j * (Ψ x e y / c y)) =
        (Ψ x e y / c y) * (δ y * v (I₀ e) y) := fun e ↦ by
      rw [← hΛa e, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring
    simp_rw [this]
    have hk := hker y (hBV' hyB).1 x
    calc δ y * v x y = δ y / c y * (c y * v x y) := by field_simp
      _ = δ y / c y * ∑ e, Ψ x e y * v (I₀ e) y := by rw [hk]
      _ = ∑ e, Ψ x e y / c y * (δ y * v (I₀ e) y) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ ↦ by ring
  
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, ht₁v, -⟩ := D.exists_capPole_sum h₀ hBG (s := fun j ↦ s (J j))
    (fun j ↦ hs (J j)) ha
  have ht₁ev : ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ x, D.evalVec w t₁.1.1 y x = δ y * v x y := fun y hy x ↦ by
    rw [D.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun h₀ hBG hwρ ht₁v hy x, hkey y hy x]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hBG hBB₀ _ hy]
  obtain ⟨t', ht', ht'v⟩ := D.exists_capPole_evalVec_eq_of_mul h₀ hBG (convex_ball b ε) ht₁ hδ
    hδ0 hM hw hwρ (fun x ↦ (hv x).mono fun y hy ↦ (hBV' hy).1) ht₁ev
  exact ⟨B, isOpen_ball, hBV', mem_ball_self hε, t', ht', ht'v⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_capPole_of_kerCond
statement:
theorem exists_capPole_of_kerCond {V' : Set (Cm.{u} m)} (hV' : IsOpen V') (hV'N' : V' ⊆ N')
    {v : D.EvIdx M → Cm.{u} m → ℂ} (hv : ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (v x) V')
    (hker : ∀ y ∈ V', ∀ x, c y * v x y = ∑ e, Ψ x e y * v (I₀ e) y) :
    ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V' hV') (V' ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
      ∀ y ∈ V', ∀ x, D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x = v x y
proof:
:= by
  have hV'G : V' ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hVG (hN'V (hV'N' hy))
  have hV'S : IsOpen (V' \ R.zeroSet) := R.isOpen_diff_zeroSet hV' hV'G
  have hSG : V' \ R.zeroSet ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hV'G hy.1
  obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃, ht₃v⟩ := D.exists_capPole_of_locally h₀ (hU := hV'S) hSG hM hw hwρ
    fun b hb ↦ by
      obtain ⟨B, hB, hBS, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩ := exists_local_capPole_of_kerCond hwρ hw hM hloc hVo
        hVG hVc hr hb₀ hN'V hc hc0 hΦ hV' hV'N' hv hker hb
      exact ⟨B, hB, hBS, hbB, t, ht, htv⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htf, -⟩ := D.exists_capPole_extend h₀ (hU := hV') hV'G R hV'S ht₃
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  have hev : ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦ D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x) V' := fun x ↦
    (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ t.1.1 x).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hV'G hy, by
      rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hV'G, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩
  intro y hy x
  refine Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (s := V' \ R.zeroSet) (t := V') (fun y hy ↦ ?_)
    (hev x).continuousOn (hv x).continuousOn sdiff_subset
    (subset_closure_sdiff_zeroSet R hV' hV'G) hy
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, hval⟩ := D.exists_evalVec_eq_tube h₀ hwρ hSG hy x (hV := hV'S)
  rw [← ht₃v y hy x, hval, ← htf p hp,
    ← D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hSG sdiff_subset t hy (hV := hV') (hV' := hV'S), hval]
  simp only [capRestrict]
  rw [evalFun_map W _ _ hp]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.okaRing_eq_zero
statement:
lemma okaRing_eq_zero {U : TopologicalSpace.Opens (Cm.{u} m)} (f : OkaRing U)
    (h : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), OkaRing.evalHom hy f = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  OkaRing.ext (funext fun y ↦ h y.1 y.2)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.sum_kerCoeff
statement:
lemma sum_kerCoeff {X : Type*} [Finite X] [DecidableEq X] {q : ℕ} (eX : X ≃ Fin q)
    (I₀ : Fin r → X) (a : X → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (Ψ : X → Fin r → ℂ) (x : X) :
    ∑ i, a (eX.symm i) * ((if eX.symm i = x then 1 else 0) * c -
      ∑ e, (if eX.symm i = I₀ e then 1 else 0) * Ψ x e) = c * a x - ∑ e, Ψ x e * a (I₀ e)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite X
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp eX.symm (fun x' ↦ a x' * ((if x' = x then 1 else 0) * c -
    ∑ e, (if x' = I₀ e then 1 else 0) * Ψ x e))]
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', mul_comm]
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ ↦ ?_
    simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', mul_comm]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.capLocallyFinite_of_forall_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwρ⟩ := exists_nodes F.one_lt_ρ ((∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n + 1)
  have hM : (∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n < (∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεG⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 F.isOpen_G z hz
  set V := ball z ε
  have hVo : IsOpen V := isOpen_ball
  have hVc : IsPreconnected V := (convex_ball z ε).isPreconnected
  
  set S := V \ R.zeroSet
  set T : Set ℕ := (fun y ↦ finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y)) '' S
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁V, hb₁Z⟩ := exists_mem_sdiff_zeroSet R hVo hεG (mem_ball_self hε)
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := ⟨_, b₁, ⟨hb₁V, hb₁Z⟩, rfl⟩
  have hTbdd : BddAbove T := ⟨Fintype.card (D.EvIdx ((∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n + 1)), by
    rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact (Submodule.finrank_le _).trans_eq (Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card ℂ)⟩
  obtain ⟨bstar, hbstar, hbstarT⟩ := Nat.sSup_mem hTne hTbdd
  have hr : ∀ y ∈ S, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w bstar) :=
    fun y hy ↦ (le_csSup hTbdd ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩).trans_eq hbstarT.symm
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀⟩ := Submodule.exists_bijective_coordProj (D.fibImage h₀ n w bstar)
  have hb₀ : ∃ b ∈ S, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ b := ⟨bstar, hbstar, hI₀⟩
  
  obtain ⟨N', hN'o, hzN', hN'V, c, Ψ, hc, hΨ, hc0, hΦ⟩ :=
    D.exists_graph_rep R hwρ hloc hVo hεG hVc hr hb₀ (mem_ball_self hε)
  have hdense := D.subset_closure_goodSet R hwρ hloc hVo hεG hVc hr hb₀
  
  set X := D.EvIdx ((∑ i, (D.deg i : ℕ)) * n + 1)
  set eX := Fintype.equivFin X
  set U₀ : TopologicalSpace.Opens (Cm.{u} m) := ⟨N', hN'o⟩
  have hcoef : ∀ i j, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦
      (if eX.symm i = eX.symm j then 1 else 0) * c y -
        ∑ e, (if eX.symm i = I₀ e then 1 else 0) * Ψ (eX.symm j) e y) U₀ := fun i j ↦
    ((differentiableOn_const _).mul hc).sub
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun e _ ↦ (differentiableOn_const _).mul (hΨ _ e))
  set col : Fin (Fintype.card X) → Fin (Fintype.card X) → OkaRing U₀ := fun i j ↦
    OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn _ (hcoef i j)
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀U₀, k, g, hzV₀, hrel, hgen⟩ := oka' U₀ col z hzN'
  have hV₀N' : (V₀ : Set (Cm.{u} m)) ⊆ N' := hV₀U₀
  
  have hgl : ∀ l, ∃ t ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V₀ V₀.isOpen) (V₀ ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ),
      ∀ y ∈ V₀, ∀ x, D.evalVec w t.1.1 y x = (g l (eX x)).toGlobalFun _ y := by
    intro l
    refine exists_capPole_of_kerCond hwρ hw hM hloc hVo hεG hVc hr hb₀ hN'V hc hc0 hΦ
      V₀.isOpen hV₀N' (fun x ↦ (g l (eX x)).differentiableOn_toGlobalFun) fun y hy x ↦ ?_
    have := congrArg (OkaRing.evalHom hy) (hrel l (eX x))
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.evalHom_restrict] at this
    have key : c y * (g l (eX (eX.symm (eX x)))).toGlobalFun _ y =
        ∑ e, Ψ (eX.symm (eX x)) e y * (g l (eX (I₀ e))).toGlobalFun _ y := by
      rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← sum_kerCoeff eX I₀ (fun x' ↦ (g l (eX x')).toGlobalFun _ y) (c y)
        (fun x e ↦ Ψ x e y) (eX.symm (eX x))]
      refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_).trans this
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hy]
      rfl
    simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using key
  choose t ht htv using hgl
  refine ⟨V₀, V₀.isOpen, fun y hy ↦ hεG (hN'V (hV₀N' hy)), hzV₀, k, t, ht,
    fun b' hb' V hV hVV₀ hb'V t' ht' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hVG : V ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hεG (hN'V (hV₀N' (hVV₀ hy)))
  have hker := kerCond_evalVec hN'V hc hΨ hc0 hΦ hdense hwρ (fun y hy ↦ hV₀N' (hVV₀ hy)) hVG ht'
  have hev : ∀ x, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y ↦ D.evalVec w t'.1.1 y x) V := fun x ↦
    (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ t'.1.1 x).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hVG hy, by
      rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hVG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩
  set UV : TopologicalSpace.Opens (Cm.{u} m) := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have hUV : UV ≤ V₀ := hVV₀
  set a : Fin (Fintype.card X) → OkaRing UV := fun i ↦
    OkaRing.ofDifferentiableOn _ (hev (eX.symm i))
  have hrel' : ∀ j, ∑ i, a i * OkaRing.restrict (hUV.trans hV₀U₀) (col i j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    refine okaRing_eq_zero _ fun y hy ↦ ?_
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.evalHom_restrict]
    have h2 := sum_kerCoeff eX I₀ (fun x' ↦ D.evalVec w t'.1.1 y x') (c y)
      (fun x e ↦ Ψ x e y) (eX.symm j)
    rw [hker y hy (eX.symm j), sub_self] at h2
    rw [← h2]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨W'', hW''V, hb'W'', c', hc'⟩ := hgen UV hUV a hrel' b' hb'V
  have hW''V' : (W'' : Set (Cm.{u} m)) ⊆ V := hW''V
  refine ⟨W'', hW''V', W''.isOpen, hb'W'', fun l ↦ (c' l).toGlobalFun _,
    fun l ↦ (c' l).differentiableOn_toGlobalFun, ?_⟩
  refine D.evalFun_eq_sum_of_evalVec h₀ W''.isOpen hVG hW''V' hVV₀ ht' ht hM hw hwρ
    (fun l ↦ (c' l).differentiableOn_toGlobalFun) fun y hy x ↦ ?_
  have h1 : D.evalVec w t'.1.1 y x = OkaRing.evalHom hy (OkaRing.restrict hW''V (a (eX x))) := by
    simp [a]
  rw [h1, hc' (eX x), map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_mul, OkaRing.evalHom_restrict, htv l y (hUV (hW''V hy)) x,
    OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ hy, OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply _ (hUV (hW''V hy))]
  rfl

name: RegularPairFamily.exists_common_isQuotRep
statement:
theorem exists_common_isQuotRep {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {f : κ → (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} {z : ι → ℂ}
    (h : ∀ k, IsQuotRep Z (f k) z) :
    ∃ N : Set (ι → ℂ), IsOpen N ∧ z ∈ N ∧ ∃ (c : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ) (Ψ : κ → (ι → ℂ) → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ c N ∧ (∀ k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Ψ k) N) ∧
      interior (N ∩ c ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ ∧
      ∀ y ∈ N, ∀ k, y ∈ regPts Z (f k) → c y ≠ 0 → f k y = Ψ k y / c y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  choose N hN u w hu hw hw0 hf using h
  set N₀ : Set (ι → ℂ) := ⋂ k, interior (N k)
  have hN₀N : ∀ k, N₀ ⊆ N k := fun k ↦ (iInter_subset _ k).trans interior_subset
  have hN₀o : IsOpen N₀ := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun _ ↦ isOpen_interior
  refine ⟨N₀, hN₀o, mem_iInter.2 fun k ↦ mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 (hN k),
    fun y ↦ ∏ k, w k y, fun k y ↦ u k y * ∏ k' ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, w k' y,
    ComplexAnalytic.Cap.differentiableOn_finsetProd _ fun k _ ↦ (hw k).mono (hN₀N k),
    fun k ↦ ((hu k).mono (hN₀N k)).mul
      (ComplexAnalytic.Cap.differentiableOn_finsetProd _ fun k' _ ↦ (hw k').mono (hN₀N k')),
    interior_inter_preimage_zero_prod_eq_empty Finset.univ
      (fun k _ ↦ ((hw k).mono (hN₀N k)).continuousOn) fun k _ ↦ subset_empty_iff.1
        (hw0 k ▸ interior_mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hN₀N k hy.1, hy.2⟩), fun y hy k hr hc ↦ ?_⟩
  have hne : ∀ k', w k' y ≠ 0 := fun k' ↦ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.1 hc) k' (Finset.mem_univ _)
  change f k y = u k y * (∏ k' ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, w k' y) / ∏ k, w k y
  rw [hf k y (hN₀N k hy) hr (hne k), ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun k' ↦ w k' y)
    (Finset.mem_univ k), mul_div_mul_right _ _
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun k' _ ↦ hne k')]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.IsCapGenAt.capRestrict
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV hVB' hbV t ht
  obtain ⟨V', hV'V, hV', hbV', e, he, hrel⟩ := h V hV (hVB'.trans hB'B) hbV t ht
  refine ⟨V', hV'V, hV', hbV', e, he, fun y hy hyV' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hy' : y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N B' hB') := preim_mono h₀ W (tubeN_mono hVB') hy
  rw [hrel y hy hyV']
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ congrArg (e k (baseOf (pt W y)) * ·)
    (evalFun_map W _ _ hy').symm

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.differentiableOn_det_evalMat
proof:
:=
  differentiableOn_det fun i j ↦ (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ (s (J j)) (I₀ i)).mono
    fun y hy ↦ ⟨hBG hy, by
      rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hBG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isGood_of_det
proof:
:=
  Submodule.bijective_coordProj_of_det hdim (fun j ↦ D.evalVec w (s (J j)).1.1 y)
    (fun j ↦ evalVec_mem_fibImage hBG hyB (hs (J j))) hdet

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.graphVec_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  set A := D.evalMat h₀ w I₀ (fun k ↦ (s k).1.1) J y
  refine Submodule.eq_of_coord_eq hgood (Submodule.graphVec_mem hgood e)
    (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (evalVec_mem_fibImage hBG hyB (hs (J j)))) fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [Submodule.graphVec_apply]
  have : (A * A⁻¹) i e = (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) i e := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hdet)]
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_apply]
  rw [← this]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ mul_comm _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.graphFun_eq_div
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphFun, dif_pos hgood, graphVec_eq_sum hBG hs hyB hgood hdet e]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_chart
statement:
theorem exists_chart (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet) (hgood : ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∃ y ∈ O, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y) :
    ∃ (B : Set (Cm.{u} m)) (hB : IsOpen B), b ∈ B ∧ B ⊆ V \ R.zeroSet ∧ Convex ℝ B ∧
      ∃ (K : ℕ) (s : Fin K → boundedSubring h₀ W (tubeN N B hB) × (D.ι → Cm.{u} m × ℂ → ℂ)),
        (∀ k, s k ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N B hB) (B ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ)) ∧
        (∀ b' ∈ B, D.IsCapGenAt h₀ n s b') ∧ ∃ J : Fin r → Fin K,
          interior (B ∩ (fun y ↦ (D.evalMat h₀ w I₀ (fun k ↦ (s k).1.1) J y).det) ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ ∧
          ∀ y ∈ B, (D.evalMat h₀ w I₀ (fun k ↦ (s k).1.1) J y).det ≠ 0 →
            D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, -, hbB₀, K, s₀, hs₀, hgen₀⟩ := hloc b (hVG hb.1) hb.2
  have hSo : IsOpen (V \ R.zeroSet) := R.isOpen_diff_zeroSet hVo hVG
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hB₀.inter hSo) b ⟨hbB₀, hb⟩
  have hBB₀ : ball b ε ⊆ B₀ := fun y hy ↦ (hεB hy).1
  have hBS : ball b ε ⊆ V \ R.zeroSet := fun y hy ↦ (hεB hy).2
  have hBG : ball b ε ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hVG (hBS hy).1
  have hle : tubeN N (ball b ε) isOpen_ball ≤ tubeN N B₀ hB₀ := tubeN_mono hBB₀
  set s := fun k ↦ D.capRestrict h₀ hle (s₀ k)
  have hs : ∀ k, s k ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N (ball b ε) isOpen_ball) (ball b ε ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ) :=
    fun k ↦ D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono hBB₀ subset_rfl) (hs₀ k)
  have hgen : ∀ b' ∈ ball b ε, D.IsCapGenAt h₀ n s b' := fun b' hb' ↦
    (hgen₀ b' (hBB₀ hb')).capRestrict hBB₀
  obtain ⟨y, hyB, hy⟩ := hgood _ (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_self hε))
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := Submodule.exists_det_ne_zero hy (fun k ↦ D.evalVec w (s k).1.1 y)
    (D.fibImage_le_span hwρ hyB (hgen y hyB))
  refine ⟨ball b ε, isOpen_ball, mem_ball_self hε, hBS, convex_ball b ε, K, s, hs, hgen, J, ?_,
    fun y' hy' hdet ↦ isGood_of_det hBG hs hy' (hr y' (hBS hy')) hdet⟩
  exact AnalyticOnNhd.interior_inter_preimage_zero_eq_empty (fun x hx ↦
    analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_of_finiteDimensional isOpen_ball
      (differentiableOn_det_evalMat hwρ hBG _ J) hx) (convex_ball b ε).isPreconnected hyB hJ

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_nhds_frequently_isGood
statement:
lemma exists_nhds_frequently_isGood (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet) (hgood : ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∃ y ∈ O, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y) :
    ∃ B ∈ 𝓝 b, ∀ b' ∈ B, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 b', ∃ y ∈ O, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbB, -, -, K, s, hs, -, J, hint, hJ⟩ :=
    D.exists_chart R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hr hb hgood
  refine ⟨B, hB.mem_nhds hbB, fun b' hb' O hO ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyO, hyB, hy0⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 (subset_closure_diff_zero hB hint hb') O hO
  exact ⟨y, hyO, hJ y hyB hy0⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.forall_frequently_isGood
statement:
theorem forall_frequently_isGood (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hVc : IsPreconnected V)
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    (hb₀ : ∃ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ b) :
    ∀ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∃ y ∈ O, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y
proof:
:= by
  set P : Cm.{u} m → Prop := fun b ↦ ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∃ y ∈ O, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y
  set U₁ : Set (Cm.{u} m) := {b | ∃ B ∈ 𝓝 b, ∀ b' ∈ B, P b'}
  set U₂ : Set (Cm.{u} m) := {b | ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∀ y ∈ O, ¬D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y}
  have hU₁ : IsOpen U₁ := isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.2 fun b ⟨B, hB, hP⟩ ↦
    Filter.mem_of_superset (interior_mem_nhds.2 hB) fun b' hb' ↦
      ⟨B, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hb', hP⟩
  have hU₂ : IsOpen U₂ := isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.2 fun b ⟨O, hO, hP⟩ ↦
    Filter.mem_of_superset (interior_mem_nhds.2 hO) fun b' hb' ↦
      ⟨O, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hb', hP⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint U₁ U₂ := Set.disjoint_left.2 fun b ⟨B, hB, hP⟩ ⟨O, hO, hQ⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y, hyO, hy⟩ := hP b (mem_of_mem_nhds hB) O hO
    exact hQ y hyO hy
  have hspread : ∀ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, P b → b ∈ U₁ := fun b hb hPb ↦
    D.exists_nhds_frequently_isGood R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hr hb hPb
  have hsub : V \ R.zeroSet ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ := fun b hb ↦ by
    by_cases h : ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 b, ∀ y ∈ O, ¬D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ y
    · exact Or.inr h
    · push Not at h
      exact Or.inl (hspread b hb h)
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀S, hb₀⟩ := hb₀
  have hconn := (R.restrict hVG).isPreconnected_sdiff_zeroSet hVo subset_rfl hVc
  have hS₁ := hconn.subset_left_of_subset_union hU₁ hU₂ hdisj hsub
    ⟨b₀, hb₀S, hspread b₀ hb₀S fun O hO ↦ ⟨b₀, mem_of_mem_nhds hO, hb₀⟩⟩
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hP⟩ := hS₁ hb
  exact hP b (mem_of_mem_nhds hB)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.differentiableOn_evalMat
proof:
:=
  (D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ (s (J j)) (I₀ i)).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hBG hy, by
    rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hBG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.differentiableOn_cramerNum
proof:
:=
  DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun j _ ↦
    (differentiableOn_adjugate (D.differentiableOn_evalMat hwρ hBG s J) j e).mul
      ((D.differentiableOn_evalVec F.isOpen_G hwρ (s (J j)) x).mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hBG hy, by
        rw [F.mem_img_tubeN hBG, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
        exact ⟨hy, mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (hwρ _).2⟩⟩)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.mem_goodSet_of_chart
proof:
:= by
  have hBG : B ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hVG (hBS hy).1
  set δ := fun y ↦ (D.evalMat h₀ w I₀ (fun k ↦ (s k).1.1) J y).det
  have hδ : DifferentiableOn ℂ δ B := D.differentiableOn_det_evalMat hwρ hBG _ J
  set O := B ∩ {y | δ y ≠ 0}
  have hO : IsOpen O := hδ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hB isOpen_ne
  refine ⟨hBS hyB, hJ y hyB hy, fun x e ↦ ⟨(hBS hyB).2, O, hO.mem_nhds ⟨hyB, hy⟩, _,
    (((D.differentiableOn_cramerNum hwρ hBG _ J x e).mono inter_subset_left).mul
      ((hδ.mono inter_subset_left).inv fun y' hy' ↦ hy'.2)).congr fun y' _ ↦ div_eq_mul_inv _ _,
    fun y' hy' _ ↦ graphFun_eq_div hBG hs hy'.1 (hJ y' hy'.1 hy'.2) hy'.2 x e⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.subset_closure_sdiff_zeroSet
statement:
lemma subset_closure_sdiff_zeroSet (hVo : IsOpen V) (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) :
    V ⊆ closure (V \ R.zeroSet)
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦ by
  rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
  intro t ht
  have hO : IsOpen (interior (t ∩ V)) := isOpen_interior
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbZ⟩ := exists_mem_sdiff_zeroSet R hO
    (interior_subset.trans (inter_subset_right.trans hVG))
    (interior_mem_nhds.2 (inter_mem ht (hVo.mem_nhds hy)) |> mem_of_mem_nhds)
  have := interior_subset hb
  exact ⟨b, this.1, this.2, hbZ⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.subset_closure_goodSet
statement:
theorem subset_closure_goodSet (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hVc : IsPreconnected V)
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    (hb₀ : ∃ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ b) :
    V ⊆ closure (D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : V \ R.zeroSet ⊆ closure (D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V) := fun b hb ↦ by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hbB, hBS, -, K, s, hs, -, J, hint, hJ⟩ := D.exists_chart R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hr hb
      (D.forall_frequently_isGood R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀ b hb)
    refine closure_mono ?_ (subset_closure_diff_zero hB hint hbB)
    exact fun y hy ↦ D.mem_goodSet_of_chart R hwρ hVG hBS hs hJ hy.1 hy.2
  exact (subset_closure_sdiff_zeroSet R hVo hVG).trans (closure_minimal hS isClosed_closure)

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isQuotRep_graphFun
statement:
theorem isQuotRep_graphFun (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hVc : IsPreconnected V)
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    (hb₀ : ∃ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ b) {b : Cm.{u} m} (hb : b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet)
    (x : D.EvIdx M) (e : Fin r) :
    RegularPairFamily.IsQuotRep R.zeroSet (D.graphFun h₀ n w I₀ x e) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbB, hBS, -, K, s, hs, -, J, hint, hJ⟩ := D.exists_chart R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hr hb
    (D.forall_frequently_isGood R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀ b hb)
  have hBG : B ⊆ F.G := fun y hy ↦ hVG (hBS hy).1
  exact ⟨B, hB.mem_nhds hbB, _, _, D.differentiableOn_cramerNum hwρ hBG _ J x e,
    D.differentiableOn_det_evalMat hwρ hBG _ J, hint,
    fun y hy _ hdet ↦ graphFun_eq_div hBG hs hy (hJ y hy hdet) hdet x e⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_graph_rep
statement:
theorem exists_graph_rep (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ overlap F.ρ)
    (hloc : ∀ b ∈ F.G, b ∉ R.zeroSet → D.CapLocallyFinite h₀ n b) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hVG : V ⊆ F.G) (hVc : IsPreconnected V)
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, finrank ℂ (D.fibImage h₀ n w y) ≤ r)
    (hb₀ : ∃ b ∈ V \ R.zeroSet, D.IsGood h₀ n w I₀ b) {z : Cm.{u} m} (hz : z ∈ V) :
    ∃ N' : Set (Cm.{u} m), IsOpen N' ∧ z ∈ N' ∧ N' ⊆ V ∧ ∃ (c : Cm.{u} m → ℂ)
      (Ψ : D.EvIdx M → Fin r → Cm.{u} m → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ c N' ∧
      (∀ x e, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Ψ x e) N') ∧ interior (N' ∩ c ⁻¹' {0}) = ∅ ∧
      ∀ y ∈ N', y ∈ D.goodSet h₀ n w I₀ R V → c y ≠ 0 →
        ∀ x e, D.graphFun h₀ n w I₀ x e y = Ψ x e y / c y
proof:
:= by
  have hdense := D.subset_closure_goodSet R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀
  have hq : ∀ p : D.EvIdx M × Fin r,
      RegularPairFamily.IsQuotRep R.zeroSet (D.graphFun h₀ n w I₀ p.1 p.2) z := fun p ↦
    (R.restrict hVG).isQuotRep_of_forall hVo
      (fun y hy ↦ closure_mono (fun y' hy' ↦ hy'.2.2 p.1 p.2) (hdense hy))
      (fun y hy hyZ ↦ D.isQuotRep_graphFun R hwρ hloc hVo hVG hVc hr hb₀ ⟨hy, hyZ⟩ p.1 p.2) z hz
  obtain ⟨N', hN'o, hzN', c, Ψ, hc, hΨ, hc0, hΦ⟩ := RegularPairFamily.exists_common_isQuotRep hq
  refine ⟨N' ∩ V, hN'o.inter hVo, ⟨hzN', hz⟩, inter_subset_right, c, fun x e ↦ Ψ (x, e),
    hc.mono inter_subset_left, fun x e ↦ (hΨ (x, e)).mono inter_subset_left,
    subset_empty_iff.1 (hc0 ▸ interior_mono fun y hy ↦ ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩),
    fun y hy hyg hcy x e ↦ hΦ y hy.1 (x, e) (hyg.2.2 x e) hcy⟩

name: RegularPairFamily.eq_of_eqOn_regPts
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (𝓝[N ∩ regPts Z f] y).NeBot := by
    rw [← mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot]
    rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds] at hy ⊢
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzr⟩ := hy (t ∩ N) (inter_mem ht hN)
    exact ⟨z, hz.1, hz.2, hzr⟩
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique (h₁.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := N ∩ regPts Z f))) ?_
  refine (h₂.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y' hy'
  exact (h y' hy'.1 hy'.2).symm

name: RegularPairFamily.regularize_eq
statement:
lemma regularize_eq {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ closure (regPts Z f)) {N : Set (ι → ℂ)}
    (hN : N ∈ 𝓝 y) {F : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F N)
    (hfF : ∀ y' ∈ N, y' ∈ regPts Z f → f y' = F y') :
    regularize Z f y = F y
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasRegRep Z f y := ⟨N, hN, F, hF, hfF⟩
  rw [regularize, dif_pos h]
  have hN' := h.choose_spec.1
  obtain ⟨hF', hfF'⟩ := h.choose_spec.2.choose_spec
  refine eq_of_eqOn_regPts hy (inter_mem hN hN') (hF'.continuousOn.continuousAt hN')
    (hF.continuousOn.continuousAt hN) fun y' hy' hr ↦ ?_
  rw [← hfF' y' hy'.2 hr, hfF y' hy'.1 hr]

name: RegularPairFamily.IsQuotRep.isLocallyQuotientAt
statement:
lemma IsQuotRep.isLocallyQuotientAt {z : ι → ℂ} (hdense : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, y ∈ closure (regPts Z f))
    (h : IsQuotRep Z f z) : IsLocallyQuotientAt (regularize Z f) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, u, w, hu, hw, hw0, hf⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀N, hN₀o, hzN₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 (inter_mem hN hdense)
  refine ⟨N₀, hN₀o.mem_nhds hzN₀, u, w, hu.mono fun y hy ↦ (hN₀N hy).1,
    hw.mono fun y hy ↦ (hN₀N hy).1, subset_empty_iff.1 (hw0 ▸ interior_mono fun y hy ↦
      ⟨(hN₀N hy.1).1, hy.2⟩), fun y hy hwy ↦ ?_⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (N₀ ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) :=
    (hw.mono fun y hy ↦ (hN₀N hy).1).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hN₀o isOpen_ne
  have hu' : DifferentiableOn ℂ u (N₀ ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) := hu.mono fun y hy ↦ (hN₀N hy.1).1
  have hw' : DifferentiableOn ℂ w (N₀ ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) := hw.mono fun y hy ↦ (hN₀N hy.1).1
  refine regularize_eq (F := fun y ↦ u y / w y) (hN₀N hy).2 (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hwy⟩)
    ((hu'.mul (hw'.inv fun y hy ↦ hy.2)).congr fun y _ ↦ div_eq_mul_inv _ _)
    fun y' hy' hr ↦ hf y' (hN₀N hy'.1).1 hr hy'.2

name: RegularPairFamily.isQuotRep_of_hasDenominatorAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hzW, c, F, hc, hF, hc0, hcF⟩ := h
  refine ⟨W ∩ U, inter_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hzW) (hU.mem_nhds hz), F, c, hF.mono inter_subset_left,
    hc.mono inter_subset_left, subset_empty_iff.1 (hc0 ▸ interior_mono fun y hy ↦
      ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩), fun y hy hr hcy ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hyZ, N, hN, G, hG, hfG⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀N, hN₀o, hyN₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 (inter_mem hN (hU.mem_nhds hy.2))
  
  have hreg : ∀ y' ∈ N₀, regularize Z f y' = G y' := fun y' hy' ↦
    regularize_eq (hdense y' (hN₀N hy').2) (hN₀o.mem_nhds hy') (hG.mono fun _ h ↦ (hN₀N h).1)
      fun y'' hy'' hr ↦ hfG y'' (hN₀N hy'').1 hr.1
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (regularize Z f) y := by
    refine (hG.continuousOn.continuousAt hN).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hN₀o.mem_nhds hyN₀] with y' hy'
    exact (hreg y' hy').symm
  have := hcF y hy.1 (fun h ↦ hyZ (hSZ h)) hcont
  rw [hreg y hyN₀, ← hfG y (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) hyZ] at this
  rw [this, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hcy]

name: RegularPairFamily.isQuotRep_of_forall
statement:
theorem isQuotRep_of_forall (hU : IsOpen U) (hdense : ∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ closure (regPts P.zeroSet f))
    (hq : ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ P.zeroSet → IsQuotRep P.zeroSet f y) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, IsQuotRep P.zeroSet f z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  suffices H : ∀ s : Finset (Fin P.k), ∀ y ∈ U, (∀ i ∉ s, y ∉ P.zeroSetOf i) →
      IsQuotRep P.zeroSet f y from
    fun z hz ↦ H Finset.univ z hz fun i hi ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro y hy h
    exact hq y hy fun hZ ↦ by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hZ
      exact h i (Finset.notMem_empty i) hi
  | insert i s his ih =>
    intro y hy h
    set U' := U \ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.univ \ insert i s, P.zeroSetOf j
    have hU' : IsOpen U' := P.isOpen_diff_biUnion hU subset_rfl _
    have hyU' : y ∈ U' := ⟨hy, fun hj ↦ by
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hyj⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hj
      exact h j (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hj).2 hyj⟩
    have hden := hasDenominatorAt_of_isWeaklyRegular hU' hyU' (P.isWeaklyRegular i y hy)
      (f := regularize P.zeroSet f) fun z hz hzi ↦ by
        refine IsQuotRep.isLocallyQuotientAt ?_ (ih z hz.1 fun j hj ↦ ?_)
        · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz.1] with y' hy' using hdense y' hy'
        · by_cases hji : j = i
          · subst hji
            exact hzi
          · exact fun hzj ↦ hz.2 (mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨j, Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ j,
              fun h ↦ (Finset.mem_insert.1 h).elim hji hj⟩, hzj⟩)
    exact isQuotRep_of_hasDenominatorAt (fun x hx ↦ mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hx⟩) hU hdense hy hden

name: RegularPairFamily.isPreconnected_sdiff_zeroSet
statement:
theorem isPreconnected_sdiff_zeroSet {V : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U)
    (hVc : IsPreconnected V) : IsPreconnected (V \ P.zeroSet)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hs : IsOpen (V \ P.zeroSet) := P.isOpen_diff_zeroSet hV hVU
  intro u v hu hv hsuv ⟨a, has, hau⟩ ⟨b, hbs, hbv⟩
  by_contra hne
  rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
  have hsep : ∀ y ∈ V \ P.zeroSet, y ∈ v → y ∉ u := fun y hy hyv hyu ↦
    (eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.1 hne) y ⟨hy, hyu, hyv⟩
  set f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ := fun y ↦ if y ∈ u then 1 else 0
  have hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (V \ P.zeroSet) := by
    intro y hy
    refine DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt ?_
    by_cases hyu : y ∈ u
    · refine (differentiableAt_const (1 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hu.mem_nhds hyu] with y' hy'
      simp [f, hy']
    · have hyv : y ∈ v := (hsuv hy).resolve_left hyu
      refine (differentiableAt_const (0 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [(hs.inter hv).mem_nhds ⟨hy, hyv⟩] with y' hy'
      simp [f, hsep y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFf⟩ := P.exists_differentiableOn_eqOn hV hVU hf
  have h01 : EqOn (fun y ↦ F y * (F y - 1)) (fun _ ↦ 0) V := by
    refine P.eqOn_of_eqOn_diff hV hVU (hF.continuousOn.mul (hF.continuousOn.sub
      continuousOn_const)) continuousOn_const fun y hy ↦ ?_
    rw [hFf hy]
    by_cases hyu : y ∈ u <;> simp [f, hyu]
  have hc := hF.continuousOn
  have hopen : ∀ c : ℂ, IsOpen (V ∩ F ⁻¹' Metric.ball c (1 / 2)) := fun c ↦
    hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hV Metric.isOpen_ball
  obtain ⟨y, hyV, hy0, hy1⟩ := hVc _ _ (hopen 0) (hopen 1) (fun y hy ↦ by
      have := h01 hy
      simp only [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at this
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, by simp [h]⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, by simp [h]⟩)
    ⟨b, hbs.1, hbs.1, by
      have : F b = 0 := by rw [hFf hbs]; simp [f, hsep b hbs hbv]
      simp [this]⟩
    ⟨a, has.1, has.1, by
      have : F a = 1 := by rw [hFf has]; simp [f, hau]
      simp [this]⟩
  have h1 := hy0.2
  have h2 := hy1.2
  simp only [mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] at h1 h2
  have : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ < 1 := calc
    ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = ‖F y - (F y - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ ‖F y‖ + ‖F y - 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ < 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 := add_lt_add h1 h2
    _ = 1 := by norm_num
  simp at this

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.exists_polynomial_of_infCoeff
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_of_infCoeff (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ i) {u | ‖u ^ (deg i : ℕ)‖ < ρ})
    {A : ℂ → ℂ} (hA : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (ball 0 ρ))
    (hAB : ∀ w ∈ overlap ρ, A w = infCoeff deg k φ l w w) :
    ∃ p : ℂ[X], p.degree < ↑((∑ i, (deg i : ℕ)) * k + 1) ∧
      EqOn A (fun w ↦ p.eval w) (ball 0 ρ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := zero_lt_one.trans hρ
  have hρi : ρ⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hρ
  set d := ∑ i, (deg i : ℕ)
  set B : ℂ → ℂ := fun w ↦ infCoeff deg k φ l w w
  have hS (i : ι) : IsOpen {u : ℂ | ‖u ^ (deg i : ℕ)‖ < ρ} :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_pow _)) continuous_const
  have hB (w₀ : ℂ) (hw₀ : ρ⁻¹ < ‖w₀‖) : DifferentiableAt ℂ B w₀ := by
    have hw₀0 : w₀ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 ((inv_pos.2 hρ0).trans hw₀)
    have heq : (fun w ↦ infCoeff deg k φ l w₀ w) =ᶠ[𝓝 w₀] B := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hw₀0] with w hw
      exact infCoeff_eq deg k φ l hw₀0 hw hw
    refine DifferentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ heq.symm
    refine BoundedSections.differentiableAt_coeff_prod_X_sub_C _ _ (fun ij _ ↦ ?_) l
    have hk := differentiableAt_kroot (deg ij.1) (w₁ := w₀) (w := w₀)
      (by rw [div_self hw₀0]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
    have hne := zeta_pow_mul_kroot_ne_zero (deg ij.1).ne_zero ij.2 hw₀0 hw₀0
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (φ ij.1)
        (Kummer.zeta (deg ij.1) ^ (ij.2 : ℕ) * kroot (deg ij.1) w₀ w₀)⁻¹ := by
      refine (hφ ij.1).differentiableAt ((hS ij.1).mem_nhds ?_)
      change ‖_‖ < ρ
      rw [norm_pow_inv_zeta_pow_mul_kroot (deg ij.1).ne_zero ij.2 hw₀0 hw₀0]
      exact inv_lt_of_inv_lt₀ hρ0 hw₀
    exact (differentiableAt_pow k).mul (hφd.comp w₀ ((hk.const_mul _).inv hne))
  set E : ℂ → ℂ := fun w ↦ if ‖w‖ < ρ then A w else B w
  have hEA (w : ℂ) (h : ‖w‖ < ρ) : E w = A w := if_pos h
  have hEB (w : ℂ) (h : ρ⁻¹ < ‖w‖) : E w = B w := by
    by_cases h' : ‖w‖ < ρ
    · rw [hEA w h']
      exact hAB w ⟨h, h'⟩
    · exact if_neg h'
  have hE : Differentiable ℂ E := by
    intro w₀
    by_cases h : ‖w₀‖ < ρ
    · have hn : ball (0 : ℂ) ρ ∈ 𝓝 w₀ := isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_zero_iff.2 h)
      refine (hA.differentiableAt hn).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hn] with w hw using hEA w (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hw)
    · have h' : ρ⁻¹ < ‖w₀‖ := hρi.trans (hρ.trans_le (not_lt.1 h))
      refine (hB w₀ h').congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds h'] with w hw
        using hEB w hw
  have hφb (i : ι) : ∃ c, ∀ u ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖φ i u‖ ≤ c :=
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hφ i).continuousOn.mono
      fun u hu ↦ by
        change ‖u ^ (deg i : ℕ)‖ < ρ
        rw [norm_pow]
        exact (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg u) (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 hu)).trans_lt hρ)
  choose c hc using hφb
  set C₀ := ∑ i, |c i|
  have hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
  have hφC (i : ι) (u : ℂ) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) : ‖φ i u‖ ≤ C₀ :=
    (hc i u (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hu)).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i ↦ |c i|) (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)))
  have hBb (w : ℂ) (hw : 1 ≤ ‖w‖) : ‖B w‖ ≤ (1 + C₀) ^ d * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (d * k) := by
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (zero_lt_one.trans_le hw)
    have hcard : (Finset.univ : Finset (Σ i, Fin (deg i))).card = d := by
      simp [d]
    have h₁ := BoundedSections.norm_coeff_prod_X_sub_C_le
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Σ i, Fin (deg i)))
      (fun ij ↦ w ^ k * φ ij.1
        (Kummer.zeta (deg ij.1) ^ (ij.2 : ℕ) * kroot (deg ij.1) w w)⁻¹)
      (M := ‖w‖ ^ k * C₀) (by positivity) (fun ij _ ↦ ?_) l
    · rw [hcard] at h₁
      refine h₁.trans ?_
      rw [pow_mul', ← mul_pow]
      refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ d
      have t₁ : 1 ≤ (1 + ‖w‖) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [norm_nonneg w])
      have t₂ : ‖w‖ ^ k ≤ (1 + ‖w‖) ^ k :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) (by linarith) k
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t₂ hC₀]
    · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hφC _ _ ?_) (by positivity)
      have h₂ := norm_pow_inv_zeta_pow_mul_kroot (deg ij.1).ne_zero ij.2 hw0 hw0
      rw [norm_pow] at h₂
      refine (pow_le_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (deg ij.1).ne_zero).1 ?_
      rw [h₂]
      exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hw
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hE.continuous.continuousOn
  set C := max ((1 + C₀) ^ d) C₂
  have hbound (t : ℂ) : ‖E t‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (d * k) := by
    have h₁ : 1 ≤ (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (d * k) := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [norm_nonneg t])
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + C₀) ^ d).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    by_cases ht : ‖t‖ ≤ 1
    · exact (hC₂ t (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 ht)).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans
        (le_mul_of_one_le_right hC h₁))
    · rw [hEB t (hρi.trans (not_le.1 ht))]
      exact (hBb t (not_le.1 ht).le).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _)
        (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hp⟩ := Differentiable.exists_polynomial_eq_of_norm_le_pow hE hbound
  exact ⟨p, hpdeg, fun w hw ↦ by rw [← hEA w (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hw), hp]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.eq_sum_lagrange_of_infCoeff
statement:
theorem eq_sum_lagrange_of_infCoeff (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ i) {u | ‖u ^ (deg i : ℕ)‖ < ρ})
    {A : ℂ → ℂ} (hA : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (ball 0 ρ))
    (hAB : ∀ w ∈ overlap ρ, A w = infCoeff deg k φ l w w)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : (∑ i, (deg i : ℕ)) * k < M) {w : Fin M → ℂ} (hw : Function.Injective w)
    (hwρ : ∀ ν, w ν ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :
    A z = ∑ ν, A (w ν) * (Lagrange.basis Finset.univ w ν).eval z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hp⟩ := exists_polynomial_of_infCoeff hρ hφ hA hAB
  have hdeg : p.degree < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M)).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact hpdeg.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hM)
  have h := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (s := Finset.univ) (v := w) hw.injOn hdeg
  have h1 : A z = p.eval z := hp hz
  rw [h1, h, Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  have h2 : A (w ν) = p.eval (w ν) := hp (hwρ ν)
  rw [eval_mul, eval_C, h2]

proof:
:= by

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.evalFun_eq_sum_of_evalVec
proof:
:= by
  have hV'G : V' ⊆ F.G := hV'V.trans hVG
  have hle : tubeN N V' hV' ≤ tubeN N V hV := tubeN_mono hV'V
  have hleB : tubeN N V' hV' ≤ tubeN N B hB := tubeN_mono (hV'V.trans hVB)
  set t₁ := D.capRestrict h₀ hle t
  have ht₁ : t₁ ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V' hV') (V' ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ) :=
    D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hle (prod_mono hV'V subset_rfl) ht
  set s₁ : Fin K → _ := fun k ↦ D.capRestrict h₀ hleB (s k)
  have hs₁ : ∀ k, s₁ k ∈ D.capPole h₀ n (tubeN N V' hV') (V' ×ˢ ball 0 F.ρ) := fun k ↦
    D.capRestrict_mem_capPole h₀ hleB (prod_mono (hV'V.trans hVB) subset_rfl) (hs k)
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, ht₂v, -⟩ := D.exists_capPole_sum h₀ hV'G hs₁ he
  obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := D.capPole_ext h₀ hV'G ht₁ ht₂ hM hw hwρ fun b hb ↦ funext fun x ↦ by
    rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hV'G hV'V _ hb, h b hb x,
      D.evalVec_eq_sum_of_evalFun h₀ hV'G hwρ ht₂v hb x]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [D.evalVec_capRestrict h₀ hwρ hV'G (hV'V.trans hVB) _ hb]
  intro y hy hyV'
  have hy' : y ∈ preim h₀ W (tubeN N V' hV') := by
    obtain ⟨hyN, -⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 ((mem_preim_iff h₀ W).1 hy)
    exact (mem_preim_iff h₀ W).2 (mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hyN, hyV'⟩)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun a : boundedSubring h₀ W _ ↦ evalFun a.1 y) h1
  simp only [t₁, capRestrict] at h2
  rw [evalFun_map W _ _ hy', ht₂v y hy'] at h2
  rw [h2]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [s₁, capRestrict]
  rw [evalFun_map W _ _ hy']

    differentiable_pi.2 fun j ↦ differentiable_apply _

  have h2 := (differentiable_mkPt.{u} (m := m) ((ofBase.{u} ∘ Prod.fst) p, p.2)).comp p

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.holFun_psi0
statement:
lemma holFun_psi0 {V : (space N).Opens} (r : (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).presheaf.obj
    (op (img0 N V))) {x : Cn.{u} (m + 1)} (hx : x ∈ img V) :
    holFun (psi0 N V r) x = (relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).eval (chart0Pt x)
      ((chart0Pt_mem_img0 N).2 hx) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxN, hxV⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
  rw [holFun_eq_eval _ hx, psi0, RingHom.comp_apply]
  erw [eval_presheaf_map]
  erw [eval_c_app (chart0Map N).toLRSHom (chart0Map N).isCLinear ⟨x, hxN⟩
    (le_preimage_img0 N V hxV)]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.psi0_res

lemma psi0_res {V₁ V₂ : (space N).Opens} (h : V₁ ≤ V₂)

    psi0 N V₁ ((relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).res
      ((isOpenEmbedding_chart0Map N).isOpenMap.functor.monotone h) r) =
      (space N).res h (psi0 N V₂ r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psi0, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  change (space N).res _ ((chart0Map N).toLRSHom.c.app _ ((relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).res _ r))
    = (space N).res h ((space N).res _ ((chart0Map N).toLRSHom.c.app _ r))
  rw [c_app_res, res_res, res_res]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.bijective_psi0
statement: lemma bijective_psi0 (V : (space N).Opens) : Function.Bijective (psi0 N V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r r' h
    refine eq_of_forall_eval_eq fun p hp ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (mem_img0 N).1 hp
    have := congrArg (fun q ↦ holFun q x) h
    rwa [holFun_psi0 N r hx, holFun_psi0 N r' hx] at this
  · intro q
    set S : TopologicalSpace.Opens ((Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ) := ⟨chartCoordHomeo '' (img V),
      chartCoordHomeo.isOpenMap _ (img V).isOpen⟩
    have hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p ↦ holFun q (chartCoordHomeo.symm p)) S := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hd := (differentiableOn_holFun q).differentiableAt ((img V).isOpen.mem_nhds hx)
      have hc : DifferentiableAt ℂ (chartCoordHomeo.symm : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ → Cn.{u} (m + 1))
          (chartCoordHomeo x) := differentiable_chartCoordHomeo_symm _
      have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℂ (holFun q) (chartCoordHomeo.symm (chartCoordHomeo x)) := by
        rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
        exact hd
      exact (hd'.comp _ hc).differentiableWithinAt
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_f0_eq S _ hF
    have hle : img0 N V ≤ chartBox 0 S := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (mem_img0 N).1 hp
      exact ⟨chartCoordHomeo x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(relProjectiveSpaceAn.{u} m 1).res hle a, eq_of_holFun_eq fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [holFun_psi0 N _ hx]
    erw [eval_presheaf_map]
    refine (f0_eq_eval a (p := chartCoordHomeo x) (hle ((chart0Pt_mem_img0 N).2 hx))).symm.trans ?_
    rw [ha _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.chartPt_one_eq_chartPt_zero
statement:
lemma chartPt_one_eq_chartPt_zero {p q : (Fin m → ℂ) × ℂ}
    (h : chartPt.{u} 1 p = chartPt.{u} 0 q) : p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ q = (p.1, p.2⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q.2 ≠ 0 := (chartPt_zero_mem_range_chart_one_iff q).1 ⟨cpt p, h⟩
  rw [chartPt_zero_eq_chartPt_one hq] at h
  have e := chartPt_injective 1 h
  have hp : p.2 ≠ 0 := by rw [e]; exact inv_ne_zero hq
  refine ⟨hp, Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.fst e).symm ?_⟩
  rw [e, inv_inv]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.exists_partner
statement:
lemma exists_partner {i : D.ι} {x : Cn.{u} (m + 1)} (hx : x ∈ D.kPiece i) (h0 : D.kVal x ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ‖D.kVal x‖⁻¹ < F.ρ) :
    ∃ z : KummerAnnulus.base F.G F.ρ⁻¹ F.ρ (D.deg i), D.kPt i (invCoord z.1) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : D.kCoord x ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ h0 (by rw [D.kVal_eq_kCoord_pow hx, h, zero_pow
    (D.deg i).ne_zero])
  have hk := D.kVal_eq_kCoord_pow hx
  have hlt : ‖D.kVal x‖ < F.ρ := by rw [D.kVal_of_mem hx]; exact hx.2
  refine ⟨⟨(baseOf x, (D.kCoord x)⁻¹), hx.1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · change F.ρ⁻¹ < ‖(D.kCoord x)⁻¹‖ ^ (D.deg i : ℕ)
    rw [norm_inv, inv_pow, ← norm_pow, ← hk]
    exact inv_lt_inv₀ F.pos_ρ (norm_pos_iff.2 h0) |>.2 hlt
  · change ‖(D.kCoord x)⁻¹‖ ^ (D.deg i : ℕ) < F.ρ
    rw [norm_inv, inv_pow, ← norm_pow, ← hk]
    exact hρ
  · simp only [invCoord, inv_inv]
    exact D.kPt_kCoord hx

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.kVal_ne_zero_of_mem_img0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxK, hxV⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (mem_img0 N).1 hxV
  change chartPt 0 _ = D.kMap.toLRSHom.base _ at hyx
  rw [D.kMap_base] at hyx
  obtain ⟨h0, e⟩ := chartPt_one_eq_chartPt_zero hyx.symm
  refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
  have hyN : y ∈ N := img_le V y hy
  have := ((F.mem_N y).1 hyN).2
  have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
  simp only at e2
  rw [← norm_inv, ← e2]
  exact this

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.isBddOn_capWVal
statement:
lemma isBddOn_capWVal {V : (space N).Opens} (s : D.capModule.val.obj (op (img0 N V))) :
    IsBddOn W V (capWVal s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxN₀
  have hxP : chart0Pt x ∈ img0 N V := (chart0Pt_mem_img0 N).2 hx
  obtain ⟨M, hM, C, hC⟩ := wPart_isBoundedNear s.1 (chart0Pt x) hxP
    ⟨x, ⟨img_le V x hx, hxN₀⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨chart0Pt ⁻¹' M, continuous_chart0Pt.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hM, C,
    fun w hwM hwV ↦ ?_⟩
  have hw : w ∈ (Opens.map (projW W).toLRSHom.base).obj (img0 N V) := by
    change (projW W).toLRSHom.base w ∈ img0 N V
    rw [projW_base]
    exact (chart0Pt_mem_img0 N).2 hwV
  have := hC w hw (by rw [projW_base]; exact hwM)
  rwa [capWVal, evalFun_of_mem _ hw]

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.injective_phi0
statement: lemma injective_phi0 (V : (space N).Opens) : Function.Injective (phi0 (D := D) h₀ V)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have hW : ∀ w ∈ (Opens.map (projW W).toLRSHom.base).obj (img0 N V),
      capWVal s w = capWVal t w := fun w hw ↦ by
    have hw' := (mem_preimW_img0_iff h₀).1 hw
    rw [← evalFun_phi0 h₀ s hw', ← evalFun_phi0 h₀ t hw', h]
  refine capModule_ext hW fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hxK, -⟩ := mem_img_iff.1 hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := D.mem_kOpens.1 hxK
  obtain ⟨h0, hρ⟩ := kVal_ne_zero_of_mem_img0 N hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_partner hi h0 hρ
  have hzO := kMap_toFun_mem_img0 N hx hz
  rw [← hz, ← capWVal_compat s i z hzO, ← capWVal_compat t i z hzO]
  exact hW _ hzO

name: ComplexAnalytic.Cap.AnnulusDecomposition.kFunOf_of_mem
