  have hN : ∀ x, x ∈ D.N' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ N := fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl
  have P := isPuiseuxPullback_puiseuxCover hN₀' W D.pos
  set W' := puiseuxCover hN₀' W
  set c := D.config
  set h₀' := D.N₀'_le h₀
  
  set y₁ := coordRoot d.it D.s x₀.1
  have hy₁ : coordPow d.it D.s y₁ = x₀.1 := coordPow_coordRoot D.pos.ne' _
  have hy₁N : y₁ ∈ D.N' := (hN y₁).2 (hy₁ ▸ x₀.2)
  have hy₁t : y₁ d.it ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ ht (by
    rw [← hy₁, coordPow_self, h, zero_pow D.pos.ne'])
  obtain ⟨Ue, k, e, hy₁Ue, hfreeE⟩ := c.exists_isFreeSpanAt_of_subsingleton h₀' W' hy₁N
    fun i j hi hj ↦ by
      by_contra hij
      exact c.ψ_ne_of_ne hij (mem_cyl_of_mem hy₁N) hy₁t (hi.trans hj.symm)
  obtain ⟨Vb, -, r, b, -, hy₁Vb, -, hspan, hindep⟩ :=
    hfreeE ⟨y₁, hy₁N⟩ (mem_img_iff.1 hy₁Ue).2
  obtain ⟨V₀, P₀, hV₀, hP₀Vb, hP⟩ := exists_isPiece D.pos hy₁t
    ((img Vb).isOpen.mem_nhds (mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hy₁N, hy₁Vb⟩))
  rw [hy₁] at hV₀
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hP.existsUnique y₁ (by rw [mem_preimage, hy₁]; exact hV₀)
  set y₂ := coordRot d.it (zeta D.s ^ (l : ℕ)) y₁
  have hy₂ : coordPow d.it D.s y₂ = x₀.1 := by
    rw [coordPow_coordRot (zeta_pow_pow D.pos _), hy₁]
  have hy₂Vb : y₂ ∈ img Vb := hP₀Vb hl
  have hy₂N : y₂ ∈ D.N' := img_le Vb _ hy₂Vb
  
  let V : (space N).Opens := ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' V₀, hP.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hV : ∀ x ∈ img V, x ∈ V₀ := fun x hx ↦ (mem_img_iff.1 hx).2
  have hx₀V : x₀ ∈ V := hV₀
  let σ : Fin r → (boundedModule h₀' W').val.obj (op (pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' V)) :=
    fun k ↦ P.spread hN hP hP₀Vb hV (b k)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQVb, hQpull, hy₂Q, hQP⟩ : ∃ Q : (space D.N').Opens, Q ≤ Vb ∧
      Q ≤ pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' V ∧ (⟨y₂, hy₂N⟩ : space D.N') ∈ Q ∧ ∀ z ∈ Q, z.1 ∈ P₀ :=
    ⟨Vb ⊓ pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' V ⊓ ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' P₀,
      hP.isOpen_piece.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩, inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left,
      inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right, ⟨⟨(mem_img_iff.1 hy₂Vb).2,
        show coordPow d.it D.s y₂ ∈ img V by rw [hy₂]; exact mem_img_iff.2 ⟨x₀.2, hx₀V⟩⟩, hl⟩,
      fun _ hz ↦ hz.2⟩
  have hfree : IsFreeSpanAt h₀' W' σ ⟨y₂, hy₂N⟩ := by
    refine isFreeSpanAt_of_basis hQpull
      (fun k ↦ sectRes (boundedModule h₀' W') hQVb (b k))
      (fun V'' h a ↦ ?_) (fun V'' h c' hc' ↦ hindep V'' (h.trans hQVb) c' ?_) le_rfl hy₂Q
      (fun k i ↦ if k = i then 1 else 0) fun k ↦ ?_
    · obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hspan V'' (h.trans hQVb) a
      exact ⟨c', by simpa only [sectRes_sectRes] using hc'⟩
    · simpa only [sectRes_sectRes] using hc'
    · simp only [ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      refine secVal_ext h₀' W' fun w hw ↦ ?_
      have hwP : pt W' w ∈ P₀ := by
        have := hQP _ ((mem_preim_iff h₀' W').1 hw |> mem_img_iff.1).2
        exact this
      have hwpull : w ∈ preim h₀' W' (pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' V) := preim_mono h₀' W' hQpull hw
      rw [evalFun_secVal_sectRes _ _ hw, evalFun_secVal_sectRes _ _ hw]
      exact (P.evalFun_spread_of_mem hN hP hP₀Vb hV (b k) hwpull hwP).symm.trans
        (evalFun_secVal_sectRes (h₀ := h₀') (W := W') hQpull (σ k) hw).symm
  exact isCoherentAt_of_isFreeSpanAt _ _
    (P.isFreeSpanAt_avgSec_of_ne_zero hN σ hx₀V ht hy₂ hfree)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.coordPow_of_eq_zero
statement: lemma coordPow_of_eq_zero {x : Cn.{u} n} (ht : x d.it = 0) : coordPow d.it D.s x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordPow, ht, zero_pow D.pos.ne', ← ht, Function.update_eq_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.isCoherentAt_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isCoherentAt_of_eq_zero {x₀ : space N} (ht : x₀.1 d.it = 0) :
    IsCoherentAt (d.N₀t_le.trans h₀) W x₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hN₀' : ∀ x, x ∈ D.N₀' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ d.N₀t := D.mem_N₀'_iff
  have hN : ∀ x, x ∈ D.N' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ N := fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl
  have P := isPuiseuxPullback_puiseuxCover hN₀' W D.pos
  set W' := puiseuxCover hN₀' W
  set c := D.config
  set h₀' := D.N₀'_le h₀
  have hx₀N' : x₀.1 ∈ D.N' := (hN _).2 ((d.coordPow_of_eq_zero D ht).symm ▸ x₀.2)
  
  obtain ⟨V', m, σ₀, hx₀V', hgen⟩ :=
    (IsCoherentAt.of_isCoherent h₀' W' (c.isCoherent h₀' W') ⟨x₀.1, hx₀N'⟩).1
  
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : ∃ x₁ : Cn.{u} n, x₁ = x₀.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht₁ : x₁ d.it = 0 := hx₁ ▸ ht
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (img V').isOpen x₁
    (hx₁ ▸ mem_img_iff.2 ⟨hx₀N', hx₀V'⟩)
  have hδ : 0 < min ε (ε ^ D.s) := lt_min hε (pow_pos hε _)
  let U : (space N).Opens := opensOf N (isOpen_ball (x := x₁) (ε := min ε (ε ^ D.s)))
  have hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U := by
    have hmem : x₁ ∈ ball x₁ (min ε (ε ^ D.s)) := mem_ball_self hδ
    nth_rewrite 2 [hx₁] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hUV' : pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' U ≤ V' := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ : ∃ y₁ : Cn.{u} n, y₁ = y.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h₁ : coordPow d.it D.s y₁ ∈ ball x₁ (min ε (ε ^ D.s)) := hy₁ ▸ (mem_img_iff.1 hy).2
    have h₂ : y₁ ∈ ball x₁ ε := by
      rw [mem_ball, dist_pi_lt_iff hε]
      rw [mem_ball, dist_pi_lt_iff hδ] at h₁
      intro j
      have hj := h₁ j
      by_cases hjt : j = d.it
      · subst hjt
        rw [coordPow_self, ht₁, dist_zero_right, norm_pow] at hj
        rw [ht₁, dist_zero_right]
        exact (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hε.le D.pos.ne').1
          (hj.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
      · rw [coordPow_of_ne _ _ hjt] at hj
        exact hj.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
    have := (mem_img_iff.1 (hball h₂)).2
    rwa [show (⟨y₁, _⟩ : space D.N') = y from Subtype.ext hy₁] at this
  let σ : Fin m → (boundedModule h₀' W').val.obj (op (pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' U)) :=
    fun i ↦ sectRes (boundedModule h₀' W') hUV' (σ₀ i)
  
  set S' : Set (Cn.{u} n) := {x | x d.it = 0 ∧ ∃ j, x d.iw = D.ψ j x}
  have hfree : ∀ y' ∈ pullOpens d.it D.s D.N' U, y'.1 ∉ S' → IsFreeSpanAt h₀' W' σ y' := by
    intro y' hy' hyS
    have hsub : ∀ i j, c.ψ i y'.1 = y'.1 c.iw → c.ψ j y'.1 = y'.1 c.iw → i = j := by
      intro i j hi hj
      by_cases ht' : y'.1 d.it = 0
      · exact absurd ⟨ht', i, hi.symm⟩ hyS
      · by_contra hij
        exact c.ψ_ne_of_ne hij (mem_cyl_of_mem y'.2) ht' (hi.trans hj.symm)
    obtain ⟨Ue, k, e, hy'Ue, hfreeE⟩ := c.exists_isFreeSpanAt_of_subsingleton h₀' W' y'.2 hsub
    refine isFreeSpanAt_of_locGen (hfreeE y' (mem_img_iff.1 hy'Ue).2) hy'
      fun W'' h t hy'W ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨W''', h', hy''', c', hc'⟩ := hgen W'' (h.trans hUV') t y' hy'W
    exact ⟨W''', h', hy''', c', by rw [hc']; simp only [σ, sectRes_sectRes]⟩
  
  have hSig : ∀ y ∈ U, y.1 ∉ {x : Cn.{u} n | x d.it = 0 ∧ d.val x = 0} →
      IsFreeSpanAt (d.N₀t_le.trans h₀) W (P.avgSec hN σ) y := by
    intro y hyU hySig
    refine P.isFreeSpanAt_avgSec hN σ hfree hyU ?_ ?_
    · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxy⟩
      rw [d.coordPow_of_eq_zero D hxS.1] at hxy
      subst hxy
      refine hySig ⟨hxS.1, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hxS.2
      have hxN' : y.1 ∈ D.N' := (hN _).2 ((d.coordPow_of_eq_zero D hxS.1).symm ▸ y.2)
      have hprod := D.prod_eq_of_mem (mem_cyl_of_mem hxN')
      rw [d.coordPow_of_eq_zero D hxS.1] at hprod
      rw [val, hprod, eval_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (by rw [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, hj, sub_self])
    · by_cases hyt : y.1 d.it = 0
      · right
        have hyN₀ : y.1 ∈ N₀ := (d.mem_iff y.1 y.2).2 fun h ↦ hySig ⟨hyt, h⟩
        obtain ⟨U₂, k, e, hyU₂, hfreeE⟩ := d.exists_isFreeSpanAt_of_mem h₀ W hyN₀
        exact ⟨U₂, k, e, hfreeE y (mem_img_iff.1 hyU₂).2⟩
      · exact Or.inl hyt
  
  refine isCoherentAt_of_criterion (d.N₀t_le.trans h₀) W d.hasThinComplement
    (RegularPairFamily.ofCoord (img U).isOpen d.it (h := d.val)
      (d.differentiableOn_val.mono fun x hx ↦ d.subset_region x (img_le U x hx))
      fun z _ hzt _ hev ↦ d.not_eventually_val z ?_)
    (P.avgSec hN σ) hx₀U ?_ hSig
  · filter_upwards [hev] with y hy hyt
    exact hy (hyt.trans hzt)
  · rw [RegularPairFamily.ofCoord_zeroSet]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.isCoherent
statement:
theorem isCoherent (h₀ : N₀ ≤ N) (W : FiniteEtaleOver (space N₀)) [T2Space W.left] :
    (boundedModule h₀ W).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := d.nonempty_puiseuxData
  have hp : Function.update (0 : Cn.{u} n) d.it (d.r : ℂ) ∉ N₀ := fun h ↦ by
    have := (d.mem_region _ (h₀ h)).2
    rw [Function.update_self, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg d.pos.le] at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  have hβ := isMapPullback_mapCover (restrictMap d.N₀t_le hp) W
  refine isCoherent_of_forall_isCoherentAt h₀ W fun x ↦ isCoherentAt_of_restrict
    (h₀ := h₀) d.N₀t_le hβ (fun _ hx ↦ restrictMap_χ d.N₀t_le hp hx)
    (g := fun x : Cn.{u} n ↦ x d.it) (differentiable_apply d.it).differentiableOn
    (subset_empty_iff.1 ((interior_mono inter_subset_right).trans
      (interior_setOf_apply_eq_zero d.it).subset))
    (fun x hx ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hx, h⟩⟩) ?_
  by_cases ht : x.1 d.it = 0
  · exact d.isCoherentAt_of_eq_zero h₀ D _ ht
  · exact d.isCoherentAt_of_ne_zero h₀ D _ ht

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.baseProj_apply
statement:
lemma baseProj_apply (x : Cn.{u} n) (j : ULift.{u} (Fin n)) :
    baseProj it iw x j = if j = iw ∨ j = it then 0 else x j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : j = iw
  · subst hw
    simp [baseProj]
  · by_cases ht : j = it
    · subst ht
      simp [baseProj, Function.update_of_ne hw]
    · simp [baseProj, hw, ht]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.baseProj_update_iw
statement:
lemma baseProj_update_iw (x : Cn.{u} n) (a : ℂ) :
    baseProj it iw (Function.update x iw a) = baseProj it iw x
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [baseProj_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (not_or.1 h).1]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.baseProj_update_it
statement:
lemma baseProj_update_it (x : Cn.{u} n) (a : ℂ) :
    baseProj it iw (Function.update x it a) = baseProj it iw x
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [baseProj_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (not_or.1 h).2]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.baseProj_baseProj
statement: lemma baseProj_baseProj (x : Cn.{u} n) : baseProj it iw (baseProj it iw x) = baseProj it iw x
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [baseProj_apply]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.baseProj_coordPow
statement:
lemma baseProj_coordPow (s : ℕ) (x : Cn.{u} n) :
    baseProj it iw (coordPow it s x) = baseProj it iw x
proof:
:=
  baseProj_update_it x _

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.differentiable_baseProj
statement: lemma differentiable_baseProj : Differentiable ℂ (baseProj (n := n) it iw)
proof:
:=
  differentiableOn_univ.1 (differentiableOn_update (differentiableOn_update differentiableOn_id
    (differentiableOn_const 0) it) (differentiableOn_const 0) iw)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.update_baseProj_it
statement:
lemma update_baseProj_it (hne : it ≠ iw) (x : Cn.{u} n) :
    Function.update (baseProj it iw x) it (x it) = Function.update x iw 0
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases ht : j = it
  · subst ht
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hne]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne ht, baseProj_apply]
    by_cases hw : j = iw
    · subst hw
      simp
    · simp [hw, ht]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.map_update
statement:
lemma map_update (x : Cn.{u} n) (a : ℂ) :
    d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) (Function.update x d.iw a)) =
      d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) x)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp [d.coeff_update]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.val_update
statement:
lemma val_update (x : Cn.{u} n) (a : ℂ) :
    d.val (Function.update x d.iw a) = (d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) x)).eval a
proof:
:= by
  rw [val, map_update, Function.update_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.map_ne_zero
statement: lemma map_ne_zero (x : Cn.{u} n) : d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) x) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (d.monic.map _).ne_zero

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.not_eventually_eval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma not_eventually_eval_eq_zero {q : ℂ[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) (c : ℂ) :
    ¬ ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), q.eval (c + ε) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hinf : {ε : ℂ | q.eval (c + ε) = 0}.Infinite := infinite_of_mem_nhds 0 h
  refine hq (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot q ?_)
  have : (fun ε ↦ c + ε) '' {ε : ℂ | q.eval (c + ε) = 0} ⊆ {a | q.IsRoot a} := by
    rintro _ ⟨ε, hε, rfl⟩
    exact hε
  exact ((hinf.image (add_right_injective c).injOn)).mono this

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.not_eventually_val
statement: lemma not_eventually_val (x : Cn.{u} n) : ¬ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y d.it = x d.it → d.val y = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht : Tendsto (fun ε : ℂ ↦ Function.update x d.iw (x d.iw + ε)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 x) := by
    have hc : Continuous fun ε : ℂ ↦ Function.update x d.iw (x d.iw + ε) :=
      continuous_const.update d.iw (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    simpa using hc.tendsto 0
  refine not_eventually_eval_eq_zero (d.map_ne_zero x) (x d.iw) ?_
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually h] with ε hε
  rw [← d.val_update]
  exact hε (Function.update_of_ne d.it_ne_iw _ _)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.isOpen_region
statement: lemma isOpen_region : IsOpen d.region
proof:
:=
  (d.isOpen.preimage differentiable_baseProj.continuous).inter
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_apply d.it).norm continuous_const)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.differentiableOn_val
statement: lemma differentiableOn_val : DifferentiableOn ℂ d.val d.region
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x, d.val x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d.P.natDegree + 1), d.P.coeff k x * x d.iw ^ k :=
    fun x ↦ by
      rw [val, eval_eq_sum_range, d.monic.natDegree_map]
      simp [coeff_map]
  have : d.val = fun x ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d.P.natDegree + 1), d.P.coeff k x * x d.iw ^ k :=
    funext h
  rw [this]
  exact DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun k _ ↦ (d.differentiableOn_coeff k).mul
    ((differentiable_apply d.iw).pow k).differentiableOn

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.subset_region
statement: lemma subset_region : ∀ x ∈ N, x ∈ d.region
proof:
:=
  d.mem_region

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.Q_coeff
statement: lemma Q_coeff (k : ℕ) (p : Cn.{u} n × ℂ) : d.Q.coeff k p = d.P.coeff k (d.sec p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q, coeff_map]
  rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.Q_monic
statement: lemma Q_monic : d.Q.Monic
proof:
:=
  d.monic.map _

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.Q_map_eval
statement:
lemma Q_map_eval (p : Cn.{u} n × ℂ) :
    d.Q.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) p) = d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) (d.sec p))
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp [Q_coeff]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.sec_baseProj
statement: lemma sec_baseProj (x : Cn.{u} n) (t : ℂ) : d.sec (baseProj d.it d.iw x, t) = d.sec (x, t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sec, baseProj_baseProj]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.P_map_eq
statement:
lemma P_map_eq (x : Cn.{u} n) : d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) x) =
    d.Q.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) (baseProj d.it d.iw x, x d.it))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q_map_eval, sec_baseProj, sec, update_baseProj_it d.it_ne_iw, map_update]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.convex_G'
statement: lemma convex_G' : Convex ℝ d.G'
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ (baseProj (n := n) d.it d.iw) := by
    constructor
    · intro x y
      funext j
      simp only [baseProj, Pi.add_apply]
      by_cases hw : j = d.iw
      · subst hw; simp
      by_cases ht : j = d.it
      · subst ht; simp [Function.update_of_ne hw]
      · simp [Function.update_of_ne hw, Function.update_of_ne ht]
    · intro c x
      funext j
      simp only [baseProj, Pi.smul_apply]
      by_cases hw : j = d.iw
      · subst hw; simp
      by_cases ht : j = d.it
      · subst ht; simp [Function.update_of_ne hw]
      · simp [Function.update_of_ne hw, Function.update_of_ne ht]
  exact d.convex.is_linear_preimage hlin

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.isOpen_G'
statement: lemma isOpen_G' : IsOpen d.G'
proof:
:=
  d.isOpen.preimage differentiable_baseProj.continuous

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.sec_mem_region
statement:
lemma sec_mem_region {p : Cn.{u} n × ℂ} (hp : p.1 ∈ d.G') (ht : ‖p.2‖ < d.r) :
    d.sec p ∈ d.region
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sec, baseProj_update_it, baseProj_baseProj]
    exact hp
  · rwa [sec, Function.update_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.differentiableOn_Q_coeff
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_Q_coeff (k : ℕ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (d.Q.coeff k) (d.G' ×ˢ ball 0 d.r)
proof:
:= by
  have hsec : Differentiable ℂ d.sec := differentiableOn_univ.1
    (differentiableOn_update (fun e _ ↦ ((differentiable_baseProj (it := d.it) (iw := d.iw)
      e.1).comp e differentiableAt_fst).differentiableWithinAt)
      differentiable_snd.differentiableOn d.it)
  have : d.Q.coeff k = fun p ↦ d.P.coeff k (d.sec p) := funext (d.Q_coeff k)
  rw [this]
  exact (d.differentiableOn_coeff k).comp hsec.differentiableOn fun p hp ↦
    d.sec_mem_region hp.1 (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hp.2)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.separable_Q
statement:
lemma separable_Q {y : Cn.{u} n} (hy : y ∈ d.G') {x : ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxr : ‖x‖ < d.r) :
    (d.Q.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) (y, x))).Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q_map_eval]
  have hmem := d.sec_mem_region (p := (y, x)) hy hxr
  refine d.separable _ hmem.1 hmem.2 ?_
  rwa [sec, Function.update_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.nonempty_puiseuxData
statement: theorem nonempty_puiseuxData : Nonempty d.PuiseuxData
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ρ, φ, hρ, hρs, hφd, hprod, -, hinj⟩ := Puiseux.exists_prod_eq_of_radius
    d.convex_G' d.isOpen_G' d.pos d.Q_monic d.differentiableOn_Q_coeff
    fun y hy x hx hxr ↦ d.separable_Q hy hx hxr
  exact ⟨⟨s, s.pos, ρ, hρ, hρs, φ, hφd, hprod, fun y hy t ht htr ↦ hinj y hy t ht htr⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.mem_N₀t
statement: lemma mem_N₀t {x : Cn.{u} n} : x ∈ d.N₀t ↔ x ∈ N₀ ∧ x d.it ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.N₀t_le
statement: lemma N₀t_le : d.N₀t ≤ N₀
proof:
:=
  inf_le_left

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.mem_N'
statement: lemma mem_N' {x : Cn.{u} n} : x ∈ D.N' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ N
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.mem_N₀'
statement: lemma mem_N₀' {x : Cn.{u} n} : x ∈ D.N₀' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ d.N₀t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.N₀'_le
statement: lemma N₀'_le (h₀ : N₀ ≤ N) : D.N₀' ≤ D.N'
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ h₀ (d.N₀t_le hx)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.mem_N₀'_iff
statement: lemma mem_N₀'_iff (x : Cn.{u} n) : x ∈ D.N₀' ↔ coordPow d.it D.s x ∈ d.N₀t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.pow_lt_iff
statement: lemma pow_lt_iff {a : ℂ} : ‖a‖ ^ D.s < d.r ↔ ‖a‖ < D.ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.pow_ρ]
  exact pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg a) D.ρ_pos.le D.pos.ne'

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.mem_of_mem_cyl
statement:
lemma mem_of_mem_cyl {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x ∈ cyl D.N' d.iw) :
    (baseProj d.it d.iw x, x d.it) ∈ d.G' ×ˢ ball (0 : ℂ) D.ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := d.mem_region _ ((D.mem_N').1 ha)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change baseProj d.it d.iw (baseProj d.it d.iw x) ∈ d.G
    rwa [baseProj_baseProj, ← baseProj_update_iw x a, ← baseProj_coordPow D.s]
  · rw [coordPow_self, Function.update_of_ne d.it_ne_iw, norm_pow, D.pow_lt_iff] at h₂
    exact mem_ball_zero_iff.2 h₂

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.differentiableOn_ψ
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_ψ (j : Fin d.Q.natDegree) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (D.ψ j) (cyl D.N' d.iw)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Differentiable ℂ fun x : Cn.{u} n ↦ ((baseProj d.it d.iw x, x d.it) : Cn.{u} n × ℂ) :=
    differentiable_baseProj.prodMk (differentiable_apply d.it)
  exact (D.differentiableOn j).comp hm.differentiableOn fun x hx ↦ D.mem_of_mem_cyl hx

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.exists_contact
statement:
lemma exists_contact : ∃ k : Fin d.Q.natDegree → Fin d.Q.natDegree → ℕ,
    Codim2.IsContactFamily (d.G' ×ˢ ball 0 D.ρ) D.φ k
proof:
:=
  Codim2.isContactFamily_of_injective d.isOpen_G' d.convex_G'.isPreconnected D.differentiableOn
    fun z hz hz0 ↦ D.injective z.1 hz.1 z.2 hz0 (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz.2)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.prod_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma prod_eq_of_mem {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x ∈ cyl D.N' d.iw) :
    d.P.map (Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ℂ) (coordPow d.it D.s x)) = ∏ j, (X - C (D.ψ j x))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := D.mem_of_mem_cyl hx
  rw [d.P_map_eq, baseProj_coordPow, coordPow_self]
  exact D.prod_eq _ hmem.1 _ hmem.2

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BPointData.PuiseuxData.mem_N₀'_iff_graphs
statement:
lemma mem_N₀'_iff_graphs (x : Cn.{u} n) (hx : x ∈ D.N') :
    x ∈ D.N₀' ↔ x d.it ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ j, x d.iw ≠ D.ψ j x
proof:
:= by
  have hcyl : x ∈ cyl D.N' d.iw := mem_cyl_of_mem hx
  refine ((D.mem_N₀'_iff x).trans d.mem_N₀t).trans ?_
  refine (and_congr (d.mem_iff _ ((D.mem_N').1 hx)) Iff.rfl).trans ?_
  rw [coordPow_self, coordPow_of_ne _ _ d.it_ne_iw.symm, D.prod_eq_of_mem hcyl,
    eval_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, and_comm, pow_ne_zero_iff D.pos.ne']
  simp [sub_eq_zero]

name: Codim2.mem_graphs
statement:
lemma mem_graphs {V : Set (E × ℂ)} {ψ : ι → E × ℂ → ℂ} {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} :
    x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔ x.1 ∈ V ∧ ∃ i, x.2 = ψ i x.1
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Codim2.mem_vertical
statement:
lemma mem_vertical {V : Set (E × ℂ)} {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} :
    x ∈ vertical V ↔ x.1 ∈ V ∧ x.1.2 = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.mono
statement:
lemma mono (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) {W : Set (E × ℂ)} (hWV : W ⊆ V) :
    IsContactFamily W ψ k where
  differentiableOn i
proof:
:= (h.differentiableOn i).mono hWV
  exists_unit i j hij := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu0, hψu⟩ := h.exists_unit i j hij
    exact ⟨u, hu.mono hWV, fun z hz ↦ hu0 z (hWV hz), fun z hz ↦ hψu z (hWV hz)⟩

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.comp
statement:
lemma comp (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) {ι' : Type*} {e : ι' → ι} (he : Function.Injective e) :
    IsContactFamily V (fun i ↦ ψ (e i)) (fun i j ↦ k (e i) (e j)) where
  differentiableOn i
proof:
:= h.differentiableOn (e i)
  exists_unit i j hij := h.exists_unit (e i) (e j) (he.ne hij)

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.eq_iff_one_le
statement:
lemma eq_iff_one_le (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {z : E × ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ V) (hz0 : z.2 = 0) : ψ i z = ψ j z ↔ 1 ≤ k i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, -, hu0, hψu⟩ := h.exists_unit i j hij
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, hψu z hz, hz0, mul_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff', Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
  simp [hu0 z hz]

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.one_le_of_eq
statement:
lemma one_le_of_eq (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {z : E × ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ V) (hz0 : z.2 = 0) (he : ψ i z = ψ j z) : 1 ≤ k i j
proof:
:=
  (h.eq_iff_one_le hij hz hz0).1 he

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.ne_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma ne_of_ne_zero (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {z : E × ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ V) (hz0 : z.2 ≠ 0) : ψ i z ≠ ψ j z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, -, hu0, hψu⟩ := h.exists_unit i j hij
  rw [ne_eq, ← sub_eq_zero, hψu z hz]
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hz0) (hu0 z hz)

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.eventually_mem_graphs_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_graphs_iff [Finite ι] (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) (hV : IsOpen V)
    {z₀ : E × ℂ} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ V) (w₀ : ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (z₀, w₀), x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔
      x ∈ graphs V (fun i : {i // ψ i z₀ = w₀} ↦ ψ i)
proof:
:= by
  have hev (i : ι) (hi : ψ i z₀ ≠ w₀) : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (z₀, w₀), x.2 ≠ ψ i x.1 := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2 - ψ i x.1) (z₀, w₀) :=
      continuousAt_snd.sub (((h.differentiableOn i).continuousOn.continuousAt
        (hV.mem_nhds hz₀)).comp continuousAt_fst)
    filter_upwards [hc.eventually_ne (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hi))] with x hx
    exact sub_ne_zero.1 hx
  have hall : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (z₀, w₀), ∀ i, ψ i z₀ ≠ w₀ → x.2 ≠ ψ i x.1 :=
    eventually_all.2 fun i ↦ by
      by_cases hi : ψ i z₀ = w₀
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x h ↦ absurd hi h
      · exact (hev i hi).mono fun x hx _ ↦ hx
  filter_upwards [hall] with x hx
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hxV, i, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨hxV, ?_⟩, fun ⟨hxV, i, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨hxV, i, hi⟩⟩
  by_cases hi' : ψ i z₀ = w₀
  · exact ⟨⟨i, hi'⟩, hi⟩
  · exact absurd hi (hx i hi')

name: Codim2.IsContactFamily.blowup
statement:
theorem blowup (h : IsContactFamily V ψ k) (hV : IsOpen V) (i₀ : ι)
    (hk : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 1 ≤ k i j) :
    ∃ χ : ι → E × ℂ → ℂ, (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V, ψ i z = ψ i₀ z + z.2 * χ i z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, χ i₀ z = 0) ∧ IsContactFamily V χ fun i j ↦ k i j - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdiv (i : ι) : ∃ χ : E × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ χ V ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, ψ i z - ψ i₀ z = z.2 * χ z) ∧ (i = i₀ → ∀ z ∈ V, χ z = 0) := by
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      exact ⟨0, differentiableOn_const 0, fun z _ ↦ by simp, fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, -, hψu⟩ := h.exists_unit i i₀ hi
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ z.2 ^ (k i i₀ - 1) * u z, (differentiableOn_snd.pow _).mul hu,
      fun z hz ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ absurd h hi⟩
    rw [hψu z hz, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (hk i i₀ hi)]
  choose χ hχ hψχ hχ₀ using hdiv
  refine ⟨χ, fun i z hz ↦ by rw [← hψχ i z hz, add_sub_cancel], hχ₀ i₀ rfl, hχ, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu0, hψu⟩ := h.exists_unit i j hij
  refine ⟨u, hu, hu0, ?_⟩
  have hZ := interior_inter_preimage_snd_zero V
  refine EqOn.of_eqOn_diff_zero hV hZ ((hχ i).sub (hχ j)).continuousOn
    ((differentiableOn_snd.pow _).mul hu).continuousOn fun z hz ↦ ?_
  have hz0 : z.2 ≠ 0 := hz.2
  have h₁ : z.2 * (χ i z - χ j z) = z.2 * (z.2 ^ (k i j - 1) * u z) := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← hψχ i z hz.1, ← hψχ j z hz.1, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, hψu z hz.1,
      ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (hk i j hij)]
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hz0 h₁

name: Codim2.isContactFamily_of_injective
statement:
theorem isContactFamily_of_injective [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] {G : Set E} (hGo : IsOpen G)
    (hG : IsPreconnected G) {r : ℝ} {ψ : ι → E × ℂ → ℂ}
    (hψ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) (G ×ˢ ball 0 r))
    (hinj : ∀ z ∈ G ×ˢ ball (0 : ℂ) r, z.2 ≠ 0 → Function.Injective fun i ↦ ψ i z) :
    ∃ k : ι → ι → ℕ, IsContactFamily (G ×ˢ ball 0 r) ψ k
proof:
:= by
  have h (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) := exists_eq_pow_mul hGo hG ((hψ i).sub (hψ j))
    fun z hz hz0 he ↦ hij (hinj z hz hz0 (sub_eq_zero.1 he))
  choose! k u hu hu0 hψu using h
  exact ⟨k, hψ, fun i j hij ↦ ⟨u i j, hu i j hij, hu0 i j hij, hψu i j hij⟩⟩

name: Codim2.chart₁_fst
statement:
@[simp]
lemma chart₁_fst (x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ) : (chart₁ φ x).1 = x.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Codim2.chart₁_snd
statement:
@[simp]
lemma chart₁_snd (x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ) : (chart₁ φ x).2 = φ x.1 + x.1.2 * x.2
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Codim2.chart₁_chart₁Inv
statement: lemma chart₁_chart₁Inv {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} (hx : x.1.2 ≠ 0) : chart₁ φ (chart₁Inv φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
  simp only [chart₁, chart₁Inv]
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hx, add_sub_cancel]

name: Codim2.chart₁Inv_chart₁
statement: lemma chart₁Inv_chart₁ {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} (hx : x.1.2 ≠ 0) : chart₁Inv φ (chart₁ φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
  simp only [chart₁, chart₁Inv]
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx]

name: Codim2.chart₂_chart₂Inv
statement: lemma chart₂_chart₂Inv {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} (hx : x.2 ≠ φ x.1) : chart₂ φ (chart₂Inv φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x.2 - φ x.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
  have h₁ : ((x.1.1, (x.2 - φ x.1) * (x.1.2 / (x.2 - φ x.1))) : E × ℂ) = x.1 :=
    Prod.ext rfl (mul_div_cancel₀ _ hx')
  simp only [chart₂, chart₂Inv, h₁, add_sub_cancel]

name: Codim2.chart₂Inv_chart₂
statement: lemma chart₂Inv_chart₂ {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} (hx : x.1.2 ≠ 0) : chart₂Inv φ (chart₂ φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chart₂, chart₂Inv, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx]

name: Codim2.chart₂_eq_chart₁
statement:
lemma chart₂_eq_chart₁ {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} (hx : x.2 ≠ 0) :
    chart₂ φ ((x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2), x.2⁻¹) = chart₁ φ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chart₂, chart₁, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, mul_one]

name: Codim2.chart₂_fst
statement: lemma chart₂_fst (x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ) : (chart₂ φ x).1 = (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Codim2.shear_injective
statement: lemma shear_injective (χ : E × ℂ → ℂ) : Function.Injective (shear χ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x x' h
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
  rw [h₁] at h₂
  exact Prod.ext h₁ (sub_left_inj.1 h₂)

name: Codim2.differentiableOn_chart₁
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_chart₁ {V : Set (E × ℂ)} (hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ V) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (chart₁ φ) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ φ x.1) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V) :=
    hφ.comp differentiableOn_fst fun _ hx ↦ hx
  exact differentiableOn_fst.prodMk (h₁.add
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.1.2 * x.2).differentiableOn)

name: Codim2.differentiableOn_chart₁Inv
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_chart₁Inv {V : Set (E × ℂ)} (hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ V) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (chart₁Inv φ) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.1.2 ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2 - φ x.1)
      (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.1.2 ≠ 0}) :=
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2).differentiableOn.sub
      (hφ.comp differentiableOn_fst fun _ hx ↦ hx.1)
  have h₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ (x.1.2)⁻¹)
      (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.1.2 ≠ 0}) :=
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.1.2).differentiableOn.inv
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.2
  refine differentiableOn_fst.prodMk ?_
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact h₁.mul h₂

name: Codim2.differentiableOn_chart₂
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_chart₂ {V : Set (E × ℂ)} (hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ V) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (chart₂ φ) {x | (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V}
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ((x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) : E × ℂ) := by
    fun_prop
  have h₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ φ (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2))
      {x | (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V} :=
    hφ.comp hm.differentiableOn fun _ hx ↦ hx
  exact hm.differentiableOn.prodMk (h₁.add
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.1.2).differentiableOn)

name: Codim2.differentiableOn_chart₂Inv
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_chart₂Inv {V : Set (E × ℂ)} (hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ V) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (chart₂Inv φ) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.2 ≠ φ x.1})
proof:
:= by
  have hs : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2 - φ x.1)
      (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.2 ≠ φ x.1}) :=
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2).differentiableOn.sub
      (hφ.comp differentiableOn_fst fun _ hx ↦ hx.1)
  have hi : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ (x.2 - φ x.1)⁻¹)
      (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V ∩ {x | x.2 ≠ φ x.1}) :=
    hs.inv fun _ hx ↦ sub_ne_zero.2 hx.2
  refine ((by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.1.1).differentiableOn.prodMk
    hs).prodMk ?_
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.1.2).differentiableOn.mul hi

name: Codim2.differentiableOn_shear
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_shear {χ : E × ℂ → ℂ} {V : Set (E × ℂ)} (hχ : DifferentiableOn ℂ χ V) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (shear χ) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' V)
proof:
:=
  differentiableOn_fst.prodMk
    ((by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2).differentiableOn.sub
      (hχ.comp differentiableOn_fst fun _ hx ↦ hx))

name: Codim2.chart₁_mem_vertical_iff
statement: lemma chart₁_mem_vertical_iff {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} : chart₁ φ x ∈ vertical V ↔ x ∈ vertical V
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Codim2.chart₁_mem_graphs_iff
statement:
theorem chart₁_mem_graphs_iff [Nonempty ι] (hχ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V, ψ i z = φ z + z.2 * χ i z)
    {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} : chart₁ φ x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔ x ∈ graphs V χ ∨ x ∈ vertical V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_graphs, mem_vertical, chart₁_fst, chart₁_snd]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, i, hi⟩
    rw [hχ i _ hx, add_right_inj] at hi
    rcases mul_eq_mul_left_iff.1 hi with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, i, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨hx, i, hi⟩ | ⟨hx, h0⟩)
    · exact ⟨hx, i, by rw [hχ i _ hx, hi]⟩
    · obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
      exact ⟨hx, i, by rw [hχ i _ hx, h0, zero_mul, zero_mul]⟩

name: Codim2.chart₂_mem_vertical_iff
statement:
lemma chart₂_mem_vertical_iff {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} :
    chart₂ φ x ∈ vertical V ↔ (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V ∧ (x.1.2 = 0 ∨ x.2 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_vertical, chart₂_fst, mul_eq_zero]

name: Codim2.chart₂_mem_graphs_iff
statement:
theorem chart₂_mem_graphs_iff [Nonempty ι] (hχ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V, ψ i z = φ z + z.2 * χ i z)
    {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} : chart₂ φ x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔ (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V ∧
      (x.1.2 = 0 ∨ ∃ i, x.2 * χ i (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_graphs, chart₂_fst]
  refine and_congr_right fun hx ↦ ?_
  simp only [chart₂, hχ _ _ hx, add_right_inj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    by_cases hs : x.1.2 = 0
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · refine Or.inr ⟨i, mul_left_cancel₀ hs ?_⟩
      rw [mul_one, ← mul_assoc]
      exact hi.symm
  · rintro (hs | ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
      exact ⟨i, by simp [hs]⟩
    · exact ⟨i, by rw [mul_assoc, hi, mul_one]⟩

name: Codim2.eventually_chart₂_mem_graphs_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_chart₂_mem_graphs_iff [Nonempty ι] [Finite ι] (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hχ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V, ψ i z = φ z + z.2 * χ i z) (hχc : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (χ i) V)
    {y₀ : E} (hy₀ : (y₀, 0) ∈ V) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ), (chart₂ φ x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔ x.1.2 = 0) ∧
      (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Continuous fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ((x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) : E × ℂ) := by fun_prop
  have hm₀ : ((((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ).1.1, (((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ).1.2 *
      (((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ).2) = (y₀, 0) := by simp
  have hmem : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ), (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) ∈ V :=
    hm.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hm₀]; exact hV.mem_nhds hy₀)
  have hlt (i : ι) : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (((y₀, 0), 0) : (E × ℂ) × ℂ),
      ‖x.2 * χ i (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2)‖ < 1 := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ x.2 * χ i (x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2))
        ((y₀, 0), 0) := by
      refine continuousAt_snd.mul ?_
      refine ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ ↦ ((x.1.1, x.1.2 * x.2) : E × ℂ))
        ?_ hm.continuousAt
      rw [hm₀]
      exact (hχc i).continuousAt (hV.mem_nhds hy₀)
    exact hc.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simp))
  filter_upwards [hmem, eventually_all.2 hlt] with x hx hlt
  refine ⟨?_, hx⟩
  rw [chart₂_mem_graphs_iff hχ, and_iff_right hx]
  refine or_iff_left fun ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_
  have := hlt i
  rw [hi, norm_one] at this
  exact lt_irrefl _ this

name: Codim2.mem_graphs_unique_iff
statement:
lemma mem_graphs_unique_iff {χ : E × ℂ → ℂ} {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} :
    x ∈ graphs V (fun _ : Unit ↦ χ) ↔ x.1 ∈ V ∧ (shear χ x).2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_graphs, shear, sub_eq_zero]

name: Codim2.mem_graphs_iff_of_subsingleton
statement:
lemma mem_graphs_iff_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] {i : ι} {x : (E × ℂ) × ℂ} :
    x ∈ graphs V ψ ↔ x.1 ∈ V ∧ (shear (ψ i) x).2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_graphs, shear, sub_eq_zero]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ⟨fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ Subsingleton.elim j i ▸ hj, fun h ↦ ⟨i, h⟩⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isOpen_cyl
statement:
lemma isOpen_cyl (N : (AnalyticSpace.complexAffineSpace.{u} n).Opens) (iw : ULift.{u} (Fin n)) :
    IsOpen (cyl N iw)
proof:
:= by
  have : cyl N iw = ⋃ a : ℂ, {x : Cn.{u} n | Function.update x iw a ∈ N} := by
    ext x
    simp [cyl]
  rw [this]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun a ↦ N.isOpen.preimage (continuous_id.update iw continuous_const)

proof:

  ⟨x iw, by rwa [Function.update_eq_self]⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.differentiableWithinAt_update
statement:
lemma differentiableWithinAt_update {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {F : E → Cn.{u} n} {g : E → ℂ} {s : Set E} {e : E} (hF : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ F s e)
    (hg : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ g s e) (i : ULift.{u} (Fin n)) :
    DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ (fun e ↦ Function.update (F e) i (g e)) s e
proof:
:= by
  refine differentiableWithinAt_pi.2 fun j ↦ ?_
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simpa using hg
  · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hj] using differentiableWithinAt_pi.1 hF j

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.differentiableOn_update
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_update {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {F : E → Cn.{u} n} {g : E → ℂ} {s : Set E} (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F s)
    (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g s) (i : ULift.{u} (Fin n)) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun e ↦ Function.update (F e) i (g e)) s
proof:
:=
  fun e he ↦ differentiableWithinAt_update (hF e he) (hg e he) i

:=
  (isOpen_cyl N C.iw).preimage C.continuous_ta

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.differentiableOn_φ_ta
statement: lemma differentiableOn_φ_ta : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun a ↦ C.φ (C.ta a)) C.dom₂
proof:
:=
  C.differentiableOn_φ.comp C.differentiable_ta.differentiableOn fun _ ha ↦ ha

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.differentiableOn_ch₂
statement: lemma differentiableOn_ch₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.ch₂ C.dom₂
proof:
:=
  differentiableOn_update C.differentiable_ta.differentiableOn
    (C.differentiableOn_φ_ta.add (differentiable_apply C.it).differentiableOn) C.iw

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.mem_dom₂_of_ch₂_mem
statement: lemma mem_dom₂_of_ch₂_mem {a : Cn.{u} n} (ha : C.ch₂ a ∈ N) : a ∈ C.dom₂

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.M₂₀_le
statement: lemma M₂₀_le : C.M₂₀ h₀ ≤ C.M₂
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha ↦ h₀ ha

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.M₂_le_dom₂
statement: lemma M₂_le_dom₂ {a : Cn.{u} n} (ha : a ∈ C.M₂) : a ∈ C.dom₂
proof:
:=
  C.mem_dom₂_of_ch₂_mem ha

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.L₂_it
statement: lemma L₂_it (p : Cn.{u} (1 + n)) : C.L₂ p C.it = cptBase p C.iw - C.φ (cptBase p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L₂, Function.update_of_ne C.it_ne_iw, Function.update_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.L₂_iw
statement: lemma L₂_iw (p : Cn.{u} (1 + n)) : C.L₂ p C.iw = cptFib p
proof:
:=
  Function.update_self _ _ _

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.continuous_L₂_on
statement: lemma continuous_L₂_on : ContinuousOn C.L₂ {p : Cn.{u} (1 + n) | cptBase p ∈ N}
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : ContinuousOn (fun p ↦ C.φ (cptBase p)) {p : Cn.{u} (1 + n) | cptBase p ∈ N} :=
    C.differentiableOn_φ.continuousOn.comp differentiable_cptBase.continuous.continuousOn
      fun _ hp ↦ mem_cyl_of_mem hp
  refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun j ↦ ?_
  by_cases hj : j = C.iw
  · subst hj
    simpa [L₂] using differentiable_cptFib.continuous.continuousOn
  by_cases hj' : j = C.it
  · subst hj'
    simp only [L₂, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_self]
    exact (((continuous_apply _).comp differentiable_cptBase.continuous).continuousOn.sub hφ)
  · simp only [L₂, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne hj']
    exact ((continuous_apply j).comp differentiable_cptBase.continuous).continuousOn

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.L₂_Γ₂
statement: lemma L₂_Γ₂ {a : Cn.{u} n} : C.L₂ (C.Γ₂ a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hne := C.it_ne_iw
  funext j
  simp only [L₂, Γ₂, cptBase_cptFun, cptFib_cptFun, ofBase_baseCoord, ch₂_iw, φ_ch₂]
  by_cases hj : j = C.iw
  · subst hj
    simp
  by_cases hj' : j = C.it
  · subst hj'
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  · simp [ch₂, ta, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne hj']

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ta'_L₂
statement:
lemma ta'_L₂ (p : Cn.{u} (1 + n)) :
    C.ta' (C.L₂ p, C.h₂ p) = Function.update (cptBase p) C.iw (cptFib p)
proof:
:= by
  have hne := C.it_ne_iw
  have e : C.h₂ p + C.L₂ p C.it * C.L₂ p C.iw = cptBase p C.it := by
    rw [L₂_it, L₂_iw, h₂]
    ring
  simp only [ta']
  rw [e]
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = C.iw
  · subst hj
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hne.symm, L₂]
  by_cases hj' : j = C.it
  · subst hj'
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  · simp [L₂, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne hj']

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.differentiable_ta'
statement: lemma differentiable_ta' : Differentiable ℂ C.ta'
proof:
:= by
  have h : Differentiable ℂ fun q : Cn.{u} n × ℂ ↦ q.2 + q.1 C.it * q.1 C.iw := by fun_prop
  exact fun q ↦ (differentiableWithinAt_update (s := Set.univ)
    differentiable_fst.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt (h q).differentiableWithinAt
    C.it).differentiableAt Filter.univ_mem

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.it_ne_zero_of_mem_M₁₀
statement: lemma it_ne_zero_of_mem_M₁₀ {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x ∈ C.M₁₀ h₀) : x C.it ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := C.ne_zero _ (show C.ch₁ x ∈ N₀ from hx)
  rwa [ch₁_it] at this

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ne_zero_of_mem_M₂₀
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_mem_M₂₀ {a : Cn.{u} n} (ha : a ∈ C.M₂₀ h₀) : a C.it ≠ 0 ∧ a C.iw ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := C.ne_zero _ (show C.ch₂ a ∈ N₀ from ha)
  rw [ch₂_it] at this
  exact ⟨left_ne_zero_of_mul this, right_ne_zero_of_mul this⟩

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.blowupPt_ch₁
statement:
lemma blowupPt_ch₁ {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x C.it ≠ 0) :
    C.toBlowupData.blowupPt (C.ch₁ x) = chartPt 0 (baseCoord (C.ch₁ x), x C.iw)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BlowupData.blowupPt, toBlowupData_ω, toBlowupData_τ, ch₁_iw, φ_ch₁, ch₁_it]
  congr 2
  field_simp
  ring

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.blowupPt_ch₂
statement:
lemma blowupPt_ch₂ {a : Cn.{u} n} (hs : a C.it ≠ 0) (hv : a C.iw ≠ 0) :
    C.toBlowupData.blowupPt (C.ch₂ a) = chartPt 1 (baseCoord (C.ch₂ a), a C.iw)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BlowupData.blowupPt, toBlowupData_ω, toBlowupData_τ, ch₂_iw, φ_ch₂, ch₂_it]
  have e : (C.φ (C.ta a) + a C.it - C.φ (C.ta a)) / (a C.it * a C.iw) = (a C.iw)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e, chartPt_zero_eq_chartPt_one (by simpa using hv), inv_inv]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ch₁_ch₁Inv
statement: lemma ch₁_ch₁Inv {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x C.it ≠ 0) : C.ch₁ (C.ch₁Inv x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have e : C.φ (C.ch₁Inv x) + C.ch₁Inv x C.it * C.ch₁Inv x C.iw = x C.iw := by
    simp only [ch₁Inv, C.φ_update, Function.update_of_ne C.it_ne_iw, Function.update_self]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [ch₁, e, ch₁Inv, Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ch₁Inv_ch₁
statement: lemma ch₁Inv_ch₁ {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x C.it ≠ 0) : C.ch₁Inv (C.ch₁ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have e : (C.ch₁ x C.iw - C.φ (C.ch₁ x)) / C.ch₁ x C.it = x C.iw := by
    rw [ch₁_iw, φ_ch₁, ch₁_it]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [ch₁Inv, e, ch₁, Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.differentiableOn_ch₁Inv
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_ch₁Inv :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ C.ch₁Inv {x : Cn.{u} n | x ∈ cyl N C.iw ∧ x C.it ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.φ {x : Cn.{u} n | x ∈ cyl N C.iw ∧ x C.it ≠ 0} :=
    C.differentiableOn_φ.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.1
  refine differentiableOn_update differentiableOn_id ?_ C.iw
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact fun x hx ↦ (((differentiable_apply C.iw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt).sub
    (hφ x hx)).mul ((differentiable_apply C.it).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt.inv hx.2)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ch₂_ch₂Inv
statement: lemma ch₂_ch₂Inv {x : Cn.{u} n} (hx : x C.iw - C.φ x ≠ 0) : C.ch₂ (C.ch₂Inv x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hne := C.it_ne_iw
  have hta : C.ta (C.ch₂Inv x) = Function.update x C.iw (x C.it / (x C.iw - C.φ x)) := by
    have e : C.ch₂Inv x C.it * C.ch₂Inv x C.iw = x C.it := by
      simp only [ch₂Inv, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
      field_simp
    rw [ta, e]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = C.iw
    · subst hj
      simp [ch₂Inv, Function.update_of_ne hne.symm]
    by_cases hj' : j = C.it
    · subst hj'
      simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · simp [ch₂Inv, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne hj']
  have e : C.φ (C.ta (C.ch₂Inv x)) + C.ch₂Inv x C.it = x C.iw := by
    rw [hta, C.φ_update, ch₂Inv, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
    ring
  rw [ch₂, e, hta, Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.ch₂Inv_ch₂
statement: lemma ch₂Inv_ch₂ {a : Cn.{u} n} (hs : a C.it ≠ 0) : C.ch₂Inv (C.ch₂ a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hne := C.it_ne_iw
  have e₁ : C.ch₂ a C.iw - C.φ (C.ch₂ a) = a C.it := by
    rw [ch₂_iw, φ_ch₂]
    ring
  have e₂ : C.ch₂ a C.it / a C.it = a C.iw := by
    rw [ch₂_it]
    field_simp
  rw [ch₂Inv, e₁, e₂]
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = C.iw
  · subst hj
    simp
  by_cases hj' : j = C.it
  · subst hj'
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  · simp [ch₂, ta, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne hj']

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.BlowupCentre.differentiableOn_ch₂Inv
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_ch₂Inv :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ C.ch₂Inv {x : Cn.{u} n | x ∈ cyl N C.iw ∧ x C.iw - C.φ x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.φ {x : Cn.{u} n | x ∈ cyl N C.iw ∧ x C.iw - C.φ x ≠ 0} :=
    C.differentiableOn_φ.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.1
  have hω : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x ↦ x C.iw - C.φ x)
      {x : Cn.{u} n | x ∈ cyl N C.iw ∧ x C.iw - C.φ x ≠ 0} :=
    (differentiable_apply C.iw).differentiableOn.sub hφ
  refine differentiableOn_update (differentiableOn_update differentiableOn_id hω C.it) ?_ C.iw
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact fun x hx ↦ (differentiable_apply C.it).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt.mul
    ((hω x hx).inv hx.2)

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.mem_baseN
statement: lemma mem_baseN {y : Fin n → ℂ} : y ∈ baseN N ↔ ofBase y ∈ N
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ComplexAnalytic.BoundedSections.isOpenImmersion_lift
statement:
lemma isOpenImmersion_lift {X Y Z : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f] [LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion g]
    (H : Set.range g.base ⊆ Set.range f.base) :
    LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion (LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift f g H)
proof:
