name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.φ_sectRes_sectRes
statement:
lemma φ_sectRes_sectRes {O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace} {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace}
    (hW : C.img O ≤ W) {O' : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace} (h : O ≤ O') (hW' : C.img O' ≤ W)
    (s : M.val.obj (op W)) :
    C.φ O (sectRes M hW s) = sectRes K h (C.φ O' (sectRes M hW' s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C.φ_res h, sectRes_sectRes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.ψ_res_res
statement:
lemma ψ_res_res {O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace} {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace}
    (hW : C.img O ≤ W) {O' : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace} (h : O ≤ O') (hW' : C.img O' ≤ W)
    (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    C.ψ O (Y.res hW r) = Z.res h (C.ψ O' (Y.res hW' r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C.ψ_res h, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModuleAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W', k, s, hzW', hgen⟩ := hK
  refine ⟨C.img W', k, fun l ↦ C.φInv W' (s l), (C.mem_img z W').2 hzW',
    fun W₁ hW₁ t y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have hW₁r : W₁ ≤ C.img ⊤ := hW₁.trans (C.img_mono le_top)
  have hW₁e : C.img (C.pre W₁) = W₁ := C.img_pre hW₁r
  obtain ⟨z', -, rfl⟩ := hW₁r hy
  have hpre : C.pre W₁ ≤ W' := C.pre_le_of_le_img hW₁
  obtain ⟨W₂', hW₂', hz'W₂', c', hc'⟩ := hgen (C.pre W₁) hpre
    (C.φ (C.pre W₁) (sectRes M hW₁e.le t)) z' hy
  have hW₂ : C.img W₂' ≤ W₁ := (C.img_mono hW₂').trans hW₁e.le
  refine ⟨C.img W₂', hW₂, (C.mem_img z' W₂').2 hz'W₂', fun l ↦ C.ψInv W₂' (c' l), ?_⟩
  apply C.φ_injective W₂'
  rw [C.φ_sectRes_sectRes hW₂ hW₂' hW₁e.le, hc', C.φ_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [C.φ_smul, ψ_ψInv, C.φ_res (hW₂'.trans hpre), φ_φInv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.hasLocalModuleRelationsAt
statement:
theorem hasLocalModuleRelationsAt {z : Z} (hK : HasLocalModuleRelationsAt K z) :
    HasLocalModuleRelationsAt M (C.g z)
proof:
:= by
  refine hasLocalModuleRelationsAt_of_le (C.img ⊤) ((C.mem_img z ⊤).2 trivial)
    fun V hV m f hzV ↦ ?_
  have hVe : C.img (C.pre V) = V := C.img_pre hV
  let f' : Fin m → K.val.obj (op (C.pre V)) := fun i ↦ C.φ (C.pre V) (sectRes M hVe.le (f i))
  obtain ⟨W', hW'V, k, g', hzW', hrel', hcompl'⟩ := hK (C.pre V) m f' hzV
  have hWV : C.img W' ≤ V := (C.img_mono hW'V).trans hVe.le
  refine ⟨C.img W', hWV, k, fun l i ↦ C.ψInv W' (g' l i), (C.mem_img z W').2 hzW',
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W₁ hW₁ a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply C.φ_injective W'
    rw [C.φ_sum, map_zero, ← hrel' l]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [C.φ_smul, ψ_ψInv, C.φ_sectRes_sectRes hWV hW'V hVe.le]
  · have hW₁r : W₁ ≤ C.img ⊤ := hW₁.trans (C.img_mono le_top)
    have hW₁e : C.img (C.pre W₁) = W₁ := C.img_pre hW₁r
    obtain ⟨z', -, rfl⟩ := hW₁r hy
    have hpre : C.pre W₁ ≤ W' := C.pre_le_of_le_img hW₁
    let a' : Fin m → Z.presheaf.obj (op (C.pre W₁)) := fun i ↦ C.ψ (C.pre W₁) (Y.res hW₁e.le (a i))
    have ha' : ∑ i, a' i • sectRes K (hpre.trans hW'V) (f' i) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun s ↦ C.φ (C.pre W₁) (sectRes M hW₁e.le s)) ha
      simp only [sectRes_sum, sectRes_smul, C.φ_sum, sectRes_zero, map_zero] at this
      rw [← this]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [C.φ_smul, sectRes_sectRes, C.φ_sectRes_sectRes _ (hpre.trans hW'V) hVe.le]
    obtain ⟨W₂', hW₂', hz'W₂', c', hc'⟩ := hcompl' (C.pre W₁) hpre a' ha' z' hy
    have hW₂ : C.img W₂' ≤ W₁ := (C.img_mono hW₂').trans hW₁e.le
    refine ⟨C.img W₂', hW₂, (C.mem_img z' W₂').2 hz'W₂', fun l ↦ C.ψInv W₂' (c' l),
      fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    apply C.ψ_injective W₂'
    rw [C.ψ_res_res hW₂ hW₂' hW₁e.le, hc', C.ψ_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, ψ_ψInv, C.ψ_res (hW₂'.trans hpre), ψ_ψInv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.le_preimage_openImmersionImg
statement:
lemma le_preimage_openImmersionImg (O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace) :
    O ≤ (Opens.map g.base).obj (openImmersionImg g O)
proof:
:=
  fun z hz ↦ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.preimage_openImmersionImg_le
statement:
lemma preimage_openImmersionImg_le (O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace) :
    (Opens.map g.base).obj (openImmersionImg g O) ≤ O
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨z', hz', h⟩
  rwa [(PresheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.base_open (f := g.toHom)).injective h] at hz'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.bijective_openImmersionψ
statement:
lemma bijective_openImmersionψ (O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace) :
    Function.Bijective (openImmersionψ g O)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (homOfLE (le_preimage_openImmersionImg g O)) := homOfLE_isIso_of_eq _
    (le_antisymm (le_preimage_openImmersionImg g O) (preimage_openImmersionImg_le g O))
  rw [openImmersionψ, RingHom.coe_comp]
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).comp (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.openImmersionψ_res
statement:
lemma openImmersionψ_res {O₁ O₂ : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace} (h : O₁ ≤ O₂)
    (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op (openImmersionImg g O₂))) :
    openImmersionψ g O₁ (Y.res ((PresheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.base_open
      (f := g.toHom)).isOpenMap.functor.monotone h) r) = Z.res h (openImmersionψ g O₂ r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [openImmersionψ, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  change Z.res _ (g.c.app _ (Y.res _ r)) = Z.res h (Z.res _ (g.c.app _ r))
  rw [c_app_res, res_res, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ModuleChart.ofIsOpenImmersion_g
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ModuleChart.ofIsOpenImmersion_g (φ bijective_φ φ_res φ_smul) :
    (ModuleChart.ofIsOpenImmersion (M := M) (K := K) g φ bijective_φ φ_res φ_smul).g = g.base
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_of_forall_moduleChart
statement:
theorem isCoherent_of_forall_moduleChart (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)
    (h : ∀ y : Y, ∃ (Z : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}) (K : SheafOfModules.{u} Z.ringSheaf)
      (_ : K.IsCoherent) (C : ModuleChart M K) (z : Z), C.g z = y) :
    M.IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine isCoherent_of_hasLocalModuleRelations M (fun y ↦ ?_)
    ((hasLocalModuleRelations_iff M).2 fun y ↦ ?_)
  · obtain ⟨Z, K, hK, C, z, rfl⟩ := h y
    exact C.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModuleAt
      (isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_of_isFiniteType K z)
  · obtain ⟨Z, K, hK, C, z, rfl⟩ := h y
    exact C.hasLocalModuleRelationsAt
      ((hasLocalModuleRelations_iff K).1 (hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent K) z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_pushforward_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_of_isIso {Z : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (K : SheafOfModules.{u} Z.ringSheaf) [K.IsCoherent] :
    ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} g.toRingSheafHom).obj K).IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine isCoherent_of_forall_moduleChart _ fun y ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (homeoOfIso (asIso g)).surjective y
  have hself (O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace) (s : K.val.obj (op O)) : sectRes K le_rfl s = s := by
    change (K.val.presheaf.map (𝟙 (op O))).hom s = s
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  have hbij (O : Opens Z.toPresheafedSpace) :
      Function.Bijective (K.val.map (homOfLE (le_preimage_openImmersionImg g O)).op) := by
    refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2
      ⟨fun (s : K.val.obj (op O)) ↦ sectRes K (preimage_openImmersionImg_le g O) s,
        fun s ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
    · change sectRes K _ (sectRes K _ s) = s
      rw [sectRes_sectRes, hself]
    · change sectRes K (le_preimage_openImmersionImg g O) (sectRes K
        (preimage_openImmersionImg_le g O) (show K.val.obj (op O) from s)) =
        (show K.val.obj (op O) from s)
      rw [sectRes_sectRes, hself]
  refine ⟨Z, K, inferInstance, ModuleChart.ofIsOpenImmersion g
    (fun O ↦ (K.val.map (homOfLE (le_preimage_openImmersionImg g O)).op).hom.toAddMonoidHom)
    hbij (fun {O₁ O₂} h s ↦ ?_) (fun O r s ↦ ?_), z, rfl⟩
  · change sectRes K _ (sectRes K _ s) = sectRes K h (sectRes K _ s)
    rw [sectRes_sectRes, sectRes_sectRes]
  · change sectRes K _ ((show Z.presheaf.obj (op ((Opens.map g.base).obj (openImmersionImg g O)))
        from g.c.app _ r) • (show K.val.obj (op ((Opens.map g.base).obj (openImmersionImg g O)))
        from s)) = _
    rw [sectRes_smul]
    rfl

name: SheafOfModules.exists_kernel_ι_val_app_eq
statement:
lemma exists_kernel_ι_val_app_eq (φ : P ⟶ Q) (Z : Cᵒᵖ) (b : P.val.obj Z)
    (hb : φ.val.app Z b = 0) : ∃ n, (kernel.ι φ).val.app Z n = b
proof:
:= by
  let E := evaluation R Z
  haveI : E.Additive := ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} ↦ rfl⟩
  let e := PreservesKernel.iso E φ
  let k := (ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer (E.map φ)).inv ⟨b, hb⟩
  refine ⟨e.inv k, ?_⟩
  have h1 : E.map (kernel.ι φ) (e.inv k) = kernel.ι (E.map φ) k := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    congr 1
    simp [e]
  have h2 : kernel.ι (E.map φ) k = b := by
    change ((ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer (E.map φ)).inv ≫ kernel.ι (E.map φ)) ⟨b, hb⟩ = b
    rw [ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer_inv_kernel_ι]
    rfl
  exact h1.trans h2

name: SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_sections
statement:
lemma IsFiniteType.exists_sections (K : SheafOfModules.{u} R) [K.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (X : A → C) (_ : J.CoversTop X) (k : A → ℕ)
      (s : ∀ a, Fin (k a) → K.val.obj (op (X a))),
      ∀ (a : A) (Z : C) (h : Z ⟶ X a) (n : K.val.obj (op Z)), ∃ S : Sieve Z, S ∈ J Z ∧
        ∀ ⦃W : C⦄ (g : W ⟶ Z), S g → ∃ c : Fin (k a) → R.obj.obj (op W),
          K.val.map g.op n = ∑ l, c l • K.val.map (g ≫ h).op (s a l)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData.{u} K
  obtain ⟨hfin⟩ := hσ
  have hk : ∀ a, ∃ k : ℕ, Nonempty ((σ.generators a).I ≃ Fin k) := fun a ↦
    @Finite.exists_equiv_fin _ (hfin a).finite
  choose k e using hk
  refine ⟨σ.I, σ.X, σ.coversTop, k, fun a l ↦ PresheafOfModules.sections.eval
    ((K.over (σ.X a)).freeHomEquiv (σ.generators a).π ((e a).some.symm l))
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (σ.X a)))), fun a Z h n ↦ ?_⟩
  let G := σ.generators a
  haveI : Fintype G.I := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (hfin a).finite
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hS'⟩ := SheafOfModules.exists_app_eq_of_epi G.π (Over.mk h) n
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff] at hS
  refine ⟨_, hS, fun W g hg ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff] at hg
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hS' _ hg
  refine ⟨fun l ↦ freeEval (R := R.over (σ.X a)) _ c ((e a).some.symm l), ?_⟩
  have h1 := val_app_eq_sum (R := R.over (σ.X a)) _ G.π c
  refine (hc.symm.trans h1).trans ?_
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (e a).some _ _ (fun j ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  congr 1
  exact (PresheafOfModules.sections_property ((K.over (σ.X a)).freeHomEquiv G.π j)
    (Over.homMk (g ≫ h) (Category.comp_id _) :
      Over.mk (g ≫ h) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 (σ.X a))).op).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_mem_of_coversTop_over
proof:
:= by
  have h := hZ (Over.mk (𝟙 X))
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨W, g, hg, hxW⟩ := h x hx
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff] at hg
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨k⟩⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨a, leOfHom k.left hxW⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_of_isFiniteType [M.IsFiniteType] :
    IsLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, X, hX, k, s, hs⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_sections M
  have hcov : IsOpenCover X := (Opens.coversTop_iff _ X).1 hX
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x ∈ X a := by
    have : x ∈ (⊤ : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) := trivial
    rw [← hcov.iSup_eq_top] at this
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.1 this
  refine ⟨X a, k a, s a, ha, fun W' hW' t y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hS'⟩ := hs a W' (homOfLE hW') t
  obtain ⟨W'', g, hg, hyW''⟩ := hS y hy
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hS' g hg
  exact ⟨W'', leOfHom g, hyW'', c, hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent
statement: theorem hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent [M.IsCoherent] : HasLocalModuleRelations M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro V m f x hx
  let L := ULift.{u} (Fin m)
  let φ : free L ⟶ M.over V := (M.over V).freeHomEquiv.symm
    (fun i ↦ sectionOfTerminal Over.mkIdTerminal (M.over V) (f i.down))
  have key : ∀ (Z : Over V) (b : (free (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) L).val.obj (op Z)),
      φ.val.app (op Z) b = ∑ i : Fin m, (show Y.presheaf.obj (op Z.left) from
        freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (op Z) b (ULift.up i)) •
        sectRes M (leOfHom Z.hom) (f i) := by
    intro Z b
    rw [val_app_eq_sum]
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv Equiv.ulift _ _ (fun i ↦ ?_)
    simp only [φ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, sectionOfTerminal_val]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨K, ι, hι, hlift, hK⟩ : ∃ (K : SheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringSheaf.over V))
      (ι : K ⟶ free L),
      (∀ (Z : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) (n : K.val.obj Z), φ.val.app Z (ι.val.app Z n) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (Z : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) (b : (free (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) L).val.obj Z),
        φ.val.app Z b = 0 → ∃ n, ι.val.app Z n = b) ∧ K.IsFiniteType :=
    ⟨kernel φ, kernel.ι φ, val_app_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_kernel φ,
      exists_kernel_ι_val_app_eq φ, IsCoherent.isFiniteType_kernel φ⟩
  obtain ⟨A, X, hX, k, s, hs⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_sections K
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_mem_of_coversTop_over hX x hx
  let g : Fin (k a) → Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op (X a).left) := fun l i ↦
    freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (op (X a)) (ι.val.app _ (s a l)) (ULift.up i)
  refine ⟨(X a).left, leOfHom (X a).hom, k a, g, ha, fun l ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (key (X a) _).symm.trans (hι (op (X a)) (s a l))
  intro W' hW' a' hrel y hy
  let Z' : Over V := Over.mk (homOfLE (hW'.trans (leOfHom (X a).hom)))
  let b := freeEvalSymm (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (I := L) (op Z') (fun i ↦ a' i.down)
  have hb : φ.val.app (op Z') b = 0 := by
    refine (key Z' b).trans (Eq.trans ?_ hrel)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ ?_)
    simp only [b, freeEval_freeEvalSymm]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hlift (op Z') b hb
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hS'⟩ := hs a Z' (Over.homMk (homOfLE hW') (Subsingleton.elim _ _)) n
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff] at hS
  obtain ⟨W'', gg, hgg, hyW''⟩ := hS y hy
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff] at hgg
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hS' _ hgg
  refine ⟨W'', leOfHom gg, hyW'', c, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (fun t ↦ freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (I := L) (op (Over.mk
    (gg ≫ Z'.hom))) (ι.val.app _ t) (ULift.up i)) hc
  simp only at h2
  rw [PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply] at h2
  erw [hn] at h2
  rw [freeEval_naturality] at h2
  simp only [b, freeEval_freeEvalSymm] at h2
  have hR : ∀ (Z : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) (c : Fin (k a) → (Y.ringSheaf.over V).obj.obj Z)
      (v : Fin (k a) → K.val.obj Z),
      freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (I := L) Z (ι.val.app Z (∑ x, c x • v x))
        (ULift.up i) =
        ∑ x, c x * freeEval (R := Y.ringSheaf.over V) (I := L) Z (ι.val.app Z (v x))
          (ULift.up i) := by
    intro Z c v
    rw [map_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ ↦ ?_)
    rw [map_smul, map_smul]
    rfl
  refine h2.trans ((hR _ c _).trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ ↦ ?_)))
  congr 1
  rw [PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply, freeEval_naturality]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_open_forall
statement:
lemma exists_open_forall {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (y : Y) (P : ι → Opens Y → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ i W W', W' ≤ W → P i W → P i W') (h : ∀ i, ∃ W : Opens Y, y ∈ W ∧ P i W) :
    ∃ W : Opens Y, y ∈ W ∧ ∀ i, P i W
proof:
:= by
  choose W hyW hPW using h
  refine ⟨⟨⋂ i, (W i : Set Y), isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i ↦ (W i).2⟩,
    Set.mem_iInter.2 hyW, fun i ↦ hP i _ _ (fun z hz ↦ Set.mem_iInter.1 hz i) (hPW i)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_eq_sum_of_germ_mem_span
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_of_germ_mem_span {U W : Opens Y} {p : ℕ} (h : Fin p → Y.presheaf.obj (op W))
    (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op U)) (y : Y) (hyU : y ∈ U) (hyW : y ∈ W)
    (hr : Y.presheaf.germ U y hyU r ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ Y.presheaf.germ W y hyW (h j))) :
    ∃ (W' : Opens Y) (hW'U : W' ≤ U) (hW'W : W' ≤ W) (d : Fin p → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
      y ∈ W' ∧ Y.res hW'U r = ∑ j, d j * Y.res hW'W (h j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).1 hr
  choose V hyV t ht using fun j ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq Y.presheaf (e j)
  obtain ⟨V₀, hyV₀, hV₀⟩ := exists_open_forall Y y (fun j V' ↦ V' ≤ V j)
    (fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ ↦ h₁.trans h₂) (fun j ↦ ⟨V j, hyV j, le_rfl⟩)
  set V₁ : Opens Y := V₀ ⊓ U ⊓ W
  have h₁U : V₁ ≤ U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have h₁W : V₁ ≤ W := inf_le_right
  have h₁V : ∀ j, V₁ ≤ V j := fun j ↦ (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans (hV₀ j)
  have hyV₁ : y ∈ V₁ := ⟨⟨hyV₀, hyU⟩, hyW⟩
  have hgerm : Y.presheaf.germ V₁ y hyV₁ (Y.res h₁U r) =
      Y.presheaf.germ V₁ y hyV₁ (∑ j, Y.res (h₁V j) (t j) * Y.res h₁W (h j)) := by
    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    rw [← he, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul]
    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, ht j]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨V₂, hyV₂, i₁, i₂, heq⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq _ y hyV₁ hyV₁ _ _ hgerm
  have h₂ : V₂ ≤ V₁ := leOfHom i₁
  refine ⟨V₂, h₂.trans h₁U, h₂.trans h₁W, fun j ↦ Y.res (h₂.trans (h₁V j)) (t j), hyV₂, ?_⟩
  have e₁ : Y.res (h₂.trans h₁U) r = Y.res h₂ (Y.res h₁U r) := (res_res _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [e₁]
  change Y.presheaf.map i₁.op _ = _
  rw [heq]
  change Y.res h₂ _ = _
  rw [res_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [res_mul, res_res, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.c_app_res
statement:
lemma Hom.c_app_res {U V : Opens Y} (h : U ≤ V) (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    f.c.app (op U) (Y.res h r) =
      X.res ((Opens.map f.base).monotone h) (f.c.app (op V) r)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (f.c.naturality (homOfLE h).op))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.exists_app_eq
statement:
lemma Hom.exists_app_eq (hf : IsInducing f.base) (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x))
    {U : Opens X} (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (c : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y) (hW : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U) (d : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)),
      f.base x ∈ W ∧ f.c.app (op W) d = X.res hW c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hs x (X.presheaf.germ U x hx c)
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀, d₀, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq Y.presheaf r
  rw [stalkMap_germ_apply] at hr
  obtain ⟨U₁, hxU₁, i₁, i₂, heq⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq _ x hW₀ hx _ _ hr
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, hpre⟩ := hf.isOpen_iff.1 U₁.2
  let W : Opens Y := ⟨W₁, hW₁⟩ ⊓ W₀
  have hWU₁ : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U₁ := fun z hz ↦ by
    have : z ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := hz.1
    rw [hpre] at this
    exact this
  have hxW : f.base x ∈ W := ⟨by
    have : x ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := by rw [hpre]; exact hxU₁
    exact this, hW₀⟩
  refine ⟨W, hWU₁.trans (leOfHom i₂), Y.res inf_le_right d₀, hxW, ?_⟩
  rw [Hom.c_app_res]
  have e₁ : X.res ((Opens.map f.base).monotone (inf_le_right : W ≤ W₀))
      (f.c.app (op W₀) d₀) = X.res hWU₁ (X.presheaf.map i₁.op (f.c.app (op W₀) d₀)) :=
    (res_res _ _ _ _).symm
  have e₂ : X.res (hWU₁.trans (leOfHom i₂)) c = X.res hWU₁ (X.presheaf.map i₂.op c) :=
    (res_res _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [e₁, e₂, heq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.exists_app_eq_family
statement:
lemma Hom.exists_app_eq_family (hf : IsInducing f.base)
    (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x)) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {U : Opens X} (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (c : ι → X.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y) (hW : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U) (d : ι → Y.presheaf.obj (op W)),
      f.base x ∈ W ∧ ∀ i, f.c.app (op W) (d i) = X.res hW (c i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, hpre⟩ := hf.isOpen_iff.1 U.2
  obtain ⟨W₀, hxW₀, hW₀⟩ := exists_open_forall Y (f.base x)
    (fun i W ↦ ∃ (hW : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U) (d : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)),
      f.c.app (op W) d = X.res hW (c i))
    (fun i W W' hle ⟨hW, d, hd⟩ ↦ ⟨((Opens.map f.base).monotone hle).trans hW,
      Y.res hle d, by rw [Hom.c_app_res, hd, res_res]⟩)
    (fun i ↦ by
      obtain ⟨W, hW, d, hxW, hd⟩ := f.exists_app_eq hf hs x hx (c i)
      exact ⟨W, hxW, hW, d, hd⟩)
  let W : Opens Y := W₀ ⊓ ⟨W₁, hW₁⟩
  have hWU : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U := fun z hz ↦ by
    have : z ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := hz.2
    rw [hpre] at this
    exact this
  have hxW : f.base x ∈ W := ⟨hxW₀, by
    have : x ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := by rw [hpre]; exact hx
    exact this⟩
  choose hW d hd using hW₀
  refine ⟨W, hWU, fun i ↦ Y.res inf_le_left (d i), hxW, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Hom.c_app_res, hd, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.subsingleton_val_obj_of_eq_bot
statement:
lemma subsingleton_val_obj_of_eq_bot {U : Opens X} (hU : U = ⊥) :
    Subsingleton (M.val.obj (op U))
proof:
:=
  AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.1
    (TopCat.Sheaf.isTerminalOfEqEmpty ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj M) hU).isZero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.subsingleton_pushforward_val_obj
statement:
lemma subsingleton_pushforward_val_obj {W : Opens Y} (hW : ∀ y ∈ W, y ∉ Set.range f.base) :
    Subsingleton (((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).val.obj (op W))
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_val_obj_of_eq_bot M (U := (Opens.map f.base).obj W)
    (eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ hW _ hx ⟨x, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_pushforward
statement:
lemma Hom.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_pushforward (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f.base)
    (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x)) (hM : IsLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule M) :
    IsLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule
      ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  have hoff : ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (t : ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u}
      f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).val.obj (op W')) (y : Y), y ∈ W' → y ∉ Set.range f.base →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (W : Opens Y) (hW' : W' ≤ W)
        (s : Fin k → ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).val.obj (op W)),
      ∃ (W'' : Opens Y) (hW'' : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧ ∃ c : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W''),
        sectRes _ hW'' t = ∑ l, c l • sectRes _ (hW''.trans hW') (s l) := by
    intro W' t y hy hy' k W hW' s
    haveI := subsingleton_pushforward_val_obj M (W := W' ⊓ f.rangeCompl hf.isClosed_range)
      fun z hz ↦ hz.2
    exact ⟨W' ⊓ f.rangeCompl hf.isClosed_range, inf_le_left, ⟨hy, hy'⟩, 0,
      Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∉ Set.range f.base
  · exact ⟨f.rangeCompl hf.isClosed_range, 0, ![], hy,
      fun W' hW' t y' hy' ↦ hoff W' t y' hy' (hW' hy') 0 _ hW' ![]⟩
  rw [not_not] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨U, k, s, hxU, hgen⟩ := hM x
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, hpre⟩ := hf.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 U.2
  let W : Opens Y := ⟨W₁, hW₁⟩
  have hWU : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ U := fun z hz ↦ by
    have : z ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := hz
    rw [hpre] at this
    exact this
  have hxW : f.base x ∈ W := by
    have : x ∈ f.base ⁻¹' W₁ := by rw [hpre]; exact hxU
    exact this
  refine ⟨W, k, fun l ↦ sectRes M hWU (s l), hxW, fun W' hW' t y' hy' ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hy'' : y' ∉ Set.range f.base
  · exact hoff W' t y' hy' hy'' k W hW' _
  rw [not_not] at hy''
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hy''
  obtain ⟨U'', hU'', hxU'', c', hc'⟩ := hgen ((Opens.map f.base).obj W')
    (((Opens.map f.base).monotone hW').trans hWU) t x' hy'
  obtain ⟨W₂, hW₂, c, hxW₂, hc⟩ := f.exists_app_eq_family hf.isInducing hs x' hxU'' c'
  have hle : (Opens.map f.base).obj (W₂ ⊓ W') ≤ U'' := fun z hz ↦ hW₂ hz.1
  refine ⟨W₂ ⊓ W', inf_le_right, ⟨hxW₂, hy'⟩, fun l ↦ Y.res inf_le_left (c l), ?_⟩
  change sectRes M ((Opens.map f.base).monotone (inf_le_right : W₂ ⊓ W' ≤ W')) t =
    ∑ l, (show X.presheaf.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj (W₂ ⊓ W'))) from
      f.c.app (op (W₂ ⊓ W')) (Y.res (inf_le_left : W₂ ⊓ W' ≤ W₂) (c l))) •
      (show M.val.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj (W₂ ⊓ W'))) from
        sectRes M ((Opens.map f.base).monotone ((inf_le_right : W₂ ⊓ W' ≤ W').trans hW'))
          (sectRes M hWU (s l)))
  dsimp only
  refine (sectRes_sectRes M hle hU'' t).symm.trans ?_
  rw [hc', sectRes_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [sectRes_smul, sectRes_sectRes, sectRes_sectRes, Hom.c_app_res, hc l, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_not_mem (hf : IsClosed (Set.range f.base))
    (V : Opens Y) (m : ℕ)
    (fs : Fin m → ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).val.obj (op V))
    (y : Y) (hyV : y ∈ V) (hy : y ∉ Set.range f.base) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y) (hWV : W ≤ V) (k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → (Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W))),
      y ∈ W ∧ (∀ l, ∑ i, g l i • sectRes _ hWV (fs i) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (hW' : W' ≤ W) (a : Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
        (∑ i, a i • sectRes _ (hW'.trans hWV) (fs i) = 0) → ∀ y ∈ W',
          ∃ (W'' : Opens Y) (hW'' : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧
            ∃ c : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W''),
              ∀ i, Y.res hW'' (a i) = ∑ l, c l * Y.res (hW''.trans hW') (g l i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := subsingleton_pushforward_val_obj M (W := V ⊓ f.rangeCompl hf) fun z hz ↦ hz.2
  refine ⟨V ⊓ f.rangeCompl hf, inf_le_left, m, fun l i ↦ if l = i then 1 else 0, ⟨hyV, hy⟩,
    fun l ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun W' hW' a _ y' hy' ↦ ⟨W', le_rfl, hy', a, fun i ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb ↦ by rw [if_neg hb, res_zero, mul_zero])
    (by simp), if_pos rfl, res_self]
  exact (mul_one _).symm.trans (congrArg _ (map_one _).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_mem
statement:
lemma Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_mem (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f.base)
    (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x)) (hI : f.HasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal)
    (hM : HasLocalModuleRelations M) (V : Opens Y) (m : ℕ)
    (fs : Fin m → ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).val.obj (op V))
    (x : X) (hxV : f.base x ∈ V) :
    ∃ (W : Opens Y) (hWV : W ≤ V) (k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → (Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W))),
      f.base x ∈ W ∧ (∀ l, ∑ i, g l i • sectRes _ hWV (fs i) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (W' : Opens Y) (hW' : W' ≤ W) (a : Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W')),
        (∑ i, a i • sectRes _ (hW'.trans hWV) (fs i) = 0) → ∀ y ∈ W',
          ∃ (W'' : Opens Y) (hW'' : W'' ≤ W'), y ∈ W'' ∧
            ∃ c : Fin k → Y.presheaf.obj (op W''),
              ∀ i, Y.res hW'' (a i) = ∑ l, c l * Y.res (hW''.trans hW') (g l i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨WX, hWX, k', g', hxWX, hrelM, hgenM⟩ := hM ((Opens.map f.base).obj V) m fs x hxV
  obtain ⟨WI, p, h, hxWI, hkill, hspan⟩ := hI (f.base x)
  obtain ⟨Wg, hWg, d, hxWg, hd⟩ := f.exists_app_eq_family hf.isInducing hs x hxWX
    (fun li : Fin k' × Fin m ↦ g' li.1 li.2)
  let W : Opens Y := Wg ⊓ WI ⊓ V
  have hWV : W ≤ V := inf_le_right
  have hWWg : W ≤ Wg := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hWWI : W ≤ WI := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  let ι := Fin k' ⊕ (Fin p × Fin m)
  let e : ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι) := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let G : ι → Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W) := fun r i ↦ match r with
    | Sum.inl l => Y.res hWWg (d (l, i))
    | Sum.inr (j, i') => if i' = i then Y.res hWWI (h j) else 0
  refine ⟨W, hWV, Fintype.card ι, fun l ↦ G (e.symm l), ⟨⟨hxWg, hxWI⟩, hxV⟩, fun l ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : (Opens.map f.base).obj W ≤ WX := ((Opens.map f.base).monotone hWWg).trans hWg
    suffices H : ∀ r : ι, ∑ i, G r i •
        sectRes ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M) hWV (fs i) = 0 from
      H (e.symm l)
    rintro (l' | ⟨j, i'⟩)
    · have key : ∀ i, Y.res hWWg (d (l', i)) •
          sectRes ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M) hWV (fs i) =
          sectRes M hle (g' l' i • sectRes M hWX (fs i)) := by
        intro i
        change (show X.presheaf.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj W)) from
          f.c.app (op W) (Y.res hWWg (d (l', i)))) •
          (show M.val.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj W)) from
            sectRes M ((Opens.map f.base).monotone hWV) (fs i)) = _
        dsimp only
        rw [sectRes_smul, sectRes_sectRes, Hom.c_app_res, hd, res_res]
      dsimp only [G]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ key i]
      exact (sectRes_sum M hle _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg _ (hrelM l')).trans
        (sectRes_zero M hle))
    · dsimp only [G]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i' (fun b _ hb ↦ by rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hb), zero_smul])
        (by simp), if_pos rfl]
      change (show X.presheaf.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj W)) from
        f.c.app (op W) (Y.res hWWI (h j))) •
        (show M.val.obj (op ((Opens.map f.base).obj W)) from
          sectRes M ((Opens.map f.base).monotone hWV) (fs i')) = 0
      dsimp only
      rw [Hom.c_app_res, hkill j]
      erw [res_zero, zero_smul]
  intro W' hW' a hrel y' hy'
  have hW'X : (Opens.map f.base).obj W' ≤ WX :=
    ((Opens.map f.base).monotone (hW'.trans hWWg)).trans hWg
  
  obtain ⟨W4, h4, hy4, c, hc⟩ : ∃ (W4 : Opens Y) (h4 : W4 ≤ W') (hy4 : y' ∈ W4),
      ∃ c : Fin k' → Y.presheaf.obj (op W4), ∀ i,
        Y.presheaf.germ W4 y' hy4 (Y.res h4 (a i) -
          ∑ l, c l * Y.res (h4.trans (hW'.trans hWWg)) (d (l, i))) ∈
            f.pushforwardStalkIdeal y' := by
    by_cases hy'' : y' ∉ Set.range f.base
    · refine ⟨W', le_rfl, hy', 0, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [f.pushforwardStalkIdeal_eq_top hf.isClosed_range y' hy'']
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    rw [not_not] at hy''
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hy''
    obtain ⟨U'', hU'', hxU'', c', hc'⟩ := hgenM ((Opens.map f.base).obj W') hW'X
      (fun i ↦ f.c.app (op W') (a i)) hrel x' hy'
    obtain ⟨W3, hW3, c3, hxW3, hc3⟩ := f.exists_app_eq_family hf.isInducing hs x' hxU'' c'
    refine ⟨W3 ⊓ W', inf_le_right, ⟨hxW3, hy'⟩, fun l ↦ Y.res inf_le_left (c3 l),
      fun i ↦ f.germ_mem_pushforwardStalkIdeal _ _ _ ?_⟩
    have hle : (Opens.map f.base).obj (W3 ⊓ W') ≤ U'' :=
      ((Opens.map f.base).monotone inf_le_left).trans hW3
    have e₂ := congrArg (X.res hle) (hc' i)
    rw [res_res, res_sum] at e₂
    simp only [res_mul, res_res] at e₂
    erw [map_sub, map_sum, sub_eq_zero]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (e₂.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_))
    · erw [Hom.c_app_res]
      rfl
    · erw [map_mul, Hom.c_app_res, Hom.c_app_res, hc3, hd, res_res, res_res]
      rfl
  
  have hy'WI : y' ∈ WI := hWWI (hW' hy')
  let b : Fin m → Y.presheaf.obj (op W4) := fun i ↦ Y.res h4 (a i) -
    ∑ l, c l * Y.res (h4.trans (hW'.trans hWWg)) (d (l, i))
  let P : Fin m → Opens Y → Prop := fun i W'' ↦ ∃ (h1 : W'' ≤ W4) (h2 : W'' ≤ WI)
    (D : Fin p → Y.presheaf.obj (op W'')), Y.res h1 (b i) = ∑ j, D j * Y.res h2 (h j)
  have hPmono : ∀ i W'' W''', W''' ≤ W'' → P i W'' → P i W''' := by
    rintro i W'' W''' hle ⟨h1, h2, D, hD⟩
    refine ⟨hle.trans h1, hle.trans h2, fun j ↦ Y.res hle (D j), ?_⟩
    rw [← res_res _ hle h1, hD, res_sum]
    simp only [res_mul, res_res]
  obtain ⟨W5, hy5, hP5⟩ := exists_open_forall Y y' P hPmono fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨W'', h1, h2, D, hy'', hD⟩ :=
      exists_eq_sum_of_germ_mem_span Y h (b i) y' hy4 hy'WI (hspan y' hy'WI (hc i))
    exact ⟨W'', hy'', h1, h2, D, hD⟩
  obtain ⟨W6, h65, h64, hy6⟩ : ∃ W6 : Opens Y, W6 ≤ W5 ∧ W6 ≤ W4 ∧ y' ∈ W6 :=
    ⟨W5 ⊓ W4, inf_le_left, inf_le_right, hy5, hy4⟩
  have hP6 : ∀ i, P i W6 := fun i ↦ hPmono i _ _ h65 (hP5 i)
  choose h1 h2 D hD using hP6
  
  have h6 : W6 ≤ W' := h64.trans h4
  let C : ι → Y.presheaf.obj (op W6) := fun r ↦ match r with
    | Sum.inl l => Y.res h64 (c l)
    | Sum.inr (j, i') => D i' j
  refine ⟨W6, h6, hy6, fun l ↦ C (e.symm l), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp e.symm (fun r : ι ↦ C r * Y.res (h6.trans hW') (G r i)),
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hinr : ∀ j, ∑ i', C (Sum.inr (j, i')) * Y.res (h6.trans hW') (G (Sum.inr (j, i')) i) =
      D i j * Y.res (h2 i) (h j) := by
    intro j
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb ↦ by
      simp only [C, G, if_neg hb, res_zero, mul_zero]) (by simp)]
    simp only [C, G, if_pos rfl, res_res]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ hinr j, ← hD i]
  have res_sub : ∀ {U U' : Opens Y} (hU : U ≤ U') (s t : Y.presheaf.obj (op U')),
      Y.res hU (s - t) = Y.res hU s - Y.res hU t := fun _ s t ↦ map_sub _ s t
  simp only [C, G, b, res_sub, res_res, res_sum, res_mul]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward
statement:
lemma Hom.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f.base)
    (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x)) (hI : f.HasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal)
    (hM : HasLocalModuleRelations M) :
    HasLocalModuleRelations ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  intro V m fs y hy
  by_cases h : y ∈ Set.range f.base
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h
    exact f.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_mem M hf hs hI hM V m fs x hy
  · exact hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward_of_not_mem M hf.isClosed_range V m fs y hy h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.isCoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
theorem Hom.isCoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedEmbedding (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f.base)
    (hs : ∀ x, Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x)) (hI : f.HasLocallyFinitelyGeneratedIdeal)
    [M.IsCoherent] : ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj M).IsCoherent
proof:
:=
  isCoherent_of_hasLocalModuleRelations _
    (f.isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_pushforward M hf hs
      (isLocallyFinitelyGeneratedModule_of_isFiniteType M))
    (f.hasLocalModuleRelations_pushforward M hf hs hI (hasLocalModuleRelations_of_isCoherent M))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toPullbackModules_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.toPullbackModules_naturality {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackAb f.base).map ((modulesToAb Y).map φ) ≫ f.toPullbackModules N =
      f.toPullbackModules M ≫ (modulesToAb X).map (f.pullbackModules.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Hom.pullbackAbAdj f).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right,
    Hom.homEquiv_toPullbackModules, Hom.homEquiv_toPullbackModules]
  have := congrArg (modulesToAb Y).map (f.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.naturality φ)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.cohomologyMap_map
statement:
lemma Hom.cohomologyMap_map {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} (φ : M ⟶ N) {q : ℕ}
    (x : H M q) :
    f.cohomologyMap N q (H.map φ q x) =
      H.map (f.pullbackModules.map φ) q (f.cohomologyMap M q x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.cohomologyMap_apply, Hom.cohomologyMap_apply, H.map, H.map,
    TopCat.Sheaf.H.pullback_map, ← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply,
    ← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun g => TopCat.Sheaf.H.map g q (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pullback f.base x))
    (f.toPullbackModules_naturality φ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.cohomologyMap_δ
statement:
lemma Hom.cohomologyMap_δ {S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (hS' : (S.map f.pullbackModules).ShortExact)
    {n₀ n₁ : ℕ} (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) (x : H S.X₃ n₀) :
    f.cohomologyMap S.X₁ n₁ (H.δ hS n₀ n₁ h x) =
      H.δ hS' n₀ n₁ h (f.cohomologyMap S.X₃ n₀ x)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : (S.map (modulesToAb Y)).map (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackAb f.base) ⟶
      (S.map f.pullbackModules).map (modulesToAb X) :=
    { τ₁ := f.toPullbackModules S.X₁
      τ₂ := f.toPullbackModules S.X₂
      τ₃ := f.toPullbackModules S.X₃
      comm₁₂ := (f.toPullbackModules_naturality S.f).symm
      comm₂₃ := (f.toPullbackModules_naturality S.g).symm }
  exact (congrArg (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map (f.toPullbackModules S.X₁) n₁)
    (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pullback_δ f.base (shortExact_map_modulesToAb hS) h x)).trans
    (TopCat.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality _ (shortExact_map_modulesToAb hS') φ h _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.equiv₀_cohomologyMap

lemma Hom.equiv₀_cohomologyMap (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) (x : H M 0) :

      (f.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app M).val.app (op ⊤) (H.equiv₀ M x)
proof:
:= by

    TopCat.Sheaf.H.equiv₀_pullback]
  rw [← modulesToAb_map_hom_app_apply, ← Hom.homEquiv_toPullbackModules,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_comp_map_baseChange
statement:
lemma unit_comp_map_baseChange (G : B) :
    adjg.unit.app (Rf.obj G) ≫ Rg.map (adjf'.unit.app (Lg.obj (Rf.obj G)) ≫
        Rf'.map (e.app (Rf.obj G) ≫ Lg'.map (adjf.counit.app G))) =
      Rf.map (adjg'.unit.app G) ≫
        (conjugateEquiv (adjf.comp adjg') (adjg.comp adjf') e).app (Lg'.obj G)
proof:
:= by
  have key := unit_conjugateEquiv (adjf.comp adjg') (adjg.comp adjf') e (Rf.obj G)
  simp only [Adjunction.comp_unit_app, Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc] at key
  have nat := (conjugateEquiv (adjf.comp adjg') (adjg.comp adjf') e).naturality
    (Lg'.map (adjf.counit.app G))
  simp only [Functor.comp_map] at nat
  have nat' := adjg'.unit.naturality (adjf.counit.app G)
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at nat'
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, ← reassoc_of% key]
  erw [← nat]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  erw [← nat']
  rw [Functor.map_comp_assoc, Adjunction.right_triangle_components_assoc]
  rfl

        (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} g.toRingSheafHom).map (pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G) =
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).map (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G) ≫
        (pushforwardModulesCommSq h).app (g'.pullbackModules.obj G)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modulesToAb_map_conjugateEquiv_pullbackModulesCongr_hom_app
statement:
lemma modulesToAb_map_conjugateEquiv_pullbackModulesCongr_hom_app {k k' : Y' ⟶ X}
    (e : k = k') (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y'.ringSheaf) :
    (modulesToAb X).map ((conjugateEquiv k'.pullbackModulesAdj k.pullbackModulesAdj
      (Hom.pullbackModulesCongr e).hom).app M) =
      eqToHom (by rw [e])
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp [Hom.pullbackModulesCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesCommSq_app
statement:
lemma modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesCommSq_app (M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y'.ringSheaf) :
    (modulesToAb X).map ((pushforwardModulesCommSq h).app M) =
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAbCommSqIso (base_comm_of_comm h)).hom.app M.toAb
proof:
:= by
  have hν : pushforwardModulesCommSq h =
      conjugateEquiv (f.pullbackModulesAdj.comp g'.pullbackModulesAdj)
          (g' ≫ f).pullbackModulesAdj (Hom.pullbackModulesComp g' f).inv ≫
        conjugateEquiv (g' ≫ f).pullbackModulesAdj (f' ≫ g).pullbackModulesAdj
          (Hom.pullbackModulesCongr h).hom ≫
        conjugateEquiv (f' ≫ g).pullbackModulesAdj
          (g.pullbackModulesAdj.comp f'.pullbackModulesAdj) (Hom.pullbackModulesComp f' g).hom := by
    rw [conjugateEquiv_comp, conjugateEquiv_comp]
    rfl
  have h₁ : conjugateEquiv (f.pullbackModulesAdj.comp g'.pullbackModulesAdj)
      (g' ≫ f).pullbackModulesAdj (Hom.pullbackModulesComp g' f).inv =
        (SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp.{u} f.toRingSheafHom g'.toRingSheafHom).hom :=
    SheafOfModules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv f.toRingSheafHom g'.toRingSheafHom
  have h₃ : conjugateEquiv (g.pullbackModulesAdj.comp f'.pullbackModulesAdj)
      (f' ≫ g).pullbackModulesAdj (Hom.pullbackModulesComp f' g).inv =
        (SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp.{u} g.toRingSheafHom f'.toRingSheafHom).hom :=
    SheafOfModules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv g.toRingSheafHom f'.toRingSheafHom
  have e₁ : (conjugateEquiv (f.pullbackModulesAdj.comp g'.pullbackModulesAdj)
      (g' ≫ f).pullbackModulesAdj (Hom.pullbackModulesComp g' f).inv).app M = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [h₁]
    rfl
  have e₃ : (conjugateEquiv (f' ≫ g).pullbackModulesAdj
      (g.pullbackModulesAdj.comp f'.pullbackModulesAdj) (Hom.pullbackModulesComp f' g).hom).app M =
        𝟙 _ := by
    have := congrArg (fun τ ↦ τ.app M) (conjugateEquiv_comm
      (g.pullbackModulesAdj.comp f'.pullbackModulesAdj) (f' ≫ g).pullbackModulesAdj
      (Hom.pullbackModulesComp f' g).hom_inv_id)
    simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, h₃] at this
    exact (Category.id_comp _).symm.trans this
  rw [hν, NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.comp_app, e₁, e₃]
  erw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  refine (modulesToAb_map_conjugateEquiv_pullbackModulesCongr_hom_app h M).trans ?_
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAbCommSqIso, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.toPullbackModules_comp_modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesBaseChange
statement:
lemma toPullbackModules_comp_modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesBaseChange
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) :
    g.toPullbackModules ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj G) ≫
        (modulesToAb X').map (pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G) =
      TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardBaseChangeApp (base_comm_of_comm h) G.toAb ≫
        f'.pushforwardAb.map (g'.toPullbackModules G)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Hom.pullbackAbAdj g).homEquiv _ _).injective
  let c := (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAbCommSqIso (base_comm_of_comm h)).hom
  have L : (Hom.pullbackAbAdj g).homEquiv _ _
      (g.toPullbackModules ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj G) ≫
        (modulesToAb X').map (pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G)) =
      f.pushforwardAb.map ((modulesToAb Y).map (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G)) ≫
        c.app (g'.pullbackModules.obj G).toAb := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Hom.homEquiv_toPullbackModules]
    calc _ = (modulesToAb X).map (g.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app _ ≫
          (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} g.toRingSheafHom).map
            (pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G)) := (Functor.map_comp _ _ _).symm
      _ = (modulesToAb X).map
          ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).map
            (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G) ≫
          (pushforwardModulesCommSq h).app (g'.pullbackModules.obj G)) :=
        congrArg (modulesToAb X).map (unit_comp_pushforward_map_pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G)
      _ = (modulesToAb X).map ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).map
            (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G)) ≫
          (modulesToAb X).map ((pushforwardModulesCommSq h).app (g'.pullbackModules.obj G)) :=
        Functor.map_comp _ _ _
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun t ↦ (modulesToAb X).map ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u}
            f.toRingSheafHom).map (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G)) ≫ t)
          (modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesCommSq_app h (g'.pullbackModules.obj G))
  have R : (Hom.pullbackAbAdj g).homEquiv _ _
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardBaseChangeApp (base_comm_of_comm h) G.toAb ≫
        f'.pushforwardAb.map (g'.toPullbackModules G)) =
      f.pushforwardAb.map ((modulesToAb Y).map (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G)) ≫
        c.app (g'.pullbackModules.obj G).toAb := by
    have hN := c.naturality (g'.toPullbackModules G)
    have hU : (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAbAdj g'.base).unit.app G.toAb ≫
        g'.pushforwardAb.map (g'.toPullbackModules G) =
          (modulesToAb Y).map (g'.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app G) := by
      rw [← Hom.homEquiv_toPullbackModules, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [TopCat.Sheaf.homEquiv_pullbackPushforwardBaseChangeApp]
    rw [Category.assoc]
    erw [← hN]
    rw [← hU, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  exact L.trans R.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv_cohomologyMap
statement:
theorem pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv_cohomologyMap (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f.base)
    (hf' : IsClosedEmbedding f'.base) (G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf) {n : ℕ} (x : H G n) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.H.pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv hf' (g'.pullbackModules.obj G).toAb n
        (g'.cohomologyMap G n x) =
      H.map (pushforwardModulesBaseChange h G) n
        (g.cohomologyMap ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj G) n
          (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv hf G.toAb n x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.cohomologyMap_apply, Hom.cohomologyMap_apply, H.map,
    ← TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply,
    toPullbackModules_comp_modulesToAb_map_pushforwardModulesBaseChange,
    TopCat.Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  exact (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv_map hf' (g'.toPullbackModules G)
    (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pullback g'.base x)).trans (congrArg
      (TopCat.Sheaf.H.map ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f'.base).map (g'.toPullbackModules G)) n)
      (TopCat.Sheaf.H.pushforwardClosedEmbeddingAddEquiv_pullback (base_comm_of_comm h) hf hf'
        G.toAb x))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictGlobal_map
statement:
lemma restrictGlobal_map (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) {U V : (Opens Y)ᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.H.map_smul
statement:
lemma map_smul {N : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} (φ : M ⟶ N) {q : ℕ}
    (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (x : H M q) : map φ q (r • x) = r • map φ q x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.H.mapₗ_apply

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.H.δ_smul
statement:
lemma δ_smul {S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    {n₀ n₁ : ℕ} (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (x : H S.X₃ n₀) :
    δ hS n₀ n₁ h (r • x) = r • δ hS n₀ n₁ h x
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality (shortExact_map_modulesToAb hS) (shortExact_map_modulesToAb hS)
    ((modulesToAb Y).mapShortComplex.map (shortComplexSMul S r)) h x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pushforward_map_modulesSMul
statement:
lemma pushforward_map_modulesSMul (N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf)
    (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).map
        (modulesSMul N (f.globalSectionsRingHom r)) =
      modulesSMul ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} f.toRingSheafHom).obj N) r
proof:
:= by
  ext U m
  let U' : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ := op ((Opens.map f.base).obj U.unop)
  let a : X.ringSheaf.obj.obj U' := f.c.app U (restrictGlobal r U)
  have key : restrictGlobal (f.globalSectionsRingHom r) U' = a :=
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.c.naturality (homOfLE le_top : U.unop ⟶ ⊤).op) r).symm
  let m' : N.val.obj U' := m
  have : restrictGlobal (f.globalSectionsRingHom r) U' • m' = a • m' := by
    rw [key]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.pullbackModules_map_modulesSMul
statement:
lemma pullbackModules_map_modulesSMul (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    f.pullbackModules.map (modulesSMul M r) =
      modulesSMul (f.pullbackModules.obj M) (f.globalSectionsRingHom r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (f.pullbackModulesAdj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, pushforward_map_modulesSMul]
  exact (f.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.naturality (modulesSMul M r)).symm.trans
    (modulesSMul_naturality (f.pullbackModulesAdj.unit.app M) r).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.cohomologyMap_smul
statement:
lemma Hom.cohomologyMap_smul {q : ℕ} (r : Y.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (x : H M q) :
    f.cohomologyMap M q (r • x) = f.globalSectionsRingHom r • f.cohomologyMap M q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.smul_def, Hom.cohomologyMap_map, pullbackModules_map_modulesSMul, H.smul_def]

name: CommRingCat.faithfullyFlat_hom_of_isIso

theorem _root_.CommRingCat.faithfullyFlat_hom_of_isIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_comp
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : X)
    (hf : (f.stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat) (hg : (g.stalkMap (f.base x)).hom.FaithfullyFlat) :
    ((f ≫ g).stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkMap_comp]
  exact RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.stableUnderComposition (g.stalkMap (f.base x)).hom
    (f.stalkMap x).hom hg hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_isIso

theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_isIso (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) [IsIso (f.stalkMap x)] :

proof:
:=
  CommRingCat.faithfullyFlat_hom_of_isIso _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_isOpenImmersion (f : X ⟶ Y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp (ι : X ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ Z) (x : X)
    [IsIso (ι.stalkMap x)] (h : ((ι ≫ f).stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat) :
    (f.stalkMap (ι.base x)).hom.FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  have e : f.stalkMap (ι.base x) = (ι ≫ f).stalkMap x ≫ inv (ι.stalkMap x) := by
    rw [stalkMap_comp]; simp
  rw [e]
  exact RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.stableUnderComposition ((ι ≫ f).stalkMap x).hom
    (inv (ι.stalkMap x)).hom h (CommRingCat.faithfullyFlat_hom_of_isIso _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp_eq (ι : X ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : ι ≫ f = g) (x : X) [IsIso (ι.stalkMap x)] (h : (g.stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat) :
    (f.stalkMap (ι.base x)).hom.FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp ι f x h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp_eq_right
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_of_comp_eq_right (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (g : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : f ≫ j = g) (x : X) [IsIso (j.stalkMap (f.base x))]
    (h : (g.stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat) : (f.stalkMap x).hom.FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have e : f.stalkMap x = inv (j.stalkMap (f.base x)) ≫ (f ≫ j).stalkMap x := by
    rw [stalkMap_comp]; simp
  rw [e]
  exact RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.stableUnderComposition (inv (j.stalkMap (f.base x))).hom
    ((f ≫ j).stalkMap x).hom (CommRingCat.faithfullyFlat_hom_of_isIso _) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_free
statement:
lemma subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_free (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (hW : ∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj Y.structureSheafAb) q)) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I).toAb) q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let F := modulesToAb Y ⋙ TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_of_sum Finset.univ
    (fun _ : I ↦ F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringSheaf))
    (fun i ↦ F.map (SheafOfModules.freeProj _ i)) (fun i ↦ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree i)) ?_ q
    (fun _ _ ↦ hW q hq)
  simp_rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_sum, SheafOfModules.sum_freeProj_comp_ιFree, F.map_id]

name: SheafOfModules.HasFreeResolutionLE.exists_presentation_acyclic
statement:
theorem exists_presentation_acyclic {M : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringSheaf} {d : ℕ}
    (h : M.HasFreeResolutionLE d) :
    ∃ (I I' : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (_ : Finite I') (p : SheafOfModules.free I ⟶ M)
      (a : SheafOfModules.free I' ⟶ SheafOfModules.free I), a ≫ p = 0 ∧
      ∀ W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace,
        (∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj Y.structureSheafAb) q)) →
        (∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj M.toAb) q)) ∧
        Function.Surjective (p.val.app (op W)) ∧
        ∀ t, p.val.app (op W) t = 0 → ∃ t', a.val.app (op W) t' = t
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | free n I e =>
    refine ⟨I, PEmpty, inferInstance, inferInstance, e.inv, 0, by simp, fun W hW ↦
      ⟨fun q hq ↦ ?_, ?_, fun t ht ↦ ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · haveI := subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_free W hW q hq (I := I)
      exact TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_of_iso
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).mapIso ((modulesToAb Y).mapIso e)) q
    · intro s
      refine ⟨e.hom.val.app (op W) s, ?_⟩
      change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).val.app (op W) s = s
      rw [e.hom_inv_id]
      rfl
    · have ht0 : t = 0 := by
        have : t = (e.inv ≫ e.hom).val.app (op W) t := by rw [e.inv_hom_id]; rfl
        rw [this, SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, ht,
          map_zero]
      rw [ht0]
      exact map_zero _
  | @ext M K n I _ i p w hS hK ih =>
    obtain ⟨I₂, I₂', _, _, p₂, a₂, hpa₂, H₂⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨I, I₂, inferInstance, inferInstance, p, p₂ ≫ i, by simp [w], fun W hW ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hK₁, hK₂, -⟩ := H₂ W hW
    have hS' := shortExact_map_modulesToAb hS
    have hSW := TopCat.Sheaf.shortExact_restrictOpen W hS'
    refine ⟨fun q hq ↦ ?_, ?_, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact @TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_X₃_of_shortExact _ _ hSW q
        (subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_free W hW q hq (I := I)) (hK₁ (q + 1) (by omega))
    · exact TopCat.Sheaf.surjective_of_H_one_restrictOpen W hS'
        (fun x ↦ @Subsingleton.elim _ (hK₁ 1 one_pos) x 0)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (TopCat.Presheaf.sections_exact hS' W).2 t ht
      obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := hK₂ k
      exact ⟨t', hk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.functor_obj_preimageOpen
statement:
lemma functor_obj_preimageOpen {N W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (hW : W ≤ N) :
    N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj (preimageOpen N W) = W
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine ⟨?_, fun hx ↦ ⟨⟨x, hW hx⟩, hx, rfl⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sheafOfModules_map_map
statement:
lemma sheafOfModules_map_map {X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (M : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf)
    {U V W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    M.val.map (homOfLE h₁).op (M.val.map (homOfLE h₂).op s) =
      M.val.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sheafOfModules_map_self
statement:
lemma sheafOfModules_map_self {X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (M : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf)
    {U : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (h : U ≤ U) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    M.val.map (homOfLE h).op s = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 (op U) from rfl, PresheafOfModules.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sheafOfModules_map_sum_smul
statement:
lemma sheafOfModules_map_sum_smul {X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}}
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf) {U W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (h : W ≤ U)
    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (r : I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op U)) (σ : I → M.val.obj (op U)) :
    M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (∑ i ∈ s, r i • σ i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (r i) • M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ PresheafOfModules.map_smul _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf_map_map
statement:
lemma ringSheaf_map_map {X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}}
    {U V W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
    X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h₁).op (X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h₂).op s) =
      X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ringSheaf_map_self
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 (op U) from rfl, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.freeEval_val_app_free
statement:
lemma freeEval_val_app_free {Y : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} {I I' : Type u}
    [Fintype I'] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq I']
    (a : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I' ⟶ SheafOfModules.free I)
    (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (t : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringSheaf) I').val.obj (op W))
    (i : I) :
    SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W) (a.val.app (op W) t) i = ∑ j,
      SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W) t j * Y.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top : W ⟶ ⊤).op
        (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op ⊤) (a.val.app (op ⊤) (generatorSection (𝟙 _) j)) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SheafOfModules.val_app_eq_sum (op W) a t, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, eval_freeHomEquiv_eq_map]
  erw [SheafOfModules.freeEval_naturality]
  congr 3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictSectionsEquiv_smul
statement:
lemma restrictSectionsEquiv_smul (W' : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace)
    (r : (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W'))
    (m : ((restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N)).val.obj (op W')) :
    restrictSectionsEquiv N M W' (r • m) =
      (show X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op (N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W')) from r) •
        restrictSectionsEquiv N M W' m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictSectionsEquiv_map
statement:
lemma restrictSectionsEquiv_map {W'₁ W'₂ : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace}
    (h : W'₁ ≤ W'₂) (h' : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W'₁ ≤
      N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W'₂)
    (m : ((restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N)).val.obj (op W'₂)) :
    restrictSectionsEquiv N M W'₁
        (((restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N)).val.map (homOfLE h).op m) =
      M.val.map (homOfLE h').op (restrictSectionsEquiv N M W'₂ m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictOverEquiv_toAb
statement:
lemma restrictOverEquiv_toAb :
    ((restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N)).toAb =
      (TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen N).obj M.toAb
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_restrict
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictOverEquiv_toAb] at h
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ (TopCat.Sheaf.H.restrictOpenAddEquivOfEq N.isOpenEmbedding W'
    M.toAb q hφW).toEquiv h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.map_val_app_free_eq_sum
statement:
lemma map_val_app_free_eq_sum [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I ⟶
      (restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N))
    {W' : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace} {W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace}
    (hφW : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' = W) (hW : W ≤ N)
    (t : (SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I).val.obj
      (op W')) :
    M.val.map (homOfLE hφW.ge).op (restrictSectionsEquiv N M W' (p.val.app (op W') t)) = ∑ i,
      X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hφW.ge).op (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') t i) •
        M.val.map (homOfLE hW).op (restrictGenerator N M p i)
proof:
:= by
  have r₃ : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' ≤
      N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj ⊤ :=
    hφW.le.trans (hW.trans (TopCat.Sheaf.functor_obj_top N).ge)
  rw [SheafOfModules.val_app_eq_sum (op W') p t, map_sum]
  simp_rw [restrictSectionsEquiv_smul]
  rw [sheafOfModules_map_sum_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [eval_freeHomEquiv_eq_map]
  erw [restrictSectionsEquiv_map le_top r₃]
  rw [sheafOfModules_map_map, restrictGenerator, sheafOfModules_map_map]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sheafOfModules_map_injective
proof:
:= fun x y hxy ↦ by
  rw [← sheafOfModules_map_self M (le_refl V) x, ← sheafOfModules_map_self M (le_refl V) y,
    ← sheafOfModules_map_map M h₂ h₁, ← sheafOfModules_map_map M h₂ h₁, hxy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sum_restrictRelation_smul
statement:
lemma sum_restrictRelation_smul [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {I' : Type u}
    (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I ⟶
      (restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N))
    (a : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I' ⟶
      SheafOfModules.free I) (hap : a ≫ p = 0) (j : I') :
    ∑ i, restrictRelation N a j i • restrictGenerator N M p i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : p.val.app (op ⊤) (a.val.app (op ⊤) (generatorSection (𝟙 _) j)) = 0 := by
    change (a ≫ p).val.app (op ⊤) _ = 0
    rw [hap]
    rfl
  have h₀ := map_val_app_free_eq_sum p (TopCat.Sheaf.functor_obj_top N) le_rfl
    (a.val.app (op ⊤) (generatorSection (𝟙 _) j))
  erw [hz, map_zero] at h₀
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h₀.symm
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [sheafOfModules_map_self]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.val_app_freeEvalSymm_eq_zero
statement:
lemma val_app_freeEvalSymm_eq_zero [Fintype I]
    (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I ⟶
      (restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N))
    {W' : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace} {W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace}
    (hφW : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' = W) (hW : W ≤ N)
    (f : I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W))
    (hf : ∑ i, f i • M.val.map (homOfLE hW).op (restrictGenerator N M p i) = 0) :
    p.val.app (op W') (SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
      (op W') (fun i ↦ X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hφW.le).op (f i))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (restrictSectionsEquiv N M W').injective
  apply sheafOfModules_map_injective M hφW.ge hφW.le
  have h1 := map_val_app_free_eq_sum p hφW hW (SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm
    (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) (op W')
    (fun i ↦ X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hφW.le).op (f i)))
  simp_rw [SheafOfModules.freeEval_freeEvalSymm, ringSheaf_map_map, ringSheaf_map_self] at h1
  rw [hf] at h1
  rw [h1, map_zero, map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_eq_sum_restrictRelation
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_restrictRelation [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {I' : Type u} [Fintype I']
    (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I ⟶
      (restrictOverEquiv X N).functor.obj (M.over N))
    (a : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf) I' ⟶
      SheafOfModules.free I)
    {W' : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace} {W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace}
    (hφW : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' = W) (hW : W ≤ N)
    (hker : ∀ t, p.val.app (op W') t = 0 → ∃ t', a.val.app (op W') t' = t)
    (f : I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W))
    (hf : ∑ i, f i • M.val.map (homOfLE hW).op (restrictGenerator N M p i) = 0) :
    ∃ c : I' → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W),
      ∀ i, f i = ∑ j, c j * X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hW).op (restrictRelation N a j i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have r₁ : W ≤ N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' := hφW.ge
  have r₂ : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' ≤ W := hφW.le
  let t := SheafOfModules.freeEvalSymm (R := (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).ringSheaf)
    (op W') (fun i ↦ X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE r₂).op (f i))
  have ht : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') t i =
      X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE r₂).op (f i) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [SheafOfModules.freeEval_freeEvalSymm]
  have hpt : p.val.app (op W') t = 0 := val_app_freeEvalSymm_eq_zero p hφW hW f hf
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := hker t hpt
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE r₁).op (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') t' j),
    fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have h2 := freeEval_val_app_free a W' t' i
  rw [ht', ht] at h2
  have h3 := congrArg (X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE r₁).op) h2
  rw [ringSheaf_map_map, ringSheaf_map_self] at h3
  rw [h3]
  erw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  erw [map_mul]
  refine congrArg _ ?_
  exact (ringSheaf_map_map _ _ _).trans (ringSheaf_map_map hW _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_generators_acyclic
statement:
theorem exists_generators_acyclic (N : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringSheaf) {d : ℕ}
    (h : ((X.restrictModules N).obj M).HasFreeResolutionLE d) :
    ∃ (I I' : Type u) (_ : Fintype I) (_ : Fintype I') (g : I → M.val.obj (op N))
      (A : I' → I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op N)), (∀ j, ∑ i, A j i • g i = 0) ∧
      ∀ (W : Opens X.toPresheafedSpace) (hW : W ≤ N),
        (∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj X.structureSheafAb) q)) →
        (∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W).obj M.toAb) q)) ∧
        (∀ s : M.val.obj (op W), ∃ f : I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W),
          s = ∑ i, f i • M.val.map (homOfLE hW).op (g i)) ∧
        (∀ f : I → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W),
          ∑ i, f i • M.val.map (homOfLE hW).op (g i) = 0 →
          ∃ c : I' → X.ringSheaf.obj.obj (op W),
            ∀ i, f i = ∑ j, c j * X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE hW).op (A j i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, I', _, _, p, a, hap, H⟩ :=
    (h.of_iso (restrictModulesObjIso X N M)).exists_presentation_acyclic
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I'
  have hN : N ≤ N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj ⊤ := (TopCat.Sheaf.functor_obj_top N).ge
  refine ⟨I, I', inferInstance, inferInstance, restrictGenerator N M p, restrictRelation N a,
    sum_restrictRelation_smul p a hap, fun W hW hWa ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨W', hφW⟩ : ∃ W' : Opens (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).toPresheafedSpace,
      N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' = W :=
    ⟨preimageOpen N W, functor_obj_preimageOpen hW⟩
  have r₁ : W ≤ N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' := hφW.ge
  have r₂ : N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W' ≤ W := hφW.le
  have hW'a : ∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (TopCat.Sheaf.H
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrictOpen W').obj (X.restrict N.isOpenEmbedding).structureSheafAb) q) :=
    fun q hq ↦ @Equiv.subsingleton _ _
      (structureSheafAbAddEquivOfEq (X.ofRestrict N.isOpenEmbedding) N.isOpenEmbedding W' hφW
        q).symm.toEquiv (hWa q hq)
  obtain ⟨hMa, hsurj, hker⟩ := H W' hW'a
  refine ⟨fun q hq ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_, fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact subsingleton_H_restrictOpen_of_restrict hφW (hMa q hq)
  · let s' : M.val.obj (op (N.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj W')) :=
      M.val.map (homOfLE r₂).op s
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsurj ((restrictSectionsEquiv N M W').symm s')
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ X.ringSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE r₁).op (SheafOfModules.freeEval (op W') t i),
      ?_⟩
    have e1 : M.val.map (homOfLE r₁).op s' = s := by
      rw [sheafOfModules_map_map, sheafOfModules_map_self]
    rw [← e1, ← (restrictSectionsEquiv N M W').apply_symm_apply s', ← ht]
    exact map_val_app_free_eq_sum p hφW hW t
  · exact exists_eq_sum_restrictRelation p a hφW hW hker f hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_colimit_ι_base_eq
statement:
theorem exists_colimit_ι_base_eq (x : (colimit F : LocallyRingedSpace.{u})) :
    ∃ (i : Discrete ι) (y : F.obj i), (colimit.ι F i).base y = x
proof:
:= by
  set e := preservesColimitIso forgetToSheafedSpace.{u} F with he
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := SheafedSpace.colimit_exists_rep (F ⋙ forgetToSheafedSpace.{u})
    (e.hom.hom.base x)
  refine ⟨i, y, ?_⟩
  have hcomp := ι_preservesColimitIso_hom forgetToSheafedSpace.{u} F i
  have key : e.hom.hom.base ((colimit.ι F i).base y) = e.hom.hom.base x := by
    rw [← hy, ← hcomp]
    rfl
  have : IsIso ((SheafedSpace.forget CommRingCat.{u}).map e.hom) := inferInstance
  exact (TopCat.homeoOfIso (asIso ((SheafedSpace.forget CommRingCat.{u}).map e.hom))).injective key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.exists_sigma_ι_base_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sigma_ι_base_eq (x : (∐ f : LocallyRingedSpace.{u})) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (y : f i), (Sigma.ι f i).base y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := exists_colimit_ι_base_eq (Discrete.functor f) x
  exact ⟨i.as, y, hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.eq_of_colimit_ι_base_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_colimit_ι_base_eq {i j : Discrete ι} {x : F.obj i} {y : F.obj j}
    (h : (colimit.ι F i).base x = (colimit.ι F j).base y) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hc := isColimitOfPreserves forgetToTop.{u} (colimit.isColimit F)
  have hi := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hc.fac (indexCocone F) i) x
  have hj := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hc.fac (indexCocone F) j) y
  simp only [Functor.mapCocone_ι_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hi hj
  exact Discrete.ext (hi.symm.trans
    ((congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom (hc.desc (indexCocone F))) h).trans hj))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.eq_of_sigmaι_base_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_sigmaι_base_eq {i j : ι} {x : f i} {y : f j}
    (h : (Sigma.ι f i).base x = (Sigma.ι f j).base y) : i = j
proof:
:=
  congrArg Discrete.as (eq_of_colimit_ι_base_eq (Discrete.functor f) h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sigmaι_base_injective
statement: theorem sigmaι_base_injective (i : ι) : Function.Injective (Sigma.ι f i).base
proof:
:=
  (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f i).base_open.injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.sigmaι_base_eq_iff
statement:
theorem sigmaι_base_eq_iff (i j : ι) (x : f i) (y : f j) :
    (Sigma.ι f i).base x = (Sigma.ι f j).base y ↔
      (Sigma.mk i x : (i : ι) × (f i).toTopCat) = Sigma.mk j y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain rfl := eq_of_sigmaι_base_eq f h
    exact congrArg _ (sigmaι_base_injective f i h)
  · rintro ⟨⟩
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.disjoint_range_sigmaι
statement:
theorem disjoint_range_sigmaι {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (Sigma.ι f i).base) (Set.range (Sigma.ι f j).base)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact h (eq_of_sigmaι_base_eq f hy).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.disjoint_opensRange_sigmaOpenCover
statement:
theorem disjoint_opensRange_sigmaOpenCover {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint ((sigmaOpenCover f).opensRange i) ((sigmaOpenCover f).opensRange j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff, ← SetLike.coe_set_eq, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_inf,
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_bot, OpenCover.coe_opensRange, OpenCover.coe_opensRange]
  exact Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (disjoint_range_sigmaι f h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc (i : ι) (x : f i) :
    (Sigma.desc g).base ((Sigma.ι f i).base x) = (g i).base x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun m : f i ⟶ Y ↦ m.base x) (Sigma.ι_desc g i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.image_base_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem image_base_sigmaDesc (C : Set (∐ f : LocallyRingedSpace.{u})) :
    (Sigma.desc g).base '' C = ⋃ i, (g i).base '' ((Sigma.ι f i).base ⁻¹' C)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := exists_sigma_ι_base_eq f x
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ⟨y, hx, (base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc f g i y).symm⟩⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨i, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hz
    exact ⟨(Sigma.ι f i).base y, hy, base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc f g i y⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isClosedMap_base_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem isClosedMap_base_sigmaDesc [Finite ι] (h : ∀ i, IsClosedMap (g i).base) :
    IsClosedMap (Sigma.desc g).base
proof:
:= by
  intro C hC
  rw [image_base_sigmaDesc]
  exact isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun i ↦ h i _ (hC.preimage (Sigma.ι f i).base.hom.continuous)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isSeparatedMap_base_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem isSeparatedMap_base_sigmaDesc (h : ∀ i, IsSeparatedMap ⇑(g i).base) :
    IsSeparatedMap ⇑(Sigma.desc g).base
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy hne
  obtain ⟨i, a, rfl⟩ := exists_sigma_ι_base_eq f x
  obtain ⟨j, b, rfl⟩ := exists_sigma_ι_base_eq f y
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    have hab : (g i).base a = (g i).base b := by
      rw [← base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc f g i a, ← base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc f g i b]
      exact hxy
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hau, hbv, huv⟩ := h i a b hab fun hab' ↦ hne (by rw [hab'])
    refine ⟨(Sigma.ι f i).base '' u, (Sigma.ι f i).base '' v,
      (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f i).base_open.isOpenMap _ hu,
      (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f i).base_open.isOpenMap _ hv,
      ⟨a, hau, rfl⟩, ⟨b, hbv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩
    obtain rfl := sigmaι_base_injective f i hqp
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 huv hp hq
  · refine ⟨Set.range ⇑(Sigma.ι f i).base, Set.range ⇑(Sigma.ι f j).base,
      (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f i).base_open.isOpen_range,
      (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f j).base_open.isOpen_range, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
    exact hij (eq_of_sigmaι_base_eq f hq).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isLocalHomeomorph_base_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base_sigmaDesc (h : ∀ i, IsLocalHomeomorph (g i).base) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph (Sigma.desc g).base
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, z, rfl⟩ := exists_sigma_ι_base_eq f x
  have hcomp : IsLocalHomeomorphOn ((Sigma.desc g).base ∘ (Sigma.ι f i).base) Set.univ := by
    have he : (Sigma.desc g).base ∘ ((Sigma.ι f i).base : f i → (∐ f : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}))
        = (g i).base := funext fun y ↦ base_sigmaι_sigmaDesc f g i y
    rw [he]
    exact (h i).isLocalHomeomorphOn
  exact hcomp.of_comp_right
    (sigmaι_isOpenImmersion f i).base_open.isLocalHomeomorph.isLocalHomeomorphOn _
      ⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isIso_stalkMap_sigmaDesc
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_sigmaDesc (h : ∀ i (x : f i), IsIso ((g i).stalkMap x))
    (x : (∐ f : LocallyRingedSpace.{u})) : IsIso ((Sigma.desc g).stalkMap x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, z, rfl⟩ := exists_sigma_ι_base_eq f x
  exact isIso_stalkMap_of_comp (Sigma.ι f i) (Sigma.desc g) (g i) (Sigma.ι_desc g i) z (h i z)

theorem sigmaHomeoSigma_symm_apply (i : ι) (y : f i) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ExtSec.smul_def
statement:
lemma ExtSec.smul_def {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (r : Γᵧ(W)) (x : ExtSec N U W) :
    r • x = (show N.val.obj (op (W ⊓ U)) from
      (r |ₒ (W ⊓ U)) • (show N.val.obj (op (W ⊓ U)) from x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.isSheaf_restrictExtendPresheaf
statement:
lemma isSheaf_restrictExtendPresheaf :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (restrictExtendPresheaf N U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro κ W sf hsf
  have key : ∃! t : N.val.obj (op (iSup W ⊓ U)), ∀ a,
      modRes t (W a ⊓ U) (inf_le_inf_right U (le_iSup W a)) = sf a := by
    refine modRes_existsUnique_gluing N (fun a ↦ W a ⊓ U) (by rw [iSup_inf_eq]) _ _ ?_
    intro a b
    have h1 : modRes (N := N) (sf a) ((W a ⊓ W b) ⊓ U) (by order) =
        modRes (N := N) (sf b) ((W a ⊓ W b) ⊓ U) (by order) := hsf a b
    have := congrArg (fun x : N.val.obj (op ((W a ⊓ W b) ⊓ U)) ↦
      modRes x (W a ⊓ U ⊓ (W b ⊓ U)) (by order)) h1
    simpa only [modRes_res] using this
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := key
  exact ⟨t, ht, fun s hs ↦ hu s hs⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictExtendSec_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrictExtendSec_mk {W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (x : N.val.obj (op (W ⊓ U))) :
    restrictExtendSec (restrictExtendMk (U := U) x) = x
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.restrictExtendSMul_res

lemma restrictExtendSMul_res {V : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace} (h : V ≤ U) (a : Γᵧ(U)) :

      restrictExtendRes N h ≫ restrictExtendSMul N V (a |ₒ V)

    ((a |ₒ V) |ₒ (W ⊓ V)) • modRes (N := N) (restrictExtendSec x) (W ⊓ V) (inf_le_inf_left W h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSec_existsUnique_gluing
statement:
lemma homSec_existsUnique_gluing
    (hc : ∀ a b, (show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) from hf a) ≫
        restrictExtendRes K (inf_le_left : U a ⊓ U b ≤ U a) =
      (show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U b) from hf b) ≫ restrictExtendRes K inf_le_right)
    (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (x : F.val.obj (op W)) :
    ∃! t : K.val.obj (op (W ⊓ iSup U)), ∀ a,
      modRes t (W ⊓ U a) (inf_le_inf_left W (le_iSup U a)) =
        restrictExtendSec ((show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) from hf a).val.app (op W) x)
proof:
:= by
  refine modRes_existsUnique_gluing K (fun a ↦ W ⊓ U a) (by rw [inf_iSup_eq]) _ _ ?_
  intro a b
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a ⊓ U b) ↦
    restrictExtendSec (φ.val.app (op W) x)) (hc a b)
  change modRes (N := K) (restrictExtendSec ((show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) from hf a).val.app
      (op W) x)) (W ⊓ (U a ⊓ U b)) (inf_le_inf_left W inf_le_left) =
    modRes (N := K) (restrictExtendSec ((show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U b) from hf b).val.app
      (op W) x)) (W ⊓ (U a ⊓ U b)) (inf_le_inf_left W inf_le_right) at h1
  have := congrArg (fun y : K.val.obj (op (W ⊓ (U a ⊓ U b))) ↦
    modRes y (W ⊓ U a ⊓ (W ⊓ U b)) (by order)) h1
  simpa only [modRes_res] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSecGlueApp_spec
statement:
lemma homSecGlueApp_spec (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (x : F.val.obj (op W)) (a : κ) :
    modRes (homSecGlueApp U hf hc W x) (W ⊓ U a) (inf_le_inf_left W (le_iSup U a)) =
      restrictExtendSec ((show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) from hf a).val.app (op W) x)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSecGlueApp_unique
statement:
lemma homSecGlueApp_unique (W : Opens Y.toPresheafedSpace) (x : F.val.obj (op W))
    (t : K.val.obj (op (W ⊓ iSup U)))
    (ht : ∀ a, modRes t (W ⊓ U a) (inf_le_inf_left W (le_iSup U a)) =
      restrictExtendSec ((show F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) from hf a).val.app (op W) x)) :
    t = homSecGlueApp U hf hc W x
proof:
:=
  (homSec_existsUnique_gluing U hf hc W x).unique ht (homSecGlueApp_spec U hf hc W x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSecGlue_res

    homSecGlue U hf hc ≫ restrictExtendRes K (le_iSup U a) = hf a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSecGlue_unique
statement:
lemma homSecGlue_unique (s : F ⟶ restrictExtend K (iSup U))
    (hs : ∀ a, s ≫ restrictExtendRes K (le_iSup U a) = hf a) : s = homSecGlue U hf hc
proof:
:=
  modHom_ext fun W x ↦ homSecGlueApp_unique U hf hc W x _ fun a ↦
    congrArg (fun φ : F ⟶ restrictExtend K (U a) ↦ restrictExtendSec (φ.val.app (op W) x)) (hs a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.homSheafMap_comp_homSheafMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma homSheafMap_comp_homSheafMap_eq_zero (H : ψ ≫ g = 0) :
