name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.MkCore.ι_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ι_eq_iff (i j : h.J) (x : h.U i) (y : h.U j) :
    (h.toGlueData.ι i).base x = (h.toGlueData.ι j).base y ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ h.V i j, ((h.t i j).base ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [GlueData.ι_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨z, hz'⟩, hz, hy⟩
    change z = x at hz
    change ((h.t i j).base ⟨z, hz'⟩).1 = y at hy
    refine ⟨hz ▸ hz', ?_⟩
    rw [← hy]
    congr 3
    exact hz.symm
  · rintro ⟨hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.MkCore.preimage_range
statement:
theorem preimage_range (i j : h.J) :
    (h.toGlueData.ι i).base ⁻¹' Set.range (h.toGlueData.ι j).base =
      (h.V i j : Set (h.U i))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ((h.ι_eq_iff i j x y).mp hy.symm).1
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨_, ((h.ι_eq_iff i j x _).mpr ⟨hx, rfl⟩).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.GlueData.MkCore.ι_jointly_surjective

proof:
:=
  GlueData.ι_jointly_surjective _ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.mem_zeroLocus_iff
statement:
lemma mem_zeroLocus_iff {y : Y} :
    y ∈ Y.zeroLocus f ↔
      ∀ i, Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f i) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (RingedSpace.mem_zeroLocus_iff (X := Y.toRingedSpace) (Set.range f) y).trans ?_
  simp only [Set.forall_mem_range, RingedSpace.mem_top_basicOpen, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff]

statement:
lemma mem_zeroLocus_iff_not_isUnit {y : Y} :
    y ∈ Y.zeroLocus f ↔ ∀ i, ¬ IsUnit (Y.presheaf.Γgerm y (f i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_zeroLocus_iff, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.mem_zeroLocus_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem mem_zeroLocus_restrict_iff (X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}) (V : Opens X) {κ : Type*}
    (g : κ → (X.restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (y : X.restrict V.isOpenEmbedding) :
    y ∈ (X.restrict V.isOpenEmbedding).zeroLocus g ↔
      ∀ i, ¬ IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (V.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj ⊤)
        (Opens.inclusion' V y) ⟨y, trivial, rfl⟩ (g i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_zeroLocus_iff_not_isUnit]
  refine forall_congr' fun i ↦ not_congr ?_
  rw [← X.restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ_apply V.isOpenEmbedding ⊤ y trivial (g i)]
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (X.restrictStalkIso V.isOpenEmbedding y).hom.hom _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom
statement:
theorem stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom (z : Y.zeroLocusSpace f) :
    (Y.zeroLocusιHom f).stalkMap z =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat.{u} (Y.zeroLocusι f z)).map
        (Y.presheaf.toQuotientSpan f) ≫ (Y.zeroLocusStalkIso f z).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat.{u} (Y.zeroLocusι f z)).map (Y.zeroLocusC f) ≫
      (Y.zeroLocusPresheaf f).stalkPushforward CommRingCat.{u} (Y.zeroLocusι f) z = _
  rw [zeroLocusC]
  
  
  erw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_naturality]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.surjective_stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom
statement:
theorem surjective_stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom (z : Y.zeroLocusSpace f) :
    Function.Surjective ((Y.zeroLocusιHom f).stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom]
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Y.zeroLocusStalkIso f z).hom).surjective.comp
    (Y.presheaf.surjective_stalkFunctor_map_toQuotientSpan f (Y.zeroLocusι f z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.ker_stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom (z : Y.zeroLocusSpace f) :
    RingHom.ker ((Y.zeroLocusιHom f).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ Y.presheaf.Γgerm (Y.zeroLocusι f z) (f i))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective ((Y.zeroLocusStalkIso f z).hom).hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Y.zeroLocusStalkIso f z).hom).injective
  rw [← Y.presheaf.ker_stalkFunctor_map_toQuotientSpan f (Y.zeroLocusι f z),
    stalkMap_zeroLocusιHom]
  ext t
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg ((Y.zeroLocusStalkIso f z).hom).hom (RingHom.mem_ker.mp h)).trans
    (map_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.span_Γgerm_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
lemma span_Γgerm_le_maximalIdeal (z : Y.zeroLocusSpace f) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ Y.presheaf.Γgerm (Y.zeroLocusι f z) (f i)) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (Y.zeroLocusι f z))
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact (Y.mem_zeroLocus_iff f).1 z.2 i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.span_Γgerm_ne_top
statement:
lemma span_Γgerm_ne_top (z : Y.zeroLocusSpace f) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ Y.presheaf.Γgerm (Y.zeroLocusι f z) (f i)) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (Y.presheaf.stalk (Y.zeroLocusι f z))).ne_top
    (eq_top_iff.2 (h ▸ Y.span_Γgerm_le_maximalIdeal f z))

name: OkaRing.toGlobalFun_eq_evalHom
statement:
theorem toGlobalFun_eq_evalHom (f : OkaRing U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    f.toGlobalFun U y = OkaRing.evalHom hy f
proof:
:=
  OkaRing.toGlobalFun_apply f hy

name: OkaRing.coeff_single_one_germ
statement:
theorem coeff_single_one_germ (hy : y ∈ U) (f : OkaRing U) (j : ι) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single j 1)
        ((germ hy f : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) =
      fderiv ℂ (f.toGlobalFun U) y (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  set P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ := ((germ hy f : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) with hP
  have hconv : P.LocallyConvergent := (germ hy f).locallyConvergent
  have hEq : P.eval =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ι → ℂ)] fun z ↦ f.toGlobalFun U (z + y) :=
    hconv.represents_eval.eventuallyEq (germ_represents hy f)
  rw [← hconv.fderiv_eval_zero j, hEq.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp_add_right]
  simp

name: MvPowerSeries.evalMonomial_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma evalMonomial_zero (x : ι → ℂ) : evalMonomial (0 : ι →₀ ℕ) x = 1

name: MvPowerSeries.evalMonomial_add

    evalMonomial (d + e) x = evalMonomial d x * evalMonomial e x
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_add_index' (by simp) (by simp [pow_add])

statement:

proof:

statement:

lemma term_add (P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :

proof:

name: MvPowerSeries.term_algebraMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma term_algebraMap_zero (c : ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) c).term x 0 = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [term, algebraMap_apply, coeff_C, if_pos rfl, evalMonomial_zero, mul_one]
  simp

name: MvPowerSeries.term_algebraMap_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma term_algebraMap_of_ne_zero (c : ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) {d : ι →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) c).term x d = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [term, algebraMap_apply, coeff_C, if_neg hd, zero_mul]

name: MvPowerSeries.term_mul
statement:
lemma term_mul [DecidableEq ι] (P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (P * Q).term x d =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d, P.term x p.1 * Q.term x p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [term, coeff_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [term, term, ← hp, evalMonomial_add]
  ring

name: MvPowerSeries.evalMonomial_eq_zero
statement: lemma evalMonomial_eq_zero {d : ι →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) : evalMonomial d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
  refine Finset.prod_eq_zero hi ?_
  exact zero_pow (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)

name: MvPowerSeries.eval_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eval_zero (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) : P.eval 0 = constantCoeff P
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval, tsum_eq_single 0 fun d hd ↦ by rw [term, evalMonomial_eq_zero hd, mul_zero], term,
    evalMonomial_zero, mul_one, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]

name: MvPowerSeries.summableAt_algebraMap
statement:
lemma summableAt_algebraMap (c : ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) c).SummableAt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := {0}) fun d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [term_algebraMap_of_ne_zero c x (by simpa using hd), norm_zero]

name: MvPowerSeries.SummableAt.add
statement:
lemma SummableAt.add {P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {x : ι → ℂ} (hP : P.SummableAt x)
    (hQ : Q.SummableAt x) : (P + Q).SummableAt x
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun d ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun d ↦ ?_) (Summable.add hP hQ)
  rw [term_add]
  exact norm_add_le _ _

name: MvPowerSeries.SummableAt.mul
statement:
lemma SummableAt.mul {P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {x : ι → ℂ} (hP : P.SummableAt x)
    (hQ : Q.SummableAt x) : (P * Q).SummableAt x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hF : Summable fun p : (ι →₀ ℕ) × (ι →₀ ℕ) ↦ ‖P.term x p.1‖ * ‖Q.term x p.2‖ :=
    Summable.mul_of_nonneg hP hQ (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
  have hkey : Summable fun d : ι →₀ ℕ ↦
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d, ‖P.term x p.1‖ * ‖Q.term x p.2‖ := by
    refine Summable.congr (((antidiagonalSigmaEquiv ι).summable_iff.mpr hF).sigma) fun d ↦ ?_
    rw [← Finset.tsum_subtype]
    rfl
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun d ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun d ↦ ?_) hkey
  rw [term_mul]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [norm_mul]

name: MvPowerSeries.locallyConvergent_algebraMap

lemma locallyConvergent_algebraMap (c : ℂ) :

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.add
statement:
lemma LocallyConvergent.add {P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hP : P.LocallyConvergent)
    (hQ : Q.LocallyConvergent) : (P + Q).LocallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP, hQ] with x hx hx' using hx.add hx'

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.mul
statement:
lemma LocallyConvergent.mul {P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hP : P.LocallyConvergent)
    (hQ : Q.LocallyConvergent) : (P * Q).LocallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP, hQ] with x hx hx' using hx.mul hx'

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.congr
statement:
lemma Represents.congr {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {f g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hP : P.Represents f)
    (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ)] g) : P.Represents g
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP, h] with x hx hx' using hx' ▸ hx

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.eventuallyEq
statement:
lemma Represents.eventuallyEq {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {f g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ}
    (hf : P.Represents f) (hg : P.Represents g) : f =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ)] g
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hf, hg] with x hx hx' using hx.unique hx'

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.represents_eval
statement:
lemma LocallyConvergent.represents_eval {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hP : P.LocallyConvergent) :
    P.Represents P.eval
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP] with x hx using hx.hasSum

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.add
statement:
lemma Represents.add {P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {f g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hP : P.Represents f)
    (hQ : Q.Represents g) : (P + Q).Represents (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP, hQ] with x hx hx'
  have h : (P + Q).term x = fun d ↦ P.term x d + Q.term x d := funext (term_add P Q x)
  rw [h, Pi.add_apply]
  exact hx.add hx'

name: MvPowerSeries.represents_algebraMap
statement:
lemma represents_algebraMap (c : ℂ) :
    (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) c).Represents (Function.const (ι → ℂ) c)
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_forall fun x ↦ ?_
  simpa using hasSum_single (f := (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) c).term x) 0
    (fun d hd ↦ term_algebraMap_of_ne_zero c x hd)

name: MvPowerSeries.represents_zero
statement: lemma represents_zero : (0 : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).Represents (Function.const (ι → ℂ) 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using represents_algebraMap (ι := ι) 0

name: MvPowerSeries.represents_one
statement: lemma represents_one : (1 : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).Represents (Function.const (ι → ℂ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using represents_algebraMap (ι := ι) 1

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [hPc, hQc, hP, hQ] with x hPx hQx hPf hQg
  rw [Pi.mul_apply]
  
  have hprod : HasSum (fun p : (ι →₀ ℕ) × (ι →₀ ℕ) ↦ P.term x p.1 * Q.term x p.2)
      (f x * g x) :=
    hPf.mul hQg (summable_mul_of_summable_norm hPx hQx)
  
  refine ((antidiagonalSigmaEquiv ι).hasSum_iff.mpr hprod).sigma fun d ↦ ?_
  have hval : ∑ p : {p : (ι →₀ ℕ) × (ι →₀ ℕ) // p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d},
      P.term x p.val.1 * Q.term x p.val.2 = (P * Q).term x d := by
    rw [term_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_coe_sort _ fun p : (ι →₀ ℕ) × (ι →₀ ℕ) ↦ P.term x p.1 * Q.term x p.2
  rw [← hval]
  exact hasSum_fintype _

name: MvPowerSeries.evalMonomial_eq_prod
statement: lemma evalMonomial_eq_prod (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (x : ι → ℂ) : evalMonomial d x = ∏ i, x i ^ d i
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ fun _ ↦ pow_zero _

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_evalMonomial
statement:
lemma norm_evalMonomial (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖evalMonomial d x‖ = ∏ i, ‖x i‖ ^ d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMonomial_eq_prod, norm_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ norm_pow _ _

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_evalMonomial_le
statement:
lemma norm_evalMonomial_le (h : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ‖evalMonomial d x‖ ≤ ‖evalMonomial d y‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evalMonomial, Finsupp.prod, norm_prod, norm_pow]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ ↦ by positivity)
    fun i _ ↦ pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h i) _

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_term_le
statement:
lemma norm_term_le (h : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ‖P.term x d‖ ≤ ‖P.term y d‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [term, term, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_evalMonomial_le h d) (norm_nonneg _)

name: MvPowerSeries.SummableAt.mono
statement: lemma SummableAt.mono (hy : P.SummableAt y) (h : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) : P.SummableAt x
proof:
:=
  Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun d ↦ norm_term_le h d) hy

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.exists_summableAt_const
statement:
lemma LocallyConvergent.exists_summableAt_const [Finite ι] (hP : P.LocallyConvergent) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ P.SummableAt (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  refine ⟨ε / 2, by positivity, hball ?_⟩
  rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
  have h1 : ‖fun _ : ι ↦ ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε / 2 :=
    (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr fun i ↦ by
      simp [Complex.norm_real, abs_of_nonneg hε.le]
  linarith

name: MvPowerSeries.mem_degFinset
statement: lemma mem_degFinset {n : ℕ} {d : ι →₀ ℕ} : d ∈ degFinset ι n ↔ ∑ i, d i = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [degFinset, Finset.mem_finsuppAntidiag]
  exact and_iff_left (Finset.subset_univ _)

name: MvPowerSeries.self_mem_degFinset
statement: lemma self_mem_degFinset (d : ι →₀ ℕ) : d ∈ degFinset ι (∑ i, d i)
proof:
:=
  mem_degFinset.mpr rfl

name: MvPowerSeries.hasSum_degFinset
statement:
lemma hasSum_degFinset {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] [TopologicalSpace α] [ContinuousAdd α]
    [RegularSpace α] {f : (ι →₀ ℕ) → α} {s : α} (h : HasSum f s) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, f d) s
proof:
:= by
  refine (degreeSigmaEquiv.hasSum_iff.mpr h).sigma fun n ↦ ?_
  have hval : ∑ d : {d : ι →₀ ℕ // d ∈ degFinset ι n}, f d.val = ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, f d :=
    Finset.sum_coe_sort _ _
  rw [← hval]
  exact hasSum_fintype _

name: MvPowerSeries.hasSum_degree
statement:
lemma hasSum_degree {s : ℂ} (h : HasSum (P.term x) s) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, P.term x d) s
proof:
:=
  hasSum_degFinset h

name: MvPowerSeries.hasSum_degree_norm
statement:
lemma hasSum_degree_norm (h : P.SummableAt x) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖P.term x d‖) (∑' d, ‖P.term x d‖)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_degFinset (Summable.hasSum h)

name: MvPowerSeries.monomialCMM_apply_diag
statement:
lemma monomialCMM_apply_diag {d : ι →₀ ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ degFinset ι n) (y : ι → ℂ) :
    monomialCMM d n (fun _ ↦ y) = evalMonomial d y
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card ((i : ι) × Fin (d i)) = n := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
    simpa using mem_degFinset.mp hd
  rw [monomialCMM, dif_pos hcard]
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
  rw [Equiv.prod_comp (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard).symm fun j ↦ y j.1]
  rw [Fintype.prod_sigma]
  simp [evalMonomial_eq_prod]

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_monomialCMM_le
statement: lemma norm_monomialCMM_le (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ‖monomialCMM d n‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomialCMM]
  split
  · refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num) fun v ↦ ?_
    rw [one_mul, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, norm_prod]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) fun k _ ↦ norm_le_pi_norm _ _
  · simp

name: MvPowerSeries.toFPS_apply_diag
statement:
lemma toFPS_apply_diag (n : ℕ) (y : ι → ℂ) :
    toFPS P n (fun _ ↦ y) = ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, P.term y d
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFPS, sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_apply, monomialCMM_apply_diag hd, term, smul_eq_mul]

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_toFPS_le
statement: lemma norm_toFPS_le (n : ℕ) : ‖toFPS P n‖ ≤ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖coeff d P‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun d _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [norm_smul]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (norm_monomialCMM_le d n)

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_term_const
statement:
lemma norm_term_const {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) {n : ℕ} {d : ι →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ degFinset ι n) :
    ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) d‖ = ‖coeff d P‖ * ρ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [term, norm_mul, norm_evalMonomial]
  congr 1
  rw [← mem_degFinset.mp hd, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ]

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall
statement:
theorem LocallyConvergent.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall (hP : P.LocallyConvergent) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ HasFPowerSeriesOnBall P.eval (toFPS P) 0 (ENNReal.ofReal ρ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hsum⟩ := hP.exists_summableAt_const
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_, ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hρ, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖toFPS P n‖ * ((Real.toNNReal ρ : NNReal) : ℝ) ^ n ≤
        ∑' d, ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) d‖ := by
      intro n
      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal ρ hρ.le]
      have h1 : ‖toFPS P n‖ * ρ ^ n ≤ (∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖coeff d P‖) * ρ ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_toFPS_le n) (by positivity)
      have h2 : (∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖coeff d P‖) * ρ ^ n
          = ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) d‖ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ (norm_term_const hρ.le hd).symm
      have h3 : ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) d‖ ≤
          ∑' d, ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) d‖ :=
        le_hasSum (hasSum_degree_norm hsum) n fun m _ ↦
          Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1.trans h3
    exact (toFPS P).le_radius_of_bound _ hbound
  · 
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.eball_ofReal, mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
    have hle : ∀ i, ‖y i‖ ≤ ‖(fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) i‖ := fun i ↦ by
      refine (norm_le_pi_norm y i).trans ?_
      simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le, hy.le]
    have := hasSum_degree (P := P) (x := y) (hsum.mono hle).hasSum
    simpa only [toFPS_apply_diag, zero_add] using this

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.analyticAt_aux
statement:
theorem LocallyConvergent.analyticAt_aux (hP : P.LocallyConvergent) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ P.eval 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, h⟩ := hP.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall
  exact h.analyticAt

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_basisVec_le
statement: lemma norm_basisVec_le (i : ι) : ‖basisVec i‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr fun j ↦ by
    rw [basisVec]; split <;> simp

name: MvPowerSeries.tupleDeg_apply
statement:
lemma tupleDeg_apply {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ι) (i : ι) :
    tupleDeg s i = (Finset.univ.filter fun k ↦ s k = i).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleDeg, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.card_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ by rw [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: MvPowerSeries.tupleDeg_mem_degFinset
statement: lemma tupleDeg_mem_degFinset {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ι) : tupleDeg s ∈ degFinset ι n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_degFinset]
  simp_rw [tupleDeg_apply]
  rw [← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := s) fun k _ ↦ Finset.mem_univ (s k)]
  simp

name: MvPowerSeries.prod_eq_evalMonomial
statement:
lemma prod_eq_evalMonomial [Finite ι] {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ι) (y : ι → ℂ) :
    ∏ k, y (s k) = evalMonomial (tupleDeg s) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  rw [evalMonomial_eq_prod,
    ← Finset.prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun k _ ↦ Finset.mem_univ (s k)) fun k ↦ y (s k)]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [tupleDeg_apply, ← Finset.prod_const]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2]

name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_ofFPS
statement:
lemma coeff_ofFPS (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ (ι → ℂ) ℂ) {n : ℕ} {d : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (hd : d ∈ degFinset ι n) : coeff d (ofFPS p) = fpsCoeff p n d
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_apply, ofFPS, mem_degFinset.mp hd]

name: MvPowerSeries.apply_diag_eq_sum
statement:
lemma apply_diag_eq_sum (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ (ι → ℂ) ℂ) (n : ℕ) (y : ι → ℂ) :
    p n (fun _ ↦ y) = ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, (ofFPS p).term y d
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [show (fun _ : Fin n ↦ y) = fun _ : Fin n ↦ ∑ i, y i • basisVec i from
    funext fun _ ↦ pi_eq_sum_univ y]
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ s : Fin n → ι, (p n fun k ↦ y (s k) • basisVec (s k)) =
      evalMonomial (tupleDeg s) y * p n fun k ↦ basisVec (s k) := fun s ↦ by
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, prod_eq_evalMonomial, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun s _ ↦ tupleDeg_mem_degFinset s)
    fun s ↦ evalMonomial (tupleDeg s) y * p n fun k ↦ basisVec (s k)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [term, coeff_ofFPS p hd, fpsCoeff, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2, mul_comm]

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_fpsCoeff_le
statement:
lemma norm_fpsCoeff_le (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ (ι → ℂ) ℂ) (n : ℕ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ‖fpsCoeff p n d‖ ≤ (tupleFinset n d).card * ‖p n‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_const]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ ↦ ?_
  refine ((p n).le_opNorm _).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) ?_
  exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) fun k _ ↦ norm_basisVec_le _

name: MvPowerSeries.sum_card_fibers
statement:
lemma sum_card_fibers (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ((tupleFinset n d).card : ℝ) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tupleFinset]
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (f := fun s : Fin n → ι ↦ tupleDeg s) fun s _ ↦ tupleDeg_mem_degFinset s]
  simp

name: MvPowerSeries.norm_evalMonomial_le_pow
statement:
lemma norm_evalMonomial_le_pow {ρ : ℝ} {y : ι → ℂ} (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ ρ) {n : ℕ} {d : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (hd : d ∈ degFinset ι n) : ‖evalMonomial d y‖ ≤ ρ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ i, ‖y i‖ ≤ ρ := fun i ↦ (norm_le_pi_norm y i).trans hy
  rw [norm_evalMonomial, ← mem_degFinset.mp hd, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ ↦ by positivity)
    fun i _ ↦ pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h1 i) _

name: MvPowerSeries.summable_of_summable_degFinset
statement:
lemma summable_of_summable_degFinset {g : (ι →₀ ℕ) → ℝ} (hg : ∀ d, 0 ≤ g d)
    (h : Summable fun n ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, g d) : Summable g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← degreeSigmaEquiv.summable_iff]
  simp only [Function.comp_def]
  rw [summable_sigma_of_nonneg fun _ ↦ hg _]
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ Summable.of_finite, h.congr fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort _ g).symm

name: MvPowerSeries.exists_represents_aux
statement:
theorem exists_represents_aux {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) :
    ∃ P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ, P.LocallyConvergent ∧ P.Represents f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, r, hp⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨u, hu0, hur⟩ := exists_between hp.r_pos
  have hutop : u ≠ ⊤ := (hur.trans_le le_top).ne
  set v : ℝ := u.toReal with hv
  have hv0 : 0 < v := ENNReal.toReal_pos hu0.ne' hutop
  have hvu : ENNReal.ofReal v = u := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hutop
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hCbound⟩ := p.norm_mul_pow_le_of_lt_radius (r := u.toNNReal)
    (by rw [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hutop]; exact hur.trans_le hp.r_le)
  set N : ℕ := Fintype.card ι with hN
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  set ρ : ℝ := v / (2 * (N + 1)) with hρdef
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by positivity
  have hρv : ρ < v := by
    rw [hρdef]
    exact div_lt_self hv0 (by linarith)
  set q : ℝ := N * ρ / v with hq
  have hqval : q = (N : ℝ) / (2 * (N + 1)) := by
    rw [hq, hρdef]
    field_simp
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by rw [hqval]; positivity
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by
    rw [hqval, div_lt_one (by positivity)]
    linarith
  
  have key : ∀ y : ι → ℂ, ‖y‖ ≤ ρ →
      Summable fun n : ℕ ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖(ofFPS p).term y d‖ := by
    intro y hy
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n ↦ Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
      (fun n ↦ ?_) ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).mul_left C)
    have h1 : ∀ d ∈ degFinset ι n, ‖(ofFPS p).term y d‖ ≤
        ((tupleFinset n d).card * ‖p n‖) * ρ ^ n := by
      intro d hd
      rw [term, norm_mul, coeff_ofFPS p hd]
      exact mul_le_mul (norm_fpsCoeff_le p n d) (norm_evalMonomial_le_pow hy hd)
        (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_card_fibers]
    have hvn : (v : ℝ) ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv0.ne'
    have hpow : (N : ℝ) ^ n * ‖p n‖ * ρ ^ n = (‖p n‖ * v ^ n) * q ^ n :=
      calc (N : ℝ) ^ n * ‖p n‖ * ρ ^ n = ‖p n‖ * ((N : ℝ) * ρ) ^ n := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
        _ = (‖p n‖ * v ^ n) * (((N : ℝ) * ρ) ^ n / v ^ n) := by field_simp
        _ = (‖p n‖ * v ^ n) * q ^ n := by rw [hq, div_pow]
    rw [hpow]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
    have h2 := hCbound n
    rwa [show ((u.toNNReal : NNReal) : ℝ) = v from rfl] at h2
  
  have hconv : ∀ y : ι → ℂ, ‖y‖ ≤ ρ → (ofFPS p).SummableAt y := fun y hy ↦
    summable_of_summable_degFinset (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (key y hy)
  refine ⟨ofFPS p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ι → ℂ) hρ0] with y hy
    exact hconv y (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hy).le
  · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ι → ℂ) hρ0] with y hy
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
    
    have hball : y ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ι → ℂ) r := by
      change edist y (0 : ι → ℂ) < r
      have h1 : edist y (0 : ι → ℂ) < ENNReal.ofReal v := by
        rw [edist_zero_right, ← ofReal_norm]
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hv0).mpr (hy.trans hρv)
      rw [hvu] at h1
      exact h1.trans hur
    have h1 := hp.hasSum hball
    rw [zero_add] at h1
    simp_rw [apply_diag_eq_sum] at h1
    
    have h2 := hasSum_degree (P := ofFPS p) (x := y) (hconv y hy.le).hasSum
    rw [h1.unique h2]
    exact (hconv y hy.le).hasSum

name: MvPowerSeries.term_sub
statement:
lemma term_sub (P Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (P - Q).term x d = P.term x d - Q.term x d
proof:
:= by
  simp [term, sub_mul]

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.sub
statement:
lemma Represents.sub {f g : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hP : P.Represents f) (hQ : Q.Represents g) :
    (P - Q).Represents (f - g)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP, hQ] with x hx hx'
  have h : (P - Q).term x = fun d ↦ P.term x d - Q.term x d := funext (term_sub P Q x)
  rw [h, Pi.sub_apply]
  exact hx.sub hx'

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.locallyConvergent
statement:
lemma Represents.locallyConvergent {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hP : P.Represents f) :
    P.LocallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hP] with x hx
  exact summable_norm_iff.mpr hx.summable

name: MvPowerSeries.evalMonomial_smul
statement:
lemma evalMonomial_smul (t : ℂ) (y : ι → ℂ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    evalMonomial d (t • y) = t ^ (∑ i, d i) * evalMonomial d y
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMonomial_eq_prod, evalMonomial_eq_prod, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_pow]

name: MvPowerSeries.eq_zero_of_hasSum_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_hasSum_zero {a : ℕ → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ n, ‖a n‖ ≤ C)
    (hzero : ∀ᶠ t : ℂ in 𝓝 0, HasSum (fun n ↦ a n * t ^ n) 0) (n : ℕ) : a n = 0
proof:
:= by
  set p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a with hp
  have hnorm : ∀ m, ‖p m‖ ≤ ‖a m‖ := by
    intro m
    rw [hp, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars, norm_smul]
    refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) ?_
    simp
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hbound 0)
  have hrad : ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) ≤ p.radius := by
    refine p.le_radius_of_bound C fun m ↦ ?_
    simpa using (hnorm m).trans (hbound m)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hzero
  have hfps : HasFPowerSeriesAt (0 : ℂ → ℂ) p 0 := by
    refine ⟨min (ENNReal.ofReal ε) 1, le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by simpa using hrad),
      lt_min (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hε) one_pos, fun {y} hy ↦ ?_⟩
    have hy' : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε := by
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      have h1 : edist y (0 : ℂ) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_left _ _)
      rwa [edist_zero_right, ← ofReal_norm,
        ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at h1
    have h2 := hball hy'
    simpa [hp, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h2
  have hpz : p = 0 := hfps.eq_zero
  have h0 : p n (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)) = a n := by
    rw [hp, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq]
    simp
  rw [← h0, hpz]
  simp

name: MvPowerSeries.eq_zero_of_represents_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_represents_zero [Finite ι] {R : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hR : R.Represents 0) :
    R = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hconv : R.LocallyConvergent := hR.locallyConvergent
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hR.and hconv)
  set ρ := ε / 2 with hρdef
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by positivity
  have hmem : ∀ x : ι → ℂ, ‖x‖ ≤ ρ → HasSum (R.term x) 0 ∧ R.SummableAt x := by
    intro x hx
    refine hball ?_
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    calc ‖x‖ ≤ ρ := hx
      _ < ε := by rw [hρdef]; linarith
  
  have hhom : ∀ y : ι → ℂ, ‖y‖ ≤ ρ → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y = 0 := by
    intro y hy n
    refine eq_zero_of_hasSum_zero (a := fun m ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι m, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y)
      (C := ∑' d, ‖R.term y d‖) (fun m ↦ ?_) ?_ n
    · calc ‖∑ d ∈ degFinset ι m, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y‖
          ≤ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι m, ‖R.term y d‖ := by
            refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ rfl
        _ ≤ ∑' d, ‖R.term y d‖ :=
            le_hasSum (hasSum_degree_norm (hmem y hy).2) m fun _ _ ↦
              Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
    · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) one_pos] with t ht
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at ht
      have hty : ‖t • y‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [norm_smul]
        calc ‖t‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ 1 * ρ := by
              refine mul_le_mul ht.le hy (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = ρ := one_mul ρ
      have h2 := hasSum_degree (hmem (t • y) hty).1
      have hfun : (fun m ↦ ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι m, R.term (t • y) d) =
          fun m ↦ (∑ d ∈ degFinset ι m, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y) * t ^ m := by
        funext m
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
        rw [term, evalMonomial_smul, mem_degFinset.mp hd]
        ring
      rwa [hfun] at h2
  
  have hall : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : ι → ℂ), ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y = 0 := by
    intro n y
    set l : ℝ := ρ / (‖y‖ + 1) with hl
    have hl0 : 0 < l := by positivity
    have hly : ‖(l : ℂ) • y‖ ≤ ρ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hl0.le, hl, div_mul_eq_mul_div,
        div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg y, hρ0]
    have h1 := hhom _ hly n
    have h2 : ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, coeff d R * evalMonomial d ((l : ℂ) • y) =
        (l : ℂ) ^ n * ∑ d ∈ degFinset ι n, coeff d R * evalMonomial d y := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
      rw [evalMonomial_smul, mem_degFinset.mp hd]
      ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hl0.ne'))
  
  refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_
  have hΦ : (∑ e ∈ degFinset ι (∑ i, d i), MvPolynomial.monomial e (coeff e R) :
      MvPolynomial ι ℂ) = 0 := by
    refine MvPolynomial.funext fun y ↦ ?_
    rw [map_zero, map_sum]
    simpa [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial, evalMonomial] using hall (∑ i, d i) y
  have h3 := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff d) hΦ
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum] at h3
  simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero] at h3
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (degFinset ι (∑ i, d i)) d (fun e ↦ coeff e R)] at h3
  rw [if_pos (self_mem_degFinset d)] at h3
  simpa using h3

name: MvPowerSeries.Represents.unique
statement:
theorem Represents.unique [Finite ι] {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hP : P.Represents f)
    (hQ : Q.Represents f) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  have h : (P - Q).Represents 0 := by
    have h1 := hP.sub hQ
    rwa [sub_self] at h1
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_represents_zero h)

name: MvPowerSeries.exists_represents
statement:
theorem exists_represents [Fintype ι] {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) :
    ∃ P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ, P.LocallyConvergent ∧ P.Represents f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact exists_represents_aux hf

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.analyticAt
statement:
theorem LocallyConvergent.analyticAt [Fintype ι] {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ}
    (hP : P.LocallyConvergent) : AnalyticAt ℂ P.eval 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact hP.analyticAt_aux

name: MvPowerSeries.LocallyConvergent.inv
statement:
theorem LocallyConvergent.inv [Finite ι] {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hP : P.LocallyConvergent)
    (h : constantCoeff P ≠ 0) : P⁻¹.LocallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hA : AnalyticAt ℂ P.eval 0 := hP.analyticAt
  have hne : P.eval 0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [eval_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQc, hQ⟩ := exists_represents (hA.inv hne)
  
  have h1 : (P * Q).Represents (Function.const (ι → ℂ) 1) := by
    refine (Represents.mul hP hQc hP.represents_eval hQ).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hA.continuousAt.eventually_ne hne] with x hx
    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx]
  
  have hPQ : P * Q = 1 := h1.unique represents_one
  have hQP : Q = P⁻¹ := by
    calc Q = Q * (P * P⁻¹) := by rw [MvPowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel P h, mul_one]
    _ = P * Q * P⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = P⁻¹ := by rw [hPQ, one_mul]
  exact hQP ▸ hQc

proof:

name: LocalOkaRing.isUnit_iff_ne_zero
statement: theorem isUnit_iff_ne_zero [IsEmpty ι] {P : LocalOkaRing ι} : IsUnit P ↔ P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff, constantCoeff_apply, ne_eq, ne_eq, not_iff_not]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]; simp⟩
  refine LocalOkaRing.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_)
  have hd : d = 0 := by ext i; exact (IsEmpty.false i).elim
  subst hd
  simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h]

proof:

  refine ⟨⟨s, hsopen⟩, h0, ⟨fun x ↦ (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact okaAnalytic_restrict fun x hx ↦ hs hx
  · refine OkaRing.toLocalOkaRing_eq_of_represents (h0 := h0) (P.2.represents_eval.congr ?_)
    exact (OkaRing.toGlobalFun_eventuallyEq h0 fun x ↦ rfl).symm

name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_eval₂AlgHom_rename
statement:
private lemma coeff_eval₂AlgHom_rename (Q : (MvPowerSeries τ R)[X]) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i k)
      (Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom (rename f) (X i) (fun _ ↦ Commute.all _ _) Q) =
        coeff e (Q.coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ∀ x : τ →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.mapDomain f x i = 0 := fun x ↦
    Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range x i hi
  induction Q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial k' a =>
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom_apply, Polynomial.eval₂_monomial, X_pow_eq, coeff_mul_monomial]
    simp only [RingHom.coe_coe]
    
    have hle : Finsupp.single i k' ≤ Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i k ↔ k' ≤ k := by
      refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa [hD] using h i, fun h j ↦ ?_⟩
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simpa [hD] using h
      · simp [hj]
    have hsub : ∀ m : ℕ, Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i k - Finsupp.single i m =
        Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i (k - m) := by
      refine fun m ↦ Finsupp.ext fun j ↦ ?_
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [hD]
      · simp [hj]
    
    have hcoeff : ∀ m : ℕ, coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i m) (rename f a) =
        if m = 0 then coeff e a else 0 := by
      intro m
      rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | hm
      · have h : Finsupp.mapDomain f e = Finsupp.embDomain ⟨f, hf⟩ e :=
          (Finsupp.embDomain_eq_mapDomain ⟨f, hf⟩ e).symm
        rw [if_pos rfl, Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero, h]
        exact coeff_embDomain_rename ⟨f, hf⟩ a e
      · rw [if_neg hm]
        refine coeff_rename_eq_zero f a ?_
        rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
        exact hm (by simpa [hD] using (congrArg (fun g ↦ g i) hx).symm)
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    rcases le_or_gt k' k with h | h
    · rw [if_pos (hle.mpr h), hsub, hcoeff, mul_one]
      rcases eq_or_ne k' k with rfl | hk
      · simp
      · rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ k - k' = 0), if_neg hk, map_zero]
    · have hlt : ¬ Finsupp.single i k' ≤ Finsupp.mapDomain f e + Finsupp.single i k := fun hc ↦
        absurd (hle.mp hc) (by omega)
      rw [if_neg hlt, if_neg (by omega : ¬ k' = k), map_zero]

name: MvPowerSeries.eval₂AlgHom_rename_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  refine Polynomial.ext fun k ↦ MvPowerSeries.ext fun e ↦ ?_
  rw [← coeff_eval₂AlgHom_rename f hf hi P e k, ← coeff_eval₂AlgHom_rename f hf hi Q e k, h]

name: MvPowerSeries.partialEval_X_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma partialEval_X_self : partialEval i (X i : MvPowerSeries σ R) = PowerSeries.X
proof:

name: MvPowerSeries.order_partialEval_eq_one_iff

name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_X_mul'
statement:
lemma coeff_X_mul' (i : ι) (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d (X i * P) = if d i = 0 then 0 else coeff (d - Finsupp.single i 1) P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [X, coeff_monomial_mul, one_mul]
  by_cases h : d i = 0
  · rw [if_pos h, if_neg]
    exact fun hle ↦ by simpa [h] using hle i
  · rw [if_neg h, if_pos]
    exact Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h)

name: MvPowerSeries.exists_eq_sum_X_mul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum_X_mul [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} (hP : constantCoeff P = 0) :
    ∃ Q : ι → MvPowerSeries ι ℂ, P = ∑ i, X i * Q i ∧
      (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → P.SummableAt (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) →
        ∀ i, (Q i).SummableAt (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ d : ι →₀ ℕ, ∑ j, d j < k + 1 → coeff d P = 0) →
        ∀ (i : ι) (e : ι →₀ ℕ), ∑ j, e j < k → coeff e (Q i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hex : ∀ d : ι →₀ ℕ, ∃ i : ι, d ≠ 0 → d i ≠ 0 := by
    intro d
    rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with rfl | hd
    · exact ⟨Classical.arbitrary ι, fun h ↦ absurd rfl h⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
      exact ⟨i, fun _ ↦ Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi⟩
  choose idx hidx using hex
  set Q : ι → MvPowerSeries ι ℂ := fun i e ↦
    if idx (e + Finsupp.single i 1) = i then coeff (e + Finsupp.single i 1) P else 0 with hQdef
  have hQcoeff : ∀ (i : ι) (e : ι →₀ ℕ), coeff e (Q i) =
      if idx (e + Finsupp.single i 1) = i then coeff (e + Finsupp.single i 1) P else 0 :=
    fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hsingle : ∀ (i : ι) (e : ι →₀ ℕ),
      ∑ j, (e + Finsupp.single i 1 : ι →₀ ℕ) j = (∑ j, e j) + 1 := by
    intro i e
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    ext d
    rw [map_sum]
    have hterm : ∀ i : ι, coeff d (X i * Q i) =
        if d i = 0 then 0 else if idx d = i then coeff d P else 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [coeff_X_mul']
      rcases eq_or_ne (d i) 0 with h | h
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, hQcoeff,
          tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h))]
    simp only [hterm]
    rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with rfl | hd
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ if_pos (by simp), coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hP]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (idx d)]
      · rw [if_neg (hidx d hd), if_pos rfl]
      · intro i _ hi
        rcases eq_or_ne (d i) 0 with h | h
        · rw [if_pos h]
        · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (Ne.symm hi)]
      · intro h
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · 
    intro ρ hρ hs i
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun e : ι →₀ ℕ ↦ e + Finsupp.single i 1 :=
      add_left_injective _
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun e ↦ ?_)
      ((hs.comp_injective hinj).mul_left ρ⁻¹)
    have hev : evalMonomial (e + Finsupp.single i 1) (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) =
        evalMonomial e (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) * (ρ : ℂ) := by
      rw [evalMonomial_add, evalMonomial_single_one]
    have hnorm : ‖P.term (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ)) (e + Finsupp.single i 1)‖ =
        ‖coeff (e + Finsupp.single i 1) P‖ * ‖evalMonomial e (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))‖ * ρ := by
      rw [term, hev, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos hρ, mul_assoc]
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hnorm, term, hQcoeff, norm_mul,
      show ρ⁻¹ * (‖coeff (e + Finsupp.single i 1) P‖ *
        ‖evalMonomial e (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))‖ * ρ) =
        ‖coeff (e + Finsupp.single i 1) P‖ * ‖evalMonomial e (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))‖ from by
          field_simp]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    split_ifs with h
    · exact le_rfl
    · simp
  · 
    intro k hk i e he
    rw [hQcoeff]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hk _ (by rw [hsingle]; omega)
    · rfl

name: MvPowerSeries.mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma mem_maximalIdeal_iff {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} :
    P ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) ↔ constantCoeff P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_iff_constantCoeff,
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not]

name: MvPowerSeries.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff [Fintype ι] {k : ℕ} {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} :
    P ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) ^ k ↔
      ∀ d : ι →₀ ℕ, ∑ i, d i < k → coeff d P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing P with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    constructor
    · intro hP
      rw [pow_succ] at hP
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hP ?_ ?_
      · intro a ha b hb d hd
        rw [coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        have hsum : (∑ i, p.1 i) + (∑ i, p.2 i) = ∑ i, d i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (∑ i, p.2 i) with h2 | h2
        · have hp2 : p.2 = 0 := by
            ext i
            exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h2 ▸ Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
              (Finset.mem_univ i))
          rw [hp2, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mp hb, mul_zero]
        · rw [ih.mp ha p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]
      · intro x y hx hy d hd
        rw [map_add, hx d hd, hy d hd, add_zero]
    · intro hP
      rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
      · have hP0 : P = 0 := by
          refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_
          have hd : d = 0 := by ext i; exact (IsEmpty.false i).elim
          subst hd
          rw [map_zero]
          exact hP 0 (by simp)
        rw [hP0]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · have hP0 : constantCoeff P = 0 := by
          rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
          exact hP 0 (by simp)
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -, hQvan⟩ := exists_eq_sum_X_mul hP0
        rw [hQ, pow_succ']
        refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_mul ?_ ?_
        · exact mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr (by simp)
        · exact ih.mpr fun e he ↦ hQvan k hP i e he

name: MvPowerSeries.locallyConvergent_of_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma locallyConvergent_of_coeff_eq_zero {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {s : Finset (ι →₀ ℕ)}
    (h : ∀ d ∉ s, coeff d P = 0) : P.LocallyConvergent
proof:
:=
  .of_forall fun x ↦ summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := s) fun d hd ↦ by
    rw [term, h d hd, zero_mul, norm_zero]

name: MvPowerSeries.locallyConvergent_of_summableAt_const
statement:
lemma locallyConvergent_of_summableAt_const [Finite ι] {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h : P.SummableAt (fun _ ↦ (ρ : ℂ))) : P.LocallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ι → ℂ) hρ] with x hx
  refine h.mono fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ]
  exact (norm_le_pi_norm x i).trans (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx).le

name: LocalOkaRing.coe_coord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_coord (i : ι) : (coord i : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) = MvPowerSeries.X i
proof: := rfl

name: LocalOkaRing.coord_ne_zero
statement: lemma coord_ne_zero (i : ι) : coord i ≠ 0

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_maximalIdeal_iff

name: LocalOkaRing.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_constantCoeff

name: LocalOkaRing.maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LocalOkaRing ι) = Ideal.span (Set.range (coord (ι := ι)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  refine le_antisymm (fun P hP ↦ ?_) ?_
  · rw [mem_maximalIdeal_iff] at hP
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
    · 
      have hP0 : P = 0 := by
        refine LocalOkaRing.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_)
        have hd : d = 0 := by ext i; exact (IsEmpty.false i).elim
        subst hd
        rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
          MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ← constantCoeff_apply,
          ← constantCoeff_apply, hP, map_zero]
      rw [hP0]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hsum⟩ := P.2.exists_summableAt_const
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQconv, -⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_eq_sum_X_mul
        (P := (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ)) (by rw [← constantCoeff_apply]; exact hP)
      set R : ι → LocalOkaRing ι := fun i ↦
        ⟨Q i, MvPowerSeries.locallyConvergent_of_summableAt_const hρ (hQconv ρ hρ hsum i)⟩
        with hR
      have hPeq : P = ∑ i, coord i * R i := by
        refine Subtype.ext ?_
        rw [show ((∑ i, coord i * R i : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) =
          (localOkaSubring ι).val (∑ i, coord i * R i) from rfl, map_sum]
        simpa using hQ
      rw [hPeq]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦
        Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr (constantCoeff_coord i)

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff {k : ℕ} {P : LocalOkaRing ι} :
    P ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LocalOkaRing ι) ^ k ↔
      ∀ d : ι →₀ ℕ, ∑ i, d i < k → MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing P with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    constructor
    · 
      intro hP
      rw [pow_succ] at hP
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hP ?_ ?_
      · intro a ha b hb d hd
        rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        have hsum : (∑ i, p.1 i) + (∑ i, p.2 i) = ∑ i, d i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (∑ i, p.2 i) with h2 | h2
        · 
          have hp2 : p.2 = 0 := by
            ext i
            exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h2 ▸ Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
              (Finset.mem_univ i))
          rw [hp2, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ← constantCoeff_apply,
            mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mp hb, mul_zero]
        · rw [ih.mp ha p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]
      · intro x y hx hy d hd
        rw [AddMemClass.coe_add, map_add, hx d hd, hy d hd, add_zero]
    · 
      intro hP
      rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
      · have hP0 : P = 0 := by
          refine LocalOkaRing.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_)
          have hd : d = 0 := by ext i; exact (IsEmpty.false i).elim
          subst hd
          rw [show ((0 : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) = 0 from rfl, map_zero]
          exact hP 0 (by simp)
        rw [hP0]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hsum⟩ := P.2.exists_summableAt_const
        have hP0 : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) = 0 := by
          rw [← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
          exact hP 0 (by simp)
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQconv, hQvan⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_eq_sum_X_mul
          (P := (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ)) hP0
        set R : ι → LocalOkaRing ι := fun i ↦
          ⟨Q i, MvPowerSeries.locallyConvergent_of_summableAt_const hρ (hQconv ρ hρ hsum i)⟩
        have hPeq : P = ∑ i, coord i * R i := by
          refine Subtype.ext ?_
          rw [show ((∑ i, coord i * R i : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) =
            (localOkaSubring ι).val (∑ i, coord i * R i) from rfl, map_sum]
          simpa using hQ
        rw [hPeq, pow_succ']
        refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_mul ?_ ?_
        · exact mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr (constantCoeff_coord i)
        · exact ih.mpr fun e he ↦ hQvan k hP i e he

name: LocalOkaRing.iInf_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot
statement:
theorem iInf_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot :
    ⨅ k : ℕ, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LocalOkaRing ι) ^ k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun P hP ↦ ?_) bot_le
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hP
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
  refine LocalOkaRing.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun d ↦ ?_)
  rw [show ((0 : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ) = 0 from rfl, map_zero]
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι

name: LocalOkaRing.isNoetherianRing_of_isEmpty
statement: theorem isNoetherianRing_of_isEmpty : IsNoetherianRing (LocalOkaRing ι)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg _).mpr fun I ↦ ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne I ⊥ with rfl | hI
  · exact Submodule.fg_bot
  · obtain ⟨x, hxI, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
    rw [Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem I hxI (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx0)]

name: LocalOkaRing.module_finite_quotient_fromPolynomial
statement:
theorem module_finite_quotient_fromPolynomial {g : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]}
    (hg : IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial
      (Polynomial.map (Subring.subtype (localOkaSubring _).toSubring) g)) :
    Module.Finite (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
      (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ Ideal.span {LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g})
proof:
:= by
  have hgm : g.Monic := Polynomial.monic_of_injective Subtype.val_injective hg.monic
  have hgdeg : g.degree = (g.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hgm.ne_zero
  haveI : Module.Finite (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
      ((LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]_(g.natDegree)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv _ _).symm
  refine Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (((Submodule.mkQ (Ideal.span {LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g})).restrictScalars
      (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))).comp (polyIncl (d := g.natDegree))) ?_
  intro x
  induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H y =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hy⟩ := localweierstrass_division g hg y
    refine ⟨⟨b, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (hgdeg ▸ hb)⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
      Submodule.mkQ_apply, polyIncl_apply]
    refine (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mpr ?_
    have hsub : LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial b - y = -(a * LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g) := by
      rw [hy]; ring
    rw [hsub]
    exact neg_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))

name: LocalOkaRing.fg_of_fromPolynomial_mem
statement:
theorem fg_of_fromPolynomial_mem [IsNoetherianRing (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))]
    {I : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))} {g : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]}
    (hg : IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial
      (Polynomial.map (Subring.subtype (localOkaSubring _).toSubring) g))
    (hgI : LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g ∈ I) : I.FG
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_quotient_fromPolynomial hg
  haveI : IsNoetherian (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
      (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ Ideal.span {LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g}) :=
    isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite _ _
  haveI : IsNoetherian (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))
      (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ Ideal.span {LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g}) :=
    isNoetherian_of_tower (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) inferInstance
  refine Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker
    (Submodule.mkQ (Ideal.span {LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g})) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_
  rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ, inf_eq_right.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem I).mpr hgI)]
  exact Submodule.fg_span_singleton _

name: LocalOkaRing.isNoetherianRing_fin
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_fin : ∀ n : ℕ, IsNoetherianRing (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
  | 0 => isNoetherianRing_of_isEmpty
  | (n + 1) => by
    haveI
proof:
:= isNoetherianRing_fin n
    refine (isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg _).mpr fun I ↦ ?_
    rcases eq_or_ne I ⊥ with rfl | hI
    · exact Submodule.fg_bot
    obtain ⟨f, hfI, hf0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
    
    obtain ⟨φ, u, hu, g, hg, hfeq⟩ := exists_congr_localweierstrass_preparation hf0
    refine Ideal.FG.of_map_ringEquiv (congr φ).toRingEquiv (fg_of_fromPolynomial_mem hg ?_)
    
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu.exists_right_inv
    have hgv : LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g = (congr φ).toRingEquiv f * v := by
      rw [show (congr φ).toRingEquiv f = LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial g * u from hfeq,
        mul_assoc, hv, mul_one]
    rw [hgv]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hfI)

name: LocalOkaRing.eventually_eval_add
statement:
lemma eventually_eval_add (P Q : LocalOkaRing ι) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), ((P + Q : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z =
      (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z + (Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(P + Q).2.represents_eval,
    Represents.add P.2.represents_eval Q.2.represents_eval] with z h1 h2
  exact h1.unique (by rwa [AddMemClass.coe_add])

name: LocalOkaRing.eventually_eval_mul
statement:
lemma eventually_eval_mul (P Q : LocalOkaRing ι) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), ((P * Q : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z =
      (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z * (Q : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(P * Q).2.represents_eval,
    Represents.mul P.2 Q.2 P.2.represents_eval Q.2.represents_eval] with z h1 h2
  exact h1.unique (by rwa [MulMemClass.coe_mul])

name: LocalOkaRing.eventually_eval_pow
statement:
lemma eventually_eval_pow (P : LocalOkaRing ι) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), ((P ^ n : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z =
      ((P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    filter_upwards [(1 : LocalOkaRing ι).2.represents_eval, represents_one (ι := ι)] with z h1 h2
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
    exact h1.unique (by rwa [OneMemClass.coe_one])
  | succ n ih =>
    filter_upwards [ih, eventually_eval_mul (P ^ n) P] with z hz hmul
    rw [pow_succ, hmul, hz, pow_succ]

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff
statement: lemma mem_vanishingIdeal_iff {f : LocalOkaRing ι} : f ∈ vanishingIdeal I ↔ VanishesOn I f
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: LocalOkaRing.le_vanishingIdeal
statement: theorem le_vanishingIdeal : I ≤ vanishingIdeal I
proof:
:=
  fun _ hf ↦ Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ h ↦ h _ hf

name: LocalOkaRing.vanishingIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal (LocalOkaRing ι)} (h : I ≤ J) :
    vanishingIdeal I ≤ vanishingIdeal J
proof:
:=
  fun _ hf ↦ hf.mono fun _ hz hJ ↦ hz fun g hg ↦ hJ g (h hg)

name: LocalOkaRing.isRadical_vanishingIdeal
statement: theorem isRadical_vanishingIdeal : (vanishingIdeal I).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rintro f ⟨n, hfn⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · 
    rw [pow_zero] at hfn
    simpa using (vanishingIdeal I).mul_mem_left f hfn
  · filter_upwards [hfn, eventually_eval_pow f n] with z hz hpow h
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff hn.ne' |>.mp (hpow ▸ hz h)

name: LocalOkaRing.radical_le_vanishingIdeal
statement: theorem radical_le_vanishingIdeal : I.radical ≤ vanishingIdeal I
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.radical_mono (le_vanishingIdeal I)).trans (isRadical_vanishingIdeal I)

name: LocalOkaRing.vanishingIdeal_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_top : vanishingIdeal (⊤ : Ideal (LocalOkaRing ι)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm le_top (fun f _ ↦ ?_)
  filter_upwards [(1 : LocalOkaRing ι).2.represents_eval, represents_one (ι := ι)] with z h1 h2 h
  exact absurd (h 1 Submodule.mem_top)
    (by rw [h1.unique (by rwa [OneMemClass.coe_one])]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: LocalOkaRing.eq_zero_of_eventually_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eventually_eval_eq_zero {P : LocalOkaRing ι}
    (h : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:=
  LocalOkaRing.ext (eq_zero_of_represents_zero (P.2.represents_eval.congr h))

name: LocalOkaRing.vanishingIdeal_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_bot : vanishingIdeal (⊥ : Ideal (LocalOkaRing ι)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun f hf ↦ ?_) ?_
  · refine Ideal.mem_bot.mpr (eq_zero_of_eventually_eval_eq_zero ?_)
    filter_upwards [hf, (0 : LocalOkaRing ι).2.represents_eval, represents_zero (ι := ι)]
      with z hz h1 h2
    refine hz fun g hg ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot.mp hg]
    exact h1.unique (by rwa [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero])
  · simp

name: Polynomial.mem_span_of_resultant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, -, -, e⟩ := exists_mul_add_mul_eq_C_resultant w b hw hb hmn
  rw [← e]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))
    (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))

name: Polynomial.exists_isRoot_of_resultant_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  have hcop : IsCoprime w b := by
    rw [isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed ℂ ℂ]
    intro a
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hne a (by simpa using hc.1) (by simpa using hc.2)
  have hu := (isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime hw).mpr hcop
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hb
  rw [resultant_add_right_deg _ _ _ _ k le_rfl, hw.coeff_natDegree, one_pow, one_mul] at h
  exact hu.ne_zero h

name: Polynomial.exists_common_root_of_forall_resultant_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_common_root_of_forall_resultant_eq_zero {r : ℕ} {w : ℂ[X]} (hw : w.Monic)
    (b : Fin r → ℂ[X]) {n : ℕ} (hb : ∀ i, (b i).natDegree ≤ n)
    (h : ∀ s ∈ range (w.natDegree * r + 1),
      resultant w (∑ i : Fin r, C ((s : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ)) * b i) w.natDegree n = 0) :
    ∃ t, w.IsRoot t ∧ ∀ i, (b i).IsRoot t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdeg : ∀ s : ℕ, (∑ i : Fin r, C ((s : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ)) * b i).natDegree ≤ n := fun s ↦
    (natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ ↦ (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (hb i))
  choose! t ht using fun s hs ↦ exists_isRoot_of_resultant_eq_zero hw (hdeg s) (h s hs)
  have hmaps : ∀ s ∈ range (w.natDegree * r + 1), t s ∈ w.roots.toFinset := fun s hs ↦
    Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr ((mem_roots hw.ne_zero).mpr (ht s hs).1)
  have hcard : #w.roots.toFinset * r < #(range (w.natDegree * r + 1)) := by
    rw [card_range]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
      ((Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans (card_roots' w)))
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfib⟩ := exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to hmaps hcard
  refine ⟨y, (mem_roots hw.ne_zero).mp (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hy), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  
  set Q : ℂ[X] := ∑ j : Fin r, C ((b j).eval y) * X ^ (j : ℕ) with hQ
  have hQdeg : Q.natDegree < r := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with rfl | hr
    · exact absurd i.2 (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun j _ ↦ ?_) (Nat.sub_lt hr one_pos)
    exact (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt j.2)
  set S : Finset ℂ := ((range (w.natDegree * r + 1)).filter fun s ↦ t s = y).image
    (fun s : ℕ ↦ (s : ℂ)) with hS
  have hScard : #S = #((range (w.natDegree * r + 1)).filter fun s ↦ t s = y) :=
    card_image_of_injective _ Nat.cast_injective
  have hQ0 : Q = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero' Q S (fun c hc ↦ ?_) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hc
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := mem_filter.mp hs
    have := (ht s hs1).2
    rw [hs2, IsRoot, eval_finsetSum] at this
    rw [hQ, eval_finsetSum, ← this]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [eval_mul, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X, mul_comm]
  have := congrArg (coeff · (i : ℕ)) hQ0
  simp only [hQ, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_zero] at this
  rw [sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ if_neg (fun h ↦ hj (Fin.ext h.symm))) (by simp),
    if_pos rfl] at this
  exact this

name: Polynomial.norm_lt_of_isRoot
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  push Not at hle
  set d := w.natDegree
  have heval : t ^ d = -∑ i ∈ range d, w.coeff i * t ^ i := by
    have := ht.eq_zero
    rw [eval_eq_sum_range, sum_range_succ, hw.coeff_natDegree, one_mul] at this
    linear_combination this
  set ρ := ‖t‖ / ε
  have hρ : 1 ≤ ρ := (one_le_div hε).mpr hle
  have htρ : ‖t‖ = ρ * ε := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hε.ne']
  have hbound : ‖t‖ ^ d ≤ ρ ^ d * ∑ i ∈ range d, ‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i := by
    calc ‖t‖ ^ d = ‖∑ i ∈ range d, w.coeff i * t ^ i‖ := by rw [← norm_pow, heval, norm_neg]
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range d, ‖w.coeff i‖ * ‖t‖ ^ i := by
          refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq (sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_))
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range d, ρ ^ d * (‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i) := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ ?_
          rw [htρ, mul_pow]
          have : ρ ^ i ≤ ρ ^ d := pow_le_pow_right₀ hρ (mem_range.mp hi).le
          have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε i).le
          calc ‖w.coeff i‖ * (ρ ^ i * ε ^ i) = ρ ^ i * (‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i) := by ring
            _ ≤ ρ ^ d * (‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this h0
      _ = ρ ^ d * ∑ i ∈ range d, ‖w.coeff i‖ * ε ^ i := by rw [mul_sum]
  have hpos : 0 < ρ ^ d := pow_pos (by linarith) d
  have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsmall hpos
  rw [htρ, mul_pow] at hbound
  linarith

name: LocalOkaRing.exists_incl_sub_mul_mem
statement:
theorem exists_incl_sub_mul_mem {W : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]}
    (hW : IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial
      (W.map (Subring.subtype (localOkaSubring (Fin n)).toSubring)))
    {P : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))} [P.IsPrime] (hWP : fromPolynomial W ∈ P)
    {g : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))} (hg : g ∉ P) :
    ∃ (c : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (h : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))), incl c ∉ P ∧
      incl c - g * h ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_quotient_fromPolynomial hW
  have hle : Ideal.span {fromPolynomial W} ≤ P := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).mpr hWP
  haveI : Module.Finite (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ P) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) hle).toLinearMap
      (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle)
  have hint : IsIntegral (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (Ideal.Quotient.mk P g) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _
  have hne : Ideal.Quotient.mk P g ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hlt := Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_integral_mem_sdiff (R := LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
    (I := (⊥ : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ P)))
    (J := Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk P g}) bot_le
    ⟨Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _, hne⟩ hint
  obtain ⟨c, hcJ, hcI⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
  have halg : ∀ x, algebraMap (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)) ⧸ P) x =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk P (incl x) := fun x ↦ by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk P (fromPolynomial (C x)) = _
    rw [fromPolynomial_C]
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hcJ
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hcJ
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  refine ⟨c, h, fun hc ↦ hcI ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.mem_comap, halg, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact hc
  · rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, ← halg, ← hy]
    ring

name: LocalOkaRing.frequently_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem frequently_of_eq_bot [Finite ι] {r : ℕ} {f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing ι}
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊥) {g : LocalOkaRing ι} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
      (g : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf0 : ∀ i, f i = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hf]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), (g : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z ≠ 0 :=
    fun h ↦ hg (eq_zero_of_eventually_eval_eq_zero (by simpa using h))
  refine hfreq.mono fun z hz ↦ ⟨fun i ↦ ?_, hz⟩
  rw [hf0 i, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, MvPowerSeries.eval_of_zero]

name: LocalOkaRing.frequently_of_congr
statement:
theorem frequently_of_congr [Fintype ι] (φ : (ι → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (ι → ℂ)) {r : ℕ}
    (f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing ι) (g : LocalOkaRing ι)
    (h : ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ),
      (∀ i, ((congr φ (f i) : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
        ((congr φ g : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ), (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
      (g : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ P : LocalOkaRing ι, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ),
      ((congr φ P : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval z =
        (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval (φ.symm z) := fun P ↦
    (congr_represents (φ := φ) P.2.represents_eval).eval_eq
  have h' : ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : ι → ℂ),
      (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing ι) : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval (φ.symm z) = 0) ∧
        (g : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval (φ.symm z) ≠ 0 := by
    refine (h.and_eventually ((eventually_all.mpr fun i ↦ hE (f i)).and (hE g))).mono ?_
    rintro z ⟨⟨hf, hg⟩, hEf, hEg⟩
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ (hEf i) ▸ hf i, hEg ▸ hg⟩
  have ht : Tendsto φ.symm (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using φ.symm.continuous.tendsto (0 : ι → ℂ)
  exact ht.frequently h'

name: LocalOkaRing.frequently_step
statement:
theorem frequently_step
    (IH : ∀ (P : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))) [P.IsPrime] {r : ℕ}
      (f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing (Fin n)), Ideal.span (Set.range f) = P →
      ∀ {g : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)}, g ∉ P →
        ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ),
          (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
            (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z ≠ 0)
    {P : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))} [P.IsPrime] {r : ℕ}
    (f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = P)
    {W : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]}
    (hW : IsLocalWeierstrassPolynomial
      (W.map (Subring.subtype (localOkaSubring (Fin n)).toSubring)))
    (hWP : fromPolynomial W ∈ P) {g : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))} (hg : g ∉ P) :
    ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
        (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, h, hcP, hch⟩ := exists_incl_sub_mul_mem hW hWP hg
  
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (P.comap (incl (n := n))))
  have hIH := IH (P.comap (incl (n := n))) p hp (g := c) (by rwa [Ideal.mem_comap])
  
  rw [← hf] at hch
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
    (R := LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))).mp hch
  have hE : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ),
      ((incl c : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z =
        (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z *
          (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z +
        ∑ i, ((k i : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z *
          ((f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).eval z := by
    filter_upwards [g.locallyConvergent, h.locallyConvergent,
      eventually_all.mpr fun i ↦ (k i).locallyConvergent,
      eventually_all.mpr fun i ↦ (f i).locallyConvergent] with z hgz hhz hkz hfz
    have hsum : incl c = g * h + ∑ i, k i * f i := by
      rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← hk]
      rfl
    rw [hsum, AddMemClass.coe_add, MulMemClass.coe_mul, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
      MvPowerSeries.eval_add_of_summableAt (hgz.mul hhz)
        (MvPowerSeries.SummableAt.sum (P := fun i ↦
          ((k i * f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ))
          fun i _ ↦ (hkz i).mul (hfz i)),
      MvPowerSeries.eval_mul_of_summableAt hgz hhz,
      MvPowerSeries.eval_sum_of_summableAt (P := fun i ↦
        ((k i * f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ))
        (fun i _ ↦ (hkz i).mul (hfz i))]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, MvPowerSeries.eval_mul_of_summableAt (hkz i) (hfz i)]
  rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
  intro U hU
  have hL := eventually_exists_lift hW f (hf ▸ hWP) p (by rw [hf]; exact hp.ge)
    (inter_mem hU hE)
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨hpa, hca⟩, hlift⟩ := (hIH.and_eventually hL).exists
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨htU, htE⟩, hft⟩ := hlift hpa
  refine ⟨Fin.snoc a t, htU, hft, fun hgz ↦ hca ?_⟩
  have hsnoc : (fun j : Fin n ↦ (Fin.snoc a t : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) j.castSucc) = a :=
    funext fun j ↦ by simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have := htE
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, eval_incl, hsnoc, hgz, zero_mul, hft, mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: LocalOkaRing.frequently_forall_eval_eq_zero_and_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frequently_forall_eval_eq_zero_and_ne_zero :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (P : Ideal (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))) [P.IsPrime] {r : ℕ}
      (f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing (Fin n)), Ideal.span (Set.range f) = P →
      ∀ {g : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)}, g ∉ P →
        ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ),
          (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z = 0) ∧
            (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z ≠ 0
  | 0, P, _, r, f, hf, g, hg => by
    have hP : P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
      refine (Submodule.eq_bot_iff P).mpr fun x hx ↦ by_contra fun hx0 ↦ ?_
      exact Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top ‹_› (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem P hx
        (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx0))
    exact frequently_of_eq_bot (hf.trans hP) fun h ↦ hg (h ▸ zero_mem P)
  | n + 1, P, _, r, f, hf, g, hg => by
    by_cases hP : P = ⊥
    · exact frequently_of_eq_bot (hf.trans hP) fun h ↦ hg (h ▸ zero_mem P)
    obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀P, hf₀⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hP
    obtain ⟨φ, u, hu, W, hW, heq⟩ := exists_congr_localweierstrass_preparation hf₀
    set e := congr φ
    haveI : (P.map e).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_equiv e
    have hf' : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ e (f i)) = P.map e := by
      rw [← hf, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
      rfl
    have hWP : fromPolynomial W ∈ P.map e := by
      have h1 : fromPolynomial W * u ∈ P.map e := heq ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem e hf₀P
      refine (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem ‹_› h1).resolve_right fun hu' ↦ ?_
      exact Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top ‹_› (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hu' hu)
    have hg' : e g ∉ P.map e := by
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv]
      rintro ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩
      exact hg (e.injective hxe ▸ hx)
    exact frequently_of_congr φ f g (frequently_step
      (fun P _ r f hf g hg ↦ frequently_forall_eval_eq_zero_and_ne_zero P f hf hg)
      (fun i ↦ e (f i)) hf' hW hWP hg')

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_radical_span_of_eventually_fin
statement:
theorem mem_radical_span_of_eventually_fin {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → LocalOkaRing (Fin n))
    {g : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)}
    (h : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ),
      (∀ i, ((f i : LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z = 0) →
        (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ).eval z = 0) :
    g ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).radical
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hg
  rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf, Submodule.mem_sInf] at hg
  push Not at hg
  obtain ⟨P, ⟨hIP, hPprime⟩, hgP⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian P)
  have hF : Ideal.span (Set.range (Fin.append p f)) = P := by
    refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (hp ▸ Ideal.span_mono ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine Fin.addCases (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) k
      · rw [Fin.append_left, ← hp]
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · rw [Fin.append_right]
        exact hIP (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd r j, Fin.append_left p f j⟩
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨hFz, hgz⟩, hz⟩ :=
    ((frequently_forall_eval_eq_zero_and_ne_zero P (Fin.append p f) hF hgP).and_eventually
      h).exists
  exact hgz (hz fun i ↦ by simpa using hFz (Fin.natAdd m i))

name: LocalOkaRing.mem_radical_span_of_eventually
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  set φ : (ι → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℂ) :=
    (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hE : ∀ P : LocalOkaRing ι, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℂ),
      ((congr φ P : LocalOkaRing (Fin (Fintype.card ι))) :
        MvPowerSeries (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℂ).eval z =
        (P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ).eval (φ.symm z) := fun P ↦
    (congr_represents (φ := φ) P.2.represents_eval).eval_eq
  have ht : Tendsto φ.symm (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using φ.symm.continuous.tendsto (0 : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℂ)
  have h' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℂ),
      (∀ i, ((congr φ (f i) : LocalOkaRing (Fin (Fintype.card ι))) :
        MvPowerSeries (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℂ).eval z = 0) →
        ((congr φ g : LocalOkaRing (Fin (Fintype.card ι))) :
          MvPowerSeries (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℂ).eval z = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ht.eventually h, eventually_all.mpr fun i ↦ hE (f i), hE g]
      with z hz hf hg hvan
    rw [hg]
    exact hz fun i ↦ (hf i) ▸ hvan i
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_radical_span_of_eventually_fin (fun i ↦ congr φ (f i)) h'
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (congr φ).symm hk
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp, map_pow, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  convert this using 3
  funext i
  exact ((congr φ).symm_apply_apply (f i)).symm

name: OkaRing.germ_mem_radical_span_of_eventually
statement:
theorem germ_mem_radical_span_of_eventually {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {U : TopologicalSpace.Opens (ι → ℂ)} {w : ι → ℂ} (hw : w ∈ U) {r : ℕ}
    (F : Fin r → OkaRing U) (G : OkaRing U)
    (h : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 w, (∀ i, (F i).toGlobalFun _ y = 0) → G.toGlobalFun _ y = 0) :
    germ hw G ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ germ hw (F i))).radical
proof:
:= by
  refine LocalOkaRing.mem_radical_span_of_eventually _ ?_
  have ht : Tendsto (fun z : ι → ℂ ↦ z + w) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 w) := by
    have := (continuous_add_const w).tendsto (0 : ι → ℂ)
    rwa [zero_add] at this
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually h, eventually_all.mpr fun i ↦ (germ_represents hw (F i)).eval_eq,
    (germ_represents hw G).eval_eq] with z hz hF hG hvan
  rw [hG]
  exact hz fun i ↦ (hF i) ▸ hvan i

name: MvPowerSeries.SummableAt.neg
statement:
lemma SummableAt.neg {P : MvPowerSeries ι ℂ} {x : ι → ℂ} (h : P.SummableAt x) :
    (-P).SummableAt x
proof:
:= by
  have : (-P).term x = fun d ↦ -P.term x d := funext fun d ↦ by simp [term]
  simpa [SummableAt, this] using h

statement:
