  by_cases hcase : ∀ m ∈ P, ∀ b, t * algebraMap A K m = algebraMap A K b → b ∈ P
  · exfalso
    
    let N : Submodule A K := Submodule.map (Algebra.linearMap A K) P
    have hN : N ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      have : algebraMap A K y ∈ N := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hyP
      rw [h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
      exact hyK this
    have hint : IsIntegral A t := by
      refine isIntegral_of_smul_mem_submodule N hN (Submodule.FG.map _
        (IsNoetherian.noetherian P)) t fun n hn ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hn
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := htP m hm
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Algebra.linearMap_apply, hb]
      exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hcase m hm b hb)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 hint
    have : x = y * a := by
      apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
      rw [map_mul, ha, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hyK]
    have h1 : (1 : A) ∈ P := (hP 1).2 ⟨a, by rw [one_mul, this]⟩
    exact (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›) ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one P).2 h1)
  · push Not at hcase
    obtain ⟨m, hm, u, hu, huP⟩ := hcase
    
    refine Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes (Ideal.span {m}) P
      ⟨⟨inferInstance, (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).2 hm⟩, fun Q hQ hQP ↦ ?_⟩
    intro m' hm'
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := htP m' hm'
    have hmQ : m ∈ Q := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem Q).1 hQ.2
    have key : m' * u = b * m := by
      apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hu, ← hb]
      ring
    have hmu : m' * u ∈ Q := key ▸ Q.mul_mem_left b hmQ
    exact (hQ.1.mem_or_mem hmu).resolve_right fun h ↦ huP (hQP h)

name: isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_forall_height_le_one
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_forall_height_le_one {g h : A} (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (H : ∀ P : Ideal A, P.IsPrime → P.height ≤ 1 → g ∈ P → h ∉ P) :
    IsWeaklyRegular A [g, h]
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff, isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff]
  refine ⟨IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hg, fun x y hxy ↦ ?_, IsWeaklyRegular.nil _ _⟩
  have hmem : ∀ z : A, Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := g • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) z = 0 ↔
      ∃ b, z = g * b := fun z ↦ by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    simp [eq_comm]
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  have hxy' : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := g • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) (h * (x - y)) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hxy
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub]
  set z := x - y
  by_contra hz
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPass, hPle⟩ := exists_le_isAssociatedPrime_of_isNoetherianRing A
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := g • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) z) hz
  obtain ⟨hPprime, w, hw⟩ := (isAssociatedPrime_iff).1 hPass
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
  have hPmem : ∀ a, a ∈ P ↔ ∃ b, a * w = g * b := fun a ↦ by
    rw [hw, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, hmem]
  have hht := Ideal.height_le_one_of_forall_mem_iff_exists_mul_eq hg hPmem
  have hgP : g ∈ P := (hPmem g).2 ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hhP : h ∈ P := hPle (by
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    exact hxy')
  exact H P hPprime hht hgP hhP

name: exists_pair_of_forall_two_le_height
statement:
theorem exists_pair_of_forall_two_le_height (J : Ideal R)
    (hJ : ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → J ≤ P → 2 ≤ P.height) :
    ∃ g ∈ J, ∃ h ∈ J, g ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → P.height ≤ 1 → g ∈ P → h ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgJ, hg⟩ : ∃ g ∈ J, g ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! H
    have hJ0 : J ≤ ⊥ := fun x hx ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot R).2 (H x hx)
    have := hJ ⊥ Ideal.isPrime_bot hJ0
    rw [Ideal.height_bot] at this
    exact absurd this (by norm_num)
  
  let F : Finset (Ideal R) := (Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing R
    (Ideal.span {g})).toFinset.filter fun P ↦ P.height ≤ 1
  have hF : ∀ P ∈ F, P.IsPrime ∧ P.height ≤ 1 := fun P hP ↦ by
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hP
    exact ⟨hP.1.1.1, hP.2⟩
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ P ∈ F, J ≤ P := by
    rintro ⟨P, hP, hJP⟩
    haveI := (hF P hP).1
    have := (hJ P inferInstance hJP).trans (hF P hP).2
    exact absurd this (by norm_num)
  have havoid : ¬ (J : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ (↑F : Set (Ideal R)), (P : Set R) := by
    intro hsub
    exact hnot ((Ideal.subset_union_prime (f := fun P : Ideal R ↦ P) ⊥ ⊥
      fun P hP _ _ ↦ (hF P hP).1).1 hsub)
  obtain ⟨h, hhJ, hh⟩ := Set.not_subset.1 havoid
  refine ⟨g, hgJ, h, hhJ, hg, fun P hP hPh hgP hhP ↦ hh ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).2 hgP)
  have hQeq : Q = P := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : Q < P := lt_of_le_of_ne hQP hne
    haveI := hQ.1.1
    have hQ0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := fun h0 ↦ hg (by
      have := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem Q).1 hQ.1.2
      rw [h0, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
      exact this)
    have h1 : Q.height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hQ0 (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.1 h)
    have h2 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
    have h3 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ P.height :=
      le_trans (by
        have : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Q.height := Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h1
        calc (2 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 1 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ Q.height + 1 := add_le_add_left this 1) h2
    exact absurd (h3.trans hPh) (by norm_num)
  subst hQeq
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := Q) ?_ hhP
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  exact ⟨hQ, hPh⟩

name: exists_isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_isIntegral
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A)) (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : ∀ P : Ideal A, P.IsPrime → I ≤ P → 2 ≤ P.height) :
    ∃ p₁ ∈ I.comap (algebraMap R A), ∃ p₂ ∈ I.comap (algebraMap R A),
      IsWeaklyRegular R [p₁, p₂] ∧ IsWeaklyRegular A [algebraMap R A p₁, algebraMap R A p₂]
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FaithfulSMul R A := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R A).2 hinj
  have hJ : ∀ Q : Ideal R, Q.IsPrime → I.comap (algebraMap R A) ≤ Q → 2 ≤ Q.height := by
    intro Q hQ hIQ
    obtain ⟨P, hIP, hP, rfl⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral Q I hIQ
    exact (hI P hP hIP).trans (Ideal.height_le_height_comap_of_isIntegral P)
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, hp0, hpair⟩ := exists_pair_of_forall_two_le_height _ hJ
  refine ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_forall_height_le_one hp0 hpair,
    isWeaklyRegular_pair_of_forall_height_le_one ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).2 hp0)
      fun P hP hPh h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
  exact hpair (P.comap (algebraMap R A)) inferInstance
    ((Ideal.height_comap_le_height P).trans hPh) h₁ h₂

name: PolynomialModule.tensorEquiv_symm_single_zero
statement:
lemma tensorEquiv_symm_single_zero (m : M) :
    (tensorEquiv (A := A) (M := M)).symm (single A 0 m) = 1 ⊗ₜ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  simp [polynomialTensorProductLEquivPolynomialModule, lsingle]

name: PolynomialModule.single_eq_X_pow_smul
statement:
lemma single_eq_X_pow_smul (i : ℕ) (m : M) :
    single A i m = (X ^ i : A[X]) • single A 0 m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow, monomial_smul_single, one_smul, add_zero]

name: PolynomialModule.augment_single
statement: lemma augment_single (i : ℕ) (m : M) : augment (single A i m) = (X ^ i : A[X]) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_eq_X_pow_smul, LinearMap.map_smul]
  simp [augment, tensorEquiv_symm_single_zero]

name: PolynomialModule.diff_single
statement:
lemma diff_single (i : ℕ) (m : M) :
    diff (single A i m) = single A (i + 1) m - single A i ((X : A[X]) • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_eq_X_pow_smul, LinearMap.map_smul]
  simp only [diff, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
    tensorEquiv_symm_single_zero, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
  simp only [diffAux, lsingle, mulX, LinearMap.restrictScalars_smul,
    LinearMap.restrictScalars_id, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Function.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, coeffLinearEquiv_symm_apply, ofCoeff_single,
    LinearMap.coe_smul, LinearMap.id_coe, Pi.smul_apply, id_eq, smul_sub,
    ← single_eq_X_pow_smul, sub_left_inj]
  rw [← monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow, monomial_smul_single, one_smul]

name: PolynomialModule.augment_diff
statement: lemma augment_diff (q : PolynomialModule A M) : augment (diff q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | single i m => simp [diff_single, augment_single, pow_succ, mul_smul]

name: PolynomialModule.X_smul_coeff
statement:
lemma X_smul_coeff (q : PolynomialModule A M) (n : ℕ) :
    ((X : A[X]) • q).coeff (n + 1) = q.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← monomial_one_one_eq_X, monomial_smul_apply]
  simp

name: PolynomialModule.map_coeff
statement:
lemma map_coeff (f : M →ₗ[A] M) (q : PolynomialModule A M) (n : ℕ) :
    (map A f q).coeff n = f (q.coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map]

name: PolynomialModule.diff_eq
statement: lemma diff_eq (q : PolynomialModule A M) : diff q = (X : A[X]) • q - map A mulX q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]; abel
  | single i m =>
    rw [diff_single, map_single, ← monomial_one_one_eq_X, monomial_smul_single, one_smul,
      add_comm 1 i]
    rfl

name: PolynomialModule.diff_injective
statement: lemma diff_injective : Function.Injective (diff (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro q hq
  by_contra hq0
  have hs : q.coeff.support.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
    exact fun h ↦ hq0 (coeff_eq_zero.mp h)
  set N := q.coeff.support.max' hs
  have hN : q.coeff N ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp (q.coeff.support.max'_mem hs)
  have hN1 : q.coeff (N + 1) = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have := q.coeff.support.le_max' _ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h)
    omega
  have := congr_arg (fun r ↦ r.coeff (N + 1)) hq
  have hsub : ∀ x y : PolynomialModule A M, (x - y).coeff = x.coeff - y.coeff :=
    map_sub (coeffAddEquiv (R := A) (M := M))
  simp only [diff_eq, hsub, Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, X_smul_coeff, map_coeff, hN1,
    map_zero, sub_zero, coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  exact hN this

name: PolynomialModule.sub_single_augment_mem_range
statement:
lemma sub_single_augment_mem_range (q : PolynomialModule A M) :
    q - single A 0 (augment q) ∈ LinearMap.range (diff (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, single_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem hx hy
  | single i m =>
    induction i generalizing m with
    | zero => simp [augment_single]
    | succ i ih =>
      have h := ih ((X : A[X]) • m)
      rw [augment_single] at h ⊢
      have e : single A (i + 1) m - single A 0 ((X ^ (i + 1) : A[X]) • m) =
          diff (single A i m) + (single A i ((X : A[X]) • m) -
            single A 0 ((X ^ i : A[X]) • (X : A[X]) • m)) := by
        rw [diff_single, pow_succ, mul_smul]
        abel
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _) h

name: PolynomialModule.exact_diff_augment
statement: lemma exact_diff_augment : Function.Exact (diff (A := A) (M := M)) augment
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [h] using sub_single_augment_mem_range q
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact augment_diff q

name: PolynomialModule.augment_surjective
statement: lemma augment_surjective : Function.Surjective (augment (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:=
  fun m ↦ ⟨single A 0 m, by simp [augment_single]⟩

name: ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_succ_of_exact
statement:
lemma hasProjectiveDimensionLE_succ_of_exact {K P N : Type u} [AddCommGroup K] [Module A K]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    (f : K →ₗ[A] P) (g : P →ₗ[A] N) (hfg : Function.Exact f g) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (d : ℕ) [Module.Projective A P]
    [HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A K) d] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A N) (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero f g hfg.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S hfg hf hg
  have : Projective S.X₂ := (IsProjective.iff_projective P).mp inferInstance
  exact (hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff d this).mpr ‹_›

name: ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_exact
statement:
lemma hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_exact {K P N : Type u} [AddCommGroup K] [Module A K]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    (f : K →ₗ[A] P) (g : P →ₗ[A] N) (hfg : Function.Exact f g) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (d : ℕ) [Module.Projective A P]
    [HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A N) (d + 1)] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A K) d
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero f g hfg.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S hfg hf hg
  have : Projective S.X₂ := (IsProjective.iff_projective P).mp inferInstance
  exact (hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff d this).mp ‹_›

name: ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_baseChange
statement:
lemma hasProjectiveDimensionLE_baseChange (d : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    [HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A N) d] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of B (B ⊗[A] N)) d
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing N with
  | zero =>
    have h : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A N) 0 := ‹_›
    simp only [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, zero_add, ← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one,
      ← IsProjective.iff_projective] at h ⊢
    infer_instance
  | succ d ih =>
    let g : (N →₀ A) →ₗ[A] N := Finsupp.linearCombination A id
    have hg : Function.Surjective g := fun x ↦ ⟨Finsupp.single x 1, by simp [g]⟩
    have hK := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_exact (K := LinearMap.ker g) (LinearMap.ker g).subtype g
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map g) (Submodule.injective_subtype _) hg d
    have := ih (LinearMap.ker g)
    refine hasProjectiveDimensionLE_succ_of_exact
      ((LinearMap.ker g).subtype.baseChange B) (g.baseChange B) ?_ ?_ ?_ d
    · rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor, LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
      exact Module.Flat.lTensor_exact (R := A) B (N := LinearMap.ker g) (N' := N →₀ A)
        (N'' := N) (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map g)
    · rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
      exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _
        (LinearMap.ker g).injective_subtype
    · rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
      exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B hg

name: ModuleCat.HasGlobalDimensionLE.mono
statement:
lemma HasGlobalDimensionLE.mono {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {d e : ℕ}
    (h : HasGlobalDimensionLE R d) (hde : d ≤ e) : HasGlobalDimensionLE R e
proof:
:= fun M _ _ ↦
  have := h M
  hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ (d + 1) (e + 1) (by omega)

name: ModuleCat.hasGlobalDimensionLE_zero_of_field
statement: lemma hasGlobalDimensionLE_zero_of_field (k : Type u) [Field k] : HasGlobalDimensionLE k 0
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _
  simp only [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, zero_add, ← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one,
    ← IsProjective.iff_projective]
  infer_instance

name: ModuleCat.HasGlobalDimensionLE.of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma HasGlobalDimensionLE.of_ringEquiv {R R' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] (e : R ≃+* R')
    {d : ℕ} (h : HasGlobalDimensionLE R d) : HasGlobalDimensionLE R' d
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _
  letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (e : R →+* R')
  let e' : ModuleCat.of R M ≃ₛₗ[RingHomClass.toRingHom e] ModuleCat.of R' M :=
    { AddEquiv.refl M with map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have := h M
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_semiLinearEquiv e e' d

name: ModuleCat.hasGlobalDimensionLE_polynomial
statement:
theorem hasGlobalDimensionLE_polynomial {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {d : ℕ}
    (h : HasGlobalDimensionLE A d) : HasGlobalDimensionLE A[X] (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _
  letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap A A[X])
  haveI : IsScalarTower A A[X] M := ⟨fun a p m ↦ by
    change (a • p) • m = (algebraMap A A[X] a) • (p • m)
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]⟩
  have := h M
  have hT := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_baseChange (A := A) (B := A[X]) d M
  have hP : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of A[X] (PolynomialModule A M)) d :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_linearEquiv.{u, u}
      (M := ModuleCat.of A[X] (A[X] ⊗[A] M)) (N := ModuleCat.of A[X] (PolynomialModule A M))
      (PolynomialModule.polynomialTensorProductLEquivPolynomialModule A M) d
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A[X]) :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero (PolynomialModule.diff (A := A) (M := M))
      PolynomialModule.augment PolynomialModule.exact_diff_augment.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S
    PolynomialModule.exact_diff_augment PolynomialModule.diff_injective
    PolynomialModule.augment_surjective
  exact hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (d + 1) hP
    (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ (d + 1) (d + 1 + 1) (by omega))

name: ModuleCat.hasGlobalDimensionLE_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem hasGlobalDimensionLE_mvPolynomial (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    HasGlobalDimensionLE (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact (hasGlobalDimensionLE_zero_of_field k).of_ringEquiv
      (MvPolynomial.isEmptyAlgEquiv k (Fin 0)).symm.toRingEquiv
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (hasGlobalDimensionLE_polynomial ih).of_ringEquiv
      (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n).symm.toRingEquiv

name: ModuleCat.HasFGGlobalDimensionLE.of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma HasFGGlobalDimensionLE.of_ringEquiv {R R' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing R']
    (e : R ≃+* R') {d : ℕ} (h : HasFGGlobalDimensionLE R d) : HasFGGlobalDimensionLE R' d
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _ _
  letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (e : R →+* R')
  haveI : Module.Finite R M := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ‹Module.Finite R' M›.fg_top
    refine ⟨⟨s, Submodule.eq_top_iff'.2 fun m ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span R' (s : Set M) := hs ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span hy
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul r y _ hy =>
      have : r • y = e.symm r • y := by
        change r • y = e (e.symm r) • y
        rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  let e' : ModuleCat.of R M ≃ₛₗ[RingHomClass.toRingHom e] ModuleCat.of R' M :=
    { AddEquiv.refl M with map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have := h M
  exact ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_semiLinearEquiv e e' d

name: ModuleCat.hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_zero_of_isField
statement:
lemma hasFGGlobalDimensionLE_zero_of_isField {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (hR : IsField R) :
    HasFGGlobalDimensionLE R 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := hR.toField
  intro M _ _ _
  simp only [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, zero_add, ← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one,
    ← IsProjective.iff_projective]
  infer_instance

name: ModuleCat.isSMulRegular_ker
statement:
lemma isSMulRegular_ker {k : ℕ} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (f : (Fin k → R) →ₗ[R] M) {x : R} (hx : IsSMulRegular R x) :
    IsSMulRegular (LinearMap.ker f) x
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i ↦ hx ?_)
  have := congrArg (fun c : LinearMap.ker f ↦ (c : Fin k → R) i) hab
  simpa using this

name: ModuleCat.injective_quotSMulTop_map_subtype_ker
statement:
lemma injective_quotSMulTop_map_subtype_ker {F K : Type u} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F]
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] (f : F →ₗ[R] K) (hK : IsSMulRegular K x) :
    Function.Injective (QuotSMulTop.map x (LinearMap.ker f).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  rw [QuotSMulTop.map_apply_mk, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hq
  obtain ⟨v, -, hv⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp hq
  have hfv : f v = 0 := by
    refine hK.right_eq_zero_of_smul ?_
    rw [← map_smul, hv]
    exact l.2
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  have : l = x • (⟨v, hfv⟩ : LinearMap.ker f) := Subtype.ext (by simpa using hv.symm)
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ Submodule.mem_top

name: ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotSMulTop
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotSMulTop (hreg : IsSMulRegular R x)
    (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (e : ℕ) :
    ∀ (K : Type u) [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [Module.Finite R K], IsSMulRegular K x →
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K)) e →
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R K) e
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro K _ _ _ hK h
    haveI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2 fun htop ↦ (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
        (eq_top_iff.2 (htop ▸ Ideal.span_le.2 (by simpa using hx)))
    haveI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    haveI : Module.Projective (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K) :=
      projective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero _
    haveI : Module.Finite (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K) :=
      Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R _ _
    haveI : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K) :=
      Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
    haveI := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R K
    have hjac : x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson := by
      rwa [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top]
    haveI : Module.Free R K := (Module.free_quotSMulTop_iff_free R K hjac hK).1 inferInstance
    simp only [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, zero_add, ← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one,
      ← IsProjective.iff_projective]
    infer_instance
  | succ e ih =>
    intro K _ _ _ hK h
    obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R K
    have hLreg : IsSMulRegular (LinearMap.ker f) x := isSMulRegular_ker f hreg
    let S := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
    let i : QuotSMulTop x (LinearMap.ker f) →ₗ[S] QuotSMulTop x (Fin k → R) :=
      (QuotSMulTop.map x (LinearMap.ker f).subtype).extendScalarsOfSurjective
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    let p : QuotSMulTop x (Fin k → R) →ₗ[S] QuotSMulTop x K :=
      (QuotSMulTop.map x f).extendScalarsOfSurjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hex : Function.Exact i p :=
      QuotSMulTop.map_exact x (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map f) hf
    have hi : Function.Injective i := injective_quotSMulTop_map_subtype_ker f hK
    have hp : Function.Surjective p := QuotSMulTop.map_surjective x hf
    haveI : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of S (QuotSMulTop x K)) (e + 1) := h
    have hL := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_exact i p hex hi hp e
    haveI := ih (LinearMap.ker f) hLreg hL
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_succ_of_exact (LinearMap.ker f).subtype f
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map f) (Submodule.injective_subtype _) hf e

name: ModuleCat.HasFGGlobalDimensionLE.of_quotient
statement:
theorem HasFGGlobalDimensionLE.of_quotient (hreg : IsSMulRegular R x) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    {d : ℕ} (h : HasFGGlobalDimensionLE (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) d) :
    HasFGGlobalDimensionLE R (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _ _
  obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R M
  haveI : Module.Finite (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x (LinearMap.ker f)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R _ _
  haveI := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotSMulTop hreg hx d (LinearMap.ker f)
    (isSMulRegular_ker f hreg) (h _)
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_succ_of_exact (LinearMap.ker f).subtype f
    (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map f) (Submodule.injective_subtype _) hf d

name: RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.quotIdealMap
statement:
theorem RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.quotIdealMap {f : A →+* B} (hf : f.FaithfullyFlat) (I : Ideal A) :
    (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map f) f Ideal.le_comap_map).FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := hf
  exact RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff.mpr (Module.FaithfullyFlat.quotIdealMap A B I)

name: Algebra.isSmoothAt_of_flat_of_formallySmooth_residueField_tensor
statement:
lemma isSmoothAt_of_flat_of_formallySmooth_residueField_tensor [FinitePresentation R S]
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] :
    letI
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
    Module.Flat (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) →
    FormallySmooth 𝓀[Localization.AtPrime p]
      (𝓀[Localization.AtPrime p] ⊗[Localization.AtPrime p] Localization.AtPrime q) →
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt R q := by
  intro _ _
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  let Sp := Localization (algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)
  let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q
  let := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  let f : Sp →ₐ[S] Sq := IsLocalization.liftAlgHom (M := algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)
        (f := Algebra.ofId _ _) (by
      rintro ⟨_, x, hx, rfl⟩
      simpa using! IsLocalization.map_units (M := q.primeCompl) Sq ⟨algebraMap _ _ x,
        by simp_all [q.over_def p]⟩)
  algebraize [f.toRingHom]
  have : IsScalarTower R Sp Sq := .to₁₃₄ _ S _ _
  have : IsScalarTower Rp Sp Sq := .of_algebraMap_eq' <| by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext p.primeCompl
    simp only [RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  have : IsLocalization (algebraMapSubmonoid Sp q.primeCompl) Sq :=
    .isLocalization_of_submonoid_le _ _ (algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl) _
    (by rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; simp_all [q.over_def p])
  have : FinitePresentation Rp Sp := by
    have : Algebra.IsPushout R Rp S Sp :=
      .symm <| Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization p.primeCompl _ _ _
    exact .equiv (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R Rp S Sp)
  have := FormallySmooth.of_formallySmooth_residueField_tensor
    (R := Rp) (S := Sq) (P := Sp) (algebraMapSubmonoid _ q.primeCompl)
  exact .comp R Rp Sq

name: Algebra.isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one
statement:
theorem isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one {K A : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K A] [FiniteType K A] (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q)]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)]
    (h : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q) ≤ 1) : IsSmoothAt K q
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.AtPrime q
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing A := FiniteType.isNoetherianRing K A
  by_cases hS : IsField S
  · letI := hS.toField
    exact FormallySmooth.of_perfectField
  
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 S := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mpr h
  haveI : Ring.DimensionLEOne S :=
    ⟨fun hp hp' ↦ Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_isPrime_bot.mp inferInstance _ hp hp'⟩
  haveI : IsDedekindDomain S := {}
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE S hS).out 2 4).mp ‹IsDedekindDomain S›
  obtain ⟨a, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq q.primeCompl ϖ
  have hm : maximalIdeal S = Ideal.span {algebraMap A S a} := by
    rw [hϖ, Ideal.submodule_span_eq, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one,
      Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit]
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (algebraMap A S s) (by rw [IsLocalization.mk'_spec, map_one])
  have ha0 : algebraMap A S a ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hS <| by
    rw [isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, hm, h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  have ha : a ∈ q := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (I := q), Ideal.mem_comap, hm]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  
  letI : Algebra K[X] A := (aeval a).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower K K[X] A := .of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ (aeval_C a r).symm
  haveI : FiniteType K[X] A := .of_restrictScalars_finiteType K K[X] A
  haveI : FinitePresentation K[X] A := FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  let p : Ideal K[X] := Ideal.span {X}
  haveI hpm : p.IsMaximal := PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible irreducible_X
  haveI : q.LiesOver p := by
    refine ⟨hpm.eq_of_le (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance) ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    change aeval a X ∈ q
    rwa [aeval_X]
  letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  have hXS : algebraMap K[X] S X = algebraMap A S a := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K[X] A S]
    exact congrArg _ (aeval_X a)
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap K[X] S) := by
    rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
    by_contra hne
    haveI : (RingHom.ker (algebraMap K[X] S)).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
    have hle : RingHom.ker (algebraMap K[X] S) ≤ p := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q) (p := p), Ideal.under, Ideal.mem_comap,
        ← Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (I := q), Ideal.mem_comap,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, RingHom.mem_ker.mp hx]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hX : X ∈ RingHom.ker (algebraMap K[X] S) := by
      rw [(Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal inferInstance hne).eq_of_le hpm.ne_top hle]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact ha0 (hXS ▸ RingHom.mem_ker.mp hX)
  
  have hflat : Module.Flat Rp S := by
    haveI : Module.IsTorsionFree Rp S := by
      rw [Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective, injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨r, t, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq p.primeCompl x
      have e : algebraMap Rp S (IsLocalization.mk' Rp r t) * algebraMap K[X] S t =
          algebraMap K[X] S r := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K[X] Rp S t, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K[X] Rp S r,
          ← map_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
      rw [hx, zero_mul, eq_comm, ← map_zero (algebraMap K[X] S)] at e
      rw [hinj e, IsLocalization.mk'_zero]
    infer_instance
  
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal Rp).map (algebraMap Rp S) = maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hXS, hm]
  have hT : IsField (𝓀[Rp] ⊗[Rp] S) := by
    let e : S ⧸ (maximalIdeal Rp).map (algebraMap Rp S) ≃+* 𝓀[Rp] ⊗[Rp] S :=
      (TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S (maximalIdeal Rp)).toRingEquiv.trans
        (TensorProduct.comm Rp S (Rp ⧸ maximalIdeal Rp)).toRingEquiv
    refine e.symm.toMulEquiv.isField ?_
    rw [hmap]
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient _).mp inferInstance
  letI := hT.toField
  haveI : CharZero 𝓀[Rp] := charZero_of_injective_ringHom
    (f := (algebraMap Rp 𝓀[Rp]).comp ((algebraMap K[X] Rp).comp (C : K →+* K[X])))
    (RingHom.injective _)
  haveI : EssFiniteType K[X] S := .of_comp K K[X] S
  haveI : EssFiniteType Rp S := .of_comp K[X] Rp S
  haveI : IsSmoothAt K[X] q :=
    isSmoothAt_of_flat_of_formallySmooth_residueField_tensor p q hflat
      FormallySmooth.of_perfectField
  exact FormallySmooth.comp K K[X] S

name: Algebra.isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_isField
statement:
theorem isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_isField {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CharZero R]
    (hR : IsField R) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [FiniteType R A] (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime]
    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)]
    (h : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q) ≤ 1) : IsSmoothAt R q
proof:
:= by
  letI := hR.toField
  exact isSmoothAt_of_ringKrullDim_le_one q h

name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_eq_zero_iff_of_injective
statement:
theorem TensorProduct.sum_tmul_eq_zero_iff_of_injective (ℓ : B →ₗ[R] (Fin r → R))
    (hℓ : Function.Injective ℓ) (b : Fin m → B) (c : Fin m → S) :
    ∑ j, c j ⊗ₜ[R] b j = 0 ↔ ∀ k, ∑ j, c j * algebraMap R S (ℓ (b j) k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (ℓ.lTensor S) :=
    Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap ℓ hℓ
  have key : ∀ k, piScalarRight R R S (Fin r) (ℓ.lTensor S (∑ j, c j ⊗ₜ[R] b j)) k =
      ∑ j, c j * algebraMap R S (ℓ (b j) k) := fun k ↦ by
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, piScalarRight_apply, piScalarRightHom_tmul,
      Finset.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by rw [_root_.Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
  constructor
  · intro h k
    rw [← key, h, map_zero, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  · intro h
    refine hinj ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    refine (piScalarRight R R S (Fin r)).injective ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    funext k
    rw [key, h k, Pi.zero_apply]

name: exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finite (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (ℓ : B →ₗ[A] (Fin r → A)), Function.Injective ℓ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, b, hb⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := A) (M := B)
  haveI : FaithfulSMul A B := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A B).2 hinj
  let K := FractionRing A
  let L := FractionRing B
  letI : Algebra K L := FractionRing.liftAlgebra A L
  haveI : IsScalarTower A K L := FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra A L
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite K L := Module.Finite.of_isLocalization A B (nonZeroDivisors A)
    (Rₚ := K) (Sₚ := L)
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable K L := inferInstance
  let T : B → Fin m → K := fun x k ↦ Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L x * algebraMap B L (b k))
  have hT : ∀ x k, ∃ a : A, algebraMap A K a = T x k := fun x k ↦ by
    have hx : IsIntegral A (algebraMap B L x * algebraMap B L (b k)) := by
      rw [← map_mul]
      exact (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := A) (x * b k)).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L)
    exact IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 (Algebra.isIntegral_trace (R := A) hx)
  choose ℓ₀ hℓ₀ using hT
  have hK := IsFractionRing.injective A K
  have hBL : ∀ a : A, algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) :=
    fun a ↦ by rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  let ℓ : B →ₗ[A] (Fin m → A) :=
    { toFun := fun x k ↦ ℓ₀ x k
      map_add' := fun x y ↦ funext fun k ↦ hK (by
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add, hℓ₀, T, add_mul])
      map_smul' := fun a x ↦ funext fun k ↦ hK (by
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, map_mul, hℓ₀, T,
          _root_.Algebra.smul_def, hBL, mul_assoc]
        rw [← _root_.Algebra.smul_def, LinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]) }
  refine ⟨m, ℓ, (injective_iff_map_eq_zero ℓ).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have hx0 : ∀ k, T x k = 0 := fun k ↦ by
    rw [← hℓ₀]
    exact (congrArg (algebraMap A K) (congrFun hx k)).trans (map_zero _)
  
  have hxB : ∀ y : B, Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L x * algebraMap B L y) = 0 := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).1
      (hb ▸ Submodule.mem_top : y ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range b))
    simp only [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, _root_.Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, hBL]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← _root_.Algebra.smul_def, LinearMap.map_smul]
    change algebraMap A K (a k) • T x k = 0
    rw [hx0 k, smul_zero]
  have hxL : ∀ z : L, Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L x * z) = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (nonZeroDivisors A)) z
    obtain ⟨a, ha, has⟩ := s.2
    have ha0 : algebraMap A K a ≠ 0 := IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors ha
    have e : Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L x * z) * algebraMap A K a = 0 := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, ← LinearMap.map_smul, _root_.Algebra.smul_def, ← hBL, has,
        mul_left_comm, mul_comm (algebraMap B L (s : B)) z, hs]
      exact hxB y
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e).resolve_right ha0
  have h0 : algebraMap B L x = 0 := (traceForm_nondegenerate K L).1 _ fun z ↦ by
    rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply]
    exact hxL z
  exact IsFractionRing.injective B L (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Function.bijective_iff_forall_card_preimage_eq_one
statement:
theorem Function.bijective_iff_forall_card_preimage_eq_one {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) :
    Function.Bijective f ↔ ∀ b, Nat.card (f ⁻¹' {b}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Function.bijective_iff_existsUnique, Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique,
    Set.subsingleton_coe, Set.nonempty_coe_sort, Set.preimage_singleton_nonempty]
  refine forall_congr' fun b ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hu⟩ := h
    exact ⟨fun x hx y hy ↦ (hu x hx).trans (hu y hy).symm, a, ha⟩
  · obtain ⟨hs, a, ha⟩ := h
    exact ⟨a, ha, fun y hy ↦ hs hy ha⟩

name: Nat.card_preimage_singleton_comp
statement:
theorem Nat.card_preimage_singleton_comp {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (z : γ)
    [Finite ((g ⁻¹' {z}) : Set β)] [∀ y : β, Finite ((f ⁻¹' {y}) : Set α)] {d : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ y : β, Nat.card ((f ⁻¹' {y}) : Set α) = d) :
    Nat.card (((g ∘ f) ⁻¹' {z}) : Set α) = Nat.card ((g ⁻¹' {z}) : Set β) * d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ((g ⁻¹' {z}) : Set β) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_congr (Set.preimageCompEquivSigma f g z), Nat.card_sigma]
  simp [hf, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, mul_comm]

name: okaStalkHom_germ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma okaStalkHom_germ {y : ι → ℂ} {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hy : y ∈ U) (f : OkaRing U) :
    okaStalkHom y ((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ U y hy f) = OkaRing.germ hy f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (colimit.ι_desc (okaStalkCocone y)
    (op (⟨U, hy⟩ : OpenNhds (X := TopCat.of (ι → ℂ)) y))) f

name: okaStalkHom_surjective
statement:
lemma okaStalkHom_surjective (y : ι → ℂ) :
    Function.Surjective (okaStalkHom y).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  obtain ⟨W, hy, f, hf⟩ := LocalOkaRing.exists_okaRing_germ P y
  exact ⟨(okaCommPresheaf ι).germ W y hy f, by rw [okaStalkHom_germ hy f, hf]⟩

name: okaStalkHom_injective
statement:
lemma okaStalkHom_injective (y : ι → ℂ) :
    Function.Injective (okaStalkHom y).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨U, hy, f, rfl⟩ := (okaCommPresheaf ι).exists_germ_eq a
  rw [okaStalkHom_germ hy f] at ha
  obtain ⟨W, hWU, hyW, hres⟩ := OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_zero hy ha
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (okaCommPresheaf ι) (homOfLE hWU) y hyW f]
  change (okaCommPresheaf ι).germ W y hyW (OkaRing.restrict hWU f) = 0
  rw [hres]
  exact map_zero _

name: okaStalkEquiv_germ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma okaStalkEquiv_germ {y : ι → ℂ} {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hy : y ∈ U) (f : OkaRing U) :
    okaStalkEquiv y ((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ U y hy f) = OkaRing.germ hy f
proof:
:=
  okaStalkHom_germ hy f

name: okaStalkEquiv_germ_algebraMap
statement:
lemma okaStalkEquiv_germ_algebraMap {y : ι → ℂ} {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hy : y ∈ U) (c : ℂ) :
    okaStalkEquiv y ((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ U y hy (algebraMap ℂ (OkaRing U) c)) =
      algebraMap ℂ (LocalOkaRing ι) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [okaStalkEquiv_germ hy, AlgHom.commutes]

name: constantCoeff_okaStalkEquiv_germ
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_okaStalkEquiv_germ {y : ι → ℂ} {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hy : y ∈ U)
    (f : OkaRing U) :
    LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (okaStalkEquiv y ((okaCommPresheaf ι).germ U y hy f)) =
      OkaRing.evalHom hy f
proof:
:= by
  rw [okaStalkEquiv_germ hy, OkaRing.constantCoeff_germ]

name: isUnit_okaStalkEquiv_iff
statement:
lemma isUnit_okaStalkEquiv_iff {y : ι → ℂ} (a : (okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y) :
    IsUnit (okaStalkEquiv y a) ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.map (okaStalkEquiv y).symm, fun h ↦ h.map (okaStalkEquiv y)⟩

name: mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff
statement:
lemma mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff {y : ι → ℂ} (a : (okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y) :
    a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y) ↔
      LocalOkaRing.constantCoeff (okaStalkEquiv y a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, ← isUnit_okaStalkEquiv_iff,
    LocalOkaRing.isUnit_iff, not_not]

name: map_okaStalkEquiv_maximalIdeal
statement:
lemma map_okaStalkEquiv_maximalIdeal (y : ι → ℂ) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y)).map (okaStalkEquiv y) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LocalOkaRing ι)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal _

name: germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma germ_mem_maximalIdeal_iff {y : ι → ℂ} {U : Opens (ι → ℂ)} (hy : y ∈ U) (f : OkaRing U) :
    (okaCommPresheaf ι).germ U y hy f ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y) ↔
      OkaRing.evalHom hy f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff, constantCoeff_okaStalkEquiv_germ]

name: isLocalRing_okaStalk
statement: theorem isLocalRing_okaStalk (y : ι → ℂ) : IsLocalRing ((okaCommPresheaf ι).stalk y)
proof:
:=
  (okaStalkEquiv y).symm.isLocalRing

name: sum_mul_sum_mul
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: OkaStatement.of_one
statement: theorem OkaStatement.of_one {n : ℕ} (h : OkaStatement 1 n) (q : ℕ) : OkaStatement q n
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    
    
    intro m U f x hx
    refine ⟨U, le_rfl, m, fun l i ↦ if l = i then 1 else 0, hx, fun l j ↦ j.elim0,
      fun W hWU a _ y hy ↦ ⟨W, le_rfl, hy, a, fun i ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    simp [apply_ite (OkaRing.restrict (le_rfl.trans hWU))]
  | succ q ih =>
    intro m U f x hx
    
    obtain ⟨V₁, hV₁, k₁, A, hxV₁, hArel, hAgen⟩ := ih U (fun i j ↦ f i j.castSucc) x hx
    
    
    obtain ⟨V₂, hV₂, k₂, B, hxV₂, hBrel, hBgen⟩ :=
      h V₁ (fun l _ ↦ ∑ i, A l i * OkaRing.restrict hV₁ (f i (Fin.last q))) x hxV₁
    
    refine ⟨V₂, hV₂.trans hV₁, k₂, fun s i ↦ ∑ l, B s l * OkaRing.restrict hV₂ (A l i), hxV₂,
      fun s j ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
    · 
      
      rw [sum_mul_sum_mul]
      have hres : ∀ l, ∑ i, OkaRing.restrict hV₂ (A l i) *
          OkaRing.restrict (hV₂.trans hV₁) (f i j) =
          OkaRing.restrict hV₂ (∑ i, A l i * OkaRing.restrict hV₁ (f i j)) := fun l ↦ by
        simp only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.restrict_restrict]
      simp only [hres]
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => exact hBrel s 0
      | cast j => simp [hArel]
    · 
      
      obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, hyW₁, c, hc⟩ :=
        hAgen W (hWV.trans hV₂) a (fun j ↦ ha j.castSucc) y hy
      
      have hcL : ∀ j : Fin 1, ∑ l, c l * OkaRing.restrict ((hW₁.trans hWV).trans hV₂)
          (∑ i, A l i * OkaRing.restrict hV₁ (f i (Fin.last q))) = 0 := by
        intro _
        have hres : ∀ l, OkaRing.restrict ((hW₁.trans hWV).trans hV₂)
            (∑ i, A l i * OkaRing.restrict hV₁ (f i (Fin.last q))) =
            ∑ i, OkaRing.restrict (hW₁.trans (hWV.trans hV₂)) (A l i) *
              OkaRing.restrict (hW₁.trans ((hWV.trans hV₂).trans hV₁)) (f i (Fin.last q)) :=
          fun l ↦ by simp only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.restrict_restrict]
        simp only [hres, ← sum_mul_sum_mul, ← hc]
        simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.restrict_restrict] using
          congrArg (OkaRing.restrict hW₁) (ha (Fin.last q))
      
      obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', e, he⟩ := hBgen W₁ (hW₁.trans hWV) c hcL y hyW₁
      refine ⟨W', hW'.trans hW₁, hyW', e, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      have hres : ∀ s, OkaRing.restrict ((hW'.trans hW₁).trans hWV)
          (∑ l, B s l * OkaRing.restrict hV₂ (A l i)) =
          ∑ l, OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hW₁.trans hWV)) (B s l) *
            OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hW₁.trans (hWV.trans hV₂))) (A l i) :=
        fun s ↦ by simp only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.restrict_restrict]
      simp only [hres, ← sum_mul_sum_mul, ← he]
      simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.restrict_restrict] using
        congrArg (OkaRing.restrict hW') (hc i)

name: okaStatement_zero
statement: theorem okaStatement_zero (q : ℕ) : OkaStatement q 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m U f x hx
  
  
  have hinj : ∀ {V : Opens (Fin 0 → ℂ)} {y : Fin 0 → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ V),
      Function.Injective (OkaRing.evalHom hy) := by
    intro V y hy u v huv
    refine OkaRing.ext (funext fun z ↦ ?_)
    rw [Subsingleton.elim z ⟨y, hy⟩]
    exact huv
  set T : (Fin m → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Fin q → ℂ) :=
    ∑ i, (LinearMap.proj i).smulRight (fun j ↦ OkaRing.evalHom hx (f i j)) with hT
  have hTapply : ∀ (a : Fin m → ℂ) (j : Fin q),
      T a j = ∑ i, a i * OkaRing.evalHom hx (f i j) := by
    intro a j
    simp [hT]
  obtain ⟨k, s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := ℂ) (M := LinearMap.ker T)
  refine ⟨U, le_rfl, k, fun l i ↦ algebraMap ℂ (OkaRing U) ((s l : Fin m → ℂ) i), hx,
    fun l j ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine hinj hx ?_
    have h0 : ∑ i, (s l : Fin m → ℂ) i * OkaRing.evalHom hx (f i j) = 0 := by
      rw [← hTapply]
      exact congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (s l).2) j
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.restrict_self,
      OkaRing.evalHom_algebraMap] using h0
  · have hxW : x ∈ W := by rwa [Subsingleton.elim x y]
    have hker : (fun i ↦ OkaRing.evalHom hxW (a i)) ∈ LinearMap.ker T := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      funext j
      rw [hTapply]
      simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, OkaRing.evalHom_restrict] using
        congrArg (OkaRing.evalHom hxW) (ha j)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℂ).mp
      (hs ▸ Submodule.mem_top : (⟨_, hker⟩ : LinearMap.ker T) ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range s))
    refine ⟨W, le_rfl, hy, fun l ↦ algebraMap ℂ (OkaRing W) (c l), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    refine hinj hxW ?_
    have hci : ∑ l, c l * (s l : Fin m → ℂ) i = OkaRing.evalHom hxW (a i) := by
      simpa using congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hc) i
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, OkaRing.restrict_self, AlgHom.commutes,
      OkaRing.evalHom_algebraMap] using hci.symm

name: OkaRowStatement.okaStatement_one
statement: theorem OkaRowStatement.okaStatement_one {n : ℕ} (h : OkaRowStatement n) : OkaStatement 1 n
proof:
:= by
  intro p U f x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, hrel, hgen⟩ := h U (fun i ↦ f i 0) x hx
  refine ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, fun l j ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Subsingleton.elim j 0]
    exact hrel l
  · exact hgen W hWV a (ha 0) y hy

name: OkaRowConclusion.of_le
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.of_le {W : Opens (Fin n → ℂ)} (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (h : OkaRowConclusion W (fun i ↦ OkaRing.restrict hWU (f i)) x) :
    OkaRowConclusion U f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, hrel, hgen⟩ := h
  exact ⟨V, hV.trans hWU, k, g, hxV, hrel, fun W' hW' a ha ↦ hgen W' hW' a ha⟩

name: OkaRowConclusion.restrict
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.restrict {W : Opens (Fin n → ℂ)} (hWU : W ≤ U) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (h : OkaRowConclusion U f x) :
    OkaRowConclusion W (fun i ↦ OkaRing.restrict hWU (f i)) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, hrel, hgen⟩ := h
  refine ⟨V ⊓ W, inf_le_right, k, fun l i ↦ OkaRing.restrict inf_le_left (g l i), ⟨hxV, hxW⟩,
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W' hW' a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.restrict_restrict] using
      congrArg (OkaRing.restrict (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W ≤ V)) (hrel l)
  · obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c, hc⟩ :=
      hgen W' (hW'.trans inf_le_left) a ha y hy
    exact ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c, hc⟩

name: OkaRowConclusion.unit_mul
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.unit_mul {u : Fin p → OkaRing U} (hu : ∀ i, IsUnit (u i))
    (h : OkaRowConclusion U f x) :
    OkaRowConclusion U (fun i ↦ u i * f i) x
proof:
:= by
  choose w hw using fun i ↦ (hu i).exists_right_inv
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, hrel, hgen⟩ := h
  refine ⟨V, hV, k, fun l i ↦ g l i * OkaRing.restrict hV (w i), hxV, fun l ↦ ?_,
    fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine .trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_) (hrel l)
    rw [map_mul, show g l i * OkaRing.restrict hV (w i) *
      (OkaRing.restrict hV (u i) * OkaRing.restrict hV (f i)) =
        g l i * OkaRing.restrict hV (f i) *
          (OkaRing.restrict hV (u i) * OkaRing.restrict hV (w i)) from by ring,
      ← map_mul, hw i, map_one, mul_one]
  · have hb : ∑ i, (a i * OkaRing.restrict (hWV.trans hV) (u i)) *
        OkaRing.restrict (hWV.trans hV) (f i) = 0 := by
      refine .trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_) ha
      rw [map_mul]
      ring
    obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', c, hc⟩ := hgen W hWV _ hb y hy
    refine ⟨W', hW', hyW', c, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have key : OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hWV.trans hV)) (u i) *
        OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hWV.trans hV)) (w i) = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, hw i, map_one]
    calc OkaRing.restrict hW' (a i)
        = OkaRing.restrict hW' (a i * OkaRing.restrict (hWV.trans hV) (u i)) *
            OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hWV.trans hV)) (w i) := by
          rw [map_mul]
          simp only [OkaRing.restrict_restrict, mul_assoc, key, mul_one]
      _ = (∑ l, c l * OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans hWV) (g l i)) *
            OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans (hWV.trans hV)) (w i) := by rw [hc i]
      _ = ∑ l, c l * OkaRing.restrict (hW'.trans hWV) (g l i * OkaRing.restrict hV (w i)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
          rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
          simp only [OkaRing.restrict_restrict]

name: OkaRowConclusion.of_shift
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.of_shift
    (h : OkaRowConclusion (U.shift x) (fun i ↦ OkaRing.shift U x (f i)) 0) :
    OkaRowConclusion U f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V', hV', k, g', h0V', hrel', hgen'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ : ∃ V, V.shift x = V' := ⟨V'.shift (-x), by simp [Opens.shift_shift]⟩
  have hV : V ≤ U := Opens.shift_le_shift_iff.mp hV'
  refine ⟨V, hV, k, fun l i ↦ (OkaRing.shift V x).symm (g' l i), by simpa using h0V',
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine (OkaRing.shift V x).injective ?_
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, OkaRing.shift_restrict]
      using hrel' l
  · have ha' : ∑ i, OkaRing.shift W x (a i) *
        OkaRing.restrict ((Opens.shift_mono hWV).trans hV') (OkaRing.shift U x (f i)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.shift_restrict] using
        congrArg (OkaRing.shift W x) ha
    obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c', hc'⟩ :=
      hgen' (W.shift x) (Opens.shift_mono hWV) _ ha' (y - x) (by simpa using hy)
    obtain ⟨W', rfl⟩ : ∃ W', W'.shift x = W'' := ⟨W''.shift (-x), by simp [Opens.shift_shift]⟩
    refine ⟨W', Opens.shift_le_shift_iff.mp hW'', by simpa using hyW'',
      fun l ↦ (OkaRing.shift W' x).symm (c' l), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    refine (OkaRing.shift W' x).injective ?_
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, OkaRing.shift_restrict] using hc' i

name: OkaRowConclusion.of_congr
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.of_congr (φ : (Fin n → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ))
    (h : OkaRowConclusion (φ.opensCongr U) (fun i ↦ OkaRing.congr φ U (f i)) (φ x)) :
    OkaRowConclusion U f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V', hV', k, g', hxV', hrel', hgen'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ : ∃ V, φ.opensCongr V = V' :=
    ⟨φ.opensCongr.symm V', φ.opensCongr.apply_symm_apply V'⟩
  have hV : V ≤ U := φ.opensCongr.le_iff_le.mp hV'
  refine ⟨V, hV, k, fun l i ↦ (OkaRing.congr φ V).symm (g' l i), by simpa using hxV',
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine (OkaRing.congr φ V).injective ?_
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, OkaRing.congr_restrict]
      using hrel' l
  · have ha' : ∑ i, OkaRing.congr φ W (a i) *
        OkaRing.restrict ((φ.opensCongr.monotone hWV).trans hV')
          (OkaRing.congr φ U (f i)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero, OkaRing.congr_restrict] using
        congrArg (OkaRing.congr φ W) ha
    obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hyW'', c', hc'⟩ :=
      hgen' (φ.opensCongr W) (φ.opensCongr.monotone hWV) _ ha' (φ y) (by simpa using hy)
    obtain ⟨W', rfl⟩ : ∃ W', φ.opensCongr W' = W'' :=
      ⟨φ.opensCongr.symm W'', φ.opensCongr.apply_symm_apply W''⟩
    refine ⟨W', φ.opensCongr.le_iff_le.mp hW'', by simpa using hyW'',
      fun l ↦ (OkaRing.congr φ W').symm (c' l), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    refine (OkaRing.congr φ W').injective ?_
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, OkaRing.congr_restrict] using hc' i

name: OkaRowConclusion.of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem OkaRowConclusion.of_eq_zero {f : Fin (p + 1) → OkaRing U} (i₀ : Fin (p + 1))
    (h0 : f i₀ = 0) (h : OkaRowConclusion U (fun i ↦ f (i₀.succAbove i)) x) :
    OkaRowConclusion U f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, g, hxV, hrel, hgen⟩ := h
  refine ⟨V, hV, k + 1,
    Fin.cases (fun i ↦ if i = i₀ then 1 else 0) (fun l ↦ i₀.insertNth 0 (g l)), hxV,
    fun l ↦ ?_, fun W hWV a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · induction l using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Fin.cases_zero, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true, h0, map_zero]
    | succ l =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i₀]
      simpa only [Fin.cases_succ, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove,
        zero_mul, zero_add] using hrel l
  · have ha' : ∑ j, a (i₀.succAbove j) *
        OkaRing.restrict (hWV.trans hV) (f (i₀.succAbove j)) = 0 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i₀] at ha
      simpa only [h0, map_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] using ha
    obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', c, hc⟩ := hgen W hWV _ ha' y hy
    refine ⟨W', hW', hyW', Fin.cases (OkaRing.restrict hW' (a i₀)) c, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      simp
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
      simpa only [Fin.cases_zero, Fin.cases_succ, Fin.succAbove_ne, if_false,
        Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, map_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] using hc j

name: exists_isWeierstrassPolynomial_row
statement:
theorem exists_isWeierstrassPolynomial_row (U : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) (h0 : 0 ∈ U)
    (f : Fin p → OkaRing U)
    (hf : ∀ (i : Fin p) (W : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) (hWU : W ≤ U), 0 ∈ W →
      OkaRing.restrict hWU (f i) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (φ : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) (V : Opens (Fin n → ℂ))
      (W : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) (hWU : W ≤ φ.opensCongr U) (hWV : W ≤ V.extend')
      (Q : Fin p → (OkaRing V)[X]) (u : Fin p → OkaRing W),
      0 ∈ V ∧ 0 ∈ W ∧ (∀ i, IsWeierstrassPolynomial V (Q i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsUnit (u i)) ∧
        ∀ i, OkaRing.restrict hWU (OkaRing.congr φ U (f i)) =
          u i * OkaRing.restrict hWV (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  
  have hgerm : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ h0 (f i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hzero
    obtain ⟨W, hWU, h0W, hres⟩ := OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_zero h0 hzero
    exact hf i W hWU h0W hres
  have hcoe : ∀ i, ((OkaRing.germ h0 (f i) : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) :
      MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ) ≠ 0 := fun i hc ↦ hgerm i (Subtype.ext hc)
  obtain ⟨v, hvlast, hv⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_direction
    (fun i ↦ ((OkaRing.germ h0 (f i) : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) :
      MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)) hcoe
  set φ : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) := lineEquiv v hvlast with hφ
  have h0U' : (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ∈ φ.opensCongr U := by
    have h1 : φ 0 ∈ φ.opensCongr U := by simp [h0]
    rwa [map_zero] at h1
  set g : Fin p → OkaRing (φ.opensCongr U) := fun i ↦ OkaRing.congr φ U (f i) with hgdef
  
  have hgen : ∀ i, ((OkaRing.germ h0U' (g i) : LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1))) :
      MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ).IsGeneralIn (Fin.last n) := by
    intro i hpe
    have hax := (OkaRing.germ_represents h0U' (g i)).eventually_axis_eq_zero (Fin.last n) hpe
    have hopen : ∀ᶠ t : ℂ in nhds 0,
        t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ) ∈ φ.opensCongr U := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun t : ℂ ↦ t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ) :=
        continuous_id.smul continuous_const
      have htend := hcont.tendsto 0
      rw [zero_smul] at htend
      exact htend.eventually ((φ.opensCongr U).isOpen.mem_nhds h0U')
    
    have hline : ∀ᶠ t : ℂ in nhds 0,
        (fun z ↦ (f i).toGlobalFun _ (z + 0)) (t • v) = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hax, hopen] with t ht hmem
      have h2 : (g i).toGlobalFun _ (t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ) + 0) = 0 := ht
      rw [add_zero, (g i).toGlobalFun_apply hmem] at h2
      have hmemU : φ.symm (t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ)) ∈ U := hmem
      have h3 : (g i).toFun _ ⟨t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ), hmem⟩ =
          (f i).toGlobalFun _ (φ.symm (t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ))) := by
        rw [(f i).toGlobalFun_apply hmemU]
        rfl
      rw [h3] at h2
      have h4 : φ.symm (t • Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℂ)) = t • v :=
        lineEquiv_symm_smul_single v hvlast t
      rw [h4] at h2
      change (f i).toGlobalFun _ (t • v + 0) = 0
      rwa [add_zero]
    have hcontra := (OkaRing.germ_represents h0 (f i)).homogeneous_eval_eq_zero v hline
    obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ := hv i
    exact hkk (hcontra kk)
  
  choose uu huu gpoly hgpolyW hfac using fun i ↦
    localweierstrass_preparation (OkaRing.germ h0U' (g i)) (hgen i)
  
  choose V₀ h0V₀ Q₀ hQmap hQW using fun i ↦
    LocalOkaRing.exists_isWeierstrassPolynomial_realize (hgpolyW i)
  set V : Opens (Fin n → ℂ) := Finset.univ.inf V₀ with hVdef
  have h0V : (0 : Fin n → ℂ) ∈ V := Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun i _ ↦ h0V₀ i
  have hVle : ∀ i, V ≤ V₀ i := fun i ↦ Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i)
  set Q : Fin p → (OkaRing V)[X] :=
    fun i ↦ (Q₀ i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hVle i)).toRingHom with hQdef
  have hQWeier : ∀ i, IsWeierstrassPolynomial V (Q i) := fun i ↦
    (hQW i).map_restrict (hVle i) h0V
  have h0Ve : (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ∈ V.extend' := Opens.zero_mem_extend'.mpr h0V
  
  have hgermQ : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ h0Ve (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i)) =
      LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial (gpoly i) := by
    intro i
    rw [OkaRing.germ_toOkaRing h0Ve (Q i)]
    congr 1
    have e2 : OkaRing.germPoly (Opens.mem_extend'.mp h0Ve)
        ((0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (Fin.last n)) (Q i) =
        (Q i).map (OkaRing.germ (Opens.mem_extend'.mp h0Ve)).toRingHom :=
      OkaRing.germPoly_zero _ (Q i)
    rw [e2]
    simp only [hQdef]
    rw [Polynomial.map_map]
    have hcomp : (OkaRing.germ (Opens.mem_extend'.mp h0Ve)).toRingHom.comp
        (OkaRing.restrict (hVle i)).toRingHom = (OkaRing.germ (h0V₀ i)).toRingHom :=
      RingHom.ext fun a ↦ OkaRing.germ_restrict (hVle i) (Opens.mem_extend'.mp h0Ve) a
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hQmap i
  
  choose Wu h0Wu uf huf using fun i ↦
    LocalOkaRing.exists_okaRing_germ (uu i) (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)
  have hufunit : ∀ i, IsUnit (OkaRing.germ (h0Wu i) (uf i)) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [huf i]
    exact huu i
  choose Wu' hWu'le h0Wu' huu' using fun i ↦
    OkaRing.exists_isUnit_restrict (h0Wu i) (hufunit i)
  
  set W₁ : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :=
    (φ.opensCongr U ⊓ V.extend') ⊓ Finset.univ.inf Wu' with hW₁def
  have h0W₁ : (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ∈ W₁ :=
    ⟨⟨h0U', h0Ve⟩, Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun i _ ↦ h0Wu' i⟩
  have hW₁U' : W₁ ≤ φ.opensCongr U := le_trans inf_le_left inf_le_left
  have hW₁V : W₁ ≤ V.extend' := le_trans inf_le_left inf_le_right
  have hW₁u : ∀ i, W₁ ≤ Wu' i := fun i ↦
    le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  
  have hgermeq : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ h0W₁ (OkaRing.restrict hW₁U' (g i)) =
      OkaRing.germ h0W₁
        (OkaRing.restrict (hW₁u i) (OkaRing.restrict (hWu'le i) (uf i)) *
          OkaRing.restrict hW₁V (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))) := by
    intro i
    calc OkaRing.germ h0W₁ (OkaRing.restrict hW₁U' (g i))
        = OkaRing.germ h0U' (g i) := OkaRing.germ_restrict _ _ _
      _ = LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial (gpoly i) * uu i := hfac i
      _ = uu i * LocalOkaRing.fromPolynomial (gpoly i) := mul_comm _ _
      _ = OkaRing.germ h0W₁
            (OkaRing.restrict (hW₁u i) (OkaRing.restrict (hWu'le i) (uf i))) *
          OkaRing.germ h0W₁ (OkaRing.restrict hW₁V (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))) := by
          rw [OkaRing.germ_restrict, OkaRing.germ_restrict, OkaRing.germ_restrict]
          congr 1
          · exact (huf i).symm
          · exact (hgermQ i).symm
      _ = OkaRing.germ h0W₁
            (OkaRing.restrict (hW₁u i) (OkaRing.restrict (hWu'le i) (uf i)) *
              OkaRing.restrict hW₁V (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))) :=
          (map_mul _ _ _).symm
  
  choose W₂ hW₂le h0W₂ hres using fun i ↦
    OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_of_germ_eq h0W₁ (hgermeq i)
  set W : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) := W₁ ⊓ Finset.univ.inf W₂ with hWdef
  have h0W : (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ∈ W :=
    ⟨h0W₁, Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun i _ ↦ h0W₂ i⟩
  have hWW₂ : ∀ i, W ≤ W₂ i := fun i ↦
    le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hWU' : W ≤ φ.opensCongr U := le_trans inf_le_left hW₁U'
  have hWV : W ≤ V.extend' := le_trans inf_le_left hW₁V
  refine ⟨φ, V, W, hWU', hWV, Q,
    fun i ↦ OkaRing.restrict (le_trans inf_le_left (hW₁u i))
      (OkaRing.restrict (hWu'le i) (uf i)),
    h0V, h0W, hQWeier, fun i ↦ (huu' i).map _, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have h5 := congrArg (OkaRing.restrict (hWW₂ i)) (hres i)
  simp only [OkaRing.restrict_restrict, map_mul] at h5
  exact h5

name: coeff_sum_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
private lemma coeff_sum_C_mul_X_pow {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {d : ℕ} (aa : Fin d → R)
    (kk : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (aa j) * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)).coeff kk =
      if h : kk < d then aa ⟨kk, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  have h1 : ∀ j : Fin d, (Polynomial.C (aa j) * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)).coeff kk =
      if kk = (j : ℕ) then aa j else 0 := fun j ↦ by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ h1 j]
  by_cases h : kk < d
  · rw [dif_pos h]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨kk, h⟩ : Fin d)]
    · rw [if_pos rfl]
    · intro j _ hj
      exact if_neg fun hc ↦ hj (Fin.ext hc.symm)
    · intro hc
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hc
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ if_neg fun hc : kk = (j : ℕ) ↦ h (hc ▸ j.2)

name: sum_C_coeff_mul_X_pow
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ext fun kk ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_sum_C_mul_X_pow (fun j : Fin d ↦ P.coeff (j : ℕ)) kk]
  by_cases h : kk < d
  · rw [dif_pos h]
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    exact (Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)).symm

name: sum_C_mul_X_pow_mul_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private lemma sum_C_mul_X_pow_mul_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {V : Opens (Fin n → ℂ)} {p d : ℕ}
    (Q : Fin p → (OkaRing V)[X]) (hQd : ∀ i, (Q i).natDegree < d)
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (ψ : OkaRing V →+* S) (a : Fin (p * d) → S) :
    (∀ j : Fin (2 * d), ∑ c, a c *
        ψ ((Q (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 *
          Polynomial.X ^ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ)).coeff j) = 0) ↔
      ∑ i, (∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (a (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)) *
        ((Q i).map ψ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff : ∀ kk : ℕ,
      (∑ i, (∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (a (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) *
        Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)) * ((Q i).map ψ)).coeff kk =
      ∑ c, a c * ψ ((Q (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 *
        Polynomial.X ^ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ)).coeff kk) := by
    intro kk
    rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    have h1 : ∀ i, ((∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (a (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) *
        Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)) * ((Q i).map ψ)).coeff kk =
        ∑ j : Fin d, a (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) *
          ψ ((Q i * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)).coeff kk) := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rw [mul_assoc, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [show Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ) * (Q i).map ψ = (Q i * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)).map ψ by
        rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, mul_comm]]
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ h1 i, ← Finset.sum_product',
      Finset.univ_product_univ]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv finProdFinEquiv _ _ fun ij ↦ by simp
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine Polynomial.ext fun kk ↦ ?_
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero, hcoeff]
    by_cases hkk : kk < 2 * d
    · exact h ⟨kk, hkk⟩
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ ↦ ?_
      have hdeg : (Q (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 *
          Polynomial.X ^ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ)).natDegree < 2 * d := by
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le ?_
        have h2 := hQd (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1
        have h3 : (Polynomial.X ^ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ) :
            (OkaRing V)[X]).natDegree ≤ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ) :=
          Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_le _
        have h4 : ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ) < d := (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2.2
        omega
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hdeg (by omega)),
        map_zero, mul_zero]
  · intro h j
    rw [← hcoeff, h, Polynomial.coeff_zero]

name: okaRowConclusion_toOkaRing
statement:
theorem okaRowConclusion_toOkaRing (hn : ∀ q, OkaStatement q n) (V : Opens (Fin n → ℂ))
    (Q : Fin p → (OkaRing V)[X]) (hQ : ∀ i, IsWeierstrassPolynomial V (Q i))
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (hx : x ∈ V.extend') :
    OkaRowConclusion V.extend' (fun i ↦ Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set d : ℕ := (Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (Q i).natDegree) + 1 with hddef
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.succ_pos _
  have hQd : ∀ i, (Q i).natDegree < d := fun i ↦
    Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ (Q i).natDegree) (Finset.mem_univ i))
  set M : Fin (p * d) → Fin (2 * d) → OkaRing V := fun c j ↦
    (Q (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 *
      Polynomial.X ^ ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ)).coeff j with hMdef
  
  obtain ⟨V₁, hV₁, k, g, hxV₁, hgrel, hggen⟩ :=
    hn (2 * d) V M (Fin.init x) (Opens.mem_extend'.mp hx)
  
  set G : Fin k → Fin p → (OkaRing V₁)[X] := fun l i ↦
    ∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (g l (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) * Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)
    with hGdef
  have hGpoly : ∀ l, ∑ i, G l i * ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₁).toRingHom) = 0 :=
    fun l ↦ (sum_C_mul_X_pow_mul_eq_zero_iff Q hQd (OkaRing.restrict hV₁).toRingHom
      (g l)).mp (hgrel l)
  refine ⟨V₁.extend', Opens.extend'_mono hV₁, k,
    fun l i ↦ Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁ (G l i), Opens.mem_extend'.mpr hxV₁, fun l ↦ ?_,
    fun W hW a ha y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    calc ∑ i, Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁ (G l i) *
          OkaRing.restrict (Opens.extend'_mono hV₁) (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))
        = Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁
            (∑ i, G l i * ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₁).toRingHom)) := by
          rw [map_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
          rw [map_mul, Polynomial.toOkaRing_map_restrict]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hGpoly l, map_zero]
  · 
    have hyV₁e : y ∈ V₁.extend' := hW hy
    have hy'V₁ : Fin.init y ∈ V₁ := Opens.mem_extend'.mp hyV₁e
    have hy'V : Fin.init y ∈ V := hV₁ hy'V₁
    have hyVe : y ∈ V.extend' := Opens.extend'_mono hV₁ hyV₁e
    
    set Fp : Fin p → (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X] := fun i ↦
      OkaRing.germPoly hy'V (y (Fin.last n)) (Q i) with hFpdef
    have hFpmonic : ∀ i, (Fp i).Monic := fun i ↦
      OkaRing.monic_germPoly hy'V (y (Fin.last n)) (hQ i).monic
    have hFpdeg : ∀ i, (Fp i).degree < (d : WithBot ℕ) := fun i ↦
      lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree (by
        exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_lt (OkaRing.natDegree_germPoly_le hy'V _ (Q i)) (hQd i))
    set F : Fin p → (Polynomial.degreeLT (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) d) := fun i ↦
      ⟨Fp i, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (hFpdeg i)⟩ with hFdef
    have hoka := oka_lemma p d F fun j ↦ hFpmonic j
    
    have hF'eq : ∀ j, polyIncl (F j) =
        OkaRing.germ hyVe (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q j)) := by
      intro j
      rw [OkaRing.germ_toOkaRing hyVe (Q j)]
      rfl
    have hker : (fun i ↦ OkaRing.germ hy (a i)) ∈
        LinearMap.ker (linOfFun fun j ↦ polyIncl (F j)) := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Module.Basis.constr_apply_fintype]
      simp only [Pi.basisFun_equivFun, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have hterm : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ hy (a i) * polyIncl (F i) =
          OkaRing.germ hy (a i * OkaRing.restrict (hW.trans (Opens.extend'_mono hV₁))
            (Polynomial.toOkaRing V (Q i))) := by
        intro i
        rw [map_mul, hF'eq i, OkaRing.germ_restrict]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ hterm i, ← map_sum, ha, map_zero]
    rw [hoka] at hker
    obtain ⟨T, cg, κs, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.mp hker
    choose κ hκK hκval using fun t ↦ Submodule.mem_map.mp (κs t).2
    
    choose V₂ hy'V₂ R hRgerm hRdeg using fun (t : Fin T) (i : Fin p) ↦
      LocalOkaRing.exists_poly_germPoly ((κ t i : Polynomial.degreeLT _ d) :
        (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) (Fin.init y) (y (Fin.last n))
    set V₃ : Opens (Fin n → ℂ) :=
      V₁ ⊓ Finset.univ.inf (fun ti : Fin T × Fin p ↦ V₂ ti.1 ti.2) with hV₃def
    have hy'V₃ : Fin.init y ∈ V₃ :=
      ⟨hy'V₁, Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun ti _ ↦ hy'V₂ ti.1 ti.2⟩
    have hV₃V₁ : V₃ ≤ V₁ := inf_le_left
    have hV₃V₂ : ∀ t i, V₃ ≤ V₂ t i := fun t i ↦
      le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ (t, i)))
    have hyV₃e : y ∈ V₃.extend' := Opens.mem_extend'.mpr hy'V₃
    set R' : Fin T → Fin p → (OkaRing V₃)[X] := fun t i ↦
      (R t i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hV₃V₂ t i)).toRingHom with hR'def
    have hR'germ : ∀ t i, OkaRing.germPoly hy'V₃ (y (Fin.last n)) (R' t i) =
        ((κ t i : Polynomial.degreeLT _ d) : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) := by
      intro t i
      rw [hR'def]
      simp only
      rw [OkaRing.germPoly_map_restrict (hV₃V₂ t i) hy'V₃]
      exact hRgerm t i
    have hR'deg : ∀ t i, (R' t i).natDegree < d := by
      intro t i
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.natDegree_map_le ?_
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (hRdeg t i) ?_
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_lt_of_mem_degreeLT hd0 (κ t i).2
    
    set S : Fin T → (OkaRing V₃)[X] := fun t ↦
      ∑ i, R' t i * ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hV₃V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom) with hSdef
    have hSgerm : ∀ t, OkaRing.germ hyV₃e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₃ (S t)) = 0 := by
      intro t
      rw [hSdef]
      simp only
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      have hterm : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ hyV₃e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₃
          (R' t i * ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hV₃V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom))) =
          polyIncl (κ t i) * polyIncl (F i) := by
        intro i
        rw [map_mul, map_mul]
        congr 1
        · rw [OkaRing.germ_toOkaRing hyV₃e (R' t i)]
          have h6 : OkaRing.germPoly (Opens.mem_extend'.mp hyV₃e) (y (Fin.last n)) (R' t i) =
              ((κ t i : Polynomial.degreeLT _ d) : (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) := hR'germ t i
          rw [h6]
          rfl
        · rw [Polynomial.toOkaRing_map_restrict, OkaRing.germ_restrict, hF'eq i]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ hterm i]
      
      have h7 := hκK t
      simp only [kDeg, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.coe_comp,
        LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Function.comp_apply,
        Module.Basis.constr_apply_fintype, Pi.basisFun_equivFun, LinearEquiv.refl_apply,
        smul_eq_mul] at h7
      exact h7
    
    have hslice : ∀ t, ∃ (V₄ : Opens (Fin n → ℂ)) (hle : V₄ ≤ V₃), Fin.init y ∈ V₄ ∧
        (S t).map (OkaRing.restrict hle).toRingHom = 0 := by
      intro t
      obtain ⟨W₄, hW₄le, hyW₄, hW₄zero⟩ :=
        OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_zero hyV₃e (hSgerm t)
      exact Polynomial.exists_map_restrict_eq_zero (S t) hW₄le hyW₄ hW₄zero
    choose V₄ hV₄le hy'V₄ hSzero using hslice
    set V₅ : Opens (Fin n → ℂ) := V₃ ⊓ Finset.univ.inf V₄ with hV₅def
    have hy'V₅ : Fin.init y ∈ V₅ :=
      ⟨hy'V₃, Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun t _ ↦ hy'V₄ t⟩
    have hV₅V₄ : ∀ t, V₅ ≤ V₄ t := fun t ↦
      le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ t))
    have hV₅V₃ : V₅ ≤ V₃ := inf_le_left
    have hV₅V₁ : V₅ ≤ V₁ := hV₅V₃.trans hV₃V₁
    
    set b : Fin T → Fin (p * d) → OkaRing V₅ := fun t c ↦
      OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃ ((R' t (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1).coeff
        ((finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2 : ℕ)) with hbdef
    have hSzero' : ∀ t, ∑ i, ((R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom) *
        ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom) = 0 := by
      intro t
      have h9 : (S t).map ((OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₄ t)).toRingHom.comp
          (OkaRing.restrict (hV₄le t)).toRingHom) = 0 := by
        rw [← Polynomial.map_map, hSzero t, Polynomial.map_zero]
      have h10 : (OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₄ t)).toRingHom.comp
          (OkaRing.restrict (hV₄le t)).toRingHom = (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom :=
        RingHom.ext fun aa ↦ rfl
      rw [h10] at h9
      calc ∑ i, ((R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom) *
            ((Q i).map (OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom)
          = (S t).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom := by
            rw [hSdef]
            simp only
            rw [Polynomial.map_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
            have hcomp2 : (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom.comp
                (OkaRing.restrict (hV₃V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom =
                (OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom :=
              RingHom.ext fun aa ↦ rfl
            rw [Polynomial.map_mul]
            congr 1
            rw [Polynomial.map_map, hcomp2]
        _ = 0 := h9
    
    have hrows : ∀ t (j : Fin (2 * d)),
        ∑ c, b t c * OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₁.trans hV₁) (M c j) = 0 := by
      intro t
      refine (sum_C_mul_X_pow_mul_eq_zero_iff Q hQd
        (OkaRing.restrict (hV₅V₁.trans hV₁)).toRingHom (b t)).mpr ?_
      have hrecon : ∀ i, (∑ j : Fin d, Polynomial.C (b t (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) *
          Polynomial.X ^ (j : ℕ)) = (R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom := by
        intro i
        have hb : ∀ j : Fin d, b t (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) =
            ((R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict hV₅V₃).toRingHom).coeff (j : ℕ) := by
          intro j
          have hsymm : finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) = (i, j) :=
            Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
          simp only [hbdef, hsymm, Polynomial.coeff_map]
          rfl
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by rw [hb j]]
        exact sum_C_coeff_mul_X_pow
          (lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.natDegree_map_le (hR'deg t i))
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [hrecon i]]
      exact hSzero' t
    
    choose W₅ hW₅le hy'W₅ c' hc' using fun t ↦
      hggen V₅ hV₅V₁ (b t) (hrows t) (Fin.init y) hy'V₅
    
    have hpoly : ∀ t i, (R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₃)).toRingHom =
        ∑ l, Polynomial.C (c' t l) *
          (G l i).map (OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₁)).toRingHom := by
      intro t i
      refine Polynomial.ext fun kk ↦ ?_
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      have hRr : ∀ l, (Polynomial.C (c' t l) *
          (G l i).map (OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₁)).toRingHom).coeff kk =
          c' t l * OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₁) ((G l i).coeff kk) := by
        intro l
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_map]
        rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ hRr l]
      by_cases hkk : kk < d
      · have hGc : ∀ l, (G l i).coeff kk = g l (finProdFinEquiv (i, ⟨kk, hkk⟩)) := by
          intro l
          simp only [hGdef]
          rw [coeff_sum_C_mul_X_pow, dif_pos hkk]
        have hRc : (OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₃)).toRingHom
            ((R' t i).coeff kk) =
            OkaRing.restrict (hW₅le t) (b t (finProdFinEquiv (i, ⟨kk, hkk⟩))) := by
          have hsymm : finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (i, (⟨kk, hkk⟩ : Fin d))) =
              (i, ⟨kk, hkk⟩) := Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
          simp only [hbdef, hsymm]
          rfl
        rw [hRc, hc' t (finProdFinEquiv (i, ⟨kk, hkk⟩))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
        rw [hGc l]
      · have hR0 : (R' t i).coeff kk = 0 :=
          Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by have := hR'deg t i; omega)
        have hG0 : ∀ l, (G l i).coeff kk = 0 := by
          intro l
          simp only [hGdef]
          rw [coeff_sum_C_mul_X_pow, dif_neg hkk]
        rw [hR0, map_zero]
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ ↦ ?_).symm
        rw [hG0 l, map_zero, mul_zero]
    have hyW₅e : ∀ t, y ∈ (W₅ t).extend' := fun t ↦ Opens.mem_extend'.mpr (hy'W₅ t)
    
    have hκexpand : ∀ t i, polyIncl (κ t i) =
        ∑ l, OkaRing.germ (hyW₅e t) (OkaRing.pullbackInit (W₅ t) (c' t l)) *
          OkaRing.germ hyV₁e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁ (G l i)) := by
      intro t i
      have h11 : polyIncl (κ t i) =
          OkaRing.germ hyV₃e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₃ (R' t i)) := by
        rw [OkaRing.germ_toOkaRing hyV₃e (R' t i)]
        have h12 : OkaRing.germPoly (Opens.mem_extend'.mp hyV₃e) (y (Fin.last n)) (R' t i) =
            ((κ t i : Polynomial.degreeLT (LocalOkaRing (Fin n)) d) :
              (LocalOkaRing (Fin n))[X]) := hR'germ t i
        rw [h12]
        rfl
      have h13 : OkaRing.germ hyV₃e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₃ (R' t i)) =
          OkaRing.germ (hyW₅e t) (Polynomial.toOkaRing (W₅ t)
            ((R' t i).map (OkaRing.restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₃)).toRingHom)) := by
        rw [Polynomial.toOkaRing_map_restrict ((hW₅le t).trans hV₅V₃) (R' t i),
          OkaRing.germ_restrict]
      rw [h11, h13, hpoly t i, map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, Polynomial.toOkaRing_C, Polynomial.toOkaRing_map_restrict,
        OkaRing.germ_restrict]
    
    have hEsum : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ hy (a i) =
        ∑ l, (∑ t, cg t * OkaRing.germ (hyW₅e t) (OkaRing.pullbackInit (W₅ t) (c' t l))) *
          OkaRing.germ hyV₁e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁ (G l i)) := by
      intro i
      have h14 := congrFun hsum i
      rw [Finset.sum_apply] at h14
      have h15 : ∀ t, (cg t • (κs t : Fin p → LocalOkaRing (Fin (n + 1)))) i =
          cg t * polyIncl (κ t i) := by
        intro t
        rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        congr 1
        rw [← hκval t]
        rfl
      rw [← h14, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ h15 t,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ by rw [hκexpand t i, Finset.mul_sum],
        Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
      ring
    
    choose O hyO CC hCC using fun l : Fin k ↦
      LocalOkaRing.exists_okaRing_germ
        (∑ t, cg t * OkaRing.germ (hyW₅e t) (OkaRing.pullbackInit (W₅ t) (c' t l))) y
    set W'' : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) := W ⊓ Finset.univ.inf O with hW''def
    have hyW'' : y ∈ W'' := ⟨hy, Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun l _ ↦ hyO l⟩
    have hW''W : W'' ≤ W := inf_le_left
    have hW''O : ∀ l, W'' ≤ O l := fun l ↦
      le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ l))
    have hW''V₁e : W'' ≤ V₁.extend' := hW''W.trans hW
    have hgermfinal : ∀ i, OkaRing.germ hyW'' (OkaRing.restrict hW''W (a i)) =
        OkaRing.germ hyW''
          (∑ l, OkaRing.restrict (hW''O l) (CC l) *
            OkaRing.restrict hW''V₁e (Polynomial.toOkaRing V₁ (G l i))) := by
      intro i
      rw [OkaRing.germ_restrict, map_sum, hEsum i]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_mul, OkaRing.germ_restrict, OkaRing.germ_restrict, hCC l]
    choose W₆ hW₆le hyW₆ hres using fun i ↦
      OkaRing.exists_restrict_eq_of_germ_eq hyW'' (hgermfinal i)
    set W' : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) := W'' ⊓ Finset.univ.inf W₆ with hW'def
    have hyW' : y ∈ W' := ⟨hyW'', Opens.mem_finset_inf.mpr fun i _ ↦ hyW₆ i⟩
    have hW'W₆ : ∀ i, W' ≤ W₆ i := fun i ↦
      le_trans inf_le_right (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
    refine ⟨W', (inf_le_left : W' ≤ W'').trans hW''W, hyW',
      fun l ↦ OkaRing.restrict ((inf_le_left : W' ≤ W'').trans (hW''O l)) (CC l),
      fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    have h16 := congrArg (OkaRing.restrict (hW'W₆ i)) (hres i)
    simp only [OkaRing.restrict_restrict, map_sum, map_mul] at h16
    exact h16

name: okaRowStatement_succ
statement: theorem okaRowStatement_succ (hn : ∀ q, OkaStatement q n) : OkaRowStatement (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices H : ∀ (p : ℕ) (U : Opens (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)), 0 ∈ U → ∀ f : Fin p → OkaRing U,
      OkaRowConclusion U f 0 by
    intro p U f x hx
    exact OkaRowConclusion.of_shift (H p (U.shift x) (by simpa using hx) _)
  intro p
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    
    intro U h0 f
    exact ⟨U, le_rfl, 0, fun l ↦ l.elim0, h0, fun l ↦ l.elim0,
