      · rw [uniformizationMap_snd, uniformizationMap_snd]; simp only [P, D] at hP hD
        rw [hP, hD]
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ := (h.fibre τ₁ τ₂).mp hπ
    exact (hinv γ hγ τ₁).symm
  obtain ⟨ι, hιm, hιψ⟩ := U.exists_iota
  have hιPD : ∀ τ, P (ι • τ) = P τ ∧ D (ι • τ) = -D τ := fun τ ↦ by
    have := wpΨ_derΨ_smul U (Or.inr rfl) (zero_mem _) (fun τ ↦ by rw [hιψ]; ring) τ
    simpa using this
  have hγPD : ∀ γ ∈ U.pmDeck, ∀ τ, (P (γ • τ) = P τ ∧ D (γ • τ) = D τ) ∨
      (P (γ • τ) = P τ ∧ D (γ • τ) = -D τ) := by
    rintro γ ⟨ε, hε, l, hl, hγ⟩ τ
    have := wpΨ_derΨ_smul U hε hl hγ τ
    rcases hε with rfl | rfl
    · left; simpa using this
    · right; simpa using this
  
  set gp : ℍ → ℂ := fun τ ↦ g τ + g (ι • τ)
  set gm : ℍ → ℂ := fun τ ↦ (g τ - g (ι • τ)) * D τ
  have hgpinv : Unif.PmInvariant (U := U) gp := by
    intro γ hγ τ
    rcases hγPD γ hγ τ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · simp only [gp]
      rw [hfib _ _ h1 h2, hfib (ι • γ • τ) (ι • τ) (by rw [(hιPD _).1, (hιPD _).1, h1])
        (by rw [(hιPD _).2, (hιPD _).2, h2])]
    · simp only [gp]
      rw [hfib (γ • τ) (ι • τ) (by rw [(hιPD _).1, h1]) (by rw [(hιPD _).2, h2]),
        hfib (ι • γ • τ) τ (by rw [(hιPD _).1, h1]) (by rw [(hιPD _).2, h2, neg_neg]), add_comm]
  have hgminv : Unif.PmInvariant (U := U) gm := by
    intro γ hγ τ
    rcases hγPD γ hγ τ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · simp only [gm]
      rw [hfib _ _ h1 h2, hfib (ι • γ • τ) (ι • τ) (by rw [(hιPD _).1, (hιPD _).1, h1])
        (by rw [(hιPD _).2, (hιPD _).2, h2]), h2]
    · simp only [gm]
      rw [hfib (γ • τ) (ι • τ) (by rw [(hιPD _).1, h1]) (by rw [(hιPD _).2, h2]),
        hfib (ι • γ • τ) τ (by rw [(hιPD _).1, h1]) (by rw [(hιPD _).2, h2, neg_neg]), h2]
      ring
  
  have hxP : ∀ τ, 2 + ‖x τ‖ ≤ (1 + ‖(C.u⁻¹ : ℂ) ^ 2‖ * (1 + ‖C.r‖)) * (2 + ‖P τ‖) := by
    intro τ
    have e : x τ = (C.u⁻¹ : ℂ) ^ 2 * (P τ - C.r) := uniformizationMap_fst τ
    rw [e, norm_mul]
    have h0 := norm_nonneg ((C.u⁻¹ : ℂ) ^ 2)
    have h1 := norm_nonneg (P τ)
    have h2 := norm_nonneg C.r
    have h3 : ‖P τ - C.r‖ ≤ (1 + ‖C.r‖) * (2 + ‖P τ‖) := by
      have := norm_sub_le (P τ) C.r
      nlinarith
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h0
    nlinarith
  have hxι : ∀ τ, x (ι • τ) = x τ := fun τ ↦ by
    simp only [x]; rw [uniformizationMap_fst, uniformizationMap_fst]
    exact congrArg (fun w ↦ (C.u⁻¹ : ℂ) ^ 2 * (w - C.r)) (hιPD τ).1
  have hbι : PolyBdd x fun τ ↦ ‖g (ι • τ)‖ := by
    obtain ⟨c, N, hc⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨c, N, fun τ ↦ by have := hc (ι • τ); rwa [hxι] at this⟩
  have hD : PolyBdd P fun τ ↦ ‖D τ‖ := by
    refine ((PolyBdd.const 1).add (PolyBdd.poly_eval (h₀ := P) (cubic (Lt t)))).mono
      fun τ ↦ ?_
    have hsq : D τ ^ 2 = (cubic (Lt t)).eval (P τ) := by
      rw [cubic_eval]; exact (Lt t).derivWeierstrassP_sq _ (U.ψ_notMem τ)
    have : ‖D τ‖ ^ 2 = ‖(cubic (Lt t)).eval (P τ)‖ := by rw [← hsq, norm_pow]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (D τ)]
  have hbP : PolyBdd P fun τ ↦ ‖g τ‖ := hb.of_le hxP
  have hbιP : PolyBdd P fun τ ↦ ‖g (ι • τ)‖ := hbι.of_le hxP
  obtain ⟨Pp, hPp⟩ : ∃ Pp : ℂ[X], ∀ τ, gp τ = Pp.eval (P τ) := by
    have hgpb : PolyBdd P fun τ ↦ ‖gp τ‖ :=
      (hbP.add hbιP).mono fun τ ↦ (norm_add_le (g τ) (g (ι • τ)))
    obtain ⟨c, N, hc⟩ := hgpb
    exact eq_poly_of_bound hgpinv (DifferentiableOn.add hg (hg.comp_smul ι)) hc
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPm⟩ : ∃ Pm : ℂ[X], ∀ τ, gm τ = Pm.eval (P τ) := by
    have hgmb : PolyBdd P fun τ ↦ ‖gm τ‖ := ((hbP.add hbιP).mul hD
      (fun τ ↦ add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (fun τ ↦ norm_nonneg _)).mono
        fun τ ↦ by
          simp only [gm, norm_mul, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.add_apply]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_sub_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨c, N, hc⟩ := hgmb
    exact eq_poly_of_bound hgminv
      (DifferentiableOn.mul (DifferentiableOn.sub hg (hg.comp_smul ι)) (holH_derΨ U)) hc
  
  have hsq : ∀ τ, D τ ^ 2 = (cubic (Lt t)).eval (P τ) := fun τ ↦ by
    rw [cubic_eval]; exact (Lt t).derivWeierstrassP_sq _ (U.ψ_notMem τ)
  have hroots : ∀ e ∈ E₂ (Lt t), Pm.IsRoot e := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := wpΨ_surjective U e
    have hD0 : D τ = 0 := by
      have h1 := hsq τ
      rw [show P τ = e from hτ, cubic_eval, (mem_E₂ _).mp he] at h1
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff (two_ne_zero) |>.mp h1
    have := hPm τ
    simp only [gm, hD0, mul_zero] at this
    rw [IsRoot, ← show P τ = e from hτ]; exact this.symm
  have hdvd : cubic (Lt t) ∣ Pm := by
    by_cases hPm0 : Pm = 0
    · rw [hPm0]; exact dvd_zero _
    have hdeg : (cubic (Lt t)).natDegree = 3 := by rw [cubic]; compute_degree!
    have hcard : Multiset.card (cubic (Lt t)).roots = (cubic (Lt t)).natDegree := by
      rw [IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree]
    have hnd : (cubic (Lt t)).roots.Nodup := by
      rw [← Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup, hcard, hdeg]
      exact card_E₂ hΔ
    have hle : (cubic (Lt t)).roots ≤ Pm.roots :=
      (Multiset.le_iff_subset hnd).mpr fun e he ↦ (mem_roots hPm0).mpr
        (hroots e (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr he))
    have hprod := (Multiset.prod_X_sub_C_dvd_iff_le_roots hPm0 _).mpr hle
    rw [← C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C hcard, C_mul_dvd
      (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (cubic_ne_zero _))]
    exact hprod
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hdvd
  
  obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (E₂ (Lt t))
  obtain ⟨τ₁, hτ₁⟩ := wpΨ_surjective U w₁
  have hD1 : D τ₁ ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    hw₁ (hτ₁ ▸ (derivWeierstrassP_eq_zero_iff (U.ψ_notMem τ₁)).mp h0)
  have hodd : ∀ τ, g τ - g (ι • τ) = D τ * R.eval (P τ) := by
    have hF : Unif.HolH fun τ ↦ g τ - g (ι • τ) - D τ * R.eval (P τ) :=
      DifferentiableOn.sub (DifferentiableOn.sub hg (hg.comp_smul ι))
        (DifferentiableOn.mul (holH_derΨ U) (holH_poly_wpΨ U R))
    intro τ
    refine sub_eq_zero.mp (Unif.HolH.eq_zero_of_mul hF (holH_derΨ U) (fun σ ↦ ?_) hD1 τ)
    have h1 := hPm σ
    have h2 := hsq σ
    simp only [gm] at h1
    rw [hR, eval_mul] at h1
    linear_combination h1 - R.eval (P σ) * h2
  
  set X' : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing := (C.u : ℂ) ^ 2 • xA W + algebraMap ℂ _ C.r
  set Y' : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing :=
    (2 : ℂ) • ((C.u : ℂ) ^ 3 • yA W + (C.s * (C.u : ℂ) ^ 2) • xA W + algebraMap ℂ _ C.t)
  refine ⟨(1 / 2 : ℂ) • (aeval X' Pp + Y' * aeval X' R), fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  set cf := coordFun W (fun τ ↦ (uniformizationMap t C τ).1)
    (fun τ ↦ (uniformizationMap t C τ).2) h.mem
  have hX' : cf X' τ = P τ := by
    simp only [X', cf, map_add, map_smul, AlgHom.commutes, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      coordFun_xA, smul_eq_mul, Pi.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
    exact (wpΨ_eq τ).symm
  have hY' : cf Y' τ = D τ := by
    simp only [Y', cf, map_add, map_smul, AlgHom.commutes, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      coordFun_xA, coordFun_yA, smul_eq_mul, Pi.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
      RingHom.id_apply]
    exact (derΨ_eq (C := C) τ).symm
  have hA : ∀ p : ℂ[X], cf (aeval X' p) τ = p.eval (P τ) := fun p ↦ by
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_pi_apply, hX']
  simp only [map_smul, map_add, map_mul, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hA, hY',
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← hPp τ, ← hodd τ]
  simp only [gp]
  ring

name: Uniformization.FEt.pt_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pt_apply (ι₀ : A →ₐ[ℂ] (ℍ → ℂ)) (τ : ℍ) (a : A) : pt ι₀ τ a = ι₀ a τ
proof: := rfl

name: Uniformization.FEt.Over.apply_aeval
statement:
theorem Over.apply_aeval {χ : A →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ} (ψ : Over B χ) (b₀ : B) (P : A[X]) :
    ψ.1 (aeval b₀ P) = (P.map (χ : A →+* ℂ)).eval (ψ.1 b₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, eval_map]
  have := Polynomial.hom_eval₂ P (algebraMap A B) (ψ.1 : B →+* ℂ) b₀
  rw [RingHom.coe_coe] at this
  rw [this]
  congr 1
  ext a
  exact ψ.2 a

name: Uniformization.FEt.Over.ext_of_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext b
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := (Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval A b₀ ▸ hpres b :
    algebraMap A B δ * b ∈ (aeval b₀).range)
  have h1 := congrArg ψ.1 hP
  have h2 := congrArg ψ'.1 hP
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe] at h1 h2
  rw [Over.apply_aeval, map_mul, ψ.2] at h1
  rw [Over.apply_aeval, map_mul, ψ'.2] at h2
  rw [h] at h1
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hδ (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: Uniformization.FEt.Over.isRoot
statement:
theorem Over.isRoot {χ : A →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ} (ψ : Over B χ) {b₀ : B} {F : A[X]} (hF : aeval b₀ F = 0) :
    (F.map (χ : A →+* ℂ)).IsRoot (ψ.1 b₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRoot, ← Over.apply_aeval, hF, map_zero]

name: Uniformization.FEt.exists_local
statement:
theorem exists_local (hhol : ∀ a, Unif.HolH (ι₀ a)) {n : ℕ}
    (hcount : ∀ τ, Nat.card (Over B (pt ι₀ τ)) = n) (τ₀ : ℍ) {b₀ : B} {F : A[X]} {δ : A}
    (hFm : F.Monic) (hFn : F.natDegree = n) (hF : aeval b₀ F = 0) (hδ : ι₀ δ τ₀ ≠ 0)
    (hpres : ∀ b, algebraMap A B δ * b ∈ Algebra.adjoin A {b₀}) :
    ∃ O : Set ℂ, IsOpen O ∧ (τ₀ : ℂ) ∈ O ∧ (∀ z ∈ O, 0 < z.im) ∧
      (∀ τ : ℍ, (τ : ℂ) ∈ O → ι₀ δ τ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ r : Fin n → ℂ → ℂ, (∀ j, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (r j) O) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ O, Function.Injective fun j ↦ r j z) ∧
        (∀ τ : ℍ, (τ : ℂ) ∈ O → ∀ ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ), ∃ j, ψ.1 b₀ = r j τ) ∧
        ∀ τ : ℍ, (τ : ℂ) ∈ O → ∀ j, ∃ ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ), ψ.1 b₀ = r j τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set p : ℂ → ℂ[X] := fun z ↦ F.map (pt ι₀ (ofComplex z) : A →+* ℂ)
  have hpm : ∀ z, (p z).Monic := fun z ↦ hFm.map _
  have hpn : ∀ z, (p z).natDegree = n := fun z ↦ by rw [(hFm.natDegree_map _), hFn]
  have hpa : ∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦ (p z).coeff i) τ₀ := by
    intro i
    simp only [p, coeff_map]
    exact (hhol (F.coeff i)).analyticAt (isOpen_upper.mem_nhds τ₀.im_pos)
  have hp₀ : p τ₀ = F.map (pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ) := by simp [p]
  
  have hinj₀ : Function.Injective fun ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ₀) ↦ ψ.1 b₀ :=
    fun ψ ψ' h ↦ Over.ext_of_apply_eq hδ hpres h
  have hsep : (p τ₀).Separable := by
    rw [← nodup_roots_iff_of_splits (hpm _).ne_zero (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
    rw [← Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup]
    apply le_antisymm (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _)
    rw [IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hpn]
    have hmaps : ∀ ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ₀), ψ.1 b₀ ∈ (p τ₀).roots.toFinset := fun ψ ↦ by
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots (hpm _).ne_zero, hp₀]; exact ψ.isRoot hF
    have := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (fun ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ₀) ↦
      (⟨ψ.1 b₀, hmaps ψ⟩ : (p τ₀).roots.toFinset)) (fun ψ ψ' h ↦ hinj₀ (congrArg Subtype.val h))
    rwa [hcount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe] at this
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hτU, r, hra, hr⟩ :=
    Polynomial.exists_analyticOnNhd_eq_prod_X_sub_C_of_separable hpm hpn hpa hsep
  
  have hδc : ContinuousOn (fun z ↦ ι₀ δ (ofComplex z)) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} :=
    (hhol δ).continuousOn
  set O := U ∩ ({z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} ∩ (fun z ↦ ι₀ δ (ofComplex z)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ)
  have hOo : IsOpen O := hUo.inter (hδc.isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_upper isOpen_compl_singleton)
  have hτO : (τ₀ : ℂ) ∈ O := ⟨hτU, τ₀.im_pos, by simpa [ofComplex_apply] using hδ⟩
  have hOi : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 < z.im := fun z hz ↦ hz.2.1
  have hOδ : ∀ τ : ℍ, (τ : ℂ) ∈ O → ι₀ δ τ ≠ 0 := fun τ hτ ↦ by
    have := hτ.2.2
    simpa [ofComplex_apply] using this
  have hpτ : ∀ τ : ℍ, p τ = F.map (pt ι₀ τ : A →+* ℂ) := fun τ ↦ by simp [p]
  have hroot : ∀ τ : ℍ, (τ : ℂ) ∈ O → ∀ ψ : Over B (pt ι₀ τ), ∃ j, ψ.1 b₀ = r j τ := by
    intro τ hτ ψ
    have h1 := ψ.isRoot hF
    rw [← hpτ, (hr τ hτ.1).2, IsRoot, eval_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at h1
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := h1
    exact ⟨j, by simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hj⟩
  refine ⟨O, hOo, hτO, hOi, hOδ, r, fun j ↦ (hra j).mono inter_subset_left,
    fun z hz ↦ (hr z hz.1).1, hroot, fun τ hτ ↦ ?_⟩
  
  choose idx hidx using hroot τ hτ
  have hinj : Function.Injective idx := fun ψ ψ' h ↦
    Over.ext_of_apply_eq (hOδ τ hτ) hpres (by rw [hidx, hidx, h])
  have hbij := hinj.bijective_of_nat_card_le (by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin,
    hcount])
  intro j
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hbij.2 j
  exact ⟨ψ, by rw [hidx, hψ]⟩

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.const
statement: theorem const (c : ℝ) : PolyBdd h₀ fun _ ↦ c
proof: := ⟨c, 0, fun τ ↦ by simp⟩

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.mono
statement: theorem mono {u v : ℍ → ℝ} (hv : PolyBdd h₀ v) (h : ∀ τ, u τ ≤ v τ) : PolyBdd h₀ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, N, hC⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨C, N, fun τ ↦ (h τ).trans (hC τ)⟩

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.add
statement: theorem add {u v : ℍ → ℝ} (hu : PolyBdd h₀ u) (hv : PolyBdd h₀ v) : PolyBdd h₀ (u + v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, N, hC⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨D, M, hD⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨|C| + |D|, N + M, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 + ‖h₀ τ‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (h₀ τ)]
  have hN : (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ N ≤ (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ (N + M) := pow_le_pow_right₀ h1 (by omega)
  have hM : (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ M ≤ (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ (N + M) := pow_le_pow_right₀ h1 (by omega)
  have hp : 0 ≤ (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ N := by positivity
  have hq : 0 ≤ (2 + ‖h₀ τ‖) ^ M := by positivity
  have := hC τ
  have := hD τ
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  nlinarith [le_abs_self C, le_abs_self D, abs_nonneg C, abs_nonneg D]

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.mul
statement:
theorem mul {u v : ℍ → ℝ} (hu : PolyBdd h₀ u) (hv : PolyBdd h₀ v) (hu0 : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ u τ)
    (hv0 : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ v τ) : PolyBdd h₀ (u * v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, N, hC⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨D, M, hD⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨C * D, N + M, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, pow_add]
  have := mul_le_mul (hC τ) (hD τ) (hv0 τ) ((hu0 τ).trans (hC τ))
  linarith

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.prod
statement:
theorem prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {u : ι → ℍ → ℝ} (hu : ∀ i ∈ s, PolyBdd h₀ (u i))
    (hu0 : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ τ, 0 ≤ u i τ) : PolyBdd h₀ fun τ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s, u i τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using const 1
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    simp_rw [Finset.prod_insert hj]
    exact mul (hu j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun i hi ↦ hu i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
        fun i hi ↦ hu0 i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      (hu0 j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      fun τ ↦ Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi ↦ hu0 i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) τ

name: Uniformization.FEt.PolyBdd.sum
statement:
theorem sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {u : ι → ℍ → ℝ} (hu : ∀ i ∈ s, PolyBdd h₀ (u i)) :
    PolyBdd h₀ fun τ ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, u i τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using const 0
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_insert hj]
    exact add (hu j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih fun i hi ↦ hu i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: Uniformization.FEt.Over.transport_coe
statement:
theorem Over.transport_coe {χ χ' : A →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ} (h : χ = χ') (ψ : Over B χ) :
    ⇑(ψ.transport h).1 = ⇑ψ.1
proof: := by subst h; rfl

name: Uniformization.FEt.IsLift.smul
statement:
theorem IsLift.smul {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)} (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ a τ, ι₀ a (γ • τ) = ι₀ a τ)
    {ι : ℍ → B → ℂ} (h : IsLift ι₀ ι) {γ : SL(2, ℝ)} (hγ : γ ∈ Γ) :
    IsLift ι₀ fun τ ↦ ι (γ • τ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun τ ↦ ?_, fun b ↦ (h.cont b).comp (continuous_const_smul γ)⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := h.pt (γ • τ)
  have hpt : FEt.pt ι₀ (γ • τ) = FEt.pt ι₀ τ := AlgHom.ext fun a ↦ hΓ γ hγ a τ
  exact ⟨ψ.transport hpt, by rw [Over.transport_coe, hψ]⟩

name: Uniformization.FEt.IsLift.eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsLift.eq_zero [IsDomain B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] (hinj : Function.Injective ι₀)
    {ι : ℍ → B → ℂ} (h : IsLift ι₀ ι) {b : B} (hb : ∀ τ, ι τ b = 0) : b = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hb0
  haveI : Nontrivial A := ⟨⟨1, 0, fun h ↦ by
    have := congrFun (congrArg ι₀ h) UpperHalfPlane.I; simp at this⟩⟩
  have hint : IsIntegral A b := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral b
  have hGm : (minpoly A b).Monic := minpoly.monic hint
  have hG : aeval b (minpoly A b) = 0 := minpoly.aeval A b
  have hG0 : (minpoly A b).coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := X_dvd_iff.mpr h0
    have hHm : H.Monic := Monic.of_mul_monic_left monic_X (hH ▸ hGm)
    have hHb : aeval b H = 0 := by
      rw [hH, map_mul, aeval_X] at hG
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hG).resolve_left hb0
    have hmin := minpoly.min A b hHm hHb
    rw [hH, mul_comm, degree_mul_X, degree_eq_natDegree hHm.ne_zero] at hmin
    have : ((H.natDegree + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) ≤ (H.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := by
      push_cast; exact hmin
    norm_cast at this
    omega
  apply hG0
  apply hinj
  funext τ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := h.pt τ
  have hdec := divX_mul_X_add (minpoly A b)
  have h1 : aeval b (minpoly A b) = aeval b (divX (minpoly A b)) * b +
      algebraMap A B ((minpoly A b).coeff 0) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hdec]
    simp [map_add, map_mul]
  rw [hG] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg ψ.1 h1
  rw [map_zero, map_add, map_mul, ψ.2, hψ, hb τ, mul_zero, zero_add, pt_apply] at h2
  rw [← h2]
  simp

name: Uniformization.FEt.norm_le_of_isRoot_monic
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_isRoot_monic {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {r : ℂ} (hr : p.IsRoot r) :
    ‖r‖ ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, ‖p.coeff i‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := hr.norm_lt_cauchyBound hp.ne_zero
  have hc : cauchyBound p ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, ‖p.coeff i‖₊) + 1 := by
    rw [cauchyBound, hp.leadingCoeff, nnnorm_one, div_one]
    gcongr
    exact Finset.sup_le fun i hi ↦
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i ↦ ‖p.coeff i‖₊) (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) hi
  have h2 : (‖r‖₊ : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, ‖p.coeff i‖₊) + 1 : NNReal) :=
    NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (h.le.trans hc)
  push_cast at h2
  linarith

name: Uniformization.FEt.exists_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq (hhol : ∀ a, Unif.HolH (ι₀ a)) {n : ℕ}
    (hcount : ∀ τ, Nat.card (Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ)) = n) (hloc : ∀ τ, LocPres ι₀ (B := B) n τ)
    {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)} (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ a τ, ι₀ a (γ • τ) = ι₀ a τ) {h₀ : ℍ → ℂ}
    (hgrowth : ∀ a, PolyBdd h₀ fun τ ↦ ‖ι₀ a τ‖)
    (hpoly : ∀ g : ℍ → ℂ, Unif.HolH g → (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ τ, g (γ • τ) = g τ) →
      PolyBdd h₀ (fun τ ↦ ‖g τ‖) → ∃ a, ∀ τ, ι₀ a τ = g τ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ι₀) {ι ι' : ℍ → B → ℂ} (hι : IsLift ι₀ ι)
    (hιh : ∀ b, Unif.HolH fun τ ↦ ι τ b) (hι' : IsLift ι₀ ι') :
    ∃ γ ∈ Γ, ι' = fun τ ↦ ι (γ • τ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Nontrivial A := ⟨⟨1, 0, fun h ↦ by
    have := congrFun (congrArg ι₀ h) UpperHalfPlane.I; simp at this⟩⟩
  have hcov := isCoveringMap_proj hhol hcount hloc
  set τ₀ := UpperHalfPlane.I
  obtain ⟨b₀, F, δ, hFm, hFn, hF, hδ, hpres⟩ := hloc τ₀
  
  set O : Set (ℍ → B → ℂ) := {f | ∃ γ ∈ Γ, f = fun τ ↦ ι (γ • τ)}
  have hOlift : ∀ f ∈ O, IsLift ι₀ f := by
    rintro f ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩; exact hι.smul hΓ hγ
  have hOhol : ∀ f ∈ O, ∀ b, Unif.HolH fun τ ↦ f τ b := by
    rintro f ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ b; exact (hιh b).comp_smul γ
  have hιO : ι ∈ O := ⟨1, Γ.one_mem, by simp⟩
  
  have hOverinj : Function.Injective fun ψ : Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀) ↦ ψ.1 b₀ :=
    fun ψ ψ' h ↦ Over.ext_of_apply_eq hδ hpres h
  haveI hOverfin : Finite (Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀)) := by
    have hmaps : ∀ ψ : Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀),
        ψ.1 b₀ ∈ (F.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).roots.toFinset := fun ψ ↦ by
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots ((hFm.map _).ne_zero)]; exact ψ.isRoot hF
    exact Finite.of_injective (fun ψ ↦ (⟨ψ.1 b₀, hmaps ψ⟩ :
      (F.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).roots.toFinset))
      fun ψ ψ' h ↦ hOverinj (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  
  choose ψf hψf using fun f : {f // f ∈ O} ↦ (hOlift f.1 f.2).pt τ₀
  have hψfinj : Function.Injective ψf := fun f g h ↦ Subtype.ext
    ((hOlift f.1 f.2).eq hcov (hOlift g.1 g.2) (by rw [← hψf, ← hψf, h]))
  haveI : Finite {f // f ∈ O} := Finite.of_injective ψf hψfinj
  have hOfin : O.Finite := Set.toFinite O
  set S := hOfin.toFinset
  have hS : ∀ f, f ∈ S ↔ f ∈ O := fun f ↦ Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hOfin
  set m := S.card
  
  set P : ℍ → ℂ[X] := fun τ ↦ ∏ f ∈ S, (X - C (f τ b₀))
  have hPinv : ∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ τ, P (γ • τ) = P τ := by
    intro γ hγ τ
    refine Finset.prod_nbij' (fun f τ ↦ f (γ • τ)) (fun f τ ↦ f (γ⁻¹ • τ)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro f hf
      obtain ⟨γ', hγ', rfl⟩ := (hS f).mp hf
      exact (hS _).mpr ⟨γ' * γ, Γ.mul_mem hγ' hγ, by funext τ; simp [mul_smul]⟩
    · intro f hf
      obtain ⟨γ', hγ', rfl⟩ := (hS f).mp hf
      exact (hS _).mpr ⟨γ' * γ⁻¹, Γ.mul_mem hγ' (Γ.inv_mem hγ), by funext τ; simp [mul_smul]⟩
    · intro f _; funext τ; simp
    · intro f _; funext τ; simp
    · intro f _; rfl
  have hPm : ∀ τ, (P τ).Monic := fun τ ↦ monic_prod_X_sub_C _ _
  have hPdeg : ∀ τ, (P τ).natDegree = m := fun τ ↦ natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card _ _
  
  set R : ℍ → ℝ := fun τ ↦ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖ι₀ (F.coeff i) τ‖
  have hR : PolyBdd h₀ R := (PolyBdd.const 1).add (PolyBdd.sum _ fun i _ ↦ hgrowth _)
  have hfR : ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ τ, ‖f τ b₀‖ ≤ R τ := by
    intro f hf τ
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (hOlift f ((hS f).mp hf)).pt τ
    have := norm_le_of_isRoot_monic (hFm.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ : A →+* ℂ)) (ψ.isRoot hF)
    rw [(hFm.natDegree_map _), hFn] at this
    simp only [coeff_map, RingHom.coe_coe, pt_apply] at this
    rw [← hψ]; exact this
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ k, ∃ a : A, ∀ τ, ι₀ a τ = (P τ).coeff k := by
    intro k
    refine hpoly _ ?_ (fun γ hγ τ ↦ by rw [hPinv γ hγ τ]) ?_
    · exact differentiableOn_coeff_prod_X_sub_C S (a := fun f z ↦ f (ofComplex z) b₀)
        (fun f hf ↦ hOhol f ((hS f).mp hf) b₀) k
    · refine (PolyBdd.prod S (u := fun _ τ ↦ 1 + R τ) (fun _ _ ↦ (PolyBdd.const 1).add hR)
        fun _ _ τ ↦ by positivity).mono fun τ ↦ ?_
      refine (norm_coeff_prod_X_sub_C_le _ _ k).trans ?_
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity) fun f hf ↦ by linarith [hfR f hf τ]
  choose a ha using hcoeff
  set Q : A[X] := X ^ m + ∑ i : Fin m, C (a i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)
  have hQm : Q.Monic := monic_X_pow_add (degree_sum_fin_lt _)
  have hQmap : ∀ τ, Q.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ : A →+* ℂ) = P τ := by
    intro τ
    conv_rhs => rw [(hPm τ).as_sum, hPdeg τ, Finset.sum_range]
    simp only [Q, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, Polynomial.map_sum,
      Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, RingHom.coe_coe, pt_apply, ha]
  have hQb : aeval b₀ Q = 0 := by
    refine hι.eq_zero hinj fun τ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hι.pt τ
    rw [← hψ, Over.apply_aeval, hQmap]
    simp only [P, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero ((hS ι).mpr hιO) (by rw [hψ, sub_self])
  
  have hnm : n ≤ m := by
    have hroots : ∀ ψ : Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀),
        ψ.1 b₀ ∈ (Q.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).roots.toFinset := fun ψ ↦ by
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots ((hQm.map _).ne_zero), IsRoot, ← Over.apply_aeval,
        hQb, map_zero]
    have h1 := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (fun ψ : Over B (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀) ↦
      (⟨ψ.1 b₀, hroots ψ⟩ : (Q.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).roots.toFinset))
      fun ψ ψ' h ↦ hOverinj (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    rw [hcount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe] at h1
    calc n ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ Multiset.card (Q.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).roots := Multiset.toFinset_card_le _
      _ ≤ (Q.map (FEt.pt ι₀ τ₀ : A →+* ℂ)).natDegree := card_roots' _
      _ = m := by
        rw [hQm.natDegree_map]
        change (X ^ m + ∑ i : Fin m, C (a i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).natDegree = m
        rw [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt, natDegree_X_pow]
        exact (degree_sum_fin_lt _).trans_eq (degree_X_pow m).symm
  have hmO : m = Nat.card {f // f ∈ O} := by
    rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card O hOfin]
  have hbij := hψfinj.bijective_of_nat_card_le (by rw [hcount, ← hmO]; exact hnm)
  obtain ⟨ψ', hψ'⟩ := hι'.pt τ₀
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hbij.2 ψ'
  have hfeq : f.1 = ι' := (hOlift f.1 f.2).eq hcov hι' (by rw [← hψf, hf, hψ'])
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hfγ⟩ := f.2
  exact ⟨γ, hγ, hfeq.symm.trans hfγ⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.eq_cx_cy
statement: theorem eq_cx_cy (z : ℂ) : z = cx t z + cy t z * (t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := t.im_pos.ne'
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [cx, cy, add_re, ofReal_re, mul_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
      UpperHalfPlane.coe_re]; ring
  · simp only [cx, cy, add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, zero_add, zero_mul, add_zero,
      UpperHalfPlane.coe_im]
    field_simp

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_add
statement: theorem cy_add (z w : ℂ) : cy t (z + w) = cy t z + cy t w
proof: := by simp [cy, add_div]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_add
statement: theorem cx_add (z w : ℂ) : cx t (z + w) = cx t z + cx t w
proof:
:= by
  simp [cx, cy_add]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_smul
statement: theorem cy_smul (a : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : cy t (a • z) = a * cy t z
proof:
:= by
  simp [cy, mul_div_assoc]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_smul
statement: theorem cx_smul (a : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : cx t (a • z) = a * cx t z
proof:
:= by
  unfold cx; rw [cy_smul]; simp; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_one
statement: theorem cy_one : cy t 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [cy]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_one
statement: theorem cx_one : cx t 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [cx, cy]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_t
statement: theorem cy_t : cy t t = 1
proof: := by simp [cy, t.im_pos.ne']

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_t
statement: theorem cx_t : cx t t = 0
proof: := by simp [cx, cy, t.im_pos.ne']

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_neg
statement: theorem cy_neg (z : ℂ) : cy t (-z) = -cy t z
proof: := by simp [cy, neg_div]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_neg
statement: theorem cx_neg (z : ℂ) : cx t (-z) = -cx t z
proof: := by simp [cx, cy_neg]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_sub
statement: theorem cy_sub (z w : ℂ) : cy t (z - w) = cy t z - cy t w
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, cy_add, cy_neg]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_sub
statement: theorem cx_sub (z w : ℂ) : cx t (z - w) = cx t z - cx t w
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, cx_add, cx_neg]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.continuous_cy
statement: theorem continuous_cy : Continuous (cy t)
proof: := by unfold cy; fun_prop

name: Uniformization.Generators.continuous_cx
statement: theorem continuous_cx : Continuous (cx t)
proof: := by unfold cx cy; fun_prop

name: Uniformization.Generators.ext_cx_cy
statement: theorem ext_cx_cy {z w : ℂ} (h1 : cx t z = cx t w) (h2 : cy t z = cy t w) : z = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_cx_cy t z, eq_cx_cy t w, h1, h2]

name: Uniformization.Generators.mem_lattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_lattice_iff (z : ℂ) :
    z ∈ (Lt t).lattice ↔ ∃ m n : ℤ, cy t z = m ∧ cx t z = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodPair.mem_lattice]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨m, n, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₁, Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₂,
        mul_one]
      rw [cy_add, show ((m : ℂ) * t) = (m : ℝ) • (t : ℂ) by simp,
        show ((n : ℂ)) = (n : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) by simp, cy_smul, cy_smul, cy_t, cy_one]; ring
    · simp only [Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₁, Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₂,
        mul_one]
      rw [cx_add, show ((m : ℂ) * t) = (m : ℝ) • (t : ℂ) by simp,
        show ((n : ℂ)) = (n : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) by simp, cx_smul, cx_smul, cx_t, cx_one]; ring
  · rintro ⟨m, n, hm, hn⟩
    refine ⟨m, n, ?_⟩
    simp only [Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₁, Heights.periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane_ω₂,
      mul_one]
    rw [eq_cx_cy t z, hm, hn]; push_cast; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.one_mem
statement: theorem one_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ (Lt t).lattice
proof: := (Lt t).ω₂_mem_lattice

name: Uniformization.Generators.t_mem
statement: theorem t_mem : (t : ℂ) ∈ (Lt t).lattice
proof: := (Lt t).ω₁_mem_lattice

name: Uniformization.Generators.convex_K₁
statement: theorem convex_K₁ : Convex ℝ (K₁ t)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨h5, h6, h7, h8⟩ := hw
  simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_smul, cy_smul]
  refine ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith, ?_⟩
  rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
  · constructor <;> nlinarith
  · subst ha'; rw [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simpa using ⟨h7, h8⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.convex_K₂
statement: theorem convex_K₂ : Convex ℝ (K₂ t)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨h5, h6, h7, h8⟩ := hw
  simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_smul, cy_smul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, by positivity, by nlinarith⟩
  · rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
    · nlinarith
    · subst ha'; rw [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simpa using h5
  · rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
    · nlinarith
    · subst ha'; rw [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simpa using h6

name: Uniformization.Generators.K_notMem_lattice
statement: theorem K_notMem_lattice {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) : k ∉ (Lt t).lattice
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_lattice_iff]
  rintro ⟨m, n, hm, hn⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  · rw [hm] at h3 h4
    have : (0 : ℤ) < m := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have : m < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h4
    omega
  · rw [hn] at h1 h2
    have : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have : n < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega

name: Uniformization.Generators.K_subset
statement: theorem K_subset : K t ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ
proof: := fun _ hk ↦ K_notMem_lattice t hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_c₀
statement: theorem cx_c₀ : cx t (c₀ t) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [c₀, show (1 + (t : ℂ)) / 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (t : ℂ) by
      rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul]; push_cast; ring,
    cx_add, cx_smul, cx_smul, cx_one, cx_t]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_c₀
statement: theorem cy_c₀ : cy t (c₀ t) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [c₀, show (1 + (t : ℂ)) / 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (t : ℂ) by
      rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul]; push_cast; ring,
    cy_add, cy_smul, cy_smul, cy_one, cy_t]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.c₀_mem₁
statement: theorem c₀_mem₁ : c₀ t ∈ K₁ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_c₀, cy_c₀]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.c₀_mem₂
statement: theorem c₀_mem₂ : c₀ t ∈ K₂ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_c₀, cy_c₀]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_mem_K
statement:
theorem exists_mem_K {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∉ (Lt t).lattice) :
    ∃ k ∈ K t, w - k ∈ (Lt t).lattice
proof:
:= by
  set k : ℂ := (Int.fract (cx t w) : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (Int.fract (cy t w) : ℝ) • (t : ℂ)
  have hkx : cx t k = Int.fract (cx t w) := by
    simp only [k, cx_add, cx_smul, cx_one, cx_t]; ring
  have hky : cy t k = Int.fract (cy t w) := by
    simp only [k, cy_add, cy_smul, cy_one, cy_t]; ring
  have hdiff : w - k ∈ (Lt t).lattice := by
    rw [mem_lattice_iff]
    refine ⟨⌊cy t w⌋, ⌊cx t w⌋, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [cy_sub, hky, Int.fract]; ring
    · rw [cx_sub, hkx, Int.fract]; ring
  refine ⟨k, ?_, hdiff⟩
  have hx0 := Int.fract_nonneg (cx t w)
  have hx1 := Int.fract_lt_one (cx t w)
  have hy0 := Int.fract_nonneg (cy t w)
  have hy1 := Int.fract_lt_one (cy t w)
  rcases hx0.lt_or_eq with hx | hx
  · right; exact ⟨hkx ▸ hx, hkx ▸ hx1, hky ▸ hy0, hky ▸ hy1.le⟩
  rcases hy0.lt_or_eq with hy | hy
  · left; exact ⟨hkx ▸ hx0, hkx ▸ hx1.le, hky ▸ hy, hky ▸ hy1⟩
  exfalso
  have hc0 : cy t 0 = 0 := by simp [cy]
  have hk0 : k = 0 := ext_cx_cy t (by rw [hkx, ← hx]; simp [cx, hc0])
    (by rw [hky, ← hy, hc0])
  rw [hk0, sub_zero] at hdiff
  exact hw hdiff

name: Uniformization.Generators.K₁_subset
statement: theorem K₁_subset : K₁ t ⊆ K t
proof: := subset_union_left

name: Uniformization.Generators.K₂_subset
statement: theorem K₂_subset : K₂ t ⊆ K t
proof: := subset_union_right

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_e₀
statement: theorem ψ_e₀ : U.ψ (e₀ U) = c₀ t
proof:
:=
  (U.surj (c₀ t) (K_notMem_lattice t (K₁_subset (c₀_mem₁ t)))).choose_spec

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_s
statement:
theorem exists_s (C : Set ℂ) (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hCK : C ⊆ K t) (hc₀ : c₀ t ∈ C) :
    ∃ s : ℂ → ℍ, ContinuousOn s C ∧ (∀ k ∈ C, U.ψ (s k) = k) ∧ s (c₀ t) = e₀ U
proof:
:=
  U.covering.exists_lift_of_convex hC continuousOn_id (fun _ hk ↦ K_subset t (hCK hk)) hc₀
    (ψ_e₀ U)

name: Uniformization.Generators.s₁_spec
statement:
theorem s₁_spec : ContinuousOn (s₁ U) (K₁ t) ∧ (∀ k ∈ K₁ t, U.ψ (s₁ U k) = k) ∧
    s₁ U (c₀ t) = e₀ U
proof: := (exists_s U _ (convex_K₁ t) K₁_subset (c₀_mem₁ t)).choose_spec

name: Uniformization.Generators.s₂_spec
statement:
theorem s₂_spec : ContinuousOn (s₂ U) (K₂ t) ∧ (∀ k ∈ K₂ t, U.ψ (s₂ U k) = k) ∧
    s₂ U (c₀ t) = e₀ U
proof: := (exists_s U _ (convex_K₂ t) K₂_subset (c₀_mem₂ t)).choose_spec

name: Uniformization.Generators.s₁_eq_s₂
statement: theorem s₁_eq_s₂ : EqOn (s₁ U) (s₂ U) (K₁ t ∩ K₂ t)
proof:
:=
  U.covering.eqOn_of_lift ((convex_K₁ t).inter (convex_K₂ t)).isPreconnected
    ((s₁_spec U).1.mono inter_subset_left) ((s₂_spec U).1.mono inter_subset_right)
    (fun k hk ↦ by
      change U.ψ (s₁ U k) ∈ _
      rw [(s₁_spec U).2.1 k hk.1]; exact K_subset t (K₁_subset hk.1))
    (fun k hk ↦ by
      change U.ψ (s₁ U k) = U.ψ (s₂ U k)
      rw [(s₁_spec U).2.1 k hk.1, (s₂_spec U).2.1 k hk.2])
    ⟨c₀_mem₁ t, c₀_mem₂ t⟩ ((s₁_spec U).2.2.trans (s₂_spec U).2.2.symm)

name: Uniformization.Generators.sK_of_mem₁
statement: theorem sK_of_mem₁ {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K₁ t) : sK U k = s₁ U k
proof: := by simp [sK, hk]

name: Uniformization.Generators.sK_of_mem₂
statement: theorem sK_of_mem₂ {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K₂ t) : sK U k = s₂ U k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : k ∈ K₁ t
  · rw [sK_of_mem₁ U h]; exact s₁_eq_s₂ U ⟨h, hk⟩
  · simp [sK, h]

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_sK
statement: theorem ψ_sK {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) : U.ψ (sK U k) = k
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · rw [sK_of_mem₁ U hk]; exact (s₁_spec U).2.1 k hk
  · rw [sK_of_mem₂ U hk]; exact (s₂_spec U).2.1 k hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.continuousOn_sK₁
statement: theorem continuousOn_sK₁ : ContinuousOn (sK U) (K₁ t)
proof:
:=
  (s₁_spec U).1.congr fun _ hk ↦ sK_of_mem₁ U hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.continuousOn_sK₂
statement: theorem continuousOn_sK₂ : ContinuousOn (sK U) (K₂ t)
proof:
:=
  (s₂_spec U).1.congr fun _ hk ↦ sK_of_mem₂ U hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.sK_c₀
statement: theorem sK_c₀ : sK U (c₀ t) = e₀ U
proof: := by rw [sK_of_mem₁ U (c₀_mem₁ t)]; exact (s₁_spec U).2.2

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_pL
statement: theorem cx_pL : cx t (pL t) = 0
proof: := by rw [pL, cx_smul, cx_t, mul_zero]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_pL
statement: theorem cy_pL : cy t (pL t) = 1 / 2
proof: := by rw [pL, cy_smul, cy_t, mul_one]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_pB
statement: theorem cx_pB : cx t pB = 1 / 2
proof: := by rw [pB, cx_smul, cx_one, mul_one]

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_pB
statement: theorem cy_pB : cy t pB = 0
proof: := by rw [pB, cy_smul, cy_one, mul_zero]

name: Uniformization.Generators.pL_mem
statement: theorem pL_mem : pL t ∈ K₁ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_pL, cy_pL]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.pL_add_mem
statement: theorem pL_add_mem : pL t + 1 ∈ K₁ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_pL, cy_pL, cx_one, cy_one]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.pB_mem
statement: theorem pB_mem : pB ∈ K₂ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_pB, cy_pB]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.pB_add_mem
statement: theorem pB_add_mem : pB + t ∈ K₂ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_pB, cy_pB, cx_t, cy_t]; norm_num

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_A
statement: theorem exists_A : ∃ A ∈ U.deckGroup, A • sK U (pL t) = sK U (pL t + 1)
proof:
:=
  U.exists_mem_deckGroup (by
    rw [ψ_sK U (K₁_subset pL_add_mem), ψ_sK U (K₁_subset pL_mem), add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact one_mem t)

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_B
statement: theorem exists_B : ∃ B ∈ U.deckGroup, B • sK U pB = sK U (pB + t)
proof:
:=
  U.exists_mem_deckGroup (by
    rw [ψ_sK U (K₂_subset pB_add_mem), ψ_sK U (K₂_subset pB_mem), add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact t_mem t)

name: Uniformization.Generators.A_mem
statement: theorem A_mem : A U ∈ U.deckGroup
proof: := (exists_A U).choose_spec.1

name: Uniformization.Generators.A_smul_pL
statement: theorem A_smul_pL : A U • sK U (pL t) = sK U (pL t + 1)
proof: := (exists_A U).choose_spec.2

name: Uniformization.Generators.B_smul_pB
statement: theorem B_smul_pB : B U • sK U pB = sK U (pB + t)
proof: := (exists_B U).choose_spec.2

name: Uniformization.Generators.B_mem
statement: theorem B_mem : B U ∈ U.deckGroup
proof: := (exists_B U).choose_spec.1

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_A_smul
statement: theorem ψ_A_smul (τ : ℍ) : U.ψ (A U • τ) = U.ψ τ + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, h⟩ := A_mem U
  have h0 := h (sK U (pL t))
  rw [A_smul_pL] at h0
  change U.ψ (sK U (pL t + 1)) = _ at h0
  rw [ψ_sK U (K₁_subset pL_add_mem), ψ_sK U (K₁_subset pL_mem)] at h0
  have : l = 1 := by linear_combination -h0
  rw [h, this]

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_B_smul
statement: theorem ψ_B_smul (τ : ℍ) : U.ψ (B U • τ) = U.ψ τ + t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, h⟩ := B_mem U
  have h0 := h (sK U pB)
  rw [B_smul_pB] at h0
  change U.ψ (sK U (pB + t)) = _ at h0
  rw [ψ_sK U (K₂_subset pB_add_mem), ψ_sK U (K₂_subset pB_mem)] at h0
  have : l = t := by linear_combination -h0
  rw [h, this]

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_A_inv_smul
statement: theorem ψ_A_inv_smul (τ : ℍ) : U.ψ ((A U)⁻¹ • τ) = U.ψ τ - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := ψ_A_smul U ((A U)⁻¹ • τ); rw [smul_inv_smul] at this; rw [this]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.ψ_B_inv_smul
statement: theorem ψ_B_inv_smul (τ : ℍ) : U.ψ ((B U)⁻¹ • τ) = U.ψ τ - t
proof:
:= by
  have := ψ_B_smul U ((B U)⁻¹ • τ); rw [smul_inv_smul] at this; rw [this]; ring

name: Uniformization.Generators.convex_EL
statement: theorem convex_EL : Convex ℝ (EL t)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz; obtain ⟨h4, h5, h6⟩ := hw
  simp only [EL, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_smul, cy_smul, h1, h4, mul_zero, add_zero,
    true_and]
  rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
  · constructor <;> nlinarith
  · subst ha'; rw [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simpa using ⟨h5, h6⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.convex_EB
statement: theorem convex_EB : Convex ℝ (EB t)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz; obtain ⟨h4, h5, h6⟩ := hw
  simp only [EB, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_smul, cy_smul, h1, h4, mul_zero, add_zero,
    true_and]
  rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
  · constructor <;> nlinarith
  · subst ha'; rw [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simpa using ⟨h5, h6⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.EL_subset
statement: theorem EL_subset {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ EL t) : z ∈ K₁ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz; exact ⟨h1.ge, by rw [h1]; norm_num, h2, h3⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.EL_add_subset
statement: theorem EL_add_subset {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ EL t) : z + 1 ∈ K₁ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz
  simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, h1, cx_one, cy_one]; norm_num; exact ⟨h2, h3⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.EB_subset
statement: theorem EB_subset {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ EB t) : z ∈ K₂ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz; exact ⟨h2, h3, h1.ge, by rw [h1]; norm_num⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.EB_add_subset
statement: theorem EB_add_subset {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ EB t) : z + t ∈ K₂ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz
  simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, h1, cx_t, cy_t]; norm_num; exact ⟨h2, h3⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.A_smul_sK
statement: theorem A_smul_sK {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ EL t) : A U • sK U k = sK U (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := U.covering.eqOn_of_lift ((convex_EL (t := t))).isPreconnected
    (σ₁ := fun p ↦ A U • sK U p) (σ₂ := fun p ↦ sK U (p + 1))
    ((continuous_const_smul _).comp_continuousOn ((continuousOn_sK₁ U).mono fun _ h ↦ EL_subset h))
    ((continuousOn_sK₁ U).comp (continuous_add_const 1).continuousOn fun _ h ↦ EL_add_subset h)
    (fun p hp ↦ by
      change U.ψ (A U • sK U p) ∈ _
      rw [ψ_A_smul, ψ_sK U (K₁_subset (EL_subset hp))]
      exact K_subset t (K₁_subset (EL_add_subset hp)))
    (fun p hp ↦ by
      change U.ψ (A U • sK U p) = U.ψ (sK U (p + 1))
      rw [ψ_A_smul, ψ_sK U (K₁_subset (EL_subset hp)),
        ψ_sK U (K₁_subset (EL_add_subset hp))])
    (a₀ := pL t) ⟨cx_pL, by rw [cy_pL]; norm_num, by rw [cy_pL]; norm_num⟩
    (A_smul_pL U)
  exact this hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.B_smul_sK
statement: theorem B_smul_sK {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ EB t) : B U • sK U k = sK U (k + t)
proof:
:= by
  have := U.covering.eqOn_of_lift ((convex_EB (t := t))).isPreconnected
    (σ₁ := fun p ↦ B U • sK U p) (σ₂ := fun p ↦ sK U (p + t))
    ((continuous_const_smul _).comp_continuousOn ((continuousOn_sK₂ U).mono fun _ h ↦ EB_subset h))
    ((continuousOn_sK₂ U).comp (continuous_add_const _).continuousOn fun _ h ↦ EB_add_subset h)
    (fun p hp ↦ by
      change U.ψ (B U • sK U p) ∈ _
      rw [ψ_B_smul, ψ_sK U (K₂_subset (EB_subset hp))]
      exact K_subset t (K₂_subset (EB_add_subset hp)))
    (fun p hp ↦ by
      change U.ψ (B U • sK U p) = U.ψ (sK U (p + t))
      rw [ψ_B_smul, ψ_sK U (K₂_subset (EB_subset hp)),
        ψ_sK U (K₂_subset (EB_add_subset hp))])
    (a₀ := pB) ⟨cy_pB, by rw [cx_pB]; norm_num, by rw [cx_pB]; norm_num⟩
    (B_smul_pB U)
  exact this hk

name: Uniformization.Generators.A_mem_H
statement: theorem A_mem_H : A U ∈ H U
proof: := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

name: Uniformization.Generators.B_mem_H
statement: theorem B_mem_H : B U ∈ H U
proof: := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

name: Uniformization.Generators.neg_one_mem_H
statement: theorem neg_one_mem_H : (-1 : SL(2, ℝ)) ∈ H U
proof: := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

name: Uniformization.Generators.neg_one_smul'
statement: theorem neg_one_smul' (τ : ℍ) : (-1 : SL(2, ℝ)) • τ = τ
proof:
:= by
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ext
  rw [coe_SL2R_smul]
  simp

name: Uniformization.Generators.neg_one_mem_deckGroup
statement: theorem neg_one_mem_deckGroup : (-1 : SL(2, ℝ)) ∈ U.deckGroup
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun τ ↦ by rw [neg_one_smul', add_zero]⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.H_le
statement: theorem H_le : H U ≤ U.deckGroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [H, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl
  exacts [A_mem U, B_mem U, neg_one_mem_deckGroup U]

name: Uniformization.Generators.mem_H_of_fixed
statement:
theorem mem_H_of_fixed {g : SL(2, ℝ)} (hg : g ∈ U.deckGroup) {τ : ℍ} (h : g • τ = τ) :
    g ∈ H U
proof:
:= by
  rcases U.eq_one_or_neg_one hg h with rfl | rfl
  exacts [(H U).one_mem, neg_one_mem_H U]

name: Uniformization.Generators.K_bounds
statement:
theorem K_bounds {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) :
    0 ≤ cx t k ∧ cx t k ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ cy t k ∧ cy t k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  · exact ⟨h1, h2, h3.le, h4.le⟩
  · exact ⟨h1.le, h2.le, h3, h4⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.cy_mem_of_cx
statement:
theorem cy_mem_of_cx {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) (h : cx t k = 0 ∨ cx t k = 1) :
    0 < cy t k ∧ cy t k < 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  · exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
  · rcases h with h | h <;> linarith

name: Uniformization.Generators.cx_mem_of_cy
statement:
theorem cx_mem_of_cy {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) (h : cy t k = 0 ∨ cy t k = 1) :
    0 < cx t k ∧ cx t k < 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  · rcases h with h | h <;> linarith
  · exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.int_eq_zero_of
statement:
theorem int_eq_zero_of {m : ℤ} {a b : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1)
    (h : b = a + m) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (m : ℝ) < 1 := by linarith
  have h2 : (-1 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have h1' : m < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have h2' : -1 < m := by exact_mod_cast h2
  omega

name: Uniformization.Generators.mem_H_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem mem_H_of_smul_eq {δ : SL(2, ℝ)} (hδ : δ ∈ U.deckGroup) {k k' : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t)
    (hk' : k' ∈ K t) (h : δ • sK U k = sK U k') : δ ∈ H U
proof:
:= by
  have hδ' := hδ
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hψ⟩ := hδ
  have hkk : k' = k + l := by
    have := hψ (sK U k); rwa [h, ψ_sK U hk', ψ_sK U hk] at this
  obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn⟩ := (mem_lattice_iff t l).mp hl
  have hx : cx t k' = cx t k + n := by rw [hkk, cx_add, hn]
  have hy : cy t k' = cy t k + m := by rw [hkk, cy_add, hm]
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := K_bounds hk
  obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := K_bounds hk'
  have hn1 : -1 ≤ n := by
    have : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hn2 : n ≤ 1 := by
    have : (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hm1 : -1 ≤ m := by
    have : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hm2 : m ≤ 1 := by
    have : (m : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hl_eq : ∀ a b : ℝ, cx t l = a → cy t l = b → l = (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) * t := fun a b ha hb ↦ by
    rw [eq_cx_cy t l, ha, hb]
  rcases (show n = -1 ∨ n = 0 ∨ n = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · 
    have hcx : cx t k' = 0 := by push_cast at hx; linarith
    have hcy := cy_mem_of_cx hk' (Or.inl hcx)
    have hm0' : -m = 0 := int_eq_zero_of hcy.1 hcy.2 a3 a4 (by push_cast; linarith)
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
    subst hm0
    have hl1 : l = -1 := by rw [hl_eq (-1) 0 (by rw [hn]; simp) (by rw [hm]; simp)]; simp
    have hkk' : k = k' + 1 := by rw [hkk, hl1]; ring
    have hE : k' ∈ EL t := ⟨hcx, hcy⟩
    have h1 : (A U * δ) • sK U k = sK U k := by
      rw [mul_smul, h, A_smul_sK U hE, ← hkk']
    have := mem_H_of_fixed U (mul_mem (A_mem U) hδ') h1
    have h2 : δ = (A U)⁻¹ * (A U * δ) := by group
    rw [h2]; exact mul_mem (inv_mem (A_mem_H U)) this
  · rcases (show m = -1 ∨ m = 0 ∨ m = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · 
      have hcy : cy t k' = 0 := by push_cast at hy; linarith
      have hcx := cx_mem_of_cy hk' (Or.inl hcy)
      have hlt : l = -t := by rw [hl_eq 0 (-1) (by rw [hn]; simp) (by rw [hm]; simp)]; simp
      have hkk' : k = k' + t := by rw [hkk, hlt]; ring
      have hE : k' ∈ EB t := ⟨hcy, hcx⟩
      have h1 : (B U * δ) • sK U k = sK U k := by
        rw [mul_smul, h, B_smul_sK U hE, ← hkk']
      have := mem_H_of_fixed U (mul_mem (B_mem U) hδ') h1
      have h2 : δ = (B U)⁻¹ * (B U * δ) := by group
      rw [h2]; exact mul_mem (inv_mem (B_mem_H U)) this
    · have hl0 : l = 0 := by rw [hl_eq 0 0 (by rw [hn]; simp) (by rw [hm]; simp)]; simp
      rw [hl0, add_zero] at hkk
      rw [hkk] at h
      exact mem_H_of_fixed U hδ' h
    · 
      have hcy : cy t k = 0 := by push_cast at hy; linarith
      have hcx := cx_mem_of_cy hk (Or.inl hcy)
      have hlt : l = t := by rw [hl_eq 0 1 (by rw [hn]; simp) (by rw [hm]; simp)]; simp
      have hE : k ∈ EB t := ⟨hcy, hcx⟩
      have h1 : ((B U)⁻¹ * δ) • sK U k = sK U k := by
        rw [mul_smul, h, hkk, hlt, ← B_smul_sK U hE, inv_smul_smul]
      have := mem_H_of_fixed U (mul_mem (inv_mem (B_mem U)) hδ') h1
      have h2 : δ = B U * ((B U)⁻¹ * δ) := by group
      rw [h2]; exact mul_mem (B_mem_H U) this
  · 
    have hcx : cx t k = 0 := by push_cast at hx; linarith
    have hcy := cy_mem_of_cx hk (Or.inl hcx)
    have hm0 : m = 0 := int_eq_zero_of hcy.1 hcy.2 b3 b4 hy
    subst hm0
    have hl1 : l = 1 := by rw [hl_eq 1 0 (by rw [hn]; simp) (by rw [hm]; simp)]; simp
    have hE : k ∈ EL t := ⟨hcx, hcy⟩
    have h1 : ((A U)⁻¹ * δ) • sK U k = sK U k := by
      rw [mul_smul, h, hkk, hl1, ← A_smul_sK U hE, inv_smul_smul]
    have := mem_H_of_fixed U (mul_mem (inv_mem (A_mem U)) hδ') h1
    have h2 : δ = A U * ((A U)⁻¹ * δ) := by group
    rw [h2]; exact mul_mem (A_mem_H U) this

name: Uniformization.Generators.isOpen_preimage_univ
statement: theorem isOpen_preimage_univ : IsOpen ((fun τ : ℍ ↦ U.Ψ τ) ⁻¹' ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  convert isOpen_univ
  ext τ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_compl_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_univ, iff_true]
  exact U.ψ_notMem τ

name: Uniformization.Generators.isOpen_box
statement:
theorem isOpen_box (a b c d : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {z | a < cx t z ∧ cx t z < b ∧ c < cy t z ∧ cy t z < d}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [setOf_and]
  exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_cx t)).inter
    ((isOpen_lt (continuous_cx t) continuous_const).inter
    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_cy t)).inter
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_cy t) continuous_const)))

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_local_section
statement:
theorem exists_local_section {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) {O : Set ℂ} (hO : IsOpen O) (hkO : k ∈ O)
    (hOΩ : O ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ σ : ℂ → ℍ, ball k r ⊆ O ∧ ContinuousOn σ (ball k r) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ ball k r, U.ψ (σ p) = p) ∧ σ k = sK U k ∧ σ '' ball k r ∈ 𝓝 (sK U k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO k hkO
  obtain ⟨σ, hσc, hσψ, hσk⟩ := U.covering.exists_lift_of_convex (convex_ball k r)
    continuousOn_id (fun p hp ↦ hOΩ (hrO hp)) (mem_ball_self hr) (e₀ := sK U k) (ψ_sK U hk)
  refine ⟨r, hr, σ, hrO, hσc, hσψ, hσk, ?_⟩
  have hopen := isOpen_image_of_section (f := fun τ : ℍ ↦ U.Ψ τ) isOpen_ball
    (fun p hp ↦ hOΩ (hrO hp)) (isOpen_preimage_univ U)
    U.covering.continuousOn (fun e he ↦ by
      obtain ⟨φ, heφ, hφ⟩ := U.covering.isLocalHomeomorphOn e he
      exact ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source.mem_nhds heφ, hφ ▸ φ.injOn⟩) hσc hσψ
  exact hopen.mem_nhds ⟨k, mem_ball_self hr, hσk⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.agree
statement:
theorem agree {kk : ℂ} {σ σ' : ℂ → ℍ} {C : Set ℂ} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hkC : kk ∈ C)
    (hσ : ContinuousOn σ C) (hσ' : ContinuousOn σ' C) (hψ : ∀ p ∈ C, U.ψ (σ p) = p)
    (hψ' : ∀ p ∈ C, U.ψ (σ' p) = p) (hCΩ : C ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ)
    (h0 : σ kk = σ' kk) : EqOn σ σ' C
proof:
:=
  U.covering.eqOn_of_lift hC.isPreconnected hσ hσ'
    (fun p hp ↦ by change U.ψ (σ p) ∈ _; rw [hψ p hp]; exact hCΩ hp)
    (fun p hp ↦ by change U.ψ (σ p) = U.ψ (σ' p); rw [hψ p hp, hψ' p hp]) hkC h0

name: Uniformization.Generators.lattice_cy_int
statement: theorem lattice_cy_int {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ (Lt t).lattice) : ∃ m : ℤ, cy t z = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, hm, -⟩ := (mem_lattice_iff t z).mp hz; exact ⟨m, hm⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.lattice_cx_int
statement: theorem lattice_cx_int {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ (Lt t).lattice) : ∃ n : ℤ, cx t z = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, -, hn⟩ := (mem_lattice_iff t z).mp hz; exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.notMem_of_cy
statement: theorem notMem_of_cy {z : ℂ} (h0 : 0 < cy t z) (h1 : cy t z < 1) : z ∉ (Lt t).lattice
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := lattice_cy_int hz
  rw [hm] at h0 h1
  have : (0 : ℤ) < m := by exact_mod_cast h0
  have : m < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  omega

name: Uniformization.Generators.notMem_of_cx
statement: theorem notMem_of_cx {z : ℂ} (h0 : 0 < cx t z) (h1 : cx t z < 1) : z ∉ (Lt t).lattice
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lattice_cx_int hz
  rw [hn] at h0 h1
  have : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast h0
  have : n < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  omega

name: Uniformization.Generators.tiled_interior
statement:
theorem tiled_interior {k : ℂ} (hx0 : 0 < cx t k) (hx1 : cx t k < 1) (hy0 : 0 < cy t k)
    (hy1 : cy t k < 1) : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (sK U k), TiledBy U N
proof:
:= by
  set O : Set ℂ := {z | 0 < cx t z ∧ cx t z < 1 ∧ 0 < cy t z ∧ cy t z < 1}
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_box (t := t) _ _ _ _
  have hOK : O ⊆ K₁ t := fun z hz ↦ ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2.1.le, hz.2.2⟩
  have hOΩ : O ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ := fun z hz ↦ notMem_of_cy hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2
  have hk : k ∈ K t := K₁_subset (hOK ⟨hx0, hx1, hy0, hy1⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, hrO, hσc, hσψ, hσk, hN⟩ :=
    exists_local_section U hk hO ⟨hx0, hx1, hy0, hy1⟩ hOΩ
  refine ⟨_, hN, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have := agree U (convex_ball k r) (mem_ball_self hr) hσc
    ((continuousOn_sK₁ U).mono fun q hq ↦ hOK (hrO hq)) hσψ
    (fun q hq ↦ ψ_sK U (K₁_subset (hOK (hrO hq)))) (fun q hq ↦ hOΩ (hrO hq)) hσk hp
  exact ⟨1, (H U).one_mem, p, K₁_subset (hOK (hrO hp)), by rw [this, one_smul]⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.tiled_left
statement: theorem tiled_left {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ EL t) : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (sK U k), TiledBy U N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy0, hy1⟩ := hk
  set O : Set ℂ := {z | -1 / 2 < cx t z ∧ cx t z < 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < cy t z ∧ cy t z < 1}
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_box (t := t) _ _ _ _
  have hkO : k ∈ O := ⟨by rw [hx]; norm_num, by rw [hx]; norm_num, hy0, hy1⟩
  have hOΩ : O ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ := fun z hz ↦ notMem_of_cy hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2
  have hkK : k ∈ K t := K₁_subset (EL_subset ⟨hx, hy0, hy1⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, hrO, hσc, hσψ, hσk, hN⟩ := exists_local_section U hkK hO hkO hOΩ
  refine ⟨_, hN, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hpO := hrO hp
  by_cases hpx : 0 ≤ cx t p
  · 
    have hK1 : ∀ q ∈ ball k r ∩ K₁ t, q ∈ K₁ t := fun q hq ↦ hq.2
    have hpK : p ∈ K₁ t := ⟨hpx, by linarith [hpO.2.1], hpO.2.2.1, hpO.2.2.2⟩
    have := agree U ((convex_ball k r).inter (convex_K₁ t))
      ⟨mem_ball_self hr, EL_subset ⟨hx, hy0, hy1⟩⟩ (hσc.mono inter_subset_left)
      ((continuousOn_sK₁ U).mono hK1) (fun q hq ↦ hσψ q hq.1)
      (fun q hq ↦ ψ_sK U (K₁_subset hq.2)) (fun q hq ↦ hOΩ (hrO hq.1)) hσk ⟨hp, hpK⟩
    exact ⟨1, (H U).one_mem, p, K₁_subset hpK, by rw [this, one_smul]⟩
  · 
    push Not at hpx
    set C := ball k r ∩ (fun z ↦ z + 1) ⁻¹' K₁ t
    have hC : Convex ℝ C := (convex_ball k r).inter ((convex_K₁ t).translate_preimage_left 1)
    have hpK : p + 1 ∈ K₁ t := by
      simp only [K₁, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_one, cy_one, add_zero]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hpO.1], by linarith, hpO.2.2.1, hpO.2.2.2⟩
    have hkC : k ∈ C := ⟨mem_ball_self hr, EL_add_subset ⟨hx, hy0, hy1⟩⟩
    have hσ' : ContinuousOn (fun q ↦ (A U)⁻¹ • sK U (q + 1)) C :=
      (continuous_const_smul _).comp_continuousOn ((continuousOn_sK₁ U).comp
        (continuous_add_const 1).continuousOn fun q hq ↦ hq.2)
    have := agree U hC hkC (hσc.mono inter_subset_left) hσ'
      (fun q hq ↦ hσψ q hq.1)
      (fun q hq ↦ by
        rw [ψ_A_inv_smul, ψ_sK U (K₁_subset hq.2)]; ring)
      (fun q hq ↦ hOΩ (hrO hq.1))
      (by rw [← A_smul_sK U ⟨hx, hy0, hy1⟩, inv_smul_smul, hσk]) ⟨hp, hpK⟩
    exact ⟨(A U)⁻¹, inv_mem (A_mem_H U), p + 1, K₁_subset hpK, this⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.tiled_bottom
statement: theorem tiled_bottom {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ EB t) : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (sK U k), TiledBy U N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hy, hx0, hx1⟩ := hk
  set O : Set ℂ := {z | 0 < cx t z ∧ cx t z < 1 ∧ -1 / 2 < cy t z ∧ cy t z < 1 / 2}
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_box (t := t) _ _ _ _
  have hkO : k ∈ O := ⟨hx0, hx1, by rw [hy]; norm_num, by rw [hy]; norm_num⟩
  have hOΩ : O ⊆ ((Lt t).lattice : Set ℂ)ᶜ := fun z hz ↦ notMem_of_cx hz.1 hz.2.1
  have hkK : k ∈ K t := K₂_subset (EB_subset ⟨hy, hx0, hx1⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, hrO, hσc, hσψ, hσk, hN⟩ := exists_local_section U hkK hO hkO hOΩ
  refine ⟨_, hN, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hpO := hrO hp
  by_cases hpy : 0 ≤ cy t p
  · have hK2 : ∀ q ∈ ball k r ∩ K₂ t, q ∈ K₂ t := fun q hq ↦ hq.2
    have hpK : p ∈ K₂ t := ⟨hpO.1, hpO.2.1, hpy, by linarith [hpO.2.2.2]⟩
    have := agree U ((convex_ball k r).inter (convex_K₂ t))
      ⟨mem_ball_self hr, EB_subset ⟨hy, hx0, hx1⟩⟩ (hσc.mono inter_subset_left)
      ((continuousOn_sK₂ U).mono hK2) (fun q hq ↦ hσψ q hq.1)
      (fun q hq ↦ ψ_sK U (K₂_subset hq.2)) (fun q hq ↦ hOΩ (hrO hq.1)) hσk ⟨hp, hpK⟩
    exact ⟨1, (H U).one_mem, p, K₂_subset hpK, by rw [this, one_smul]⟩
  · push Not at hpy
    set C := ball k r ∩ (fun z ↦ z + (t : ℂ)) ⁻¹' K₂ t
    have hC : Convex ℝ C := (convex_ball k r).inter ((convex_K₂ t).translate_preimage_left _)
    have hpK : p + t ∈ K₂ t := by
      simp only [K₂, mem_setOf_eq, cx_add, cy_add, cx_t, cy_t, add_zero]
      exact ⟨hpO.1, hpO.2.1, by linarith [hpO.2.2.1], by linarith⟩
    have hkC : k ∈ C := ⟨mem_ball_self hr, EB_add_subset ⟨hy, hx0, hx1⟩⟩
    have hσ' : ContinuousOn (fun q ↦ (B U)⁻¹ • sK U (q + t)) C :=
      (continuous_const_smul _).comp_continuousOn ((continuousOn_sK₂ U).comp
        (continuous_add_const _).continuousOn fun q hq ↦ hq.2)
    have := agree U hC hkC (hσc.mono inter_subset_left) hσ'
      (fun q hq ↦ hσψ q hq.1)
      (fun q hq ↦ by
        rw [ψ_B_inv_smul, ψ_sK U (K₂_subset hq.2)]; ring)
      (fun q hq ↦ hOΩ (hrO hq.1))
      (by rw [← B_smul_sK U ⟨hy, hx0, hx1⟩, inv_smul_smul, hσk]) ⟨hp, hpK⟩
    exact ⟨(B U)⁻¹, inv_mem (B_mem_H U), p + t, K₂_subset hpK, this⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.tiled_smul
statement:
theorem tiled_smul {g : SL(2, ℝ)} (hg : g ∈ H U) {τ : ℍ} (h : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 τ, TiledBy U N) :
    ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (g • τ), TiledBy U N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hT⟩ := h
  refine ⟨g • N, (smul_mem_nhds_smul_iff g).mpr hN, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, k', hk', rfl⟩ := hT ν hν
  exact ⟨g * δ, mul_mem hg hδ, k', hk', by rw [mul_smul]⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_nhds_tiles
statement: theorem exists_nhds_tiles {k : ℂ} (hk : k ∈ K t) : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (sK U k), TiledBy U N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := K_bounds hk
  rcases a1.lt_or_eq with hx0 | hx0
  · rcases a2.lt_or_eq with hx1 | hx1
    · rcases a3.lt_or_eq with hy0 | hy0
      · rcases a4.lt_or_eq with hy1 | hy1
        · exact tiled_interior U hx0 hx1 hy0 hy1
        · 
          have hE : k - t ∈ EB t := ⟨by rw [cy_sub, cy_t, hy1]; ring,
            by rw [cx_sub, cx_t, sub_zero]; exact hx0, by rw [cx_sub, cx_t, sub_zero]; exact hx1⟩
          have heq : B U • sK U (k - t) = sK U k := by rw [B_smul_sK U hE, sub_add_cancel]
          rw [← heq]; exact tiled_smul U (B_mem_H U) (tiled_bottom U hE)
      · exact tiled_bottom U ⟨hy0.symm, hx0, hx1⟩
    · 
      have hcy := cy_mem_of_cx hk (Or.inr hx1)
      have hE : k - 1 ∈ EL t := ⟨by rw [cx_sub, cx_one, hx1]; ring,
        by rw [cy_sub, cy_one, sub_zero]; exact hcy.1,
        by rw [cy_sub, cy_one, sub_zero]; exact hcy.2⟩
      have heq : A U • sK U (k - 1) = sK U k := by rw [A_smul_sK U hE, sub_add_cancel]
      rw [← heq]; exact tiled_smul U (A_mem_H U) (tiled_left U hE)
  · exact tiled_left U ⟨hx0.symm, cy_mem_of_cx hk (Or.inl hx0.symm)⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.exists_tile
statement: theorem exists_tile (σ : ℍ) : ∃ g ∈ U.deckGroup, ∃ k ∈ K t, σ = g • sK U k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hdiff⟩ := exists_mem_K t (U.ψ_notMem σ)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgk⟩ := U.exists_mem_deckGroup (τ := sK U k) (τ' := σ)
    (by rw [ψ_sK U hk]; exact hdiff)
  exact ⟨g, hg, k, hk, hgk.symm⟩

name: Uniformization.Generators.deckGroup_le
statement: theorem deckGroup_le : U.deckGroup ≤ H U
proof:
:= by
  set Uset : Set ℍ := {σ | ∃ h ∈ H U, ∃ k ∈ K t, σ = h • sK U k}
  set Vset : Set ℍ := {σ | ∃ g ∈ U.deckGroup, g ∉ H U ∧ ∃ k ∈ K t, σ = g • sK U k}
  have hUo : IsOpen Uset := isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun σ ⟨h, hh, k, hk, hσ⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hT⟩ := tiled_smul U hh (exists_nhds_tiles U hk)
    rw [hσ]
    refine mem_of_superset hN fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, k', hk', rfl⟩ := hT ν hν
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, k', hk', rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen Vset := isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun σ ⟨g, hg, hgH, k, hk, hσ⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hT⟩ := exists_nhds_tiles U hk
    rw [hσ]
    refine mem_of_superset ((smul_mem_nhds_smul_iff g).mpr hN) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, k', hk', rfl⟩ := hT ν hν
    refine ⟨g * δ, mul_mem hg (H_le U hδ), fun h ↦ hgH ?_, k', hk', by rw [mul_smul]⟩
    have : g = g * δ * δ⁻¹ := by group
    rw [this]; exact mul_mem h (inv_mem hδ)
  have hdisj : Disjoint Uset Vset := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro σ ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩ ⟨g, hg, hgH, k', hk', heq⟩
    apply hgH
    have h1 : (h⁻¹ * g) • sK U k' = sK U k := by rw [mul_smul, ← heq, inv_smul_smul]
    have := mem_H_of_smul_eq U (mul_mem (inv_mem (H_le U hh)) hg) hk' hk h1
    have : g = h * (h⁻¹ * g) := by group
    rw [this]; exact mul_mem hh ‹_›
  have hcover : (univ : Set ℍ) ⊆ Uset ∪ Vset := fun σ _ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨g, hg, k, hk, rfl⟩ := exists_tile U σ
    by_cases hgH : g ∈ H U
    · exact Or.inl ⟨g, hgH, k, hk, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨g, hg, hgH, k, hk, rfl⟩
  have hne : ((univ : Set ℍ) ∩ Uset).Nonempty :=
    ⟨sK U (c₀ t), mem_univ _, 1, (H U).one_mem, c₀ t, K₁_subset (c₀_mem₁ t), by rw [one_smul]⟩
  have hsub := isPreconnected_univ.subset_left_of_subset_union hUo hVo hdisj hcover hne
  intro g hg
  by_contra hgH
  have hV : g • sK U (c₀ t) ∈ Vset := ⟨g, hg, hgH, c₀ t, K₁_subset (c₀_mem₁ t), rfl⟩
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (hsub (mem_univ _)) hV

name: Uniformization.coe_SL2R_smul
statement:
theorem coe_SL2R_smul (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    ((g • τ : ℍ) : ℂ) = ((g 0 0 : ℂ) * τ + g 0 1) / ((g 1 0 : ℂ) * τ + g 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]; rfl

name: Uniformization.denom_SL2R_ne_zero
statement:
theorem denom_SL2R_ne_zero (g : SL(2, ℝ)) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (g 1 0 : ℂ) * z + g 1 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := UpperHalfPlane.denom_ne_zero (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) ⟨z, hz⟩
  simpa [UpperHalfPlane.denom] using this

name: Uniformization.ofComplex_of_im_pos
statement: theorem ofComplex_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) : ((ofComplex z : ℍ) : ℂ) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos hz]

name: Uniformization.HolomorphicH.smul
statement:
theorem HolomorphicH.smul {F : ℍ → ℍ} (hF : HolomorphicH F) (g : SL(2, ℝ)) :
    HolomorphicH fun τ ↦ g • F τ
proof:
:= by
  unfold HolomorphicH at *
  have : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z ↦ ((g 0 0 : ℂ) * (F (ofComplex z) : ℂ) + g 0 1) /
      ((g 1 0 : ℂ) * (F (ofComplex z) : ℂ) + g 1 1)) {z | 0 < z.im} :=
    (((differentiableOn_const _).mul hF).add_const _).div
      (((differentiableOn_const _).mul hF).add_const _)
      fun z _ ↦ denom_SL2R_ne_zero g (F (ofComplex z)).im_pos
  exact this.congr fun z _ ↦ coe_SL2R_smul g _

name: Uniformization.HolomorphicH.comp_smul
statement:
theorem HolomorphicH.comp_smul {F : ℍ → ℍ} (hF : HolomorphicH F) (g : SL(2, ℝ)) :
    HolomorphicH fun τ ↦ F (g • τ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HolomorphicH at *
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z ↦ ((g 0 0 : ℂ) * z + g 0 1) / ((g 1 0 : ℂ) * z + g 1 1))
      {z | 0 < z.im} :=
    (((differentiableOn_const _).mul differentiableOn_id).add_const _).div
      (((differentiableOn_const _).mul differentiableOn_id).add_const _)
      fun z hz ↦ denom_SL2R_ne_zero g hz
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun z ↦ ((g 0 0 : ℂ) * z + g 0 1) / ((g 1 0 : ℂ) * z + g 1 1))
      {z | 0 < z.im} {z | 0 < z.im} := fun z hz ↦ by
    have := (g • (⟨z, hz⟩ : ℍ)).im_pos
    rwa [← UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, coe_SL2R_smul] at this
  refine (hF.comp hg hmaps).congr fun z hz ↦ ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  congr 2
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ext
  rw [ofComplex_of_im_pos (hmaps hz), ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos hz, coe_SL2R_smul]

name: Uniformization.discConj_mem_ball
statement: theorem discConj_mem_ball (F : ℍ → ℍ) (w : ℂ) : discConj F w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1
proof:
:=
  cayley_mem_ball (F _).im_pos

name: Uniformization.differentiableOn_discConj
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_discConj {F : ℍ → ℍ} (hF : HolomorphicH F) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (discConj F) (ball 0 1)
proof:
:=
  (differentiableOn_cayley.comp (hF.comp differentiableOn_cayleyInv fun _ hw ↦ im_cayleyInv_pos hw)
    fun z _ ↦ (F (ofComplex (cayleyInv z))).im_pos : _)

name: Uniformization.cayleyInv_zero
statement: theorem cayleyInv_zero : cayleyInv 0 = I
proof: := by simp [cayleyInv]

name: Uniformization.cayley_I
statement: theorem cayley_I : cayley I = 0
proof: := by simp [cayley]

name: Uniformization.discConj_comp
statement:
theorem discConj_comp {F G : ℍ → ℍ} (w : ℂ) :
    discConj F (discConj G w) = discConj (F ∘ G) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold discConj
  rw [cayleyInv_cayley (G _).im_pos]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  congr 3
  exact ofComplex_apply _

name: Uniformization.discConj_id
statement: theorem discConj_id {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1) : discConj id w = w
proof:
:= by
  unfold discConj
  simp only [id]
  rw [ofComplex_of_im_pos (im_cayleyInv_pos hw), cayley_cayleyInv hw]

name: Uniformization.cayley_rot_smul
statement:
theorem cayley_rot_smul (e : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (τ : ℍ) :
    cayley ((rot e he • τ : ℍ) : ℂ) = e ^ 2 * cayley τ
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : e.re ^ 2 + e.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have := Complex.sq_norm e; rw [he, normSq_apply] at this; nlinarith
  have hcoe : ((rot e he • τ : ℍ) : ℂ) =
      ((e.re : ℂ) * τ + e.im) / (-(e.im : ℂ) * τ + e.re) := by
    rw [coe_SL2R_smul]; simp [rot]
  have hden : -(e.im : ℂ) * τ + e.re ≠ 0 := by
    have := denom_SL2R_ne_zero (rot e he) τ.im_pos
    simpa [rot] using this
  have hτI := add_I_ne_zero τ.im_pos
  have hconj : ((e.re : ℂ) - e.im * I) * e = 1 := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mul_re, mul_im] <;> nlinarith [hsq]
  have hnum : (e.re : ℂ) * τ + e.im - (-(e.im : ℂ) * τ + e.re) * I = e * (τ - I) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mul_re, mul_im] <;> ring
  have hden2 : (e.re : ℂ) * τ + e.im + I * (-(e.im : ℂ) * τ + e.re) =
      ((e.re : ℂ) - e.im * I) * (τ + I) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mul_re, mul_im] <;> ring
  have hc : ((e.re : ℂ) - e.im * I) = e⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hconj
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at he
  rw [hcoe, cayley, cayley, div_sub' hden, div_add' _ _ _ hden, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hden,
    hnum, hden2, hc]
  field_simp

name: Uniformization.exists_SL2R_eq_of_holomorphic
statement:
theorem exists_SL2R_eq_of_holomorphic {T S : ℍ → ℍ} (hT : HolomorphicH T) (hS : HolomorphicH S)
    (hTS : ∀ τ, T (S τ) = τ) (hST : ∀ τ, S (T τ) = τ) : ∃ g : SL(2, ℝ), ∀ τ, T τ = g • τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq SL(2, ℝ) (T UpperHalfPlane.I) UpperHalfPlane.I
  set F : ℍ → ℍ := fun τ ↦ g₀ • T τ
  set Fi : ℍ → ℍ := fun τ ↦ S (g₀⁻¹ • τ)
  have hFFi : F ∘ Fi = id := by funext τ; simp [F, Fi, hTS]
  have hFiF : Fi ∘ F = id := by funext τ; simp [F, Fi, hST]
  have hF : HolomorphicH F := hT.smul g₀
  have hFi : HolomorphicH Fi := hS.comp_smul g₀⁻¹
  set G := discConj F
  set H := discConj Fi
  have hofI : (ofComplex (cayleyInv 0) : ℍ) = UpperHalfPlane.I := by
    rw [cayleyInv_zero]; exact ofComplex_apply UpperHalfPlane.I
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
    change cayley (F (ofComplex (cayleyInv 0))) = 0
    rw [hofI]; simp only [F, hg₀]; exact cayley_I
  have hH0 : H 0 = 0 := by
    change cayley (Fi (ofComplex (cayleyInv 0))) = 0
    rw [hofI]
    have : g₀⁻¹ • UpperHalfPlane.I = T UpperHalfPlane.I := by rw [inv_smul_eq_iff, hg₀]
    simp only [Fi, this, hST]; exact cayley_I
  have hHG : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, H (G w) = w := fun w hw ↦ by
    change discConj Fi (discConj F w) = w
    rw [discConj_comp, hFiF, discConj_id hw]
  have hmaps : ∀ K : ℍ → ℍ, MapsTo (discConj K) (ball 0 1) (closedBall 0 1) :=
    fun K w _ ↦ ball_subset_closedBall (discConj_mem_ball K w)
  have hGle : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖G w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := fun w hw ↦
    Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball (differentiableOn_discConj hF) (hmaps F) hG0
      (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw)
  have hHle : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖H w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := fun w hw ↦
    Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball (differentiableOn_discConj hFi) (hmaps Fi) hH0
      (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw)
  have hGnorm : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖G w‖ = ‖w‖ := fun w hw ↦ le_antisymm (hGle w hw) (by
    have := hHle (G w) (discConj_mem_ball F w)
    rwa [hHG w hw] at this)
  
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; norm_num
  set u := dslope G 0 (1 / 2)
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u]
    rw [dslope_of_ne _ (by norm_num), slope_def_field, hG0, sub_zero, sub_zero, norm_div,
      hGnorm _ hhalf]
    norm_num
  have hGu : ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, G w = w * u := by
    intro w hw
    have := Complex.affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_norm_dslope_eq_div (R₁ := 1) (R₂ := 1)
      (differentiableOn_discConj hF)
      (by change MapsTo G _ (closedBall (G 0) 1); rw [hG0]; exact hmaps F) hhalf
      (by change ‖u‖ = 1 / 1; rw [hu]; norm_num) hw
    change G w = _ at this
    rw [this]
    change G 0 + (w - 0) • u = w * u
    rw [hG0]; simp [smul_eq_mul]
  
  set e : ℂ := u ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹
  have he2 : e ^ 2 = u := cpow_nat_inv_pow u two_ne_zero
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
    have h1 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← norm_pow, he2, hu]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg e]
  refine ⟨g₀⁻¹ * rot e he, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hFτ : F τ = rot e he • τ := by
    apply UpperHalfPlane.ext
    have h1 : cayley (F τ) = cayley ((rot e he • τ : ℍ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [cayley_rot_smul, he2]
      have : G (cayley τ) = cayley (F τ) := by
        change cayley (F (ofComplex (cayleyInv (cayley τ)))) = _
        rw [cayleyInv_cayley τ.im_pos, ofComplex_apply]
      rw [← this, hGu _ (cayley_mem_ball τ.im_pos), mul_comm]
    have := congrArg cayleyInv h1
    rwa [cayleyInv_cayley (F τ).im_pos, cayleyInv_cayley (rot e he • τ).im_pos] at this
  rw [mul_smul, ← hFτ]
  simp [F]

name: Uniformization.analyticAt_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem analyticAt_of_differentiableOn {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 z) : AnalyticAt ℂ f z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hV, hzV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  exact (hf.mono hVU).analyticAt (hV.mem_nhds hzV)

name: Uniformization.deriv_ne_zero_of_injOn
statement:
theorem deriv_ne_zero_of_injOn {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 z) (hinj : InjOn f U) : deriv f z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  have han : AnalyticAt ℂ f z := analyticAt_of_differentiableOn hf hU
  have han' : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w ↦ f w - f z) z := han.sub analyticAt_const
  
  have hnc : ¬ ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, f w - f z = 0 := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (h.and (eventually_mem_nhds_iff.mpr
      hU |>.mono fun _ h ↦ mem_of_mem_nhds h))
    have h1 : z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ ball z ε := by
      rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; simp [abs_of_pos hε]; linarith
    have := hinj (hball _ h1).2 (hball z (mem_ball_self hε)).2
      (sub_eq_zero.mp (hball _ h1).1)
    have : ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by simpa using this
    exact (by positivity : (ε / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast this)
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg, hgz, hfg⟩ := han'.exists_eventuallyEq_pow_smul_nonzero_iff.mpr hnc
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hfg
  
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have := hfg.self_of_nhds
    simp only [sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul] at this
    exact hgz this.symm
  have hn1 : n ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ f w - f z) (g z) z := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ (w - z) ^ 1) 1 z := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const z
      have := (h1.mul hg.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq hfg
      simpa using this
    have : deriv (fun w ↦ f w - f z) z = deriv f z := by simp
    rw [← this, hd'.deriv] at hd
    exact hgz hd
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℂ, c ^ n = g z := ⟨g z ^ (n⁻¹ : ℂ), Complex.cpow_nat_inv_pow _ hn0⟩
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp [zero_pow hn0] at hc; exact hgz hc.symm
  set h : ℂ → ℂ := fun w ↦ c * Complex.exp (Complex.log (g w / g z) / n) with hh
  have hgw : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, g w / g z ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    have : Tendsto (fun w ↦ g w / g z) (𝓝 z) (𝓝 1) := by
      simpa [div_self hgz] using (hg.continuousAt.div_const (g z)).tendsto
    exact this.eventually (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
  have hhpow : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, h w ^ n = g w := by
    refine hgw.mono fun w hw ↦ ?_
    have hw0 : g w / g z ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hw
    rw [hh, mul_pow, hc, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast hn0),
      Complex.exp_log hw0]
    field_simp
  have hhan : AnalyticAt ℂ h z := by
    have hsl : g z / g z ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
      simp [div_self hgz]
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w ↦ g w / g z) z := hg.div_const
    have h2 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w ↦ Complex.log (g w / g z) / n) z := (h1.clog hsl).div_const
    exact analyticAt_const.mul h2.cexp'
  have hhz : h z = c := by simp [hh, div_self hgz]
  set φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w ↦ (w - z) * h w with hφ
  have hφd : HasStrictDerivAt φ c z := by
    have h1 : HasStrictDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ w - z) 1 z := (hasStrictDerivAt_id z).sub_const z
    have := HasStrictDerivAt.mul h1 hhan.hasStrictDerivAt
    simp only [one_mul, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, hhz] at this
    exact this
  have hfφ : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, f w = f z + φ w ^ n := by
    filter_upwards [hfg, hhpow] with w h1 h2
    rw [hφ, mul_pow, h2, ← h1]; ring
  
  have hmap := hφd.map_nhds_eq hc0
  have hφz : φ z = 0 := by simp [hφ]
  rw [hφz] at hmap
  have hV : {w | f w = f z + φ w ^ n} ∩ U ∈ 𝓝 z := inter_mem hfφ hU
  have hW : φ '' ({w | f w = f z + φ w ^ n} ∩ U) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hmap]; exact image_mem_map hV
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεW⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
  set ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n)
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn0
  have hζn : ζ ^ n = 1 := hprim.pow_eq_one
  have hζ1 : ζ ≠ 1 := hprim.ne_one (by omega)
  have hζnorm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]; simp
  set δ : ℂ := ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hδ : δ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ε := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; simp [δ, abs_of_pos hε]; linarith
  have hδζ : δ * ζ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) ε := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_mul, hζnorm, mul_one]; simpa using hδ
  obtain ⟨w₁, ⟨hw₁f, hw₁U⟩, hw₁⟩ := hεW hδ
  obtain ⟨w₂, ⟨hw₂f, hw₂U⟩, hw₂⟩ := hεW hδζ
  have heq : f w₁ = f w₂ := by
    rw [hw₁f, hw₂f, hw₁, hw₂, mul_pow, hζn, mul_one]
  have hw : w₁ = w₂ := hinj hw₁U hw₂U heq
  have hδ0 : δ ≠ 0 := by simp [δ, hε.ne']
  apply hζ1
  have : φ w₁ = φ w₂ := by rw [hw]
  rw [hw₁, hw₂] at this
  exact (mul_eq_left₀ hδ0).mp this.symm

name: Uniformization.differentiableAt_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_of_comp_eq {f g σ : ℂ → ℂ} {u f' : ℂ}
    (hf : HasStrictDerivAt f f' (σ u)) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) (hσ : ContinuousAt σ u)
    (hfg : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, f (σ v) = g v) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ g u) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ σ u
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := hf.to_localInverse hf'
  have hleft := hf.eventually_left_inverse hf'
  have hσ' : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, hf.localInverse f f' (σ u) hf' (f (σ v)) = σ v :=
    hσ.eventually hleft
  have heq : σ =ᶠ[𝓝 u] fun v ↦ hf.localInverse f f' (σ u) hf' (g v) := by
    filter_upwards [hσ', hfg] with v h1 h2
    rw [← h2, h1]
  have hgu : g u = f (σ u) := hfg.self_of_nhds.symm
  have : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun v ↦ hf.localInverse f f' (σ u) hf' (g v)) u := by
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (hf.localInverse f f' (σ u) hf') (g u) := by
      rw [hgu]; exact hinv.hasDerivAt.differentiableAt
    exact h2.comp u hg
  exact this.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: Uniformization.eventually_eq_of_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
statement:
theorem eventually_eq_of_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn {F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z β : ℂ}
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hF : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) (ball z r))
    (hlim : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f atTop (ball z r))
    (hne : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ w ∈ ball z r, F n w ≠ β) (hfz : f z = β) :
    ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, f w = β
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball z r) := hlim.differentiableOn hF isOpen_ball
  have han : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w ↦ f w - β) z :=
    (analyticAt_of_differentiableOn hfd (ball_mem_nhds z hr)).sub analyticAt_const
  rcases han.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with h | h
  · exact h.mono fun w hw ↦ sub_eq_zero.mp hw
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp h)
  set ρ := min ε r / 2 with hρ
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by positivity
  have hρε : ρ < ε := by rw [hρ]; linarith [min_le_left ε r]
  have hρr : ρ < r := by rw [hρ]; linarith [min_le_right ε r]
  have hsph : (sphere z ρ).Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr hρ0.le
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun w ↦ ‖f w - β‖) (sphere z ρ) :=
    ((hfd.continuousOn.mono (sphere_subset_ball hρr)).sub continuousOn_const).norm
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_sphere z ρ).exists_isMinOn hsph hcont
  set m := ‖f w₀ - β‖ with hm
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by
    refine norm_pos_iff.mpr (hεball w₀ ?_ ?_)
    · rw [mem_sphere] at hw₀; rw [mem_ball, hw₀]; exact hρε
    · intro hwz; rw [mem_sphere, hwz, dist_self] at hw₀; exact hρ0.ne' hw₀.symm
  
  have hunif : TendstoUniformlyOn F f atTop (closedBall z ρ) :=
    (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact isOpen_ball).mp hlim _
      (closedBall_subset_ball hρr) (isCompact_closedBall z ρ)
  have hclose : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ w ∈ closedBall z ρ, dist (f w) (F n w) < m / 2 :=
    Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hunif _ (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2, hn3⟩ := (hF.and (hne.and hclose)).exists
  
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w ↦ (F n w - β)⁻¹) (ball z r) :=
    (hn1.sub_const β).inv fun w hw ↦ sub_ne_zero.mpr (hn2 w hw)
  have hbound : ‖(F n z - β)⁻¹‖ ≤ (m / 2)⁻¹ := by
    refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le (f := fun w ↦ (F n w - β)⁻¹)
      (U := ball z ρ) (z := z) isBounded_ball (hdiff.diffContOnCl_ball (closedBall_subset_ball hρr))
      ?_ (subset_closure (mem_ball_self hρ0))
    · intro w hw
      rw [frontier_ball z hρ0.ne'] at hw
      have h1 : m ≤ ‖f w - β‖ := hmin hw
      have h2 : dist (f w) (F n w) < m / 2 := hn3 w (sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2
      have h3 : m / 2 ≤ ‖F n w - β‖ := by
        have := norm_add_le (F n w - β) (f w - F n w)
        have e : F n w - β + (f w - F n w) = f w - β := by ring
        rw [e] at this; linarith
      rw [norm_inv]
      exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h3
  have h4 : dist (f z) (F n z) < m / 2 := hn3 z (mem_closedBall_self hρ0.le)
  rw [hfz, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h4
  have hne0 : F n z - β ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (hn2 z (mem_ball_self hr))
  rw [norm_inv] at hbound
  have := (inv_le_inv₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hne0) (by positivity)).mp hbound
  linarith

name: Uniformization.exists_localSection
statement:
theorem exists_localSection {f : ℂ → ℂ} {f' a : ℂ} (hf : HasStrictDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ s : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn s (ball (f a) ε) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball (f a) ε, f (s y) = y) ∧
      s (f a) = a
proof:
:= by
  set e := (hf.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hf').toOpenPartialHomeomorph f
  have hsrc : a ∈ e.source := (hf.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hf').mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have htgt : f a ∈ e.target :=
    (hf.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hf').image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp e.open_target _ htgt
  refine ⟨ε, hε, e.symm, e.continuousOn_symm.mono hball, fun y hy ↦ e.right_inv (hball hy), ?_⟩
  exact e.left_inv hsrc

name: Uniformization.norm_coeff_prod_X_sub_C_le
statement:
theorem norm_coeff_prod_X_sub_C_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i))).coeff k‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 + ‖a i‖)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing k with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.prod_empty, coeff_one]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, Finset.prod_insert hj, mul_comm (X - C _)]
    have hM : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 + ‖a i‖) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ by positivity
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      rw [mul_coeff_zero, coeff_sub, coeff_X_zero, coeff_C_zero, zero_sub, norm_mul, norm_neg]
      nlinarith [ih 0, norm_nonneg (a j), norm_nonneg ((∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i))).coeff 0)]
    | succ k =>
      rw [coeff_mul_X_sub_C]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_mul]
      nlinarith [ih k, ih (k + 1), norm_nonneg (a j),
        norm_nonneg ((∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i))).coeff (k + 1))]

name: Uniformization.differentiableOn_coeff_prod_X_sub_C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing k with
  | empty => exact differentiableOn_const _
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    have ih' := ih fun i hi ↦ ha i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have hj' := ha j (Finset.mem_insert_self j s)
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have e : (fun z ↦ (∏ i ∈ insert j s, (X - C (a i z))).coeff 0) =
          fun z ↦ (∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i z))).coeff 0 * -a j z := by
        funext z
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, mul_comm (X - C _), mul_coeff_zero, coeff_sub, coeff_X_zero,
          coeff_C_zero, zero_sub]
      rw [e]
      exact (ih' 0).mul hj'.neg
    | succ k =>
      have e : (fun z ↦ (∏ i ∈ insert j s, (X - C (a i z))).coeff (k + 1)) =
          fun z ↦ (∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i z))).coeff k -
            (∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (a i z))).coeff (k + 1) * a j z := by
        funext z
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, mul_comm (X - C _), coeff_mul_X_sub_C]
      rw [e]
      exact (ih' k).sub ((ih' (k + 1)).mul hj')
